• Monitor account health metrics (usage, engagement, renewals).

• Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to customers.

• Expansion Ownership: Proactively identify, qualify, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.

• Strategic Pitching: Utilize case studies and data-driven insights to pitch new modules or seats that solve specific client pain points.

• Contract Negotiation: Lead negotiations for multi-year contracts and renewals to increase Life-Time Value (LTV) and secure long-term partnership.

• Account Planning: Develop annual success plans for high-value accounts that outline specific growth and expansion targets.

**Qualifications & Skills**

• Experience: 2–5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales (preferably in SaaS or technology).

• Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to present to senior stakeholders.

• Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with the ability to understand customer challenges and propose solutions.

• Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly learn and articulate product capabilities.

• Negotiation: Skilled in pitching case studies and securing multi-year contracts.

• Collaboration: Team player with cross-functional coordination skills (Sales, Product, Support).

• Flexibility: Willingness to work across time zones and adapt to customer needs

**Performance Metrics**

• Customer retention rate.

• Net revenue retention (NRR) Customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS).

• Product adoption and usage growth.

• Upsell/cross-sell revenue contribution.

• Number/value of multi-year contracts secured.

• Secure Case Studies from Happy Customers.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

• Customer-centric mindset with a passion for helping clients succeed.

• Strong presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to balance multiple accounts and prioritize effectively.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn

description:

Key Responsibilities

Business Leadership & P&L Ownership

* Own the full profit and loss (P&L) for Client of Pinnacle Group’s India operations across IT Services, IT Consulting, KPO, IT Training, and Software Products.

* Identify opportunities for cross-selling KPO, IT training, and software products into the existing client base.

* Represent Client of Pinnacle Group with regulators, industry associations, technology partners (e.g., global OEMs and software vendors), and at public/industry forums.

Operations & Delivery Oversight

* Oversee delivery quality and client satisfaction across all engagements, working closely with delivery and consulting leads.
* Ensure robust governance, risk management, and commercial discipline across projects and contracts.

People Leadership

* Lead, mentor, and develop the India leadership team across sales and business development, and work in tandem with the company executive suite across delivery, operations, finance, and HR.
* Build a strong local talent pipeline, with particular attention to developing talent in line with country goals.
* Foster a high-performance, client-centric culture aligned with the company’s values.

* Typically 12–20+ years of overall experience, with at least 5–10 years in a senior sales, business development, or general management capacity within IT services in India.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and the opportunity to build and scale a high-performing local leadership team.

title: Sr Product Mgr I
description:
**Are you keen to develop your Product Management career?**
**Would you enjoy working on our cutting-edge products?**
**About The Team**
Mercury is RX’s global registration and eCommerce platform, supporting the journeys that bring visitors and exhibitors to our events. It covers registration, purchasing, badging, and onsite access, connecting customer experiences with the data and business systems behind them. Our Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Success, and regional business teams work together to deliver reliable services, better customer experiences, and measurable business value.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with strong communication, influencing, and product judgment skills who can build effective relationships across a complex, international business. You’ll help shape our registration and eCommerce capabilities by turning customer insights and business needs into prioritized opportunities and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes.
  
  
Initially, you’ll have a significant role in go-to-market activity and business-unit engagement, working with regional teams to understand needs, assess readiness, remove adoption barriers, and support successful rollouts. As our operating model evolves, Product Success will take on more ongoing rollout coordination and day-to-day business engagement. You’ll help enable that transition, creating more capacity for product discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, and continuous improvement while remaining closely connected to customers and stakeholders and retaining responsibility for product decisions within your remit. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how products work in practice and using that insight to decide what should change and why.
  
  
**Responsibilities (What You’ll Do)**
**Discover opportunities and shape product direction**

* Build a deep understanding of visitor, exhibitor, and event-team needs through research, stakeholder conversations, product data, and live-event observation.
* Look beyond feature requests to uncover underlying problems, test assumptions, and distinguish local needs from opportunities with broader value.
* Assess opportunities across registration, eCommerce, and related journeys, including improvements that support revenue growth, customer experience, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations and proportionate business cases that clearly explain benefits, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Own and maintain a prioritized opportunity backlog for your area and contribute to the broader product strategy and roadmap.

**Turn priorities into measurable improvements**

* Partner with Design, Engineering, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to translate validated opportunities into clear outcomes, scope, and requirements.
* Balance customer value and business priorities with technical feasibility, operational readiness, and the needs of a shared global platform.
* Work with adjacent product and business-system teams to manage dependencies across end-to-end journeys.
* Partner with Product Analytics to define success measures, establish baselines, and evaluate releases and experiments.
* Use launch results, customer feedback, and product performance to refine priorities and continuously improve the product.

**Partner with business units on rollout and adoption**

* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across registration, marketing, commercial, and event teams.
* Initially lead agreed product-engagement forums to clarify priorities, communicate roadmap decisions, and maintain visibility of adoption barriers and dependencies.
* Assess how well existing capabilities meet event requirements and determine whether process changes, configuration, or product development is the right response.
* Work with Product Success and delivery teams on launch readiness, pilots, and adoption plans, helping teams understand available capabilities and required business changes.
* Provide product input on significant issues through established support and escalation processes, ensuring recurring problems drive product improvements rather than repeated workarounds.
* Communicate decisions, constraints, and next steps clearly without committing ahead of discovery or delivery agreement.

**Help build a scalable Product–Product Success partnership**

* Establish clear responsibilities, decision-making boundaries, and feedback loops across Product, Product Success, and business units.
* Support the phased transfer of agreed go-to-market and stakeholder-coordination activities through shared documentation, knowledge transfer, and joint working.
* Maintain continuity for business units as responsibilities evolve, pacing handovers to agreed readiness and capacity.
* Equip Product Success colleagues with clear product context, value propositions, and guidance, while using their adoption insights to inform discovery.
* Retain ownership of product priorities and outcomes within your remit as more day-to-day engagement and coordination moves to Product Success.

**Requirements (What You’ll Bring)**

* Experience managing digital products or a clearly defined product area, from problem discovery and opportunity prioritization through delivery and evaluation.
* Evidence of improvements that delivered customer or business outcomes, rather than simply completed features or project milestones.
* Strong discovery and analytical skills, including the ability to combine qualitative and quantitative evidence and recognize data limitations.
* Sound prioritization and commercial judgment, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, explain trade-offs, and constructively say “not yet.”
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams in an agile product-development environment.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, including influencing across functions and balancing regional needs with global product goals.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences, plus a practical understanding of rollout, adoption, and business change.
* The ability to learn complex workflows and integrations, navigate ambiguity, and stay focused on the highest-value problems.

**Useful, But Not Essential**

* Experience with registration, ticketing, eCommerce, payments, or other transaction-based digital products.
* Experience with global platforms serving multiple markets, business units, or customer groups.
* Familiarity with products connected to finance, CRM, identity, marketing, or reporting systems.
* Experience working with Product Success, Customer Success, or implementation teams on launches, adoption, and structured handovers.
* Experience with experimentation, conversion optimization, product analytics, or digital revenue growth.
* Experience in events or other time-critical environments where reliability and operational readiness are essential.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clear, evidence-based product priorities balancing customer needs, business value, and platform scalability.
* Product improvements with defined outcomes and measurable impact.
* Business units that understand product direction, adoption requirements, and the rationale behind decisions.
* Successful rollout and adoption of agreed capabilities, with risks and dependencies identified early.
* A sustainable partnership with Product Success, with responsibilities transferred progressively and without gaps in business engagement.
* More capacity for proactive discovery and continuous improvement, supported by strong customer and business insight.

**Why join us?**

title: Sr Product Mgr I
description:
**Are you keen to develop your Product Management career?**
**Would you enjoy working on our cutting-edge products?**
**About The Team**
Mercury is RX’s global registration and eCommerce platform, supporting the journeys that bring visitors and exhibitors to our events. It covers registration, purchasing, badging, and onsite access, connecting customer experiences with the data and business systems behind them. Our Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Success, and regional business teams work together to deliver reliable services, better customer experiences, and measurable business value.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with strong communication, influencing, and product judgment skills who can build effective relationships across a complex, international business. You’ll help shape our registration and eCommerce capabilities by turning customer insights and business needs into prioritized opportunities and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes.
  
  
Initially, you’ll have a significant role in go-to-market activity and business-unit engagement, working with regional teams to understand needs, assess readiness, remove adoption barriers, and support successful rollouts. As our operating model evolves, Product Success will take on more ongoing rollout coordination and day-to-day business engagement. You’ll help enable that transition, creating more capacity for product discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, and continuous improvement while remaining closely connected to customers and stakeholders and retaining responsibility for product decisions within your remit. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how products work in practice and using that insight to decide what should change and why.
  
  
**Responsibilities (What You’ll Do)**
**Discover opportunities and shape product direction**

* Build a deep understanding of visitor, exhibitor, and event-team needs through research, stakeholder conversations, product data, and live-event observation.
* Look beyond feature requests to uncover underlying problems, test assumptions, and distinguish local needs from opportunities with broader value.
* Assess opportunities across registration, eCommerce, and related journeys, including improvements that support revenue growth, customer experience, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations and proportionate business cases that clearly explain benefits, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Own and maintain a prioritized opportunity backlog for your area and contribute to the broader product strategy and roadmap.

**Turn priorities into measurable improvements**

* Partner with Design, Engineering, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to translate validated opportunities into clear outcomes, scope, and requirements.
* Balance customer value and business priorities with technical feasibility, operational readiness, and the needs of a shared global platform.
* Work with adjacent product and business-system teams to manage dependencies across end-to-end journeys.
* Partner with Product Analytics to define success measures, establish baselines, and evaluate releases and experiments.
* Use launch results, customer feedback, and product performance to refine priorities and continuously improve the product.

**Partner with business units on rollout and adoption**

* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across registration, marketing, commercial, and event teams.
* Initially lead agreed product-engagement forums to clarify priorities, communicate roadmap decisions, and maintain visibility of adoption barriers and dependencies.
* Assess how well existing capabilities meet event requirements and determine whether process changes, configuration, or product development is the right response.
* Work with Product Success and delivery teams on launch readiness, pilots, and adoption plans, helping teams understand available capabilities and required business changes.
* Provide product input on significant issues through established support and escalation processes, ensuring recurring problems drive product improvements rather than repeated workarounds.
* Communicate decisions, constraints, and next steps clearly without committing ahead of discovery or delivery agreement.

**Help build a scalable Product–Product Success partnership**

* Establish clear responsibilities, decision-making boundaries, and feedback loops across Product, Product Success, and business units.
* Support the phased transfer of agreed go-to-market and stakeholder-coordination activities through shared documentation, knowledge transfer, and joint working.
* Maintain continuity for business units as responsibilities evolve, pacing handovers to agreed readiness and capacity.
* Equip Product Success colleagues with clear product context, value propositions, and guidance, while using their adoption insights to inform discovery.
* Retain ownership of product priorities and outcomes within your remit as more day-to-day engagement and coordination moves to Product Success.

**Requirements (What You’ll Bring)**

* Experience managing digital products or a clearly defined product area, from problem discovery and opportunity prioritization through delivery and evaluation.
* Evidence of improvements that delivered customer or business outcomes, rather than simply completed features or project milestones.
* Strong discovery and analytical skills, including the ability to combine qualitative and quantitative evidence and recognize data limitations.
* Sound prioritization and commercial judgment, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, explain trade-offs, and constructively say “not yet.”
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams in an agile product-development environment.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, including influencing across functions and balancing regional needs with global product goals.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences, plus a practical understanding of rollout, adoption, and business change.
* The ability to learn complex workflows and integrations, navigate ambiguity, and stay focused on the highest-value problems.

**Useful, But Not Essential**

* Experience with registration, ticketing, eCommerce, payments, or other transaction-based digital products.
* Experience with global platforms serving multiple markets, business units, or customer groups.
* Familiarity with products connected to finance, CRM, identity, marketing, or reporting systems.
* Experience working with Product Success, Customer Success, or implementation teams on launches, adoption, and structured handovers.
* Experience with experimentation, conversion optimization, product analytics, or digital revenue growth.
* Experience in events or other time-critical environments where reliability and operational readiness are essential.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clear, evidence-based product priorities balancing customer needs, business value, and platform scalability.
* Product improvements with defined outcomes and measurable impact.
* Business units that understand product direction, adoption requirements, and the rationale behind decisions.
* Successful rollout and adoption of agreed capabilities, with risks and dependencies identified early.
* A sustainable partnership with Product Success, with responsibilities transferred progressively and without gaps in business engagement.
* More capacity for proactive discovery and continuous improvement, supported by strong customer and business insight.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Field Sales Executive | Symbionic | Chennai**

Symbionic builds assistive devices that help people with upper-limb differences perform everyday activities with greater independence. We’re looking for an Outside Sales Executive to find potential customers, build referral relationships and grow sales of our Krea Adaptive products.

This is a field sales role involving customer meetings, product demonstrations and regular follow-ups. You should be comfortable initiating conversations, planning visits and taking ownership of sales opportunities from first contact to purchase.

**What you’ll do**

* Identify and approach potential customers through field visits, local outreach and referrals.
* Build relationships with hospitals, rehabilitation centres, physiotherapy clinics, prosthetists, NGOs and disability communities.
* Meet customers and their families to understand their needs and explain our products.
* Conduct product demonstrations and coordinate with our prosthetist and technical team for suitability assessments.
* Explain pricing and the purchase process, handle objections and follow up to close sales.
* Organise demonstration sessions with relevant clinics, organisations and community groups.
* Plan your territory and visits to build a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities.
* Maintain accurate records of meetings, referrals, follow-ups and sales in our CRM.
* Coordinate with the internal team for customer assessment, fitting and delivery.
* Work towards agreed targets for qualified leads, demonstrations, active referral partners and revenue.

**What we’re looking for**

* Previous experience in field sales or direct B2C sales, with examples of targets achieved.
* Clear spoken Tamil and working proficiency in English. Additional Indian languages are an advantage.
* Confidence approaching new people and building relationships with customers and referral partners.
* Strong listening, negotiation and follow-up skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly for customer meetings and field visits.
* Ability to plan your day independently and take ownership of results.
* Basic familiarity with smartphones, WhatsApp, spreadsheets and CRM tools.
* Experience in healthcare, medical devices, rehabilitation or other consultative sales roles is an advantage. Prosthetics experience is not essential.

**Why join Symbionic?**

You’ll sell a tangible product that can make a meaningful difference in someone’s daily life. You’ll work closely with our founding and product teams and help build our field sales and referral network.

We value ownership, empathy and honest selling. Success means understanding customers, setting realistic expectations and following through on commitments.

Pay: ₹23,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive, energetic, and result-oriented **Lead Generation Executive** to support the business development of our labour law compliance services. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and generating qualified business leads from corporate organizations across India.

Our target customers include companies in the IT, manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, BPO, and other corporate sectors that require labour law compliance, statutory compliance, and related HR services.

The candidate should be confident in digital prospecting, data mining, cold calling, professional networking, and communicating with HR professionals and corporate decision-makers. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about sales and marketing and aspires to grow into a business development or sales leadership position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lead Generation & Prospecting**

* Identify and generate prospective business leads from corporate companies across India.
* Research and build databases of target companies, HR heads, CHROs, HR managers, Admin Heads, Compliance Managers, Plant Heads, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Conduct systematic data mining using LinkedIn, company websites, online business directories, industry portals, professional networks, and other digital platforms.
* Identify companies that may require labour law compliance, statutory compliance, payroll compliance, and outsourced HR services.
Maintain an updated database of prospective clients with relevant contact details, company information, and lead status.  

**2. Cold Calling & Client Outreach**

* Proactively make outbound cold calls to prospective clients and corporate decision-makers.
* Introduce the company's services, identify potential business requirements, and generate interest in our offerings.
* Follow up consistently through telephone calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other professional communication channels.
* Initiate conversations with prospects and arrange meetings for the business development or sales team.
Demonstrate persistence, confidence, and a results-driven approach while handling objections and follow-ups.  

**3. Digital Networking & Relationship Building**

* Build a strong professional network with HR professionals, business leaders, and corporate decision-makers.
* Use LinkedIn and other digital platforms effectively to identify prospects and initiate professional conversations.
* Participate in HR networking forums, industry events, HR fraternity meetings, and business networking activities.
Develop a strong understanding of target industries and their potential labour law compliance requirements.  

**4. Presentation & Communication**

* Communicate the company's services clearly and professionally to prospective clients.
* Deliver introductory presentations and explain the value proposition of labour law compliance services.
* Coordinate with the sales team to schedule prospect meetings, demonstrations, and business discussions.
Maintain professional communication and a positive brand image during all prospect interactions.  

**5. Reporting & Performance Tracking**

* Maintain accurate records of leads generated, calls made, follow-ups completed, and meetings scheduled.
* Update the CRM or lead tracking system regularly.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly lead generation reports.
Continuously explore new prospecting channels and improve lead generation effectiveness.  

**6. Travel & Industry Engagement**

* Be willing to travel, as required, to attend HR fraternity meetings, networking events, industry associations, and corporate business forums.
Explore opportunities to build professional connections and generate prospective leads from different regions of India.  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The primary KPI for this role is **the generation of qualified prospective business leads**.

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of qualified prospective leads generated per week and month.
* Relevance of leads to the company's target industries and service offerings.
* Number of new corporate accounts and decision-makers identified.
* Effectiveness of cold calling, digital prospecting, and follow-up activities.
* Number of prospective client meetings and business discussions arranged.
* Accuracy and completeness of lead data and reporting.
Consistency in achieving agreed lead generation targets.  

  
  

### **Requirements**

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline; a degree in Business Administration, Marketing, HR, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in lead generation, telemarketing, inside sales, business development, or corporate sales is preferred.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong networking, persuasion, presentation, and relationship-building abilities.
* Comfortable making frequent outbound cold calls and conducting structured follow-ups.
* Good working knowledge of LinkedIn, online research, digital prospecting, Excel, and lead management tools.
* Ability to identify the right corporate contacts and build reliable prospect databases.
* Self-motivated, persistent, target-oriented, and capable of working independently.
* Willingness to learn about labour law compliance and related HR services.
* Willingness to travel for professional networking events and HR fraternity meetings.
Ability to generate prospective leads from different parts of India.  

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience selling HR services, HR outsourcing, payroll services, statutory compliance, labour law compliance, recruitment services, or other B2B services will be an added advantage.
* Existing professional connections within the HR fraternity or corporate sector will be beneficial.
* Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM systems, and B2B lead generation tools is desirable.

* Plan and achieve monthly and yearly sales targets; set monthly/quarterly/yearly targets for each distributor in the region.
* Ensure product availability at all relevant channels through the distributor sales force per company guidelines, drive redistribution value and volume targets.
* Build and enhance trade relations; drive continuous market development and addition of new outlets for wider coverage.

* Monitor and minimize bad-goods returns; track deliveries from distributors to customers and ensure effective market coverage.
* Monitor distributor overheads and profitability (ROI); build strong business relationships with distributors, trade, and key accounts in assigned territories.
* Produce accurate and timely market intelligence reports (competitor activity, price changes, promotional support) and coordinate communication between the team and distributor management.

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication skills with poise and confidence.
* Analytical approach; flexible, resourceful, and innovative mindset to solve on-ground challenges.

title: Operation Executive - E-commerce & Order Fulfilment
description:
About BackdropSource

BackdropSource is a global e-commerce business serving customers across international markets. We focus on delivering quality products and seamless customer experiences through efficient operations, strong coordination, and technology-driven processes.

Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Operations Executive to support our post-sales operational workflow. Once the Sales Team confirms a sale, you will handle the day-to-day execution: checking order details, verifying invoices, coordinating shipping, following up with vendors, and tracking each order through to delivery. You will work closely with Sales, Finance, Procurement, Warehouse, Logistics, and Customer Support, and report to the Operations Lead.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Order processing**

* Review confirmed orders for product specifications, quantities, pricing, customer requirements and delivery commitments.
* Check that all required information and documents are available before processing begins.
* Update order status at each stage and flag any delays or missing information to the Operations Lead.

**2. Invoice verification**

* Check customer invoices and purchase invoices against confirmed sales orders, quotations, purchase orders and agreed pricing.
* Verify product descriptions, quantities, taxes, shipping charges, discounts and payment terms.
* Raise discrepancies with Sales and Finance, and escalate unresolved ones to the Operations Lead.
* Keep accurate records of verified and approved invoices. Final approvals stay with the Operations Lead and Finance.

**3. Shipping & logistics coordination**

* Coordinate with couriers, freight forwarders and logistics vendors to book and dispatch shipments.
* Verify delivery addresses, shipping methods, freight costs and estimated delivery timelines.
* Prepare shipping documents and share tracking details with Sales and Customer Support.
* Follow up on delayed, lost, damaged or returned shipments until they are resolved.

**4. Vendor and supplier follow-up**

* Follow up with suppliers and manufacturers on product availability, production timelines and dispatch schedules.
* Report vendor delays, quality issues or pricing mismatches to the Operations Lead.

**5. Cross-team coordination**

* Act as the day-to-day contact for order-related queries from Sales, Finance, Warehouse and Customer Support.
* Pass order requirements and deadlines clearly between teams.

**6. Order tracking and delivery**

* Monitor orders from confirmation through dispatch to final delivery, and flag at-risk deliveries early.
* Keep clear records for completed, delayed, cancelled and returned orders.

**7. Reporting (MIS)**

* Maintain order trackers and prepare daily and weekly reports on pending orders, delayed shipments, invoice discrepancies and open issues.
* Follow the team’s SOPs and suggest improvements where you see repeated problems.

Key Performance Indicators

* Accuracy and turnaround time of invoice verification
* Order processing turnaround time
* On-time shipment and delivery percentage
* Number of order, invoice and documentation errors
* Timely, accurate status updates and reports
* Adherence to SOPs

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in operations, order management, logistics or e-commerce operations.
* Basic understanding of invoicing, billing checks and shipping documentation.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple orders at once.
* Clear written and spoken English, and good follow-up discipline.
* A proactive attitude and a strong sense of ownership.

Preferred Experience

* Experience with international e-commerce orders or cross-border shipping.
* Familiarity with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms.
* Experience handling international invoices and working with freight or courier vendors.
* Comfort using automation and AI tools to speed up routine work.

We are developing a cloud-based audit assistant tool for professional firms. The platform supports engagement management, client document exchange, working papers, review and approval workflows, and rule-based processing of financial and tax-audit documents.

We have an existing network of CA contacts, partners and prospective resellers, and are looking for someone who can help turn those relationships into product demonstrations, customer engagement and sustained adoption.

Who should apply

You enjoy working with people, learning a product and taking ownership of follow-ups. When given a problem and limited resources, you can propose a practical approach and carry it through. We welcome applicants from any educational background. Evidence of your communication, organisation and problem-solving skills will carry more weight than your degree.

Marketing and social media

* Maintain an active, professional presence on LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Turn product features, demonstrations and founder insights into clear posts, presentations and short videos.
* Prepare a practical content calendar and coordinate approval before publication.
* Suggest and execute marketing activities using the resources available.

Partner and reseller coordination

* Coordinate meetings, demonstrations and follow-ups with partners, resellers and CA contacts.
* Share approved product information and record discussion outcomes, commitments and next steps.
* Ensure interested contacts receive timely follow-up.

Customer engagement

* Coordinate product demonstrations, trial onboarding and training sessions.
* Understand where prospective customers hesitate or existing users face difficulties.
* Maintain a tracker of enquiries, demonstrations, trials and customer progress.
* Communicate clearly and avoid making unapproved commitments about pricing, features or delivery dates.

Customer feedback

* Speak with users to understand their workflow, problems and expectations.
* Capture feedback with examples and business impact.
* Help distinguish software issues, usability concerns, training needs and feature requests.
* Coordinate with the product team and update customers when their feedback has been addressed.

Practical problem-solving

* Propose achievable solutions to business problems using the available network, budget and tools.
* Plan small marketing and customer-engagement experiments.
* Report what worked, what did not and what should change.

Skills we value

* Clear written and spoken communication.
* Strong organisation and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to understand and explain a software product.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn and basic content creation.
* Comfort with spreadsheets, presentations and contact-management tools.
* Good listening skills and an ability to ask useful questions.
* Initiative, resourcefulness and willingness to learn.
* Responsible handling of contact details and customer information.

Experience with customer support, inside sales, marketing, community management or partner coordination is helpful. Knowledge of the CA profession or accounting software is an advantage, but is not mandatory.

What success looks like

* Contacts and follow-ups are organised and current.
* Partners and resellers receive timely coordination and support.
* Relevant content is published consistently.
* Interested firms attend demonstrations and progress through trials.
* Customers receive help getting started.
* Feedback reaches the product team clearly, and customers receive updates.
* Activities are assessed through meaningful engagement and adoption, not only likes or follower counts.

Selection process

We shall provide our problem statement, available resources and we wish to hear from you the solution / plan of action.

Plans own territory or account approach and has input into colleagues' approaches; manages own and often others' resources. Actions may impact the organization and its reputation. Effects of erroneous decisions may be long-lasting, influence the future course of the organization and/or require the expenditure of extensive additional resources.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

title: Business Analyst II
description:
**Business Analyst II**

  

**Are you a strategic planner and problem-solver?**

  

**Are you looking to develop your Data Analyst career?**

  

**About the Team:**

Mercury is RX’s global registration and eCommerce platform, supporting the journeys that bring visitors and exhibitors into our events. Its capabilities span registration, purchasing, badging and onsite access, connecting customer experiences with the data and business systems behind them. We work across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Success and regional business teams to deliver reliable services, improve customer experiences and create measurable business value.

  

**About the Role**

We’re seeking a Business Analyst with a strong focus on User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to bridge product delivery and business validation. You’ll coordinate testing, help business users evaluate new features, manage feedback, and communicate releases in clear, accessible language. The focus is hands-on business acceptance and coordination—not software development or test automation engineering.

  

**Responsibilities (What you’ll do)**

  

**Plan and coordinate business acceptance testing**

* Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to understand desired outcomes, user journeys, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Turn requirements into practical, risk-based UAT scenarios covering standard journeys, exceptions, and relevant regional variations.
* Coordinate testing scope and schedules, providing participants with clear instructions, test-event links, and prerequisites.
* Work with engineering, QA, and configuration teams to ensure environments, test data, and configurations are ready before testing.
* Perform hands-on business validation and help users investigate and reproduce unexpected results.
  

**Manage feedback, defects, and acceptance evidence**

* Maintain a consolidated record of business feedback and communicate test completion, outstanding observations, and potential enhancements.
* Separate defects from configuration issues, clarification requests, and enhancement ideas, working with product and technical teams to agree next steps.
* Document reproducible issues, including expected and actual results, supporting evidence, and business impact, and coordinate retesting after fixes.
* Report progress, coverage, blockers, and residual risks so decision-makers can clearly assess readiness.
* Coordinate acceptance evidence and follow-up while keeping approval and validation accountability with the relevant Business Units.
  

**Support release communication and continuous improvement**

* Prepare business-facing release updates that explain what changed, why it matters, and any relevant limitations or actions.
* Keep testing guidance, feedback records, and supporting documentation accessible to global stakeholders.
* Create reusable scenarios and checklists to improve consistency and reduce repeated effort across releases.
* Apply lessons from UAT and production issues to strengthen future acceptance coverage and identify gaps earlier.
* Collaborate across regions and time zones, keeping dependencies, decisions, and ownership clear.
  

  

**Requirements (What you’ll bring)**

* Practical experience in UAT, business analysis, functional testing, or a similar role supporting user-facing digital products.
* Experience translating requirements and business processes into clear acceptance criteria and end-to-end test scenarios.
* Ability to organize testing with business users, balance competing priorities, and follow issues through to documented outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to explain business impact as well as technical symptoms.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing user guidance, test summaries, and release updates.
* Experience with issue-tracking and collaborative documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence, or equivalents.
* Understanding of Agile delivery and the differences between engineering QA, business acceptance, and release approval.
* A collaborative approach and confidence working with technical and non-technical stakeholders in a distributed team.
  

**Useful, but not essential, skills**

* Experience with event registration, ticketing, eCommerce, or other transaction-based customer journeys.
* Familiarity with payments, invoicing, discounts, upgrades, entitlements, or integrations between customer-facing and back-office systems.
* Exposure to onsite operational tools, badge management, or access-control workflows.
* Awareness of accessibility, localization, and data-quality considerations in business acceptance testing.
* Experience with test-management tools, basic data queries, or API-testing tools to support investigations.
  

**What success looks like**

* Business users know what to test, how to participate, and where to provide feedback.
* Critical business journeys have clear acceptance coverage and traceable results.
* Defects and feedback are actionable, assigned, and followed through, with unresolved risks visible before release decisions.
* Business approvers receive concise evidence to support acceptance decisions.
* Release communications clearly explain changes and limitations, helping teams prepare for adoption.
* Reusable guidance and lessons learned make each testing cycle more effective.
  

**Why join us?**

Help shape digital experiences that connect online registration with the live event experience. You’ll work across product, technology, and business operations, building domain knowledge while improving how changes are validated and communicated. RX values collaboration, inclusion, curiosity, and learning, with opportunities to contribute across a global network.

  

**Work in a Way That Works for You**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous well-being initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

  

**Working for You**

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges
* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support
* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays
  

**About the Business**

RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, leveraging industry expertise, data, and technology to build businesses for individuals, communities, and organizations. With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people. RX empowers businesses to thrive by leveraging data-driven insights and digital solutions. RX is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. For more information, visit http://www.rxglobal.com

description:
**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

This role is primarily focused on FP&A, pricing analysis, financial modeling, and scenario / what-if analysis. **Key Skills**

* Advanced Excel skills
* Financial modelling
* Pricing Analysis
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Communications skills

This is a remote, field-based position responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing customer relationships, delivering technical product presentations, and driving sales of IRISS industrial safety, reliability, and condition monitoring solutions.

The ideal candidate has 3–5 years of experience in industrial or technical B2B sales, preferably involving electrical equipment, industrial automation, predictive maintenance, reliability solutions, or related engineered products.

This position requires strong technical knowledge, consultative selling skills, and the ability to engage engineering, maintenance, operations, and procurement professionals.

**Applicants must currently reside in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, to be considered for this position.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales and Business Development**

* Develop and execute territory sales strategies to achieve established business growth and revenue objectives.

* Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities within assigned industrial markets.

* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified opportunities through customer visits, referrals, networking, and prospecting.

* Manage the sales process from initial customer engagement through proposal development, negotiation, and closing.

* Expand relationships with existing customers while identifying opportunities for additional products and solutions.

* Monitor sales activities, customer engagement, and opportunities using established reporting and CRM processes.

**Technical Sales and Customer Consultation**

* Understand customer challenges related to electrical safety, equipment reliability, predictive maintenance, and condition monitoring.

* Present and recommend appropriate IRISS products and solutions based on customer needs.

* Conduct technical product presentations, demonstrations, and sales consultations.

* Communicate product capabilities, technical benefits, and value propositions to engineering and maintenance professionals.

* Support the development of technical proposals and business cases, including potential operational and financial benefits.

* Collaborate with internal technical teams to address customer requirements and provide appropriate solutions.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain professional relationships with plant managers, maintenance managers, reliability engineers, electrical engineers, procurement professionals, and other decisionmakers.

* Conduct regular customer visits and follow-up activities throughout the assigned territory.

* Provide timely responses to customer inquiries and coordinate technical support when needed.

* Identify customer requirements and maintain accurate records of sales opportunities and interactions.

* Support long-term customer satisfaction and account development.

**Market Development and Reporting**

* Research industry trends, competitive activity, and emerging market opportunities.

* Identify prospective customers within manufacturing, power generation, oil and gas, infrastructure, and related industrial sectors.

* Represent IRISS at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and technical presentations.

* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and customer activity reports.

* Coordinate with sales leadership and other internal teams to support regional business objectives.

**Territory Management and Travel**

* Work remotely from Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

* Travel regularly throughout the assigned territory for customer meetings, prospecting, product demonstrations, and business development activities.

* Plan and manage territory activities to maximize customer engagement and sales opportunities.

* Participate in internal meetings, training, and other business activities as required.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

* 3–5 years of experience in industrial sales, technical sales, or B2B business development.

* Experience selling technical products, industrial equipment, engineered solutions, or related technologies.

* Strong understanding of industrial customer environments and technical sales processes.

* Demonstrated ability to identify business opportunities, develop customer relationships, and manage sales pipelines.

* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and consultative selling skills.

* Ability to understand technical requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.

* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage an assigned sales territory independently.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with CRM systems.

* Ability and willingness to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.

* **Must currently reside in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in electrical safety, industrial reliability, predictive maintenance, or condition monitoring.

* Familiarity with industrial automation, electrical equipment, or engineered industrial products.

* Experience selling to manufacturing facilities, utilities, oil and gas companies, or industrial infrastructure customers.

* Existing professional relationships with plant managers, maintenance professionals, engineers, or industrial procurement teams.

* Experience conducting technical demonstrations and presenting industrial solutions.

* Familiarity with B2B sales cycles involving technical evaluations and multiple decisionmakers.

**Why Join IRISS?**

* Competitive compensation.

* Opportunity to represent innovative industrial safety and reliability technologies.

* Work with a growing global organization serving critical industrial markets.

* Develop customer relationships and expand business opportunities within an assigned territory.

* Collaborate with experienced technical and commercial professionals.

* Professional development and long-term career growth opportunities.

* Support a mission focused on improving industrial safety and operational reliability.

At IRISS, we move fast, think boldly, and support each other while doing meaningful work that makes industries safer.

**We Humanize Safety.**

**Important Work Location Information**

This is a
**remote, field-based position based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.

**Applicants must currently reside in Hyderabad to be considered.**
The selected candidate will be required to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory for customer meetings, technical presentations, business development activities, and other business needs.

**Candidates residing outside Hyderabad will not be considered for this location-specific opening.**

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit an updated resume highlighting their technical sales experience, industrial market knowledge, and relevant engineering background.

Applicants may also be asked to provide their current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period during the recruitment process.

title: Growth Manager
description:
**About Turium AI**

**Turium AI is an enterprise technology company building next-generation AI-powered business platforms designed to transform how organisations operate, automate and make decisions.**

**Our flagship ERP platform, Turium Orbit**
, brings together enterprise financial management, procurement, human capital management, asset management, budgeting and intelligent automation in a unified ecosystem.

We are expanding our global sales operations and seeking an ambitious, commercially driven Growth Managerr based in Hyderabad to accelerate international growth.

**We are looking for a high-performing enterprise software sales professional with proven experience selling ERP solutions to medium and large enterprises across international markets.**

**The ideal candidate understands the global ERP landscape, has experience competing with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Workday or similar enterprise platforms, and can independently build pipelines, engage C-level decision-makers and close complex enterprise deals.**

**This is a revenue-generating, hands-on sales leadership role, not a sales coordination or account support position.**

**You will take ownership of international ERP sales opportunities, from prospect identification through commercial negotiations and contract closure.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Global ERP Sales & Revenue Growth**

* Drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth for Turium Orbit across international markets.
* Develop and execute territory-specific enterprise sales strategies.
* Own the complete B2B enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through proposals, negotiations and closure.
* Build a strong pipeline of qualified enterprise ERP opportunities.
* Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales and revenue targets.
* Identify ERP replacement, legacy modernisation and digital transformation opportunities.

2. Enterprise Customer Acquisition

* Develop strategic relationships with large enterprises, multinational organisations and government agencies.

3. ERP Solution Selling

* Sell enterprise solutions across:Finance, General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable
* Procurement, Purchase-to-Pay and Contract Management
* Human Capital Management, HR and Payroll
* Budgeting, Forecasting and Financial Planning
* Enterprise Asset Management
* AI-powered workflow automation, reporting and analytics
* Understand customer business processes and translate requirements into compelling ERP value propositions.
* Work closely with solution architects, presales consultants and product teams to deliver demonstrations and proposals.

* Prepare proposals, responses to RFPs/RFIs and commercial presentations.
* Collaborate with marketing to execute outbound campaigns, account-based marketing and lead-generation programs.
* Track competitors, market developments and customer purchasing trends.
* Report sales performance, pipeline conversion, strategic accounts and revenue forecasts to executive leadership.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 8–15+ years of B2B enterprise software sales experience, including at least 5 years in ERP or major enterprise applications.
* Demonstrated success selling ERP solutions such as
  **SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Workday, NetSuite, Infor or comparable platforms**
  .
* Proven experience selling to customers outside India, preferably across Australia, North America, Europe or the Middle East.
* Strong track record of achieving sales quotas and closing high-value enterprise software contracts.
* Experience managing long, complex enterprise sales cycles and multiple decision-makers.
* Ability to communicate effectively with C-level executives.
* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation capabilities and understanding of SaaS, subscription licensing and enterprise software contracts.
* Experience using CRM platforms and structured sales methodologies.
* Excellent written and spoken English, presentation skills and executive communication.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, Finance or a related field. MBA desirable.

**Preferred Experience**

* Existing relationships with international enterprise customers or ERP partner ecosystems.
* Experience selling into government, public sector, financial services, manufacturing or large corporate environments.
* Proven success positioning emerging ERP products against established global vendors.
* Familiarity with AI-driven ERP, business process automation and cloud enterprise applications.
* Experience building a new territory or scaling international enterprise software revenue from India.
* Understanding of ERP implementation, migration, integration and transformation programs.

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 90 Days**

* Develop a global target-account strategy and territory sales plan.
* Build a qualified pipeline of enterprise prospects.
* Establish executive-level conversations with prospective customers and partners.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of Turium Orbit and its competitive positioning.

**First 6–12 Months**

* Convert qualified opportunities into contracted customers.
* Develop a predictable international sales pipeline.
* Establish strategic channel and enterprise partnerships.
* Consistently deliver against agreed revenue and sales performance targets.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build the global sales business for a next-generation AI-powered ERP platform.
* Direct engagement with founders and executive leadership.
* Exposure to international enterprise and government markets.
* Ownership of major enterprise sales opportunities and market expansion.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked sales incentives.
* High-growth technology environment with significant career progression opportunities.

.

The successful candidate must be comfortable working across international time zones, engaging directly with global customers and travelling internationally when required.

We are looking for a self-driven professional who thrives in an ambitious, performance-oriented environment and takes accountability for generating revenue.

title: Head of Business Development & Client Delivery
description:
**Job Description – Head of Business Development & Client Delivery**

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience:**
10–15 Years

**Work Mode:**
On-site

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Reporting To:**
CEO / Senior Leadership

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an accomplished and result-oriented
**Head of Business Development & Client Delivery**
to independently drive business growth, acquire new clients, close high-value deals and manage end-to-end client engagements.

The ideal candidate must have strong experience in IT services business development, client acquisition, solution selling, commercial negotiations, project scoping, budgeting and delivery management.

This is a senior leadership position requiring someone who can take complete ownership of the business development lifecycle, convert opportunities into revenue and build a high-performing team. We are looking for a hands-on business leader who can independently drive results rather than simply coordinate activities or delegate responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Revenue Generation**

* Independently identify, develop and acquire new business opportunities across domestic and international markets.
* Drive the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and prospecting to negotiations and final deal closures.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.
* Convert prospective clients into long-term business relationships and generate consistent revenue.
* Develop business growth strategies, identify new market opportunities and achieve revenue targets.
* Lead commercial discussions, pricing negotiations and contract finalisation.

**2. Client Management & Relationship Building**

* Independently manage client interactions, meetings and presentations.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into suitable IT solutions.
* Build long-term strategic relationships with key clients and decision-makers.
* Manage client expectations, resolve escalations and ensure client satisfaction.
* Act as the primary point of contact throughout the business engagement.

**3. Solutioning, Proposals & Commercial Management**

* Prepare and present proposals, business presentations, RFPs, RFQs and RFIs.
* Define project scope, deliverables, timelines and resource requirements.
* Develop project budgets, pricing models, cost estimates and commercial proposals independently.
* Evaluate project feasibility, profitability and commercial viability.
* Work closely with technical teams to develop appropriate technology solutions and service offerings.

**4. Project Scoping & Delivery Oversight**

* Understand the complete project lifecycle, including requirement gathering, solutioning, estimation, planning and execution.
* Identify suitable technology stacks and collaborate with technical teams on solution architecture.
* Ensure alignment between client expectations, project scope, timelines and delivery capabilities.
* Monitor project progress and proactively address business and delivery challenges.
* Maintain coordination between clients, technical teams and internal stakeholders.

**5. Team Building & Leadership**

* Build, develop and lead business development and client management teams.
* Identify team capabilities, allocate responsibilities and establish performance expectations.
* Mentor team members and drive accountability for business outcomes.
* Establish effective processes for lead management, sales execution and client engagement.
* Take ownership of team performance and overall business growth.

**6. Strategic Leadership & Decision-Making**

* Develop and execute business strategies aligned with organisational objectives.
* Make independent decisions regarding business opportunities, pricing, negotiations and resource allocation.
* Identify business risks and develop effective solutions.
* Work closely with senior leadership to drive organisational growth and profitability.
* Demonstrate complete ownership of business outcomes, revenue generation and client relationships.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 10–15 years of overall experience, with substantial experience in IT services business development.
* Proven track record of independently acquiring clients and closing business deals.
* Strong experience in end-to-end sales cycle management and revenue generation.
* Demonstrated expertise in commercial negotiations, pricing, budgeting and proposal development.
* Strong understanding of IT services, software development, digital transformation and technology consulting.
* Experience in project estimation, scoping, resource planning and delivery management.
* Proven experience in building and managing business development teams.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate independently and make critical business decisions.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working with international clients, particularly the US, UK and European markets.
* Exposure to services such as:
* Custom Software Development
* AI/ML and Generative AI Solutions
* Cloud Computing and Digital Transformation
* Product Engineering
* Application Development and Modernisation
* IT Consulting and Technology Services
* Experience managing large-value IT services engagements and strategic client accounts.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a commercially strong and hands-on business leader who can independently drive revenue, acquire clients, negotiate and close deals, manage client relationships and oversee project engagements.

**Business development and actual deal closures are the most critical evaluation criteria for this position.**

Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to sales coordination, lead generation, relationship management or team delegation without independently closing business will not be suitable for this role.

* Ensure proper product display and placement at retail outlets.

title: Growth Marketing
description:
**Growth Marketing : Netenrich**

**Experience:**
8+ Years of relevant experience

Work location:
**Hyderabad / Bangalore/Remote, India.**
On-site, owning growth across the
**US and India.**

**About Netenrich Praxis**

Most pipelines are a black box. Praxis is glass. It's Netenrich's intelligent data pipeline management platform — a single visual control plane where security and observability teams collect, parse, enrich, filter, and route telemetry, with deep insights and observability built into every step. In production today, Praxis removes up to
**70% of noise at the edge**
, auto-masks PII, PHI, and credentials before anything ships (
**100% masked before delivery**
), and gives teams
**100% real-time visibility**
into a pipeline most vendors treat as a black box.

Two things set it apart from the black-box, per-GB tools it competes against: customer data never leaves the customer's own environment — nothing is stored in a Praxis-hosted cloud console — and teams can
**Self-Run**
Praxis themselves or have Netenrich
**Co-Run**
it for them. It's built on open standards (OpenTelemetry + OpAMP), powered by
**Otto**
, an AI agent built on Gemini, and it's the intelligent front door to the broader Netenrich agentic SOC stack (Resolution Intelligence Cloud, Agentic SOC, Cyber Risk Operations).

**Job Description**

Netenrich is looking for a data-obsessed
**Growth Marketer**
to own demand generation and adoption for Praxis across the US and India. This isn't a traditional marketing role — in the early days, you'll run the full growth stack yourself: paid, organic, content, community, product-led loops, and conversion optimization, all measured against hard numbers, not activity. You'll work closely with Praxis product, marketing, and sales to turn a genuinely disruptive product — flat, published pricing and a "your data never leaves you" story that black-box incumbents can't match — into a repeatable, aggressive growth engine in two very different markets, simultaneously.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Own the Growth Funnel End-to-End:**
   Drive strategy and execution across the full Praxis funnel — awareness → self-serve
   **Praxis Free**
   signup (100 GB/day) → activation → upgrade to
   **Standard**
   or
   **Enterprise**
   .
2. **Run Rapid Growth Experiments:**
   Design, launch, and measure fast, low-cost experiments across paid, organic, content, community, referral, and in-product channels. Kill what doesn't work within days; double down on what does.
3. **Win the Category Displacement Battle:**
   Build campaigns, comparison content, and switch-and-save offers that target evaluators of black-box, per-GB pipeline tools like Cribl and Bindplane — leading with Praxis's published, volume-decoupled pricing and its data-sovereignty story (data never leaves the customer's own environment).
4. **Build Product-Led Growth Loops:**
   Partner with product to grow signups and activation on the self-serve Free tier, and design in-product nudges that convert Free users into paying Standard or Enterprise customers.
5. **Paid & Performance Marketing:**
   Plan and optimize paid acquisition (search, LinkedIn, developer and security communities, retargeting) with distinct budgets, creative, and targeting for the US and India markets.
6. **Drive Community & Grassroots Growth:**
   Build credibility and pull in developer, DevOps, and SecOps communities — Reddit, Hacker News, the OpenTelemetry ecosystem, Slack/Discord groups — where practitioners already hang out.
7. **Own SEO & Organic Acquisition:**
   Win category and competitive search terms ("Cribl alternative," "OpenTelemetry pipeline management," "keep security data out of a vendor cloud," "Google SecOps forwarder migration") through technical SEO and content strategy.
8. **Instrument, Measure, Report:**
   Build and own the growth analytics stack — signup-to-activation rate, Free-to-Standard/Enterprise conversion, CAC, channel ROI — and report results weekly with a bias toward action.

**What You'll Need**

* Minimum 8+ years of relevant hands-on growth marketing / growth hacking experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, observability, or developer tools.
* A track record of experiments you've run and the numbers behind them — funnel lifts, CAC reduction, free-to-paid conversion, pipeline generated — not just campaigns you managed.
* Hands-on fluency with growth tooling: web/product analytics (GA4, Mixpanel, or Amplitude), marketing automation (HubSpot preferred), A/B testing, SEO tools, and paid ad platforms (Google, LinkedIn, Reddit).
* Working knowledge of — or a genuine hunger to quickly learn — SIEM, security operations, observability, and data pipeline concepts. You should be comfortable speaking credibly to SOC analysts, DevOps engineers, and CISOs.
* Experience running growth playbooks across more than one geography, or strong comfort adapting messaging, channels, and cadence for both US and India audiences.
* A bias to action — comfortable shipping a scrappy landing page, ad, or outreach sequence in days, not waiting on a full campaign brief.
* Sharp written communication skills. You can write a hook, a subject line, and a landing page that converts.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience growing a self-serve or product-led-growth (PLG) SaaS product from a free tier to paid conversion at scale.
* Familiarity with the data pipeline / telemetry management category (Cribl, Bindplane, Splunk, Datadog, Google SecOps/Chronicle, OpenTelemetry).
* Prior experience in a founder-led or startup growth role where you owned a number, not just a channel.

If you'd rather run ten scrappy experiments than polish one perfect campaign, and you want to take a genuinely disruptive product head-on against well-funded, black-box incumbents in a hot new category, we want to hear from you. Join us at Netenrich and help write the growth story of Praxis from the ground up — across two of the world's most important markets.

We turn texts like the Bhagavad Gita into practical guidance for stress, relationships, purpose and decisions, built around three pillars: Know Yourself, Grow Yourself, Free Yourself. Kitab is backed by Sunera Group and led by founder Ravi Reddy Kaki, who has built and exited companies before.The roleWe call this role Social Creative & Organic Growth Lead. Your job: make Kitab one of the most recognisable brands on Instagram, X and LinkedIn, so people know it's Kitab before they see the logo. You'll own creative strategy and organic growth, from the first idea to the published post.What you'll own• Social identity: content pillars, tone and recurring formats that make Kitab instantly recognisable• Hands-on creation: idea, script, edit and publish Reels, carousels, threads and posts• Platform strategy: a native plan for each platform, never the same post copied three times• Organic growth: weekly experiments, collaborations and distribution that grow the right audience• Community: turn comments and conversations into ideas, advocates and app interest• Content intelligence: a performance dashboard, weekly creative reviews and a library of winning hooksPosting rhythm• Instagram: 4 Reels and 2 carousels a week• X: 1–2 posts a day and 1 thread a week• LinkedIn: 3 posts a week, including founder contentWhat success looks like by day 90 (proposed, agreed with you in week 1)• 15% monthly growth in relevant followers• 60% of Reel reach from non-followers• 3 recurring Kitab series people recognise• 1,000 visits a month to Kitab from social, tracked with UTMsHow AI fits this role• Scan trends and comments with Claude or ChatGPT and turn them into concepts• Produce animation, illustrations and visuals with tools like Higgsfield, Midjourney, HeyGen or ElevenLabs• Turn founder interviews and podcasts into clips, carousels and threads in hours• Prompt engineering: keep a shared prompt library for brand voice, hooks, captions and visual styles• Judgment: catch AI artefacts and factual slips; no engagement bait or automated repliesWhat you bring• 1–3+ years creating content that clearly performed or growing social accounts• Sharp writing: hooks, scripts and captions• Visual taste and hands-on editing (Canva, CapCut or similar)• A clear sense of how Instagram, X and LinkedIn audiences differ• Prompt engineering and daily use of AI tools• Bonus: grew a consumer app, creator or media brand; built a recurring series; motion graphics; interest in psychology and philosophyWho you areGrounded, curious, accountable, kind and purpose-driven. You read books, not just feeds, and you use your phone with intention. This isn't about religion or background; people of every faith and none belong at Kitab.How to get hired1. Portfolio review2. Intro call with Ganesh Bende, Marketing & Brand Lead3. 72-hour assignment: a two-week plan for one Kitab moment across Instagram, X and LinkedIn, one finished Reel or carousel, 5 hooks and the prompts you used4. Culture conversation with Kitab leadership5. OfferPay: fixed plus a performance-linked variable, discussed openly in the first conversation.To apply, share three posts that performed and why, an account you helped grow, a format you invented, and how you use AI (with prompts). You can also email socials@kitab.com with the subject "Social Media Manager – [Your name]".

* Maintain proper records and documentation for statutory and internal audits.

* Support internal, statutory, GST, and tax audits.

* **3–4 years of relevant experience** in accounting and finance.
* CA Inter / M.Com / MBA Finance will be an added advantage.
* Strong practical knowledge of **Indian accounting and taxation**.
* Experience handling **end-to-end accounting operations** is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Tally Prime / Tally ERP**.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel**, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, and basic financial analysis.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

**Awards**

**What you will do:**

As a Worldwide Regional Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, developing existing customer relationships, and promoting Ocean Freight, Air Freight, Warehousing, and End-to-End Logistics solutions. You will play a key role in expanding the customer base, increasing revenue, and delivering profitable growth through effective sales strategies and strong market engagement.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* **Business Development:** Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers for Ocean Freight (FCL/LCL) and Air Freight services. Generate leads through cold calling, customer visits, networking, and referrals while developing and maintaining a strong sales pipeline to achieve assigned revenue targets.
* **Customer Growth:** Manage and strengthen relationships with existing customers, identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling, and increase customer wallet share through relevant logistics solutions.
* **Customer Relationship Management:** Build strong relationships with exporters, importers, manufacturers, traders, and freight forwarders. Understand their supply chain requirements and recommend suitable logistics solutions to meet their business needs.
* **Sales & Quotations:** Prepare competitive freight quotations in coordination with pricing and operations teams. Negotiate freight rates, contracts, and commercial terms, and proactively follow up on quotations to convert business opportunities into confirmed revenue.
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor market trends, competitor activities, freight rate movements, trade lanes, shipping line activities, and airline developments. Share relevant market insights and business opportunities with management.
* **Internal Coordination:** Collaborate with pricing, operations, customs clearance, and customer service teams to ensure smooth execution and seamless customer experience. Support new customer onboarding, service delivery, collections, and credit control activities.
* **Sales Reporting & Forecasting:** Maintain accurate CRM records, sales activity reports, and monthly business forecasts. Track sales performance against targets and monitor key metrics such as revenue generation, customer acquisition, and conversion ratios.
* **Performance Management:** Drive achievement of assigned monthly and annual sales targets while maintaining focus on profitability, customer retention, and timely collections.

**You will be a great fit if you:**

* Hold a bachelor's degree in commerce, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Have 2–8 years of relevant experience in Ocean Freight and Air Freight sales, preferably within freight forwarding, NVOCC, logistics, or shipping organizations.
* Have hands-on knowledge of Ocean Freight operations, including FCL and LCL, and Air Freight Export and Import services.
* Possess a strong understanding of freight forwarding, end-to-end supply chain solutions, and customs clearance processes.
* Demonstrate proven capabilities in business development, new customer acquisition, and managing existing customer relationships.
* Have strong negotiation, influencing, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective customer relationships.
* Possess commercial awareness and a profitability-oriented mindset, with the ability to negotiate competitive rates and identify business growth opportunities.
* Are proficient in CRM management, sales pipeline development, reporting, and business forecasting.
* Have a strong hunter mindset, are self-motivated and target-driven, and demonstrate resilience in working under pressure and meeting deadlines.
* Are proactive in gathering market intelligence, identifying competitor activities, and translating market insights into business opportunities.
* Have a demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets while maintaining customer satisfaction, retention, and payment compliance.

**What you can expect**

* Attractive remuneration package.
* Spread your wings and take ownership of your career with opportunities to network and connect with professionals in your field and involvement in cross-functional projects.
* A supportive and inclusive work environment.
* Mentorship and guidance from industry professionals.
* Exposure to real-world projects and challenges across business functions.
* Valuable skills and experience to enhance your professional growth and career progression.
