**Our Commitment to Equal Opportunities**

Our greatest asset at FedEx is our people. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, and offer equal opportunities, fairness and respect to all regardless of who you are. We encourage you to apply even if you feel your experience does not align with all the aspects in the job description as you could be exactly who we need for this or another opportunity.

We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, age, genetic information, citizenship, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status or any other characteristic protected under national, state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate team members and third parties with physical and mental disabilities.

**Interested to join Team FedEx?**

Everyone at FedEx has a part to play. It's about coming up with smart solutions, remaining resilient in the face of setbacks, and going above and beyond to get the job done. And whether you're a business leader or delivery driver, you'll be empowered to take responsibility and overcome each challenge in your own way.

If this role and working environment sound like a place you can thrive in, apply today and let's create what's next together.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

**Our Company**
---------------

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

description:
Experience Required

15+

Location

Mumbai

Role Type

Full Time

  

###### **Role: Commercial Manager**

###### **Department: Customer Success**

###### **Location: Saki Vihar Road (beside L&T)**

###### **Work Mode: Work from office**

###### **Working Days: Monday to Friday**

###### **Experience: 15+**

### **Job Description:**

##### **About Role**

The role plays a key role in ensuring deal sanctity and integrity of transactions with our company and will report to the Vice President and / or Executive Director

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Contract and SOW Management
  + Owning the entire contracting lifecycle — from initial term sheet to execute agreement.
  + For on-premise deals this includes perpetual license agreements, maintenance terms, and multi-year commitments.
  + For cloud/subscription this includes SaaS MSAs, subscription order forms, renewal schedules, and auto-escalation clauses.
  + This role ensures legal alignment across APAC & IME jurisdictions (India, SEA, ANZ, etc.) where regulatory and tax requirements vary significantly.
* Billing Operations
  + Managing two different billing models in parallel: One-time or milestone-based invoicing for on-premise licenses.
  + Recurring subscription billing (monthly/annual) for cloud products.
  + This role designs the billing cadence, ensures invoices are accurate and issued on time, and coordinates with finance on revenue recognition standards.
* Collections and AR
  + Running accounts receivable follow-up, escalation protocols, and cash flow visibility.
  + In APAC & IME, this means navigating varying payment cultures — some markets pay promptly, others require structured follow-up.
  + This role sets and enforces DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) targets and ensures timely escalations to CSM or NB Team.
* Commercial Governance
  + Acting as the internal control point for commercial risk — ensuring deals don't get closed with unusual payment terms, uncapped liability, or non-standard SLAs without appropriate approvals. This includes deal review sign-offs before contracts go out.
* Commercial Reporting
  + Providing leadership with visibility on ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue), TCV (Total Contract Value), pipeline-to-cash conversion, renewal rates, and collection efficiency — across both on-premise and cloud revenue lines.

**The Job responsibilities of the candidate shall include but not limited to the Job Description & to perform any other tasks/functions as required by the Company**

* Retail domain knowledge, strategic thinking, and leadership to mentor teams.

* Pick & Drop facility from Saki Naka Metro.
* Complimentary breakfast.
* Medical insurance coverage.

title: International Logistics & Pricing Executive
description:
Job Description: Pricing & Operations Executive (Cross-Trade: Air & LCL Consolidation)**Location:** Mumbai, India  
**Department:** Pricing & Freight Operations  
**Experience Required:** 2 to 4 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
Position PurposeThe **Pricing & Operations Executive** manages spot freight procurement, commercial quotation structuring, cargo consolidation planning, and end-to-end shipment coordination, with a primary focus on **third-country / cross-trade cargo movements**. The operation is predominantly **Air Freight (via overseas partner agents)** and **Ocean LCL**, alongside occasional FCL shipments.  
A central responsibility of this role is **Air Freight Consolidation Planning**: consolidating multiple smaller air orders sharing common foreign origins and destinations into scheduled, cost-optimized master consolidations to maximize freight buying power, optimize chargeable weight breaks, and improve shipment profitability while strictly preserving commercial neutrality.  
Key Responsibilities1. Air Consolidation Planning & Load Optimization

* Plan, build, and coordinate scheduled **Air Freight Consolidations (Coload/Consol)** by grouping multiple individual consignments originating from the same foreign origin/airport hub moving to the same destination.

* Coordinate with foreign overseas agents to stage, hold, and consolidate multiple vendor deliveries into unified master shipments, balancing supplier readiness against client delivery deadlines.

* Analyze piece dimensions, gross weight, and volume ratios (1:6000 density rule) to optimize chargeable weight breaks ($+100\text{ kg}$, $+300\text{ kg}$, $+500\text{ kg}$, $+1000\text{ kg}$), minimizing dead freight and driving volume discounts.

* Structure and assign individual House Air Waybills (HAWBs) against a single consolidated Master Air Waybill (MAWB), ensuring distinct commercial segregation for each underlying order.

2. Cross-Trade Pricing & Spot Procurement

* Liaise with overseas network agents and international forwarders to procure spot air freight rates, airport handling fees, terminal charges, and destination tariffs.

* Negotiate and secure competitive spot Ocean LCL co-loader rates (per CBM/W/M) and direct carrier FCL rates across international shipping corridors.

* Build multi-currency landed-cost estimates and commercial quotations for clients and internal sales desks, factoring in foreign origin collection/terminal fees, freight rates, documentation charges, and destination handling.

* Structure profitable customer pricing sheets with targeted margins per kilogram, CBM, or container, maintaining turnaround times (TAT) of 2 to 4 hours on spot inquiries.

3. Cross-Trade Execution & Shipment Coordination

* Issue booking instructions to overseas origin agents for scheduled air consols, standalone air shipments, and ocean LCL/FCL bookings.

* Coordinate milestone tracking across foreign origin airport/port departures, international transit hubs, and destination arrivals, sending automated status updates to clients.

* Act as the operational bridge across multiple time zones, coordinating foreign suppliers, origin consolidators, overseas agents, and destination delivery teams.

* Manage operational exceptions, flight delays, offloads, and transshipment bottlenecks, securing alternate connections to keep cargo moving.

4. Switch Documentation & Neutrality Compliance

* Execute and verify cross-trade transport documents: Master Air Waybills (MAWB), House Air Waybills (HAWB), Master Bills of Lading (MBL), House Bills of Lading (HBL), and Delivery Orders (DO).

* Execute strict **Switch B/L and Switch AWB** procedures: replace actual foreign factory/vendor identities with the buyer’s nominated commercial entity, safeguarding vendor relationships and client confidentiality.

* Audit all cargo documentation (Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin, Manifests) to ensure 100% data consistency across shipper, consignee, notify parties, marks/numbers, piece counts, and weights.

* Prevent documentation discrepancies that trigger customs queries, destination clearance delays, or origin amendment penalties.

5. Vendor Disbursement Audit & Discrepancy Control

* Pre-audit overseas agent consol invoices, co-loader bills, and foreign disbursement accounts against agreed buy rates and confirmed consolidation manifests.

* Detect and challenge unauthorized billing additions, such as unapproved rate hikes, unexpected airline terminal surcharges, or unquoted origin handling costs.

* Monitor cargo dwell times at foreign airports and bonded warehouses to avoid storage and demurrage expenses.

* Reconcile profit-share splits, co-load rebates, and operational accounts with overseas forwarding partners.

Requirements & Qualifications

**CriterionRequirementEducation** Bachelor’s degree in International Trade, Foreign Trade, Commerce, Logistics & Supply Chain, or a related discipline.

**Experience2 to 4 years** of hands-on experience in freight pricing and operational coordination within an international freight forwarding environment, with clear exposure to **third-country / cross-trade movements**.**Air & LCL Focus,**Strong practical experience in **Air Freight operations** and **Ocean LCL**, including understanding of airline chargeable weight calculations (actual vs. volumetric at $1\text{ cbm} = 167\text{ kg}$), airline weight-break scales, and LCL co-loading dynamics.

**Consolidation Planning-**Demonstrated ability to plan multi-order cargo grouping, schedule cut-offs, evaluate dimensions/weights for density optimization, and coordinate with overseas hubs to build air consols.

**Cross-Trade Acumen-**Practical understanding of Switch AWB and Switch B/L workflows, HAWB-to-MAWB relationships, third-party logistics confidentiality, and Incoterms 2020 (FOB, FCA, CFR, CIF, DAP).

**Technical Skills-**Proficiency in freight forwarding ERP/TMS platforms and strong MS Excel skills (XLOOKUP, formulas, pivot tables, CBM/volumetric weight modeling).

**Communication-**Sharp commercial acumen, vendor negotiation skills, high attention to detail in document verification, and fluent business email correspondence across international time zones.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Air Consolidation Efficiency:** Maximizing payload density and achieving favorable chargeable-to-gross weight ratios across scheduled air consolidation runs.

* **Documentation & Switch Neutrality:** 100% defect-free execution of Switch AWBs/BLs with zero disclosure of confidential supplier identities and zero destination amendment fees.

* **Spot Quote Turnaround Time (TAT):** Delivering competitive air and ocean LCL cross-trade proposals within 2 to 4 hours of receiving customer/agent requests.

* **Margin Integrity:** Consistently meeting or exceeding targeted gross profit margins per kilogram on air shipments and per CBM on LCL cargo.

* **Invoice & Disbursement Accuracy:** 100% pre-payment reconciliation of overseas agent consol invoices and carrier disbursements against confirmed buy rates.

Is a premier media partner operating at the dynamic intersection of brands and content. We act as the bridge between intellectual property (IP) owners, streaming/broadcast platforms, and retail brands to unlock massive commercial value across **Animation, Bollywood, and Gaming** ecosystems.

**About the Role**  
We are seeking an aggressive, results-driven **Content Licensing & Merchandising Manager / Senior Manager** who loves closing deals.

This is a highly entrepreneurial, sales-heavy role. You will be responsible for the entire pipeline: first, reaching out to creators and studios to acquire high-value IPs; second, pitching and licensing those IPs to major platforms; and third, onboarding manufacturing partners to turn those IPs into profitable merchandise (specifically focusing on **Apparel and Toys**).

If you are a smooth negotiator who knows how to hustle, build rapport with IP holders, and drive hard sales closures, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

1) **IP Acquisition & Inbounding:**

a) Proactively hunt, connect, and build relationships with IP holders, animation studios, Bollywood creators, and gaming developers to secure representation rights for their properties.

b) Convince creators and IP owners of SkyBlue’s capabilities to monetize and elevate their content.

2) **Platform Pitching & Sales Closure:**

a) Pitch acquired IPs to domestic and international OTT platforms, broadcasters, digital networks, and syndication partners.

b) Drive the sales process end-to-end—from initial cold outreach and pitching to commercial negotiations and contract closure.

3) **Merchandising & Retail Monetization:**

a) Pitch the represented IPs to retail brands, D2C companies, and manufacturers to launch co-branded consumer products, with a core focus on **Apparel and Toys**.

b) Secure minimum guarantees (MGs) and lucrative royalty structures from merchandising licensees.

4) **Account & Pipeline Management:**

a) Maintain a robust sales pipeline, tracking all outreach, active pitches, and deal statuses.

b) Coordinate with internal legal and finance teams to wrap up contract vetting and invoicing smoothly.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* **Experience:** 5 years plus of hardcore sales, business development, or client-facing experience in media syndication, celebrity management, ad-sales, or brand licensing.
* **Core Competency:** **A proven track record of closing sales deals.** You must be comfortable with aggressive pitching, cold calling, and handling objections.
* **Industry Knowledge:** A solid grasp of how IP licensing, syndication rights, and merchandising royalty models work.
* **Network:** Existing relationships with content creators, production houses, or retail brands in Mumbai is a massive advantage.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written presentation skills. You must be able to command a room and pitch effectively to C-level executives.

**Perks and Benefits**

* **Performance Bonus:** Highly lucrative, milestone-linked incentives designed for high-performing sales closers.
* **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical coverage for you.
* **Work-Life Balance:** A standard 5-day work week (Monday to Friday) within a high-growth, energetic media environment.

**Why Sky Blue Media?**

Because we don’t just work with brands and content; we help shape how audiences experience them. Every partnership here is an opportunity to redefine how storytelling meets strategy, across television, digital, and OTT. If you’re someone who understands the pulse of media and knows how to bring brands into that story, this is where you belong.

description:
Hiring: Junior Accountant / Accounts Executive

Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month (based on skills and experience)Location: HyderabadExperience: 0–3 yearsEmployment Type: Full-time

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Accountant to manage day-to-day accounting activities across multiple companies.

* Sales and purchase entries.
* Expense entries and voucher preparation.
* Maintaining ledgers and accounting records.
* Maintaining cash book and bank book.

* Organising financial documents.
* Preparing and maintaining Excel reports.
* Banking & Reconciliation

* Bank statement reconciliation.
* Cash and bank balance tracking.
* Payment and receipt entries.
* Following up on pending payments and collections.

* Maintaining books of accounts for multiple companies.
* Tracking individual company expenses and income.
* Maintaining separate financial records.
* Assisting in monthly account closures.

* Basic understanding of GST.
* Assisting with GST data preparation and filing.
* TDS calculations and documentation support.
* Preparing data for CA and auditors.

* Basic knowledge of accounting principles.
* Knowledge of Tally Prime or willingness to learn.

* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Willingness to learn GST, TDS and taxation.
* Ability to manage multiple company accounts.
* Responsible, organised and trustworthy.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to handle accounts of multiple companies.
* Practical exposure to real-world business accounting.
* Learning opportunities in GST, taxation, bookkeeping and financial management.
* Direct exposure to business operations and financial decision-making.
* Supportive working environment.
* Opportunity to grow into a Senior Accountant / Accounts Manager role based on performance.

Who Should Apply?

* B.Com graduates and commerce students.
* Freshers with good accounting fundamentals.

* Have strong negotiation, influencing, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective customer relationships.
* Possess commercial awareness and a profitability-oriented mindset, with the ability to negotiate competitive rates and identify business growth opportunities.
* Are proficient in CRM management, sales pipeline development, reporting, and business forecasting.
* Have a strong hunter mindset, are self-motivated and target-driven, and demonstrate resilience in working under pressure and meeting deadlines.
* Are proactive in gathering market intelligence, identifying competitor activities, and translating market insights into business opportunities.
* Have a demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets while maintaining customer satisfaction, retention, and payment compliance.

* Spread your wings and take ownership of your career with opportunities to network and connect with professionals in your field and involvement in cross-functional projects.
* A supportive and inclusive work environment.
* Mentorship and guidance from industry professionals.
* Exposure to real-world projects and challenges across business functions.
* Valuable skills and experience to enhance your professional growth and career progression.
* Complimentary 24/7 access to our learning platforms to support you in becoming who you want to be.

**Our Commitment to Equal Opportunities**
Our greatest asset at FedEx is our people. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, and offer equal opportunities, fairness and respect to all regardless of who you are. We encourage you to apply even if you feel your experience does not align with all the aspects in the job description as you could be exactly who we need for this or another opportunity.
  
  
We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, age, genetic information, citizenship, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status or any other characteristic protected under national, state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate team members and third parties with physical and mental disabilities.
  
  
**Interested to join Team FedEx?**
Everyone at FedEx has a part to play. It's about coming up with smart solutions, remaining resilient in the face of setbacks, and going above and beyond to get the job done. And whether you're a business leader or delivery driver, you'll be empowered to take responsibility and overcome each challenge in your own way.
  
  
If this role and working environment sound like a place you can thrive in, apply today and let's create what's next together.
  
  
Presentation Skills;Influencing & Persuasion Skills;Negotiation Skills;Written & Verbal Communication Skills;Networking Skills
  
  
FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. About Sinclairs

Sinclairs Hotels & Resorts is one of eastern India's most established hospitality names, operating nine properties across the country's hills, plains and coastline, from Himalayan resorts to a beachfront hotel in the Andamans. We are a listed, debt-free group with a strong cash position, now in an active expansion phase and transforming how we run: our commercial discipline, our people systems and our technology.

The Role

You will sell Sinclairs across channels and across properties. One day you are working OTA visibility and rate parity for the hill properties before peak season; the next you are in a corporate's office pitching an offsite, or working a tour-operator contract for Port Blair. You will own a book of accounts and a set of channels, with targets, and be measured on the revenue you bring in.

We are hiring from hospitality. You should already know how a hotel sells: how OTAs rank and price, how travel agents and operators contract, how a corporate RFP works, how a wedding or MICE enquiry becomes a confirmed block. What we add is scope: nine properties, every channel, and a head office building the systems and marketing to back you.

What You'll Do

* Manage OTA performance for your properties: content, parity, promotions, visibility, market-manager relationships
* - Work the travel trade: tour operators, travel agents, DMCs; contracting, allocations, series and FIT business
* - Build corporate accounts for rooms, offsites and MICE; respond to RFPs and negotiate rate agreements
* - Convert wedding, banquet and group enquiries with the properties: site visits, proposals, follow-up, close
* - Keep the pipeline current in the group CRM; plan activity against occupancy gaps
* - Travel regularly to the properties; know every room category and banquet space well enough to sell from memory

What We're Looking For

* 2+ years in hotel or hospitality sales with experience across more than one channel
* - A sales record you can show: targets, production, accounts won
* - Working knowledge of OTA extranets, channel managers, rate parity and promotions
* - Confident with proposals, rate agreements and negotiation; clear in person, on the phone and in writing
* - Comfortable with a CRM and Excel
* - Ambition to grow into a management role, and the work ethic to earn it

Where This Goes

The group sales team is small today and will not stay that way. Progression to Sales Executive and Sales Manager owning a region or channel.

title: Sales Executive FOS
description:
**About Fos 2.0**
FOS 2.0 (Feet on Street) is Nitco's field sales intelligence programme covering active construction sites across the
  
  
Mumbai Metropolitan Region. Field Sales Representatives are deployed cluster-wise along the suburban rail network
  
  
(Western, Central, Harbour, and Trans-Harbour lines) to generate live, ground-level lead data that feeds directly into
  
  
Nitco's sales pipeline and CRM.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Field Sales Representative is the primary data-collection point for FOS 2.0 and is also responsible for driving
  
  
assigned leads through to closure. The Field Sales Representative visits construction sites within their home cluster,
  
  
engages site personnel and decision-makers using the standard site-visit script, logs structured visit data, and then
  
  
owns the lead end-to-end — converting it in partnership with the Sales Executive designated for that area.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct daily on-ground visits to construction sites within the assigned home cluster, following the FOS 2.0

site-visit script (pre-visit and post-visit with the sales person). 15 Calls a Day.
  
  

* Identify construction stage, tile decision-maker, and site contact details at each visit; prioritise reaching the

actual decision-maker to improve lead conversion.
  
  

* Capture accurate visit data — site details, contact information, brand and competitor presence, product

requirements, and lead priority — via the FOS 2.0 app / daily submission format.
  
  

* Record and flag competitive brand presence at sites.
* Submit a real-time Daily Site Report (DSR) so visit data reflects on the live cluster dashboard.
* Own end-to-end lead conversion for the assigned cluster — from initial site visit through to closure — working

closely with the designated Sales Executive of that area at every stage.
  
  

* Follow up on logged leads through to conversion, coordinating site visits, quotations, and dealer/decision-maker

meetings jointly with the area Sales Executive.
  
  

* Update lead status (converted/lost/follow-up) accurately and in a timely manner, and escalate stalled leads to the

Sales Executive/Cluster Manager.
  
  

* Maintain visit coverage targets for the assigned cluster and report any data or process issues encountered in the

field.
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a graduate/undergraduate degree (any stream; sales, marketing, or

civil/construction background is a plus).
  
  

* Comfortable with extensive daily field travel within the assigned Mumbai cluster, including active construction

sites.
  
  

* Confident communicator, able to approach site staff, contractors, and decision-makers professionally.
* Basic comfort with smartphone-based data entry (forms/app); attention to detail in data logging.
* Self-motivated and reliable — able to work with minimal daily supervision while meeting visit and reporting

targets.
  
  

* Resides in or near the assigned cluster (Western / Central / Harbour / Trans-Harbour corridor) preferred, for ease

of daily commute.
  
  
**What You'll Gain**

* Direct, hands-on exposure to field sales operations at a listed building-materials company.
* Structured training on the official Nitco site-visit script and lead-qualification approach.
* Visibility of your field data feeding directly into cluster dashboards reviewed by senior leadership.
* A certificate of completion and a strong reference for a sales/operations career track.

description:
**About 1% Club**
1% Club is an education-led fintech platform that helps people make smarter decisions with their money.
  
  
Founded by Sharan Hegde and Raghav Gupta, 1% Club was built on a core belief: financial literacy is the first step to financial independence. That belief built India's most trusted personal finance education brand, and has since evolved into a fintech platform with an app that helps users invest, plan, and manage their money in one place, powered by AI.
  
  
Company Snapshot
  
  

* Headquarters: Mumbai, India
* Team Size: 200+
* Backed by Gruhas (Nikhil Kamath)

What We Do
  
  
Financial Education 7L+ learners across personal finance, taxation, insurance, credit cards, and investing through live masterclasses and a subscription-based membership.
  
  
Fintech Services The 1% Club app is built to replace the traditional bank RM with something smarter, faster, and always available. It combines an AI finance copilot with a curated set of financial products, including mutual fund baskets, fixed deposits, and stock baskets, with plans to solve for credit cards, taxation, insurance, and loans over time. For users who want deeper guidance, the app offers Personal CFO, a premium SEBI-registered advisory service for end-to-end financial planning. Insurance advisory is handled through Pillow, an independent vertical focused on transparent, long-term protection.
  
  
Compliance & Governance
  
  
1% Club operates under:
  
  

* SEBI-registered Investment Advisor (RIA) license
* SEBI-registered Research Analyst (RA) license

Trust is the foundation. Compliance is how we protect it.
  
  
The Road Ahead Build the simplest, smartest way for Indians to manage their money, end to end, in one app. The modern replacement for your bank RM.
  
  
Come build it with us.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a People Associate Employee Engagement & TA to be the heartbeat of our people function, someone who owns the employee experience from the moment a candidate enters our pipeline to the moment they're thriving inside the team.
  
  
This is not a back-office HR coordinator role. We need someone with genuine emotional intelligence, the kind of person who reads a room before speaking, knows when a team is burning out before anyone says it, and can have difficult conversations without making them worse. You'll sit at the intersection of talent acquisition and employee engagement, and you'll need to be equally sharp at both.
  
  
If you've designed engagement initiatives that people actually looked forward to (not just filled attendance for), run hiring cycles end-to-end, and navigated the messy reality of PF, ESIC, and HR compliance without someone holding your hand this role is for you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Employee Engagement
  
  

* Own the employee engagement calendar end-to-end — plan, design, execute, and measure initiatives that actually move the needle on team morale and retention
* Build and run feedback mechanisms (pulse surveys, skip-levels, 1-on-1 frameworks) and translate insights into actionable changes, not just dashboards
* Drive recognition and rewards programmes that feel authentic, not performative
* Be the go-to person employees trust when something's off — from team friction to manager blind spots to personal challenges affecting work
* Partner with team leads and department heads to identify engagement gaps, flight risks, and culture health across the org
* Own onboarding experience design — ensure every new joiner feels connected, informed, and set up to succeed in their first 90 days
* Plan and execute company-wide events, offsites, town halls, and celebrations that reinforce culture without feeling forced

**Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for assigned roles — from crafting job descriptions and sourcing candidates to scheduling, coordinating interviews, and closing offers
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline through LinkedIn sourcing, referral programmes, job boards, and campus/community channels
* Own the candidate experience — every touchpoint from first message to offer letter should reflect 1% Club's culture and speed
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, interview structures, and evaluation criteria
* Track and report hiring metrics — time-to-fill, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates — and use data to improve the process

**HR Compliance & Administration**

* Maintain working knowledge of PF (EPF/EPS), ESIC, Professional Tax, and other statutory HR compliances — flag deadlines, ensure documentation is in order, and coordinate with the payroll/finance team
* Support employee lifecycle administration — confirmation letters, exit formalities, experience letters, HRMS data hygiene
* Keep employee records, compliance trackers, and HR documentation audit-ready at all times

**What We're Looking For**

* 2–3 years of experience in an HR/People role with hands-on exposure to both employee engagement and talent acquisition, ideally in a startup or fast-scaling company
* High emotional intelligence — you're perceptive, empathetic, and able to navigate sensitive conversations with maturity and discretion
* Strong communication skills — written and verbal. You can draft a compelling job post, run a town hall, and have a tough retention conversation, all in the same week
* Proven stakeholder management — you've worked across functions, managed hiring manager expectations, and influenced decisions without positional authority
* Sound judgement on people decisions — you know when to escalate, when to intervene, and when to let things play out
* Familiarity with PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and general HR statutory compliance — you don't need to be a payroll specialist, but you should know what's due, when it's due, and what happens if it's missed
* Proficiency with HRMS tools (Keka, Zoho, Darwinbox, or similar) and sourcing platforms (LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Instahyre)
* Detail-oriented and organised — able to juggle engagement calendars, open requisitions, and compliance deadlines without things falling through

**Bonus Points**

* You've built an engagement programme from scratch, not just inherited and maintained one
* You've hired for both tech and non-tech roles in a startup environment
* You have payroll processing knowledge, salary computation, TDS on salaries, or month-end reconciliation experience
* You have experience with employer branding, LinkedIn content, campus connects, career page storytelling
* You naturally stay updated on labour law changes, HR best practices, and what top startups are doing differently with their people function

Skills: emotional intelligence,stakeholder management,talent acquisition,people operations,hr compliance,recruitment,employee engagement

title: Senior Marketing Executive
description:
**Suspire Marketing Senior Executive - Brand, Growth & Product Marketing**

**Location:**
 Vile Parle (West), Mumbai | 
**Type:**
 Full-time, On-site | 
**Joining:**
 Immediate

**Experience:**
 2-3 years | 
**Reports to**
: Founder and the CMO

**About Suspire**

Suspire makes better living easier, through wellness-first, thoughtfully curated choices you can

trust. We are a 4-year-old startup building an ecosystem of 400+ sustainable brands, 500,000+

conscious community members, and 100,000+ delivered eco-friendly gifts. Our mission: help

people live healthier, stronger and calmer lives by building a high-trust wellness ecosystem.

We are a tight, high-ownership team at a critical growth stage. Every hire shapes our future.

**The Team You'll Lead: Marketing**

Suspire's full-stack marketing team isn't just about promotions; it owns our end-to-end digital

presence, brand voice, customer journeys, content, data analysis and revenue-generating

initiatives. We also build products and in-house technology. Suspire sits at an exciting

intersection of brand, customers and B2B clients, so marketing here touches almost every part

of the business. You'll lead a dynamic department that drives real business and proactively

accelerates Suspire’s growth journey.

**The Role**

Own marketing at Suspire as our Marketing Senior Executive at a pivotal moment. The role sits between a brand manager and a growth marketer, with a product mindset: you will set how the brand

shows up, own growth and the best use of budgets, and help shape the features and products

that serve our customers, our partner brands and our B2B clients.You will be a driving force behind our new branding and repositioning, and behind taking Suspire to its next level. This is not a one-dimensional role: the right person sees how every decision lands on sales, customers, finances and brand reputation, and decides accordingly.

**Your core responsibilities:**

●
**Strategy and brand:**
 Build and own the marketing strategy and plan, and own Suspire's

positioning, brand voice and consistency across channels as the new brand rolls out.

●
**Growth and budgets:**
 Own the marketing budget. Plan, allocate and optimize it across

paid, organic and retention, track returns, costs and contribution, and make fast

scale-or-stop calls.

●
**Channels and campaigns:**
 Direct end-to-end digital marketing funnels and customer

lifecycle management across Meta, Google, Instagram and social, website, SEO, PR,

email and WhatsApp, with content that can double as performance creative.

●
**Product thinking**
: Partner with tech and product teams to shape customer experience

and features, and to package offerings that can be sold to our partner brands and B2B

clients.

●
**Launches:**
 Plan and run launches from narrative and assets through rollout sequencing

based on audience and objective, followed by post-launch review.

●
**Agencies and cross-functional work:**
 Brief, manage and review external agencies,

and coordinate across ops, sales, design and tech so teams move in the same direction.

●
**Reporting and leadership communication:**
 Track and analyse performance, and

translate it into clear updates, trade-offs and recommendations for the founder and the

CMO.

●
**AI-led ways of working:**
 Use AI to sharpen strategy, speed up execution, stress-test

ideas and improve creative work, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

●
**People and systems:**
 Lead, coach and set priorities for the in-house team, raise the

quality bar, and build simple systems and SOPs so the team runs well without you in

every decision.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't just hand work to agencies, and you won't just

execute tasks yourself. You set the direction, hold the quality bar, make the call and keep things

moving.

**Primary KPIs**

Marketing-driven Revenue and Contribution | Channel-wise Performance | Budget Efficiency |

End-to-End Customer Experience | Average Order Value | Lifecycle & Retention Metrics |

Organic Growth | Experiment Velocity (test, learn, scale or kill) | Products Build & Launch

delivery | Team and agency output quality | Effort-Result Ratio

**Who You Are**

**Must-haves:**

● 2-3 years of marketing experience with a strong grasp of marketing, brand and customer

behaviour fundamentals.

● Ownership at manager level: you take responsibility for outcomes, make decisions even

with incomplete information, and own the results.

● Big-picture judgement: you can see the impact of decisions on sales, customers,

finances and brand reputation, and balance them.

● Taste and judgement: you can review creative, content and campaigns, give sharp,

constructive feedback and decide what ships.

●nSpeed: you enjoy building, measuring and fixing quickly, you keep what works, and you

kill ideas fast when they don't.

● A real pulse on teams: you understand what ops, sales, design and tech need and plan

your work so it lands well across functions and with leadership.

● Team leadership: you have led, mentored or coordinated people, interns or agencies,

and you enable others instead of doing everything yourself.

● Working familiarity with Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Google Ads, Meta Ads, CRM

platforms and Excel or Sheets. You don't need to be a hands-on technical expert, but

you should know enough to brief, audit and challenge.

● Fluent English and Hindi (spoken) with strong written English.

**AI is part of how we work:**

● You use AI regularly (ChatGPT, Claude, Lovable, etc.) for strategy, execution,

stress-testing ideas and creative work, and you know how to prompt clearly and iterate.

● You have the taste to judge AI-generated output and decide what is good enough to

ship.

● You are curious about building agentic and AI-assisted workflows that cut manual effort.

**Good-to-haves:**

● Experience in e-commerce or D2C brands (a big plus), including familiarity with Shopify.

● Exposure to a range of digital marketing formats, from paid and social to SEO, email,

WhatsApp and content.

● Digital marketing certifications, for example in Google Ads, Google Analytics or Meta

**Education:**
 A Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business or a related field is strongly

preferred.

**Why Join Suspire**

● Join at a pivotal moment: a new brand and positioning, with you helping to shape it.

● Report directly to the founder and the CMO, and work closely with leadership on most

decisions.

● Work at the intersection of brand, customers and B2B clients, and see how marketing

connects to product and revenue.

● Take real ownership of strategy, budgets, experiments and a team, and see the impact of

your work quickly.

Suspire appreciates energetic ideas, coupled with even better execution. We welcome trial and

error and give you complete room to grow, explore and build, just like Suspire itself does.

**How to Apply**

Share your 
**CV + a short note**
 at swayam.doshi@suspire.in on the following:

● Why you'd like to work with Suspire.

● One marketing decision you made, such as scaling or killing a campaign or idea quickly,

and what made you decide.

Feel free to reach out to us on Instagram (@suspire.in) / LinkedIn if you'd like to chat, ask

questions or simply get a feel of the brand. Meanwhile, explore our website and socials to

understand our community, brands and philosophy.

**Thank you for your interest in being part of Suspire's journey. We would be happy to**

**connect and explore whether this role and our team are the right fit for you.**

title: AGM - Marketing
description:
About Sinclairs

Sinclairs Hotels & Resorts is one of eastern India's most established hospitality names, operating nine properties across the country's hills, plains and coastline, from Himalayan resorts to a beachfront hotel in the Andamans. We are a listed, debt-free group with a strong cash position, now in an active expansion phase and transforming how we run: our commercial discipline, our people systems and our technology.

The Role

You will be a founding member of the group's marketing function, with a mandate to build it: the brand, the demand engine, the direct-booking channel and the team. We measure marketing on what it does to occupancy, rate and direct-booking share, not on impressions. You will own the marketing budget, make the case for spend and be held to what it returns.

Two things make this different from a conventional hotel marketing seat. We want a D2C operator who has owned a funnel from first touch to repeat purchase and knows CAC, LTV and retention. And we want someone who will build and run marketing with AI agents doing much of the work, so a small team does what used to take a large one.

What You'll Own

* Brand positioning and visual identity across nine properties and every touchpoint
* - Direct bookings run as a D2C business: full funnel from acquisition to booking to repeat stay, measured by property and channel
* - Performance marketing, search, social, email, CRM campaigns, PR and partnerships, planned against occupancy gaps
* - AI agents for research, content, campaign ops, personalisation, review response and reporting, with the right guardrails
* - The marketing dashboard: cost per booking, direct share, channel ROI, repeat rate
* - Building the team and managing agencies until in-house capability exists
* - Destination-level marketing with general managers; launch marketing for new properties

What We're Looking For

* Has owned marketing for a services business, brand or line with at least Rs 50 crore in annual revenue, with results to show
* - Hands-on D2C experience: acquired and retained customers directly, managed to CAC, conversion, LTV and retention
* - Has built or run AI-agent or agentic workflows in marketing, not just used AI tools
* - 4+ years in marketing across brand and performance; hotels/hospitality preferred, other services industries welcome
* - Has hired, led or built a team, or is clearly ready to
* - Strong analytical fluency; excellent communication and brand judgement
* - Based in Mumbai or Kolkata, willing to travel regularly to the properties

Where This Goes

Founding seat in a function that will grow with the group; progression to DGM and GM Marketing.

title: SEO Growth Manager: Healthcare
description:
SEO Growth Manager: Healthcare

Bandra, Mumbai · Full-time · On-site

Rankings don't fill appointment slots. Leads do.

Healthus.ai is a healthcare growth agency. We help hospital networks, clinic chains, funded health start-ups, pharma companies and wellness brands in India and abroad turn search visibility into patients and revenue.

Search is changing fast. Patients now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews before they ever click a link. We're looking for an SEO leader who understands this and is excited about it. You should care more about how many enquiries came in than how many impressions you got.

What you'll own

* **Search strategy built around leads.**
  You'll plan organic growth around appointments, enquiries and qualified leads, with traffic as a step towards those goals.
* **AI search visibility (AIO and GEO).**
  You'll help our clients' doctors, treatments and facilities appear and get cited correctly in AI Overviews and in answers from tools like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.
* **Search intent research.**
  You'll go beyond keyword volume to find the questions patients actually ask and the searches most likely to turn into bookings.
* **Technical and on-page SEO.**
  You'll cover site structure, schema, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, location pages and doctor profiles, so that both search engines and patients can trust what they find.
* **Content with medical credibility (E-E-A-T).**
  You'll work with doctors, writers and designers on content that is accurate and compliant and that ranks.
* **Conversion and attribution.**
  You'll work with our paid media and web teams to track forms, calls and WhatsApp enquiries through to real outcomes, and to fix the pages that leak leads.
* **Competitor and market intelligence.**
  You'll find out where competitors win in classic search and in AI answers, and how we can overtake them.
* **Client-facing reporting.**
  You'll turn data into clear, honest stories that clients' leadership teams can act on.

You'll thrive here if you

* Have 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally with healthcare, pharma, wellness or other regulated categories.
* Can show us results you drove in leads, bookings or revenue, not just traffic graphs.
* Already experiment with AI search: you track AI citations, structure content for LLMs, and have opinions on what works.
* Know your way around GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush or Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Looker Studio. Comfort with AI tools in your daily workflow is a big plus.
* Understand healthcare marketing rules: NMC guidelines, ASCI healthcare codes, the Drugs and Magic Remedies Act and India's DPDP Act. Knowing HIPAA, FDA or UK rules helps with our international clients.
* Think like a growth marketer: test, measure, learn and scale.
* Communicate clearly with doctors, founders and developers alike.

Why Healthus.ai

* You'll work on brands where your work helps patients find the right care.
* You'll get room to shape our AI search offering from the ground up.
* You'll join a small, fast team with direct access to the founder and no layers of approval.
* You'll work on a portfolio that spans hospitals, Ayurveda, fertility, longevity and global clinics.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**The role**

**You will be the Social Media Manager for PL Capital. You will own social media across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, WhatsApp, Telegram and any emerging platform, from strategy and execution to reporting and user growth. The role also includes online reputation management (ORM).**

**About PL Capital**

* Founded in 1944 as a stockbroker, with over 80 years in the markets and regulated by NSE, BSE, MCX, SEBI, RBI and IRDAI.
* Diversified into retail broking, wealth management, institutional equities, investment banking, lending against shares and asset management (PMS, AIFs and quant strategies).
* Research is the core: an in-house platform spanning fundamental, technical, derivatives and quant research, now augmented with AI.
* Recognised for research and fair business practice: Thomson Reuters Analyst Awards winner, Asia Money top-20 analyst rankings, MCX Leading Member for Research, and the Jamnalal Bajaj Prize for Fair Business Practices.

**What you will do**

* Own social media strategy and execution across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, WhatsApp, Telegram and other emerging platforms.
* Create a strategy for each platform and use each in its own way: long-form video and Shorts on YouTube, expert voices and thought leadership on LinkedIn, Reels and carousels on Instagram, real-time market commentary on X, and owned broadcast audiences on WhatsApp and Telegram.
* Drive organic leads from social: build content that brings qualified leads, webinar registrations and app installs, with every lead tracked to its source.
* Own YouTube as a channel: grow views, watch time, subscribers and engagement through a regular video calendar, and improve titles, thumbnails and retention using the data.
* Grow community and engagement on LinkedIn, Instagram and X, and build owned audiences on WhatsApp channels and Telegram.
* Plan and run the content calendar with the research, content and creative teams, turning research into posts, reels, videos and carousels for each platform.
* Own reporting and analytics as a KPI you optimise: read platform analytics and Firebase data to see what drives reach, engagement and leads, and use it to improve content, timing and the customer journey.
* Run online reputation management (ORM): monitor mentions, reviews and complaints, respond quickly, and keep sentiment and ratings healthy.
* Track how PL Capital ranks and shows up on each platform and against peer brands, and act on the gaps.
* Make AI part of the daily workflow: generate content ideas and variants, repurpose research into multiple formats, automate reporting and analysis, and check every output before it goes live.
* Make sure all activity follows the compliance requirements of each business.

**What you bring**

* 4 to 7 years in marketing, with at least 2 years of hands-on ownership of social media for a brand.
* Proven record of growing a social presence, with numbers you can show: views, subscribers, engagement or leads. Experience growing a YouTube channel is preferred.
* Experience driving leads or app installs from organic social, with source tracking in place.
* Able to build a separate strategy for each platform instead of posting the same content everywhere.
* Hands-on command of LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and X, and working knowledge of WhatsApp and Telegram channels.
* Strong analytics: platform analytics and reporting that tie social to business outcomes.
* Experience with ORM and social listening tools.
* Strong writing, and the ability to explain investing and markets simply and accurately.
* Strong hands-on AI skills: you use AI tools every day for content ideas, copy and variants, research and reporting, and can show what you have built or sped up with them.
* Able to build repeatable AI workflows (prompts, templates, automations) for recurring tasks, with the judgement to check outputs before anything is published in a regulated category.
* Preferred experience across broking, mutual funds, wealth, PMS or AIFs.

title: Event Planner
description:
**Job Description: Event Planner – Jewellery Industry**

**Job Title:** Event Planner – Jewellery Industry

**Department:** Marketing / Events

**Industry:** Jewellery / Luxury Retail

**Experience:** 3–5 years (preferably in jewellery, luxury retail, or lifestyle events)

**Location:** As per company requirements

**Reporting To:** Marketing Head / Brand Manager

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative, organised, and detail-oriented Event Planner to plan, coordinate, and execute events for our jewellery brand. The candidate will be responsible for organising jewellery exhibitions, product launches, bridal shows, trade fairs, customer engagement events, festive promotions, and VIP events.

The ideal candidate should have excellent coordination, communication, vendor management, and event execution skills, along with an understanding of the jewellery and luxury retail industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Marketing & Social Media**

· Manage the brand's social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, and other relevant channels.

· Plan and execute monthly social media calendars.

· Create engaging content ideas, reels, stories, posts, and campaigns to promote jewellery collections.

· Coordinate with photographers, videographers, graphic designers, and content creators.

· Monitor social media engagement, reach, followers, and campaign performance.

· Manage digital marketing campaigns and coordinate with agencies for paid advertisements.

· Maintain consistent brand communication and visual identity across all platforms.

**2. Event Planning & Execution**

· Plan and execute jewellery exhibitions, trade shows, and retail events.

· Organise new jewellery collection launches and brand promotions.

· Coordinate bridal jewellery shows, fashion shows, and designer showcases.

· Plan festive events, seasonal campaigns, and special customer engagement activities.

· Manage pre-event planning, on-ground execution, and post-event activities.

**3. Vendor & Supplier Management**

· Identify, coordinate, and negotiate with event vendors and agencies.

· Manage decorators, fabricators, caterers, photographers, models, anchors, and production teams.

· Ensure timely delivery of event materials and services.

· Monitor vendor quality and ensure cost-effective execution.

**4. Budget & Cost Management**

· Prepare event budgets and cost estimates.

· Monitor expenses and ensure events are executed within the approved budget.

· Negotiate vendor rates and maintain expense records.

· Prepare post-event cost reports.

**5. Jewellery Exhibition & Product Launch Management**

· Coordinate jewellery displays, counters, showcases, and product arrangements.

· Ensure proper presentation and visual merchandising of jewellery collections.

· Coordinate with sales teams for product availability and display requirements.

· Ensure proper security arrangements and handling procedures for high-value jewellery.

· Manage guest experiences during exclusive jewellery previews and launches.

**6. Marketing & Promotions**

· Coordinate with marketing and social media teams for event promotions.

· Develop event concepts, themes, invitations, and promotional activities.

· Coordinate influencer collaborations, celebrity appearances, and media coverage.

· Ensure brand guidelines and luxury positioning are maintained throughout events.

**7. Client & Guest Management**

· Manage VIP customers, HNI clients, designers, celebrities, and business associates.

· Coordinate invitations, RSVPs, guest lists, and event registrations.

· Ensure smooth hospitality and guest experiences.

· Build relationships with event partners and jewellery industry stakeholders.

**8. Reporting & Coordination**

· Coordinate with internal departments, including sales, marketing, merchandising, and management.

· Prepare event schedules, checklists, and execution plans.

· Monitor event performance and customer engagement.

· Share post-event reports, photographs, feedback, and suggestions for improvement.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

· Graduate in Event Management, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field.

· 2–5 years of experience in event planning and management.

· Experience in jewellery, luxury retail, fashion, or lifestyle events will be an advantage.

· Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

· Strong vendor management and coordination abilities.

· Good budgeting and organisational skills.

· Creative thinking and attention to detail.

· Ability to manage multiple events and work under deadlines.

· Willingness to travel and work on weekends when required.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

· Successful execution of events within the approved budget.

· Timely planning and execution of events.

· Quality of event presentation and customer experience.

· Vendor management and cost optimisation.

· Guest attendance and customer engagement.

· Lead generation and sales contribution from events.

· Brand visibility and overall event impact.

**Types of Events to Be Managed**

· Jewellery exhibitions and trade shows.

· New collection and product launches.

· Bridal jewellery exhibitions.

· Wedding and fashion shows.

· VIP and HNI customer events.

· Influencer and celebrity events.

· Festive and seasonal promotions.

· Retail store inaugurations.

· Dealer and distributor meets.

· International jewellery exhibitions.

**Additional Responsibilities Specific to the Jewellery Industry**

The Event Planner must understand the importance of luxury brand presentation and the sensitivity involved in handling high-value jewellery. They should ensure:

· Secure transportation and storage of jewellery.

· Coordination of jewellery insurance and security arrangements, where applicable.

· Controlled access to jewellery display areas.

· Proper inventory coordination before and after events.

· Premium ambience, lighting, display aesthetics, and customer experience.

**Ideal Candidate:** Someone who can combine creativity, luxury brand understanding, strong execution capabilities, and excellent relationship management to create memorable jewellery events that enhance brand image and drive business growth.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager-Digital and Technology-Hong Kong and Taiwan
description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Country Digital & Technology Senior Manager is the senior Digital & Technology leader accountable for Digital, Data, AI and Technology outcomes within a Local Operating Company (LOC), or cluster of LOCs. The role leads local execution of global D&T strategy, develops and governs the integrated country roadmap, and acts as the single point of accountability for success, service continuity, compliance and value realization of local, products and services. The role combines transformation leadership with operational technology accountability: driving business outcomes through transformational AI, data and product-led thinking while ensuring core commercial systems are secure, compliant, resilient and well-governed.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Lead Country D&T Strategy and Execution:** Translate the country’s business strategy into an integrated Digital & Technology (D&T) roadmap, aligning local market priorities with enterprise strategy, value creation, capacity, investment and governance requirements.
* **Strategic Business Partnership and Leadership:** Act as the accountable D&T leader and primary technology partner, part of the LOC Leadership Team, representing GSK Tech and orchestrating enterprise capabilities to address local business priorities. Build trusted relationships with C-suite and senior business leaders, influencing strategic decisions and shaping technology-enabled business outcomes.
* **AI-Enabled Business Transformation:** Drive AI-led business transformation by identifying, prioritising and scaling high-value opportunities across AI, data and omnichannel engagement. Embed AI into business processes and decision-making, evolving the LOC from point solutions and tool adoption towards AI-enabled ways of working.
* **Intelligent Automation and Human–AI Collaboration:** Accelerate productivity and operational efficiency through intelligent automation, leveraging enterprise platforms, applications and low-/no-code capabilities to eliminate manual effort, augment decision-making and enable effective Human + AI operating models.
* **Commercial Technology and Service Governance:** Own the governance and performance of local core commercial technology, systems and services, ensuring business adoption, lifecycle management, service excellence, business continuity, operational resilience, compliance and effective risk management.
* **Portfolio, Demand and Value Management:** Lead the end-to-end technology demand and portfolio lifecycle, from opportunity identification and value assessment through prioritisation, investment planning, delivery and benefits realisation. Drive informed build/buy/partner decisions, scale successful solutions and establish sustainable business-as-usual (BAU) operating models.
* **Product-Led Strategy and Enterprise Reuse:** Champion product-led thinking and strategic reuse of global and regional platforms, products and capabilities. Balance enterprise standardisation with legitimate local market needs to maximise business value, accelerate delivery and improve cost efficiency and productivity.
* **Data, Analytics and Insight-Led Decision-Making:** Enable data-driven business decisions through trusted data, actionable analytics, customer insights, omnichannel performance metrics and forward-looking dashboards that improve commercial effectiveness and business performance.
* **Digital Capability and Talent Development:** Build digital, data and AI maturity across the LOC by strengthening business capabilities, upskilling commercial teams and developing local champions. Lead, coach and develop local employees, contingent workers and external delivery partners, as applicable, to build sustainable technology capabilities.
* **Responsible Technology, Risk and Compliance:** Champion the secure, ethical and compliant adoption of technology, AI and data capabilities. Partner closely with Compliance, Legal, Procurement, Privacy, Security, Risk and Medical/Commercial governance stakeholders to ensure adherence to enterprise policies, regulatory obligations and local market requirements

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Minimum Bachelor/Masters degree or equivalent experience in Information Technology, Digital, Data, Life Sciences, Commercial Operations or a related discipline. Advanced degree or equivalent experience, e.g. MBA, MSc, Computer Science, AI/data certification, product, digital or transformation qualification is preferred.
* Significant experience in Digital, Technology, Data, AI, Product, Commercial Excellence or Business Transformation
* 12+ years in technology/digital with substantial leadership experience.
* Experience in a global role with exposure to markets such as **Southeast Asia and APAC, preferably China & Taiwan.**
* Proficiency in spoken Chinese is an advantage.

* Proven ability to translate market strategy and business priorities into technology-enabled outcomes, adoption and measurable value.
* Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing local, regional and global matrix organizations.
* Experience managing or influencing teams, contingent workers, vendors and development partners, including capacity, budgets, contracts, delivery performance and capability development.
* Experience with enterprise platforms, core commercial systems, omnichannel capabilities, data/analytics, AI use cases, digital marketing/channels and sales/marketing systems such as Veeva, IQVIA or local equivalents where applicable.
* Experience with technology lifecycle management, service continuity, portfolio health, demand/value prioritization, build/buy/outsource choices, BAU transition, governance, risk, privacy, security, quality and audit/inspection expectations.

**Preferred Skills:**

* **Vendor & Financial Management:** Proven expertise in managing external service vendors and controlling IT financial cross-charge and provisioning models.
* **Service Architecture, ITSM -** ServiceNow processes including Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Risk & Control Assessments (R&CA), Incident Management, and Knowledge Management for all regional tech services.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Assistant F&B Manager
description:
**Job Description**

**Your Role in the Story**

As the F&B Manager you lead the full spectrum of our food and beverage, from bars and restaurants to in-room dining and outlets. You tailor group standards to the local context and make sure every experience feels memorable and true to our brand.

You lead a dynamic team and build a culture of service, collaboration and continuous improvement. It’s a hands-on leadership role for someone who knows F&B and hotel operations deeply, loves developing talent and is at their best on the floor.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all F&B operations across restaurants, bars, in-room dining, events, and banqueting, ensuring a consistent and memorable guest experience.
* Inspire, develop, and lead a high-performing team, building a culture of professionalism, collaboration, accountability, and genuine hospitality.
* Lead and align all Floor Managers, ensuring unity across outlets and driving operational excellence through one-team leadership.
* Drive departmental performance, balancing exceptional guest experiences with strong commercial results.
* Partner closely with the Executive Chef and Bar Manager to create exceptional food and beverage experiences that reflect brand and destination.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding, training, and talent development, hiring individuals with the right attitude, personality, and potential; in alignment with the P&C team.
* Create development opportunities for the team and build succession plans for future leaders.
* Be present on the floor, leading by example during service, peak periods, VIP visits, and key guest moments.
* Ensure the team has strong product knowledge and can confidently recommend food, wine, cocktails, and experiences.
* Drive guest satisfaction by anticipating needs, resolving concerns, and creating memorable dining experiences.
* Take ownership of guest feedback and service recovery, turning challenges into opportunities to build loyalty and trust.
* Work closely with Revenue, Reservations, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to maximise covers, revenue, and guest engagement.
* Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of all events, banquets, private dining experiences, and special activations.
* Work collaboratively with Sales and Events teams to ensure flawless event delivery and commercial success.
* Oversee workforce planning and labour productivity across all outlets.
* Prepare and manage team schedules and rosters, ensuring the right staffing levels are in place at all times.
* Monitor and control overtime costs through effective scheduling, productivity management, and operational planning.
* Manage departmental budgets, payroll, purchasing, inventory, and profitability while maintaining quality standards.
* Monitor guest feedback, market trends, and business performance, implementing improvements where needed.
* Create and support events, activations, and seasonal experiences that enhance the hotel's identity and guest experience.
* Ensure compliance with hygiene, HACCP, health & safety, licensing requirements, and company standards across all F&B operations.
* Build strong relationships with suppliers and local partners, supporting quality, sustainability, and cost efficiency.
* Champion local products, responsible sourcing, and sustainable operating practices.
* Oversee in-room dining standards and operations, ensuring efficient, professional, and personalized service.
* Work collaboratively with all hotel departments to ensure a seamless guest journey.
* Act as a brand ambassador, maintaining strong relationships with guests, VIPs, and returning customers.
* Stay informed on industry trends and continuously seek opportunities to elevate the guest, team, and business experience.

  
**Qualifications**

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Minimum 3-5 years' experience in a F&B leadership role within a luxury hotel, resort, lifestyle hospitality brand, beach club, or premium restaurant environment; with great references.
* Proven experience managing multiple outlets, including restaurants, bars, in-room dining, events, and banqueting operations.
* Strong track record of leading, developing, and retaining high-performing teams in fast-paced, high-volume environments.
* Experience in recruitment, workforce planning, scheduling, and labor cost management.
* Solid understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cost control, payroll, inventory management, and commercial performance.
* Hands-on experience driving guest satisfaction, service recovery, and operational excellence.
* Experience collaborating with Culinary, Revenue, Sales, Marketing, and Rooms teams to achieve business objectives.
* Experience in luxury lifestyle, boutique, or destination-led hospitality concepts is a strong advantage.
* Warm, welcomed, inspiring and guest oriented profile.
