title: Sales Director-Tech Cloud
description:
In this role, you will drive the adoption of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) across customers IaaS and PaaS environments, including distributed, public, and private cloud portfolios.

You will help customers solve critical business challenges—such as accelerating decision-making with AI-powered insights or meeting demanding service-level expectations—by delivering strategic cloud solutions that drive measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of all OCI products and services; sales experience in the enterprise software space, and a passion for helping clients succeed through applying innovative technology.

You would have solid expertise selling to C-suite, engineering, and DevOps, and be familiar with open source and other cloud tools (such as Dockers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Linux, Java)

We are seeking motivated individuals with a strong "hunter and challenger" mindset who excel at opening new markets, developing territories, and growing existing accounts.

You will create exceptional customer experiences that result in long-term partnerships, contract renewals, and expanded cloud adoption.

  

* **Sales Prospecting & Lead Generation:**

  + Identify and target new business opportunities for Oracle Cloud solutions across multiple industries to ensure coverage of the assigned territory.
  + Develop and execute outbound strategies to generate leads through customer engagement, networking, attending events, and leveraging digital channels.
  + Qualify and prioritize leads to engage the most promising prospects for Oracle Cloud solutions.
  + Create and continuously update account management plans within the defined territory.
* **Consultative and Solution Selling:**

  + Engage with senior executives (C-level) as a trusted advisor to challenge conventional approaches and deliver transformative results. You will understand what motivates customers to buy and know how to tap into those needs in an effective way.
  + Grow consumption on a quarter-on-quarter basis, by landing new customers and/or new workloads on a monthly-basis, maintaining performance metrics and contributing to sustained revenue growth.
  + Build and implement key sales and business development initiatives to improve awareness of Oracle OCI and increase sales pipeline.
* **Product Presentations & Demos:**

  + Master and share the *“Why Oracle Story”* that represents the value Oracle provides to customers with our unified, multi-pillar offerings.
  + Prepare and deliver persuasive presentations and demonstrations of Oracle’s Cloud products and services.
  + Work closely with technical teams to deliver proof-of-concept trials and in-depth product demos, showcasing the value of Oracle's solutions.
  + Leverage your and Oracle’s expertise to deliver world-class Cloud solutions, that highlight OCI’s unique benefits and capabilities across Compute (GPU/Non-GPU), Networking, Cloud Native Development and AI, to drive transformative outcomes.
* **Sales Negotiation & Deal Closure:**

  + Lead the negotiation process, addressing customer objections and aligning contract terms with Oracle’s offerings (cloud subscriptions and perpetual licenses).
  + Work with legal, finance, and technical teams in a timely manner to ensure that proposals, contracts, and renewals are delivered and closed out successfully.
  + Close deals and meet or exceed revenue targets, quotas and KPI’s.
* **Relationship Management & Account Development:**

  + Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within the customer base to drive incremental revenue.
  + Provide ongoing customer support during and after the sales process, ensuring smooth implementation and adoption of Oracle cloud solutions.
* **Collaboration with Internal Teams:**

  + Work collaboratively with Oracle’s technical, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure seamless pre-sales and post-sales experiences.
  + Provide timely feedback to Oracle product teams regarding customer requirements and market trends to inform product enhancements.
  + Coordinate with marketing to actively execute campaigns and promotions for the target market of Oracle cloud prospects.
  + Work collaboratively with Technology Cloud Data Platform sales team and all other LOB’s to maximise customer success and drive adoption of Oracle products and services.
* **Partnering**

  + Build strong and growth-oriented relationships with clients and partners to foster trust, collaboration, and long-term mutual success by understanding their needs and offering tailored solutions.
  + Identify and build relationship with partners that influence customers within your territory and leverage Oracle’s partner team where appropriate.
* **Sales Pipeline & Forecast Management:**

  + Actively progress the pipeline through sales stages throughout the quarter.
  + Manage an active sales pipeline in CRM tools and provide accurate and timely updates on sales opportunities, forecasts, and activities.
  + Monitor pipeline progress and adjust sales strategies as needed to ensure sales objectives are met.
  + Regularly report sales metrics, progress, and achievements to senior management.
  + Identify and pursue new clients while expanding opportunities within existing accounts by understanding their needs and offering tailored solutions.

title: Strategic Partner Development Manager, Recurring Payments, Google Pay
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in business development, telecommunications, enterprise sales, or partnership development.
* Experience building and maintaining relationships with C-suite executives at matrixed organizations.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience in the telecom industry.
* Experience working with digital payments.
* Excellent partnerships, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

Google Pay allows people to instantly send money to a contact, pay their bills, recharge their mobile balance, or make a purchase at the corner store. Google Pay is about making money simple for everyone with more convenient shopping experiences at stores and online, as well as access to financial services like loans or repayment plans.

Google Pay has one of the best reliability in the UPI ecosystem today. There is increasing complexity across new forms of payments such as UPI Lite, RuPay Credit Card on UPI, Creditline on UPI etc., and this requires innovative ways to manage transaction reliability for new FoPs as well. UPI continues to grow in scale and scope and new features continue to be launched - UPI is today a 800M+ daily payment system; driving launch and managing them end-to-end is critical to continue to grow and be relevant for our users.

The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product-enabling partnerships, go-to-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage recurring payments businesses including bill payments, telecommunication recharges and subscriptions business partnerships.
* Manage relationships with Telcos, Bharat connect, existing and technical service providers [TSP], product area relationships for supporting recurring payments business and acquiring banking relationships for this business.
* Bring depth of industry knowledge to the team and help shape goals for the recurring payments business. Drive advocacy with industry participants and trade associations.
* Collaborate deeply with teams at Google to drive growth while ensuring compliance.
* Drive thought leadership with Partners and cross-functional teams on various business areas.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

**C. Sales & Corporate Recruitment**

* Manage recruitment for Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Administration, IT and other corporate functions.
* Handle recruitment of Regional Sales Managers, Area Sales Managers, Sales Officers and distribution-related positions.
* Ensure effective recruitment for multiple locations across India.

**D. Sourcing & Talent Pool Management**

* Utilize job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn and other recruitment platforms.
* Develop strong networks with recruitment consultants, colleges, institutes and industry professionals.

* Coordinate with HODs and departmental managers to understand manpower requirements.
* Ensure timely feedback and decision-making from interview panels.
* Follow up with selected candidates to ensure offer acceptance and joining.

* Track pending positions, interview status, offers released, and candidates joining.

**About the Team**  
The Managing Director - India role is part of the APJ Sales Leadership team at Nutanix, which is dedicated to driving revenue growth and establishing strong business relationships across South-East Asia. We are looking for a true "growth leader" to build an exceptional team culture, elevate our brand in the region, and consistently exceed sales targets while building lasting partnerships with customers and partners.

You will report directly to the VP of Sales - APJ, who is known for his strong leadership skills and commitment to developing a high-performing sales organization. His leadership style encourages open communication and collaboration, providing team members with the support they need to excel

The role is hybrid, requiring a flexible work setup where the new hire is expected to spend time meeting with customers and partners, alongside hosting team meetings. Regular in-office presence and travel up to 50% travel within India, as well as about 10% of travel outside of region will be essential for team collaboration and market visibility.  
  
**Your Role**

\*The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities.

* Lead and manage a field sales organisation, including managing first-line and second line sales managers.
* Develop and implement successful sales strategies to drive new business and double-digit revenue growth across the South-East Asia region.
* Capitalise on market tailwinds, specifically focusing on displacing legacy virtualisation solutions and driving the adoption of modern apps and AI.
* Foster a strong, positive, and resilient team culture to enhance Nutanix's employer brand in the region and attract/retain top-tier "A-player" talent.
* Build strong relationships with customers and ecosystem partners through frequent meetings and engagement.
* Conduct regular forecast calls with team members to assess performance and refine sales strategies.
* Collaborate with supporting functions such as marketing and customer success to enhance sales efforts.
* Leverages AI, CRM systems, and data-driven insights to maximise operational efficiency and business outcomes.
* Act as a spokesperson and champion for Nutanix in the region, enhancing brand visibility and reputation.
* Act as a spokesperson and champion for Nutanix in the region, enhancing brand visibility and reputation.

**What You Will Bring**

* Minimum 10 years of sales leadership experience in the relevant tech/software industry.  
  Strong market network with C-suite executives across at least 2-3 industry verticals.
* Deep understanding of the India enterprise market, specifically regarding legacy virtualization solutions, modern applications, and AI trends.
* Demonstrated success in achieving double-digit revenue growth year over year.
* Proven ability to act as a growth leader, driving high-performing sales organizations through a strong focus on new logo acquisition and market expansion.
* Experience managing a large sales organization, including managing first and second line managers and coaching and leading other functional managers in matrix.
* Strong people leadership qualities, with focus on accountability, sales discipline and high performance within the team.
* Collaborative and growth mindset, with experience in building a strong talent bench and track record in fostering a positive work environment.
* Demonstrated thought leadership and has a good understanding in selling Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions.
* Familiarity with CRM and sales software tools such as Salesforce, Aviso and Tableau.

As the F&B Manager you lead the full spectrum of our food and beverage, from bars and restaurants to in-room dining and outlets. You tailor group standards to the local context and make sure every experience feels memorable and true to our brand.

* Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of all events, banquets, private dining experiences, and special activations.
* Work collaboratively with Sales and Events teams to ensure flawless event delivery and commercial success.
* Oversee workforce planning and labour productivity across all outlets.

description:
**About SkyBlue Media Group**

We are an international media company with operations across Malaysia, Dubai, and India, specializing in creating impactful brand experiences across diverse media platforms. Over the past 15+ years, we have established a strong reputation for innovation, scale, and effectiveness in the OOH and entertainment marketing space.

Our Markets & Expertise

* **Malaysia – OOH Media Leadership**  
  With over 15 years of experience, we are one of Malaysia’s leading OOH media companies, offering a nationwide portfolio of outdoor and transit advertising formats. Our strong partnerships in cinema, retail, and outdoor environments ensure unmatched visibility and brand recall.
* **Dubai – Transit Media Exclusivity**  
  Through SB Mobility Media LLC, we hold the exclusive 5-year rights from Dubai’s Roads & Transport Authority (RTA) to manage bus and transit media. This includes bus exteriors, shelters, stations, and MUPIs, making us a leading player in transit advertising across the UAE.
* **India – Entertainment & Content Integrations**  
  Expanding into the world’s largest film and OTT markets, we are establishing our Mumbai-based operations focused on in-film brand integrations, OTT partnerships, and branded entertainment solutions. Supported by our AI-driven placement and analytics platform, we connect brands with audiences through story-driven content integrations that deliver measurable impact.

##### **View our websites at -** **https://www.skybluemedia.my/** **I** **https://skybluemedia.ae/**

**SkyBlue Cinematix\_India**

Is a premier media partner operating at the dynamic intersection of brands and content. We specialize in building strategic brand-content collaborations, seamless integrations, and cross-platform alliances. We act as the bridge between intellectual property (IP) owners, streaming/broadcast platforms, and retail brands to unlock massive commercial value across **Animation, Bollywood, and Gaming** ecosystems.

**About the Role**  
We are seeking an aggressive, results-driven **Content Licensing & Merchandising Manager / Senior Manager** who loves closing deals.

This is a highly entrepreneurial, sales-heavy role. You will be responsible for the entire pipeline: first, reaching out to creators and studios to acquire high-value IPs; second, pitching and licensing those IPs to major platforms; and third, onboarding manufacturing partners to turn those IPs into profitable merchandise (specifically focusing on **Apparel and Toys**).

If you are a smooth negotiator who knows how to hustle, build rapport with IP holders, and drive hard sales closures, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

1) **IP Acquisition & Inbounding:**

a) Proactively hunt, connect, and build relationships with IP holders, animation studios, Bollywood creators, and gaming developers to secure representation rights for their properties.

b) Convince creators and IP owners of SkyBlue’s capabilities to monetize and elevate their content.

2) **Platform Pitching & Sales Closure:**

a) Pitch acquired IPs to domestic and international OTT platforms, broadcasters, digital networks, and syndication partners.

b) Drive the sales process end-to-end—from initial cold outreach and pitching to commercial negotiations and contract closure.

3) **Merchandising & Retail Monetization:**

a) Pitch the represented IPs to retail brands, D2C companies, and manufacturers to launch co-branded consumer products, with a core focus on **Apparel and Toys**.

b) Secure minimum guarantees (MGs) and lucrative royalty structures from merchandising licensees.

4) **Account & Pipeline Management:**

a) Maintain a robust sales pipeline, tracking all outreach, active pitches, and deal statuses.

b) Coordinate with internal legal and finance teams to wrap up contract vetting and invoicing smoothly.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* **Experience:** 5 years plus of hardcore sales, business development, or client-facing experience in media syndication, celebrity management, ad-sales, or brand licensing.
* **Core Competency:** **A proven track record of closing sales deals.** You must be comfortable with aggressive pitching, cold calling, and handling objections.
* **Industry Knowledge:** A solid grasp of how IP licensing, syndication rights, and merchandising royalty models work.
* **Network:** Existing relationships with content creators, production houses, or retail brands in Mumbai is a massive advantage.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written presentation skills. You must be able to command a room and pitch effectively to C-level executives.

**Perks and Benefits**

* **Performance Bonus:** Highly lucrative, milestone-linked incentives designed for high-performing sales closers.
* **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical coverage for you.
* **Work-Life Balance:** A standard 5-day work week (Monday to Friday) within a high-growth, energetic media environment.

**Why Sky Blue Media?**

Because we don’t just work with brands and content; we help shape how audiences experience them. Every partnership here is an opportunity to redefine how storytelling meets strategy, across television, digital, and OTT. If you’re someone who understands the pulse of media and knows how to bring brands into that story, this is where you belong.

-----------------

You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.

title: Manager Business Finance
description:
Overview:

**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**PURPOSE**
-----------

As the trusted partner to the BU CFO / Director for all Business Finance matters, the Finance Business Partner enables financially sound planning and decision making across the partner organization. The role spreads financial acumen, tells clear, data-driven stories that spur action, bridges the gap between finance and operations, and helps shape the decision support tools delivered with Data and Analytics / FP&A.

The role takes a technology-guided, coaching-led approach to partnering, enabling decision makers to act more independently. It interprets data, advises the business and supports long-run performance management, drawing on a deep understanding of SITA's business models and financial drivers to convert analysis into decisions, targets and outcomes. It does not produce reporting; production is owned centrally by Data and Analytics / FP&A.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

**Deepen decision makers’ Business Finance acumen**

* Continuously coach decision makers on how Business Finance analyzes situations, develops insights, and applies them to decisions.
* **Influence decisions through narrative and visuals:** Turn financial analysis into clear, compelling stories linked to business decisions. Use standardized Data & Analytics / FP&A and BI reports, ERP analytics, Copilot, and tailored visuals based on governed data. Focus on decision quality rather than analysis volume.
* Challenge assumptions through problem analysis and root-cause exercises to reduce bias and introduce a Finance perspective.
* Train decision makers to use value-driver trees to connect operational decisions with enterprise value creation, risk mitigation, investment priorities, and financial impact.
* Improve financial data literacy through learning programs, financial storytelling, modeling, and scenario analysis, helping stakeholders understand financial impacts and risks.

**Assess and anticipate decision makers’ needs**

* Build strong relationships with executives and business leaders to understand financial needs, challenges, and the most effective support required.
* Identify latent needs through active listening and uncover opportunities for new decision-support tools and services from Data & Analytics / FP&A.
* Maintain continuous stakeholder feedback loops to rapidly improve Finance services and support.

**Provide personalized decision support to executives**

* Proactively guide executives toward meeting and exceeding performance goals.
* Monitor leading indicators to identify delivery risks and performance gaps, drive corrective actions, and recommend alternative approaches.
* Help executives identify opportunities to create enterprise value or mitigate risk through effective metric prioritization.

**Support nonexecutive decision makers when appropriate**

* Assess and prioritize inbound support requests and determine whether existing decision-support tools can meet the need or new solutions are required.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities and support cost-reduction planning.
* Pressure-test budgets, providing Business Finance expertise on potential risks and constraints.
* Lead comprehensive business cases for investments, product initiatives, internal funding, and M&A. Assess benefits, costs, risks, and ROI through realistic, measurable, stress-tested financial models. Partner with Pricing, Product, and transversal teams; present and defend cases to Investment Boards; track actual versus projected ROI; drive corrective actions; and lead post-M&A integration planning.
* Identify performance issues and support course correction.

**Facilitate digital decision-support tools**

* Partner with technology teams to ensure tools provide actionable guidance for operational and strategic decisions.
* Act as the **voice of the internal customer** with Data & Analytics / FP&A and technology teams, helping design intuitive reports, analyses, and dashboards for nonexecutive decision makers.

**Drive adoption of decision-support tools**

* Match stakeholders with the most appropriate decision-support tools.
* Demonstrate their value through success stories and early adopters/change champions, tailoring communications to different audiences.
* Support change-management strategies that increase adoption of new tools and processes.
* Translate financial insights into clear business language so recommendations embedded in tools are intuitive and actionable.

**Monitor and assess the value of support**

* Champion Finance Business Partner and Data & Analytics / FP&A knowledge-sharing forums to exchange lessons on educating and supporting decision makers.
* Help define success criteria and measurable business and technical metrics for decision-support tools, monitoring utilization and quality.
* Proactively seek stakeholder feedback.

Qualifications:

**EXPERIENCE**
--------------

* Extensive experience in financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling
* Proven ability to train decision makers to have an enterprisewide perspective and in simplifying complex financial analysis into easily digestible logic
* Proven history of building and maintaining strong relationships with business unit leaders and other stakeholders
* Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams to create and implement financial decision support tools
* Preferred familiarity with managing change and ensuring the smooth adoption of new tools and processes
* Has established and monitored success criteria and metrics for financial tools
* 7+ years in financial analysis, controlling or business partnering, preferably in a multinational, high-technology environment.
* Experience interacting at senior management level and exercising sound judgement between personal involvement and delegation.
* People management experience in an international, multi-matrix organisation.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**
----------------------

* **Financial planning and analysis** **expertise**: Expert knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes, including the ability to drive continuous improvement in these areas. Deep understanding of the P&L and balance sheet, KPI driver maps and reporting methodologies

title: Manager, Analytics & Effectiveness
description:
**Manager, Analytics & Effectiveness**

**Hybrid working - Mumbai-based**

We’re looking for a Manager to join the Analytics & Effectiveness team in Mumbai, owning the measurement requirements of our Insights team.

The Team - INSIGHTS @ Blis

Not data, not analytics, not research, but all of these things - plus human interpretation - to shorten the gap between what these data tell us, and the recommendations we can make to clients.

* Purpose - Work with Sales to win new business, retain these clients, and grow their spend with us.
* Principles - Be useful (solve client challenges), be interesting (use our data and expertise to tell them something they don’t know), and be honest (understand our data, in order to use it appropriately).
* Process - Observation (data + context) Interpretation (what does it say?) Implication (what does it mean? So what?) Recommendation (what should I do?)

**Responsibilities:**

You will own the day-to-day management of Analytics and Measurement requirements within the Insights team, including but not limited to:

* Manage research project requirements across regions, taking ownership of key processes.
* Support the Analytics & Effectiveness Lead in managing and developing team members.
* Work with large data sets to create executive-level presentations that distill complex findings into compelling insights and deliver flawless research and analytics to clients.
* Provide reporting and ongoing analytical support to key stakeholders.
* Design, build, and maintain dashboards that turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.
* Be accountable for the quality of work in your domain (dashboards, analyses, weighting, etc.), running quality checks on all allocated projects.
* Anticipate, troubleshoot, and resolve challenges proactively, escalating to your project lead in a timely manner when needed.
* Identify and implement ways to automate and improve processes and reporting.
* Mentor junior team members and uphold high standards across all deliverables.

**What you bring:**

**Education & Experience:**

* Education: Graduate or Post Graduate in a quantitative, business, or computer-related field (mathematics, statistics, engineering, research, computer science, etc.).
* 4-5 years of experience in Market Research, Insights, or Data Analytics.

**Personal skills**

* Attention to detail: accuracy matters at every stage, from brief-taking to set-up to output. You’re unafraid of big data sets and have an eye for quality.
* Time management: you can prioritise projects across multiple clients and deliver scheduled reports on time.
* Communication: you manage stakeholder expectations on output and timings, and deliver work with clarity.
* Customer-centric mindset: you take a solution-oriented approach to client needs.
* Relationship building: you work well with your team and local market reps.

**Technical skills**

* Experience in quantitative research and media effectiveness measurement, with a solid understanding of media objectives and the right measurement methodologies.
* Solutions mindset: You know the ‘perfect’ approach, but must be flexible enough to apply a ‘practical’ approach that delivers on client needs, with the tools available.
* Market research: Comfort blending primary and secondary research to understand market trends, the competitive landscape, and other industry factors.
* Advanced Microsoft office and G-suite applications skills required. Dashboarding experience in tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio,etc
* Dashboarding experience, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.
* Innovation & Process Optimization: Continuously strive to Identify ways to automate and improve processes, reports, etc.
* Mentorship: Provide guidance and quality control for the junior folks within the team, ensuring high standards across all deliverables.

**About us**

**Blis is the only omnichannel DSP that unites telco data, real-world movement patterns, and transactions to deliver a complete view of the consumer. Powered by T-Mobile and built for precision at scale, Blis' omnichannel platform helps marketers map the full purchase journey – from impression to transaction – and expand their audience reach, driving incremental results across every screen.**

**Founded in the UK in 2004, Blis employs over 300 global employees across 14 offices in 11 countries.**

title: Sales Representative (Work From Home) | KrushiSarthi
description:
**About KrushiSarthi**

**KrushiSarthi is India’s first AI-powered agro agency management system**
. We help fertilizer, seed and pesticide dealers run their entire shop from one app, and we are replacing slow, manual billing software with something that feels modern.

**What makes it stand out:**

* **AI Purchase Entry:**
  Upload a supplier invoice and the AI fills in everything, including batch, expiry and manufacture dates. A job that takes about 2 hours by hand is done in minutes.
* **Smart Udhari Management:**
  Automatic WhatsApp reminders for credit customers, sent in a way that keeps the shopkeeper’s own number safe.
* **GST-ready billing:**
  E-invoice and e-way bill support, dynamic QR on invoices, and bill-wise and item-wise profit and loss.
* **Alerts that save money:**
  Expiry and low-stock notifications, plus agro-specific reports.
* **Works on any phone or laptop:**
  Cloud backup, mobile app and multi-counter billing, all in one plan.

**The Role**

We are looking for a driven Sales Representative to bring KrushiSarthi to agro dealers across India. You will connect with shop owners, show them what the product can do, and help them switch from old software or paper registers to KrushiSarthi. This is a fully remote role. You work from home, we give you the product, the pitch and the support to sell it.

**What You Will Do**

* Reach out to agro shop owners and agencies through calls, WhatsApp and video calls
* Run live online demos of KrushiSarthi on your laptop and screen-share with prospects
* Explain the product in simple language, in Marathi, Hindi or the dealer’s own language
* Understand each dealer’s pain points (billing time, udhari recovery, stock, GST) and match them to our features
* Follow up with leads, handle objections and close subscriptions.
* Share dealer feedback with our product team so we keep improving.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Comfortable with technology: you can learn a new app quickly, screen-share, use WhatsApp Business, Google Meet, and Excel or Google Sheets without help
* Strong communication skills and confidence on calls
* Fluent in Marathi and Hindi (more regional languages is a bonus)
* Self-motivated, disciplined, and able to work independently from home
* Sales experience is a plus. Freshers with great communication and hunger to learn are welcome.
* Background in agriculture, agro inputs, or dealing with shopkeepers is a bonus

**Why Join Us**

* Sell a genuinely new kind of product with no true AI competitor in the agro billing space
* 100% work from home
* Grow with a fast-moving product
* Real ownership: your results are visible and rewarded

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a short note on why you would be great at this role to info.krushisarthi@gmail.com Please mention the languages you speak.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
As a Pricing Specialist, you will manage customer pricing requests and support the conversion of customer requirements into accurate, timely quotations and orders.
  
  
You will communicate with customers and internal stakeholders, maintain pricing information, evaluate wholesale business requests, coordinate order progress and help deliver a reliable customer experience. * Prepare and submit accurate customer quotations, with a strong focus on right-first-time quality and agreed turnaround times.
* Manage customer pricing requests, pricing inventories and order-conversion discussions from initial request through closure.

* You use sound judgement to balance customer expectations, contractual commitments and Vodafone’s commercial interests.

An entry-level opportunity to build practical experience across customer pricing, telecom products, order management and cross-functional delivery while working with internal teams, business partners and customers.

Telecom pricing, quotation management, order-to-cash operations, customer communication, stakeholder coordination, commercial awareness and continuous process improvement.

Rohera Healthcare & Technology Pvt. Ltd. (eMedica) is a fast-growing, Pune-based medical device company bringing advanced bioelectronic healthcare technology to doctors, hospitals and patients. We are looking for driven field Sales Executives who want their income to grow with their performance.

**Your earnings**

* **Fixed salary: ₹18,000 per month (freshers) / ₹23,000 per month (experienced)**, paid every month
* **5% commission on device sales from your own field leads**, from the 2nd device onwards. Leads and enquiries you create through your own field visits earn you the highest reward
* **1% of the monthly revenue you generate on all company-generated leads**. The company gives you leads, and you earn on every rupee you close
* **₹500 for every device subscription** you close
* All commissions and bonuses are paid on top of your fixed salary

**What you could earn: an example month**

* 4 devices sold from your own field leads, at ₹2,50,000 each: 5% on the 2nd, 3rd and 4th device = **₹37,500**
* 2 devices closed on company-generated leads (₹5,00,000 revenue): 1% = **₹5,000**
* 10 subscriptions: 10 × ₹500 = **₹5,000**
* **Total: ₹47,500 in commission and bonus + your fixed salary**, which comes to ₹70,500 that month for an experienced executive
* This example is illustrative. Actual earnings depend on the sales you close each month, and every additional device you sell raises your income

**Why join eMedica**

* Percentage-based commission: your income grows with every sale
* Company-generated leads to support you, plus the highest reward for leads you build yourself
* Complete product and science training before you go to the field
* Work with doctors, hospitals and clinics in a respected healthcare category
* Growth opportunities in a fast-growing company

* Visit doctors, hospitals and clinics across Pune and build strong professional relationships

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1756969

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**The opportunity**

The product owner will be responsible for the technology analysis, end user research, future product planning, and cradle-to-grave life-cycle management of the product that is developed. You will build products from existing ideas, and help to develop new ideas based on your industry experience and your contact with customers and prospects. You must possess a unique blend of business and technical savvy; a big-picture vision, create a vision of the product from an end user perspective, and the drive to make that vision a reality. You must enjoy spending time in the market to understand their problems, and find innovative solutions for the broader market. You must be able to communicate with all areas of the company. You will work with a technology counterpart to define product release requirements. You will work closely with various stakeholders to make business decisions and create product strategies that ensure the long-term sustainability of the products or tools. You will also serve as the internal and external evangelist for your product offering, occasionally working with the sales channel and key customers.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Identifying, evaluating, and planning new software products using lean/agile principles.
* Creating use-cases and related requirements materials for use by our development/technology teams
* Defining minimum viable product features (MVP) and/or pivoting existing products.
* Propose product strategy changes because of competitive changes in the marketplace.
* Working cross-functionally, define and drive alignment and implementation of the software roadmap including products, services, and solutions.
* Closely collaborate with cross-functional teams across business, technical and implementation teams to define product requirements to build and own the product roadmap.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog together with product management.
* Report to Global leadership on product status, management of budget etc.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of customers’ challenges and needs to clearly define product requirements
* Manage the product life cycle
* Assist in the build / buy strategy including recommendations for current solutions
* Communicate and drive organizational alignment on software deployment with key stakeholders including end users
* Works with the technology and client services teams to build and enhance products from existing ideas, and help develop new concepts based on industry research and the needs of end user

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Experience with HR / Payroll technology solutions and a good understanding of global HRIS / HR / Payroll technology landscape
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done
* Ability to effectively work as a leader in a cross functional team environment including business and product development, supply chain and procurement processes and execution dependencies
* Strong track record of influencing successful product/solution vision/roadmap and executing to a plan
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and expertise in communicating with teams across geographies
* Excellent knowledge of Design Thinking and User Experience methodologies.
* Strategic thinker who is comfortable in a fast-paced, always-on, ambiguous start-up environment

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in engineering (Computer Science/ Technology
* 12 - 15 years of experience in IT/software industry with at least 6 years in capacity of product manager.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Knowledge and experience in dealing with cross platform mobile applications.
* Demonstrated success in delivering high quality technology products/services in a very high growth environment where priorities shift rapidly.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.

Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.

At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.

**Job Snapshot**

We’re looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead strategic, customer-facing programs within our Professional Services organization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of program leadership, client management, and operational excellence, bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to complex customer engagements across multiple projects and service lines. You’ll work closely with enterprise and commercial customers, internal delivery teams, and senior stakeholders to ensure seamless execution, measurable business impact, and a consistently high-quality experience across all Professional Services programs. If you excel at turning ambiguity into action, orchestrating multiple stakeholders, balancing competing priorities, and ensuring outcomes that delight customers, this role is for you.

### **What’s in it for you?**

* **Customer Program Leadership**
* Lead multiple concurrent customer programs and projects across implementation, content delivery, managed services and technical solutions workstreams — ensuring timely, high-quality, and predictable delivery.
* Build trusted relationships with customer executives and internal stakeholders to align program goals with strategic business outcomes.
* Translate customer objectives into structured delivery plans with clear timelines, milestones, and measurable success metrics.
* Participate in pre-sales efforts, contributing to scoping, effort estimation, and proposal creation in partnership with Sales, Solutions, and Delivery teams.

* **Program Governance & Delivery Excellence**
* Establish and maintain robust program governance frameworks, ensuring transparency, accountability, and consistency across customer workstreams.
* Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate delivery risks — ensuring early detection, clear communication, and effective resolution.
* Oversee project timelines, effort utilization, and resource allocation to ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.
* Define and track delivery metrics (SLA adherence, quality, customer satisfaction) to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Prepare and share timely reports with customers and internal stakeholders to maintain alignment on deliverables, effort consumed, and budget adherence.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with teams across other professional services lines, Customer Success, Product, and Operations to ensure alignment on dependencies, priorities, and customer outcomes.
* Act as the connective link between Professional Services, customer leadership, and customer-facing teams, ensuring shared visibility and cohesive execution.
* Collaborate with Sales and Solutions teams during pre-sales and expansion opportunities to shape delivery plans and ensure solution feasibility.

* **Operational Maturity & Scale Enablement**
* Define, standardize, and continuously enhance program management frameworks, delivery processes, and playbooks to improve efficiency and scalability across service lines.
* Lead operational excellence initiatives focused on workflow optimization, process automation, and performance measurement.
* Mentor and coach Program and Project Managers, driving a culture of ownership, accountability, and delivery excellence.

* **Communication & Stakeholder Management**
* Deliver clear, executive-ready updates — translating complex program progress into actionable insights for both internal and external audiences.
* Proactively manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring visibility into risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Facilitate alignment across leadership, delivery, and customer stakeholders through structured communication and governance cadence.

### **We’d love to hear from you, if you:**

* **8–10 years** of experience in program or delivery management, preferably within enterprise SaaS, consulting, or professional services environments.
* Proven track record of leading **large, multi-stakeholder programs** with measurable business outcomes across multiple customers or service portfolios.
* Demonstrated success in driving **risk management, operational excellence, and scalable governance models** across delivery teams.
* **Client Leadership:** Skilled in managing enterprise and commercial customers, building trusted relationships, and ensuring alignment at executive and operational levels.
* **Program Orchestration:** Adept at balancing multiple concurrent priorities, managing cross-functional dependencies, and ensuring predictable, high-quality delivery.
* **Risk Management:** Proactive in identifying, communicating, and mitigating risks to maintain delivery predictability and customer confidence.
* **Strategic Execution:** Ability to balance tactical project delivery with long-term program vision, ensuring all initiatives align with strategic business outcomes.
* **Communication Excellence:** Able to communicate clearly, persuasively, and effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Agility & Prioritization:** Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments; anticipate challenges, prioritize effectively among competing priorities, and adapt quickly to change.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or enterprise consulting organizations.
* Exposure to SaaS implementation, managed services, or enablement delivery models.
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, BI platforms, or workflow automation solutions.

**Our Culture & Values**
------------------------

We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.

Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.

Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.

We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.

We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.

**Mindtickle is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Your Right to Work: In compliance with applicable laws, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the respective work locations and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.  
  
The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees.
* Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
* Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
* Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases.
* Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
* Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree from accredited university or equivalent experience
* Demonstrated a strong customer obsession, ability to dive deep, bias for action, and high-level judgement on complex cases
* Intermediate proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Access, Outlook and PowerPoint
* Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including night shifts, and willingness to work overtime or on the 6th day as needed

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2 to 3 years of experience in Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role
* Ability to apply critical thinking and identify issues for problem solving
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters
* Experience working with confidential information.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The Process Manager – Technology Operations Delivery owns end-to-end delivery of competitive intelligence and analytical services for eClerx clients across online retail, fashion, MRO, manufacturing & distribution (M&D), and hi-tech computing industries. The role is accountable for day-to-day operations management, SLA adherence, client relationship and expectation management, and escalation handling, while driving hands-on use of AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to deliver faster, higher-quality insights and run lean, largely self-sufficient operations. The incumbent works closely with the immediate delivery team, cross-functional stakeholders, and client counterparts to ensure consistent, scalable, and error-free service delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Service Delivery & Operations Management**

* Own day-to-day delivery of services to clients across online retail, fashion, MRO, M&D, and hi-tech computing accounts, ensuring consistent quality and turnaround.

* Ensure adherence to defined SLAs (turnaround time, accuracy, coverage) and proactively identify and resolve deviations.

**Client Management & Escalation Handling**

* Act as a primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing expectations on scope, timelines, and deliverable quality.

* Design, document, and deploy standard operating procedures (SOPs) and quality checks to ensure error-free, consistent delivery.
* Apply systems thinking to identify process gaps, redundancies, and single points of failure across the delivery workflow.

* Skilled in prompt engineering — writing, testing, and refining prompts for consistent, accurate outputs.
* Experience designing lightweight AI-enabled workflows/agents that combine data lookup, reasoning, and task completion with minimal manual oversight.
* Strong project management and delivery planning skills — able to plan, sequence, and track multi-workstream delivery.
* Hands-on with data — comfortable working in Excel/Power BI or similar tools to build reports, dashboards, and drive data-based decisions.
* Systems thinking — able to see how processes, tools, and teams interact, and design for scale and resilience.
* Experience designing, developing, and deploying processes and SOPs that ensure error-free delivery.
* Proven ability to work with and present to senior leadership and client stakeholders.
* Experience working with cross-functional, matrixed, or global teams across time zones.

title: Originator
description:
**Originator – Business Development & Commercial**
ENGIE is accelerating the energy transition across the world. In India, our Supply & Energy Management team is building the commercial bridge between renewable energy assets and the businesses that need them. We are looking for a driven originator to grow our customer base and shape the future of clean energy procurement.
  
  
This is a role for someone who thrives on opening doors, building trust, and closing deals. You will work at the centre of a fast-moving, purpose-driven business — helping large commercial and industrial customers access renewable energy solutions that are both practical and sustainable.
  
  
**About Supply & Energy Management**
ENGIE's Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) business in India acts as the market-facing interface between energy assets, power markets, and corporate customers. S&EM intends to support Indian businesses in managing energy procurement and decarbonization through tailored solutions, while helping optimize and commercialize renewable assets.
  
  
Its activities include client origination, market access, physical and virtual PPA structuring, power supply solutions, green attributes such as RECs and I-RECs, portfolio and asset optimization, and management of price, volume, and profile risks. The team works closely with ENGIE's renewable business and regional trading platform to translate customer requirements into practical, commercially viable energy solutions.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
The role is responsible for originating, developing, and converting new customer opportunities for ENGIE's upcoming Renewable energy assets in India. The incumbent will focus on acquiring new commercial and industrial customers, developing strategic relationships with key decision-makers, and expanding ENGIE's market presence across Western and Southern India.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, develop, and secure new commercial opportunities with large commercial and industrial customers, with priority coverage across Western and Southern India.
* Build and manage a qualified pipeline in sectors such as data centers, manufacturing, metals, cement, chemicals and fertilisers, automotive, FMCG, electronics, and pharmaceuticals.
* Develop relationships with CXOs, Procurement Heads, Energy Heads, Sustainability Leaders, and Plant Management teams.
* Create and execute territory-specific business development plans and systematic account-entry strategies.
* Lead the end-to-end sales cycle, including lead generation, initial qualification, solution discussions, proposal development, commercial negotiations, and contract closure.
* Contribute to agreed revenue, margin, contracted volume, and new-customer acquisition objectives.
* Work with Commercial, Trading, Asset Development, Legal, Risk, Finance, KYC, and Back Office teams to structure executable customer solutions.
* Develop market intelligence on customer demand, competitor activity, regulations, and emerging energy procurement trends.
* Represent ENGIE at relevant industry forums, conferences, customer events, and association platforms.
* Build relationships with industry associations to strengthen market access and lead generation.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, activity, and conversion visibility in the designated CRM system.
* Identify cross-selling and account-expansion opportunities while supporting long-term customer satisfaction and retention.

**Candidate Profile**

* 5-8 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, client origination, key account management, or a commercial role.
* Demonstrated track record of generating new business opportunities and converting prospects into customers.
* Prior experience in power, renewable energy, energy services, Power Trading, or a related sector is preferred.
* Existing relationships with large commercial and industrial energy consumers will be a strong advantage.
* Prior experience and an established client network in Western India and/or Southern India will be highly valued.
* Experience managing the complete sales lifecycle, from market mapping and lead generation through negotiations and contract execution.
* Graduate degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is desirable.

**Core Competencies**

* Hunter mindset with the ability to open doors and independently create opportunities.
* Strong commercial acumen, customer orientation, and negotiation capability.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and senior-stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into practical, tailored solutions.
* Entrepreneurial, accountable, disciplined, and comfortable working in a matrix organisation.
* Working knowledge of the Indian power and renewable-energy market is preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM-based opportunity management.
* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned regions.

**Our Commitment**
At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century.
  
  
ENGIE is committed to creating an inclusive environment where every person feels respected and valued. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. We believe diverse teams make better decisions and deliver stronger results.
  
  
If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to support you.

Are you a dynamic and persuasive communicator with a passion for design and a flair for sales?

Gray Homez, a thriving interior, architectural, and furniture firm based in Sultanpur, Delhi, is looking for an exceptional Sales Person to join our growing team.

If you have impeccable English communication skills, a natural ability to connect with clients, and a keen eye for opportunities, we want to hear from you!

About Gray Homez:

At Gray Homez, we transform spaces into dreams. We specialize in creating bespoke interior and architectural designs that blend aesthetics with functionality, delivering innovative and personalized solutions for our residential and commercial clients. Our commitment to quality, creativity, and client satisfaction sets us apart in the industry.

The Role:

As our Sales Person, you will be the first point of contact for potential clients, playing a pivotal role in expanding our client base and driving business growth. Your primary responsibilities will include:

\* Lead Generation & Qualification: Identifying and researching potential clients who align with Gray Homez's service offerings.

\* Client Communication: Engaging with prospective clients through calls, emails, and in-person meetings to understand their design needs and present Gray Homez's capabilities.

\* Proposal Presentation: Effectively communicating the value proposition of our design services, explaining our processes, and presenting tailored proposals.

\* Relationship Building: Cultivating strong, lasting relationships with clients, architects, builders, and other industry professionals.

\* Negotiation & Closing: Guiding clients through the sales process, addressing objections, and successfully closing deals.

\* Market Insight: Staying informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and client demands to refine sales strategies.

\* Collaboration: Working closely with our design and project management teams to ensure seamless client transitions and satisfaction.

What We're Looking For:

\* Exceptional English Communication: Fluent, articulate, and grammatically sound English, both written and verbal. The ability to express complex design concepts clearly and compellingly.

\* Proven Sales Acumen: A track record of success in sales, preferably within the design, architecture, real estate, or luxury goods sectors.

\* Strong Interpersonal Skills: A natural ability to build rapport, listen actively, and understand client needs.

\* Presentation Skills: Comfortable and confident delivering presentations to individuals and groups.

\* Self-Motivated & Target-Oriented: Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and consistently meet or exceed sales targets.

\* Passion for Design: A genuine interest in interior design, architecture, and home aesthetics.

\* Problem-Solving Skills: Resourcefulness in addressing client concerns and finding effective solutions.

\* Proficiency in CRM Software: Experience with CRM tools is a plus.

Why Join Gray Homez?

\* Be a part of a creative and passionate team dedicated to design excellence.

\* Opportunity to work on diverse and exciting projects.

\* Competitive salary with attractive incentives based on performance.

\* A supportive work environment that values growth and innovation.

\* Located in the vibrant design hub of Sultanpur, Delhi.

If you're ready to bring your sales expertise to a firm where creativity meets opportunity, we encourage you to apply!

To Apply:

Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this role.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent, Fresher, Internship

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Language:

* English (Preferred)

**Company:** Katyals Couture

**Department:** Retail Operations  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Working Days:** Tuesday to Sunday  
**Weekly Off:** Monday  
**Working Hours:** 10:30 AM – 8:00 PM

About Katyals Couture

Katyals Couture is a premium fashion retail brand specializing in elegant ethnic and contemporary Indian wear. We are looking for an experienced, responsible, and customer-oriented Store Manager to oversee daily store operations, manage the sales team, and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Store Operations & Management**

* Manage day-to-day operations of the fashion retail store.
* Ensure the store is well-maintained, organized, and visually appealing.
* Maintain high standards of customer service and store presentation.
* Ensure opening and closing procedures are followed.
* Monitor daily sales, store performance, and operational efficiency.

**2. Sales & Revenue Management**

* Achieve monthly sales targets and maximize store revenue.
* Monitor individual and team sales performance.
* Implement strategies to increase walk-in conversions and average transaction value.
* Encourage repeat customers and build long-term relationships.
* Handle customer inquiries, complaints, and escalations professionally.

**3. Staff Management**

* Supervise, train, and motivate sales executives.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor employee performance.
* Ensure punctuality, discipline, grooming, and professional conduct.
* Prepare staff schedules and manage daily task allocation.

**4. Inventory & Merchandising**

* Monitor stock availability, inventory movement, and replenishment.
* Ensure proper tagging, pricing, folding, and display of merchandise.
* Coordinate stocktaking and maintain inventory accuracy.
* Identify fast-moving and slow-moving products.
* Ensure proper handling and security of merchandise.

**5. Customer Relationship Management**

* Maintain customer databases and purchase records.
* Follow up with customers through calls and WhatsApp.
* Inform customers about new collections, offers, and arrivals.
* Build customer loyalty and ensure excellent shopping experiences.

**6. Reporting & Administration**

* Prepare daily sales reports and monthly performance summaries.
* Maintain billing, cash handling, and transaction records.
* Coordinate with management regarding sales, stock, and staff requirements.
* Ensure store policies and procedures are followed.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Minimum 2–5 years of experience in fashion retail or apparel store management.
* Experience in ethnic wear, designer wear, or premium fashion retail preferred.
* Strong sales, leadership, and customer management skills.
* Knowledge of POS billing, inventory management, and retail operations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic knowledge of Excel and retail reporting.
* Professional appearance and customer-oriented attitude.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly sales target achievement.
* Customer satisfaction and repeat customer rate.
* Inventory accuracy and stock management.
* Staff productivity and discipline.
* Store presentation and operational efficiency.

**We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the store, lead the team, and contribute directly to the growth of Katyals Couture.**

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month
