description:
Enterprise Regional Sales; Enterprise Regional Account Strategy Development & Implementation; Sales Calls; Customer Acquisition & Retention; Pre-Sales; Customer Proposal Creation; Pricing Proposal; Account Activation; Post-Sales; Competition Monitoring

**Title: Worldwide Regional Account Executive**

**Location:** Mumbai/Gujarat

**Who we are**

At FedEx, moving the world doesn't only mean delivering for our customers around the globe. Moving the world is also about creating what's next. We are Team FedEx and we are 500,000+ people strong around the world. The work we all do comes down to one purpose: to provide our customers with outstanding experiences as we connect the world to what's next.

This isn't a place to get just a job. Here, you get a career for life. It's a place to enjoy constant change, growth, and progress in your career. Our willingness to innovate and transform is what keeps us at the forefront of our industry. With curiosity, inventiveness, and entrepreneurial spirit, we keep finding new and better ways to deliver results for our customers, for our people and for the planet.

Here, you will have the flexibility and empowerment to reimagine the new, spread your wings and see your impact. By doing so, we are motivated to be better together. And together, we will continue to drive and deliver excellence.

**Our Values**

We take pride in being a people-first company, where our employees feel safe, valued and respected. Our culture values empower us to deliver great results.

With one FedEx culture, we:

**Take care of each other | Commit to do good | Own outstanding | Drive business results | Create what's next**

**Awards**

* FedEx has consistently ranked among the top 20 in the "World's Most Admired Companies" report, published in FORTUNE magazine, since 2001.
* Ethisphere named FedEx as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies® in 2023.

**What you will do:**

As a Worldwide Regional Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, developing existing customer relationships, and promoting Ocean Freight, Air Freight, Warehousing, and End-to-End Logistics solutions. You will play a key role in expanding the customer base, increasing revenue, and delivering profitable growth through effective sales strategies and strong market engagement.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* **Business Development:** Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers for Ocean Freight (FCL/LCL) and Air Freight services. Generate leads through cold calling, customer visits, networking, and referrals while developing and maintaining a strong sales pipeline to achieve assigned revenue targets.
* **Customer Growth:** Manage and strengthen relationships with existing customers, identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling, and increase customer wallet share through relevant logistics solutions.
* **Customer Relationship Management:** Build strong relationships with exporters, importers, manufacturers, traders, and freight forwarders. Understand their supply chain requirements and recommend suitable logistics solutions to meet their business needs.
* **Sales & Quotations:** Prepare competitive freight quotations in coordination with pricing and operations teams. Negotiate freight rates, contracts, and commercial terms, and proactively follow up on quotations to convert business opportunities into confirmed revenue.
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor market trends, competitor activities, freight rate movements, trade lanes, shipping line activities, and airline developments. Share relevant market insights and business opportunities with management.
* **Internal Coordination:** Collaborate with pricing, operations, customs clearance, and customer service teams to ensure smooth execution and seamless customer experience. Support new customer onboarding, service delivery, collections, and credit control activities.
* **Sales Reporting & Forecasting:** Maintain accurate CRM records, sales activity reports, and monthly business forecasts. Track sales performance against targets and monitor key metrics such as revenue generation, customer acquisition, and conversion ratios.
* **Performance Management:** Drive achievement of assigned monthly and annual sales targets while maintaining focus on profitability, customer retention, and timely collections.

**You will be a great fit if you:**

* Hold a bachelor's degree in commerce, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Have 2–8 years of relevant experience in Ocean Freight and Air Freight sales, preferably within freight forwarding, NVOCC, logistics, or shipping organizations.
* Have hands-on knowledge of Ocean Freight operations, including FCL and LCL, and Air Freight Export and Import services.
* Possess a strong understanding of freight forwarding, end-to-end supply chain solutions, and customs clearance processes.
* Demonstrate proven capabilities in business development, new customer acquisition, and managing existing customer relationships.
* Have strong negotiation, influencing, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective customer relationships.
* Possess commercial awareness and a profitability-oriented mindset, with the ability to negotiate competitive rates and identify business growth opportunities.
* Are proficient in CRM management, sales pipeline development, reporting, and business forecasting.
* Have a strong hunter mindset, are self-motivated and target-driven, and demonstrate resilience in working under pressure and meeting deadlines.
* Are proactive in gathering market intelligence, identifying competitor activities, and translating market insights into business opportunities.
* Have a demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets while maintaining customer satisfaction, retention, and payment compliance.

**What you can expect**

* Attractive remuneration package.
* Spread your wings and take ownership of your career with opportunities to network and connect with professionals in your field and involvement in cross-functional projects.
* A supportive and inclusive work environment.
* Mentorship and guidance from industry professionals.
* Exposure to real-world projects and challenges across business functions.
* Valuable skills and experience to enhance your professional growth and career progression.
* Complimentary 24/7 access to our learning platforms to support you in becoming who you want to be.

**Our Commitment to Equal Opportunities**

Our greatest asset at FedEx is our people. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, and offer equal opportunities, fairness and respect to all regardless of who you are. We encourage you to apply even if you feel your experience does not align with all the aspects in the job description as you could be exactly who we need for this or another opportunity.

We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, age, genetic information, citizenship, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status or any other characteristic protected under national, state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate team members and third parties with physical and mental disabilities.

**Interested to join Team FedEx?**

Everyone at FedEx has a part to play. It's about coming up with smart solutions, remaining resilient in the face of setbacks, and going above and beyond to get the job done. And whether you're a business leader or delivery driver, you'll be empowered to take responsibility and overcome each challenge in your own way.

If this role and working environment sound like a place you can thrive in, apply today and let's create what's next together.

Presentation Skills;Influencing & Persuasion Skills;Negotiation Skills;Written & Verbal Communication Skills;Networking Skills

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

**Our Company**
---------------

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

description:
Overview:

**Purpose**

The Director, Business Development & Strategic Sales is a senior growth leader responsible for creating, shaping and accelerating transformational business opportunities across the India Sub-Continent.

The role goes beyond traditional sales execution to identify emerging market opportunities, influence customer investment agenda(s), build strategic ecosystems and convert complex aviation, airport, border and digital-travel transformation priorities into large-scale commercial opportunities for SITA.

The Director operates at the intersection of market strategy, customer transformation, technology and commercial execution, engaging C-suite executives, government leaders, regulators, airport and airline leadership to position SITA as a strategic transformation partner.

Working across Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, Delivery, Finance, Legal and Marketing, the Director mobilizes the organization around high-value opportunities and leads strategic pursuits from initial concept through commercial execution.

This is a role for an aggressive business developer and strategic opportunity creator—someone who can identify where the market is going, create demand before a formal opportunity exists, shape customer requirements and build the internal and external coalition required to win.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Opportunity Creation & Market Shaping**

* Identify emerging aviation, airport, border and digital-travel trends and turn them into scalable commercial opportunities for SITA.
* Originate and lead transformational large opportunities built around airport operations, AI, data platforms and automation.

**2. Market Expansion, White-Space & Ecosystem Development**

* Develop regional and account-based growth strategies aligned with SITA's revenue targets.
* Identify white-space opportunities across existing customers, new accounts and adjacent markets.
* Build partner ecosystems of technology firms, consultants and system integrators for joint go-to-market opportunities.

**3. Government, Aviation & Public-Sector Engagement**

* Build strategic relationships with ministries, regulators, immigration and airport authorities shaping aviation modernization and digital-travel programs.
* Position SITA in national aviation, border management and digital-identity initiatives well ahead of formal procurement.

**4. Revenue Leadership & Strategic Pursuits**

* Build and lead the strategic pipeline to deliver sustainable revenue, bookings and profitability growth.
* Lead complex, high-value opportunities from early shaping through to contract execution, backed by compelling business cases.
* Partner with regional sales leadership to convert strategic opportunities into annual business outcomes.

**5. Executive Relationship Management**

* Build trusted relationships with C-suite and senior decisionmakers across airlines, airports and governments.
* Influence customer investment decisions through outcome-based discussions on performance, innovation and digital transformation.

**6. Strategic Leadership & Internal Orchestration**

* Align Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, Finance and Legal around strategic pursuits and secure internal commitment to win.
* Mentor BD and sales teams and bring market intelligence into product strategy and investment decisions.

**Success Measures**

* + Growth in strategic pipeline and qualified white-space opportunities.
  + Number and value of new strategic opportunities.
  + Achievement of Revenue, margin, New Sales generated from strategic pursuits.
  + Growth in market share, strategic account penetration and SITA's addressable market.
  + Growth in executive-level relationships and strategic sponsorship.
  + Growth in partner-led and ecosystem-led opportunities.
  + Contribution to market strategy, product direction, business planning and investment priorities

Qualifications:

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 20+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, business development, strategic account management or commercial leadership.

* Proven success leading complex, multimillion-dollar and transformational sales pursuits.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute growth strategies that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Executive presence with a track record of engaging and influencing C-suite, government and senior public-sector stakeholders.
* Strong commercial, negotiation, stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams within global, matrixed organisations.

-----------------

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**Our Mission**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

**Who We Are**

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

**Job Summary**

**The Team**

Idira, a Palo Alto Networks business unit formed after its landmark acquisition of CyberArk, is the global leader in AI-driven identity security and privileged access management (PAM). Evolving beyond legacy administrative platforms, Idira unifies PAM mastery with Palo Alto Networks' security infrastructure to protect the modern AI enterprise. Operating on a single control plane, the platform eliminates identity silos by continuously discovering environmental risk and enforcing Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP) across human users, machine workloads, and autonomous AI agents through dynamic, just-in-time access controls.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

* Lead the India Idira sales organization as the Regional Vice President by defining and executing the strategic vision to drive growth across the region.
  

  

* Partner cross-functionally with internal senior leaders, theater VPs, and technical solutions leadership to optimize go-to-market execution, driving alignment across India's complex, highly matrixed enterprise environment.
  

  

* Synthesize insights gathered from multiple enterprise customers in India to influence regional priorities, align sales districts to priority verticals and targeted accounts, and position Idira as a long-term strategic partner.
  

  

* Engage C-suite executives and internal senior leaders with a strong executive presence, maintaining composure and clarity to build trusted, strategic relationships at scale.
  

  

* Empower, mentor, and build a high-performing team of District Sales Managers (DSMs) across multiple regions in India, cultivating a culture of accountability, trust, autonomous decision-making, and continuous learning.
  

  

* Identify and execute tops-down Idira (AI-driven identity security and PAM) growth initiatives, ensuring consistent execution across the region while enabling specific district-level market opportunities.
  

  

* Enforce rigorous sales hygiene and operational discipline across districts (leveraging MEDDPICC-type methodologies) to ensure accurate forecasting, healthy pipelines, and consistent performance against bookings and revenue targets.
  

  

* Drive the adoption of full-suite platform selling—moving beyond single-product solutions to comprehensive identity and security architectures—by actively guiding sales teams through complex, multi-product enterprise deals.
  

  

* Distill and simplify complex technical concepts (such as Endpoint Privilege Manager [EPM] and Privileged Access Management [PAM]) and broad regional strategies into clear, actionable guidance that accelerates cross-functional alignment and execution.
  

  

* Balance an aggressive hunting motion to open doors into net-new 'Dark' accounts with a collaborative, relationship-driven style to drive upsells and renewals.
  

  

* Guide multiple districts through market or organizational shifts, demonstrating resilience and maintaining optimism to help teams overcome customer setbacks or lost opportunities.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* Significant leadership experience managing a quota-carrying sales team focused on platform selling; cybersecurity or identity management experience is highly preferred.
  

  

* A minimum of 2 years of proven second-line leadership experience (managing other sales leaders/managers).
  

  

* Extensive experience leading, developing, mentoring, and hiring top sales talent.
  

  

* Demonstrated success in value selling, solving complex business problems, and selling directly to C-suite and senior executive stakeholders.
  

  

* A track record of leading teams that sell a full suite of solutions (e.g., software/business applications vs. just hardware).
  

  

* Deep understanding of operational rigor, sales discipline, and structured sales processes.
  

  

* Strong domain experience in specialized "2nd line" models, with a background adjacent to or directly within the identity security, PAM, or broader cybersecurity landscape.
  

  

* Exceptional communication and soft skills, with the ability to articulate a strategic vision and mobilize cross-functional teams.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

* Direct background and experience in Privileged Access Management (PAM) or Identity Security.
  

  

* Experience running and scaling sales teams across multiple segments or regions within India.
  

  

* An existing network of trusted relationships with key decision-makers and C-level executives within the Indian enterprise market.
  

  

* Familiarity with Palo Alto Networks' internal stakeholders and go-to-market strategies, allowing for a quick ramp-up.

title: Retail Pharmacy Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

The Lead Pharmacist - Store operations is the primary point of contact for the assigned pharmacy, responsible for overseeing daily store operations, ensuring accurate dispensing of medications, maintaining regulatory compliance, managing inventory, and leading the store team to deliver excellent customer service and business performance.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

**1. Pharmacy Operations & Patient Care**

* Attend prescriptions at the sales counter, ensuring accurate dispensing of medications.
* Provide clear guidance on dosage, administration, and proper use of medicines.
* Offer patient counselling on medication usage, side effects, and general health advice.
* Handle customer queries, including drug information, therapy-related concerns, and home delivery services.

**2. Inventory & Stock Management**

* Ensure 100% prescription fulfilment by coordinating sourcing of unavailable medicines/ healthcare items with the central purchase team.
* Conduct inward stock inspection (quantity, MRP, batch number & expiry date).
* Perform accurate stock entry and cross-verification with inventory records.
* Maintain proper storage conditions, including temperature-sensitive drugs.

**3. Store Operations & Coordination**

* Act as the primary point of contact for all store-related activities and communication.
* Oversee end-to-end pharmacy operations, ensuring smooth daily functioning.
* Coordinate delivery requests and ensure timely dispatch of medicines.
* Ensure adherence to SOPs and company policies at all times
* Assist in store-level sales and marketing activities to support business growth and customer acquisition.

**4. Cash & Financial Management**

* Supervise billing and assist in cash handling at the counter when required.
* Monitor cash flow and control operational expenses efficiently.

**5. Team Management & Development**

* Lead, supervise, and motivate the store team to achieve performance targets.
* Provide regular feedback and conduct on-the-job training.
* Drive team productivity, customer service standards, and accountability.

**6. Issue Resolution & Customer Experience**

* Act as the first point of contact for escalations related to customers, operations, or team issues.
* Resolve concerns promptly to ensure high customer satisfaction and smooth operations.

**7. Sales & Performance Monitoring**

* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as sales, inventory turnover, and customer satisfaction.
* Analyze sales trends to identify opportunities for upselling and improving product movement.
* Optimize stock and store performance based on data insights.

**8. Reporting & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all state and national pharmacy regulations and company policies.
* Prepare and submit weekly/monthly performance reports to management.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit readiness at all times.

**Qualifications:**

* B.Pharm / D.Pharm from a recognized institution
* Valid State Pharmacy License (mandatory)

* **Prior experience in store handling or team supervision is mandatory**
* Working knowledge of pharmacy management systems

title: Regional Medical Advisor - Vaccines
description:
**Company Description**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary**  
We are looking for the Primary scientific face of the organization to ‘Thought Leaders’ & physicians for a given therapy area. You will be responsible for Identification, mapping and profiling of thought leaders of given geography and therapy area, on an ongoing basis.  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for the engagement of identified key thought leaders through medical affairs activities, in alignment with the overall strategic plan
* You will be responsible to execution of strategic medical affairs plan including but not limited to medical education, product education, medical evidence generation, advisory boards, pre-license activities and special projects
* You will be a therapeutic area scientific expert, responsible for discussing the scientific data pertaining to products on proactive and reactive basis, patients’ treatment trends and studies in the therapeutic areas in which the Company is involved, with defined audience of leading specialists (Physicians, Pharmacists, Hospital Managers, Board Members of Scientific Societies, and other Stakeholders) and to be considered a trusted scientific counterpart
* You will be responsible with therapy area lead to support optimal patient outcomes through communication of data, information, knowledge and insights in support of healthcare professional needs and organizational goals
* You will have to represent the organization in various internal & external scientific platforms
* You will have to gather deep insights on disease trends and treatment patterns from key thought leaders and conveying them back to the therapy lead and commercial teams.
* You will need to proactively conduct disease trend analysis in identified disease segments and contribute effectively to the development of annual Medical Affairs Strategy Plan
* You will be receiving and processing scientific information requests received from physicians
* You will have to ensure that all activities in the region are conducted in alignment to organisation’s COBE (Code of Business Ethics) Policy and compliance guidelines.
* You will need to collaborate with thought leaders to conduct therapy specific reviews, meta-analysis, case studies, case series, patient reported outcomes and publish them in reputed journals.
* You will be responsible for devising an optimal training plan to ensure the flow of the latest medical developments to the sales and marketing teams.
* You will jointly be responsible with the therapy area lead to support optimal patient outcomes through communication of data, information, knowledge, and insights in support of healthcare professional needs and organizational goals.
* Representing the organization in various internal and external scientific platforms will be among your responsibilities.
* You will be responsible for developing the Medical Affairs strategic plan for identified therapeutic areas and products.
* Your ability to convert insights on disease trends and treatment patterns from key thought leaders into viable and formidable strategic plans to shape the therapeutic areas of interest will be vital.
* You will be responsible for identifying knowledge gaps, practice gaps, and data gaps and developing strategic medical action plans, including but not limited to medical education, product education, evidence generation, and special projects, will fall under your responsibility.
* Collaborating with thought leaders to conduct therapy-specific reviews, meta-analysis, case studies, case series, patient-reported outcomes, and publishing them in reputable journals will be part of your role.
* Handling complex questions from healthcare professionals related to GGI products or disease areas to satisfaction will be a key responsibility.
* You will be responsible for ensuring that all activities in the therapeutic area are conducted in alignment with Dr. Reddy's COBE (Code of Business Ethics) Policy and compliance guidelines will be essential.
* You will be responsible for ensuring that all promotional, physician, and patient education materials are approved within stipulated timelines and in alignment with Dr. Reddy's Promotional Material approval policy.
* As a product pipeline champion, you will have the ability to identify unmet needs through active stakeholder interactions and actively contribute to the new product ideation and development of differentiated products.

  
  
**Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification-** MBBS with full time post-graduate qualification of at least 2-years’ duration in any discipline of medicine/ M.B.B.S with M.B.A. from a reputed institute  
  
**Minimum work experience-** Fresh postgraduate or up to 2 years of experience in Field based Medical Affairs.  
  
**Skills & attributes –**  
**Technical Skills**  

* Strong academic record with deep knowledge of the therapeutic area, strength in research with knowledge of research methodologies and interpretation of medical data
* Experience with scientific acumen and communication skills in order to be accepted by leading specialists in peer-to-peer relationship
* Experience with complex business environments preferred
* Strong track record of success as demonstrated through annual performance ratings and/or professional accomplishments and awards.

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Integrity driven decision making skills
* Collaboration and teaming with ability to work in a matrix environment
* Strategic thinking & sound analytical skills
* Big picture orientation with attention to detail
* Sense of urgency & desire to excel
* Intellectual curiosity
* Self-awareness and adaptability
* Result oriented and performance driven
* Excellent interpersonal & communication skills to effectively interact with a broad range of audience.

 **Additional Information**

**About the Department**  
**Global Generics India**  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  
  
**Benefits Offered**  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  
  
**Our Work Culture**  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.  
For more details, please visit our career website at **https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

Indo Gulf Hospital is a multispecialty healthcare provider that has been serving the Noida and NCR community since 2003 with patient-focused, accessible medical care.

The hospital offers comprehensive services under one roof, including outpatient and inpatient care, emergency services, surgery, neurology and neurosurgery, orthopaedics, diagnostics, pathology, and preventive health check-ups. Care is delivered by experienced doctors and dedicated clinical and nursing teams with an emphasis on compassion, quality, and long-term relationships with patients and families.

Indo Gulf Hospital is committed to strengthening clinical capabilities, expanding access to quality healthcare, and continuously improving the patient experience as it grows with the community. Located in Sector 19, Noida, the hospital is a trusted healthcare partner for generations of families.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for a Business Development Executive based at Indo Gulf Hospital in Noida.

The Business Development Executive will identify and pursue new business opportunities, including corporate, institutional, and community partnerships, to grow patient inflow and hospital services.

Daily responsibilities include lead generation, follow-up with potential partners, conducting meetings and presentations, and maintaining strong relationships with referring doctors, clinics, and organizations.

The role involves tracking market trends, contributing to outreach and promotional activities, coordinating with clinical and administrative teams to design service packages, and managing key accounts to ensure high satisfaction and repeat engagement.

The Business Development Executive will prepare reports, maintain CRM or lead-tracking systems, and support strategic initiatives to enhance the hospital’s visibility and presence in the region.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in New Business Development and Lead Generation to identify, qualify, and convert opportunities for hospital growth.
* Candidates should possess skills in Account Management and Business relationship building to nurture long-term partnerships and manage key stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities, to effectively interact with internal and external stakeholders.
* Relevant experience in healthcare business development, sales, or marketing, preferably in hospitals or medical services.
* Ability to work with targets, analyze data, and prepare concise business reports and proposals.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with clinical and administrative teams on-site.
* Familiarity with the Noida/NCR healthcare market and willingness to engage in field visits and community outreach activities.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
**Job Description: Sales Associate

Department: Sales / Growth

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: On-site

Salary: ₹ 15,000 – ₹ 25,000 per month (depending on experience)

Role Overview

We are looking for a Sales Associate to convert website visitors into customers and build relationships with nutritionists and doctors. In this role, you will represent our brand, talk to prospects over calls and chat, follow up consistently, and close sales from first conversation to final order.

What Your Day-to-Day Looks Like

1. Converting Website Leads

• Call and message people who visit our website, enquire about products, or leave their details.

• Understand each customer's goals and recommend the right products.

• Handle questions and objections confidently, and close the sale.

2. Regular Follow-ups

• Follow up daily with warm leads, abandoned carts, and previous enquiries.

• Keep a clear record of every conversation, next step, and outcome in the CRM or tracker.

• Re-engage past customers for repeat purchases.

3. Working with Nutritionists & Doctors

• Reach out to nutritionists, dietitians, and doctors to introduce our products and build partnerships.

• Explain product benefits, ingredients, and usage clearly to a professional audience.

• Be their main point of contact: handle queries, share samples, and keep the relationship strong.

4. Reporting & Coordination

• Track daily call numbers, conversions, and follow-up status.

• Work with the customer operations team so orders and deliveries go smoothly.

• Share customer feedback and common objections with the team.

What We Are Looking For

• Experience: 0–2 years in sales, telecalling, inside sales, business development, or customer support. Freshers with strong communication skills are welcome.

• Communication Skills: Sharp spoken and written communication in English and Hindi. Confident on calls and persuasive without being pushy.

• Selling Ability: Comfortable pitching, handling objections, and closing. A target-driven mindset.

• Professionalism: Able to talk casually with customers and formally with doctors and nutritionists.

• Attention to Detail: Careful with orders, customer details, and follow-up schedules.

• Organization & Time Management: Can manage a daily call list, hit targets, and follow up without being reminded.

• Good to have: Interest in health, nutrition, or wellness products, and basic comfort with Excel/Google Sheets or a CRM.

What We Offer

• A role in a fast-growing women-focused wellness brand

• Direct exposure to sales strategy, customer behaviour, and professional partnerships

• Performance-linked growth opportunities**

title: Senior Vice President Sales Business Development
description:
**Company Description**
Hindustan Parking Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd (HPIPL) is an Indian brand focused on designing, manufacturing, and installing next-generation parking systems that enhance urban mobility and smart infrastructure. Guided by a Make in India approach, HPIPL blends Indian ingenuity with global technology standards to deliver ISO-certified, durable, and safe parking solutions. The company emphasizes innovation, automation, sustainability, and quality assurance, using premium components and advanced engineering to create efficient, eco-friendly, and digitally enabled systems. HPIPL serves projects across housing complexes, offices, airports, and commercial spaces in India and internationally, supported by 24/7 customer care. Its goal is to make India’s parking infrastructure smarter, faster, and future-ready through comprehensive solutions for buses, trucks, cars, bikes, semi-automatic, and fully automatic parking systems.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Vice President Sales Business Development will lead the sales and business growth strategy for HPIPL’s parking infrastructure solutions, with responsibility for driving revenue, market expansion, and strategic partnerships. This full-time hybrid role is based in Noida, with flexibility for some work-from-home, and involves overseeing sales teams, managing key accounts, and ensuring strong client relationships across India and selected international markets. Day-to-day responsibilities include setting sales targets, developing business development plans, identifying new market opportunities, and collaborating with product and operations teams to align offerings with customer needs. The role will also involve designing and refining sales processes, forecasting and reporting performance, and representing HPIPL at industry events, client meetings, and presentations. The Senior Vice President will mentor and coach the sales organization, promote data-driven decision-making, and uphold HPIPL’s standards of service quality and customer satisfaction.
  
**Qualifications**

* Proven expertise in Sales and Sales Management, with a track record of leading high-performing teams and achieving ambitious revenue targets.
* Strong background in Business Development, including market expansion, strategic partnerships, and new opportunity identification.
* Experience in Account Management, with the ability to build, sustain, and grow long-term relationships with key clients and stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Sales Operations, including pipeline management, forecasting, CRM usage, and performance reporting.
* Extensive leadership experience at a senior level, preferably in infrastructure, mobility, real estate, smart cities, or technology-driven solutions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage C-level decision-makers and institutional clients.
* Strategic mindset with strong analytical and commercial acumen, comfortable working with data and financial metrics to guide decisions.
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup from Noida, collaborate cross-functionally, and adapt to a fast-growing, innovation-focused environment.

title: Sales And Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Ozone Fire Systems is a leading passive fire protection specialist with over 14 years of experience and more than 350 completed firestop projects across safety-critical environments in India. Supported by a team of 60+ trained firestop specialists, the company serves corporate offices, IT campuses, luxury hotels, malls, hospitals, high-rise towers, data centers, airports, and major government projects such as the New Parliament House and Bharat Mandapam. As a Hilti HAFSC-certified partner, Ozone Fire Systems delivers UL & FM-based firestop systems that meet NBC, IS, UL, and ASTM standards for durable life-safety performance. Its services include site surveys, firestop product selection and system design, technical solution submittals, compliance audits, penetration firestopping, construction joint and façade fire barrier systems, and annual maintenance contracts. Team members work in a specialized, safety-focused environment with strong technical and field support.

**Role Description**
The Sales and Marketing Specialist is a full-time, hybrid role based in Delhi, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role involves identifying and nurturing leads, conducting client meetings, and presenting Ozone Fire Systems’ solutions to decision-makers in sectors such as commercial, residential, healthcare, and infrastructure. The specialist will develop and execute sales and marketing plans, prepare proposals, support bidding processes, and maintain accurate records in CRM tools. Daily tasks include coordinating with project and technical teams, delivering product and fire safety awareness sessions, and ensuring high standards of customer service and after-sales support. The role also requires monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to refine outreach strategies and contribute to revenue growth.

* Strong Communication and Customer Service skills to engage stakeholders, build trust, and manage client relationships effectively.
* Proven abilities in Sales and Sales Management to convert leads, manage pipelines, and meet or exceed assigned targets.
* Experience in Training and customer education, especially in explaining technical concepts and safety standards in clear terms.
* Background in B2B sales or marketing, preferably in construction, building materials, fire safety, or related technical industries.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setup, with frequent client visits and site meetings in the Delhi/NCR region.
* Strong organizational, negotiation, and presentation skills, with proficiency in common office and CRM software tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field; relevant certifications in sales or marketing are a plus.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and adhere to safety, compliance, and quality standards.

title: GTM & Growth Manager
description:
**About Vihara**

**Vihara helps everyday buyers and investors find bank-owned and distressed properties and bid on them online. Our AI matches people with auction deals they would otherwise never see. We’re a small, fast team, and growth is the most important lever we have.**

**The role**

**You’ll own Vihara’s growth engine from end to end, from a stranger’s first click through to their first bid. This isn’t a “post content and hope” job. You’ll find the loops, channels and hacks that bring in buyers, get them active and keep them coming back, and then turn what works into systems that repeat.**

**If metrics, experiments and shipping fast don’t excite you, this role won’t be a good fit.**

**What you’ll do**

* Own the full B2C funnel: acquisition, activation, retention, referral and revenue
* Run a high-speed experiment cadence of several growth tests every week, each with a clear hypothesis, a metric and a decision
* Find and scale acquisition channels: paid social (Meta, Instagram, YouTube), Google Search, SEO, creators and communities
* Build programmatic SEO and content engines, such as auction and city landing pages, deal breakdowns and guides that rank and convert
* Design viral and referral loops that turn buyers into our distribution
* Run lifecycle marketing over email, SMS and push: onboarding flows, deal alerts, re-engagement and win-backs
* Improve conversion on landing pages, sign-up and the path to first bid through A/B tests and CRO
* Partner with real estate investing creators, newsletters and communities to reach buyers where they already are
* Track CAC, LTV, activation rate, retention cohorts and payback, and share the numbers with the founders every week
* Work directly with the founders on positioning, messaging and which bets to make next

**Tools you’ll use**

* Analytics: Google Analytics, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Microsoft Clarity, dashboards
* Ads: Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads
* Lifecycle: Brevo or similar email/SMS platforms
* Automation and no-code tools: Zapier/Make, Clay, AI tools for creative and content
* Experimentation and landing-page tools

**What we’re looking for**

* A proven record of growing a consumer product, with numbers to back it up
* Hands-on skill with growth hacks: you’ve built referral loops, viral mechanics or programmatic SEO, or found a channel nobody else was using
* Strong analytical skills: you can find a funnel leak in a dashboard and fix it the same day
* Creativity with hooks, offers and ad creative, plus the discipline to test them properly
* A strong sense of ownership, comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action
* Clear communication and a willingness to execute very fast

**Bonus points**

* Experience in marketplaces, proptech, fintech or other high-consideration consumer purchases
* Experience with real estate or investing audiences
* Ability to write scrappy scripts, SQL or AI-assisted automations yourself

**Work style and expectations**

* Fully remote
* 6 days a week
* Fast timelines, real deadlines, real ownership
* Daily collaboration with the founders and a small, high-performance team

**How to apply**

* **Apply at**
  https://www.vihara.ai/careers/growth-manager. Tell us about the most successful growth experiment or campaign you’ve run, and the numbers it moved.

title: Program Lead
description:
**Strategy & Programme Lead | India**

**Location:**
India, with regular travel, including to the Himalayan region

**Level:**
Senior
Manager / Director, depending on experience

**Contract**
: Initially contractor set up and then, depending on experience and programme needs we can look at staff or fixed term arrangement

**About Systemiq**

Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with practical, on-the-ground work, partnering with businesses, governments, investors and civil society to deliver system change. Our international teams work across sectors and geographies, bringing together diverse expertise to address interconnected sustainability challenges.

**The opportunity**

Systemiq is seeking an experienced Strategy & Programme Lead to help deliver and grow our portfolio of work in India, initially taking a leading role in our Himalayan systems change programme.

Building on our report,
*Prosperous and Resilient Himalayas*
, this programme aims to translate an ambitious agenda for sustainable economic growth and resilience into practical initiatives, partnerships and financing solutions. Work may span water security, climate and disaster resilience, sustainable tourism, mountain products, enterprise development and policy.

Alongside leading this programme, you will contribute to other strategic advisory and systems change projects across India, working with colleagues across Systemiq's global platforms. You will also help identify and develop new opportunities, build relationships with potential clients and partners, and contribute to expanding our presence and impact in India.

We are looking for someone who combines strong management consulting capabilities, practical programme leadership and commercial judgement with a deep understanding of India's economic, policy and institutional landscape.

At Systemiq, our leaders remain closely involved in the substance and delivery of our work. This role offers significant autonomy and requires someone equally comfortable shaping strategy, leading complex engagements and turning new opportunities into funded work.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead strategic programmes and engagements. Take ownership of the Himalayan programme and contribute to other advisory projects across India, shaping priorities, analytical approaches, workplans and delivery.
* Drive business development and growth. Identify and develop new project opportunities across sectors, build relationships with potential clients and funders, lead proposals and help convert opportunities into funded engagements.
* Provide strategic and analytical leadership. Guide complex research, economic and financial analysis, business cases and feasibility assessments, translating findings into clear recommendations and practical solutions.
* Build senior stakeholder relationships. Develop trusted relationships with government, businesses, financial institutions, funders and other partners, navigating complex institutional and commercial environments.
* Translate strategy into implementation. Turn policy, sustainability and financing challenges into actionable programmes, partnerships and investment propositions that can deliver measurable impact.
* Lead and develop teams. Provide direction, oversight and mentorship to multidisciplinary project teams, ensuring high-quality delivery, sound project economics and effective collaboration.
* Collaborate across platforms and geographies. Work with Systemiq colleagues internationally, bringing together expertise across nature, energy, finance, materials and economic development to address interconnected challenges.

**The experience and capabilities we are looking for**

**Consulting and strategic leadership**

* Typically 7+ years of relevant experience in management consulting, strategy advisory or an equivalent consulting-led environment, with seniority reflecting experience.
* A strong generalist consulting toolkit, including structured problem-solving, quantitative and qualitative analysis, strategic synthesis and executive-level communication.
* Proven experience independently leading complex consulting engagements or strategic programmes, managing teams and delivering high-quality recommendations.
* Strong commercial judgement, with experience identifying opportunities, developing proposals, winning work or building client relationships.
* The ability to work across different sectors and subject areas, quickly developing an understanding of unfamiliar challenges and translating analysis into practical solutions.

**Relevant sector and regional experience**

* Significant professional experience in India, with a strong understanding of its economic, policy, institutional and business environment.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders across government, business, finance, development institutions or philanthropy.
* Relevant experience in sustainable development, climate resilience, natural resources, economic development, sustainable finance or related sectors.
* Experience in the Himalayan region, mountain economies, rural livelihoods, sustainable tourism or nature-based economic development would be an advantage.
* Sound economic and financial literacy, including experience developing business cases, investment propositions or financing strategies.

**Leadership and personal attributes**

* An entrepreneurial, commercially minded leader who combines strategic thinking with practical delivery.
* Confident operating independently, managing ambiguity and taking ownership of complex engagements.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the credibility to engage senior stakeholders.
* Adaptable and intellectually curious, with the ability to move between different projects, sectors and challenges.
* Able to think across policy, markets, finance and environmental systems, recognising how they interact and identifying opportunities for wider systems change.
* A collaborative leader committed to Systemiq's mission and to advancing sustainable, inclusive economic development.

**Languages and travel**

* Fluent English is essential. Hindi and/or another relevant Indian language would be an advantage.
* Willingness to travel regularly across India, including field visits in the Himalayan region, is essential.

**What we offer**

* Meaningful leadership: Take a leading role in a high-impact Himalayan initiative while contributing to Systemiq's wider portfolio in India.
* Entrepreneurial opportunity: Help shape new projects, partnerships and opportunities across an evolving regional portfolio.
* Diverse project experience: Work across strategy, policy, finance, sustainability and implementation, with opportunities to influence work beyond a single sector.
* Local focus, global collaboration: Build relationships in India while working with international colleagues and accessing Systemiq's global expertise.
* Autonomy and influence: Take ownership of major engagements and contribute directly to the growth and impact of our work.
* Flexible engagement arrangements: We are open to considering both fixed-term employment and consultancy arrangements, depending on experience and programme needs.

**Reward and Recognition**
The remuneration and benefits package will reflect the successful candidate's experience and expertise.

title: Brand and Marketing Manager (4+ years, B2C exp)
description:
Hey! We’re hiring for our early team.

What we’re building:

* We’re building India’s first beauty commerce concierge, bringing Sephora’s shopping experience to your home. We’ll be the first lifestyle commerce platform for the top 1% (similar to Firstclub for F&B, CRED for fintech).

Our gunpowder:

* Our team (+ hopefully you):
* Founders: CEO (ex-BCG, Warburg), CTO (ex-NVIDIA, Even)
* We’re raising ~$7m seed funding led by two of India’s largest VC firms along with a solid set of angels.

Mission & Problem Statement:

* Our mission is to reimagine how people shop - quick commerce made shopping quick; but we will make shopping at home an experiential delight. The goal is to build a category-defining company.
* Problem we’re solving: Today’s platforms are archaic, non-returnable, and not personalized because they were built when India bought cheap products. Someone buying a ₹1,000 lipstick should get a better buying experience than someone buying a ₹200 soap.
* Our solution: We’re building a platform for the top 1% where quick, advisor-led try-and-buy at home, and personalization are different limbs of the platform (building Sephora for India)

Early Team:

* We’re in our 0 to 1 phase, and we need people who are okay with uncertainty and non-linear outcomes
* We are looking for someone who:
* Is not an a\*\*hole; if you are arrogant, we’re not the right fit
* Is deeply interested in the problem statement, not the funding we have raised
* You should enjoy doing IC work (not just “manage” a team or be a “leader”)
* Is a doer first, thinker second (please think about this deeply; do you want to do execution work or more consulting/strategy roles)
* High IQ: can win at board games vs the founders
* Risk-taking appetite, professionally or personally: e.g. started something, joined a 0 to 1 startup earlier, contested student body elections, etc.
* Is willing to prioritize work over personal life for next 1-2 years (i.e. there’s fire in the belly to make it big)
* What’s in it for you:
* Team / Work environment:
* high-talent density team that is fun; you would look forward to coming to the office on a Monday morning
* You’ll not feel you’re the smartest in the room
* High impact on the org as you would be building things from scratch to scale
* Bunch of creative people given our category x target customer (we are design first)
* Financial outcome:
* We’re backed by two of the best VCs in India, and we’re aiming for a very large, category-defining outcome.
* Pay: TBD (+ founding team ESOPs) (We are at <$50m valuation; Nykaa is a ~$10B company) - we can be big af because i) our value prop is delta 4 against Nykaa, ii) we’re building a solid team, and iii) our underlying market is super attractive
* Role:
* **Brand Marketing:**
  Build and execute the brand from 0 to 1, across positioning, campaigns, content, creators, partnerships, and brand experiences.
* **Design:**
  Help shape Wingit’s visual identity and customer experience from 0 to 1, across brand, product, campaigns, content, and creative.
* **Growth:**
  Lead GTM, offline activation, build a community of users, offline marketing, etc.
* **Category:**
  Decide what would go on the platform, how we should present it to the customers, bundling, design, etc.
* **Operations (Inventory + Dark Stores):**
  Lead dark store setup and expansion, inventory management, last-mile logistics, etc.
* **Operations (Beauty Advisor Fleet):**
  Build the entire fleet, training SOPs, compensation, CX, etc. This would be a first of its kind, so would require heavy hustle, first principles thinking, and ability to lead 100+ partners.
* This is not a founder’s office/chief of staff role; this would involve doing hands-on work - not market research, but actually executing.
* Given it is an early team role - as the startup grows, we’ll be flexible if you want to take on broader roles over time.
* Location: Gurgaon, Work from office (6 days)
* Requirements:
* Good stint at any VC-backed startup with strong refs (i.e. you were a great performer at a fast-paced startup) OR
* Ex-MBB, top consulting firms (you performed well there + are okay with actual execution and not just strategy/founder’s office roles) OR
* Ex-founders OR
* You feel you’re insanely good and are hungry to prove it AND
* Work experience ≤6 years
* Your contribution to the startup would be really impactful. That’s why we're very selective about who we let in.

**Required Experience**

title: Marketing Lead, Brand & Category
description:
**About Zeko AI**

Zeko builds AI agents for hiring and talent evaluation. Our core product,
**Avya**

, runs structured L1 interviews end to end — a real conversation with an AI avatar that adapts its follow-up questions to what the candidate actually says, then produces a scored, evidence-backed report a recruiter can act on in under three minutes.

Around that sits a full stack: resume and recruiter screening, voice-based candidate engagement, post-offer follow-up, L2 panel scheduling, proctored assessments, job validation, and AskAvya — a layer that lets a hiring manager interrogate a candidate report in plain language.

**Where we are**

* **Growing 20% quarter on quarter.**

  Unit economics that work per account, not growth bought with discounts.
* **Enterprise customers with high renewal rates.**

  Persistent, Nagarro, Orion Innovation, Sopra Steria, Schneider Electric, Cholamandalam, Shadowfax, Pierian Services.
* **Best AI Startup awarded 25 lacs by Hon’ble Minister of Electronics and IT at India AI Summit. Top 20 Startups among 10,000+ applications at UAE-India CEPA Council**



**The role**

We want Zeko AI to be the company others in this category are measured against. This role owns how that happens: the story we tell, where we tell it, how consistently we tell it, and whether the market notices.

You will work directly with the founders, lead a small team, and manage our agency partners. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write briefs, edit content, sit in the edit for a launch film and run the weekly plan yourself.

**What you will own**

* **Narrative and positioning:**

  turn the founders' point of view into a messaging system that every channel, deck and page follows.
* **Flagship campaigns:**

  plan and deliver a small number of high-impact assets each year, such as a company story film, a launch campaign or a research report.
* **LinkedIn presence:**

  build a programme across company, founder and team voices that reads as a category leader, with recurring formats and a consistent visual identity.
* **Podcast and video:**

  set the editorial direction for our podcast and short-form founder video.
* **Executive events:**

  design and run a recurring executive roundtable, webinars and speaking opportunities for senior HR and business leaders.
* **Insight-led content:**

  turn product and market data into credible, sourced research the category cites.
* **Media and marketing partnerships:**

  build relationships with media, communities, event organisers and award programmes.
* **Sales enablement:**

  make sure the sales team has the stories, case studies and materials it needs, on message.
* **Website and search visibility:**

  own the site roadmap and our visibility in search and AI-generated answers, working with agency partners.
* **Planning and measurement:**

  run a quarterly plan, a weekly operating rhythm, a monthly brand scorecard and the marketing budget.
* **Team leadership:**

  direct, edit and develop a content lead and a marketing operations lead.

**What success looks like in your first six months**

* One clear narrative, used consistently across every channel and asset.
* A flagship story asset in market.
* A LinkedIn presence that senior buyers in our category recognise and engage with.
* A recurring executive event with a reputation for being worth attending.
* A monthly brand scorecard the founders use to make decisions.

**You will fit well if you have**

* 6-9 years in B2B marketing, ideally in SaaS or enterprise technology.
* Led at least one brand programme or flagship campaign end to end, and can show the work.
* Managed people, agencies or both.
* Run a marketing calendar with real deadlines, and can show the plans you built.
* Strong writing and editing judgment, with a clear sense of what looks credible to a senior executive.
* A habit of measuring brand by audience quality and business effect, not volume.
* AI tools built into how you research, draft, edit and report.
* Comfort working closely with founders, including disagreeing with evidence.

**Strong advantages**

* Experience marketing to HR leaders, CHROs or business unit heads.
* Experience marketing to large Indian enterprises or global capability centres.
* Hands-on experience producing video or running executive events.
* Time at a growth-stage company while its brand was being built.

**What we offer**

* Ownership of a function at a stage where your work shapes how the company is seen.
* Direct work with the founders and a fast, transparent culture built on ownership.
* Competitive compensation, discussed at the first conversation.

**How to apply**

Apply on Linkedin and you will be directed to our Career Page, where you will be required to submit your CV and if shortlisted, will be immediately directed to our first round of AI interview. It will be a detailed technical interview, where you will also get the experience of our key product: Avya, our AI interviewer. This will be followed by founder’s in person interview within 4-5 days, if shortlisted.

* Drive repeat purchases, customer lifetime value (LTV), and customer engagement.
* Develop customer segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, and personalized communication strategies.

* Track and Analyze key metrics, including revenue, CAC, ROAS, AOV, LTV, conversion rate, repeat purchase rate, and contribution margin.

* Coordinate product launches, offers, campaigns, and inventory planning to maximize D2C growth.

* Strong analytical skills and understanding of D2C unit economics and profitability.

* Excellent stakeholder management, problem-solving, and execution skills.

Compensation will be
**competitive and aligned with industry standards, relevant experience, and business-building capability**
.

based on revenue generation, client acquisition, account growth, and overall business performance.

title: Senior Manager - Issuance / Brand Alliances Lead (Gift Vouchers)
description:
**Location:**
Noida / Bengaluru / Mumbai

**About Paytm**

Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services distribution company, offering innovative solutions to consumers and merchants. We enable digital payments and financial inclusion through our technology-led platforms and extensive merchant ecosystem.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced business leader to drive the growth and expansion of our Gift Vouchers Issuance business. The role will be responsible for driving enterprise-level B2B sales, acquiring strategic corporate clients, building long-term partnerships, and expanding revenue streams across digital and physical gift vouchers. The individual will own business development, key account management, and revenue growth while working closely with internal teams to strengthen Paytm's voucher issuance ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Development & Revenue Growth:**
  Drive end-to-end business development by identifying prospective enterprise clients, pitching customized gift voucher solutions, negotiating commercial agreements, and closing strategic deals to achieve revenue targets.
* **Enterprise Sales:**
  Build and manage a strong sales pipeline across large corporates and enterprises, targeting HR, Marketing, Procurement, and other relevant stakeholders for corporate gifting and employee rewards solutions.
* **Key Account Management:**
  Develop and nurture relationships with strategic enterprise accounts, ensuring customer retention, business expansion, and identification of upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
* **Strategic Partnerships:**
  Establish and strengthen partnerships with corporates, brands, and ecosystem players to expand voucher distribution and issuance opportunities.
* **Business Strategy:**
  Develop and execute business plans to drive market penetration, increase voucher issuance volumes, and expand the overall business portfolio.
* **Product & Solution Development:**
  Work closely with Product, Operations, and Marketing teams to develop and enhance voucher issuance solutions, including customized corporate gifting and loyalty-integrated offerings.
* **Market Intelligence:**
  Track industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging opportunities across corporate gifting, loyalty programs, and digital rewards to identify new avenues for growth.
* **Sales Leadership:**

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 10+ years of experience in B2B Sales, Enterprise Sales, Business Development, or Strategic Partnerships.
* Strong experience in corporate gifting, gift vouchers, loyalty programs, digital rewards, or fintech/payments.

B2B Sales | Enterprise Sales | Corporate Gifting | Gift Vouchers | Loyalty Programs | Business Development | Strategic Partnerships | Sales Management | Key Account Management
