title: Tender Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – TENDER MANAGER**

**Department:** Tendering / Business Development  
**Designation:** Tender Manager  
**Reporting To:** Head – Business Development / General Manager / Director  
**Team Management:** Tender Executives and Tender Coordinators  
**Experience:** 6–10 years in tendering and bid management  
**Qualification:** Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, or a relevant discipline  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**1. Job Purpose**

The Tender Manager will be responsible for leading and managing the complete tendering and bidding process, from identifying business opportunities to bid submission, evaluation, award, and post-award handover.

The role involves developing tender strategies, managing the tendering team, ensuring technical and commercial compliance, coordinating with internal departments and external stakeholders, and improving the company's tender success rate and profitability.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Tender Identification and Business Planning**

* Identify and evaluate relevant tender opportunities across government departments, PSUs, GeM, CPWD, PWD, railways, and private-sector organizations.
* Develop a tender pipeline and maintain a structured calendar of upcoming bids and submission deadlines.
* Evaluate tender opportunities based on eligibility, commercial viability, competition, resource availability, and business objectives.
* Recommend bid/no-bid decisions to senior management based on risk, profitability, and strategic relevance.
* Monitor procurement trends, competitor activities, and new business opportunities.

**B. Tender Management and Bid Strategy**

* Oversee the complete tender lifecycle, including tender study, eligibility assessment, documentation, pricing, submission, evaluation, and award.
* Review NITs, RFPs, RFQs, BOQs, technical specifications, eligibility criteria, and contractual terms.
* Develop tender-specific strategies to maximize the probability of winning profitable contracts.
* Ensure preparation and submission of technically compliant and commercially competitive bids within prescribed deadlines.
* Review and approve tender checklists, compliance matrices, technical proposals, commercial bids, and supporting documents before submission.
* Coordinate pre-bid meetings, clarification requests, corrigenda, technical presentations, and reverse auctions, wherever applicable.
* Ensure all bids are submitted accurately and in accordance with tender requirements.

**C. Team Leadership and Performance Management**

* Lead, guide, and supervise Tender Executives and other team members.
* Allocate tenders and responsibilities based on workload, complexity, and individual capabilities.
* Establish standard operating procedures, review mechanisms, checklists, and document-control practices.
* Monitor team productivity, submission quality, compliance, and deadline adherence.
* Train team members on tender portals, procurement rules, documentation standards, and bid preparation.
* Conduct periodic review meetings to assess tender pipeline, submission status, results, and improvement areas.
* Develop a culture of accountability, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**D. Commercial Evaluation and Pricing**

* Coordinate with Finance, Accounts, Sales, Procurement, Technical, and Operations teams to prepare competitive bid pricing.
* Review cost estimates, BOQs, rate analysis, vendor quotations, taxes, duties, statutory costs, and other commercial components, as applicable.
* Assess expected margins, project profitability, financial exposure, and commercial risks before bid submission.
* Obtain necessary pricing and commercial approvals from authorized management.
* Ensure pricing accuracy and consistency between the technical and financial submissions.
* Analyze L1 status, competitor pricing where available, and the reasons for winning or losing bids.

**E. Compliance and Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with tender eligibility criteria, technical specifications, statutory requirements, and contractual conditions.
* Review company credentials, experience certificates, turnover documents, GST/PAN records, declarations, affidavits, and other supporting documents.
* Supervise the timely arrangement and tracking of EMD, tender fees, bid security, performance bank guarantees, and security deposits.
* Identify potential disqualification risks, contractual liabilities, penalties, delivery obligations, and other commercial exposures.
* Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained before submission of bids and acceptance of contractual commitments.
* Maintain confidentiality, document accuracy, audit readiness, and adherence to company policies.

**F. Portal and Stakeholder Management**

* Oversee tender activities on GeM, CPPP/eProcure, state e-procurement portals, and other relevant platforms.
* Ensure timely company/vendor registrations, document renewals, digital signature certificate management, and portal compliance.
* Coordinate with government departments, PSU representatives, consultants, clients, OEMs, vendors, and subcontractors as required.
* Supervise responses to technical and commercial queries, document shortfalls, and evaluation-related clarifications.
* Maintain professional communication and ensure timely follow-up on bid status and award decisions.

**G. Post-Tender and Contract Management**

* Track tender opening, technical qualification, financial evaluation, reverse auctions, award decisions, and contract finalization.
* Coordinate the preparation and submission of LOA/LOI-related documents, agreements, performance guarantees, and other post-award requirements.
* Ensure a structured handover of awarded contracts to the Operations, Projects, Sales, or relevant execution team.
* Monitor EMD and security deposit refunds for unsuccessful bids and ensure timely follow-up.
* Review contractual terms and highlight deviations requiring management or legal approval.
* Maintain records of awarded contracts, unsuccessful bids, pending actions, and lessons learned.

**H. MIS, Reporting, and Performance Analysis**

* Prepare and present periodic tender MIS reports to senior management.
* Maintain accurate records of tender opportunities, submissions, qualification status, awards, losses, and pending decisions.
* Track tender conversion rates, win rates, bid values, expected margins, and reasons for unsuccessful bids.
* Monitor EMD, bank guarantees, tender fees, and related financial commitments.
* Recommend process improvements, automation, and reporting enhancements to improve tendering efficiency.
* Present periodic business pipeline reviews and tender performance summaries to management.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely submission of all approved bids.
* Accuracy and completeness of tender documentation.
* Reduction in bid rejections due to documentation or compliance errors.
* Tender qualification and success/conversion rate.
* Value of tenders submitted and contracts awarded.
* Profitability and commercial viability of successful bids.
* Timely release and recovery of EMDs and other refundable deposits.
* Accuracy and timeliness of tender MIS reporting.
* Team productivity, process adherence, and deadline management.
* Effective post-award handover and closure of tender-related actions.

*Specific targets will be established by management according to the company's business objectives and tender portfolio.*

**4. Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of end-to-end tendering and bid management.
* Working knowledge of GeM, CPPP, e-procurement portals, and applicable procurement procedures.
* Understanding of technical and commercial bid preparation, BOQs, pricing, and contract conditions.
* Strong leadership, planning, coordination, and team-management skills.
* Excellent analytical, negotiation, and decision-making abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PDF tools, and tender MIS reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tenders and work under strict deadlines.
* High attention to detail, integrity, accountability, and commercial awareness.

**5. Experience and Industry Preference**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience in tendering, bidding, or proposal management, including team-handling experience.
* Demonstrated experience in independently managing complex tenders from identification through award.
* Experience in government, PSU, institutional, and private-sector tendering.
* Prior exposure to GeM, CPWD, PWD, railways, EPC, infrastructure, manufacturing, supply, or service contracts, depending on the company's business.
* Experience in commercial negotiations, pricing approvals, bid strategy, and tender performance analysis.

**6. Authority and Accountability**

The Tender Manager will be accountable for the tendering team's performance, quality of bid submissions, compliance with tender requirements, timely completion of activities, and accurate reporting to management.

The role may recommend bid/no-bid decisions, pricing strategies, and process improvements. Final financial approvals, commercial commitments, and contract acceptance will remain subject to the company's delegation of authority.

**7. Expected Outcome**

To build an efficient, compliant, and commercially focused tendering function that consistently identifies suitable opportunities, submits high-quality bids on time, improves tender conversion, minimizes avoidable disqualifications, and contributes to profitable business growth.

title: 4772-Manager - GTM Enablement
description:
**Go to Market at Innovaccer**

Our GTM team is passionate about healthcare and wants to leave a positive impact in the ecosystem. We are the tip of the spear that leads the organization externally. We care deeply about our customers and want to resolve their challenges with our solutions. If this excites you, let's chat about how you can help us tell our special story.

**About the Role**

The Manager, GTM Enablement owns the day-to-day execution of Innovaccer’s GTM readiness programs, from new-hire onboarding and certifications to live enablement sessions, learning platforms, and readiness reporting. The role reports to the Head of GTM Enablement and works closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and GTM Operations.

Innovaccer’s sellers and customer-facing teams sell a multi-product platform in a market that changes every quarter, and Growth Enablement makes sure they are ready for it. This is a hands-on role. The Manager runs programs directly, administers the systems behind them, and helps shape how readiness is measured and improved.

* **Operational Scalability:** Builds repeatable playbooks, modular training, and a consistent governance model that work across business lines and buyer segments. This lets the GTM engine take on new products and headcount without rebuilding enablement each time.
* **Higher Program Adoption and Accountability:** Tracks and follows up on enablement and certification completion in the LMS and through frontline managers. Programs actually reach the field, and leadership can see readiness by team and role.
* **Improved Onboarding Experience and Retention**: Coordinates cohort logistics, schedules, materials, and buddy programs so new hires feel supported from day one.
* **Clean Data and Insights:** Keeps enablement dashboards accurate across every product line and GTM role. It does this by tagging content consistently by product, buyer type, and sales stage, keeping user records in the LMS and content platform clean, and compiling baseline performance metrics. Leadership can then trust the readiness data it uses to make decisions.
* **Consistent Quality Control:** Reviews training modules and content in the sales repository before they reach customer-facing teams. Each piece is checked to reflect Innovaccer’s approved brand voice and messaging, cleared proof points, and customer referenceability rules, so sellers never take outdated or unvalidated claims into health system and payer conversations.

**A Day in the Life**

* **New Hire Onboarding & Ramp:** Help design and run onboarding for new GTM hires across Sales and Marketing. This includes kickoff sessions, platform orientation, structured learning paths, and 30-60-90 day milestones that get new hires to full productivity faster.
* **Certification & Competency Assessment:** Support the certification lifecycle and own its execution. Working from scenarios and scoring rubrics defined by GTM Enablement leadership and sales leaders, the Manager builds and configures certifications in the learning platform, including AI role-play certifications (for example, an executive pitch delivered to an AI buyer persona) and live, juried certifications. The role schedules and runs attempts, coordinates coach feedback, maintains scorecards, and tracks completion and proficiency, flagging learners who need a recertification or additional support.
* **Enablement Program Design & Facilitation:** Run the weekly virtual enablement sessions that keep the field current on product launches, releases, pricing, and messaging. You will take each session from intake and leader approval through presenter prep, dry runs, live facilitation, and the recap, recording, and collateral that follow.
* **Learning Platform Administration:** Administer our learning platforms (Mindtickle and Docebo/Innovaccer Academy). Onboard learners, structure content and learning paths, maintain our Sales Enablement Hub, and build simulations. You will also manage vendor relationships and platform access.
* **Learning Analytics & Readiness Reporting:** Track attendance, completion, certification results, and proficiency. Work with GTM Operations to build readiness metrics and dashboards for leadership and sales managers, and use the data to spot skill gaps and show whether enablement is changing field performance.
* **Compliance & Required Training:** Deliver and track customer-mandated and company-required training for customer-facing employees, including assessments and completion reporting.

**What You Need**

* 5 to 8 years in sales enablement, GTM enablement, learning operations, or training program management, ideally supporting a B2B enterprise sales team
* Hands-on experience administering an LMS or sales readiness platform (Mindtickle, Docebo, Highspot, Seismic, or similar)
* Experience designing and running certifications, role-plays, or skills assessments with sales leaders
* Strong facilitation and project management skills. You are comfortable running a live session with senior presenters and managing many programs at once
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and a comfort with data. You can build a tracker, pull a report, and explain what it means
* Clear written communication. You can turn a product update into a recap or learning path a seller will actually use
* Familiarity with healthcare, health IT, or enterprise SaaS selling is a plus

 **Benefits**

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

**Here’s What We Offer**

  

* Generous Leave Benefits: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical Leave Policy: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.
* Pet-Friendly Office\*: Spend more time with your treasured friends, even when you're away from home. Bring your furry friends with you to the office and let your colleagues become their friends, too. \*Noida office only
Creche Facility for children\*: Say goodbye to worries and hello to a convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well-being first. \*India offices  

**Where and how we work**

Our Noida office is situated in a posh techspace, equipped with various amenities to support our work environment. Here, we follow a five-day work schedule, allowing us to efficiently carry out our tasks and collaborate effectively within our team.

Innovaccer is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

Disclaimer: Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

Our Medical Affairs team advances patient care by engaging in scientific exchange with external medical experts and industry leaders ensuring the scientific value of our products is understood. The MAM drives local evidence-generation initiatives, securing appropriate governance approvals, and is accountable for the timely execution, analysis, and publication of local studies. By engaging scientific leaders, convening expert forums, and leading medical education initiatives, MAM strengthens trust within the scientific community and remains at the forefront of evolving patient care. The role also contributes to addressing reputational, ethical, and asset-related challenges through effective collaboration and leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's in-house tax team knows all things corporate tax. Made up of smart, perceptive Googlers with a flair for domestic, international, and sales and use tax, the knowledge and expertise of this team runs deep. You have years of experience in this field and an extensive knowledge of those tax issues most relevant to internet companies. While we don't give our Googlers individual tax advice, you make it easy for Googlers to get what they need to make good tax decisions. You find ways to work smarter by streamlining and automating our tax processes and systems, and find ways to be both innovative and compliant.
  
  
In this role, you will play a pivotal role in providing end-to-end support to the executive members of the Tax team and other stakeholders. You will be responsible to support tax optimization, controversy, audits, anticipate and mitigate potential tax risks, connect different areas of tax and finance teams to foresee potential issues, research, and cross-functional projects for India and South East Asia countries. You will directly contribute to optimizing efficiency, clearly articulating tax recommendations and establishing policies that minimize the company's tax exposure.

--------------------

The leader will own the end-to-end executive engagement lifecycle from designing engagement programs and running the Executive Briefing Center (EBC) program for India, to driving follow-through on customer commitments made by the President of AWS India & South Asia. Beyond specific engagement responsibilities, this leader will identify and resolve cross-organizational blockers, maximise the AWS India & SE President’s leverage in customer-facing engagements, and build scalable mechanisms that institutionalize executive engagement across the India business.
  
Reporting directly into the AWS India & SE President, we are looking for a highly motivated professional who can self-start, cut through ambiguity, work with and through other teams to deliver outcomes, move fast, and roll up their sleeves when needed. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, can scale through influence rather than direct authority, and brings a relentless customer obsession with a bias for action.

* Own and drive executive engagement programs, ensuring every interaction creates lasting customer value.

Dar Al Yusr Real Estate is a UAE-based real estate business preparing to expand its presence in India.

Our goal is to build strong relationships with Indian property buyers, investors, brokers, and business partners while connecting them with real estate opportunities in the UAE, particularly Dubai.

As part of this expansion, we are planning to establish an office in India and are looking for an experienced real estate professional who can help us build and grow our business.

Our recruitment and interview process in India will be coordinated by \*\*Digitech Squad Pvt. Ltd.\*\*

### About the Opportunity

We are looking for a confident, experienced, and motivated \*\*Real Estate Business Development & Operations Manager\*\* who can take responsibility for developing our India operations.

This is more than a regular real estate sales position.

We need someone who understands the property market, has strong industry connections, knows how to generate leads and close deals, and can help establish and manage a professional office.

The selected candidate will work closely with company management and UAE business partners to develop sales opportunities, manage clients, build a strong broker network, and support the company's long-term growth.

We are looking for someone who is ready to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow with the company.

\*\*1. Office Setup & Operations\*\*

- Help establish and organize our new office in India.

- Manage day-to-day office operations, client meetings, and business activities.

- Coordinate with company management and the UAE team.

- Help recruit, train, and manage sales executives as the business grows.

- Maintain proper client records, sales reports, and operational processes.

- Ensure the office operates professionally and efficiently.

\*\*2. Real Estate Sales & Business Development\*\*

- Generate quality leads for UAE residential and commercial properties.

- Handle customer inquiries, property presentations, negotiations, and sales follow-ups.

- Convert qualified leads into successful property transactions.

- Develop sales strategies to achieve monthly and quarterly targets.

- Build long-term relationships with customers and investors.

- Identify new markets and opportunities for business growth.

\*\*3. Indian & UAE Real Estate Market\*\*

- Understand the Indian property market and the investment preferences of Indian buyers.

- Have good knowledge of UAE real estate, especially Dubai's property market.

- Stay informed about property developments, pricing, payment plans, and investment opportunities.

- Explain property options and buying procedures clearly to customers.

- Coordinate with UAE-based developers and authorized professionals for property availability, bookings, and transactions.

- Support customers throughout the buying process.

\*\*4. Broker, Developer & Investor Network\*\*

- Build and maintain strong relationships with real estate brokers, agents, and developers.

- Develop a reliable network of channel partners and referral sources.

- Connect with potential investors and high-value property buyers.

- Explore new partnerships that can generate business.

- Represent the company professionally in meetings, property events, and networking activities.

\*\*5. Lead Generation & Sales Management\*\*

- Develop and manage a strong pipeline of potential customers.

- Generate leads through referrals, networking, partnerships, marketing campaigns, and other sales channels.

- Maintain regular follow-ups with interested buyers.

- Track leads and sales opportunities using CRM software.

- Monitor sales performance and provide regular updates to management.

- Work towards achieving agreed sales and revenue targets.

\*\*6. Client Relationship Management\*\*

- Understand customer requirements, budgets, and investment goals.

- Recommend suitable property opportunities.

- Arrange property presentations, online meetings, and site visits where applicable.

- Maintain clear and professional communication with clients.

- Handle customer questions and concerns responsibly.

- Build trust through honest advice, transparency, and reliable service.

\*\*7. Team Leadership & Business Growth\*\*

- Help build and lead a successful real estate sales team.

- Guide employees on customer handling, lead generation, and closing techniques.

- Monitor team performance and support sales targets.

- Suggest practical ideas to improve business operations and sales.

- Take responsibility for developing the company's presence in India.

### Who We Are Looking For

\*\*Experience & Qualifications\*\*

- Minimum 5 years of experience preferred in real estate sales, brokerage, business development, or property investment.

- Strong understanding of the Indian real estate market.

- Experience or practical knowledge of UAE real estate, particularly Dubai.

- Proven experience in generating leads, negotiating, and closing property deals.

- An existing network of brokers, developers, investors, or potential property buyers is highly preferred.

- Previous experience managing a sales team, branch, or office is an advantage.

- Experience dealing with premium properties or high-value investors will be an added benefit.

\*\*Skills & Personal Qualities\*\*

- Good communication skills in English and Hindi.

- Strong negotiation and relationship-building abilities.

- Confident in dealing with customers, investors, and business partners.

- Ability to work independently and take responsibility.

- Good organizational and leadership skills.

- Comfortable using CRM systems, Microsoft Office, and sales reporting tools.

- Professional, honest, reliable, and customer-focused.

- Willing to travel for business meetings and client requirements when needed.

### Salary, Commission & Performance Bonuses

At Dar Al Yusr Real Estate, we believe that good performance and dedication deserve to be rewarded.

The selected candidate will receive a competitive compensation package consisting of:

\*\*Fixed Monthly Salary\*\*

A competitive monthly salary based on experience, skills, market knowledge, and professional capabilities.

\*\*Attractive Sales Commission\*\*

Additional commission on eligible property sales and successfully closed deals, according to the company's commission structure.

\*\*Performance-Based Bonuses\*\*

Opportunities to earn additional bonuses for achieving or exceeding agreed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.

\*\*Business Growth Incentives\*\*

Additional incentives may be offered for exceptional performance, developing valuable business partnerships, and contributing significantly to the growth of our India operations.

\*\*Long-Term Career Growth\*\*

As the company expands, successful candidates will have opportunities to take on larger responsibilities, manage bigger teams, and grow into senior leadership roles.

\*\*Your earning potential will not be limited to your fixed salary. Strong sales performance can lead to higher overall earnings through commissions and bonuses.\*\*

Detailed salary, commission percentages, bonus eligibility, and payment terms will be discussed during the interview and confirmed in the employment offer.

### What We Offer

- Competitive fixed monthly salary.

- Attractive commission on successful property sales.

- Monthly, quarterly, and annual performance-based bonus opportunities.

- Additional incentives for exceptional business performance.

- Opportunity to help establish and manage our India office.

- Direct involvement with company management.

- Exposure to Indian and UAE real estate markets.

- Opportunity to develop and lead a sales team.

- Professional working environment.

- Long-term career growth based on performance.

### What We Expect From You

We are looking for someone who can take responsibility and deliver results.

You should be able to develop business opportunities, build a strong network of clients and brokers, manage sales leads, and help establish a successful office in India.

We value people who are honest, dependable, confident, and serious about their professional growth.

You do not need to come from a large real estate company. If you have worked as an independent broker, real estate agent, sales manager, or branch manager and have a strong track record, we would be happy to consider your application.

### Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to be part of a growing real estate business from an early stage of its India expansion.

You will have the chance to contribute your experience, build relationships, develop a team, and play an important role in shaping the company's operations.

We believe in long-term relationships, rewarding good performance, and giving capable people the opportunity to grow.

If you understand the real estate industry, enjoy working with clients, and have the confidence to develop and manage a business, we would like to hear from you.

### How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with the following details:

1. Total years of real estate experience.

2. Indian and UAE property markets you have worked in.

3. Current or previous designation.

4. Experience in property sales and business development.

5. Existing broker, developer, or investor network, if applicable.

title: 4772-Manager - GTM Enablement
description:
**Go to Market at Innovaccer**

Our GTM team is passionate about healthcare and wants to leave a positive impact in the ecosystem. We are the tip of the spear that leads the organization externally. We care deeply about our customers and want to resolve their challenges with our solutions. If this excites you, let's chat about how you can help us tell our special story.

**About the Role**

The Manager, GTM Enablement owns the day-to-day execution of Innovaccer’s GTM readiness programs, from new-hire onboarding and certifications to live enablement sessions, learning platforms, and readiness reporting. The role reports to the Head of GTM Enablement and works closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and GTM Operations.

Innovaccer’s sellers and customer-facing teams sell a multi-product platform in a market that changes every quarter, and Growth Enablement makes sure they are ready for it. This is a hands-on role. The Manager runs programs directly, administers the systems behind them, and helps shape how readiness is measured and improved.

* **Operational Scalability:** Builds repeatable playbooks, modular training, and a consistent governance model that work across business lines and buyer segments. This lets the GTM engine take on new products and headcount without rebuilding enablement each time.
* **Higher Program Adoption and Accountability:** Tracks and follows up on enablement and certification completion in the LMS and through frontline managers. Programs actually reach the field, and leadership can see readiness by team and role.
* **Improved Onboarding Experience and Retention**: Coordinates cohort logistics, schedules, materials, and buddy programs so new hires feel supported from day one.
* **Clean Data and Insights:** Keeps enablement dashboards accurate across every product line and GTM role. It does this by tagging content consistently by product, buyer type, and sales stage, keeping user records in the LMS and content platform clean, and compiling baseline performance metrics. Leadership can then trust the readiness data it uses to make decisions.
* **Consistent Quality Control:** Reviews training modules and content in the sales repository before they reach customer-facing teams. Each piece is checked to reflect Innovaccer’s approved brand voice and messaging, cleared proof points, and customer referenceability rules, so sellers never take outdated or unvalidated claims into health system and payer conversations.

**A Day in the Life**

* **New Hire Onboarding & Ramp:** Help design and run onboarding for new GTM hires across Sales and Marketing. This includes kickoff sessions, platform orientation, structured learning paths, and 30-60-90 day milestones that get new hires to full productivity faster.
* **Certification & Competency Assessment:** Support the certification lifecycle and own its execution. Working from scenarios and scoring rubrics defined by GTM Enablement leadership and sales leaders, the Manager builds and configures certifications in the learning platform, including AI role-play certifications (for example, an executive pitch delivered to an AI buyer persona) and live, juried certifications. The role schedules and runs attempts, coordinates coach feedback, maintains scorecards, and tracks completion and proficiency, flagging learners who need a recertification or additional support.
* **Enablement Program Design & Facilitation:** Run the weekly virtual enablement sessions that keep the field current on product launches, releases, pricing, and messaging. You will take each session from intake and leader approval through presenter prep, dry runs, live facilitation, and the recap, recording, and collateral that follow.
* **Learning Platform Administration:** Administer our learning platforms (Mindtickle and Docebo/Innovaccer Academy). Onboard learners, structure content and learning paths, maintain our Sales Enablement Hub, and build simulations. You will also manage vendor relationships and platform access.
* **Learning Analytics & Readiness Reporting:** Track attendance, completion, certification results, and proficiency. Work with GTM Operations to build readiness metrics and dashboards for leadership and sales managers, and use the data to spot skill gaps and show whether enablement is changing field performance.
* **Compliance & Required Training:** Deliver and track customer-mandated and company-required training for customer-facing employees, including assessments and completion reporting.

**What You Need**

* 5 to 8 years in sales enablement, GTM enablement, learning operations, or training program management, ideally supporting a B2B enterprise sales team
* Hands-on experience administering an LMS or sales readiness platform (Mindtickle, Docebo, Highspot, Seismic, or similar)
* Experience designing and running certifications, role-plays, or skills assessments with sales leaders
* Strong facilitation and project management skills. You are comfortable running a live session with senior presenters and managing many programs at once
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and a comfort with data. You can build a tracker, pull a report, and explain what it means
* Clear written communication. You can turn a product update into a recap or learning path a seller will actually use
* Familiarity with healthcare, health IT, or enterprise SaaS selling is a plus

 **Benefits**

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

**Here’s What We Offer**

  

* Generous Leave Benefits: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical Leave Policy: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.
* Pet-Friendly Office\*: Spend more time with your treasured friends, even when you're away from home. Bring your furry friends with you to the office and let your colleagues become their friends, too. \*Noida office only
Creche Facility for children\*: Say goodbye to worries and hello to a convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well-being first. \*India offices  

**Where and how we work**

Our Noida office is situated in a posh techspace, equipped with various amenities to support our work environment. Here, we follow a five-day work schedule, allowing us to efficiently carry out our tasks and collaborate effectively within our team.

Innovaccer is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

LEADERSHIP & MANAGEMENT

OPERATIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

* Collaborate with the Director of Field Service - APAC & China and Global functional leaders to establish operating and capital budgets for his/her team. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve overall financial and operational performance in the Territory.

Formulate a Service Marketing plan to maximize service value and achieve business goals for service growth in collaboration with Marketing.

title: Sales Associate
description:
About Sinclairs

Sinclairs Hotels & Resorts is one of eastern India's most established hospitality names, operating nine properties across the country's hills, plains and coastline, from Himalayan resorts to a beachfront hotel in the Andamans. We are a listed, debt-free group with a strong cash position, now in an active expansion phase and transforming how we run: our commercial discipline, our people systems and our technology.

The Role

You will sell Sinclairs across channels and across properties. One day you are working OTA visibility and rate parity for the hill properties before peak season; the next you are in a corporate's office pitching an offsite, or working a tour-operator contract for Port Blair. You will own a book of accounts and a set of channels, with targets, and be measured on the revenue you bring in.

We are hiring from hospitality. You should already know how a hotel sells: how OTAs rank and price, how travel agents and operators contract, how a corporate RFP works, how a wedding or MICE enquiry becomes a confirmed block. What we add is scope: nine properties, every channel, and a head office building the systems and marketing to back you.

What You'll Do

* Manage OTA performance for your properties: content, parity, promotions, visibility, market-manager relationships
* - Work the travel trade: tour operators, travel agents, DMCs; contracting, allocations, series and FIT business
* - Build corporate accounts for rooms, offsites and MICE; respond to RFPs and negotiate rate agreements
* - Convert wedding, banquet and group enquiries with the properties: site visits, proposals, follow-up, close
* - Keep the pipeline current in the group CRM; plan activity against occupancy gaps
* - Travel regularly to the properties; know every room category and banquet space well enough to sell from memory

What We're Looking For

* 2+ years in hotel or hospitality sales with experience across more than one channel
* - A sales record you can show: targets, production, accounts won
* - Working knowledge of OTA extranets, channel managers, rate parity and promotions
* - Confident with proposals, rate agreements and negotiation; clear in person, on the phone and in writing
* - Comfortable with a CRM and Excel
* - Ambition to grow into a management role, and the work ethic to earn it

Where This Goes

The group sales team is small today and will not stay that way. Progression to Sales Executive and Sales Manager owning a region or channel.

description:

Indian Silk House Agencies (ISHA) is a 55-year-old ethnic wear retail brand with 66 stores across 60 cities. As a

**What you’ll own**

* Working with Sales, HR, Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Accounts and Supply Chain to keep store operations on track

* Comfortable in a fast-paced retail environment
* Based in or willing to relocate to Kolkata

title: Regional Business Head
description:
About HNS Gold

HNS Gold Pvt. Ltd. is a growing company specializing in buying old gold and silver jewellery at competitive market-linked rates with instant payment. Our services also include Gold Loan Settlement, Monthly Gold Investment Plans (MGIP), and Free Gold Valuation.

As part of our business expansion in West Bengal, we are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Regional Head**
to lead our Kolkata region, strengthen branch performance, develop high-performing teams, and drive sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Regional Business Development & Growth**

* Take overall responsibility for business performance, revenue generation, and profitability across the Kolkata region.
* Drive Gold Buying, Silver Buying, Gold Loan Settlement, and MGIP business.
* Ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly business targets across all assigned branches.
* Identify new business opportunities, strengthen local market presence, and develop strategies for customer acquisition.
* Monitor branch-wise business performance and implement corrective action wherever required.

**2. Multi-Branch Management & Team Leadership**

* Lead, guide, and monitor Area Sales Managers, Branch Managers, and branch sales teams.
* Drive productivity, accountability, and consistent performance across all branches.
* Conduct regular branch visits, business reviews, and performance evaluations.
* Develop team capabilities through coaching, mentoring, and on-the-job training.
* Build a strong performance-driven culture with clear ownership of business results.

**3. Sales, Lead Conversion & Customer Acquisition**

* Ensure effective handling and conversion of leads generated through Google, Meta, digital campaigns, referrals, and branch activities.
* Improve customer walk-ins, conversion ratios, and repeat business.
* Drive customer engagement, existing customer reactivation, referral generation, and local marketing initiatives.
* Personally support high-value customer acquisition and major business closures wherever required.
* Coordinate with the Lead Management team to improve lead-to-business conversion.

**4. Branch Expansion & Market Development**

* Identify high-potential locations for new branch expansion across Kolkata and surrounding markets.
* Support market research, competitor analysis, and branch feasibility assessments.
* Coordinate new branch launches, recruitment, business planning, and initial performance development.
* Build strong local business networks to increase market penetration.

**5. Business Monitoring & Operational Compliance**

* Monitor daily MIS, sales pipeline, branch productivity, and target achievement.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, gold valuation procedures, KYC requirements, and operational controls.
* Work closely with Operations, HR, Marketing, and Lead Management departments.
* Monitor branch operating expenses, business efficiency, and profitability.
* Ensure timely reporting, proper escalation, and closure of business-related issues.

Candidate Requirements

**Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or postgraduate qualification in Management is an advantage.
* **Minimum 5–10 years of relevant experience, including significant experience in the Gold Loan industry.**
* **Proven experience managing multiple branches, regions, or large sales teams.**
* **Prior experience as Regional Manager, Area Manager, Cluster Manager, Zonal Manager, or in a comparable multi-branch leadership role.**
* **Demonstrated success in achieving sales targets, developing business volumes, and managing branch profitability.**
* **Strong knowledge of the Kolkata and West Bengal markets.**
* **Willingness to travel extensively across assigned branches.**

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
* Excellent sales planning, business development, and customer acquisition skills.
* Ability to improve underperforming branches and drive measurable results.
* Strong analytical, MIS reporting, and performance monitoring skills.
* Knowledge of gold valuation, gold-backed financial products, and branch operations.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Regional Head will be evaluated on:

* Regional Gold and Silver Buying business volume.
* Revenue generation and branch profitability.
* Daily, weekly, and monthly target achievement.
* Branch-wise productivity and sales growth.
* Customer walk-ins and lead conversion performance.
* New customer acquisition and existing customer retention.
* Gold Loan Settlement and MGIP business development.
* Team performance, retention, and leadership effectiveness.
* Successful branch expansion and new branch performance.
* Operational compliance and cost management.

What We Offer

* Senior leadership opportunity in a growing gold and silver buying business.
* Responsibility for managing and expanding the Kolkata region.
* Opportunity to build and lead high-performing teams.
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience and role requirements.
* Performance-based incentives as per company policy.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant Gold Loan industry experience and proven multi-branch leadership capabilities are invited to apply through LinkedIn.

* **Join HNS Gold and lead our next phase of regional business growth.**

title: Technical Business Development Manager
description:
**WE'RE HIRING!****Technical Business Development Manager – AI Solutions**

**Company:**
Neuraforz

**Location:**
Kolkata, West Bengal, India

**Work Mode:**
Onsite | Work From Office

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Working Hours:**
6–8 Hours During US Business Hours (EST/CST)

**Experience Required:**
3+ Years in B2B IT / Software Sales

**About Neuraforz**

**Neuraforz**
is an innovative technology company specializing in
**Artificial Intelligence, intelligent automation, and custom software development solutions**
.

We empower businesses to accelerate digital transformation through advanced technologies, including
**AI Agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), workflow automation, and full-stack software development**
.

Our mission is to help businesses solve complex challenges through practical, scalable, and results-driven technology solutions.

We are seeking a
**dynamic, results-oriented, and technically knowledgeable Business Development Manager**
who can establish strong relationships with US-based clients, identify business opportunities, and drive revenue growth.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated professional who enjoys consultative selling, understands emerging AI technologies, and thrives in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment.

**Position Overview**

As a
**Technical Business Development Manager – AI Solutions**
, you will play a pivotal role in expanding our presence across the US market.

You will be responsible for identifying prospective clients, conducting discovery meetings, understanding business requirements, presenting tailored AI and software solutions, and successfully converting opportunities into long-term client relationships.

The ideal candidate combines
**exceptional communication skills, strong B2B sales experience, technical understanding, and proven deal-closing capabilities**
.

You will work
**onsite at our Kolkata location**
, collaborating directly with company leadership and engineering teams to develop proposals, define project scopes, and deliver compelling solutions to prospective clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Client Acquisition**

* Identify and engage prospective clients across the US market, particularly within FinTech, B2B SaaS, and technology-driven industries.
* Develop and execute targeted outbound sales strategies through LinkedIn, email campaigns, professional networking, and prospecting tools.
* Establish meaningful relationships with CTOs, VP-level executives, founders, and other key decision-makers.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified business opportunities.

**2. Client Consultation & Solution Selling**

* Conduct professional discovery calls, virtual meetings, and solution presentations with US-based prospects.
* Understand client challenges, operational requirements, budgets, technical environments, and business objectives.
* Recommend appropriate AI, automation, and custom software solutions based on identified needs.
* Clearly communicate complex technical concepts in simple, persuasive, and business-focused language.

**3. Proposal Development & Deal Closure**

* Collaborate with software engineers and technical teams to develop project proposals, scopes of work, and pricing estimates.
* Present customized solutions and commercial proposals to prospective clients.
* Manage negotiations, address client objections, and confidently guide opportunities through the sales cycle.
* Take ownership of opportunities from initial engagement through successful contract closure.

**4. AI & Technical Solution Understanding**

* Demonstrate practical knowledge of AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG systems, AI agents, APIs, cloud solutions, and business process automation.
* Understand software development lifecycles, MVP development, system integrations, and project delivery methodologies.
* Translate technical capabilities into measurable business value for clients.
* Engage technical specialists when deeper solution architecture or engineering expertise is required.

**5. CRM Management & Sales Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, client interactions, opportunities, and sales activities within the CRM.
* Monitor pipeline performance, follow-up activities, proposal progress, and conversion rates.
* Provide regular sales updates and forecasts to company leadership.
* Support the development of client success stories, testimonials, and case studies.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Professional Experience**

* Minimum
  **3+ years of experience**
  in B2B sales, business development, account management, or technical pre-sales.
* Demonstrated experience selling
  **IT services, SaaS products, custom software development, or technology solutions**
  .
* Proven experience engaging with and selling to
  **US-based clients**
  .
* Strong track record of generating qualified opportunities, managing sales pipelines, and closing business deals.
* Experience communicating with senior-level stakeholders and technical decision-makers.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Good working understanding of
  **Artificial Intelligence, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, and automation technologies**
  .
* Familiarity with APIs, cloud infrastructure, software integrations, and custom application development.
* Ability to understand client requirements and communicate potential technical solutions effectively.
* General knowledge of software project scoping, development timelines, and delivery processes.

**Communication & Sales Competencies**

* **Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are mandatory.**
* Strong presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and objection-handling abilities.
* Confidence in leading business discussions with US executives and technical leaders.
* Consultative selling approach with a strong focus on understanding client requirements.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and consistently achieve business development objectives.

**Work Availability**

* Must be willing to
  **work onsite in Kolkata, West Bengal**
  .
* Must be available to work
  **6–8 hours daily during US business hours (EST/CST)**
  .
* Comfortable collaborating with distributed teams and international clients.
* Highly organized, proactive, self-motivated, and accountable for results.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Candidates with the following experience will receive additional consideration:

* Previous experience selling
  **offshore or nearshore software development services**
  to US businesses.
* Industry exposure to
  **FinTech, B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, or regulated industries**
  .
* Educational background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Prior experience as a Software Developer, Business Analyst, Technical Consultant, or Project Manager.
* Familiarity with
  **HubSpot, Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ChatGPT, Claude**
  , or similar platforms.
* An established professional network of US-based technology decision-makers.
* Experience managing medium- to high-value technology deals.

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive compensation package**
  with performance-based sales commissions.
* **Onsite opportunity in Kolkata**
  with exposure to the US technology market.
* Direct collaboration with company leadership and experienced technical professionals.
* Opportunity to represent cutting-edge AI and software development solutions.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial, and growth-oriented work environment.
* Professional development opportunities in the rapidly evolving AI industry.
* Meaningful ownership of client relationships and business development initiatives.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for more than someone who can simply generate leads.

**We want a confident business development professional who can understand technology, communicate its value, build trust with US clients, and successfully close deals.**

You could be an excellent fit if you:

* Enjoy engaging with senior decision-makers and solving business challenges.
* Can confidently explain AI solutions without relying on overly technical jargon.
* Have a demonstrated ability to convert client conversations into revenue-generating opportunities.
* Are passionate about emerging technologies and the future of AI-driven businesses.
* Thrive in a results-oriented environment where initiative and performance matter.

**Application Process**

Interested candidates are requested to submit:

**1. Updated Resume/CV**
– Highlighting relevant B2B sales, business development, and technology industry experience.

**2. Sales Achievement Summary**
– A brief description of a significant deal you successfully closed or influenced, including the approximate deal value and your contribution.

**3. Short Introduction Video (2 Minutes)**
– Explain the concept of a
**RAG-based AI chatbot**
to a non-technical business owner in clear, simple language.

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further evaluation and interviews.

**How to Apply**

**Job Location:**
Kolkata, West Bengal (Onsite)

**Contact Number:**
+91 95535 27066

**Email:**
zanemartin@exzelon.com

**Interested candidates can email their updated resume and supporting application materials to the address above or contact us directly for further information.**

**Build the Future of AI with Neuraforz!**

If you are passionate about
**technology, business development, client relationships, and driving measurable sales results**
, we would love to hear from you.

**Join Neuraforz and help businesses unlock the potential of Artificial Intelligence through innovative, real-world solutions.**

**Apply Now | Technical Business Development Manager – AI Solutions**

**Neuraforz | AI Innovation • Intelligent Automation • Custom Software Solutions**

title: Area Manager - Micra Specialist (Leadless Pacemaker)
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
Micra Specialist- Working around focus product in East with key customer in alignment with sales for Micra therapy adoption and skill building.
  
  
The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) business delivers therapies that help manage heart rhythm disorders through implantable pacing and cardiac monitoring technologies. This role supports the expansion of leadless pacing therapy, partnering with physicians, hospitals, and healthcare systems to increase adoption and improve patient access to advanced cardiac care.
  
  
This position covers East India and Chhattisgarh and requires management of a large, multi-state territory. The role is field-based with extensive customer engagement across hospitals, cardiac centers, and healthcare institutions. Travel is expected up to 60% of the time.
  
  
**Job Description Field**
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales growth, market development, and therapy adoption across the assigned territory. The role works closely with Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, hospital stakeholders, distributors, and key opinion leaders to expand access to Cardiac Rhythm Management therapies while achieving business objectives.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Drive sales performance and achieve annual operating plan targets across the assigned territory.
* Build and strengthen relationships with Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, hospital administrators, and other healthcare stakeholders.
* Develop and execute territory plans to increase adoption of leadless pacing and Cardiac Rhythm Management therapies.
* Identify new business opportunities, assess customer needs, and deliver appropriate product and therapy solutions.
* Manage key accounts, key opinion leaders, and distributor partnerships to support sustainable business growth.
* Analyze market trends, competitive activity, customer dynamics, and account potential to prioritize opportunities.
* Lead physician education, therapy awareness, and market development initiatives to expand therapy penetration.
* Maintain accurate sales reporting, customer records, and completion of required compliance and product training.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience\*
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience\*
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience\*

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Cardiac Rhythm Management devices, Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI), Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR), or Impella therapies.
* Experience managing corporate and government healthcare accounts.
* IBHRE Certified Cardiac Device Specialist (CCDS) certification.
* Understanding of electrophysiology procedures, pacing therapies, and catheterization laboratory environments.
* Experience leading therapy adoption and market development initiatives within cardiology.

**Physical Job Requirements**
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

description:

HNS Gold Pvt. Ltd. is a growing company specializing in buying old gold and silver jewellery at competitive market-linked rates with instant payment. Our services also include Gold Loan Settlement, Monthly Gold Investment Plans (MGIP), and Free Gold Valuation.

**Regional Head**

**1. Regional Business Development & Growth**

* Drive customer engagement, existing customer reactivation, referral generation, and local marketing initiatives.
* Personally support high-value customer acquisition and major business closures wherever required.

* Identify high-potential locations for new branch expansion across Kolkata and surrounding markets.
* Support market research, competitor analysis, and branch feasibility assessments.
* Coordinate new branch launches, recruitment, business planning, and initial performance development.

**5. Business Monitoring & Operational Compliance**

* Monitor daily MIS, sales pipeline, branch productivity, and target achievement.

* Ensure timely reporting, proper escalation, and closure of business-related issues.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or postgraduate qualification in Management is an advantage.
* **Minimum 5–10 years of relevant experience, including significant experience in the Gold Loan industry.**
* **Proven experience managing multiple branches, regions, or large sales teams.**

* **Demonstrated success in achieving sales targets, developing business volumes, and managing branch profitability.**

* **Willingness to travel extensively across assigned branches.**

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
* Excellent sales planning, business development, and customer acquisition skills.
* Ability to improve underperforming branches and drive measurable results.

* Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.

The Regional Head will be evaluated on:

* Revenue generation and branch profitability.
* Daily, weekly, and monthly target achievement.
* Branch-wise productivity and sales growth.
* Customer walk-ins and lead conversion performance.
* New customer acquisition and existing customer retention.
* Gold Loan Settlement and MGIP business development.
* Team performance, retention, and leadership effectiveness.
* Successful branch expansion and new branch performance.
* Operational compliance and cost management.

What We Offer

* Senior leadership opportunity in a growing gold and silver buying business.
* Responsibility for managing and expanding the Kolkata region.
* Opportunity to build and lead high-performing teams.
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience and role requirements.
* Performance-based incentives as per company policy.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant Gold Loan industry experience and proven multi-branch leadership capabilities are invited to apply through LinkedIn.

* **Join HNS Gold and lead our next phase of regional business growth.**

* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience\*
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience\*

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Cardiac Rhythm Management devices, Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI), Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR), or Impella therapies.
* Experience managing corporate and government healthcare accounts.
* IBHRE Certified Cardiac Device Specialist (CCDS) certification.
* Understanding of electrophysiology procedures, pacing therapies, and catheterization laboratory environments.

**Job Description:** Stock Executive

**Industry:** Jewellery / Retail  
**Department:** Operations & Inventory  
**Experience Required:** 2–3 years  
**Salary Range:** ₹20,000 – ₹25,000  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Stock Executive to manage our jewellery inventory with complete accuracy and security. You will be responsible for receiving, recording, tracking and reconciling stock across the showroom and warehouse, ensuring every piece is accounted for and available when customers need it.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Receive, verify and tag incoming jewellery stock (gold, diamond, silver and fashion jewellery) against purchase orders, invoices and weight/quality certificates.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date stock records in the inventory software/ERP, including item codes, gross and net weights, purity and pricing.
* Handle stock transfers between warehouse, showrooms and vendors with proper documentation and sign-offs.
* Conduct daily, weekly and monthly physical stock counts and reconcile them with system records; investigate and report discrepancies promptly.
* Ensure secure storage, handling and display of high-value items in line with company safety and insurance protocols.
* Coordinate with sales, billing and purchase teams to track fast-moving, slow-moving and out-of-stock items.
* Manage stock issued for exhibitions, customer approvals, repairs, hallmarking and manufacturing/karigar work, tracking each item until it returns.
* Prepare regular stock reports (stock ageing, movement, shortage/excess) for management.
* Monitor minimum stock levels and raise replenishment requests in time.
* Maintain records of returns, damages and rejections, and coordinate with vendors for resolution.
* Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation.
* Follow SOPs for security, CCTV coverage, key and locker control, and entry/exit checks.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration or a related field (B.Com preferred).
* 2–3 years of experience in stock/inventory management, preferably in jewellery, retail or luxury goods.
* Working knowledge of jewellery terms: gross/net weight, purity (karat), making charges, stone weight, hallmarking, BIS standards.
* Experience using inventory/ERP or billing software (e.g., Tally, Marg, Busy or a jewellery-specific ERP).
* Proficiency in MS Excel (formulas, pivot tables, basic reporting).

**Key Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy
* High integrity and trustworthiness when handling valuables
* Good organisation and time management
* Clear communication and teamwork
* Ability to work under pressure during festive and wedding seasons
* Basic problem-solving and documentation skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Stock accuracy (physical vs. system count)
* Timeliness of stock entry, transfers and reports
* Reduction in stock discrepancies and shrinkage
* Compliance with security and audit requirements

**Title: Worldwide Regional Account Executive**
**Location:**

**Who We Are**
At FedEx, moving the world doesn't only mean delivering for our customers around the globe. Moving the world is also about creating what's next. We are Team FedEx and we are 500,000+ people strong around the world. The work we all do comes down to one purpose: to provide our customers with outstanding experiences as we connect the world to what's next.

Our willingness to innovate and transform is what keeps us at the forefront of our industry. With curiosity, inventiveness, and entrepreneurial spirit, we keep finding new and better ways to deliver results for our customers, for our people and for the planet.
  
  
Here, you will have the flexibility and empowerment to reimagine the new, spread your wings and see your impact. By doing so, we are motivated to be better together. And together, we will continue to drive and deliver excellence.
  
  
**Our Values**
We take pride in being a people-first company, where our employees feel safe, valued and respected. Our culture values empower us to deliver great results.
  
  
**With One FedEx Culture, We**
**Take care of each other | Commit to do good | Own outstanding | Drive business results | Create what's next**
**Awards**

* FedEx has consistently ranked among the top 20 in the "World's Most Admired Companies" report, published in FORTUNE magazine, since 2001.
* Ethisphere named FedEx as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies® in 2023.

**What You Will Do**
As a Worldwide Regional Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, developing existing customer relationships, and promoting Ocean Freight, Air Freight, Warehousing, and End-to-End Logistics solutions. You will play a key role in expanding the customer base, increasing revenue, and delivering profitable growth through effective sales strategies and strong market engagement.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**

* Business Development: Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers for Ocean Freight (FCL/LCL) and Air Freight services. Generate leads through cold calling, customer visits, networking, and referrals while developing and maintaining a strong sales pipeline to achieve assigned revenue targets.
* Customer Growth: Manage and strengthen relationships with existing customers, identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling, and increase customer wallet share through relevant logistics solutions.
* Customer Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with exporters, importers, manufacturers, traders, and freight forwarders. Understand their supply chain requirements and recommend suitable logistics solutions to meet their business needs.
* Sales & Quotations: Prepare competitive freight quotations in coordination with pricing and operations teams. Negotiate freight rates, contracts, and commercial terms, and proactively follow up on quotations to convert business opportunities into confirmed revenue.
* Market Intelligence: Monitor market trends, competitor activities, freight rate movements, trade lanes, shipping line activities, and airline developments. Share relevant market insights and business opportunities with management.
* Internal Coordination: Collaborate with pricing, operations, customs clearance, and customer service teams to ensure smooth execution and seamless customer experience. Support new customer onboarding, service delivery, collections, and credit control activities.
* Sales Reporting & Forecasting: Maintain accurate CRM records, sales activity reports, and monthly business forecasts. Track sales performance against targets and monitor key metrics such as revenue generation, customer acquisition, and conversion ratios.
* Performance Management: Drive achievement of assigned monthly and annual sales targets while maintaining focus on profitability, customer retention, and timely collections.

**You Will Be a Great Fit If You**

* Hold a bachelor's degree in commerce, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Have 2–8 years of relevant experience in Ocean Freight and Air Freight sales, preferably within freight forwarding, NVOCC, logistics, or shipping organizations.
* Have hands-on knowledge of Ocean Freight operations, including FCL and LCL, and Air Freight Export and Import services.
* Possess a strong understanding of freight forwarding, end-to-end supply chain solutions, and customs clearance processes.
* Demonstrate proven capabilities in business development, new customer acquisition, and managing existing customer relationships.
* Have strong negotiation, influencing, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective customer relationships.
* Possess commercial awareness and a profitability-oriented mindset, with the ability to negotiate competitive rates and identify business growth opportunities.
* Are proficient in CRM management, sales pipeline development, reporting, and business forecasting.
* Have a strong hunter mindset, are self-motivated and target-driven, and demonstrate resilience in working under pressure and meeting deadlines.
* Are proactive in gathering market intelligence, identifying competitor activities, and translating market insights into business opportunities.
* Have a demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets while maintaining customer satisfaction, retention, and payment compliance.

**What You Can Expect**

* Attractive remuneration package.
* Spread your wings and take ownership of your career with opportunities to network and connect with professionals in your field and involvement in cross-functional projects.
* A supportive and inclusive work environment.
* Mentorship and guidance from industry professionals.
* Exposure to real-world projects and challenges across business functions.
* Valuable skills and experience to enhance your professional growth and career progression.
* Complimentary 24/7 access to our learning platforms to support you in becoming who you want to be.

**Our Commitment to Equal Opportunities**
Our greatest asset at FedEx is our people. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, and offer equal opportunities, fairness and respect to all regardless of who you are. We encourage you to apply even if you feel your experience does not align with all the aspects in the job description as you could be exactly who we need for this or another opportunity.
  
  
We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, age, genetic information, citizenship, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status or any other characteristic protected under national, state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate team members and third parties with physical and mental disabilities.
  
  
**Interested to join Team FedEx?**
Everyone at FedEx has a part to play. It's about coming up with smart solutions, remaining resilient in the face of setbacks, and going above and beyond to get the job done. And whether you're a business leader or delivery driver, you'll be empowered to take responsibility and overcome each challenge in your own way.
  
  
If this role and working environment sound like a place you can thrive in, apply today and let's create what's next together.
  
  
Presentation Skills;Influencing & Persuasion Skills;Negotiation Skills;Written & Verbal Communication Skills;Networking Skills
  
  
FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.
