title: MARKETPLACE & E-COMMERCE MANAGER
description:
**Location: Ahmedabad**
**(on-site)**

**Industry: Apparel / Fashion / Nightwear**

**Experience: 5–8 Years**

**Salary Range: 9.00 - 12.00 LPA**

**ABOUT SWEET DREAMS**

SWEET DREAMS (S D Retail Limited) is one of India’s leading sleepwear and apparel brands, with a legacy of over 35 years. The brand is focused on delivering comfortable, stylish and quality sleepwear and lifestyle products through its expanding retail and digital presence.

As we continue to strengthen our E-Commerce and D2C business, we are looking for a commercially driven professional who can take ownership of online sales, marketplace growth and profitability.

**JOB PURPOSE**

The
Marketplace &
E-Commerce Manager will be responsible for managing and growing SWEET DREAMS’ online business across major marketplaces and the company’s D2C website.

The role will own online sales, revenue growth, marketplace performance, product listings, pricing, promotions, advertising, inventory, customer experience and profitability.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in apparel/fashion e-commerce and a strong understanding of Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho and D2C platforms.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Marketplace Management**

* Manage day-to-day operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho and other relevant marketplaces.
* Maintain and optimize product listings, titles, descriptions, keywords, images and catalogue information.
* Ensure accurate SKU, size, colour, variant, pricing and inventory updates.
* Monitor ratings, reviews, returns, cancellations and customer complaints.
* Coordinate with marketplace account managers and resolve operational/commercial issues.
* Identify opportunities for new product launches and online category expansion.

**2. D2C Website Management**

* Manage and grow the company’s e-commerce website.
* Ensure products, pricing, offers, images and inventory are updated.
* Improve website conversion through better product presentation, navigation and customer experience.
* Coordinate with internal technology teams/agencies for website improvements.
* Monitor traffic, conversion rate, AOV and repeat customer metrics.
* Plan and execute promotional campaigns, seasonal sales and new launches.

**3. Sales & Business Growth**

* Own monthly and annual online sales targets.
* Develop strategies to increase revenue, orders, AOV and repeat purchases.
* Analyse category-wise, channel-wise and SKU-wise performance.
* Identify best-selling and slow-moving products and take corrective action.
* Recommend product assortment, pricing, bundles and offers based on data and market trends.
* Monitor competitor pricing, products, promotions and positioning.

**4. Digital Marketing & Advertising**

* Plan and manage marketplace advertising and sponsored campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams/agencies for Google, Meta and other digital campaigns.
* Monitor advertising spend, ROAS, CAC and campaign profitability.
* Plan promotional campaigns for festivals and major marketplace events.
* Ensure marketing spends are aligned with sales and profitability objectives.

**5. Inventory & Order Management**

* Coordinate with Warehouse, Production and Logistics teams for optimum online inventory.
* Monitor stock availability by SKU, size and colour.
* Ensure availability of fast-moving products and minimize stock-outs.
* Plan inventory requirements based on sales trends and upcoming campaigns.
* Monitor order processing, dispatch, delivery, cancellations and returns.
* Coordinate with logistics and marketplace fulfilment partners.

**6. Pricing & Profitability**

* Develop and maintain channel-wise pricing and promotional strategies.
* Monitor competitor pricing regularly.
* Analyse marketplace commission, shipping, discounts, advertising, returns and other costs.
* Prepare SKU/channel-level profitability analysis.
* Ensure business growth while maintaining healthy contribution margins.

**7. MIS, Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly e-commerce performance reports.
* Track marketplace-wise and product/SKU-wise sales.
* Monitor orders, AOV, conversion rate and website traffic.
* Analyse advertising spend and ROAS.
* Track returns, cancellations, inventory and stock-outs.
* Monitor gross margin/contribution and customer acquisition.
* Present business insights and actionable recommendations to management.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

* Online Sales & Revenue Growth
* Achievement of Monthly/Annual Sales Targets
* Marketplace & D2C Profitability
* Website Sales Growth
* ROAS / Advertising ROI
* Conversion Rate Improvement
* Average Order Value Growth
* Reduction in Returns & Cancellations
* Inventory Availability & Stock-out Control
* Product Visibility & Marketplace Ranking
* Customer Ratings & Reviews
* Promotional Campaign Performance
* New Product Launches & Online Category Expansion

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, E-Commerce or Business Management will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in E-Commerce / Marketplace Management.
* Hands-on experience with major Indian marketplaces is essential.
* Experience in Apparel, Garments, Fashion, Innerwear or Nightwear will be strongly preferred.
* Experience managing a significant online business or D2C brand will be an advantage.

Interested candidates can share their CV at:

**careers@sweetdreamsindia.com**

**Role Purpose**

* The Asset specialist is a subject matter expert with hardcore domain experience in Mortgage, is needed for the fulfillment of asset product applications sourced from Global Private Banking customer, open market / DSA channel for customers who are Ultra High Net Worth Individual (UHNI) and Existing Premier Customers or New Premier Criteria Alike and ensure seamless processing of these applications within the system.
* It involves interaction with various stakeholders both within HSBC and outside of HSBC (Risk Team, Builders, Societies, Legal Team etc.)
* Identifying, structuring, negotiating and underwriting complex / high value new credit opportunities for UHNW / Global Priority Clients/Family Offices

**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**
Impact on the Business / Function
  
  

* Responsible for new business acquisition and identifying sales opportunities through Existing Premier and Non-Premier clients of the Branch and Premier Alike clients through open market to achieve sales target

title: Senior Solution Architect (Product & Services)
description:
**Position Overview**

As a Senior Solution Architect, you will be a strategic leader, architecting and guiding the implementation of sophisticated technology solutions for both our innovative product development and critical client service engagements. Leveraging 12-17 years of deep experience, you will bridge business objectives with technological execution, ensuring robust, scalable, secure, and strategically aligned solutions for our clients. This pivotal role demands a unique synthesis of profound technical expertise, sharp business acumen, and exceptional leadership to navigate the dual demands of product innovation and bespoke service delivery across diverse projects and technologies. You will define the technical vision and drive its successful realization. This role now also carries direct ownership of the solution lifecycle from pre-sales through delivery, and is expected to build hands-on alongside delivery teams — picking, customizing, and extending our AI-native tooling (including our internal PDLC framework) rather than only advising on its use.

**Key Responsibilities**

Your responsibilities will span strategic design, product and service lifecycle management, technical leadership, stakeholder engagement, and governance.

**Strategic Solution Design & Architecture**

* Translate complex business strategies, product requirements, and client needs into comprehensive architectural blueprints for both product offerings and customized service solutions. Lead architectural vision and strategy across internal product roadmaps and client projects, adapting fluidly to shifting contexts.
* Ensure all solutions are inherently scalable, resilient, secure by design, and strategically aligned with our clients' enterprise architecture and business goals. This alignment is critical for long-term viability and maximizing technology investments.
* Evaluate, select, and champion appropriate technologies, platforms, architectural patterns (e.g., microservices, serverless, EDA), and design principles tailored to each product feature or service engagement, profoundly influencing evolutionary capacity and deployment efficiency.
* Develop, maintain, and enforce comprehensive architectural documentation (diagrams, standards, best practices) for clarity and consistency across product and service teams.

**Product & Service Lifecycle Management**

* Collaborate with product management to define and refine product architecture, influence roadmaps with technical insights, and ensure technical feasibility and architectural soundness of new features. Early involvement is crucial for preempting costly missteps.
* Partner with service delivery and client engagement teams to design and customize solutions aligned with client expectations, contracts, and operations, requiring nuanced understanding of service design and adaptability.
* Oversee architectural integrity during implementation, providing decisive technical leadership and mentorship to development and delivery teams across product and service projects.
* Conduct rigorous architectural reviews and assessments, ensuring adherence to design principles, quality benchmarks, and non-functional requirements across all projects.

**Pre-Sales & Hands-On Delivery**

* Partner directly with the sales team during pre-sales: scope solutions, build proof-of-concepts and demos, estimate effort, and present technical approach to prospective clients.
* Personally prototype and build critical-path components alongside delivery teams — especially early in an engagement — to validate architecture decisions with working code, not diagrams alone.
* Own the technical narrative end-to-end, from opportunity through go-live and post-launch stabilization, ensuring nothing is lost in the handoff from sales to delivery.

**Technical Leadership & Mentorship**

* Provide expert technical guidance, strategic advice, and dedicated mentorship to engineering teams and fellow architects, fostering continuous learning.
* Champion architectural best practices, advocate for emerging technologies, and drive a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
* Lead and oversee proof-of-concept (PoC) projects to evaluate new technologies and architectural approaches before wider adoption, de-risking innovation.
* Evaluate, customize, and extend our internal AI-assisted delivery tooling (e.g., our PDLC framework) rather than using it as-is — and drive its adoption and evolution across delivery teams.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**

* Serve as the primary technical liaison and trusted advisor, bridging communication between business leaders, product management, engineering, service delivery, and clients.
* Clearly and persuasively articulate complex architectural concepts, strategic decisions, risks, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, including C-level executives.
* Proactively manage stakeholder expectations, negotiate priorities, and resolve conflicts regarding architectural direction and technology choices.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**  
\*

* Conduct thorough feasibility studies, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analyses for proposed solutions and architectural changes.
* Continuously evaluate and recommend strategic improvements to architectures, processes, and technology stacks to enhance efficiency, performance, scalability, and reduce TCO.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry trends, emerging technologies, architectural paradigms, and best practices relevant to solution architecture, product development, and service delivery.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**General Experience**

* Minimum 12-17 years in IT, with 8+ years in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or senior technical leadership, significantly influencing large-scale technology outcomes.
* Proven track record of successfully designing and delivering complex, large-scale technology solutions within both product development and client service delivery contexts.

**Technical Expertise**

* **Cloud Platforms:** Extensive hands-on experience architecting and deploying solutions on major public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, cloud-native services, multi-cloud/hybrid-cloud strategies, cost optimization, and security best practices.
* **Modern Architectural Patterns:** Expertise in designing and implementing solutions using microservices, serverless, EDA, API-driven design, and DDD.
* **DevOps & Automation:** Strong understanding and experience with DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, IaC tools (e.g., Terraform), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* **AI-Native Engineering:** Hands-on, daily use of agentic AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf) to build production-grade solutions at accelerated pace — not just autocomplete-level usage. Practical experience with spec-driven development (SDD) workflows and frameworks (e.g., OpenSpec, SpecKit, BMAD), agentic orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel) for multi-agent systems, and RAG/vector-database patterns. Comfort evaluating, selecting, and extending AI tooling for a team's specific delivery needs, with sound judgment on when AI-generated output requires review or governance. Solid experience with data architecture principles (big data, data lakes, data warehousing, real-time streaming) and integrating AI/ML capabilities into enterprise applications.
* **Security Architecture:** In-depth knowledge of security architecture principles, IAM solutions (e.g., SailPoint, Okta), threat modeling, data protection, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
* **Integration Technologies:** Proficiency in designing integration solutions using API-first design (REST, GraphQL), API management platforms, message queuing (e.g., Kafka), and EIP.
* **Software Development Background:** Strong foundational understanding of software development principles and familiarity with common programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#) and frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, .NET Core).
* **Enterprise Systems:** Experience with the architecture and integration of common enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, HRMS).

\*

**Methodologies**

* Deep understanding and practical experience applying Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and principles, with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) experience highly desirable.
* Familiarity with IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks such as ITIL is advantageous.
* Experience applying Agile and SAFe in a hybrid product development and client service delivery model.
* Experience adapting Agile/SAFe cadences for AI-accelerated, spec-first delivery cycles enabled by AI-assisted build and review.

**Business Acumen**

* Strong ability to understand business strategies, market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and client requirements, translating them into impactful technology solutions.
* Proven experience in conducting feasibility studies, risk assessments, and TCO/ROI analyses.
* Ability to think strategically and holistically, anticipate technology trends, and advise on long-term architectural roadmaps.
* Direct experience owning or significantly contributing to pre-sales estimation, solutioning, and proposal writing — not solely post-signature delivery planning.

**Leadership & Influence**

* Proven ability to lead, mentor, coach, and inspire technical teams, fostering collaboration and innovation.
* Demonstrated experience influencing senior management and C-level executives on strategic technology decisions.
* Capacity to drive organizational change and champion new architectural paradigms.
* Effective servant leadership style, providing vision and guardrails while empowering teams.

**Communication & Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, articulating complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, including negotiation, conflict resolution, and consensus-building.
* Proven stakeholder management capabilities, building trust and strong working relationships.

**Problem-Solving & Analytical Skills**

* Advanced analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach.
* Proven capacity to analyze complex situations, identify root causes, and develop innovative solutions.
* Keen attention to detail in architectural design, documentation, and review.

**Preferred Qualifications**  
\*

* Relevant and current industry certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP Architect, SAFe for Architects, CISSP).
* Demonstrable experience within relevant industry verticals.
* Record of thought leadership (publications, presentations, open-source contributions).

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹4,500,000.00 per year

title: Operation Executive
description:
1. Job Purpose

The Operation Executive is responsible for coordinating and supporting day-to-day air

ambulance and medical evacuation operations, ensuring the safe, timely, and eHicient

execution of missions. The role involves flight planning coordination, obtaining flight

permits and clearances, coordinating with aircraft operators, hospitals, medical teams,

ground ambulance providers, handling agents, and other relevant stakeholders to

ensure seamless mission execution.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Flight Operations and Mission Coordination

* Coordinate domestic and international air ambulance and medical evacuation

missions.

* Share the Quotes with the sales team.

* Monitor flight schedules, aircraft availability, estimated departure and arrival

times, and mission progress.

* Coordinate with aircraft operators, flight crews, dispatch teams, and other

operational stakeholders.

* Arrange aircraft positioning, technical fuel stops, crew requirements, and

ground support services as required.

* Ensure timely communication and updates to clients, management, and

relevant stakeholders throughout the mission.

* Monitor operational developments and promptly escalate delays, disruptions, or

other critical issues to the Operation Manager.

B. Ground Handling Coordination

* Coordinate ground handling arrangements for domestic and international air

ambulance, medical evacuation, VIP charter, and business aviation flights.

* Obtain handling quotations from FBOs, ground handlers, and local service

providers.

Arrange aircraft arrival and departure handling, parking, passenger assistance,

crew services, and other airport-related requirements.

* Coordinate with handling agents regarding landing permits, slots, parking

approvals, CIQ (Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine), and other applicable

airport requirements.

* Arrange crew transportation, hotel accommodation, catering, and other ground

support services as requested.

* Coordinate with aircraft operators and flight crews to confirm handling

requirements and operational schedules.

* Monitor flight movements and communicate schedule changes, delays, or

cancellations to the relevant service providers.

* Ensure that handling arrangements are confirmed in advance and that the

required services are available at the designated airports.

* Resolve handling-related issues promptly and escalate operational concerns to

the Operation Manager.

C. Flight Permits and Regulatory Compliance

§ Coordinate and obtain overflight, landing, departure, parking, and other

necessary flight permits and clearances.

§ Liaise with Civil Aviation Authorities (CAAs), airport authorities, ground handlers,

and local aviation representatives.

§ Assist with obtaining landing slots, airport permissions, diplomatic clearances,

and other operational approvals.

§ Verify aircraft, crew, passenger, and medical team documentation required for

mission execution.

§ Maintain accurate records of permits, approvals, clearances, and operational

correspondence.

§ Ensure compliance with applicable aviation regulations, company procedures,

and country-specific operational requirements.

D. Medical Evacuation Coordination

o Coordinate with Sales Team, Case Managers and Medical Team.

o Arrange ground ambulance Tarmac Access.

o Coordinate medical team positioning, patient transfer schedules, and required

medical equipment arrangements.

o Handle sensitive medical and passenger information confidentially and

professionally.o Ensure that all stakeholders receive timely updates regarding patient transfer

arrangements and mission progress.

E. Aircraft Operator and Vendor Coordination

* Liaise with aircraft operators, charter providers, handling agents, fuel suppliers,

and other aviation service providers.

* Obtain and compare aircraft availability, quotations, operating details, and

estimated flight times.

* Arrange and Coordinate ground handling, refuelling, catering, crew

accommodation, transportation, and other support services.

* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely confirmation of services and

operational arrangements.

* Maintain updated records of vendor contacts, service providers, rates, and

operational requirements.

F. Flight Planning and Documentation

§ Assist in preparing operational itineraries, flight schedules, routing details, and

mission plans.

§ Coordinate route planning, estimated flying times, fuel requirements, technical

stops, and airport feasibility with the relevant operator or flight crew.

§ Collect and verify operational documents, including aircraft registration,

airworthiness documents, insurance, crew licences, and other required

paperwork, as applicable.

§ Prepare and maintain mission files, operational checklists, flight status reports,

and post-mission documentation.

§ Ensure that all relevant documents and approvals are available before mission

commencement.

G. Aviation Fuel Coordination

* Coordinate aviation fuel requirements for air ambulance, business aviation,

charter, and other aircraft operations.

* Obtain competitive fuel quotations from international and domestic fuel

suppliers.

* Arrange and confirm fuel availability at designated airports and FBOs.

* Coordinate fuel orders, releases, and uplift confirmations with suppliers,

operators, and handling agents.

* Verify fuel grades, quantities, airport details, pricing, applicable taxes, and other

charges before confirming orders.

* Monitor fuel delivery and uplift status and resolve discrepancies or operational

issues promptly.

Ensure timely fuel arrangements for urgent medical evacuation missions and

other time-critical flights.

H. Client Communication and Service Delivery

o Maintain professional communication with clients, brokers, hospitals, and

partner organizations.

o Provide timely updates on aircraft availability, permit status, flight schedules,

and operational progress.

o Support the preparation and follow-up of operational quotations and service

confirmations.

o Respond promptly to client enquiries and coordinate with the relevant

departments to resolve operational concerns.

o Maintain a high standard of customer service, confidentiality, and

professionalism.

I. Customer Invoicing

§ Prepare accurate customer invoices for ground handling, airport charges,

permits, fuel coordination, transportation, accommodation, and other services

provided by the company, as applicable.

§ Verify customer invoices against approved quotations, confirmed orders, actual

services rendered, and applicable commercial terms.

§ Ensure that invoices include the correct customer details, flight information,

aircraft registration, service descriptions, currency, taxes, and payment terms.

the agreed billing schedule.

§ Coordinate with the Accounts Department for invoice approval, issuance, and

submission to customers.

§ Send invoices and supporting documents to customers and follow up on invoice

acknowledgement where required.

§ Prepare revised invoices or credit notes only after obtaining the necessary

approval.

§ Maintain proper records of invoices issued, pending billing, and customer billing

queries.

J. Supplier Invoice Verification and Cost Control

* Collect invoices from handling agents, FBOs, airport authorities, and other

service providers.

* Cross-check supplier invoices against the original quotations, purchase orders,

service confirmations, and agreed rates.

* Verify actual charges, taxes, surcharges, parking duration, additional services,

and any supplementary fees.• Identify discrepancies, duplicate charges, incorrect rates, or unsupported

expenses and seek clarification from the relevant vendor.

necessary.

* Ensure that supplier invoices are submitted to the Accounts Department within

the required timelines.

* Maintain accurate records of mission-wise operational costs and supporting

documentation.

* Assist in monitoring costs against quoted amounts and identifying variations that

may aHect profitability.

K. Accounts Receivable and Payable Coordination

aHect operational continuity.

Charges.

Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

dispatch, charter operations, or travel coordination will be an advantage.

documentation, and flight permit procedures is preferred.

**Company Description:**
Cochin Computing, established in 1993, is a leading IT services and software development company based in Kochi, India. We specialize in providing a wide range of IT-related services and maintenance across various sectors, including finance, healthcare, education, retail, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, and government. Our flagship fintech product, CCBanking, powers most of the cooperative banks in the state. We are committed to driving enterprise digitalization through comprehensive solutions in data analysis, business intelligence, machine learning, digital marketing, web development, cloud integration, AWS, Microsoft Azure, SAP services, and custom software development.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
Business Development Executive / Associate – Banking Software Sales
  
  
Kochi, Kerala | Field Sales
  
  
Cochin Computing develops core banking software, payment solutions and digital banking products for cooperative banks and other financial institutions. We’re looking for a field sales professional who can generate leads independently, meet decision-makers in person and take responsibility for winning new business from the first conversation through to a signed order.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
- Find new prospects. Identify banks and financial institutions in your assigned territory. Build your own pipeline through outbound calls, referrals, industry contacts and direct visits.
  
- Meet decision-makers. Plan regular visits to branches and head offices. Build relationships with bank secretaries, CEOs, general managers, and heads of IT and operations. Understand who will use the product, who approves the budget and how the bank makes a purchase.
  
- Identify the right opportunity. Ask how the bank works today and where staff or customers face difficulties. Opportunities may include core banking software, mobile banking, WhatsApp banking, payment services or add-on products for banks that plan to keep their existing systems.
  
- Lead demos and proposals. Bring in our product team for technical discussions, then prepare a proposal that addresses the bank’s requirements, pricing and implementation scope.
  
- Close the deal. Handle objections, negotiate within approved terms and follow up through management or committee approval until the agreement or purchase order is signed. Hand over the agreed scope and commitments to the implementation team.
  
- Manage your pipeline. Keep the CRM current with meeting notes, opportunity value, expected closure date and the next action agreed with the customer.
  
  
What we’re looking for
  
  
- Experience in B2B field sales, with examples of leads you generated yourself and deals you helped close. Experience selling software, fintech products or technology services to banks is an advantage.
  
- Confidence approaching senior officials, asking practical questions and explaining software in clear business terms
  
- Field sales where you have to go out and pitch to director board of cooperative banks and financial institutions, often decision makers are politicians
  
- Ability to run meetings in Malayalam and English, prepare clear proposals and follow up consistently through longer sales cycles.
  
- Willingness to travel regularly across the assigned territory and organise your own customer visits.
  
  
How we’ll measure success
  
  
Your primary targets will be new institutions signed and the value of business won. We’ll also review qualified opportunities generated, meetings with decision-makers and the proportion of proposals that convert into orders.
  
  
  
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, IT, or a related field.
* 1-5 years of experience in business development, sales, or marketing, preferably in the IT sales or banking sector.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment, field sales where you have to go out and pitch to director board of cooperative banks and financial institutions, often decision makers are politicians
* Knowledge of digital marketing strategies and IT industry trends is highly desirable.
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and supportive work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Hybrid work model to support work-life balance.
* Exposure to a variety of projects and industries, enabling you to broaden your expertise.

TGH Technologies is a technology solutions company specialising in software development, AI-powered solutions, workflow automation, and digital product engineering.

This role requires strong communication, negotiation, prospecting, and relationship-building skills, along with an interest in technology and business solutions.

* Qualified leads generated.
* Client meetings and discovery calls scheduled.
* Sales opportunities created.
* Proposals and commercial discussions initiated.
* Deals successfully converted into revenue.
* Value of business generated and overall sales pipeline growth.

* Opportunity to work with a growing technology company.
* Exposure to software development, AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
* Direct interaction with founders, business leaders, and clients.
* Performance-driven growth opportunities.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**Job Description**
About Anthropic
  
  
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

You may be a good fit if you have
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

Logistics
  
  
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
How we're different
  
  
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
Come work with us!
  
  
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Staff Solutions Engineer
description:
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**
If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you ready to sit at the epicenter of the API and AI connectivity revolution? As a Staff Solutions Engineer at Kong, you won’t just be selling a platform — you’ll be a trusted technical advisor helping the world’s most innovative enterprises architect secure, scalable API ecosystems while navigating the transition into the agentic AI era. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers.

* Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API and AI connectivity platform.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer requirements and map them to Kong solutions, from initial product reviews through to production.
* Support POCs throughout the entire evaluation process, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment.
* Ensure customer satisfaction across your assigned set of accounts.
* Collaborate with support, product, and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs.
* Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements.
* Lead and support API Management and AI Goverance evaluations, including scoping API/AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements.
* Deliver demonstrations of Kong’s API & AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.
* Run API & AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and/or AI/agentic architectures.
* Own the technical strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals from qualification through close.
* Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy.

* Strong listener and communicator — you can confidently lead discussions with engineers, architects, and executives.
* Enthusiasm for working in a high-profile, fast-paced environment at the intersection of API and AI connectivity.

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. title: Forward Deployed Engg. - Lead
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Overview**
We are seeking a customer-focused
**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)**
to help enterprises identify, validate, design, and scale AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
As an FDE, you will operate at the intersection of
**AI consulting, solution architecture, rapid prototyping, and delivery advisory**
. You will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, platform teams, and engineering squads to transform opportunities into scalable AI solutions while balancing business value, technical feasibility, governance, and production readiness.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines
**architectural depth, hands-on technical credibility, customer engagement skills, and a pragmatic delivery mindset**
. Candidate should be comfortable engaging with business leaders, challenging architectural decisions, building rapid prototypes, and guiding solutions from experimentation through last mile adoption.
  
  
While hands-on implementation experience is important, success in this role is defined by the ability to rapidly validate business value, shape scalable solutions, and help customers move confidently from proof-of-value to enterprise adoption.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
AI Solution Architecture
  
  
You will lead the design of enterprise grade AI solutions and guide customers through architecture decisions that align with their business and technology strategies.
  
  
Key areas of focus may include:
  
  

* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Agentic AI solutions
* Multi-agent systems
* Enterprise knowledge platforms
* Conversational AI
* Intelligent automation
* Enterprise integration patterns
* AI reference architectures

Responsibilities may include:
  
  

* Defining architecture blueprints and solution patterns.
* Evaluating trade-offs across models, frameworks, and platforms.
* Guiding enterprise architects and engineering teams through design decisions.
* Establishing scalable and reusable implementation approaches.

Rapid Prototyping & Solution Validation
  
  
A core expectation of this role is the ability to validate business value quickly before significant delivery investment is made.
  
  
You will:
  
  

* Conduct discovery workshops and use-case assessments.
* Evaluate the customer's existing technology landscape and approved toolset.
* Build prototypes using available enterprise platforms and AI capabilities.
* Develop Proofs of Concept (POCs) and Proofs of Value (POVs).
* Validate technical feasibility, business value, and adoption potential.
* Define implementation roadmaps for successful prototypes.
* Partner with engineering teams to industrialize and scale approved solutions.

AI Governance & Responsible AI
  
  
You will help ensure AI solutions are designed and deployed responsibly within enterprise environments.
  
  
Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Defining AI governance approaches and guardrails.
* Embedding Responsible AI principles into solution design.
* Aligning solutions with:

+ Security requirements
+ Compliance obligations
+ Privacy standards
+ Data governance policies
+ AI risk management practices

* Supporting architecture assurance and governance reviews.

Delivery & Production Readiness
  
  
While not a pure platform engineering role, the FDE must be capable of assessing whether solutions can successfully operate at enterprise scale.
  
  
Expected areas of knowledge include:
  
  

* Production hardening
* AIOps (MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps)
* Evaluation frameworks
* Observability and monitoring
* Reliability engineering
* Scalability planning
* Cost optimization

You will:
  
  

* Challenge implementation approaches where necessary.
* Review solution readiness for production deployment.
* Provide architectural guidance on operational and support considerations.
* Help teams navigate the transition from prototype to production.

Polycloud & AI Platform Strategy
  
  
Customers operate across diverse cloud and technology environments. The FDE should be able to provide platform neutral guidance while understanding the strengths and limitations of major AI ecosystems.
  
  
Responsibilities include:

title: Applied AI Architect ( Global Customers)
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: MS Pricing & Commercial Architect Manager**
The opportunity
  
  
The objective of the role is to enable and facilitate EY in winning profitable Managed Service business through the development of appropriate pricing strategies and the creation of robust commercial and financial cases that drive optimal outcomes for both the client and EY.
  
  
The role includes the development of people, capability, reusable tools and pricing assets, and the embedding of commercial best practice, processes, knowledge and behaviours within the firm.
  
  
Your key responsibilities
  
  

* As a Pricing Architect, you’ll be responsible for providing support from “qualification to close” across all pricing, financial and commercial aspects of the largest, highest risk, most complex, strategic pursuits including the monetization approach and associated commercial terms and conditions across the full spectrum of potential business models and commercial arrangements.
* You will be expected to build trust-based relationships with peers and onshore counterparts and be instrumental in influencing decision making across internal stakeholders, contributing to positive sum outcomes that unlock client value and enhance EY revenue and margin.
* You will support activities that help draw together client and competitor intelligence (across the domains of sales, price, solution, and commercials), the value estimates (inherent and relative) of the proposed solution and innovative commercial structures to support the development of a clear, compelling proposal that aligns with the client’s willingness to pay.
* You will assist in bringing forward researched perspectives about competitor solution, pricing, and commercial positioning to be utilized as part of the win strategy to support a pricing strategy based on perceived differentiation, working across pursuit leaders, senior commercial architects, and stakeholders to achieve target.
* You will collaborate with solution architects and domain experts to align solution design to client response requirements, estimate the forecasted cost-to-serve of products, solutions, services, and transactions, integrate costing guidance and standards, and document assumptions in a concise format for deal shaping analysis, optimization, and iteration in support of key pursuit milestones.
* You will be expected to articulate the pursuit’s forecasted economics based on accounting standards and internal policies/guidelines; the competitive, commercial, and financial risks of the proposed win/pricing strategy; the integrated risk mitigation strategies; and the likely financial success and alignment of the pursuit with long term strategic plans, ensuring a compelling ROI for EY and our clients.
* As part of data quality improvement process, you will be expected to support activities to curate market and competitive intelligence across primary, secondary, and third-party research channels into an integrated ecosystem of sales, price, solution, and commercial benchmarks positioning supported and self-enabled pursuits to price with conviction, confident in our differentiated value, resulting in increased win odds and profitable growth.
* Support upfront qualification of complex MS pursuits - with particular focus on testing both parties' value proposition and designing the pricing approach for the pursuit.
* The pricing architect's contribution will include any/all of costing the solution components, development of the Client Business Case, the EY Business Case, a pricing response, contractual pricing schedules and documents, addressing client concerns/requirements and mitigating EY risks.
* Present the pursuit's EY business cases for internal approvals and may be required to interact with the client to develop and present the client's Business Case.
* Stakeholder Management is an extremely important aspect of the role.

Skills and attributes for success
  
  

* Strong business partnering skills - and a demonstrable experience of influencing commercial decisions at a senior level, through robust and persuasive analysis
* Complex data/financial modelling and ability to build compelling narratives for non-financial or non-technical audiences.
* High level of drive and ability to work independently and under pressure
* Flexibility in working with various EY stakeholders across the world and in different time zones.

To qualify for the role, you must have
  
  

* 8+ years of experience of having worked on Managed Services pricing for clients in EY and/or other organisations, fluency in alternate fee arrangements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong presentation, and client service skills
* Comfortable with presenting to senior stakeholders
* Demonstrate strong organization skills, with capability to work independently to plan structure, and execute pursuit activities

Ideally, you’ll also have
  
  

* MBA/Chartered Accountant in finance or related field
* Accountancy/financial qualification or equivalent experience with financial reporting, accounting practices and presentation of financial information
* Experience of the full lifecycle from opportunity identification through the sales process, contracting and the delivery of projects within a services organisation
* Managing the delivery of commercially complex and sensitive projects

Technologies and Tools
  
  

* Advance knowledge and hands on experience in Excel
* PowerPoint
* Word

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Forward Deployed (Value Acceleration) Consultant / Senior Consultant-2
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Software Engineering
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Forward Deployed (Value Acceleration) Consultant / Senior Consultant — Life Sciences AI sits at the intersection of customer engagement and AI-native platform delivery. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing automated business process solutions ("Blueprints") using Agentforce and Life Sciences Cloud (LSC) platform capabilities — while owning the roadmap and feature lifecycle for scalable, reusable accelerators that drive measurable value for Life Sciences customers.
  
  
You will partner closely with Life Sciences customer-facing teams, engineering, GDC delivery resources, and design to transform manual, fragmented workflows in Pharma, Biotech, and MedTech into automated, AI-native solutions. You are customer-obsessed, execution-focused, and driven by the challenge of building solutions at the speed and quality that regulated industries demand.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Roadmap and Solution Ownership
  
  

* Own the roadmap for Life Sciences process blueprints and AI-native accelerators, balancing strategic direction with near-term execution needs across the LSC portfolio
* Own the feature lifecycle for LS-specific blueprint components from discovery through launch and iteration
* Identify operational inefficiencies, manual processes, and automation opportunities across Life Sciences customer workflows — including HCP/HCO engagement, field force, clinical operations, and revenue cycle

Blueprint Design and Execution
  
  

* Partner with Life Sciences customer-facing leaders to map and analyze customer requirements for new AI-native solutions
* Build solution blueprints and workflow automations using current Agentforce and LSC platform capabilities
* Work directly with AI agents and prompting tools to design automated, enterprise-grade solutions appropriate for regulated Life Sciences environments
* Validate, test, and iterate blueprints for accuracy, consistency, and performance against LS customer acceptance criteria

Technical Specification and Delivery
  
  

* Translate high-level strategic goals and Life Sciences customer requirements into clear PRDs, user stories, and technical acceptance criteria
* Manage the product backlog, prioritize sprints, and drive consistent delivery using Agile methodologies
* Document solution architecture, demonstrations, and implementation guidelines — including Steel Thread validation in support of go-live readiness across Hub accounts

Customer and Market Research
  
  

* Conduct user interviews and quantitative analysis to understand Life Sciences customer pain points and identify accelerator opportunities
* Act as the voice of the LS customer within the Agentforce development process, feeding structured insights to Product Engineering and the Hub's product feedback loop

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with Engineering and Design to ensure technical feasibility and intuitive user experiences for Life Sciences personas
* Provide structured feedback to Product Managers on feature gaps needed to support LS-specific scalability and compliance requirements
* Support rollout and enablement of blueprint solutions across Hub teams, GDC delivery resources, and SI partners (Deloitte, Slalom, and others)
* Collaborate across the Ecosystems pillar on partner readiness and SI blueprint adoption

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Process Automation, Business Analysis, or Solutions Consulting
* Experience building or deploying external-facing products in enterprise B2B SaaS environments
* Strong understanding of business workflow mapping, process modeling, and process improvement methodologies, with demonstrated application in Life Sciences or a regulated industry
* Proven experience translating business requirements into structured automated workflows or solutions
* Hands-on technical experience with automation tools, workflow builders, AI prompting, or low/no-code platforms
* Excellent spoken and written communication with ability to present complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical Life Sciences stakeholders
* Proven ability to collaborate with virtual and global cross-functional teams including engineering, design, and customer success
* Rigor and consistency in managing product backlogs and executing delivery

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Life Sciences commercial operations, HCP/HCO engagement, field force automation, or clinical operations technology
* Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud (LSC), Agentforce, or comparable CRM/AI platforms in regulated industries
* Experience with prompt design or agent-based automation solutions
* Familiarity with the Salesforce platform ecosystem (APIs, platform services, Data Cloud)
* Understanding of Life Sciences regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., GxP, HIPAA, GDPR) as they relate to CRM and workflow automation
* Experience with network effects and cold start strategies for enterprise B2B solutions
* Lean, Six Sigma, or related process improvement certification
* Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech industry background strongly preferred

Success Metrics
  
  

* Efficiency improvements and measurable reduction in manual work for Life Sciences customers
* Blueprint adoption, usage outcomes, and business value delivered (e.g., cost savings, field force productivity, HCP engagement improvement)
* Quality and clarity of roadmap feedback influencing LSC and Agentforce platform improvements
* Time-to-value and scalability of LS-specific solution deployments
* Customer satisfaction and depth of engagement with deployed solutions across the LSC portfolio

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

title: Senior Sales Engineer
description:
**Senior Sales Engineer**

* Department: Sales
* Job Location: Bangalore
* US Shift Timings: US EST (6 PM to 3 AM IST)
* Reporting to: Director - Sales Engineering

***About Us:***

Zluri (an Infotech company) is an identity security platform built for autonomous enterprises. It gives organizations complete visibility and control over human and non-human identities across SaaS, cloud, and on-premises systems. By automating access governance, lifecycle management, and security enforcement, Zluri eliminates manual identity operations and reduces risk. Security and IT teams can ensure the right access for the right identities at the right time while enabling the enterprise to operate faster, safer, and with greater autonomy. As part of Infotech, Zluri brings its application discovery and identity governance capabilities to CIO Analytics, Infotech’s API-driven advisory platform

***Role Summary:***

We are looking for a Senior Sales Engineer to join our growing sales team. In this role, you will act as a key technical advisor and product advocate for our solutions. You will work closely with the sales team, prospects, and customers to demonstrate the value of Zluri’s platform and help them understand how our product can solve their business challenges.

***What you’ll do:***

* Champion and advocate for Application Discovery and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA). Dedicate time to learning, teaching, and promoting the value of Application Discovery and IGA while mastering how our software solves critical challenges. Work collaboratively with the sales team to create, move, and close pipeline opportunities. Your efforts will contribute to the region's success by helping meet targets and expanding market presence.
* Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical discussions, conduct product demonstrations, and facilitate solution design sessions to engage potential clients.
* Collaborate with partners and distributors to offer enablement, facilitate shared learning, and work together to close business opportunities.
* Dive deep to understand customer business needs, challenges, and objectives, recommending tailored technical solutions that precisely address their requirements.
* Conduct comprehensive technical presentations and deliver hands-on Proof of Value (POV) sessions, ensuring prospective clients clearly understand the value provided. Respond effectively to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Serve as a technical expert by articulating the Zluri platform's architecture, integrations, and security features to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support the Customer Success Management (CSM) team during onboarding to ensure smooth implementation and successful adoption of the Zluri platform.
* Document key frameworks and processes to enable rapid scaling and increased operational efficiency.
* Engage with product and engineering teams to provide valuable customer feedback, which can influence strategic product roadmap decisions.
* Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in Application discovery, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and cybersecurity.
* Offer training and knowledge-sharing sessions to internal teams, keeping them informed about product updates and new features.

***What You Will Bring***
*:*

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Network Security, or a related technical field.
* 4 to 7 years of experience as a Systems Engineer, Security Engineer, or in a similar technical role.
* Startup experience is a plus.
* Proven expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM) or specifically in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) is highly preferred.
* Deep understanding of Active Directory environments, Single Sign-On (SSO), federation protocols, cloud identity services, and federated applications. Familiarity with SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and related identity federation technologies.
* Strong foundation in cybersecurity principles, network security, and IAM/IGA solution architecture.
* A "build your own territory" mindset that supports and empowers sales and pre-sales teams. You proactively identify opportunities, help generate leads, and support deal closure by providing technical expertise and strategic insights.
* Experience working closely with channel partners, supporting their sales cycles, and successfully enabling partner-led deals. Leverage partner relationships effectively to create new opportunities and help them win.
* Ability to build and maintain executive-level relationships (C-level), demonstrating trust and strategic influence across customer organizations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce.com, with an active personal network in your territory that you can leverage to generate new opportunities.
* Self-motivated, relentless in pursuit of new opportunities, and passionate about closing high-value deals with an ambitious drive.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex sales challenges creatively and resourcefully.
* Thrives in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment, resourceful, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies, solutions, and industry best practices.
* Positive attitude, team-player mindset, and willingness to share success strategies and best practices with others.

**Empowering Diversity, Championing Inclusivity**

Zluri values diversity and inclusivity, fostering an environment where every individual feels welcome and respected. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing fair consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Sales Engineer – B2B Sales
description:
**Internship Opportunity**

**Company:**
CertifyMe (Tech99 Innovations Private Limited)

**Location:**
Whitefield, Bengaluru

**Work Mode:**
Full-time | Work from Office

**Experience:**
Freshers / Students / Recent Graduates

**Preferred Background:**
B.E./B.Tech – Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related engineering disciplines

About CertifyMe

CertifyMe is a digital credential infrastructure platform that helps universities, enterprises, certification bodies, governments, and training organizations issue, manage, verify, and analyze trusted digital credentials at scale.

Built on open standards including
**Open Badges 3.0, W3C Verifiable Credentials, and Comprehensive Learner Records (CLR)**
, CertifyMe enables organizations to create portable, verifiable, interoperable, and AI-ready credentials.

The platform connects credentials, skills, achievements, learning pathways, and experiences into trusted digital records that can be verified and shared globally.

With
**5,000+ institutions, 1M+ learner wallets, and a presence across 144+ countries**
, CertifyMe supports the complete credential lifecycle—from credential creation and bulk issuance to digital wallets, verification, analytics, and integrations.

Our vision is simple:
**Make every achievement verifiable, every skill visible, and every credential meaningful.**

About the Internship

We are looking for enthusiastic and ambitious engineering students and recent graduates to join CertifyMe as
**Sales Engineer – B2B Sales Interns**
.

This is an opportunity for engineering graduates who are interested in technology, business, communication, and customer engagement and want to explore a career in technical sales and business development.

CertifyMe offers a technical SaaS platform serving universities, enterprises, certification bodies, and training organizations globally.

Your primary responsibility will be to research potential customers, identify decision-makers, initiate conversations, and generate qualified B2B sales leads.

You will engage with prospects through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other professional channels.

You will also work directly with the founders and sales team, gaining practical exposure to customer discovery, technical product demonstrations, opportunity management, and deal conversion.

**This is not a software development internship. It is a hands-on opportunity to combine your engineering background with business development and technology sales.**

Key Responsibilities1. B2B Lead Generation & Prospect Research

* Research and identify potential customers across universities, colleges, enterprises, certification bodies, and training organizations.

4. Sales Development & Deal Conversion

* Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, quotations, and follow-up communications.

* Understand customer objections and help address concerns.

* Maintain follow-up schedules and an organized sales pipeline.
* Prepare regular activity and lead-generation reports.
* Share customer feedback, market insights, and competitor information with the team.

Who Can Apply?
