* Currently pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related engineering disciplines.
* Freshers are welcome. Prior sales experience is not mandatory.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Confidence in speaking with new people and initiating professional conversations.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and explain them clearly.
* Interest in SaaS products, technology, business development, and customer engagement.
* Willingness to make outbound calls, research prospects, send emails, and conduct follow-ups.
* Good analytical, research, and organizational skills.
* Self-motivated, proactive, persistent, and comfortable working towards measurable targets.
* Willingness to work from our Whitefield, Bengaluru office.

**Additional advantages (not mandatory):**

* Participation in college clubs, entrepreneurship cells, or student leadership activities.
* Experience in organizing events, sponsorship outreach, or partnerships.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, CRM tools, and professional email communication.
* Interest in startups, SaaS, and international business.

What You Will Learn

This internship is designed to provide practical exposure to the complete B2B technology sales process.

You will learn:

* B2B prospecting and international lead generation.
* Identifying target accounts and business decision-makers.
* Selling technical SaaS products to universities and enterprises.
* Understanding digital credentials, Open Badges, Verifiable Credentials, and related technologies.
* Engaging with senior institutional and business stakeholders.
* Conducting customer discovery conversations.
* Preparing and delivering product demonstrations.
* Handling objections and managing sales follow-ups.
* Preparing commercial proposals and understanding pricing.
* Participating in negotiations and supporting deal closures.
* Using CRM and sales automation tools.
* Understanding how a global SaaS company builds its customer base.

You will work closely with the founders and gain practical exposure to real customer interactions and business opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

During the internship, success will be measured by your ability to:

* Identify relevant organizations and decision-makers.
* Consistently generate qualified B2B leads.
* Initiate meaningful conversations with prospective customers.
* Convert prospects into discovery meetings and product demonstrations.
* Maintain disciplined follow-ups and accurate CRM records.
* Develop a strong understanding of CertifyMe's product and value proposition.
* Contribute to progressing sales opportunities and supporting deal closures.

Career Opportunity

High-performing interns may be considered for a full-time opportunity with CertifyMe based on performance, business requirements, and demonstrated capabilities.

Potential career progression:

**Sales Engineering Intern → Associate Sales Engineer → Sales Engineer → Enterprise Sales / Business Development**

Why Join CertifyMe?

* Work with a global SaaS product serving organizations across 144+ countries.
* Work directly with the founders and learn how technology businesses acquire customers.

* Build practical skills at the intersection of engineering, technology, and business.
* Participate in actual customer meetings, product demonstrations, and sales opportunities.

Who Should Apply?

If you are an engineering student or recent graduate who enjoys technology, communicating with people, understanding business problems, and exploring how technology products are sold, this internship is for you.

commissioning Casambi networks onsite, supporting partners and customers after handover, and backing the sales team with demos and system design. automation, smart-home or electrical

commissioning

Commissioning

* Run technical demos and answer specifier questions.

After-sales support

* Be first-line support for Bangalore partners and customers by phone, WhatsApp and remote session.
* Diagnose site issues flicker, dimming curves, mesh range, sensor behaviour, gateway

connectivity and fix them on site when needed.

* Log issues and resolutions, and escalate product faults to the Mumbai team and manufacturers.

Training and knowledge

* Help keep CasaNode's commissioning checklists and troubleshooting guides up to date.
* Support Kodaa One installs in Control4 homes as that line grows.

Must have

* Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics or Instrumentation.
* Working knowledge of Casambi, or a clear aptitude to learn it fast. Casambi is the core platform; no other control protocol is required. Solid grasp of LED drivers, dimming, wiring and basic electrical safety.
* Comfortable configuring systems through mobile apps and laptops; basic networking (Wi-Fi, IP, routers).
* Methodical troubleshooting and clear site documentation, plus the confidence to handle

customer-facing sales conversations.

Good spoken English plus Kannada and/or Hindi, to work with electricians on site.

* Own two-wheeler and willingness to travel to sites.

**What we offer**

* Formal training and certification on Casambi, plus Kodaa product training.
* Work on some of the most advanced wireless lighting projects in the region.
* A small team where your feedback shapes our products and processes.
* Travel and site allowances.

* **Working Hours:**
  10:00 AM to 6:00 PM
* **Working Days:**
  6 days a week, with the 1st and 3rd Saturdays off

title: Sales Manager – Energy Upgrade
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.

In this role, the Energy Upgrades Manager will lead national EU strategy and execution across the building, manufacturing and Data Center sector, driving EU business growth, expanding key account penetration, and promoting DE and digital solutions. The role owns the full commercial lifecycle—from opportunity development to service and parts—while enabling cross-functional collaboration to accelerate innovation and sustain long-term revenue growth.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Energy Upgrade Leadership**

* Lead the Energy Upgrade strategy, driving adoption of high-efficiency pumping, HVAC modernization, and digital optimization solutions. Region coverage is north and east of India.
* Identify and prioritize major Energy Upgrades (Retrofits), optimization, and decarbonization opportunities across industrial and data center facilities.
* Develop upgrade roadmaps with clear energy-saving, carbon-reduction, and ROI targets aligned with customer sustainability goals.
* Position Armstrong’s Digital and portfolio solution as core enablers of measurable performance improvement.

**Technical Assessment & Solution Design**

* Conduct energy audits, system performance assessments, and baseline studies to determine savings potential and upgrade scope.
* Design technical solutions for retrofit-EU projects—including pump right-sizing, hydronic optimization, variable-speed conversions and digitalisations
* Build strong techno-commercial proposals highlighting lifecycle cost benefits, payback analysis, and performance guarantees
* Ensure alignment with industry standards, safety norms, and green Industry requirements.

**Energy Solutions Development & Market Engagement**

* Identifying high-probability upgrade opportunities and converting them into secured orders.
* Create and monitor annual Energy Upgrade Sales Plans focused on target sectors, key accounts,

and strategic customers.

* Provide technical advocacy and thought leadership in customer meetings, consultant interactions, and sustainability forums
* Drive awareness and adoption of energy-efficient equipment, digital monitoring solutions, and long-term service offerings.

**Key Account Management**

* Engage deeply with facility/Utility owners, sustainability leaders, and consultants to influence upgrade decisions early in the cycle.
* Develop Key Account Plans for strategic customers to maximize wallet share, cross-selling, and repeat Energy Upgrade business.
* Manage upgrades across all stages—assessment, proposal, technical review, negotiation, and closure—ensuring high win rates.
* Continuously refine account strategies, forecasts, and opportunity pipelines based on customer priorities and site insights.

**Project Governance & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinate with Project Engineering, Service, and Digital teams to ensure seamless delivery of upgrade projects.
* Oversee measurement & verification (M&V) using digital tools, validating energy savings and performance commitments.
* Work closely with Offering Teams and factories for product planning, delivery schedules, and configuration support.
* Drive customer satisfaction through proactive communication, issue resolution, and on-time project completion

**What We’re Looking For**

To thrive in this role, you should bring:

**Education and Experience**

* BE/B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering; MBA preferred.
* 8 years of experience in HVAC, pumping systems, Fluid Flow/Hydronics and Heat Transfer
* Min 5 years of Demonstrated experience in Energy Upgrades (Retrofits) of Chiller Plant Rooms.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC plant rooms, energy optimization and Retrofits methodologies
* Experience managing regional sales teams and channel ecosystems.
* BEE Certifications (if any) are an added advantage.

**Technical Skills**

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and AI tools.

* A self-starter attitude with the ability to work independently.
* Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to manage conflicts within various organizational structures.
* Out of the box thinker.
* Bringing in the culture of Teamwork among the peers.
* Proficient with CRM tools like Infor CRM, Sales force etc.
* Able to read through the CAD drawings other engineering tools to Understand and work on the projects.

**Soft Skills**

* The capability to simplify complex problems, conduct root cause analysis, and provide clear, well-thought-out recommendations.
* Openness to learn.
* Team-oriented leadership skills with a proactive approach.
* An ability to communicate openly and authentically in all situations.

**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?**

By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid-flow technology while upholding Armstrong's commitment to sustainability. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

This is a full-time opportunity where you will work representing SkyBlue Cinematix, supporting in-film and out-of-film brand integrations, product placements (PPL), brand associations, and sponsorships across a diverse slate of films.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you. Please apply and explore this exciting opportunity with us.
  
  
**About SkyBlue Media Group**
We are an international media company with operations across Malaysia, Dubai, and India, specializing in creating impactful brand experiences across diverse media platforms. Over the past 15+ years, we have established a strong reputation for innovation, scale, and effectiveness in the OOH and entertainment marketing space.
  
  
Our Markets & Expertise

Our strong partnerships in cinema, retail, and outdoor environments ensure unmatched visibility and brand recall.

If you’ve ever seen your favourite superstar sipping a cola, speaking on a phone, or enjoying a snack on screen — know that it wasn’t by chance, it was by choice. Your choice. You were the one instrumental in making sure the talent showcased the brand, and in closing the deal that brought that brand into the heart of the story.
  
  
At Sky Blue Media, we believe in creating these moments with purpose. As Sales, Business Development & Brand Partnerships resource, you will play a decisive role in shaping how brands appear in films and beyond. * Track the pulse of entertainment trends, OTT innovation, and consumer engagement formats to keep our offerings unmatched.

**Ideal Profile**

title: Performance Marketing
description:
**About ShopOS**

We’re building
**ShopOS—AI agents powering the ecommerce stack.**
Already past product-market fit, we’re scaling how brands use AI to create, launch, and grow.

Backed by
**Binny Bansal**
and built by founders with successful exits to
**Flipkart and Polygon Labs**
, we bring together technology, creativity, and commerce.

**Watch: ShopOS from the founders’ lens**

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a
**Performance Marketing Manager**
to plan, run, and improve paid campaigns for D2C brands and enterprise clients.

You’ll own campaign performance across
**Meta and Google Ads**
, working closely with creative, customer success, and product teams to turn business goals into acquisition strategies. From media planning and creative testing to tracking and optimisation, you’ll be responsible for understanding what drives results and where to invest next.

This role suits someone from a
**performance marketing agency, D2C brand, or ecommerce business**
who has managed budgets, worked directly with clients, and taken ownership of campaign outcomes.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Campaign strategy and execution:**
  Plan, launch, and optimise campaigns across Meta and Google, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and remarketing.
* **Budgets and business outcomes:**
  Manage spend and pacing against agreed revenue, acquisition, ROAS, and CAC targets.
* **Creative testing:**
  Work with designers, video creators, and copywriters to test hooks, formats, messaging, and offers. Turn performance insights into clear creative briefs.
* **Measurement and tracking:**
  Ensure conversion tracking works across ad platforms, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and ecommerce platforms, coordinating technical support where needed.
* **Funnel improvements:**
  Identify gaps across ads, landing pages, product pages, and checkout, and work with teams to improve conversion.
* **Client communication:**
  Lead performance reviews, explain results clearly, and recommend next steps based on data.
* **AI and automation:**
  Use AI for research, reporting, creative analysis, and campaign workflows while keeping control of budgets and decisions.
* **Reporting and learning:**
  Maintain dashboards and testing records so the team understands what worked, what didn’t, and what to try next.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **3–7 years of hands-on performance marketing experience**
  , ideally at an agency or ecommerce business.
* Strong working knowledge of
  **Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads**
  , with direct responsibility for campaign setup, optimisation, and budgets.
* A track record of improving acquisition efficiency or revenue. Be ready to discuss the budgets you managed, results achieved, and your contribution.
* Understanding of
  **ROAS, CAC, CPA, AOV, conversion rates, LTV, and marketing efficiency ratio (MER)**
  —and how they connect to business profitability.
* Experience testing creatives, audiences, offers, and landing pages using clear hypotheses.
* Familiarity with
  **GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, product feeds, and conversion tracking**
  .
* Ability to interpret attribution differences and assess performance beyond platform-reported numbers.
* Confidence managing client expectations and presenting recommendations.
* Strong spreadsheet skills, attention to detail, and ownership of follow-through.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with fashion, beauty, lifestyle, retail, or other D2C categories.
* Familiarity with Shopify, Merchant Center, Meta Conversions API, and dashboarding tools.
* Exposure to retention marketing and how paid acquisition connects with repeat purchases.
* Experience using AI-generated images and videos in paid campaigns.
* Experience scaling campaigns across multiple accounts or markets.

**What Success Looks Like**

Campaigns launch with reliable tracking, clear targets, and disciplined budget management. Creative tests produce useful learning, performance issues are addressed early, and clients understand how their spend contributes to business growth.

**Why Join ShopOS**

* Work where AI, creative production, and performance marketing come together.
* Help shape how we test and scale campaigns for ecommerce brands.
* Collaborate closely with founders, creative teams, and product specialists.
* Take ownership in a team that values clear communication, experimentation, and accountability.
* Competitive salary and health and wellness benefits.

**Build early, own more, go further.**

title: Senior Commercialization Specialist, US Market - Renewable Energy
description:

Enfinity Global is a purpose-driven company focused on making a positive impact on the planet by helping companies, governments, and individuals transition to a carbon-free and sustainable economy. Our role as a leading IPP is to develop, finance, build, operate, and own decarbonization assets in the long term in Europe, Asia, and the Americas through our offices in the USA, Spain, Italy, UK, Netherlands, India, and Japan.

 Our team of over 400+ Enfiniters comprises seasoned finance professionals, as well as experienced project developers and operators with extensive industry experience across all stages of the project life cycle. We pride ourselves on being creative and innovative solution providers to our customers and partners.

**Job Summary:**

Enfinity Global is looking for a Senior Specialist- Commercialization to join our Commercial Operations team and drive the commercialization of utility-scale solar PV and battery energy storage (BESS) projects across our US platform. The role owns the end-to-end preparation, coordination and submission of RFP and bid packages, supports PPA and offtake structuring, manages counterparty interactions, and tracks developments across US power markets. Based in our Hyderabad office and working as an integral part of the Enfinity Americas team, this role sits at the intersection of origination, commercial strategy, and project execution, and is suited for someone seeking direct ownership of live deals and growth at the leading edge of the energy transition. We expect this candidate to actively leverage AI and automation to improve the accuracy and efficiency of our commercial processes.

The role works closely with US-based stakeholders and counterparties, and requires a working schedule that is well aligned with US business hours.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Bid and RFP Management**

o   Lead the preparation of complete RFP, RFI and bid packages for utilities, C&I and corporate offtakers, from bid/no-bid assessment through final submission.

o   Conduct detailed reviews of solicitation documents to identify:

§  Scope, eligibility and qualification criteria

§  Submission requirements and deadlines

§  Evaluation methodology and scoring

§  Key commercial, technical and contractual nuances

o   Own the bid calendar and tracker across multiple concurrent solicitations, maintaining clear visibility on status, deadlines and open items.

o   Ensure every submission is compliant, accurate, internally approved and submitted on time.

o   Manage post-submission activity, including clarifications, shortlisting, best-and-final offers and handover to the negotiation team.

**Counterparty Management**

o   Act as the primary point of contact with utilities, offtakers, RFP administrators and independent evaluators throughout the bid process.

o   Manage bidder registrations, Q&A and clarification requests, and portal submissions.

o   Build and maintain professional relationships with counterparties and keep a clear record of all correspondence.

**Cross-functional Coordination**

o   Coordinate inputs from internal teams and stakeholders, including:

§  Finance and Capital Formation (pricing, financial models, credit support)

You will partner closely with Life Sciences customer-facing teams, engineering, GDC delivery resources, and design to transform manual, fragmented workflows in Pharma, Biotech, and MedTech into automated, AI-native solutions. You are customer-obsessed, execution-focused, and driven by the challenge of building solutions at the speed and quality that regulated industries demand.

title: SLIMS Technical Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic, and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications, and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek - so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com.
  
  
**OpenLab Sync (formerly SLIMS)**
is a platform that allows supervision of all stages a sample follows to the result.
**OpenLab Sync**
captures information about the sample, requests for measurements, and follows its entire workflow through the lab, supervising manual operating procedures, automated instrument steps, and calculations until the final report.
  
  
If you decide to join our team, you will be working closely with our clients. The tasks to be performed are multifaceted, and a creative mind is needed to be able to identify and implement customer solutions and improve the quality of life in the lab environment. Want to learn more about OpenLab Sync? Visit OpenLab Sync for more information and even some videos.
  
  
This role is ideal for candidates who combine hands-on laboratory experience with technical software implementation skills. Successful candidates typically have experience working in laboratory informatics, scientific software, LIMS, ELN, LES, or laboratory automation environments.
  
  
As an
**Application Engineer**
part of the Customer Success team in India, you will support our valued customers across our Lab informatics product solutions. This role offers you the opportunity to travel and explore a variety of labs, so it is vital to have an appetite for continuously learning about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. In addition, applying communication skills, creativity, and a can-do approach is vital.
  
  
**Your main responsibilities will be:**

* Analyze customers' needs and translate them into OpenLab Sync workflows
* Configure the OpenLab Sync platform to match the lab's requirements
* Build plugins for connecting instruments or displaying custom forms or portals
* Act as the customer voice to influence future product design to meet customer needs
* Script a lab's in-silico tools into our integration framework

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has a keen interest in Lab Informatics and is seeking a new challenge. A curious individual who is driven to learn and has the desire to understand and solve customer problems to deliver customer success will succeed in this position.
  
  
**Qualifications**
We are looking for motivated individuals with the following background:
  
  

* University Degree in Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Scientific Informatics, or a related discipline (or alternatively solid relevant experience in this application engineering field)
* Hands-on laboratory experience in analytical chemistry, biobanks, pharma, biopharma, genomics, NGS, Academia, etc.
* Preferred experience with LIMS, ELN, LES, SDMS, CDS, laboratory automation, scientific software, or laboratory workflow management systems.
* You have knowledge of programming languages such as Java or Python with proven coding skills
* Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, laboratory users, or cross-functional project teams is highly desirable.
* Full proficiency in English.

On a personal level, you possess great
**problem solving**
/
**analytical skills, and**
you are
**eager to learn**
about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. You have
**communication/interpersonal skills**
to interact at various levels, and you strive to provide excellent customer support. You enjoy both
**working within a team**
and
**autonomously**
.
  
  
We will make sure
**you get all the training and development opportunities you need to become the best in your field!**

This job has a full time weekly schedule.

description:

**Job Title : Strategy Manager**
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
: EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. * reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation

* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:
  
  

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 10+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* Min. of 10+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

The following are preferred, but not required:
  
  

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Our Purpose**

India is in the middle of an extraordinary AI revolution, powered by a young, tech-savvy generation and visionary leaders who see the future in code and creativity. Across industries—from healthcare to finance to education—AI adoption is accelerating at record speed. Over 90% of business leaders are now reimagining their processes through AI, while developers and students across the country are building tools that are transforming the way India works and lives.

 

At the heart of this movement stands 
**Neysa, India’s trusted AI Acceleration Cloud Provider**

.

Neysa exists to democratize AI. Built in India for the world, Neysa carries the credibility of a leadership team that created Netmagic (now part of NTT Data). With a fully integrated system and deep local market insight, Neysa helps organizations across sectors confidently adopt, accelerate, govern, and scale AI.

 

**The Future of AI, Built on Trust and Expertise.**
 Hence, Neysa understands and builds 
the Home for Your AI
.

**The Opportunity: Champion the Growth of AI Acceleration**

Join us at the forefront of AI innovation, where you will deal with customers, architect modern AI and cloud solutions, and help accelerate their journey toward intelligent, automated enterprises. Your expertise will directly shape strategic customer outcomes.

Through technical workshops, deep-dive discussions, and hands-on PoCs, you’ll validate real-world value while guiding customers through their transformation journey and influencing key buying decisions.

* Work closely with Product & Engineering to share feedback and influence roadmap decisions.

**Core Competencies**

* Hands-on experience with LLM-powered enterprise apps (chatbots, copilots, AI search, automation).
* Experience with GPU-accelerated workloads and inference optimization.
* Ability to design scalable cloud-native architectures with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of vector databases, embeddings, and search optimization.
* Proven track record supporting enterprises through complex AI/Cloud cycles.
* Experience collaborating with engineering and product teams.
* Ability to design custom infrastructure solutions aligned with customer environments.

title: Presales Consultant
description:
**Position**

**Pre-Sales Manager**

**Experience**

**7-12 Years**

**Grade**

**T3XX - Senior Manager / AVP**

**Location**

**Mumbai**

**About FuEL**

**FuEL**
is
**Intellect's Flagship program**
designed to develop the next generation of transformation leaders for the global Fintech/Insuretech industry.

Created for high-potential professionals, the program equips participants to move beyond operational excellence and become trusted advisors who help financial institutions reimagine business models, accelerate digital & AI transformation and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Your journey begins with an immersive four-week learning experience covering Digital Transformation, Product Immersion, Design Thinking and AI-led Banking Innovation. You'll gain deep exposure to Intellect's award-winning banking platforms across Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Transaction Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth and Insurance, while working alongside some of the industry's foremost banking, product and technology experts.

Explore more at: www.intellectdesign.com

**The Opportunity**

The best presales leaders don't just respond to RFPs—they shape how clients think about their business challenges before a competitive process even begins. This role is for that kind of leader.

As
**Presales Manager**
, you will own the solutioning agenda across complex, high-value deal pursuits—bringing together deep banking domain expertise, strategic thinking, consultative selling, and genuine individual and integrated product mastery to drive measurable customer value andwin business that matters. You will be leading efforts to drive new sales, cross sell, and upsell at Intellect’s Key relationships engaging at the CXO level and solution with authority, and build the presales capability that turns market opportunities into signed engagements.

You will engage with business leaders across Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, Transaction Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, and Wealth Management to understand strategic objectives, diagnose business challenges, and translate them into differentiated transformation opportunities.

The role requires the ability to ask the right questions, challenge conventional thinking, bring external market perspectives, and guide customers from problem identification to solution vision.

You should be comfortable in working in a networked org design and in taking ownership of the outcome therefore to pool the best resources and solution that OneIntellect has to offer to its customers. This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a boardroom solutioning session as they are shaping product strategy conversations with internal roadmap teams.

**Role Definition**

The Pre-Sales Manager primarily drives the early-stage sales cycle by actively shaping and qualifying pipeline opportunities through discovery and validation. They are responsible for translating customer requirements into compelling value propositions and demonstrating product value, while providing critical support in later pipeline stages to convert opportunities into successful deals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Prospect Understanding**

Engage with banking executives, business heads, product owners, and operations leaders to understand strategic priorities. Analyse banking business models, revenue drivers, operational challenges, and competitive pressures. Translate market trends into actionable transformation opportunities. Actively validate critical deal qualifiers—including Need/Problem, Decision Makers, Customer’s Timeline, Customer’s Budget runway, and Proposal intent to successfully graduate opportunities.

**2. Consultative Value Selling**

Create Business Value to shape opportunities, influence decisions and improve win probability. Ability to articulate measurable business outcomes, ROI, and value propositions aligned to customer objectives. Help banks rethink customer journeys, operating models, and product strategies.

**3. Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops**

Conduct high-quality product demonstrations, discovery workshops, proof-of-concept sessions, technical presentations, and solution walkthroughs for prospective clients aligned to their business needs. Ensure demo is aligned to use cases to prospect’s requirements and perform Demo Diagnostic

**4. RFP/RFI and Bid Support**

Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, and proposal documents. Ensure that responses are accurate, complete, compelling, and aligned with the customer’s stated requirements.

**5. Solutioning and Proposal Development**

Design tailored high quality solution propositions using the company’s product capabilities, platform strengths, implementation approach, and domain expertise. Support the creation of scope documents, solution architecture inputs, effort estimates, implementation plans, timelines, assumptions, exclusions, and commercial inputs. Ensure that the proposed solution is practical, differentiated, and aligned to the customer’s needs.

**6. Coordination with Product, Engineering and Delivery Teams**

Work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Delivery, Implementation, and Support teams to validate solution feasibility, effort assumptions, customisation needs, integration approach, dependencies, and delivery risks.

**7. Sales Enablement**

Equip the Sales team with product collateral, demo scripts, solution notes, competitive insights, objection-handling points, customer-specific messaging, and proof points to support effective selling.

**8. Market and Customer Feedback Loop**

Capture feedback from prospects, clients, partners, competitive situations, demonstrations, and RFPs, and share structured insights with Product teams for roadmap, positioning, and solution improvement.

**9. Deal Conversion Support**

Actively drive the early-stage sales cycle by shaping and graduating qualified opportunities. Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure that the proposed solution is credible, client-specific, implementable, and capable of supporting successful deal closure.

**10. Knowledge Management**

Maintain updated value proposition product decks, reusable proposal content, case studies, standard responses, FAQs, and solution artefacts to improve pre-sales productivity and consistency.

**11. Transition to Delivery**

Support the handover from Sales to Delivery after deal closure by ensuring that the agreed scope, solution commitments, assumptions, risks, and client expectations are clearly documented and communicated.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Extensive experience in the BFSI industry, with a strong track record in Presales, Solution Consulting, Product Consulting, or other customer-facing roles within banking, financial services, or fintech organizations.
* Deep domain expertise in one or more banking business areas, with the ability to understand customer needs, analyse business challenges, and design differentiated, practical, and commercially viable solution propositions.
* Proven experience leading complex sales pursuits, including customer discovery, executive workshops, product demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to articulate product value, competitive differentiation, implementation strategy, and business outcomes, translating product capabilities into compelling customer-specific solutions.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience preparing solution proposals, scope documents, effort estimates, implementation plans, commercial inputs, and customer-facing collateral to support strategic business opportunities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence CXOs, business leaders, technical teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders across the sales lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to capture customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and emerging industry insights, leveraging them to strengthen product positioning, solution offerings, and continuous improvement.
* Proven success in enabling high-performing sales organizations through reusable solution assets, demo environments, knowledge repositories, and best practices, while ensuring a seamless transition from Sales to Delivery and consistently driving successful customer outcomes.

**Why This Role**

You will be operating at the forefront of banking transformation—where market strategy meets client needs, and where the quality of solutioning directly influences business success. You will have the opportunity, authority, and mandate to build a high-performing presales function that not only nurtures opportunities but also helps create them. If you're looking for a senior leadership role where your expertise, customer relationships, and strategic judgment can shape outcomes and drive meaningful business impact, this is the opportunity.

title: Strategic Account manager
description:

* Apply knowledge of use cases and Red Hat’s key offering value proposition to identify and act upon opportunities to guide upsell, cross-sell, and renewals across the Red Hat portfolio while deepening penetration within accounts
* Orchestrate solution architects, specialist teams, Customer Success team, and industry experts to align Red Hat’s use cases to client needs, managing end to end sales to develop solutions that deliver business value
* Coordinate support from specialist solutions architects, sales solutions specialists, and industry experts to manage end to end sales and deliver customer value

* Collaborate with the Customer Success team to co-develop success and growth plans, understanding how the customer derives value from Red Hat’s solutions to support expansion and retention and ensure that Red Hat meets or exceeds the customer success criteria
* Engage partners where appropriate to strengthen Red Hat’s customer value proposition

**What You Will Bring**

* Excellent leadership and communication skills with the ability to engage a diverse set of stakeholders in a matrixed organization and guide accountability within the account team
* Strategic orientation and value engineering skills to position and sell solutions to meet the customer needs and build business cases around return on investment (ROI) and total cost of ownership (TCO)
* Solid understanding of FSI business, industry trends, competitive landscape, and Red Hat differentiators and value proposition
* Ability to articulate the hybrid cloud story, the value of Red Hat’s solutions, and Red Hat’s differentiation in one-on-ones with key customer stakeholders
* Ability to cultivate long-term relationships and develop internal advocates across the customer organization, including IT and related business functions
* Proven experience selling complex IT solutions to large organizations within the region and to multiple decision makers

# LI-CS1
  
  
**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) portfolio is focused on advancing patient care through innovative pacing therapies, including the Micra Leadless Pacemaker system. This role supports market development, therapy adoption, and commercial growth by partnering with Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, and healthcare institutions to expand access to leadless pacing technology. The position plays a critical role in physician engagement, clinical education, key account management, and territory growth across assigned markets.
  
  
This role is based in Mumbai, India and follows a Flex work arrangement. Travel of approximately 35-40% is required to support customer engagement, therapy awareness programs, account management activities, and clinical case support across the assigned territory.
  
  
**Job Description Field**
The Area Manager is responsible for driving adoption of Micra Leadless Pacemaker therapy within the assigned territory by building strong clinical and commercial relationships with healthcare professionals and key stakeholders. The role combines sales execution, market development, clinical engagement, and account management to support business growth while enhancing patient access to innovative cardiac rhythm management therapies.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Drive achievement of sales targets and business objectives for the Cardiac Rhythm Management portfolio within the assigned territory.
* Engage Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, and other healthcare professionals to support adoption of Micra Leadless Pacemaker therapy.
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key opinion leaders, distributors, hospitals, and healthcare institutions.
* Conduct physician education, therapy awareness, and patient engagement programs to increase understanding and utilization of leadless pacing therapies.
* Support clinical discussions and provide case support during procedures in Operating Theatre (OT) and Catheterization Laboratory (Cath Lab) settings, as required.
* Identify growth opportunities through territory planning, account analysis, market assessment, and competitive intelligence gathering.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Marketing, Research and Development, and Operations to communicate customer feedback and market insights.
* Maintain accurate sales reporting, territory documentation, training completion, and compliance with business unit requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience

title: Senior Solution Architect - SAP S/4HANA
description:
**Title:**
Senior Solution Architect, Pre-sales, SAP S/4HANA

**Location:**
India

**Reports to:**
VP SAP S/4HANA Business

**Works with:**
Global Sales leaders, SAP account teams and Acuiti delivery

**Start:**
Immediate

**Who We are:**

Acuiti Labs is an SAP Endorsed Partner with a strong reputation in SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management). We help subscription, usage and consumption based businesses modernise how they monetise, bill and recognise revenue.

We are now launching a dedicated SAP S/4HANA business as a new growth engine. It will operate as a start-up within Acuiti Labs: entrepreneurial and fast moving, with the backing of an established partner's delivery capability, client base, SAP relationships and global footprint.

This is a rare chance to join an SAP practice as one of its founding

members and help shape how it wins in the market. Please visit our website.

https://www.acuitilabs.com/

* ***Most Innovative Companies in The UK, 2024***
* **Great Place to Work® Certified™ (2022 to Present)**

**What we believe in:**

We take pride in having a diverse and talented workforce spread across various geographical locations. We are a gender-neutral organisation and we strongly believe in Diversity and Inclusion. Our core values include:

* **Excellence**
* **Integrity**
* **Learning**
* **Organizational pride**
* **Respect**

**The Role:**

Acuiti Labs is hiring a senior solution architect to lead pre-sales for our new SAP S/4HANA business. You will bring broad S/4HANA solution expertise; good experience in SAP Finance will be a strong advantage.

**The mandate:**

Your job is to help win S/4HANA business. Working alongside the regional sales leader, you will be the trusted solution voice in front of clients: understand their business challenges, design the right S/4HANA solution, and build the proposals, demos and estimates that win the deal.

As a founding member of the practice, you will also build the pre-sales toolkit that others will use: reference architectures, solution collateral, demo scripts and estimating models. Once a deal is won, you will make sure it moves smoothly into delivery with a solution the team can execute well.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Pre-sales and deal support**

* Partner with the regional sales leader on qualified opportunities, from discovery through to contract.
* Lead client discovery workshops with CFOs, CIOs and business leaders to understand their business and process requirements.
* Own the solution response for RFIs, RFPs and proposals, including scope, approach, assumptions, estimates and commercials.
* Plan and deliver compelling solution demonstrations and presentations, including SAP system demos where appropriate.

**Solution architecture**

* Design end-to-end S/4HANA solutions across core business processes, such as finance, order to cash, procure to pay and supply chain.
* Bring good experience in SAP Finance to client conversations where helpful, including financial accounting, controlling, the Universal Journal and financial close.
* Advise clients on the right route to S/4HANA, including RISE with SAP (Private Cloud), GROW with SAP (Public Cloud), and greenfield, brownfield or selective data transition approaches.
* Shape end-to-end architectures covering integration, SAP BTP, data migration and clean core principles.
* Where relevant, connect S/4HANA with order to cash, billing and revenue recognition, including Acuiti's SAP BRIM expertise.
* Establish and evolve Acuiti's S/4HANA architecture principles, reference architectures and design standards, ensuring consistency across opportunities

**Proposition and asset development**

* Help define Acuiti's S/4HANA offerings, including Finance and revenue transformation for complex billing and subscription businesses.
* Build reusable pre-sales assets: reference architectures, solution collateral, demo scripts, estimating models and case studies.
* Contribute to thought leadership, including blogs, webinars and speaking at SAP and industry events.

**Ecosystem and delivery handover**

* Build strong working relationships with SAP pre-sales, solution specialists and account teams.
* Ensure every proposal is deliverable and profitable, working closely with delivery leads on scope, staffing and risk.
* Support a smooth handover of won deals to delivery, and stay engaged as solution authority in the early phases where needed.

**First 12 months: what success looks like**

By month 12, you will have helped win the practice's first S/4HANA clients and built a pre-sales toolkit that makes future wins faster and more repeatable.

**Timeframe**

**Expected outcomes**

Months 1 to 3

Onboarded to Acuiti's propositions and BRIM capability; core S/4HANA solution collateral and demo in place; actively supporting pursuits with the sales leader

Months 4 to 6

Leading solution design on qualified opportunities; first S/4HANA win supported; strong working relationships with SAP pre-sales and account teams

Months 7 to 12

Contribution to multiple wins; repeatable pre-sales toolkit of reference architectures, estimators and demo scripts; smooth handover of won deals to delivery; case studies and thought leadership published

**Candidate profile: experience and expertise**

**Must Have**

* 12 or more years in the SAP ecosystem, including at least 5 years in pre-sales or solution architecture roles with an SAP partner, systems integrator or SAP.
* Deep S/4HANA solution expertise across core business processes, with good experience in SAP Finance an advantage.
* A proven record of supporting and winning S/4HANA deals: solution design, RFP responses, demos, estimates and commercial proposals.
* Strong understanding of RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP and S/4HANA migration approaches, and what it takes to deliver them well.
* Hands-on implementation experience as a solution architect, finance lead or functional lead on S/4HANA programs.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage CFOs, CIOs and senior business leaders.

**Good to Have**

* SAP certification in S/4HANA, S/4HANA Cloud or S/4HANA Finance.
* Knowledge of order to cash, billing and revenue recognition (RAR), and ideally exposure to SAP BRIM or SAP Subscription Billing.
* Solid understanding on SAP Joule and SAP’s AI framework and offerings.
* Experience leveraging AI to enhance SAP solutioning, presales and delivery, with an ability to identify and shape AI-enabled opportunities for clients.
* Industry depth in sectors where Acuiti is strong, such as telecommunications, utilities, media, technology, or subscription and usage-based businesses.
* Experience with SAP BTP, integration, Central Finance or Group Reporting.
* Experience in a start-up, new practice or high-growth consulting environment.

**What we look for:**

Mindset matters as much as experience. We are looking for someone who:

* **Is a trusted advisor.**
  Earns credibility with senior client leaders through expertise and clear thinking, not just product knowledge.
* **Combines vision and detail.**
  Presents the big picture to a CFO one day and builds a detailed estimate the next.
* **Is commercially minded.**
  Designs solutions that win, can be delivered and make money.
* **Thinks like a founder.**
  Energised by building something new, takes ownership and creates assets others can reuse.
* **Works as one team.**
  Collaborates closely with sales, delivery, SAP and colleagues across the US, UK and India.
* **Is AI-native**
  . Uses AI to improve how presales and delivery are performed and helps shape our AI-enabled S/4HANA proposition.

**What we offer**

* The chance to be a founding member of a new SAP S/4HANA business and shape how it goes to market.
* The backing of an established SAP Endorsed Partner: delivery capability, SAP relationships, an existing client base and global teams spread across the US, UK, Netherlands and India.
* Direct access to, and partnership with, the practice leadership and Acuiti Labs leadership team.
* A competitive package, including base salary and performance incentives linked to the growth of the S/4HANA business.
* Comprehensive health, retirement, and wellness benefits.
* Investment in your learning and SAP certifications, and a clear path to senior practice leadership as the business grows.

title: Tender Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – TENDER MANAGER**

**Department:** Tendering / Business Development  
**Designation:** Tender Manager  
**Reporting To:** Head – Business Development / General Manager / Director  
**Team Management:** Tender Executives and Tender Coordinators  
**Experience:** 6–10 years in tendering and bid management  
**Qualification:** Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, or a relevant discipline  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**1. Job Purpose**

The Tender Manager will be responsible for leading and managing the complete tendering and bidding process, from identifying business opportunities to bid submission, evaluation, award, and post-award handover.

The role involves developing tender strategies, managing the tendering team, ensuring technical and commercial compliance, coordinating with internal departments and external stakeholders, and improving the company's tender success rate and profitability.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Tender Identification and Business Planning**

* Identify and evaluate relevant tender opportunities across government departments, PSUs, GeM, CPWD, PWD, railways, and private-sector organizations.
* Develop a tender pipeline and maintain a structured calendar of upcoming bids and submission deadlines.
* Evaluate tender opportunities based on eligibility, commercial viability, competition, resource availability, and business objectives.
* Recommend bid/no-bid decisions to senior management based on risk, profitability, and strategic relevance.
* Monitor procurement trends, competitor activities, and new business opportunities.

**B. Tender Management and Bid Strategy**

* Oversee the complete tender lifecycle, including tender study, eligibility assessment, documentation, pricing, submission, evaluation, and award.
* Review NITs, RFPs, RFQs, BOQs, technical specifications, eligibility criteria, and contractual terms.
* Develop tender-specific strategies to maximize the probability of winning profitable contracts.
* Ensure preparation and submission of technically compliant and commercially competitive bids within prescribed deadlines.
* Review and approve tender checklists, compliance matrices, technical proposals, commercial bids, and supporting documents before submission.
* Coordinate pre-bid meetings, clarification requests, corrigenda, technical presentations, and reverse auctions, wherever applicable.
* Ensure all bids are submitted accurately and in accordance with tender requirements.

**C. Team Leadership and Performance Management**

* Lead, guide, and supervise Tender Executives and other team members.
* Allocate tenders and responsibilities based on workload, complexity, and individual capabilities.
* Establish standard operating procedures, review mechanisms, checklists, and document-control practices.
* Monitor team productivity, submission quality, compliance, and deadline adherence.
* Train team members on tender portals, procurement rules, documentation standards, and bid preparation.
* Conduct periodic review meetings to assess tender pipeline, submission status, results, and improvement areas.
* Develop a culture of accountability, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**D. Commercial Evaluation and Pricing**

* Coordinate with Finance, Accounts, Sales, Procurement, Technical, and Operations teams to prepare competitive bid pricing.
* Review cost estimates, BOQs, rate analysis, vendor quotations, taxes, duties, statutory costs, and other commercial components, as applicable.
* Assess expected margins, project profitability, financial exposure, and commercial risks before bid submission.
* Obtain necessary pricing and commercial approvals from authorized management.
* Ensure pricing accuracy and consistency between the technical and financial submissions.
* Analyze L1 status, competitor pricing where available, and the reasons for winning or losing bids.

**E. Compliance and Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with tender eligibility criteria, technical specifications, statutory requirements, and contractual conditions.
* Review company credentials, experience certificates, turnover documents, GST/PAN records, declarations, affidavits, and other supporting documents.
* Supervise the timely arrangement and tracking of EMD, tender fees, bid security, performance bank guarantees, and security deposits.
* Identify potential disqualification risks, contractual liabilities, penalties, delivery obligations, and other commercial exposures.
* Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained before submission of bids and acceptance of contractual commitments.
* Maintain confidentiality, document accuracy, audit readiness, and adherence to company policies.

**F. Portal and Stakeholder Management**

* Oversee tender activities on GeM, CPPP/eProcure, state e-procurement portals, and other relevant platforms.
* Ensure timely company/vendor registrations, document renewals, digital signature certificate management, and portal compliance.
* Coordinate with government departments, PSU representatives, consultants, clients, OEMs, vendors, and subcontractors as required.
* Supervise responses to technical and commercial queries, document shortfalls, and evaluation-related clarifications.
* Maintain professional communication and ensure timely follow-up on bid status and award decisions.

**G. Post-Tender and Contract Management**

* Track tender opening, technical qualification, financial evaluation, reverse auctions, award decisions, and contract finalization.
* Coordinate the preparation and submission of LOA/LOI-related documents, agreements, performance guarantees, and other post-award requirements.
* Ensure a structured handover of awarded contracts to the Operations, Projects, Sales, or relevant execution team.
* Monitor EMD and security deposit refunds for unsuccessful bids and ensure timely follow-up.
* Review contractual terms and highlight deviations requiring management or legal approval.
* Maintain records of awarded contracts, unsuccessful bids, pending actions, and lessons learned.

**H. MIS, Reporting, and Performance Analysis**

* Prepare and present periodic tender MIS reports to senior management.
* Maintain accurate records of tender opportunities, submissions, qualification status, awards, losses, and pending decisions.
* Track tender conversion rates, win rates, bid values, expected margins, and reasons for unsuccessful bids.
* Monitor EMD, bank guarantees, tender fees, and related financial commitments.
* Recommend process improvements, automation, and reporting enhancements to improve tendering efficiency.
* Present periodic business pipeline reviews and tender performance summaries to management.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely submission of all approved bids.
* Accuracy and completeness of tender documentation.
* Reduction in bid rejections due to documentation or compliance errors.
* Tender qualification and success/conversion rate.
* Value of tenders submitted and contracts awarded.
* Profitability and commercial viability of successful bids.
* Timely release and recovery of EMDs and other refundable deposits.
* Accuracy and timeliness of tender MIS reporting.
* Team productivity, process adherence, and deadline management.
* Effective post-award handover and closure of tender-related actions.

*Specific targets will be established by management according to the company's business objectives and tender portfolio.*

**4. Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of end-to-end tendering and bid management.
* Working knowledge of GeM, CPPP, e-procurement portals, and applicable procurement procedures.
* Understanding of technical and commercial bid preparation, BOQs, pricing, and contract conditions.
* Strong leadership, planning, coordination, and team-management skills.
* Excellent analytical, negotiation, and decision-making abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PDF tools, and tender MIS reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tenders and work under strict deadlines.
* High attention to detail, integrity, accountability, and commercial awareness.

**5. Experience and Industry Preference**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience in tendering, bidding, or proposal management, including team-handling experience.
* Demonstrated experience in independently managing complex tenders from identification through award.
* Experience in government, PSU, institutional, and private-sector tendering.
* Prior exposure to GeM, CPWD, PWD, railways, EPC, infrastructure, manufacturing, supply, or service contracts, depending on the company's business.
* Experience in commercial negotiations, pricing approvals, bid strategy, and tender performance analysis.

**6. Authority and Accountability**

The Tender Manager will be accountable for the tendering team's performance, quality of bid submissions, compliance with tender requirements, timely completion of activities, and accurate reporting to management.

The role may recommend bid/no-bid decisions, pricing strategies, and process improvements. Final financial approvals, commercial commitments, and contract acceptance will remain subject to the company's delegation of authority.

**7. Expected Outcome**

To build an efficient, compliant, and commercially focused tendering function that consistently identifies suitable opportunities, submits high-quality bids on time, improves tender conversion, minimizes avoidable disqualifications, and contributes to profitable business growth.

Evaluate options for AI productionisation and scaled deployment, including MLOps, AI governance, value realisation tracking, and change management.

* Solution Architecture & Technology Landscape: Assess impact to client's technology landscape/architecture; formulate guiding principles and platform components. Demonstrate knowledge of IT & enterprise architecture concepts — Cloud, API-first, MCP, agent orchestration, RAG, observability.
* Budgeting & Financial Proposals: Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals for AI transformation engagements.

* The rise of forerunners
