title: Assistant Manager Accounts
description:
**JOB TITLE** - Assistant Manager – Finance and Accounts

**DEPARTMENT** - Finance and Accounts Department

**REPORTS TO** - Head – Internal Controls

**PURPOSE OF ROLE**

The Assistant Manager – Finance and Accounts owns the accuracy and timeliness of Gokul Oottupura's books.

He/she is responsible for ensuring that entries are passed correctly, books are closed on schedule, statutory dues are met and reports are ready for further analysis.

The role combines execution and supervision, ensuring reliable transactions, clean closes, compliance without lapses and enforced controls.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Tally Entries -** Pass or review accounting entries with correct ledger, cost centre and tax treatment such as:

* Accounts payable entries - purchase invoices, GRN-to-invoice matching, debit/credit notes, vendor payments
* Sales Entries
* Petty cash entries
* Expense entries: utilities, rent, repairs and maintenance, manpower, outlet and Head Office expenses.
* Maintain fixed asset entries: capitalization vs. revenue decision, additions, transfers between outlets, disposals and depreciation

Team leadership: assign work between the Senior and Junior Accountants, set monthly deadlines, review their entries before posting or finalizing, ensure nothing sits in suspense or unallocated heads; guide and give input for their appraisals.

**2. Month- End Close**

● **Cut-off and pre-close (last week of month)**: circulate the close calendar; confirm all outlets, Central Kitchen and Procurement have submitted invoices, GRNs, transfers and petty cash vouchers by the cut-off date.

● **Transaction completeness:** all purchase, expense and sales/collection entries posted; GRN-to-invoice and unbilled receipts reconciled with Procurement; inter-outlet and Central Kitchen transfers matched on both sides.

● **Accruals, provisions and depreciation:** book expenses incurred but not billed (utilities, rent, manpower, audit fees, etc.); prepaid expenses and their amortization; provisions for bonus, gratuity and leave as per policy; post depreciation, update the asset register and capitalize completed projects.

● **Reconciliations:** bank (all accounts); outlet cash, card/UPI and aggregator settlements (daily or weekly); petty cash counts; vendor statements for key suppliers and payables ageing; intercompany/related-party balances; and statutory ledgers (GST, TDS, PF/ESI) against returns and challans.

● **Stock and inventory:** obtain closing stock values from Stores/Costing, reconcile them to the books, follow up on variances and post the stock adjustment entries.

● **Trial balance review:** scan for abnormal balances, wrongly mapped ledgers, and unusual month-on-month movements; clear queries with the entry owners.

● **Lock, handover and checklist:** freeze the period in Tally; hand over the final trial balance, P&L and Balance Sheet to Costing Department and the Partners within the agreed working-day deadline; maintain a signed month-end checklist showing who completed each step and when.

**3. Year-end close**

● All month-end steps, plus a full ledger scrub: ageing review of debtors, creditors and advances, and write-off or write-back proposals for approval

● Confirmation of balances (vendors, banks, loans, deposits) and physical verification support for stock and fixed assets.

● Year-end provisions, deferred items, and 43B(h) / MSME payment-status review.

● Audit coordination: act as point of contact for statutory, tax, GST and internal auditors; prepare schedules and working papers, respond to queries and track audit adjustments to closure.

● Pass audit adjustments, finalize financial statements, and carry forward opening balances correctly.

**4. Budgeting**

● **Annual budget:** coordinate preparation with Costing, Procurement, HR and outlet heads; compile the expense, capex and cash-flow budgets in agreed formats.

● **Monthly payment budget:** consolidate vendor, statutory, payroll, rent and loan payments due; prepare the weekly/monthly payment plan against expected cash availability and obtain Partner approval; ensure MSME vendors are paid within the 45-day limit (Section 43B(h)).

● Monitor actual payments against the budget and report variances to the Partners; flag shortfalls early.

**5. Statutory compliance**

● GST: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation, annual return and reconciliation statement (GSTR-9/9C), e-invoicing and e-way bill requirements where applicable.

● TDS/TCS: correct deduction, timely deposit, quarterly returns (24Q/26Q/27Q), Form 16/16A issue, and tracking of lower-deduction certificates.

● Income Tax: advance tax computation support and payment, return and tax audit report support, notices and assessment responses (with the consultant).

● Payroll-linked and local levies: confirm PF, ESI, Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund deposits and returns are made on time (with HR).

● Company/entity filings: support the consultant with ROC/MCA or other entity filings, where applicable.

● Maintain a compliance calendar with due dates, owners and filing evidence; no interest, penalty or late fee should arise from Accounts.

**6. Documentation and recording**

● Ensure every entry has supporting documents (invoice, GRN, approval, proof of payment) filed and retrievable.

● Maintain digital records of statutory filings, challans, returns, agreements and audit working papers, with retention as required by law.

● Process improvement: keep accounting policies and SOPs updated; push for automation in Tally (bank import, GST reconciliation, voucher templates) and report recurring errors back to their source.

**7. General accounting controls**

● Oversee segregation of duties, approval limits, and master-data controls.

● Tally governance: own the chart of accounts and ledger master (no new ledger without approval); review user access and ensure back-ups, audit trail and period locks are enabled and used.

● Run routine control checks: duplicate invoices, payments without approval, cash limits, advances not adjusted.

● Report control exceptions and recommend corrective action to the Partners.

**8. Coordination with other departments** including but not limited to:

● **Procurement and Central Kitchen:** GRN and invoice flow, rate differences, returns and credit notes, transfer pricing between units.

● **Outlets and QSR:** daily sales and collection reporting, petty cash, cash deposit, expense vouchers.

● **Costing:** provide a timely, clean ledger so that analysis is accurate; resolve mapping queries.

● **Banks, lenders and external parties:** maintain loan schedules and interest bookings; prepare data for bank stock statements, renewals and compliance certificates; handle statement, confirmation and data requests from banks, landlords, consultants and authorities.

● Chase and escalate non-compliance with documentation and cut-off timelines.

**REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS**

**Technical (must have)**

1. Strong working command of Tally (Prime/ERP 9): vouchers, masters, GST and TDS configuration, reports, period locking and user rights.

2. Sound knowledge of Indian accounting standards and the double-entry cycle, including accruals, provisions, depreciation and reconciliations.

3. GST and TDS/TCS: rate structure and input tax credit rules for restaurants and food businesses, GSTR-1/3B/2B reconciliation, annual return, TDS/TCS provisions and return filing; basic knowledge of Income Tax, PF, ESI and Professional Tax.

4. Advanced Excel: lookups, pivot tables, reconciliation and data-cleaning formulas.

5. Familiarity with the GST portal, TRACES and the income tax portal.

6. Basic knowledge of cash-flow forecasting and budgeting methods.

**Technical (good to have)**

7. Experience with an ERP or POS integration with Tally, and with e-invoicing.

8. Exposure to the Companies Act / LLP Act compliance and tax audit requirements.

**Behavioural**

9. **Accuracy and deadline discipline:** catches errors before they reach the books; treats the close calendar and statutory due dates as fixed.

10. **Team leadership:** able to guide, review and develop the team and hold them accountable.

11. **Controls mindset:** comfortable saying no to a non-compliant entry, even from a senior colleague.

12. **Communication and integrity:** clear, firm and courteous when chasing outlets, Procurement, the Central Kitchen and other departments; handles sensitive financial and partner information responsibly

13. **Languages:** fluent English; Malayalam preferred for working with outlet and vendor teams in Kerala.

**WORK EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

**Work Experience**

1. Minimum 5 years of working in the field of accounting, finance, and taxation, with at least 3 years as Senior Accountant, Team Lead or Assistant Manager in a supervisory role.

2. At least 4 years in the accounts function of a multi-outlet business with high transaction volume: restaurants, hotels, QSR chains, food manufacturing, retail or FMCG are all suitable.

3. Must have personally done month-end and year-end closes, not only reviewed them.

4. Preferred: experience in a restaurant, hospitality or food business, where cash, card and aggregator settlements, perishable purchases and outlet-wise books are routine

**Educational Requirements**

5. Minimum Requirement - B.Com with M.Com or MBA (Finance); or B.Com with CA Inter / ICWA (CMA) Inter.

Preferred - Qualified CA / CMA preferred.

title: Sr. Integrated and ABM Specialist
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the Role**

As an Integrated Campaign & ABM Specialist, you’ll help shape how Sprinklr engages priority audiences and enterprise accounts. You’ll turn audience insight, account intelligence, and business priorities into connected experiences that build engagement, support pipeline progression, and create opportunities for account growth. This is a hands-on role for a B2B marketer who can move confidently between strategy and execution, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and translate performance signals into clear action.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success means delivering campaigns that feel like one connected experience rather than a collection of channel activities. Your programs help account teams understand where engagement is building, which buying-group members matter, and what action to take next. You’ll be known for reliable execution, clear communication, strong partnership, and the ability to turn performance signals into better decisions.

**What Makes You Qualified**

* Consistently deliver integrated campaigns and ABM plays against agreed briefs, milestones, quality standards, and business priorities.

description:

**Experience: 12+ Years**

**Location: Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad (Hybrid – 3 days in office)**

**Fission Labs**
is a product engineering and AI company serving mid-market clients across the US and Europe. We build custom software, data platforms and AI-driven engineering solutions.

Our delivery capabilities are established. We are now building a scalable revenue engine, and we're looking for a leader to drive this growth.

**The Role**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Head of Demand Generation**
to build and lead our demand generation function from the ground up.

You will own outbound strategy, account-based marketing, lead generation, pipeline development and team building. This is an opportunity to establish the entire demand generation playbook, drive measurable revenue impact and work closely with the leadership team.

**What You Will Do**

**1. Demand Generation & Strategy**

* Build and own the end-to-end demand generation strategy targeting US and European markets.
* Define ICPs, target accounts, buyer personas and outreach strategies across relevant industry segments.
* Drive MQL generation through outbound campaigns, email marketing, LinkedIn, cold calling and other channels.
* Design and execute ABM programs for high-value enterprise and mid-market accounts.
* Build scalable lead nurturing, qualification and MQL-to-SQL conversion processes.

**2. Build & Lead the Function**

* Build, hire and manage a high-performing inside sales and demand generation team.
* Establish outreach playbooks, campaign frameworks, sales sequences and qualification processes.
* Set team targets, KPIs and performance benchmarks.
* Coach team members and drive consistent pipeline contribution.

**3. Technology & Performance**

* Own the demand generation technology stack, including Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and HubSpot/Salesforce.
* Leverage AI and automation for prospect research, account intelligence, personalization and campaign execution.
* Track MQLs, SQLs, conversion rates, pipeline contribution and campaign ROI through regular dashboards.
* Continuously optimize campaigns through data-driven experimentation and performance analysis.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 12+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, inside sales, outbound sales or revenue development.
* Strong experience building and scaling demand generation or outbound functions in IT services, technology consulting, SaaS or product engineering companies.
* Proven track record of generating qualified leads, MQLs and building predictable sales pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with ABM, ICP definition, lead segmentation and multi-channel outbound campaigns.
* Experience managing and scaling sales development / demand generation teams.
* Strong understanding of US and European B2B markets and technology buyer personas (CTO, CIO, VP Engineering, Head of Product).
* Proficiency in tools such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve prospecting, personalization and campaign efficiency.
* Ability to work with US time zones (5 PM – 2 AM IST).

**Good to Have**

* Experience building a demand generation function from scratch.
* Exposure to intent-based marketing, predictive lead scoring and AI-driven prospecting.
* Experience targeting North American mid-market and enterprise clients.
* Strong understanding of IT services, cloud, data engineering and AI solutions.

**What This Role Offers**

* Opportunity to build a demand generation engine with people and automations
* Direct collaboration with founders and leadership.
* Ownership of growth strategy and execution.
* Opportunity to shape the team, processes, technology and overall GTM function.

title: Associate – Amazon Brand Building & Marketplace Growth
description:
**Experience:**
1–2 Years

**Location:**
Mumbai (Lower Parel)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Work from Office

**Company:**
Aromatan Brands Private Limited

About Us

Aromatan Brands is a fast-growing, global fragrance company building distinctive consumer brands across wellness, perfumery, and functional fragrances. Our portfolio includes Aromafume, Dukhni, and a 3rd brand launching soon, with a presence across major international markets.

We are looking for a curious, ambitious, and execution-driven individual who understands how brands grow on Amazon and is excited to learn the broader world of e-commerce, marketplaces, and brand strategy.

The Role

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of
**brand building, marketplace growth, and e-commerce strategy.**

You'll be responsible for executing and improving our presence on Amazon while gradually expanding into new marketplaces, geographies, and growth initiatives.

We're looking for someone who has already worked on the
**brand or seller side of Amazon**
, is comfortable navigating Seller Central, and understands that building a successful marketplace business goes beyond simply listing products.

You'll get hands-on ownership from day one, with the opportunity to learn how global consumer brands are built and scaled.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Amazon Brand Building & Growth**

* Manage and optimise product listings, including titles, descriptions, A+ Content, images, and storefronts.
* Improve product discoverability, organic rankings, conversion rates, and overall marketplace performance.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen brand presence, improve the customer experience, and drive sales.
* Monitor competitor brands, pricing, promotions, and emerging category trends.

**2. Marketplace Operations & Execution**

* Work extensively on Amazon Seller Central to manage catalogue health, listing issues, promotions, and day-to-day marketplace activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure product launches, content updates, and promotional campaigns are executed smoothly.
* Track account performance, identify issues, and proactively work towards resolving them.
* Support inventory planning and availability coordination to minimise lost sales.

**3. Growth, Analytics & Strategy**

* Analyse marketplace performance using key metrics such as sales, traffic, conversion rates, and organic rankings.
* Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, and geographies.
* Participate in planning product launches, promotional calendars, and marketplace growth initiatives.
* Work closely with senior leadership to translate growth strategies into actionable plans.

**4. New Marketplace Expansion**

* Support the launch and growth of our brands on emerging marketplaces beyond Amazon.
* Research new platforms, understand their ecosystems, and help build our presence from the ground up.
* Learn how marketplace strategies differ across countries and consumer segments.

What We're Looking For

**Must-Have**

* 1–2 years of relevant experience working with Amazon on the
  **brand side, seller side, or within an e-commerce brand team**
  .
* Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, including catalogue management, listing optimisation, and account operations.
* Understanding of how Amazon's marketplace ecosystem works and what drives product visibility and sales.
* Good analytical skills and comfort working with Excel or Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and a willingness to take ownership.
* A genuine interest in consumer brands, e-commerce, and business growth.

**Good to Have**

* Basic understanding of Amazon Advertising, including Sponsored Products and campaign performance metrics.
* Familiarity with Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Brand Stores.
* Exposure to international Amazon marketplaces such as the US, UK, or Europe.
* Experience with other marketplaces such as Walmart, Etsy, TikTok Shop, or Shopify.

What You'll Learn

This role is designed for someone who wants to grow beyond marketplace execution into broader e-commerce and brand leadership.

You'll gain exposure to:

* Building and scaling consumer brands internationally.
* Marketplace growth strategy, performance marketing, and commercial decision-making.
* Launching brands and products across new countries and platforms.
* Understanding the relationship between branding, consumer behaviour, pricing, and profitability.
* Working directly with leadership on high-impact growth projects.

Who Will Thrive Here

Someone who is
**hands-on, commercially curious, and hungry to learn**
. You enjoy figuring things out, are comfortable getting into the details, and want to understand not just
*how*
something is done, but
*why*
it matters to the business.

You don't need to know everything about e-commerce today. But you should know your way around Amazon Seller Central, have a solid foundation in marketplace execution, and be excited to build on it.

**This is not just an Amazon operations role. It's an opportunity to develop into a well-rounded marketplace growth and brand-building professional.**

title: Growth Operation Intern
description:
**Job location:**
Goregaon east, Mumbai

**Job type:**
Onsite, full time

Internovo Ventures runs Meta lead generation campaigns for premium Mumbai residential projects. We are building Meta Ads Autopilot, an in-house tool that launches campaigns from a brief, reviews them every few hours and makes safe changes, judged on cost per qualified lead. Our servers run on Microsoft Azure.

This is not a typical 9-to-5 internship. We need someone who enjoys juggling several tasks at once, keeps track of each one, and takes ownership of the numbers.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Prepare campaign briefs and check ad sets and ads before they go live, including the MahaRERA number on every ad and form.
* Review spend, leads, cost per qualified lead and creative fatigue each day, and flag anything that needs a decision.
* Keep every lead's CRM status current (fake, unreachable, qualified, site visit, booked), since these statuses feed back to Meta.
* Keep the approved creative pool up to date and track which creatives are tired.
* Sort the approval queue, check the reason for each action, and route it to the right person.
* Track monthly Azure costs for hosting, databases, monitoring, the WhatsApp API and LLM usage. Set budgets and alerts, and suggest cheaper options.
* Write the weekly summary in plain language, with simple charts where they help.
* Help run structured A/B tests and record the results.
* Test new features of the tool, log bugs and write clear notes for developers.

**Skills Required: Mandatory**

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills: formulas, pivot tables and lookups.
* Basic understanding of Meta Ads Manager: campaigns, ad sets, ads and budgets.
* Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure: at least one of Cost Management and Billing, App Service, Azure Database for PostgreSQL or Azure Monitor.
* Good written English, and comfort writing short WhatsApp messages in English or Hindi.
* Clear organisation: you can handle several tasks in one day and track each one.
* Attention to detail: a small budget mistake can cost real money.

**Skills Required: Preferred**

* Azure cost management experience: budgets, cost alerts, tagging and Azure Advisor recommendations.
* Azure hosting or data experience: App Service, Azure Functions, PostgreSQL Flexible Server or Redis.
* Basic knowledge of Python, SQL or scripting.
* Experience with CRM tools or lead management. Knows how to use AI tools and platforms.
* Interest in real estate marketing, and basic understanding of India's DPDP Act.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Graduate or final-year student in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, Commerce or a related field.
* Candidates from other disciplines with Meta Ads or Azure project experience are also encouraged to apply.

**Culture Fit:**
This role suits someone who enjoys multitasking and does not need a fixed routine. You bring a clear recommendation with the evidence behind it, spot problems early, and admit mistakes quickly. We value ownership, accuracy and a calm approach when several tasks compete for time.

title: Sr Digital Advertising Data Analyst
description:
**About DealerOn**
We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America. We are known for our cutting-edge products that streamline the car buying process and provide an experience both shoppers and dealers love. Our business model is working: we were recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing companies six years in a row, expanding to over 30 manufacturer relationship, and over 5,000 dealer partners. We are proud of what our company has done, and it’s all due to the talented and diverse team we’ve been lucky enough to assemble.
  
  
****Title:****
Sr Digital Advertising Data Analyst
  
  
****Employment Type:****
Full-time
  
  
**Job Description**
The Sr Digital Advertising Data Analyst is responsible for the data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting that supports DealerOn's OEM digital advertising programs, working analysis and data requests raised by the DigAd OEM team and the Partners and Platforms team. This role is also responsible for managing and optimizing DealerOn's advertising technology ecosystem, with a focus on Fluency platform administration, Google Analytics implementation, reporting governance, and performance measurement. This role serves as a subject matter expert for advertising operations, ensuring accurate platform configurations, scalable reporting solutions, data integrity, and actionable insights that support customer retention and growth.
  
  
Working closely with the Partners and Platforms team, this position helps establish operational standards, improve reporting capabilities, and drive continuous improvement across advertising programs.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**
****Advertising Technology & Platform Management****

* Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for the Fluency platform across advertising accounts including platform data structures, exports, and reporting outputs.
* Configure, maintain, and optimize campaign structures, workflows, budgets, and platform settings within Fluency.
* Develop standardized templates, workflows, and operating procedures to ensure consistency and scalability.
* Create and maintain documentation, training materials, and implementation guides for internal teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform utilization, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Creation and Modification of Fluency Blueprints.
* Validate Fluency OEM Reporting templates against source data as each program migrates, and document known gaps by OEM.

****Analytics, Measurement, and Reconciliation****

* Partner in owning Google Analytics 4 (GA4) implementation, governance, and ongoing optimization.
* Manage event tracking, conversion tracking, attribution frameworks, and data validation processes.
* Partner with stakeholders to troubleshoot tracking discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.
* Establish measurement standards and best practices across advertising programs.
* Support advanced reporting initiatives that demonstrate advertising performance and return on investment.
* Reconcile spend and performance data across systems, including Monthly Spend Reports, OEM billing files, Fluency platform data, and Salesforce campaign records.
* Isolate dealer-level and channel-level variances and determine whether the cause sits with the provider feed, the platform, or internal configuration.
* Document findings in root cause analyses (RCAs) and defect lists that hold up in provider and OEM escalations.

****Reporting & Business Insights****

* Develop and maintain internal reporting frameworks that support customer-facing deliverables.
* Build dashboards and executive-level reports using analytics and business intelligence tools.
* Analyze campaign performance data and identify trends, risks, and optimization opportunities.
* Deliver actionable insights that support customer retention, growth initiatives, and strategic decision-making.
* Collaborate with the DigAd OEM team and customer-facing stakeholders to translate performance data into meaningful business recommendations.
* Build repeatable analysis templates and documented methodologies so recurring OEM data requests can be completed faster with consistent output.

****Quality Assurance & Governance****

* Conduct regular audits of Fluency configurations, analytics implementations, and reporting accuracy.
* Ensure compliance with established operational standards and best practices.
* Identify and resolve operational issues impacting campaign performance, measurement, or reporting.
* Perform pre-submission quality assurance on OEM billing files and monthly spend reports ahead of program deadlines.
* Maintain a tracked log of known data defects by OEM and provider, including status and resolution, so recurring issues are identified early.

****Cross-Functional Collaboration****

* Partner with the DigAd OEM team, the Partners and Platforms team, Advertising Strategy, Product, Analytics, Customer Success, and Operations teams to support advertising initiatives.
* Act as an internal consultant on Fluency functionality, analytics implementation, and reporting best practices.
* Support onboarding and training efforts for team members utilizing Fluency and analytics tools.
* Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities for process improvements and operational enhancements.
* Triage and scope incoming data and analysis requests, communicate timelines, and manage expectations with requesting teams.

****Innovation & Continuous Improvement****

* Stay informed on industry trends, analytics advancements, advertising technologies, and platform updates.
* Evaluate new tools, integrations, and reporting capabilities that improve advertising performance.
* Support testing and validation of new platform features, products, and operational processes.
* Recommend scalable solutions that enhance efficiency, reporting quality, and customer outcomes.
* Identify recurring data issues and recommend systemic fixes rather than one-time corrections.

**Skills & Abilities**

* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and cross-referencing large data sets across multiple sources.
* Advanced knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and digital measurement frameworks.
* Strong understanding of digital advertising channels including Search, Display, Video, Social, and Programmatic.
* Experience managing advertising technology platforms and reporting ecosystems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to interpret large data sets and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Excellent project management, documentation, and organizational skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams through expertise and collaboration.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly in writing for internal and provider-facing documentation.
* Sound judgment on when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate, including the ability to challenge data that appears incorrect.
* Working knowledge of OEM program structures, tier definitions, and billing mechanics.

**Qualifications**
****Required****

* 8+ years of experience in digital advertising analytics, marketing technology, advertising operations, or related fields.
* Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager implementations.
* Experience managing enterprise-level reporting, tracking, and measurement frameworks.
* Strong proficiency with Excel, Looker Studio, and reporting platforms.
* Experience supporting complex digital advertising programs across multiple channels.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience reconciling data across multiple reporting systems and identifying the source of discrepancies.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Fluency platform administration and advertising workflows.
* Experience in automotive digital marketing or agency environments.
* Knowledge of CRM integrations, attribution modeling, and conversion tracking methodologies.
* Experience developing operational standards, process documentation, and training materials.
* Familiarity with customer environments and multi-location business models.

title: Shopify Amazon Meta Catalogue Manager
description:
Hiring: Marketplace & E-commerce Operations Executive

**MOSHA Health | Noida / Delhi NCR**

MOSHA Health is a functional food and gut wellness brand building products for everyday digestive health.

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented E-commerce & Marketplace Operations Executive to manage our online sales infrastructure across multiple platforms.

This is an ownership-oriented role for someone who enjoys getting things done, troubleshooting problems and keeping the backend of an e-commerce business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Shopify Store Management**

* Manage day-to-day Shopify store operations.
* Create and update product listings, descriptions, images, pricing, variants and collections.
* Maintain product pages, inventory, SKUs and catalogue accuracy.
* Coordinate and manage website integrations, apps, shipping and checkout-related issues.
* Identify and resolve website and listing-related issues.

**2. Meta Commerce Manager & Product Catalogue**

* Manage MOSHA's product catalogue across Meta platforms.
* Upload and maintain product listings, product sets and catalogue information.
* Monitor product approvals, rejections and policy violations.
* Troubleshoot catalogue errors and coordinate product reviews and appeals.
* Ensure smooth integration between Shopify, Meta Commerce Manager and advertising accounts.

**3. Amazon Seller Central**

* Create, optimise and maintain Amazon product listings.
* Manage product titles, descriptions, bullet points, images, keywords and backend attributes.
* Handle listing approvals, compliance requirements and catalogue issues.
* Monitor inventory, pricing, orders and account health.

**4. Other Marketplaces & Quick Commerce**

* Manage onboarding and catalogue operations on additional platforms as the business expands.
* Handle product listings, pricing, inventory and operational requirements for platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and other relevant marketplaces.
* Research platform requirements and independently coordinate the onboarding process.

**5. General E-commerce Operations**

* Ensure consistent product information, pricing and images across all sales channels.
* Maintain catalogue hygiene and operational documentation.
* Track pending issues, platform updates and listing performance.
* Coordinate with internal teams, designers, developers and platform support teams wherever required.

What We're Looking For

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in e-commerce or marketplace operations.
* Practical experience managing Shopify stores.
* Working knowledge of Meta Commerce Manager and product catalogues.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central.
* Familiarity with marketplace onboarding and catalogue management.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Good Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to independently manage multiple tasks.

**An added advantage:**
Experience with D2C brands, FMCG, food or wellness categories, and quick-commerce platforms such as Blinkit and Zepto.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an execution-focused individual who can take complete ownership of the backend of our e-commerce business.

You should be comfortable figuring things out independently, resolving platform issues, managing multiple channels and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks.

This is not a social media management or digital marketing role. It is a hands-on e-commerce operations role.

**Location:**
Noida / Delhi NCR

**Experience:**
2–4 years

**Compensation:**
As per experience and suitability

**To apply:**
Share your CV along with a brief description of the e-commerce platforms you have independently managed.

High On Sales (HOS) |

Delhi |

Full-time

**Quick Note Before Applying:**

This role is focused on building brand communications for
**personal**
**brands**
,
**coaches**
, and
**founders**
, rather than traditional D2C/e-commerce brands. We're looking for someone who understands offer creation, positioning, and conversion-focused communication for expertise-driven businesses. Candidates from other backgrounds are welcome, as long as they're aligned with this focus.

We're looking for a sharp, creative, and commercially minded
**Brand Communication Strategist**
who understands how to position brands, build compelling offers, and craft messaging that actually converts.

At HOS, we work with founders, coaches, consultants, and personal brands to help them grow and scale their businesses. Your job isn't just to write good copy. It's to figure out what to sell, how to position it, and how to communicate its value so that people actually want to buy.

You'll work closely with our clients, founders and creative teams to turn business insights into strong offers, clear messaging, and high-converting marketing assets.

* **Sales Funnels & Campaign Strategy:**

* **Pitch Decks & Sales Assets:**
  Structure persuasive pitch decks, presentations, and offer documents that help clients sell their products or services.
* **Creative & Copy Direction:**
  Develop briefs and messaging frameworks for ad scripts, landing pages, and other marketing creatives, working closely with copywriters and designers.
* **Research & Optimization:**
  Study competitor campaigns, winning offers, customer psychology, and campaign performance to continuously improve messaging and conversions.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Someone with 2
  **–4+ years**
  of relevant experience in brand strategy, marketing communication, direct-response marketing, or offer creation.
* Strong understanding of consumer psychology, sales, positioning, and conversion-driven messaging.
* Experience creating offers, marketing funnels, sales presentations, or campaign communication for brands, coaches, consultants, or service businesses.
* Someone who can research independently, think strategically, and translate complex ideas into simple, persuasive communication.

We're not looking for someone who simply writes catchy taglines or creates generic brand guidelines. * First-principles thinking drives our problem-solving approach.
* We are disciplined and uphold a strong work ethic.

* Procrastination isn’t in our DNA.

* Dynamism and ambition with an outgoing, social nature
* Creative thinker with a great solution orientation
* Being an agile and strategic team player who could work well independently in an autonomous, multicultural and evolving business environment
* Digital & social media savvy

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Industry:\*\* Affiliate Marketing | Performance Marketing | Digital Advertising

## Role Description

We are looking for an experienced and result-driven \*\*Manager / Senior Manager – Affiliate Delivery & Publisher Growth\*\* to lead campaign delivery, publisher partnerships, and revenue growth across international affiliate marketing programs.

The ideal candidate should have \*\*3–5+ years of hands-on experience working with an affiliate network, performance marketing agency, or affiliate marketing company\*\*, with strong expertise in international CPS (Cost Per Sale) and CPL/CPA (Lead Generation) campaigns.

This role requires strong operational knowledge of leading affiliate platforms, including \*\*Awin, Rakuten, Tradedoubler (TD), and Impact\*\*, along with an established network of international publishers, affiliate networks, and traffic partners.

The candidate will be responsible for maximizing campaign performance, driving quality conversions, scaling publisher relationships, and achieving revenue and profitability targets.

## Key Responsibilities

- \*\*Campaign Delivery & Performance:\*\* Own end-to-end execution, optimization, and scaling of international CPS, CPL, and CPA campaigns across multiple verticals.

- \*\*Publisher Acquisition & Management:\*\* Identify, recruit, onboard, and manage high-performing international publishers, affiliates, subnetworks, and traffic partners.

- \*\*Affiliate Platform Management:\*\* Independently manage and operate campaigns through Awin, Rakuten, Tradedoubler, Impact, and other affiliate platforms.

- \*\*Revenue & Profitability:\*\* Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue, delivery, and gross margin targets through effective campaign allocation and publisher optimization.

- \*\*International Network Partnerships:\*\* Leverage existing relationships with international affiliate networks, publishers, and agencies to unlock new campaign opportunities and scale existing programs.

- \*\*Campaign Optimization:\*\* Monitor clicks, conversions, EPC, CR, ROI, approvals, reversals, and other performance metrics to improve campaign efficiency.

- \*\*Publisher Compliance:\*\* Ensure traffic quality, source transparency, advertiser guideline adherence, and prevention of fraudulent or non-compliant activities.

- \*\*Cross-Functional Collaboration:\*\* Work closely with advertiser acquisition, business development, and finance teams to ensure smooth campaign activation, delivery, reconciliation, and payment processes.

- \*\*Team Leadership:\*\* For senior-level candidates, lead, mentor, and manage affiliate delivery executives while establishing performance benchmarks and operational processes.

## Required Skills & Qualifications

- \*\*3–5+ years of relevant experience\*\* in an affiliate network, affiliate marketing company, or performance marketing agency.

- Strong hands-on experience managing \*\*international CPS and CPL/CPA lead generation campaigns\*\*.

- \*\*Practical working knowledge of Awin, Rakuten, Tradedoubler, and Impact affiliate panels is essential.\*\*

- Established professional relationships with international affiliate networks, publishers, and traffic partners.

- Experience managing campaigns across the \*\*US, UK, Europe, and other international markets\*\*.

- Strong understanding of affiliate tracking, attribution, postbacks, conversion validation, and campaign reporting.

- Ability to troubleshoot campaign delivery challenges, optimize publisher performance, and scale profitable traffic.

- Strong analytical, commercial negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills.

- Proven track record of achieving campaign delivery, revenue, and profitability targets.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Existing publisher relationships in eCommerce, Travel, Retail, Finance, Insurance, and Lead Generation verticals.

- Experience working with affiliate platforms such as CJ, Partnerize, Admitad, and Everflow.

- Knowledge of diverse traffic sources, including content publishers, comparison websites, coupon and cashback platforms, native advertising, paid media, and email marketing.

- Previous experience managing an affiliate delivery or publisher management team.

## What We Offer

- Competitive salary based on experience and expertise.

- Attractive performance-linked incentives.

- Five-day working week.

- Opportunity to manage international campaigns and build global publisher partnerships.

- Leadership opportunities within a growing international performance marketing company.

- Collaborative, performance-driven work environment with long-term career growth.

## How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at \*\*hr@skylinedigitalgrowth.com\*\*.

\*\*Email Subject:\*\* Application – Manager / Senior Manager, Affiliate Delivery

\*\*Join SKyline Digital Growth and take ownership of building, managing, and scaling high-performing international affiliate partnerships.\*\*

title: Head of Content
description:
**About TETR**

Five years ago, we started Masters’ Union; our vision: to redefine the landscape of business education. We posed a simple question: If aspiring doctors learn from seasoned physicians and budding lawyers learn from legal experts, why shouldn't future business leaders learn directly from industry experts?

After all, can a lecture on Accounting 101 truly compare to the hands-on experience of analyzing real PnL statements?

Today, Masters' Union has an unparalleled curriculum with faculty comprising Industry Leaders and practitioners unlike any other in the country. Our academic council includes CXOs, MDs, Eminent Public Leaders, and even Members of Parliament. In just four years of operations, our flagship PGP in Technology and Business Management has achieved remarkable success, surpassing the placement records of esteemed institutions like IIM Ahmedabad and ISB.

Masters’ Union is now ranked among the top 2 B-schools in the country based on placement records.

With our growing global recognition, we realized that the hands-on experience of building real businesses, which proved to be highly effective for students in India, could offer immense value to aspiring entrepreneurs worldwide.

Thus, the idea of Tetr was born.

Picture this: a business program that isn't just about textbooks and lectures—it's an adventure that spans 7 different countries, with each semester bringing a new destination and a wealth of experience. Imagine studying at iconic institutions like INSEAD, NUS, SDA Bocconi, and IIT and learning from some of the brightest minds in the business world like Dr. Edward Rogers (Former Chief Knowledge Officer, NASA), Mr. Faverie Stephane (Executive Group President, Estee Lauder) and Mr. Saud Swar (CBO, American Express, MENA). From launching eCommerce ventures in Dubai to tackling tech startups in Silicon Valley, our students traverse the globe, building businesses and making a tangible impact. At Tetr, the world is your classroom.

If this excites you, and you resonate with our vision, then we’d love for you to come and build with us.

**About this role**

We’re looking for a Head of Content who lives on the internet, thinks like a brand builder, and leads like a people-first operator. Someone who has seen both sides of the table - agency and brand - and knows how to take an idea from “Guys, hear me out…” to something millions of people actually want to watch. You’ve built or scaled social pages from 0 → something worth talking about. You understand why organic content travels, why some videos die in the first three seconds, and why one random student moment can become the Reel everyone is sending to their friends.

You probably scroll way too much. Good.

But you also know exactly why you stopped scrolling. You understand hooks, culture, formats, trends, storytelling and algorithms — but you’re not a trend-chaser. You know how to take what’s happening on the internet and turn it into something that feels unmistakably Tetr.

At Tetr, you’ll own the entire content and social engine across channels, countries, programs and audiences.

You’ll lead the team across Creative, YouTube, Production and Video, with the Creative Directors, Producers and Video Editors reporting into you. You’ll work closely with the Head of Marketing and Category Leads to turn business priorities into content that builds brand, community, cultural relevance and demand. And, you’ll spend a lot of time with Tetr’s favourite people: our students. Because they are the content.

The late nights. The crazy ideas. The businesses. The failures. The wins. The arguments. The adventures. The “wait, did they actually do that?” moments.

Your job is to find those stories, make them impossible to ignore, and get the world watching.

You’ll own the ecosystem from: Strategy → Idea → Format → Shoot → Edit → Publish → Obsess over Analytics → Do it better.

**Specifically, this role will involve**

* Owning the content strategy across channels, countries, programs and audiences — and decide what Tetr should be talking about, showing and building next. Turn business priorities into content people actually want to consume. Revolutionary concept, we know.
* Building a content engine that can move fast, often and without becoming boring across Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and whatever the internet invents next. Right content. Right platform. Right audience. Right moment.
* Building and scaling Tetr’s social ecosystem from 0 → 1 → 100. Obsess over organic reach, retention, shares, followers and community — and figure out why something worked before trying to repeat it.
* Setting the creative ambition across Tetr’s content universe and work closely with the Creative Director to make the work sharper, stranger, smarter and more watchable. Turn student life, entrepreneurship, global travel and business-building into stories people genuinely care about.
* Building formats people recognise before they even see the Tetr logo. Experiment, kill the boring stuff, double down on what works and turn winning ideas into repeatable IPs.
* Building YouTube into a serious storytelling and audience engine — not just a place where videos go after Instagram. Work with the YouTube team on long-form formats, packaging, retention, channel growth and the ever-changing algorithmic beast.
* Making Tetr’s students the heroes, creators and co-conspirators of the content ecosystem. Build systems that make it ridiculously easy for students across the world to create authentic, entertaining, culturally relevant content.
* Building content that can travel from Mumbai to Mexico, Dubai to Tokyo without losing its soul. Know what should be global, what should be local and when a tiny student moment in one country can become a global story.
* Being slightly unreasonable about performance. Know your hooks, retention, watch time, shares, saves, completion rates and audience growth - and use the numbers to make better creative, not just prettier dashboards.
* Leading the people making all of this happen - Creative Director, YouTube Manager, Producer and Video Editors. Build a team culture that is high standards, low ego, fast feedback, big ideas and absolutely no “that’s not my job.”
* Building the systems that let great content happen at scale without turning everyone into spreadsheet zombies. Own the workflows across ideation, briefing, production, publishing, distribution, analytics and iteration.
* Making Tetr feel like a world people want to be part of - not a college they’ve seen an ad for. Build stories around students, alumni, founders, faculty and the wonderfully chaotic Tetr community.

**Ideal candidate will have**

* 10+ years across content, creative, social, digital media, entertainment, creator businesses, publishing or brand storytelling.
* You’ve worked on both agency and brand side and know the difference between making a deck look good and making the work actually work.
* You’ve built or scaled social channels from 0 and have the battle scars to prove it.
* You understand organic content deeply.
* You’re fluent in YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and whatever platform Gen Alpha is currently pretending they invented.
* You understand hooks, retention, storytelling, culture, audience psychology and algorithms.
* You can look at a viral video and explain why it went viral without saying “because the algorithm liked it.”
* You’ve built content IPs, franchises or repeatable formats.
* You have excellent creative judgement and can spot a great idea — and a painfully average one — almost instantly.
* You’re comfortable with data and know that views are great, but understanding why you got them is better.
* Experience across global markets and multicultural audiences is a big plus.
* You’re a brilliant people leader who can hire great people, make them better and keep them excited.

title: Performance creative strategist
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Performance Creative Strategist**
who understands the intersection of fashion, consumer psychology, storytelling, and performance marketing.

Your primary responsibility will be to develop high-performing creative concepts for Meta Ads and other paid digital channels, using data, consumer insights, and creative experimentation to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth.

This is not a media-buying role or a traditional graphic design position. We need someone who can identify
**what makes customers stop scrolling, engage, and ultimately purchase**
, and translate those insights into compelling creative briefs.

You will work closely with our Founder, Creative Team, Content Creators, and Performance Marketing Team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Creative Strategy & Concept Development**

* Develop performance-driven concepts for Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), including static ads, carousels, video ads, Reels, and UGC-style content.
* Create compelling hooks, headlines, visual directions, messaging angles, and storytelling frameworks.
* Translate product USPs, customer motivations, and fashion trends into creative concepts that convert.
* Develop creative strategies for product launches, seasonal collections, promotional campaigns, and evergreen bestsellers.
* Balance luxury brand positioning with direct-response marketing principles.

**2. Performance Analysis & Creative Testing**

* Analyze advertising performance using metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, and hook/hold rates.
* Identify winning creative patterns, messaging angles, and visual formats.
* Develop structured A/B testing plans for hooks, copy, formats, product positioning, and creative concepts.
* Study creative fatigue and continuously introduce new concepts and iterations.
* Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign performance and scaling opportunities.

**3. Creative Briefing & Production**

* Write detailed, actionable briefs for graphic designers, video editors, photographers, and content creators.
* Provide references, storyboards, shot lists, copy directions, and clear creative objectives.
* Guide the production of performance-focused product videos, lifestyle content, UGC, and editorial-inspired advertisements.
* Ensure creative output is consistent with Perte D’ego's visual identity and premium positioning.
* Manage a consistent pipeline of fresh creative concepts and iterations.

**4. Consumer Research & Competitor Intelligence**

* Research the US fashion consumer, purchasing motivations, objections, and emerging trends.
* Analyze competitors and leading global D2C fashion brands using Meta Ad Library and other creative intelligence tools.
* Study customer reviews, comments, and feedback to identify new messaging opportunities.
* Identify emerging creative formats and advertising trends before they become saturated.

**5. Creative Performance Reporting**

* Maintain a structured creative testing tracker.
* Present weekly insights on winning ads, underperforming concepts, and new opportunities.
* Build a library of proven hooks, visual formats, and messaging angles.
* Recommend creative priorities based on performance data and business objectives.

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years of experience in performance creative strategy, preferably with a D2C fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or premium consumer brand.
* Strong understanding of Meta Ads and performance marketing fundamentals.
* Proven ability to develop advertising concepts backed by performance data.
* Excellent copywriting, storytelling, and consumer psychology skills.
* Strong visual taste and understanding of fashion aesthetics.
* Ability to interpret creative performance data and turn insights into actionable briefs.
* Familiarity with Meta Ads Library, Ads Manager, Motion, Foreplay, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of US consumer behavior and digital advertising trends.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**What we are looking for:**

Someone who:

* Thinks like a marketer but has the eye of a creative director.
* Understands why one advertisement generates sales while another gets ignored.
* Can turn a single product into 10 different compelling advertising angles.
* Is equally comfortable analyzing ROAS and discussing visual composition.
* Understands that premium fashion advertising must build desire, not just push discounts.
* Is proactive, experimental, and constantly looking for the next winning creative concept.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Volume and quality of new creative concepts developed and tested.
* Percentage of new creative tests that outperform established benchmarks.
* Improvement in creative-driven acquisition efficiency.
* Speed of creative iteration and testing.
* Development of scalable winning creative concepts.
* Consistency and effectiveness of creative production briefs.

title: CRO Specialist
description:
We are looking for a data-driven CRO Specialist to optimize website and campaign performance by improving user experience and increasing conversion rates across digital touchpoints. The role focuses on turning traffic into customers through testing, insights, and continuous optimization.
  
  
The current position requires the following skills:

### **Responsibilities:**

* Plan, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate experiments across websites and landing pages with statistically valid outcomes.
* Identify conversion bottlenecks using funnel analysis, behavioral analytics, and AI-assisted insights.
* Improve conversion performance across landing pages, product pages, lead forms, and checkout journeys.

* Monitor and report CRO KPIs including conversion rate, experiment lift, statistical confidence, and engagement metrics.

* Drive continuous optimization using structured experimentation frameworks and iterative testing cycles.
* Maintain website content accuracy and consistency aligned with UX and conversion goals.
* Document experiments, learnings, and insights to build a scalable CRO knowledge base.

### **Technical Skills:**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, experimentation, growth marketing, eCommerce, or website optimization.
* 3+ years of working experience with HTML and CSS; ability to review and implement frontend changes.
* Proven experience designing experiments, defining success metrics, and interpreting statistical results.
* AI-Powered Analytics: Amplitude AI, Mixpanel Signal, Heap Illuminate
* Session Replay & DX: FullStory, Content square
* Personalization & AI Testing: Dynamic Yield, Mutiny, Adobe Target
* Data & Experiment QA: Looker Studio, BigQuery (basic exposure), SQL fundamentals
* AI-assisted UX & Copy tools exposure for experimentation and personalization
* Strong analytical and statistical thinking with a test-and-learn mindset.
* Ability to use AI-driven insights without blindly trusting automation.
* Solid understanding of UX, behavioral psychology, and conversion frameworks.
* Clear communicator with strong ownership and execution focus.
* Comfortable operating in fast-paced, data-heavy environments.
* CRO Tools: Optimizely, VWO, AB Tasty, Convert, Analytics & Tracking: GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, GA4 predictive metrics, automated insights, AI-based funnel analysis tools, Shopify, Sitefinity

* Willingness to learn and take initiative

* Interested to learn & work with latest/upcoming technologies

SWEET DREAMS (S D Retail Limited) is one of India’s leading sleepwear and apparel brands, with a legacy of over 35 years. The brand is focused on delivering comfortable, stylish and quality sleepwear and lifestyle products through its expanding retail and digital presence.

Marketplace &
E-Commerce Manager will be responsible for managing and growing SWEET DREAMS’ online business across major marketplaces and the company’s D2C website.

The role will own online sales, revenue growth, marketplace performance, product listings, pricing, promotions, advertising, inventory, customer experience and profitability.

**3. Sales & Business Growth**

* Develop strategies to increase revenue, orders, AOV and repeat purchases.
* Analyse category-wise, channel-wise and SKU-wise performance.

* Monitor competitor pricing, products, promotions and positioning.

**4. Digital Marketing & Advertising**

* Plan and manage marketplace advertising and sponsored campaigns.

* Monitor advertising spend, ROAS, CAC and campaign profitability.
* Plan promotional campaigns for festivals and major marketplace events.
* Ensure marketing spends are aligned with sales and profitability objectives.

**5. Inventory & Order Management**

* Monitor stock availability by SKU, size and colour.
* Ensure availability of fast-moving products and minimize stock-outs.
* Plan inventory requirements based on sales trends and upcoming campaigns.
* Monitor order processing, dispatch, delivery, cancellations and returns.
* Coordinate with logistics and marketplace fulfilment partners.

**6. Pricing & Profitability**

* Develop and maintain channel-wise pricing and promotional strategies.
* Monitor competitor pricing regularly.
* Analyse marketplace commission, shipping, discounts, advertising, returns and other costs.
* Prepare SKU/channel-level profitability analysis.
* Ensure business growth while maintaining healthy contribution margins.

**7. MIS, Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly e-commerce performance reports.
* Track marketplace-wise and product/SKU-wise sales.
* Monitor orders, AOV, conversion rate and website traffic.
* Analyse advertising spend and ROAS.
* Track returns, cancellations, inventory and stock-outs.
* Monitor gross margin/contribution and customer acquisition.
* Present business insights and actionable recommendations to management.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

* Online Sales & Revenue Growth
* Achievement of Monthly/Annual Sales Targets
* Marketplace & D2C Profitability
* Website Sales Growth
* ROAS / Advertising ROI
* Conversion Rate Improvement
* Average Order Value Growth
* Reduction in Returns & Cancellations
* Inventory Availability & Stock-out Control
* Product Visibility & Marketplace Ranking
* Customer Ratings & Reviews
* Promotional Campaign Performance
* New Product Launches & Online Category Expansion

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, E-Commerce or Business Management will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in E-Commerce / Marketplace Management.
* Hands-on experience with major Indian marketplaces is essential.
* Experience in Apparel, Garments, Fashion, Innerwear or Nightwear will be strongly preferred.
* Experience managing a significant online business or D2C brand will be an advantage.

Interested candidates can share their CV at:

**careers@sweetdreamsindia.com**

* Translate market insights into business interventions.

***E. Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration***

* Build and coach high-performing city teams.
* Partner with Product, Finance, Marketing, Supply, CX, and Category teams.
* Provide structured on-ground feedback to influence central strategy.

* Monitor key business metrics and conduct regular business reviews.
* Drive data-backed decision making and corrective actions.

* Marketplace understanding across pricing, supply-demand balancing, and operations.

* Business growth through strategic and operational interventions.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies that improve brand discoverability, citations, mentions, and recommendations across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven search platforms.

This role requires a strong understanding of AI search behaviour, entity optimization, semantic content structuring, and Large Language Model (LLM) discoverability to strengthen brand presence in the evolving AI search ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
  

* Develop and implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies.

* Develop strategies to improve brand authority, credibility, and online information consistency.
* Conduct competitor analysis to understand their AI search presence and identify content gaps.
* Collaborate with content writers, developers, and marketing teams to execute AEO and GEO strategies.
* Track performance through relevant analytics, AI visibility monitoring tools, and reporting frameworks.
* Stay updated with developments in generative AI, LLMs, AI search algorithms, and emerging optimization techniques.

Required Skills & Experience
  

* 4+ years of experience in AEO, GEO, AI Search Optimization, or related digital search optimization roles.
* Strong understanding of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
* Hands-on experience optimizing brand visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
* Strong knowledge of LLMs, generative AI search behaviour, and AI-driven content discovery.
* Expertise in entity SEO, semantic search, knowledge graphs, and structured data.
* Experience with schema markup, JSON-LD, FAQ schema, and structured content formats.
* Understanding of content optimization for AI-generated answers and conversational search queries.
* Ability to conduct AI visibility audits, citation analysis, and competitor benchmarking.
* Familiarity with tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, and AI visibility tracking platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and develop actionable strategies.
* Excellent communication, research, and strategic planning skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills
  

* Experience working with international clients and competitive global markets.
* Understanding of how LLMs retrieve, process, and reference web content.
* Familiarity with AI search monitoring and brand visibility tools.
* Knowledge of digital brand authority, online reputation, and content credibility strategies.
* Awareness of emerging AI search technologies and generative search trends.

title: Founding Team Volunteer
description:
Founding Team Volunteer – New Project Initiative
  
  
An Initiative by NKSTARS INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED
  
  
Preferred Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
  
Participation: Remote – Open Across India
  
Opportunity Type: Unpaid Volunteer Program
  
Time Commitment: 6–8 Hours Per Week
  
Initial Program Duration: 8 Weeks
  
  
---
  
  
ABOUT THE NEW PROJECT
  
  
NKSTARS INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED is taking a new initiative to develop an upcoming project and create opportunities for skilled, passionate and motivated individuals to become part of its early development journey.
  
  
Through our Founding Team Volunteer Program, we aim to bring together individuals from different backgrounds who can contribute their knowledge, skills and ideas while gaining practical experience by working on a real project.
  
  
We welcome students, fresh graduates, aspiring professionals and skilled individuals who are interested in learning, contributing and growing together.
  
  
OPEN FUNCTIONAL ROLES
  
  
We are inviting applications across the following areas:
  
  
1. Growth & Marketing
  
2. Content Creation & Communications
  
3. Education & Learning
  
4. Community Management
  
5. Product & Technology
  
6. Research & Development (R&D)
  
7. Operations & Coordination
  
  
Candidates can select their preferred functional area based on their skills, interests and experience.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL GAIN
  
  
We aim to make this a meaningful professional development opportunity for every contributor.
  
  
1. Founding Team Member Recognition
  
  
- Recognition as an early founding team contributor to the new project.
  
- Opportunity to be associated with the project's initial development journey.
  
- Recognition of eligible contributions in the project's internal records and history.
  
  
2. Official Volunteer Certificate
  
  
- Receive an official Founding Team Volunteer Certificate issued by NKSTARS INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED upon successful completion of the program and agreed contribution requirements.
  
  
3. Practical Project Experience
  
  
- Hands-on experience working on actual project activities.
  
- Opportunity to apply your skills in a practical environment.
  
- Exposure to teamwork, planning, research and execution.
  
  
4. Skill Development & Mentorship
  
  
- Improve your professional and technical skills.
  
- Receive guidance and constructive feedback.
  
- Develop communication, teamwork and problem-solving abilities.
  
  
5. Portfolio & Career Development
  
  
- Build practical work experience.
  
- Showcase approved project contributions in your CV, LinkedIn profile and professional portfolio.
  
- Strengthen your professional profile through documented achievements.
  
  
6. Leadership Opportunities
  
  
- Opportunities to take ownership of responsibilities.
  
- Potential to coordinate activities or lead functional initiatives based on performance.
  
  
7. Professional Recommendation
  
  
- Eligible contributors may receive recommendation letters or project contribution references based on verified performance and commitment.
  
  
8. Priority Consideration for Future Paid Opportunities
  
  
As the project develops and the organisation expands, suitable paid positions and project opportunities may become available.
  
  
Volunteers who demonstrate strong performance, consistency, responsibility and relevant skills will receive priority consideration for suitable opportunities within the organisation.
  
  
Future paid opportunities are subject to project growth, business requirements, available budgets and selection criteria. Employment or compensation is not guaranteed.
  
  
TIME COMMITMENT & WORKING MODEL
  
  
We understand that candidates may have academic, personal or professional commitments.
  
  
Therefore, we offer a flexible participation model.
  
  
- Expected contribution: 6–8 hours per week.
  
- Initial program duration: 8 weeks.
  
- One scheduled team coordination meeting per week.
  
- Flexible task completion based on agreed deadlines.
  
- Remote participation available across India.
  
- Occasional in-person meetings may be organised for Coimbatore-based members.
  
  
The schedule and responsibilities will be mutually agreed upon before onboarding. This is not a full-time commitment.
  
  
WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU
  
  
We are looking for individuals who can demonstrate:
  
  
- Genuine interest in contributing to a new project.
  
- Relevant skills or willingness to learn.
  
- Responsibility and consistency in completing assigned tasks.
  
- Good communication and teamwork.
  
- Ability to manage agreed weekly commitments.
  
- Openness to feedback and continuous improvement.
  
- Professional conduct and respect for project confidentiality.
  
  
Applicants should have access to a suitable device and reliable internet connection for their responsibilities.
  
  
Previous professional experience is not mandatory for every role. Students and fresh graduates are welcome.
  
  
SELECTION PROCESS
  
  
1. Application submission.
  
2. Profile review and shortlisting.
  
3. Online interaction or discussion.
  
4. Role-specific assessment, where appropriate.
  
5. Final selection and onboarding.
  
  
Selected candidates will receive their functional responsibilities, program guidelines and participation expectations.
  
  
IMPORTANT PROGRAM INFORMATION
  
  
This is an unpaid and voluntary opportunity associated with a new project initiated by NKSTARS INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED.
  
  
Participation is based on mutually agreed responsibilities and a flexible time commitment. There is no participation fee.
  
  
Certificates, recommendations and recognition are subject to actual contributions and eligibility. Future paid opportunities are not guaranteed.
  
  
LOCATION PREFERENCE
  
  
Coimbatore-based candidates are particularly encouraged to apply, as local participation can make communication, collaboration and occasional in-person meetings easier.
  
  
However, applications are welcome from suitable candidates across India through remote participation.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
**GTM Engineer, Growth Systems**

**Location:**
India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
Typically 2–4 years

**Work Schedule:**
Regular overlap during US Central business hours

**About SchoolPath**

SchoolPath helps families discover schools and education services, compare their options, and take the next step.

We’re looking for an engineer who uses AI in their own work and can turn a growth idea into a working experiment: build it, get it in front of users, measure what changes, and improve it.

One early project is to help a parent go from a specific question about a school to a useful, verified answer and a clear next step, such as saving an option, requesting information, or booking a tour.

**What You'll Own**

* Build and ship AI workflows for parent acquisition, engagement, and follow-up. Connect model APIs, approved data sources, landing pages, analytics, and CRM tools.
* Run growth experiments across acquisition and conversion, including landing pages, calls to action, and technical SEO/GEO. Set a baseline, define what success looks like, and use the results to decide what to improve, expand, or stop.
* Turn verified parent demand into actionable signals for school and provider outreach. Set up routing, follow-up triggers, and CRM records so the team knows what happened and who owns the next step.
* Test for accuracy and reliability. Make answers traceable to their sources, check for stale or conflicting information, and define when to ask a person for help. Use explicit rules for consent, routing, and duplicate records.
* Track outcomes and operating effort. Measure whether more qualified families take the intended next step, alongside answer accuracy, manual effort, and cost. Work with product and engineering to bring proven workflows into production.

**What You'll Bring**

* At least one AI workflow you personally built and shipped for real users or an operating team. Be ready to explain what the model did, how you tested it, what failed, and what improved.
* Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, SQL, and scripting or workflow automation. You can inspect data, troubleshoot integrations, and make changes independently.
* Experience instrumenting a funnel or workflow and using the results to make a decision. Relevant backgrounds include growth engineering, AI automation, product prototyping, and marketing systems engineering.
* Initiative and clear communication. You’re comfortable working with a small team, testing an idea before all the requirements are known, and sharing what you learned.
* Marketplace, consumer growth, or education experience is a plus.

**First 30 Days**

In your first 30 days, establish a baseline and get one measurable pilot running for the parent journey.

**How to Apply**

To apply, share a brief example of an AI workflow you shipped, what you owned, and what changed as a result. A sanitized example is welcome.
