title: Sr. Manager, Digital Product Management
description:
**Work Schedule**

**Environmental Conditions**

**Job Description**

When you're part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll do meaningful work that enables our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As the world leader in serving science, our digital ecosystem powers billions of dollars in customer interactions and supports scientists, researchers, healthcare professionals and industrial customers around the globe. Our Digital Customer Experience organization is responsible for defining and delivering the future of digital commerce across our digital experiences.

As a Senior Digital Product Manager, APAC, you will serve as the regional product leader connecting Asia Pacific market performance, customer needs and commercial priorities to Thermo Fisher Scientific's global digital product strategy. You will develop a fact-based point of view on where Digital can improve customer outcomes and commercial performance across the region, with particular attention to the different market structures, customer behaviors, dealer models and platform maturity that shape digital adoption in APAC.

This role is intentionally positioned in-region. You will work closely with regional Commercial, Marketing, and eBusiness leaders while partnering with global Product Management, UX, Analytics and platform teams. Your responsibility is not simply to represent regional requests. You will co-create product direction with the markets, distinguish local requirements from scalable patterns and ensure regional insights influence enterprise product decisions.

Success requires strong product judgment, commercial acumen and the ability to operate across a complex portfolio of global and localized digital experiences. You will be expected to understand revenue and funnel performance across the region, develop hypotheses about performance drivers, identify opportunities for experimentation and bring a clear recommendation back to the broader product organization. You will also identify successful regional capabilities and operating models that may warrant broader global scale.

**How You Will Make an Impact**
===============================

**Regional Product Vision and Strategy**
----------------------------------------

* Define and evolve the digital product vision for APAC, grounded in customer evidence, regional commercial priorities, competitive context and measurable business outcomes.
* Translate differences across markets into a contextualized regional strategy that clarifies what should be globally standardized, regionally adapted or locally differentiated.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year regional product roadmap that connects APAC priorities to global platform and experience roadmaps.
* Distinguish business requests from underlying customer and commercial problems, then recommend the most effective product intervention.
* Identify opportunities that span markets, sites or organizational boundaries and drive alignment on reusable capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
* Bring a clear APAC point of view into global product planning, investment discussions and roadmap trade-offs.

**Revenue, Funnel and Market Performance Leadership**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Develop command of digital revenue, engaged traffic, funnel performance, adoption and conversion across APAC markets and the digital platforms available to local teams.
* Partner with Finance, Commercial and regional stakeholders to understand performance versus plan and prior year, identify meaningful trends and explain the drivers behind regional variation.
* Build hypotheses that distinguish macroeconomic or market softness from addressable digital performance gaps.
* Bring regional insights back into the corporate product organization so market learning informs enterprise priorities, investment decisions and roadmap sequencing.

**Customer, Market and Dealer Insight**
---------------------------------------

* Establish a disciplined customer and market insight cadence using direct customer engagement, Sales and service feedback, behavioral analytics, CAS or satisfaction signals and competitive benchmarking.
* Develop a strong understanding of dealer and distributor personas across APAC, including which needs are common across markets and which are country-specific.
* Partner with UX and Research to validate customer problems before committing to solutions and ensure regional experiences reflect real customer behavior.
* Monitor local competitors, digital commerce practices and emerging market behaviors to identify opportunities for differentiation.

**Global-to-Local and Local-to-Global Product Leadership**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Accelerate adoption of global digital capabilities across APAC by translating enterprise products into relevant regional use cases, enablement plans and measurable adoption outcomes.
* Identify successful regional capabilities, market practices or customer solutions that have the potential to scale beyond a single country.
* Build the business and customer case for when localized innovation should be standardized or incorporated into global platforms.
* Anticipate dependencies across markets and product portfolios and proactively align roadmaps to reduce fragmentation.

**Cross-Functional Product Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Serve as a strategic product partner to APAC Marketing, eBusiness and regional leadership teams.
* Make and communicate prioritization recommendations when customer, regional, commercial and technical needs compete for investment.
* Clearly articulate expected customer and business outcomes, trade-offs, risks and strategic rationale to both senior executives and delivery teams.
* Create operating mechanisms that keep regional teams informed while avoiding a model centered on status reporting or request intake.
* Influence without direct authority and create momentum across globally distributed teams.

**Product Discovery and Delivery**
----------------------------------

* Lead discovery for regional customer and commercial problems before committing teams to specific solutions.
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product outcomes, requirements and MVP strategies that enable UX and Engineering teams to execute effectively.
* Determine the smallest meaningful intervention needed to validate a hypothesis and define criteria for scaling, iterating or stopping.
* Balance immediate market needs with the development of reusable global or regional platform capabilities.
* Maintain accountability for customer and business outcomes throughout the product lifecycle rather than measuring success primarily through feature delivery.

**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 7+ years of experience in Digital Product Management, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience or closely related roles.
* Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and owning roadmaps for customer-facing digital products.
* Experience leading product decisions in complex, cross-functional and geographically distributed environments.
* Experience using revenue, funnel, behavioral analytics, customer insights and experimentation to make prioritization and investment decisions.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer and business problems into product strategy, measurable outcomes and executable roadmaps.
* Strong ability to communicate strategy, recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, commercial leaders and technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with dealer or distributor portals, localized commerce models, market expansion or regional digital transformation.
* Experience delivering digital commerce capabilities for B2B customers, distributors, dealers, procurement organizations or enterprise purchasing workflows.
* Experience managing digital revenue or funnel performance and translating business performance into product interventions.
* Experience with global digital platforms that must support regional and market-specific requirements.
* Experience collaborating across cultures and time zones and influencing teams without direct authority.
* MBA or advanced business education.

**Key Capabilities for Success**
================================

* Regional strategic product leadership: Builds a clear product point of view from customer, commercial and market evidence rather than serving primarily as a conduit for requests.
* Commercial acumen: Understands revenue, funnel and market performance and can identify where Digital has meaningful levers to change outcomes.
* Customer and market grounding: Uses direct customer evidence, analytics, Sales insight, competitive context and emerging market or technology signals to challenge assumptions and guide priorities.
* Systems thinking: Understands how local market decisions interact with global platforms, shared capabilities and the broader customer journey.
* Global-local judgment: Recognizes when a market need should be localized, when a global capability should be adopted and when regional innovation has potential for enterprise scale.
* Influence and alignment: Builds trust across regional and global teams while remaining comfortable making recommendations and difficult trade-offs.
* Clear communication: Synthesizes complex performance and customer signals into a concise point of view for executive, commercial and technical audiences.
* Ownership: Takes accountability for customer and business outcomes from discovery through delivery, adoption and optimization.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the role**  
  
We are hiring a Product Manager — Household Data Products to own a portfolio of data products within Target's Household product line: from household definitions and taxonomy, through certified datasets, pipelines, quality and governance, to the applications that Media, Promotions, Merchandising and Loyalty teams use to make decisions.  
  
Household is how Target understands its guests as the real-world units that shop together. This role takes the household foundation and turns it into trusted, reusable data products and decision-ready applications — answering questions like which households we acquired, retained or reactivated, what drove it, and how we should market, promote and assort for them.  
  
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Identity and business partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and data contracts, and make sure household data products are trusted, well-governed and adopted. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll own**  
  
**Household Foundations – Must Have**  
  
You will help build and own the household foundation layer that every downstream use case depends on: stable, certified household datasets built on the enterprise household identity (owned by the Identity team), with consistent definitions that business partners can trust and reuse.

* Household lifecycle definitions and formats — acquisition, retention, reactivation and new-to-category — agreed with Analytics and Finance and published as certified data products.
* Household attributes and taxonomy — life stage, composition, demographics, interests and purchase behaviour, including third-party enrichment — with clear ownership, lineage and refresh cadence.
* Household-level enterprise KPIs such as household-based conversion, taken from definition through UAT, sign-off and production.

**Household Applications – Must Have**  
  
You will help turn the foundation into applications that change decisions across the enterprise, delivering against a roadmap shaped with your manager and business partners:

* Media — map household cohorts to the campaigns they were exposed to, starting with diagnostics and extending to Roundel (retail media) audiences and measurement.
* Promotions — connect households to promotion performance so promo teams can see who a promotion actually reached and moved.
* Merchandising — household views of newness-led acquisition and assortment relevancy by life stage.
* Enterprise growth — an acquisition and reactivation waterfall across drivers (marketing including Roundel, promotions, brand marketing, newness and assortment, new stores), plus who the acquired households are.

**Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have**  
  
Strong working knowledge of analytics and data concepts, with the ability to partner effectively with Analytics and Data Science teams. You should be comfortable with:

* Household and guest-level analytics, cohorts and segmentation
* Entity resolution and identity concepts (guest-to-household mapping, match rates, stability)
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data quality, reconciliation and metric definitions in a semantic layer
* Privacy, consent and responsible use of guest and household data

**Building data products with Data Engineering**  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs and data contracts, prioritising the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design, cost and sequencing.  
  
**Platform & ecosystem stewardship**  
  
Solid understanding of our data platform and cloud environment (GCP, BigQuery, Power BI). You make household data easy to discover, access and consume — through the certified gold layer, documented data products and self-serve paths for analysts and downstream platforms.  
  
**Trust, governance & data quality — critical**  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. Household data drives audience targeting, measurement and executive reporting, so an unstable household ID or a wrong definition ripples across every team that uses it. You own certification, quality monitoring, access and consent controls for the household product line.  
  
**Stakeholder partnership**  
  
You will work with partners across Marketing, Roundel, Loyalty, Promotions and Merchandising to gather requirements, clarify competing asks, and communicate progress, trade-offs and impact clearly to stakeholders and leadership.  
  
**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years in product management (or 5+ years in closely related data, analytics or engineering roles with product exposure), with experience on customer or household data products, CDP / customer 360, identity, data platforms, or AdTech/MarTech and retail media.
* Strong understanding of customer and household analytics — lifecycle (acquisition, retention, reactivation), segmentation, cohorts and life-stage modelling.
* Familiarity with identity resolution and householding concepts, and with how household data powers audiences, measurement and personalisation.
* Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritising a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (lakehouse, data mesh or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, privacy and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Experience translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and working effectively with cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong product management practices and excellent communication with Data Engineering, Analysts, Data Scientists and business stakeholders.
* Nice to have: exposure to marketing measurement (attribution, MTA, MMM), promotions or merchandising analytics, or third-party data enrichment.

title: Technical Projects Systems Engineer
description:
**Position Description:** Customer Proof of Concepts Engineer
  
  
Organization Overview
  
  
Global Demonstration Engineering leads the industry in delivering innovative, demonstration-centric experiences of Cisco solutions to customers. We provide a comprehensive, integrated sales-enablement portfolio that helps sales teams and partners showcase how Cisco products enhance productivity, expand sales opportunities, and shorten sales cycles. Our Cisco dCloud platform offers scripted, repeatable demos and fully customizable labs with complete administrative access, accessible on any network, device, and location. The dCloud platform not only improves user experiences but also drives business growth.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Proof-of-Concept (POC) Specialist is a Systems Engineer (SE) responsible for the end-to-end development, planning, design, delivery, and coordination of Customer Proof of Concept Labs, primarily focused on Enterprise Networking and Nexus (NX) technologies, but may include other Cisco technologies. This role involves close collaboration with Business Units (BUs), Content Developers, Partners (internal and third-party), and account teams throughout the POC lifecycle—from introduction through build, testing, and final customer delivery. The specialist will gather customer requirements, define testing criteria, and ensure POC objectives are met.

Project Management (10%)
  
  

* Identify, prioritize, and organize all project-related tasks.
* Strategize and communicate project goals and objectives across organizational levels.
* Ensure effective status reporting from all third-party developers involved in assigned projects.

Platform Design (20%)

Support (10%)

* Proven project delivery, project management, and time management skills.

Additional Desired Skills
  
  

* Basic programming and scripting skills in Go, Python, Ruby, PowerShell, XML, SQL, etc.
* Basic web development and scripting knowledge.

Qualifications and Competencies
  
  

* Strong self-management and time management skills with the ability to organize competing priorities across global time zones.
* Sense of urgency and adaptability to shifting team demands and critical time-to-market business needs.
* Flexibility to handle a wide range of tasks and rapidly switch between projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Analytical skills to use source materials effectively, think critically, identify risks, and recommend actions.

* Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, with an emphasis on building relationships and promoting collaborative goals.

* Strong analytical skills and proficiency with tools like Google Analytics, Mixpanel, and SQL.

* Ability to collaborate effectively across design, engineering, and business functions.

Apply Now & Join Us in shaping a healthier, happier world—one habit at a time!

* Sound decision-making skills, even in uncertain situations, with a focus on risk management.

* Influencing skills to persuade others and gain support for ideas and approaches.
* Effective communication skills, both verbally and in writing, adapting to various contexts.
* Strong commitment to excellence, challenging oneself and others to achieve outstanding results.

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field is essential.
* A Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., MBA, Finance, or Supply Chain Management) is highly desirable,
* A minimum of 5-7 years of experience Order to Cash processes or a related financial operations role, with at least 3 years in a leadership or supervisory position managing a sizable team.
* Proven track record of successful team management, demonstrating the ability to lead, motivate, and develop a team of 18 to 20 members or more.

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across different time zones, particularly with teams and stakeholders in the EU and Americas, showcasing flexibility and adaptability.
* Experience in implementing process improvements, driving efficiency, and ensuring adherence to internal controls and compliance standards.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, external partners, and senior management.

title: Manager - Finance & Accounts
description:
**Role :**
Manager - Finance & Accounts

**Experience:**
8–10 years

**Location:**
Chennai, Onsite

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Statutory compliance**

* Ensure timely and accurate GST compliance: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9/9C, ITC reconciliation with GSTR-2B, e-invoicing and e-way bills.
* Manage TDS/TCS: deduction, monthly deposits, quarterly returns (24Q, 26Q, 27Q), Form 16/16A issuance and 26AS/AIS reconciliation.
* Oversee payroll statutory dues: EPF, ESI, Professional Tax and Labor Welfare Fund remittances and returns.
* Coordinate ROC/MCA filings (AOC-4, MGT-7, DPT-3, MSME-1 and event-based forms) with the Company Secretary.
* Handle advance tax, income tax returns, tax audit support and transfer pricing documentation where applicable.
* Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and respond to notices and assessments from GST, Income Tax and other authorities.

**2. Statutory audit and auditor liaison**

* Drive month-end and year-end closing, and prepare financial statements under Schedule III and applicable Ind AS / AS.
* Act as primary point of contact for statutory, internal and tax auditors; prepare schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents.
* Close audit observations on time and implement recommended control improvements.
* Maintain fixed asset register, ledger scrutiny and reconciliations so the books are audit-ready year round.

**3. MIS, AOP, budgeting and forecasting**

* Prepare monthly MIS: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, budget vs actual variance analysis and key business metrics.
* Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and departmental budgets with business heads.
* Prepare rolling forecasts for revenue, expenses and cash, and flag deviations to management early.
* Support management with cost analysis, profitability reviews and ad hoc financial reports.

**4. Team management**

* Lead, guide and review the work of the accounts team; allocate tasks and set clear deadlines.
* Define processes, SOPs and internal controls for accounting, payables, receivables and compliance.
* Train team members and drive automation and system improvements in the accounting software.

**5. Vendor payments**

* Oversee the accounts payable cycle: invoice verification, three-way matching with PO and GRN, and approvals.
* Plan and release vendor payments as per agreed terms and cash availability, ensuring TDS and GST compliance.
* Reconcile vendor ledgers periodically and resolve disputes; monitor MSME payment timelines under Section 43B(h).

**6. Invoicing and collection follow-up**

* Ensure accurate and timely customer invoicing in line with contracts, including e-invoicing where applicable.
* Track receivables and ageing; follow up with customers to collect within credit terms.
* Reconcile customer ledgers, issue credit/debit notes, and report overdue accounts and DSO to management.

**7. Banking and treasury**

* Manage day-to-day banking: payments, receipts, fund transfers and bank portal administration.
* Perform monthly bank reconciliations and monitor cash and fund positions daily.
* Coordinate with banks on account opening, KYC, facilities, guarantees, FDs and forex transactions (FIRC, export proceeds, inward/outward remittances).
* Plan short-term cash flow to meet payroll, statutory dues and vendor obligations.

**Qualifications and skills**

**Education:**
CA / CMA (qualified or inter) or M.Com / MBA (Finance).

**Experience:**
**8–10 years in accounts, finance and statutory compliance, with at least 3 years managing a team**
.

**Technical skills**

* Strong working knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax, Companies Act and labour law compliances.
* Hands-on experience with Tally Prime and/or Zoho Books; familiarity with ERP systems is a plus.
* Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, financial models); exposure to BI tools is a plus.
* Experience handling statutory audits and preparing financial statements.

**Behavioral skills**

* High attention to detail and accuracy; disciplined about reconciling every figure.
* Clear communication with auditors, banks, vendors, customers and management.
* Ability to work to deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
* Integrity and confidentiality in handling financial information.

description:

NetoAI is a fast-growing AI platform company building industry-specific AI solutions, recognised by leading global analysts and trusted by enterprise customers and technology partners worldwide. Role Description

The Head of Finance will build NetoAI's finance function from the ground up and scale it to support a multi-entity, multi-geography product company. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has taken a finance function from early stage to scale-up, and who can act as a strategic partner to the leadership team while putting robust systems, controls and governance in place.

•

The Finance Consultant ensures through cooperation with the other consultants that all support of RockBis Group is done in only one way with a common data structure and common data definitions.
  
  
The Finance Consultant has the responsibility to become / stay the SAP FI-expert in the finance area, by attending following the developments in the system and the market.
  
  
The Finance Consultant keeps his line manager informed about status, plans and possible problems and proposals for improvements in connection with all planned and started support cases and projects.

* Active listening

title: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)
description:
Job Overview
  

We are looking for a Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) to manage and oversee financial operations, accounting activities, taxation, statutory compliance and financial reporting.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of financial management, GST, TDS, auditing, budgeting and project-based accounting, with the ability to independently manage financial activities across multiple business operations.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Financial Management & Accounting
  
  
  

* Oversee day-to-day accounting and financial operations.
* Manage financial statements, balance sheets, profit and loss accounts and cash flow statements.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of books of accounts.
* Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable and vendor payments.
* Handle project-wise costing and financial performance analysis.

2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance
  
  
  

* Manage GST returns, GST reconciliation and related compliances.
* Handle TDS calculations, deductions, returns and payments.
* Ensure timely income tax filings and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants.
* Ensure compliance with applicable financial and taxation regulations.

3. Audit & Financial Reporting
  
  
  

* Handle internal and statutory audit requirements.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports.
* Conduct financial reconciliations and identify discrepancies.
* Maintain proper financial documentation and records.

4. Budgeting & Financial Planning
  
  
  

* Prepare annual budgets and financial forecasts.
* Monitor project-wise expenses and operational costs.
* Analyse revenue, profitability and cost variations.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and financial efficiency.

5. Project & Operational Finance
  
  
  

* Monitor financial activities related to facility management and infrastructure projects.
* Review project expenses, manpower costs and vendor bills.
* Monitor contract billing, collections and payment cycles.
* Ensure accurate project-wise financial reporting.

6. Management Coordination
  
  
  

* Provide financial insights and reports to senior management.
* Support management in financial planning and business decisions.
* Coordinate with HR, operations, procurement and project teams regarding financial matters.

Educational Qualification
  

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from ICAI.
* Must have cleared CA Final – Both Groups.
* Active ICAI membership preferred.

Required Skills
  

* Financial Accounting & Reporting
* GST & TDS Compliance
* Income Tax & Taxation
* Statutory & Internal Auditing
* Budgeting & Forecasting
* Financial Planning & Analysis
* Project Accounting & Cost Control
* Cash Flow Management
* MIS Reporting
* Advanced MS Excel

Preferred Candidate Profile
  

* 3–5 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
* Experience in infrastructure, facility management, construction, contracting or service-based industries is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently manage financial operations.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and compliance.

**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
**Work Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  
**Work Mode:**
On-site

The Senior Tax Analyst will join Gigamon’s global tax function and support U.S. federal, state and local, and international tax activities. Based in Chennai, this role will partner closely with the Director, Accounting Operations, the Senior Director of Tax, Accounting teams in the U.S. and India, external tax advisors, tax authorities, and business stakeholders. The position will contribute to accurate and timely tax compliance, tax accounting, reconciliations, audits, notices, and related projects. Success in this role requires strong technical knowledge, careful attention to detail, and effective collaboration across U.S. and India time zones.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Prepare, review, and support state and local sales, use, commercial activity, and other indirect tax returns.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly sales and use tax accruals and support related account reconciliations.

* Prepare and submit responses to federal, state, and local tax notices in coordination with internal stakeholders and external advisors.

* Support the annual income tax provision process under ASC 740 by gathering data, preparing provision schedules and journal entries, reconciling tax accounts, and maintaining documentation.
* Assist with estimated tax payment analysis and review tax-related general ledger activity.
* Maintain organized, accurate, and review-ready tax workpapers and supporting documentation.
* Contribute to accounting and other tax-related special projects as needed.

* Earned a Chartered Accountant qualification or are a semi-qualified Chartered Accountant with a bachelor’s degree in accounting.
* Gained approximately 3–6 years of progressive accounting and tax experience, including meaningful corporate tax experience.
* Developed experience with U.S. sales and use tax, income tax compliance, tax accounting, or a comparable combination of tax disciplines.
* Demonstrated strong Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with large data sets, reconciliations, lookups, pivot tables, and supporting schedules.
* Worked with an enterprise resource planning or general ledger system; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is preferred.

* An adaptable team member who works effectively with colleagues, advisors, and business partners across functions and geographies.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how products work in practice and using that insight to decide what should change and why.

  

**Responsibilities (What you’ll do)**

  

**Discover opportunities and shape product direction**

* Build a deep understanding of visitor, exhibitor, and event-team needs through research, stakeholder conversations, product data, and live-event observation.
* Look beyond feature requests to uncover underlying problems, test assumptions, and distinguish local needs from opportunities with broader value.
* Assess opportunities across registration, eCommerce, and related journeys, including improvements that support revenue growth, customer experience, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations and proportionate business cases that clearly explain benefits, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Own and maintain a prioritized opportunity backlog for your area and contribute to the broader product strategy and roadmap.
  

  

**Turn priorities into measurable improvements**

* Partner with Design, Engineering, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to translate validated opportunities into clear outcomes, scope, and requirements.
* Balance customer value and business priorities with technical feasibility, operational readiness, and the needs of a shared global platform.
* Work with adjacent product and business-system teams to manage dependencies across end-to-end journeys.
* Partner with Product Analytics to define success measures, establish baselines, and evaluate releases and experiments.
* Use launch results, customer feedback, and product performance to refine priorities and continuously improve the product.
  

  

**Partner with business units on rollout and adoption**

* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across registration, marketing, commercial, and event teams.
* Initially lead agreed product-engagement forums to clarify priorities, communicate roadmap decisions, and maintain visibility of adoption barriers and dependencies.
* Assess how well existing capabilities meet event requirements and determine whether process changes, configuration, or product development is the right response.
* Work with Product Success and delivery teams on launch readiness, pilots, and adoption plans, helping teams understand available capabilities and required business changes.
* Provide product input on significant issues through established support and escalation processes, ensuring recurring problems drive product improvements rather than repeated workarounds.
* Communicate decisions, constraints, and next steps clearly without committing ahead of discovery or delivery agreement.
  

  

**Help build a scalable Product–Product Success partnership**

* Establish clear responsibilities, decision-making boundaries, and feedback loops across Product, Product Success, and business units.
* Support the phased transfer of agreed go-to-market and stakeholder-coordination activities through shared documentation, knowledge transfer, and joint working.
* Maintain continuity for business units as responsibilities evolve, pacing handovers to agreed readiness and capacity.
* Equip Product Success colleagues with clear product context, value propositions, and guidance, while using their adoption insights to inform discovery.
* Retain ownership of product priorities and outcomes within your remit as more day-to-day engagement and coordination moves to Product Success.
  

**Requirements (What you’ll bring)**

* Experience managing digital products or a clearly defined product area, from problem discovery and opportunity prioritization through delivery and evaluation.
* Evidence of improvements that delivered customer or business outcomes, rather than simply completed features or project milestones.
* Strong discovery and analytical skills, including the ability to combine qualitative and quantitative evidence and recognize data limitations.
* Sound prioritization and commercial judgment, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, explain trade-offs, and constructively say “not yet.”
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams in an agile product-development environment.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, including influencing across functions and balancing regional needs with global product goals.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences, plus a practical understanding of rollout, adoption, and business change.
* The ability to learn complex workflows and integrations, navigate ambiguity, and stay focused on the highest-value problems.
  

**Useful, but not essential**

* Experience with registration, ticketing, eCommerce, payments, or other transaction-based digital products.
* Experience with global platforms serving multiple markets, business units, or customer groups.
* Familiarity with products connected to finance, CRM, identity, marketing, or reporting systems.
* Experience working with Product Success, Customer Success, or implementation teams on launches, adoption, and structured handovers.
* Experience with experimentation, conversion optimization, product analytics, or digital revenue growth.
* Experience in events or other time-critical environments where reliability and operational readiness are essential.
  

**What success looks like**

* Clear, evidence-based product priorities balancing customer needs, business value, and platform scalability.
* Product improvements with defined outcomes and measurable impact.
* Business units that understand product direction, adoption requirements, and the rationale behind decisions.
* Successful rollout and adoption of agreed capabilities, with risks and dependencies identified early.
* A sustainable partnership with Product Success, with responsibilities transferred progressively and without gaps in business engagement.
* More capacity for proactive discovery and continuous improvement, supported by strong customer and business insight.
  

**Why join us?**

You’ll work on a business-critical global platform with a direct connection to real customer experiences. The role combines hands-on business engagement with end-to-end product management, giving you the opportunity to shape both the product and how its value reaches customers.

  

**Work in a Way That Works for You**

We support a healthy work-life balance and flexible ways of working. Wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals can help you meet both immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.

  

**Working for You**

Your wellbeing is central to a long and successful career. Benefits include:

* Comprehensive health insurance for you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced health insurance options at company-negotiated rates.
* Group life insurance.
* Group accident insurance covering accidental death and permanent disability.
* Flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program for personal and work-related support.

* Long-service awards.
* New baby gift.
* Subsidized meals in Chennai.
* Paid time off, including Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.

RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, using industry expertise, data, and technology to help individuals, communities, and organizations build their businesses. title: Technical Publications Engineer III
description:
Overview:

Technical Publication engineer III is responsible for development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of product information and documentation solutions for existing and future products. This position serves as a senior technical writer for technical publications, document architecture, content management, localization, and regulatory documentation requirements. The role collaborates with cross-functional teams including Marketing, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Education, Service, and Manufacturing to ensure documentation supports customer needs, product usability, regulatory compliance, and business objectives.

Technical Publication engineer III provides strategic guidance on content development processes, drives documentation standards and best practices, and manages complex documentation projects across multiple product portfolios.

Responsibilities:

* Provide the planning, development, review, approval, and maintenance of product documentation, including Instructions for Use (IFUs), Operator Manuals, Service Manuals, Installation Guides, Security manuals, System Administration manuals, Data sheets, Release Notes, and Online help systems.
* Define documentation strategies, content architecture, and information design standards to improve usability and consistency across product lines.
* Establish and maintain technical writing standards, templates, style guides, and controlled documentation processes.
* Evaluate and implement best practices for structured authoring, content reuse, and documentation efficiency.
* Serve as the publication’s representative on new product development and sustaining engineering projects.
* Partner with Engineering, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Quality Assurance, Human Factors Engineering, and Service teams to gather and validate technical information.
* Provide documentation impact assessments for product changes, design updates, and regulatory submissions.
* Participate in design reviews, risk management activities, verification and validation reviews, and product launch planning.
* Ensure documentation complies with applicable regulatory requirements, including FDA, EU MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62366, and other global medical device regulations.
* Support regulatory submissions and audit activities by providing documentation expertise and evidence of compliance.
* Review labeling, safety information, warnings, cautions, and instructions to ensure consistency with regulatory requirements.
* Supporting the global localization activities and coordinate translation vendors to support worldwide product releases.
* Define localization strategies and workflows to improve quality, consistency, and delivery timelines.
* Manage content within document control systems, Quality Management Systems (QMS), Content Management Systems (CMS), and Translation Management Systems (TMS).
* Manage multiple complex documentation projects with minimal supervision.
* Develop project schedules, identify risks, and ensure timely delivery of documentation deliverables.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to documentation tools, workflows, automation, and content development processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve documentation quality, usability, and operational efficiency.
* Conduct peer reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure high-quality content.
* Promote best practices in technical communication and content development
* Uphold the company’s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork.
* Demonstrate behavior consistent with the company’s Code of Ethics and Conduct.
* It is the responsibility of every employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem.
* Duties may be modified or assigned at any time to meet the needs of the business.

  
Qualifications:

* Minimum 8+ years of technical writing experience, preferably within the medical device, healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industries.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or related discipline required.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical documentation projects from concept through product release.
* Experience supporting regulatory compliance and quality system requirements in regulated environments.
* Expert proficiency with Adobe FrameMaker, InDesign, Photoshop, and Microsoft Office.
* Strong experience with Structured FrameMaker, XML, DITA, CMS, and TMS platforms.
* Experience with graphics creation, content reuse strategies, and structured authoring methodologies.
* Familiarity with software development life cycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and product development processes.
* Working knowledge of usability engineering, and human factors documentation.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functional areas.
* Ability to work independently and make sound decisions with limited supervision.
* Experience managing external translation and localization vendors

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**Key Responsibilities**  
As the Product Manager for P&DI for energy sector data products (specifically, areas like solar), you will own the product lifecycle of our offerings and also run program management across the product portfolio. Your responsibilities will be to:

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for relevant products, from opportunity discovery and business case through launch, scale-up and lifecycle management.
* Translate utility, C&I and consumer needs into clear problem statements, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and prioritise the backlog against business value, effort and risk.
* Work closely with Engineering, Data Science, IoT/hardware, Design and Operations teams to deliver products on time and with high quality, running sprint planning, reviews and release readiness.
* Define pricing, packaging and go-to-market plans for new energy products in partnership with Sales, Marketing and Partnerships, and support pilots and early customer deployments.
* Define product KPIs and success metrics (adoption, energy savings, revenue, reliability, customer satisfaction), and use data and customer feedback to iterate on the product.
* Run program management across all P&DI products for energy: maintain an integrated plan of milestones, dependencies, risks and resourcing, and drive cross-functional alignment on timelines and scope.
* Set up and run a consistent program governance rhythm, including status reporting, risk and issue escalation, change control and steering reviews with senior leadership.
* Track budgets, vendor and partner deliverables, and compliance with regulatory, security, data privacy and enterprise standards across programs.
* Conduct market, competitor and regulatory research in the energy sector (solar, storage, EV charging, smart metering, demand response, energy analytics) to shape product direction.
* Build reusable product and program playbooks, templates and tools that improve predictability and speed across teams.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, customers and partners, and act as a thought partner who challenges assumptions and adapts priorities as needs change.

Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field from a reputed university. An MBA or advanced degree will be an added advantage.
* 4–6 years of experience in product management, with at least 1–2 years running multi-team programs or projects, preferably in energy, utilities, IoT, cleantech or B2B technology.
* Proven track record of taking a product from concept to launch and scale, including writing PRDs, managing backlogs and working in agile teams.
* Strong program management skills: planning, dependency and risk management, stakeholder governance and delivery tracking across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Good understanding of the energy value chain and technologies such as solar, battery storage, EV charging, smart meters, and energy management or analytics platforms.
* Working knowledge of IoT and data-driven products, including APIs, platform architecture, dashboards and analytics, with the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams.
* Ability to build business cases, pricing models and financial plans, and to define and track product metrics using data (SQL, BI tools or similar).
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or equivalent, and with product and prototyping tools such as Figma.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
This is a production support role focused on improving the stability and uptime of HSBC’s Contact Centre voice platforms across Genesys Engage and Genesys Cloud. You’ll provide L2/L3 support in a critical environment - restoring service quickly during incidents and reducing repeat issues through structured problem management. description:

**Job Snapshot**
We’re looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead strategic, customer-facing programs within our Professional Services organization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of program leadership, client management, and operational excellence, bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to complex customer engagements across multiple projects and service lines. You’ll work closely with enterprise and commercial customers, internal delivery teams, and senior stakeholders to ensure seamless execution, measurable business impact, and a consistently high-quality experience across all Professional Services programs. If you excel at turning ambiguity into action, orchestrating multiple stakeholders, balancing competing priorities, and ensuring outcomes that delight customers, this role is for you.
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**

* Customer Program Leadership
* Lead multiple concurrent customer programs and projects across implementation, content delivery, managed services and technical solutions workstreams — ensuring timely, high-quality, and predictable delivery.
* Build trusted relationships with customer executives and internal stakeholders to align program goals with strategic business outcomes.
* Translate customer objectives into structured delivery plans with clear timelines, milestones, and measurable success metrics.
* Participate in pre-sales efforts, contributing to scoping, effort estimation, and proposal creation in partnership with Sales, Solutions, and Delivery teams.
* Program Governance & Delivery Excellence
* Establish and maintain robust program governance frameworks, ensuring transparency, accountability, and consistency across customer workstreams.

* Define and track delivery metrics (SLA adherence, quality, customer satisfaction) to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Prepare and share timely reports with customers and internal stakeholders to maintain alignment on deliverables, effort consumed, and budget adherence.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with teams across other professional services lines, Customer Success, Product, and Operations to ensure alignment on dependencies, priorities, and customer outcomes.
* Act as the connective link between Professional Services, customer leadership, and customer-facing teams, ensuring shared visibility and cohesive execution.
* Collaborate with Sales and Solutions teams during pre-sales and expansion opportunities to shape delivery plans and ensure solution feasibility.
* Operational Maturity & Scale Enablement
* Define, standardize, and continuously enhance program management frameworks, delivery processes, and playbooks to improve efficiency and scalability across service lines.
* Lead operational excellence initiatives focused on workflow optimization, process automation, and performance measurement.
* Mentor and coach Program and Project Managers, driving a culture of ownership, accountability, and delivery excellence.
* Communication & Stakeholder Management
* Deliver clear, executive-ready updates — translating complex program progress into actionable insights for both internal and external audiences.
* Proactively manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring visibility into risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Facilitate alignment across leadership, delivery, and customer stakeholders through structured communication and governance cadence.

**We’d love to hear from you, if you:**

* 8–10 years of experience in program or delivery management, preferably within enterprise SaaS, consulting, or professional services environments.
* Proven track record of leading large, multi-stakeholder programs with measurable business outcomes across multiple customers or service portfolios.
* Demonstrated success in driving risk management, operational excellence, and scalable governance models across delivery teams.
* Client Leadership: Skilled in managing enterprise and commercial customers, building trusted relationships, and ensuring alignment at executive and operational levels.
* Program Orchestration: Adept at balancing multiple concurrent priorities, managing cross-functional dependencies, and ensuring predictable, high-quality delivery.
* Risk Management: Proactive in identifying, communicating, and mitigating risks to maintain delivery predictability and customer confidence.
* Strategic Execution: Ability to balance tactical project delivery with long-term program vision, ensuring all initiatives align with strategic business outcomes.
* Communication Excellence: Able to communicate clearly, persuasively, and effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Agility & Prioritization: Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments; anticipate challenges, prioritize effectively among competing priorities, and adapt quickly to change.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or enterprise consulting organizations.
* Exposure to SaaS implementation, managed services, or enablement delivery models.
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, BI platforms, or workflow automation solutions.

****Our Culture & Values****
We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.
  
  
Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.
  
  
Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.
  
  
We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.
  
  
We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.
  
  
**Mindtickle is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer**
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

* Gather market and competitive intelligence and apply these insights into compelling product value propositions.
* Recommend and co-identify key product, segmentation, and positioning opportunities by leveraging data and insights.

All about you

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Customer Executive Engagement Leader
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a senior individual contributor who will be responsible for orchestrating and elevating executive customer engagement across AWS India’s highest-priority accounts and strategic partners.
  
This role is the strategic connector between AWS India’s senior leadership and our key customers and partners. The leader will own the end-to-end executive engagement lifecycle from designing engagement programs and running the Executive Briefing Center (EBC) program for India, to driving follow-through on customer commitments made by the President of AWS India & South Asia. Beyond specific engagement responsibilities, this leader will identify and resolve cross-organizational blockers, maximise the AWS India & SE President’s leverage in customer-facing engagements, and build scalable mechanisms that institutionalize executive engagement across the India business.
  
Reporting directly into the AWS India & SE President, we are looking for a highly motivated professional who can self-start, cut through ambiguity, work with and through other teams to deliver outcomes, move fast, and roll up their sleeves when needed. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, can scale through influence rather than direct authority, and brings a relentless customer obsession with a bias for action.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Scale through influence and get things done with and through others without direct reporting line authority.
* Own and drive executive engagement programs, ensuring every interaction creates lasting customer value.
* Serve as the single-threaded owner for customer commitment follow-through including tracking, unblocking, escalating, and closing the loop on behalf of the AWS India & SE President.
* Liaise across Sales, Partner, Marketing, Specialist, Technology, and Global Sales Operations teams, providing the connective tissue to keep customer engagements organised and on track.
* Partner with Field Enablement to coach and elevate sellers on executive engagement, raising the bar across the India sales organisation.
* Champion an “Always-On” engagement model that maintains continuous, value-driven touchpoints with strategic customer executives.
* Represent India in regional and global executive engagement forums, bridging local customer context to APJC and worldwide priorities.
* Be an excellent communicator (both written and verbal) who can influence, respectfully challenge, build credibility, and articulate recommendations to VP-level executives.
* Transition easily from high-level strategic thinking to creative and detailed execution, with an even keel in a highly ambiguous environment.

  
  
About the team  
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role operating at the nexus of AWS India’s most important customer relationships. You will work across India’s highest-priority accounts spanning enterprise, digital-native, and public sector customers ensuring that every executive interaction creates lasting value.
  
The role requires exceptional judgment and discretion, as you will regularly handle sensitive customer information and executive commitments. You must be equally comfortable preparing the AWS India & SE President for a Board-level meeting and rolling up your sleeves to chase down a deliverable across cross functional teams.
  
This position is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, gets energy from connecting people and ideas, and measures their success by the outcomes they enable rather than the authority they hold. If you can influence without authority, navigate complexity with grace, and care deeply about keeping promises to customers we want to talk to you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience communicating and handling cross-functional programs including project stakeholders, technical program managers, and software development teams
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
* • 10+ years of experience in customer success, executive relationship management, or executing Go-To-Market strategies.
* • Proven ability to drive alignment between diverse stakeholders and deliver outcomes without direct authority

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience as a systems administrator, engineer or technical IT/cloud operations support specialist
* Experience relationship building and influencing at the C-level of Fortune 500 customers
* • Experience as part of a cross-functional senior/executive technology leadership team
* • Familiarity with India’s enterprise customer landscape, industry dynamics, and business culture
* • Experience thinking and working creatively to develop unique joint value propositions and product GTM strategy
* • Track record of building scalable mechanisms in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Sr. Technical Recruiter - Bangalore
description:
At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) – The AI Factory Platform Company – we’re building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide.
  
  
Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale.
  
  
Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision.
  
  
At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking a highly experienced Sr. Technical Recruiter in Bangalore, India to join our global Talent Acquisition team and support full-cycle recruiting for critical roles for Penguin Solutions. This role will focus on sourcing, attracting, assessing, and closing talent for AI infrastructure, technical, engineering, and sales roles that support our growth as The AI Factory Platform Company. The Sr. Recruiter will partner closely with hiring managers, HR, and business leaders to understand workforce needs, develop targeted sourcing strategies, and deliver a high-quality candidate and hiring manager experience. The ideal candidate brings strong experience recruiting in competitive technical markets, including AI/ML, HPC, cloud, infrastructure, software, hardware, data, and technical sales talent, along with the ability to influence stakeholders, manage multiple priorities, and use data to improve recruiting outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage full-cycle recruitment for assigned requisitions, including intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate assessment, offer recommendations, approvals, and offer negotiation.
* Partner with hiring managers and HR leaders to define role requirements, candidate profiles, hiring plans, interview processes, and timelines aligned to business needs.
* Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies for scarce technical talent, including AI/ML, HPC, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, software, systems, hardware, and related technical skill sets.
* Recruit for a cross-functional set of roles, to include sales and go-to-market roles, software and hardware engineering, AI and data engineering, shared services and/or interns.
* Attend local career fairs and support internship activities.
* Collaborate with the broader global Talent Acquisition team, flexing your schedule to accommodate calls with team members in the United States and APAC.
* Build and maintain strategic talent pipelines for critical roles and capabilities, using market mapping, competitive research, referrals, LinkedIn, job boards, events, and other sourcing channels.
* Advise hiring managers on recruiting best practices, market conditions, candidate availability, compensation considerations, and effective closing strategies.
* Facilitate a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process through timely communication, clear expectations, and professional representation of Penguin Solutions.
* Partner cross-functionally with HR, Total Rewards, Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders to support approvals, offer development, and compliance with company processes.
* Maintain accurate requisition, candidate, interview, and offer data in the applicant tracking system and ensure consistent process execution.
* Track and communicate recruiting metrics, pipeline health, risks, and progress to stakeholders; use data to identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and candidate experience.
* Support employer branding and talent attraction efforts for AI, technical, and sales talent in partnership with Marketing, Communications, and Talent Acquisition leadership.
* Exercise discretion with sensitive information and diplomacy in nuanced hiring situations.
* Adjust to changing business priorities and support continuous improvement of recruiting processes, tools, and practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 8+ years of talent acquisition or recruiting experience, preferably in a corporate recruiting environment supporting technology, engineering, infrastructure, or high-growth business functions.
* Demonstrated experience managing full-cycle recruiting for technical roles such as AI/ML, software engineering, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, HPC, systems engineering, hardware engineering, product engineering, or related technical functions.
* Strong sourcing skills with experience identifying and engaging passive candidates in competitive and specialized talent markets.
* Ability to partner consultatively with hiring managers and business leaders, influence without formal authority, and provide market insight to support hiring decisions.
* Experience creating sourcing strategies, talent pipelines, and candidate target lists based on business priorities and role requirements.
* Strong understanding of full-cycle recruiting processes, including requisition intake, resume review, candidate screening, interview management, selection alignment, approvals, and offer negotiation.
* Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems and recruiting tools; SmartRecruiters or similar ATS experience a plus.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to represent the company professionally to candidates and stakeholders.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple requisitions and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to use recruiting data to identify risks and drive continuous improvement.
* Ability to work collaboratively across HR, business functions, and global teams while maintaining confidentiality and sound judgment.
* Preferred: Experience using AI-enabled tools or automation to improve sourcing efficiency, candidate screening, pipeline visibility, or recruiting operations, such as Copilot, Claude, or recruiting-specific tools.
* Preferred: Demonstrated experience recruiting for sales or go-to-market roles, including enterprise account executives, sales leaders, solutions architects, technical sales, or business development roles.

**Location**
This is a hybrid position in Bangalore, India.
  
  
**Travel**
As needed for career fairs and hiring events.

Competitive salary and benefits, equity, and a fast-moving fintech environment where your hires shape how the company operates.

The role will work closely with business leaders to understand current and future talent requirements, translate business priorities into effective hiring strategies, identify critical talent pools and drive hiring across specialised and leadership positions.

The ideal candidate will bring strong business acumen, talent market understanding and the ability to navigate niche hiring markets, particularly within the medical device, ophthalmology, healthcare technology or MedTech industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

* + Partner with business leaders and functional heads to understand business priorities, organisational requirements and talent needs.
  + Translate workforce requirements into focused talent acquisition plans aligned with business growth and expansion objectives.
  + Advise hiring managers on talent availability, market intelligence, compensation benchmarks and realistic hiring timelines.
  + Drive manpower planning discussions and proactively identify upcoming and critical talent requirements.
  + Challenge and refine hiring requirements to ensure alignment between role expectations, market availability and business needs.

**Strategic & Niche Talent Acquisition**

* + Own end-to-end recruitment across business-critical, technical, commercial, engineering, product and leadership positions.
  + Drive specialised hiring across ophthalmology, medical devices, MedTech, healthcare technology and related industries.
  + Develop targeted talent mapping and market intelligence strategies to identify high-quality and passive talent.
  + Build sustainable talent pipelines for critical roles, emerging business requirements and future leadership needs.
  + Leverage industry networks, competitor mapping, talent intelligence and direct headhunting to access niche talent pools.
  + Independently drive candidate evaluation, stakeholder alignment, compensation discussions and offer closures.

**Hiring Delivery & Stakeholder Management**

* + Own hiring outcomes against agreed recruitment priorities, quality expectations and turnaround timelines.
  + Work closely with hiring managers throughout the selection process to ensure timely feedback, effective decision-making and closure.
  + Drive offer strategy, candidate engagement, pre-joining connect and offer-to-joining conversion.
  + Manage recruitment partners and consultants, ensuring delivery quality and cost effectiveness.
  + Monitor hiring effectiveness through metrics such as Time-to-Hire, Time-to-Fill, offer acceptance, source effectiveness and quality of hire.

**Qualification & Experience**

* + Bachelor's or master’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related discipline.

  + Experience in medical devices, ophthalmology, MedTech, healthcare technology or medical equipment is strongly preferred.
  + Demonstrated experience in managing niche, leadership, technical and commercial hiring mandates.
  + Experience partnering directly with business heads, functional leaders and senior stakeholders.

**Core Competencies**

* + Strong business acumen and the ability to connect talent acquisition priorities with business objectives.

  + Strong understanding of specialised talent markets, particularly medical devices and healthcare.
  + Ability to influence hiring managers and provide data-backed talent market insights.
