description:
**Overview**
**CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT**
At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.
  
  
At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.
  
  
Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**The Opportunity**
As a Professional Recruiter focused on professional hiring, you will play a key role in attracting, assessing, and hiring top talent for PepsiCo. You will collaborate with hiring managers, HR business partners, and stakeholders to develop and execute strategic hiring plans while ensuring a seamless and engaging candidate experience.
  
  
This role requires a blend of strategic talent sourcing, stakeholder management, employer branding, data-driven decision-making, and process excellence to support our talent acquisition goals.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As Talent Acquisition Analyst your responsibilities would consist of ...
  
  
Recruitment Consulting, Advisory & Partnership
  
  

* Partner with hiring managers to conduct recruitment strategy meetings, analyze hiring needs, define job requirements, and craft customized recruitment plans.
* Provide market intelligence and competitive insights on talent availability, salary benchmarks, and industry hiring trends.
* Act as a trusted talent advisor, guiding hiring managers on interviewing best practices, inclusive hiring strategies, candidate experience standards, and the effective use of assessment tools.
* Align recruitment efforts with workforce planning, strategic TA initiatives, and business priorities.
* Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with hiring managers, HR, and other key stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates and proactive communication throughout the recruitment lifecycle, ensuring alignment and transparency.

Candidate Sourcing, Attraction, and Engagement
  
  

* Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies to identify and attract both active and passive talent using job boards, social media, employee referrals, and networking.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical and recurring roles to reduce time-to-find and time-to-accept.
* Leverage PepsiCo’s employer branding and recruitment marketing to enhance talent attraction, including writing compelling job descriptions, optimizing job postings, and engaging candidates through our established EVP messaging.
* Deliver a consistent, high-touch candidate experience, ensuring timely communication and engagement at every stage of the hiring process

End-to-End Recruitment Process Management & Execution
  
  

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from job requisition creation to offer acceptance, ensuring efficiency, quality, and a seamless and positive candidate experience while adhering to all established process standards.
* Conduct structured interviews and behavioral assessments applying the company's established interviewing framework and standards to evaluate candidate qualifications, skills, and culture add.
* Facilitate hiring manager debrief sessions and provide structured feedback to support data-driven hiring decisions.
* Manage the offer process, including extending offers and negotiating compensation packages in partnership with HR, Total Rewards, and Hiring Manager.

Data-Driven Recruitment, Compliance & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Track and analyze key recruitment metrics (e.g., time-to-find, time-to-accept, candidate experience scores) to continuously improve hiring outcomes.
* Utilize external labor market data and talent analytics to refine sourcing strategies and hiring decisions.
* Ensure adherence to global hiring policies, DEI standards, and local employment laws.
* Stay updated on industry best practices, recruitment technology advancements, and innovative hiring trends.
* Effectively utilize the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and other recruitment technologies to manage the recruitment process.

Process Adherence and Data Management
  
  

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and CRM platforms.
* Follow established recruitment process standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and data integrity.

Global Talent Acquisition Initiatives Contribution and Team Support
  
  

* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) in process, technology, or data, actively participating in SME networks and providing support to the assigned team.
* Team Support and Development: Provide backup support for team leaders and act as a coach/buddy for new hires to facilitate onboarding and development.
* Global Project Participation: Contribute as a Talent Acquisition Delivery SME on assigned global projects.

Specialized Responsibilities Based on Recruiter Type
  
  

* Focus on hiring for corporate/professional roles in Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, R&D, and other business functions.
* Source specialized talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional associations, networking events, and industry-specific job boards.
* Manage longer-cycle, strategic hiring with structured interview processes and leadership engagement.
* Provide data-driven insights and talent intelligence to support workforce planning.
* Work closely with senior leaders and HRBPs to align hiring strategies with business goals.

**Qualifications**
**Who Are We Looking For?**

* 1+ Years of Experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing to offer management within a corporate or agency environment
* Education: Bachelor's degree.
* Solid understanding of talent assessment methodologies and interviewing techniques (e.g., behavioral, competency-based).
* Proven experience with recruitment marketing principles and various channels (e.g., social media platforms, and job boards).

Technology:
  
  

* Demonstrated experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruiting technologies.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Talent Intelligence & Compliance: Knowledge of talent intelligence tools, competitor analysis, employment law, regulations, and compliance related to recruitment.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze recruitment data and metrics to inform hiring strategies and drive data-driven decisions.
* Organizational & Time Management Skills: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and consistently meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to build strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and stakeholders at all levels.

**Role Summary**

This role owns the operational effectiveness and experience quality of the Talent Acquisition practice and extends that experience through a new joiner's first 90 days in the organization. You will work closely with the Head of HR, Delivery Heads, and cross-functional teams, and act as the connecting layer between recruiters, clients, hiring managers, candidates, and new employees.

You will also serve as the dedicated buddy to every new joiner (approximately 3-5 per month), helping them settle in, stay engaged, and become productive quickly.

The role focuses on recruitment operations, experience management, and process excellence. It does not involve direct recruitment delivery (sourcing and closing roles) or HR operations such as payroll, policy administration, or compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Process and Operational Discipline***

* Define, document, and enforce standard recruitment processes and best practices across the TA practice
* Monitor adherence, flag deviations, and drive corrective action with recruiters and delivery teams
* Maintain trackers, dashboards, and MIS covering pipeline health, turnaround times, and bottlenecks

***Leadership and Cross-Functional Partnership***

* Partner with the Head of HR and Delivery Heads to align hiring priorities, capacity, and timelines
* Provide regular reporting and insights to leadership on TA performance, new joiner experience, risks, and improvement areas
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Finance, Onboarding, IT, Admin) to ensure smooth offer, documentation, and joining processes
* Escalate delays or blockers to the right stakeholders, including directly to Delivery Heads where process is not followed, and track resolution

***Interview Coordination and Feedback***

* Oversee interview scheduling between candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers
* Drive timely feedback from clients and hiring managers, escalating delays as needed
* Track interview-to-feedback turnaround and report on trends

***Client and Stakeholder Management***

* Act as a point of contact for clients and hiring managers on process, status, and follow-ups
* Run regular check-ins and reviews to capture feedback and strengthen relationships
* Ensure stakeholder commitments (feedback, decisions, availability) are met

***Candidate Experience and Offer-to-Joining Engagement***

* Maintain consistent, proactive communication with candidates at every stage
* Own candidate engagement from offer to joining, including regular touchpoints, resolving concerns, and reducing dropout risk
* Gather candidate feedback and use it to improve the experience

***New Joiner Buddy and Onboarding Support***

* Act as the dedicated first point of contact and buddy for every new employee through their first 90 days
* Welcome new joiners on Day 1 and personally guide them through introductions to teams, leaders, tools, and ways of working
* Run structured check-ins (Day 1, Week 1, Day 30, 60, 90) and maintain a tracker of each joiner's progress and any open concerns
* Coordinate with managers, HR, and cross-functional teams to close onboarding gaps (access, equipment, documentation, role clarity)
* Capture feedback on the hiring and onboarding experience and feed it into process improvements
* Flag early attrition risks to the Head of HR and relevant Delivery Heads
* Receive backup support from HR during peak hiring periods

***Accountability and Continuous Improvement***

* Drive clear ownership and accountability across recruiters and stakeholders
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to efficiency and experience
* Run periodic reviews with TA and HR leadership and share best practices

**Key Outcomes (with suggested metrics)**

* Standardized operations: process adherence rate, fewer missed follow-ups
* Stronger engagement: client and candidate satisfaction (CSAT/NPS)
* Interview discipline: feedback turnaround (e.g., within 48 hours), fewer reschedules and no-shows
* Higher joining conversion: offer-to-join ratio, fewer offer dropouts
* Smoother onboarding: 100% of new joiners covered by the buddy program, with new joiner satisfaction score and Day 1 readiness (access, equipment, documentation)
* Early retention: reduced attrition within the first 90 days
* Operational efficiency: time-to-hire, pipeline velocity
* Leadership visibility: timely, accurate MIS and review reports.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work without direct authority
* Empathy, approachability, and the ability to build trust quickly with new employees
* Comfort presenting data and recommendations to leadership
* Detail-oriented, structured, with strong follow-through
* Working knowledge of ATS/recruitment tools, trackers, and reporting
* Understanding of the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle and onboarding practices
* Graduate or postgraduate degree; HR or business specialization preferred

title: Manager – HR, India
description:
**Company Description**
Established in Malaysia in 1991, MFE, a company of Doka, has evolved into a global leader of high-quality, efficient, and cost-effective aluminium formwork systems today. Acquired by Doka in 2024, MFE is driven by continuous product innovations and an unwavering commitment to quality and customer service.
  
  
With a presence in India through its Mumbai office, MFE is strengthening its position in one of the world’s most dynamic construction markets. From supporting local housing developments to enabling large-scale urban transformation projects, MFE is shaping the future of construction in India.
  
  
Expanding beyond its initial success in residential projects, MFE has established itself as a one-stop shop for monolithic solutions. Providing end-to-end support, from bespoke formwork design, which utilises in-house 3D software, to experienced on-site technical assistance, MFE's state-of-the-art, eco-friendly manufacturing facility in Malaysia covers annual formwork production capacity exceeding 1.5 million m².
  
  
With a strong focus on on-site training and support, MFE further enables clients to achieve rapid construction cycles, solidifying its vision to be a world-class formwork enterprise dedicated to quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous innovation.
  
  
As a customer-focused organisation, MFE understands that its greatest assets are its employees, which is why it is consistently looking for talented professionals who are keen to develop their careers in this dynamic industry. Having grown continuously, based on the strength of its products and its agility to anticipate market demand, MFE is looking for skilled candidates to join their rapidly growing team.
  
  
**Job Description**
**WHAT IF you could shape the HR function of a growing business while creating meaningful employee experiences and enabling sustainable organizational growth?**
MFE India is seeking a proactive, self-driven and hands-on HR professional to take ownership of the day-to-day HR function and support the growth of its business in India.
  
  
Reporting directly to the Head of HR, this role will be responsible for managing the complete HR function at the operational level, establishing robust and scalable HR processes, and partnering with business leaders to address current and future people requirements.
  
  
As the business enters its next phase of growth and expansion, this role will play an important part in building a robust and scalable HR infrastructure, strengthening people practices, driving employee engagement and ensuring effective HR delivery to support the organization's evolving needs.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has experience supporting business growth, can independently establish and implement HR processes, takes ownership of deliverables, and can balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
* Drive end-to-end recruitment activities in collaboration with business leaders and hiring managers, ensuring timely fulfilment of manpower requirements.
* Develop and strengthen recruitment processes to support business expansion and evolving workforce requirements.
* Partner with stakeholders on workforce planning, manpower budgeting, hiring priorities and recruitment strategies.
* Explore and support campus recruitment initiatives, university partnerships and graduate hiring programmes to build a sustainable talent pipeline.
* Ensure effective onboarding and integration of new employees.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency, candidate experience and hiring processes.
* HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle
* Own and manage day-to-day HR operations and the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, confirmations, employee movements, transfers and offboarding.
* Establish, implement and continuously improve HR policies, processes, procedures and documentation to support business growth.
* Coordinate payroll activities, ensuring timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee data and resolution of payroll-related queries.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR documentation and personnel files.
* Ensure consistent and effective implementation of HR processes across the organization.
* Performance Management & Employee Relations
* Drive the performance management cycle, including goal setting, performance reviews, feedback and performance improvement initiatives.
* Support managers in addressing performance-related matters and developing effective people management practices.
* Take ownership of employee relations matters, including grievance handling, disciplinary processes, conflict resolution and employee concerns.
* Provide guidance to managers on employee-related matters, ensuring consistency, fairness and adherence to company policies.
* Promote a culture of accountability, engagement and continuous improvement.
* Employee Engagement & Culture
* Act as the primary HR contact for employees across MFE India.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture.
* Support employee communication, wellbeing, recognition and team-building activities.
* Proactively identify employee concerns and facilitate timely and effective resolution.
* Champion Doka’s values, leadership culture, Code of Conduct, and a respectful, inclusive working environment.
* Stakeholder Management & Business Partnering
* Act as a business partner and trusted advisor to business leaders and functional managers on all HR-related topics.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into effective HR initiatives and solutions.
* Provide guidance on HR policies, people practices, employee-related matters and organizational development.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Collaborate with the Head of HR and the wider HR team to ensure alignment with regional and group HR standards.
* Champion Doka's values, leadership culture and Code of Conduct, ensuring compliance with applicable local laws and regulations.
* Support change management initiatives, facilitate stakeholder buy-in and ensure effective implementation of people-related changes.
* HR Systems & Digitalization
* Support HR digitalization initiatives and process improvement projects.
* Drive the effective implementation, utilization and adoption of HR systems and related technologies, including SAP, where applicable.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of HR data and reporting.
* Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize and automate HR processes.
* Statutory Compliance & Reporting
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements and company policies.
* Coordinate statutory compliance activities and ensure timely completion of related obligations in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Prepare and maintain HR dashboards, metrics and management reports to support business decision-making.
* Coordinate internal and external HR audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Monitor changes in applicable labour legislation and support implementation of necessary changes in HR policies and practices.

**Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* Postgraduate qualification in HR is preferred.

**Experience**

* 6–8 years of progressive HR experience in a generalist role.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing day-to-day HR operations for a site, business unit or organization.
* Experience supporting business growth, organizational expansion or a significant increase in workforce strength.
* Proven ability to establish, implement and improve HR processes, policies and practices.
* Strong experience in end-to-end recruitment, employee relations, performance management and employee lifecycle management.
* Experience in payroll coordination and statutory compliance.
* Proven stakeholder management and employee engagement experience.

It combines an AI finance copilot with a curated set of financial products, including mutual fund baskets, fixed deposits, and stock baskets, with plans to solve for credit cards, taxation, insurance, and loans over time. The Road Ahead Build the simplest, smartest way for Indians to manage their money, end to end, in one app. The modern replacement for your bank RM.
  
  
Come build it with us.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a People Associate Employee Engagement & TA to be the heartbeat of our people function, someone who owns the employee experience from the moment a candidate enters our pipeline to the moment they're thriving inside the team.
  
  
This is not a back-office HR coordinator role. We need someone with genuine emotional intelligence, the kind of person who reads a room before speaking, knows when a team is burning out before anyone says it, and can have difficult conversations without making them worse. You'll sit at the intersection of talent acquisition and employee engagement, and you'll need to be equally sharp at both.
  
  
If you've designed engagement initiatives that people actually looked forward to (not just filled attendance for), run hiring cycles end-to-end, and navigated the messy reality of PF, ESIC, and HR compliance without someone holding your hand this role is for you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Employee Engagement
  
  

* Own the employee engagement calendar end-to-end — plan, design, execute, and measure initiatives that actually move the needle on team morale and retention
* Build and run feedback mechanisms (pulse surveys, skip-levels, 1-on-1 frameworks) and translate insights into actionable changes, not just dashboards
* Drive recognition and rewards programmes that feel authentic, not performative
* Be the go-to person employees trust when something's off — from team friction to manager blind spots to personal challenges affecting work
* Partner with team leads and department heads to identify engagement gaps, flight risks, and culture health across the org
* Own onboarding experience design — ensure every new joiner feels connected, informed, and set up to succeed in their first 90 days
* Plan and execute company-wide events, offsites, town halls, and celebrations that reinforce culture without feeling forced

**Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for assigned roles — from crafting job descriptions and sourcing candidates to scheduling, coordinating interviews, and closing offers
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline through LinkedIn sourcing, referral programmes, job boards, and campus/community channels
* Own the candidate experience — every touchpoint from first message to offer letter should reflect 1% Club's culture and speed
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, interview structures, and evaluation criteria
* Track and report hiring metrics — time-to-fill, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates — and use data to improve the process

**HR Compliance & Administration**

* Maintain working knowledge of PF (EPF/EPS), ESIC, Professional Tax, and other statutory HR compliances — flag deadlines, ensure documentation is in order, and coordinate with the payroll/finance team
* Support employee lifecycle administration — confirmation letters, exit formalities, experience letters, HRMS data hygiene
* Keep employee records, compliance trackers, and HR documentation audit-ready at all times

**What We're Looking For**

* 2–3 years of experience in an HR/People role with hands-on exposure to both employee engagement and talent acquisition, ideally in a startup or fast-scaling company
* High emotional intelligence — you're perceptive, empathetic, and able to navigate sensitive conversations with maturity and discretion
* Strong communication skills — written and verbal. You can draft a compelling job post, run a town hall, and have a tough retention conversation, all in the same week
* Proven stakeholder management — you've worked across functions, managed hiring manager expectations, and influenced decisions without positional authority
* Sound judgement on people decisions — you know when to escalate, when to intervene, and when to let things play out
* Familiarity with PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and general HR statutory compliance — you don't need to be a payroll specialist, but you should know what's due, when it's due, and what happens if it's missed
* Proficiency with HRMS tools (Keka, Zoho, Darwinbox, or similar) and sourcing platforms (LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Instahyre)
* Detail-oriented and organised — able to juggle engagement calendars, open requisitions, and compliance deadlines without things falling through

**Bonus Points**

* You've built an engagement programme from scratch, not just inherited and maintained one
* You've hired for both tech and non-tech roles in a startup environment

title: Senior HR Operations Executive
description:
Who we are

We're a Mumbai social enterprise that believes beautifully made products can change the story of a whole community. Through us, the people we work with craft bags, textiles and other products that end up in homes and stores around the world. Every order means steady income, skills and dignity for families who were too often left out.

3.5 million products stitched in 2025, creating 708 full time jobs, impacting 18 communities.

We're small enough that your work is visible on day one, and serious enough that quality, deadlines and compliance really matter.

Why this role exists

Every month, people across our office and shop-floor teams count on being paid correctly and on time, and every month brings a long list of statutory filings that can't slip. With the new Labour Codes changing the rules, this work needs one person who owns it end to end, not someone fitting it in between other priorities.

You'll run the engine room of HR: accurate payroll, clean employee records and zero statutory lapses. That frees our Head of People to focus on culture, capability and org design.

What you will own

Five areas, each with a clear outcome. Here's what will be yours.

* **Run monthly payroll end to end for office and shop-floor staff**
  , covering attendance and leave inputs, overtime, variable pay, deductions and arrears, reconciled before sign-off, so that everyone is paid correctly and on time, and payslip queries are sorted within agreed turnaround times.
* **Keep us fully compliant**
  , owning monthly and annual filings for PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Maharashtra Labour Welfare Fund, TDS inputs on salary, gratuity and statutory bonus, plus Shops and Establishments registers and the new Labour Codes, so that we never miss a deadline and audits, inspections and B Corp reviews are a non-event.
* **Handle the moments that need care**
  , including Full and Final settlements, exit formalities and clearances, and group health and accident insurance enrolments, endorsements and claims, so that people join and leave us with everything settled and nothing owed.
* **Keep our HR data clean and useful**
  , from employee master data and personnel files to the HRIS and a monthly HR MIS (headcount, attrition, leave, overtime cost and compliance status), so that decisions are made on numbers we trust, and manual work moves into simple, auditable systems.
* **Be the first point of contact for worker queries and grievances**
  , applying policies consistently, drafting SOPs and policy updates, and supporting the POSH Internal Committee with records and reporting, so that people feel heard and are treated fairly, every time.

**What this role is not:**
You won't be leading culture, capability-building or org design work; that sits with the Head of People. And on grievances, you're the first point of contact, not the final decision-maker: you'll escalate where needed.

You'll thrive here if...

**You really need:**

* A graduate degree and 5–7 years in HR operations, including at least 2 years independently running payroll for 200+ employees
* Hands-on, current knowledge of Maharashtra statutory compliance: PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, gratuity, bonus and Shops and Establishments
* Experience calculating F&F settlements end to end, and the ability to explain every line
* Strong Excel: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivots, reconciliations and clean, auditable workings
* Fluency in English and Hindi, so you can explain a payslip to a machine operator as easily as you walk an auditor through a PF reconciliation

**Bonus points if:**

* You speak Marathi
* You have an MBA/PGDM in HR or a diploma in labour law
* You've worked with manufacturing, social enterprise or other blue-collar workforces
* You've used an HRIS or payroll software (e.g. Keka, greytHR, Zoho People)
* You're familiar with POSH compliance and audit or certification processes

**You also:**
treat a one-rupee variance as worth explaining, stay calm and patient with repeat questions, keep confidential data confidential, and spot a compliance deadline before anyone has to ask.

title: Vice President Human Resources
description:
**Vice President – HR / HR Director**

**Company:**
RN Laboratories

**Department:**
Administration, HR, Security, Customs

**Location:**
GIDC – Sachin, Surat, Gujarat or Mumbai

**Website:**
www.garonitpharma.com

**Position Overview**

The Vice President – HR / HR Director will serve as a member of the Board of Directors, contributing to corporate strategy, governance and long-term organisational development, alongside leading HR, Administration, Security, Customs and government liaison activities. This senior leadership role demands a candidate with extensive experience in API manufacturing, and a strong background in dealing with regulatory and government bodies.

**Key Competencies**

* Board-level judgement, strategic thinking and the ability to balance business objectives, employee interests, compliance obligations and organisational reputation.
* Strong leadership and decision-making abilities.
* Skill in developing team synergies and driving collective success.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* High level of integrity and professionalism.

**Board Responsibilities & Corporate Governance**

* Participate actively in Board deliberations and contribute to decisions on business strategy, organisational structure, leadership succession, workforce planning and material operational risks.
* Provide the Board with timely updates on people-related matters, industrial relations, statutory compliance, litigation, government interactions and significant administrative or security risks, highlighting issues requiring Board intervention.

**Leadership & Management**

* Translate Board-approved strategies and policies into actionable departmental plans, establish accountability and monitor implementation across functions under the role's oversight.
* Lead and manage HR, Administration, Security, and Customs, including liaising with high-ranking officials in critical government offices and departments.
* Provide strategic oversight to all departments.
* Perform team-building activities and develop synergies between various teams to ensure they work in a synchronised manner, aligned with the company's goals.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory and legal requirements, liaising with government bodies, customs, local police, and legal consultants as needed.

**Human Resources & Administration**

* Develop and implement HR policies and procedures.
* Develop effective recruitment strategies to attract qualified talent across technical, operational, managerial and leadership positions.
* Manage day-to-day administrative operations, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness within the team.
* Stabilise the implementation of HRMS.

**Security & Compliance**

* Ensure the safety and security of the company premises, assets, and personnel.
* Develop and implement security protocols and procedures.
* Maintain compliance and establish relationships with local, state, and central regulatory bodies.

**Customs & Regulatory Affairs**

* Oversee all customs-related activities, ensuring smooth import/export processes.
* Liaise with customs authorities, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
* Oversee interactions with regulatory bodies, ensuring all company practices meet the necessary standards.
* Maintain strong working relationships and hands-on liaison experience with relevant government and statutory authorities, including Customs, FDA/drug-control authorities, Labour authorities, applicable narcotics authorities, Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB), and relevant authorities responsible for Environmental Clearance (EC).
* Coordinate regulatory approvals, statutory compliance matters, inspections and government-related requirements as applicable.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Experience**

* Prior experience as a Board member or in a senior leadership role involving regular Board interaction, governance reporting and cross-functional strategic decision-making will be preferred.
* Minimum 25 years of experience in an API manufacturing or pharmaceutical manufacturing
* At least 10 years of leadership experience in a similar or larger setup.
* Experience working in a pharmaceutical manufacturing company with an annual turnover of approximately ₹350–400 crore.
* Minimum 5 years of continuous employment with the most recent employer
* Proven experience liaising directly with government and statutory authorities relevant to pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

**Skills**

* Experience in team building and fostering collaboration across departments.
* Strong expertise in HR and administrative functions.
* Familiarity with regulatory and government bodies, including customs, local police, and legal consultants.
* Proven ability to manage multiple departments and lead cross-functional teams.
* Strong talent acquisition capabilities, including proactive candidate sourcing, recruitment strategy and hiring for specialised pharmaceutical manufacturing positions.
* Ability to manage complex regulatory interactions, government liaison activities and statutory compliance requirements.

**Education**

* Strong academic background with an MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or an equivalent specialised postgraduate HR qualification.

**Location Requirements**

* Candidates may be based in Surat or Mumbai.
* Must be willing to work onsite in Surat for a minimum of three weeks each month.
* Availability to travel for government liaison, regulatory and business requirements as needed.

title: Talent Enablement Coordinator
description:
Your Job
  
  
The
**Talent Enablement Coordinator**
will serve as a key connection point between Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and Engineering, helping accelerate technical hiring and enabling newly hired talent to transition successfully into productive engineering roles.
  
  
In this role, you will coordinate hiring activities, engineering onboarding, technical learning, ramp-up tracking, and reporting. You will work closely with Engineering Hiring Managers, Technical Leads, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition to identify bottlenecks, improve processes, and create an effective experience from candidate hiring through new-hire enablement.
  
  
Our Team
  
  
You will be part of the John Zink engineering organization, collaborating closely with Engineering Leadership, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Engineering Managers, and Technical Leads.
  
  
Our team values ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and creating long-term value by helping technical talent develop and contribute effectively.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Serve as a central liaison between Engineering, Talent Acquisition, and HR to drive effective coordination across technical hiring and talent enablement.
* Partner with Engineering Managers and Talent Acquisition to identify and address bottlenecks across résumé reviews, technical assessments, interviews, and feedback.
* Facilitate regular alignment with Engineering Managers on open positions, candidate pipelines, hiring priorities, and upcoming workforce needs.
* Coordinate engineering onboarding and technical enablement activities, including learning paths, mentoring or buddy programs, technical knowledge sessions, and 30-, 60-, and 90-day milestones.
* Partner with Technical Leads to help newly hired employees build the knowledge and capabilities required to contribute successfully.
* Track onboarding and ramp-up measures, including time-to-first-commit and talent maturity, to provide visibility into new-hire integration and development.
* Maintain accurate hiring and onboarding information across the Applicant Tracking System, internal databases, and dashboards.
* Prepare and communicate hiring-funnel, onboarding-status, and talent-enablement insights to Engineering Leadership.
* Proactively identify hiring delays and onboarding risks and collaborate with Engineering and HR stakeholders to facilitate timely support.
* Gather feedback from new hires and engineering stakeholders to continuously improve hiring coordination, onboarding, and the engineering enablement experience.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Professional university degree.
* 2 or more years of professional experience within an engineering, technology, talent enablement, talent acquisition, HR coordination, project coordination, or similar business environment.
* Experience coordinating multiple activities, stakeholders, priorities, or projects simultaneously.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and maintaining accurate operational data, trackers, or reporting.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.

What Will Put You Ahead
  
  

* Experience supporting technical or engineering hiring and onboarding processes.
* Familiarity with engineering terminology and technical talent profiles.
* Experience managing multiple open requisitions and concurrent onboarding activities in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience coordinating structured 30-, 60-, and 90-day onboarding or development plans.
* Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems, onboarding platforms, learning platforms, dashboards, or reporting tools.
* Experience preparing and presenting hiring, onboarding, or workforce metrics to business or engineering leadership.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with experience collaborating across Engineering, Talent Acquisition, HR, and global teams.
* A continuous-improvement mindset with the ability to identify process gaps and implement practical solutions.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Job description:
  
  
Purpose of the Job

The Specialized Digital & Technology (D&T) Talent Acquisition Partner is responsible for leading end-to-end recruitment for digital and technology roles from India, supporting hiring requirements across India and regional or global markets. The role acts as a specialist talent advisor to D&T leaders, delivering high-quality talent for critical technology capabilities while ensuring speed, market competitiveness, candidate experience, and alignment with the global Talent Acquisition operating model.

Job Description

* **1. Specialized D&T Recruitment Delivery**

  - Lead the full recruitment lifecycle for Digital & Technology roles across India and assigned regional or global markets.

  - Recruit across technology disciplines including software engineering, architecture, cloud, data and analytics, AI, cybersecurity, product, enterprise applications, SAP, infrastructure, and digital transformation.

  - Deliver priority, senior, niche, and hard-to-fill D&T positions with a strong focus on quality, speed, and candidate experience.

  - Adapt sourcing and assessment approaches to different markets, time zones, talent availability, and local hiring requirements.

  **2. Strategic Stakeholder Partnership**

  - Act as the specialist TA partner for D&T leaders, HR Business Partners, and hiring managers in India and across supported regional or global functions.

  - Translate technical and business requirements into clear role profiles, sourcing strategies, and structured selection criteria.

  - Provide evidence-based advice on talent availability, location strategy, compensation positioning, competitor activity, and hiring risks.

  - Support workforce planning and proactively anticipate future D&T capability needs.

  **3. Technology Talent Sourcing & Market Mapping**

  - Build targeted talent pipelines and succession-ready pools for critical and recurring D&T capabilities.

  - Conduct talent mapping across India and relevant global technology hubs, identifying passive talent from logistics, e-commerce, consulting, technology, and other digitally mature organizations.

  - Use LinkedIn Recruiter, specialist technology communities, referrals, job boards, market intelligence, and AI-powered sourcing tools.

  - Develop diverse pipelines and support inclusive, bias-aware hiring practices.

  **4. Technical Assessment & Selection**

  - Partner with hiring teams to define screening criteria and appropriate technical assessment methods.

  - Conduct structured competency-based interviews and assess candidates for technical relevance, leadership capability, motivation, mobility, compensation, and cultural contribution.

  - Coordinate technical interviews, assessments, case studies, and panel evaluations across multiple countries and time zones.

  - Ensure selection decisions are documented, consistent, and based on role-relevant evidence.

  **5. Process Compliance, Data & Quality**

  - Ensure full compliance with global TA processes, local employment requirements, approvals, assessments, reference checks, and system documentation.

  - Maintain accurate and timely recruitment data in SuccessFactors and other approved TA systems.

  - Monitor time to fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, probation outcomes, and hiring manager satisfaction.

  - Use TA dashboards and market data to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

  **6. Candidate Experience & Offer Management**

  - Provide a professional and responsive candidate experience throughout the hiring process, including candidates based outside India.

  - Manage offer alignment and support compensation discussions in partnership with HR and Compensation & Benefits teams.

  - Identify and manage risks related to counteroffers, notice periods, relocation, work authorization, and cross-border hiring.

  **7. Capability Building & Collaboration**

  - Coach D&T hiring managers on structured interviewing, Hire-to-Value methodology, selection quality, and bias-free hiring.

  - Partner with the Global TA Center of Excellence and regional TA colleagues to share market intelligence, pipelines, and best practices.

Job Requirements - Experience and Education

* - Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Technology, or a related field.

  - 5-8 years of talent acquisition experience, including strong specialist experience recruiting Digital & Technology roles.

  - Demonstrated experience recruiting technology talent in India, with exposure to regional or global hiring across multiple countries and time zones.

  - Proven delivery across several D&T domains such as software engineering, cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, product, SAP, enterprise applications, infrastructure, or digital transformation.

  - Experience managing specialist, managerial, and senior technology searches in multinational, technology, consulting, logistics, e-commerce, or digitally enabled organizations.

  - Strong understanding of the Indian technology talent market, sourcing channels, compensation dynamics, notice periods, and candidate engagement practices.

  - Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, market-mapping techniques, assessment tools, and AI-enabled sourcing solutions.

  - Strong business English and the ability to influence stakeholders and engage candidates across cultures and geographies.

title: Partner Onboarding Lead – O&M
description:
**About Claro Energy**

Claro Energy is a leading clean energy company in India with 15+ years of experience in building decentralized renewable energy solutions. We have delivered 1,00,000+ solar projects across solar irrigation pumps, rooftop solar, and large-scale clean energy programs, working closely with farmers, households, institutions, and government initiatives across multiple Indian states. As we scale further, we are building an AI-first data and intelligence foundation to power automation, forecasting, and faster decision-making across operations, growth, inventory, and finance.

**About The Role**

Our installed base is growing faster than any in-house service team can cover. We are building a freelance O&M partner network: certified solar technicians who handle servicing, breakdowns, preventive maintenance, and warranty calls for rooftop solar and solar pump systems in their own districts.

You will own this network from start to finish. You will source partners, verify them, onboard them, activate them, and keep them. Think of it as the partner/supply lead role at a mobility or home-services platform, applied to solar field service. You will also work with the tech team on bringing AI into processes to smoothen up operations, from partner screening to job allocation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Partner Acquisition

• Build supply pipelines of freelance technicians district by district, using ITIs, local electrical contractors, ex-installer networks, dealer referrals, and digital channels

• Map coverage gaps against our installed base and service ticket density, then prioritize recruitment accordingly

• Run referral and drive-based hiring campaigns to hit district-level partner targets

Verification & Onboarding

• Own the onboarding funnel from lead to document collection, KYC, and background check, through skill assessment and agreement signing, and finally activation

• Run practical skill assessments for both rooftop (on-grid/hybrid) and solar pump (AC/DC, VFD controllers) systems

• Get partners onboarded onto the partner app/CRM, covering job acceptance, photo-proof uploads, and closure workflows

Training & Certification

• Design and run induction and certification modules on Claro product lines, safety standards, RMS diagnostics, and service SOPs

• Build a tiering system (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold) based on skill level, ratings, and SLA performance, and tie it to job priority and payouts

Activation, Quality & Retention

• Track first-job activation, ensure partners complete their first jobs within defined timelines, and fix drop-offs

• Monitor partner performance on TAT, first-time-fix rate, customer ratings, rework, and photo-proof compliance

• Run quality audits and field spot checks, and manage escalations, warnings, and offboarding

• Work with Finance on rate cards, incentive structures, and on-time payouts, since payouts are the top driver of partner retention

• Run partner engagement through WhatsApp communities, monthly calls, and recognition programs

Process & Data

• Maintain a clean partner database with skills, coverage pincodes, tier, tools owned, and availability

• Work with the tech team to automate screening, reminders, and job-routing using n8n/Make and AI agents

• Publish weekly dashboards covering funnel conversion, active partners, district coverage, SLA adherence, and churn

**What We're Looking For**

• 3–6 years in partner/supply onboarding, field operations, or service network management. Gig/marketplace platforms (mobility, home services, logistics) or solar/electrical service companies are ideal backgrounds

• Proven track record of building and scaling a distributed partner or vendor network across multiple geographies

• Enough technical comfort with solar systems to assess a technician's skill. You do not need to be an engineer

• Strong data discipline: you run the funnel on numbers, not gut feel

• Comfortable in Tier 2/3 towns and rural geographies; fluent in Hindi and English, and regional languages are a plus

• Comfort with CRMs, Google Sheets, and automation tools; exposure to n8n, Make, or AI tools is a strong plus

**Success Metrics — First 6 Months**

• Active, certified partners in target districts against plan

• Lead-to-activation conversion rate and time-to-activate

• Service TAT and first-time-fix rate across partner-handled tickets

• 90-day partner retention rate

**Why Join**

• Build a field service network from zero, with direct impact on customer uptime across 1,00,000+ installations

• Run a marketplace-style operations model in solar, a space where very few companies have built one

• Work closely with leadership and the tech team on automating a ground-level operation

**How to Apply**

Click Apply — you'll be redirected to our careers portal. Once there, click Apply Now again and fill out the short form with your LinkedIn ID, resume, and contact details. Alternatively, send your updated resume directly to hr@claroenergy.in with the subject line: Application –
Partner Onboarding Lead – O&M
[Your Name]

description:
About FactoryOperation

FactoryOperation is building an integrated workforce, training, and staffing ecosystem for India's industrial sector. We help factories find reliable workers and connect workers with regular employment opportunities.

We are looking for enthusiastic and hardworking freshers to join our operations team and help build our network of industrial workers across India.

Role Overview

As a Manpower Onboarding & Fulfillment Executive, you will be responsible for connecting with workers, onboarding them onto our platform, understanding their skills and job preferences, and coordinating their placement at factories.

You will work closely with the operations and recruitment team to ensure that factory manpower requirements are fulfilled on time.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Worker Sourcing & Onboarding**

* Connect with workers looking for jobs in factories and industrial establishments.
* Source candidates through WhatsApp groups, referrals, social media, local networks, and field activities.
* Explain job opportunities and register interested workers on the FactoryOperation platform.
* Collect and verify basic candidate information, identity documents, experience, and skills.
* Maintain an updated database of registered workers.

**2. Manpower Fulfillment**

* Understand job requirements received from factories.
* Identify suitable workers from the available candidate database.
* Call candidates and explain job details, salary, location, accommodation, and other benefits.
* Coordinate interviews and selection processes.
* Follow up with selected candidates until they successfully join the factory.
* Coordinate replacements in case of candidate dropouts.

**3. Worker Engagement**

* Maintain regular communication with registered workers.
* Help workers find suitable job opportunities.
* Follow up with workers after joining to understand their experience.
* Build a strong and active network of industrial workers.

**4. Operations & Coordination**

* Maintain daily recruitment and onboarding reports.
* Update candidate information and recruitment status in internal systems.
* Coordinate with factory HR teams and internal operations teams.
* Track candidate sourcing, selection, joining, and retention.
* Ensure timely communication and resolution of worker queries.

Eligibility & Skills

* Fresh graduates from any discipline can apply.
* Good communication skills in Hindi.
* Basic English communication is preferred.
* Comfortable making phone calls and coordinating with multiple people.
* Basic knowledge of smartphones, WhatsApp, Excel, and Google Sheets.
* Willingness to learn recruitment and workforce operations.
* Comfortable with field visits when required.
* Proactive, responsible, and target-oriented.

What We Are Looking For

* Someone who enjoys interacting with people.
* Someone who can build relationships and earn the trust of workers.
* Someone who takes ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Someone who can work in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Someone who is willing to learn and grow with the company.

* Oversee HR policies, processes and employee lifecycle management.

* Lead change management and organizational development initiatives.

title: People Partner
description:
* Manage key operational people workforce, talent, engagement and organisational priorities across a complex, large-scale portfolio, partnering directly with senior leaders.

* Location Gurgaon

We’re Finding Better Ways™ to provide materials the world needs, now and in the future. Our values – care, courage and curiosity – guide how we work and how we treat each other.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a People Partner to translate people strategy into practical people and workforce plans across a defined portfolio. In this role, you’ll act as a trusted partner to leadership teams, helping them navigate workforce priorities, talent, performance, employee relations, engagement and organisational change in complex, large-scale and often multi-geography environments. This is an opportunity to influence meaningful business outcomes while strengthening your impact across the full people agenda.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  
Reporting to the Manager People Partnering and supporting Group Functions, you will be
  
  

* Act a trusted partner supporting senior leaders on day-to-day people matters, shaping priorities and coordinating delivery through People Experience and specialist teams.
* Translating people strategies into practical workforce and people plans for the portfolio, with clear actions and near-term priorities.
* Collaborating with specialist People teams, including Organisation and Talent Partners, People Experience, Areas of Expertise, Talent and Reward, to deliver aligned people strategies and initiatives.
* Delivering operational workforce planning and facilitating strategic workforce plan fulfilment with relevant stakeholders.
* Guiding leaders through complex employee and labour relations matters, including escalations.
* Leading performance, talent and pay review processes, including calibration activities, to support fair, consistent and timely outcomes.
* Using employee engagement, workforce, case and query data to identify trends and turn insights into targeted actions that improve team effectiveness and employee experience.
* Leading the people aspects of organisational change and restructures, enabling leaders and supporting effective communication, engagement and adoption.
* Coaching leaders on performance, team effectiveness and employee experience while sharing portfolio insights to inform enterprise people strategies and frameworks.

**About You**
We’re looking for someone whose experience aligns with the key requirements below. You do not need to meet every “helpful for success” item to apply, if you bring relevant experience and are excited by the opportunity, we encourage you to submit an application.
  
  
***Required for Success***

* A commitment to the safety of yourself and your team.
* Skills and Capabilities Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior leaders, provide practical advice and translate business priorities into actionable people outcomes.
* Experience Demonstrated business partnering experience across workforce planning, performance, talent, engagement and organisational change in a complex organisation.
* Employee and Labour Relations Sound judgement in applying employee and labour relations frameworks, coordinating specialist support and managing or escalating risk.
* Data and Insights Ability to interpret workforce, engagement, case or query data and convert findings into targeted business actions.
* Collaboration and Delivery Experience working across people teams and specialist functions to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.

***Helpful for Success***

* Experience supporting leaders across large-scale, operational or multi-geography environments.
* Experience with union matters, organisational restructures or enterprise-wide change and transformation initiatives.
* Experience facilitating talent or performance calibration sessions and supporting fair, consistent pay review decisions.

**What We Offer**
Be recognized for your contribution, your thinking and your hard work, and go home knowing you’ve helped the world progress.
  
  

* A work environment where safety is always the number one priority
* A competitive salary package with annual cash incentive awards for eligible employees
* Career development & education assistance to further your ambitions
* Access top tier family-friendly health and medical programs and pension plan
* Wellbeing benefits
* Generous Rio Tinto employee share program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Ongoing individual wellbeing support for you and your family for personal and professional matters
* Leave for all of life’s reasons (vacation/annual, paid parental, sick leave)

**About Rio Tinto**
Rio Tinto is a leading global mining and materials company. We operate in 35 countries where we produce iron ore, copper, aluminium, critical minerals, and other materials needed for the global energy transition and for people, communities, and nations to thrive.
  
  
We have been mining for 150 years and operate with knowledge built up across generations and continents. Our purpose is finding better ways to provide the materials the world needs – striving for innovation and continuous improvement to produce materials with low emissions and to the right environmental, social and governance standards. But we can’t do it on our own, so we’re focused on creating partnerships to solve problems, create win-win situations and meet opportunities.
  
  
**Respect and Inclusion**
At Rio Tinto, we particularly welcome and encourage applications from Indigenous Peoples, women, the LGBTQ+ community, mature workers, people with disabilities and people from different cultural backgrounds.
  
  
We are committed to an inclusive environment where people feel comfortable to be themselves. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are essential to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation or anything else that makes us different.

title: Global HR Shared Services Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
You will be a key member of our Global HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC), that’s redefining how we deliver world-class HR services—scaling operational excellence, driving innovation, and enhancing the employee experience across every touchpoint. You’ll collaborate with colleagues across multiple geographies and time zones, forming part of a close-knit global HR network that values teamwork, ownership, and continuous learning.
  
  
In this role, you’ll lead a mid-sized team and oversee the delivery of HR operations with a focus on quality, compliance, and continuous improvement. You’ll also act as a first point of escalation for complex queries, support process optimization efforts, and ensure performance targets are met through effective team management and process oversight.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**

* Lead and oversee the delivery of all HR operational processes across the employee lifecycle (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, data updates) in alignment with global policies and local/regional compliance requirements and provide strategic direction to the team
* Working with the global/regional/local teams, you will lead on ensuring a best-in-class service, documenting processes, delivering on Core HR Operations performance mgmt. metrices, reporting and managing the service once agreed.
* Ensuring the team work together efficiently and maintain consistently high standards or quality, adhere to the defined processes
* Allocate work effectively to improve team productivity and ensure high efficiency, with mechanisms to measure performance metrics.
* Assisting the team when tasks or issues are escalated and aiming to resolve those with the end-user/requester in a timely manner w.r.t service request tickets, surveys, HR Letters, etc.
* Identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate and optimize HR processes across multiple regions. Leading continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, service quality and employee experience.
* Building team capability through effective performance management, succession planning and ongoing development initiatives.
* You will enhance the development of the skills of the team, aiding the career development of your members by sharing regular, ongoing feedback through regular catch ups. You will be responsible for Appraisal process of your team ensuring feedback is sought from the end users and global stakeholders.
* Support readiness for internal and external audits by ensuring documentation and process adherence.
* Ensure data integrity and system accuracy, particularly within tools such as Workday and case management systems.
* Continuously evaluate the service portfolio with key stakeholders, using feedback and operational data to improve overall service.
* Build partnerships with stakeholders within business units, functional departments, and other teams.
* Work within culturally diverse teams, fostering relationships to drive consensus and alignment across stakeholder groups.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development or other related fields is required, Masters or Advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years of progressive experience in HR operations/Shared Services, including at least 3+ years of experience managing a team is essential.
* Deep understanding and strong knowledge of HR processes delivered out of a Shared Service or HR Operations set up.
* Ability to perform successfully in a fast-paced, intellectually intense, service-oriented and matrix-structured environment and to interpret rules and guidelines flexibly to enhance the business and in keeping with BCG’s values and culture
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) – ability to adapt communication upwards and downwards for appropriate levels of detail.
* Personal drive and positive work ethic to deliver results within tight deadlines and in demanding situations.
* Brings strong working knowledge of HR technologies and service delivery platforms, including systems such as Workday and ServiceNow, alongside practical experience applying process improvement methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and employee experience
* Flexibility in work hours to support a global team and diverse stakeholders.
* Experience working in a matrixed environment is a plus.

Additional info
  
  
You’re Good At
  
  

* Leading and managing day-to-day operations and service delivery while keeping an eye on continuous improvement opportunities.
* Strong ‘process’ thinking that connects the dots through its functional silos and delivers an impactful and effective experience.
* Leading, collaborating and supporting team members with clarity and consistency, creating a positive team dynamic.
* Fostering collaboration and team effectiveness through coaching, knowledge sharing, and a strong commitment to collective success across a global organization
* Creating meaningful experiences for every stakeholder through exceptional service — always aiming to exceed expectations and deliver with empathy and care.
* Communicating effectively with team members, stakeholders, and peers across different regions.
* Prioritizing tasks and maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced, service-oriented environment
* Solving operational challenges using sound judgment and a practical approach.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively across time zones and cultures with a collaborative mindset.

"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."

title: Lead Operations & Payroll Manager
description:
**The Role**

The Lead Operations & Payroll Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for global People Operations and payroll services. The role is accountable for governance, service performance, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement across retained People teams, managed service providers, payroll vendors and other external partners.

The role translates People Function strategy into a controlled and measurable operating model. It ensures that employee lifecycle and payroll services are delivered accurately, on time and in accordance with global policy, local legislation, contractual commitments and internal controls. The role leads through data, clear accountabilities and disciplined governance, while maintaining a strong focus on employee and stakeholder experience.

The role also leads major transformation, vendor consolidation, automation and operating-model initiatives, including business-case development, transition planning, benefits tracking and leadership reporting. It acts as a senior escalation point for complex operational, payroll, statutory, supplier and service-delivery matters and provides advice to the PB10 Director and other senior stakeholders.

The People Function delivers HR and payroll services across multiple regions, countries, legal entities and service channels. Delivery is shared between internal People teams, retained service desks, managed service providers, payroll partners, Finance, Procurement, Technology and country stakeholders. This creates a complex control environment requiring clear ownership, standard processes, reliable data and active supplier governance.

The Lead Operations & Payroll Manager operates across both business-as-usual service delivery and transformation. The role oversees global operations such as AskHR governance, retained-desk activity, managed-service performance, payroll controls, vendor and invoice governance, management reporting and operational improvement. It works closely with regional Lead Operations & Payroll Managers, Payroll and People Data Managers, People Solutions colleagues and cross-functional partners.

The role reports to the Director - Head of HR Operations and Payroll (PB10). It may directly or matrix-manage managers, specialists and project resources and will be expected to represent the function in leadership forums, service reviews, audits, supplier meetings and transformation governance.

**Main responsibilities**

The role translates People Operations and Payroll strategy into effective global operating models, governance frameworks, delivery priorities and clear accountabilities. It provides senior oversight of AskHR, retained HR service desks, outsourced operations and end-to-end payroll delivery, ensuring service quality, SLA performance, statutory compliance, payroll accuracy, financial controls, risk management and timely resolution of operational issues. It also leads supplier, commercial and financial governance, including contract management, vendor performance, purchase orders, invoice validation, budgets, cost optimisation and supplier payments.

The role drives global transformation, vendor consolidation, service transitions, automation, digitalisation and continuous improvement initiatives. This includes developing business cases, cost-benefit models, implementation plans, risk assessments, KPIs, milestones and benefits realisation. It owns operational performance reporting, dashboards, executive insights, audit and assurance activities, using data and root-cause analysis to identify risks, capacity pressures, control weaknesses and improvement opportunities. It also ensures robust documentation, business continuity, data protection and regulatory compliance across regions.

Working closely with regional and country leadership, Finance, Procurement, Technology, Legal, Risk and external service providers, the role provides strategic advice to the PB10 Director, leads governance and transformation forums, manages complex escalations and aligns stakeholders on operational priorities. It also leads, coaches and develops managers and specialists, strengthens succession planning and operational resilience, builds expertise in payroll, analytics, supplier management and controls, and promotes a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, customer focus and continuous improvement.

**Role specific skills**

* Business acumen (exemplary): connects service, risk, cost and employee experience outcomes to organizational strategy.
* Data literacy (exemplary): uses operational, financial and service data to shape priorities, challenge performance and support investment decisions.
* People advocacy (developing/exemplary): balances customer needs, fairness, compliance, ethics and organisational risk.
* Executional excellence (exemplary): converts direction into measurable plans, sustained governance and accountable delivery.
* Problem solving (exemplary): resolves complex, cross-functional issues with incomplete information and competing stakeholder interests.
* Interpersonal and influencing skills (exemplary): builds alignment across senior stakeholders, suppliers and distributed teams.
* Commercial and supplier management (developing/exemplary): manages performance, obligations, cost, risk and value across outsourced services.
* Change and transformation leadership (developing/exemplary): leads operating-model, process, technology and behavioural change.

**Role specific knowledge and experience**

description:
**Service Delivery Manager Payroll**
*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*
**Scope**
Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Transition and shared services set-up
* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR,
* Process ownership and service delivery
* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.
* Governance, risk and controls
* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.
* Continuous improvement and digital
* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.
* People leadership, performance and culture
* Build the teams from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**Essential**
**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll
