title: Senior HR Operations Specialist
description:
**Department:**
Human Resources
  
  
**Location:**
Kochi
  
  
**Experience:**
5 Years
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Reports To:**
HR Manager
  
  
**About Elance Learning**
Elance Learning is a leading education and professional learning organization focused on delivering high-quality learning experiences and career-oriented programs. As we continue to scale, we are looking for an experienced
**Senior HR Operations Specialist**
to strengthen our HR operations and employee lifecycle processes.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Senior HR Operations Specialist will be responsible for managing and streamlining day-to-day HR operations, ensuring smooth employee lifecycle management, HRMS accuracy, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, employee documentation, and HR reporting.
  
  
The role requires strong attention to detail, process ownership, stakeholder management, and the ability to work closely with employees, managers, Finance, and leadership.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle
* Manage end-to-end employee lifecycle processes from onboarding to exit.
* Ensure timely completion of joining formalities, documentation, employee records, transfers, promotions, confirmations, and exits.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee master data.
* Ensure HR policies and processes are consistently implemented across locations.
* Handle employee queries related to HR policies, benefits, attendance, leave, payroll, and other HR processes.
* HRMS & Data Management
* Manage and maintain employee information in the HRMS/Keka.
* Ensure accuracy of employee master data, attendance, leave, onboarding, and other HR records.
* Coordinate with managers and employees for timely completion of HRMS activities.
* Identify HRMS process gaps and recommend improvements.
* Generate HR reports and dashboards for management review.
* Payroll & Attendance Coordination
* Coordinate with Finance/Payroll team for monthly payroll inputs.
* Validate attendance, leave, incentives, deductions, new joiners, exits, salary revisions, and other payroll-related inputs.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs.
* Resolve employee payroll-related queries in coordination with Finance.
* Statutory Compliance
* Support the organization in maintaining applicable statutory HR compliance.
* Coordinate activities related to ESI, Professional Tax, Gratuity, labour law requirements, and other applicable statutory matters.
* Maintain statutory records and documentation.
* Support internal/external audits and compliance reviews.
* Performance Management
* Coordinate the PMS cycle, including goal setting, KRIs/KPIs, reviews, ratings, and closure.
* Ensure managers and employees complete PMS activities within defined timelines.
* Support HR in performance review analysis and documentation.
* Maintain performance-related records and reports.
* Employee Engagement & HR Initiatives
* Support employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, HR communications, and employee connect programs.
* Assist in organizing HR events, training programs, and employee development initiatives.
* Gather employee feedback and identify areas for process or engagement improvement.
* HR Policies & Process Improvement
* Support implementation and periodic review of HR policies and SOPs.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend process improvements.
* Develop and maintain HR SOPs, checklists, trackers, and process documentation.
* Ensure standardization of HR processes across locations.
* HR MIS & Analytics
* Prepare periodic HR MIS and management reports.
* Track key HR metrics such as:

+ Headcount
+ Attrition
+ Retention
+ Absenteeism
+ Hiring and onboarding
+ Employee movement
+ PMS completion
+ Payroll inputs
+ Employee engagement

* Provide data-driven insights to support HR decision-making.

Key KRIs / KPIs
  
  

* HR Operations Accuracy: ≥98%
* Employee Documentation Completion: 100%
* Payroll Input Accuracy & Timeliness: 100%
* HRMS Data Accuracy: ≥99%
* Onboarding Process Compliance: 100%
* PMS Process Closure: 100% within timelines
* Employee Query Resolution: Within defined TAT
* Statutory Compliance: 100% adherence
* HR MIS Submission: 100% on time
* Process Improvement: Minimum 2–3 measurable improvements annually

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle management.
* Good understanding of HR policies and statutory compliance.
* Hands-on experience with HRMS platforms; Keka experience will be an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and HR MIS.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High attention to detail and process orientation.
* Ability to handle confidential employee information.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Educational Qualification
  
  

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in HR Operations.

**Preferred Profile**
Candidates from
**Education/EdTech, Training, Professional Education, Retail, Service, or multi-location organizations**
with strong HR operations exposure will be preferred.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work in a fast-growing education organization.
* Exposure to end-to-end HR operations and strategic HR initiatives.
* Opportunity to work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Growth and career development opportunities.

Exciting opportunity to join the Talent Development function as a learning specialist. You will be responsible for the deployment of courses and learning based projects across Talent Development. The role includes managing the end-to-end deployment process, supporting learning budgets and monitoring compliance and attendance. Providing oversight of learning administration activities working alongside Senior Learning Associates and Learning Program Manager’s depending on portfolio.
  
  
**Your key responsibilities:**
**LEARNING / PROJECT DEPLOYMENT**

* Submit requests to Schedule Offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors

* Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business (such as UKI UK, UKI ROI, UKFS, ROI FS, Channel Islands)
* First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration team
* Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
* Provide oversight of Learning deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration team assigned.
* Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
* Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions.
* vILT producer role where vILT team can’t support
* Learning on-site support (as required)
* Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
* Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
* Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
* Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
* Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required

**FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT**

* Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for, supporting all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model
* Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.

**STAKEHOLDER RELATIONSHIPS**

* Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
* Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant). Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client group, to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Admininistration team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global deployment team, Facilitators, external suppliers.

**MEASURE LEARNING**

* Access reports on Learning course L1 – L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings
* Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting

**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT**

* Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
* Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment
* Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions

**TEAM**

* Contribute to other activities or projects across the wider Talent Development function
* Support the induction of new team members

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Proactive problem solver with solutions mindset
* Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* Strong IT skills – Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint
* Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly
* Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as ‘one team’
* Commercial acumen and business awareness
* Desire to deliver quality services
* Experience in stakeholder management / business consulting
* Ability to engage and influence others, desire to embrace and drive change
* Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks
* Expertise in curating and maintaining knowledge resources, including documentation and SharePoint sites, to enhance accessibility and usability for participants.
* Experience in establishing and managing key stakeholder relationships, including External Vendors and key internal stakeholders
* Ability to engage and influence others, demonstrating good change management skills and a desire to drive process improvements.
* Strong team worker with an enthusiastic, can-do approach, capable of coordinating and working as ‘one team’.
* Proactive problem solver with a solutions mindset, willing to adjust work schedules as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
* Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly, adapting to changing environments and priorities.
* Strong IT skills, particularly in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. There will be a test to determine your knowledge
* An openness to learn and use AI will be required
* Commitment to driving and delivering quality services and products to Talent, ensuring high standards are met.

**Experiences:**

* Experience of working in Learning or a keen interest in developing a career within this field.
* Experience of working in professional services or corporate environment
* Working in international and diverse environment

**What We Offer**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: HR Business Partner, Factories
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.

This role will create a collaborative effort, through synchronization and matrix functioning, smooth and trouble-free operation in manufacturing to achieve the targeted production with specified quality standards within the decided budget by harmonizing the use of manpower, raw materials, plant, and equipment. As the factory HRBP, you will contribute to creating performance driven values lead by the organization aligning to the business goals with the factory and implementing sustainable HR initiatives with your colleagues to enhance the organization capability of your unit.

**Key Accountabilities:**

Recruitment & Selection of shopfloor employees.

* Set selection criteria based on the recruitment plans.
* Manage and improve the quality of the selection process to recruit 'right' candidates at the right time.
* Onboarding & Induction
* Ensure the required paperwork is completed by the candidates.
* Responsible in coordinating with the required parties to process and provide company properties (uniform, access card, safety vests, safety glasses, other safety wear to be handed to the new entrants).
* Design & implement probationary period development plan for new entrants.

Training and Development

* Collaborate with the process owners/department managers to identify T&D needs as per the requirements of manufacturing excellence model to enhance multiskilling.
* Design programs, measure & improve effectiveness of programs and administration.
* Implement monthly T&D plans to build right capabilities at the Plant.
* Maintain related records/documents in compliance with ISO requirements.

Attendance Management

* Controlling absenteeism & late coming for improving labor productivity.
* Maintain timesheet records of the shopfloor employees.

Performance appraisal

* Set KPI's & monitor work performance, provide feedback & appraise.
* Roll-out performance assessments, monitor progress & compliance to the process to ensure timely and transparent appraisals of engineers & staff at the plant.
* Provide feedback on concerns to Managers, design and implement employee involvement and welfare initiatives.
* To ensure facilitation of individual & group reward and recognition.

Compensation & Benefits Administration

* Administrating Salary & Wages Administration, Full & Final Settlements, Gratuity, Leave, Bonus, Loans Superannuation Settlement.
* Assure quality and timely distribution of employee benefits including canteen, address employee grievances to ensure efficient administration.

Labour relations

* Take disciplinary measures in case of misconducts.
* Responsible in handling complaints, managing grievance procedures, and facilitating counseling in conjunction with other stakeholders.
* Investigating and resolving complex or critical industrial relations issues in a timely and effective manner.
* Collating and analyzing employee feedback across all levels on a regular basis and revising people programs and policies to generate more positive outcomes.
* Study health and hygiene requirements, identify gaps, secure budgets, and close gaps.
* Communicate and organize necessary training to ensure safety of employees.
* Complete initial reporting, accident investigations, communication work restrictions.

Exit procedures

* Ensure the exiting employees return their company properties (uniform, access card, safety vests, safety glasses, other safety wear to be handed to the new entrants).

Statutory Compliance

* Ensure implementation, monitoring & control of HR Strategy in alignment with business strategy and develop / design HR Policies & process.
* Drive and implement D&I practices.
* Keeping healthy liaison with govt., semi govt. authorities like W.C. Commissioner, Gram panchayat, Insurance, Police Station, Banks, P.F. Office, Factory Inspector, Labour Inspector, Pollution Control, Police Authority, Local bodies etc.
* To monitor and comply with all statutory and regulatory compliances.
* Audits & Inspections
* Conducts audit and analyzes reports if required.
* Responsible in conducting inspections periodically if health and safety requirements are met at the plant.

**What We’re Looking For**

To thrive in this role, you should bring:

**Qualifications & Skillsets:**

* Completed full-time master’s in business administration degree specialized in Human Resources/ Industrial & labor relations or PG certificate in HRM.
* 8-10 years of experience in Plant HR in a manufacturing company.
* In-depth exposure to various functions in plant HR with some exposure to IR, PR activities.
* Great verbal and written communications skills; not afraid to speak up when required.
* Strong knowledge of HR policies & procedures.
* In depth knowledge of employment legislations.
* Strong problem solving, negotiation & influencing skills.
* Excellent team management and conflict management skills.
* Meticulous attention to detail, quality, and follow-through; strong interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in MS Office suite of software and general knowledge on HRIS platforms.

**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?**

By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid-flow technology. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: Director/AVP - HR
description:
**WHO ARE WE?**

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

**CloudSEK,**
one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

**CloudSEK’s Product Suite:**

* CloudSEK
  **XVigil**
  constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring
  tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's
  **BeVigil**
  uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* CloudSEK’s Contextual AI
  **SVigil**
  identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.
* CloudSEK’s
  **AIVigil**
  is an AI-native Attack Surface Monitoring platform that continuously discovers, monitors, and secures exposed AI infrastructure, MCP servers, leaked AI credentials, vector databases, agentic workflows, and shadow AI across the internet.

**Key Milestones:**

* **2016**
  : Launched our first product.
* **2018**
  : Secured Pre-series A funding.
* **2019**
  : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* **2020**
  : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* **2021**
  : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* **Awards & Recognition**
  : Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* **2025**
  : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

**About the job**

At CloudSEK, performance, culture, and happiness are not separate — they are deeply linked.

We are building a company where people do the best work of their careers, and we want someone who owns that outcome end-to-end.

The Chief Happiness Officer(Director/AVP HR) is accountable for keeping our teams engaged, motivated, focused, and performing at a high level — while ensuring we retain our best people and build a culture that compounds over time.

This is not a “feel-good HR” role. This is a systems + culture + performance role.

**What you will own**

**1. Measure what matters**

You will build the instrumentation to continuously track:

• Engagement, morale, burnout, and energy levels

• Manager effectiveness and team health

• Attrition risk, regretted exits, and retention of top performers

• Alignment to company mission, clarity of goals, and execution focus

You will turn these into dashboards, signals, and early-warning systems — not once-a-year surveys.

**2. Build feedback and improvement loops**

You will design and run:

• Continuous feedback systems (pulse surveys, 1:1 frameworks, skip-levels)

• Clear escalation and resolution loops for friction, conflict, and disengagement

• Manager coaching programs to improve leadership quality across the company

Your job is to detect problems early and fix them before they impact execution.

**3. Identify, grow, and retain top performers**

**You will:**

• Build a clear, fair system to identify high performers and high-potential talent

• Ensure top performers are recognized, rewarded, and developed faster than the rest

• Design retention strategies for critical talent

• Work with leadership on promotions, growth paths, and succession planning

**Your outcome:**
our best people feel seen, valued, and challenged — not ignored or burned out.

**4. Design a culture that scales**

**You will:**

• Codify and reinforce our cultural values through rituals, stories, and behavior systems

• Ensure culture is consistent across geographies, teams, and growth stages

• Remove incentives and behaviors that create politics, fear, or low-trust environments

• Build a company where speed, ownership, integrity, and excellence are the norm

Culture is not posters — it’s what people do when no one is watching. You will shape that.

**5. Partner with leadership on org design and people strategy**

**You will work closely with:**

• The CEO and leadership team on org health and structure

• Managers on team effectiveness and leadership quality

• HR / People Ops on compensation, performance, and growth systems

You will bring data, insight, and perspective to leadership — not just execution.

**What success looks like**

• High engagement and energy across teams

• Low regretted attrition, especially among top performers

• Managers who are trusted, effective, and respected

• A culture that attracts strong talent and repels low-integrity behavior

• A company where people do great work and want to stay

**Who you are**

• 12+ years in people leadership, culture, org design, or performance roles (startup / tech preferred)

• Strong systems thinker — you can design feedback loops, metrics, and processes

• Deep empathy + high standards — you care about people, but you don’t tolerate mediocrity

• Comfortable with data, dashboards, and analytics

• Confident influencing senior leaders and holding them accountable

• High integrity, low ego, extremely trustworthy

• You genuinely care about helping people do their best work

CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: HR Director, India & Middle East
description:
**Role Overview**
This is a senior, commercially focused HR leadership role responsible for shaping and delivering the employees agenda across India and the Middle East. As a member of the India leadership team and the EMEAI HR team, the HR Director will partner closely with business leaders to translate growth, profitability and organisational priorities into practical employees strategies. The successful candidate will combine strategic judgement with a hands-on approach, using workforce insight, talent decisions and efficient HR delivery to improve business performance.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Commercial HR partnership: advise senior leaders on organisation, capability, workforce, and reward decisions, constructively challenge assumptions and ensure employees investments support revenue growth, productivity, margin and long-term value.
* Talent and succession: strengthen leadership pipelines, succession coverage and retention of critical talent; coach leaders and key employees, and establish clear career pathways, including for engineering and R&D populations.
* Performance and reward: embed consistent performance management, use market and internal data to guide pay decisions, and oversee salary and variable-pay processes with robust cost discipline.
* Organisation and change: lead workforce planning, organisational development and change initiatives that build capability, accountability, engagement, diversity and an effective employee experience.
* Growth and integration: provide HR leadership for expansion and acquisitions, including employee integration, organisation design and cultural alignment.
* Operational excellence and governance: ensure compliant, reliable and cost-effective payroll, benefits and personnel administration; simplify processes through technology, automation, outsourcing and self-service where appropriate.
* Leadership and insight: lead and develop the regional HR team, build succession capability, manage the HR plan and budget, and use meaningful metrics to identify risk, measure impact and inform business decisions.
* Matrix contribution: collaborate across Business Units and Corporate functions and make a strong contribution to the wider EMEAI employees strategy.

**Candidate Profile**

* A commercially minded senior HR professional with 12–15 years’ broad HR experience, including significant leadership responsibility in a complex, international and highly matrixed organisation.
* Strong business acumen and financial awareness, with evidence of linking HR priorities to growth, profitability, productivity, cost and organisational performance.
* A strategic thinker who can build and execute a regional HR plan, while remaining pragmatic, hands-on, results oriented and accountable for delivery.
* Credible and assertive with senior leaders, with excellent communication, negotiation, coaching, influencing and cross-cultural relationship skills.
* Proven capability across talent, succession, reward, employee relations, change, compliance, HR operations and team leadership, ideally within a fast-growing engineering, technology or industrial environment.
* High ethical standards and sound judgement, with the confidence to balance commercial objectives, employee considerations and legal or reputational risk.
* Able and willing to use AI and digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, decision quality, work quality and cost efficiency, while critically evaluating outputs.
* Graduate qualification in business, HR, engineering or a related discipline, together with an appropriate HR or business qualification, and excellent written and spoken English.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a highly matrixed organisation, using strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills to align diverse teams, build consensus and deliver outcomes without direct authority.

**Preferred Experience**

* MBA, master’s degree or equivalent professional qualification.
* Experience supporting engineering or R&D workforces, HR systems, outsourced services and business transformation.
* HR due diligence, acquisition and post-merger integration experience.
* International experience, including working or living abroad.
* Ability to communicate in Hindi and/or other Indian languages.

AMETEK India and Middle East serves as a strategic regional hub that accelerates business growth through engineering, finance, HR, IT, procurement and shared services support. It hosts AMETEK’s India Engineering Center of Excellence, drives AI and automation initiatives, enables market expansion, and provides local commercial, operational and leadership infrastructure across the region.

title: Senior Talent Partner & Advisor (Operations)
description:
**About OpenFx**
OpenFX is on a mission to
**move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems.**
We are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of cross-border payment systems for institutions. The team's execution has been exceptional, and we're scaling at a remarkable pace. Our stellar early team comes with experience in companies like J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, FalconX, Paypal, Affirm, Polygon, Kraken, Nium & others. We’re backed by Accel, Lightspeed, NfX and other top-tier investors.
  
  
**The Role**
We are hiring a senior talent partner and advisor, dedicated to hiring for the Operations team. The operations team includes compliance operations, payments operations, client success, treasury and finance operations, and adjacent roles. Many of these are senior, specialised searches in a regulated industry, spanning India, the US, UK / Europe and the Middle East. You own every operations search end to end, from intake with the hiring manager to a signed offer, in whichever geography the role sits. This is a hands-on sourcing and closing role, not a generalist or people ops role.
  
  
The role reports to the Head of Talent.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the full hiring lifecycle for all operations roles across geographies: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, feedback loops, offer negotiation and close
* Run outbound-led sourcing for operations talent (LinkedIn, referrals, industry networks), with the ability to find niche fintech and payments operators who are not actively looking
* Partner closely with operations leaders to define role requirements, calibrate on profiles and hold a high bar on senior hires
* Navigate the differences in hiring across markets: talent pools, compensation norms, notice periods, visa and relocation considerations
* Run a tight, well-communicated candidate experience and keep hiring managers accountable to interview timelines
* Keep Greenhouse (and any ATS in use) clean and current for your roles: pipelines, scorecards, stage data
* Manage agencies on operations searches where used, and keep agency spend under control
* Report weekly on pipeline health, pass-through rates and time to hire for operations roles

**What We Are Looking For (Must Haves)**

* 10 to 12 years in talent acquisition, with at least 6 years recruiting operations roles at a high-growth startup or scale-up
* Proven track record of closing senior and specialised operations hires through outbound sourcing, not agency hand-offs
* Experience hiring in at least two of our core regions: India, US, UK / Europe or UAE / Middle East
* Can assess operations talent credibly: understands what strong operators in payments, compliance or client-facing functions look like and can screen for it
* Comfortable with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS
* Clear, direct communicator who is comfortable engaging with the hiring managers and managing senior stakeholders

**What We Are Looking For (Good To Have)**

* Fintech, payments or crypto background
* Experience hiring in a regulated industry where compliance and licensing roles are part of the mix
* Agency management experience
* Prior in-house experience at a Series A or B company

What we offer
  
  
Competitive salary and benefits, equity, and a fast-moving fintech environment where your hires shape how the company operates.
  
  
OpenFX is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
We are an In-Office Company and hence expect our colleagues to collaborate and innovate while being present in the Office.

title: Senior and Principal Technical Talent Partner
description:
**Senior and Principal Technical Talent Partner**

India (remote-first, occasional office visits) | Multiple roles | 6-month fixed-term, with a view to extend and permanent options

**Join the build, not the backlog**

We're building a team of Technical Talent Partners in India to partner with one of the world's most recognised technology companies as it grows its India engineering presence quickly.

We'll be honest: this is not a steady-state role. The pace is fast, stakeholders are senior, and the hiring plan is ambitious. If you do your best work when there's real pressure, real ownership and real impact, this is your kind of environment.

We're hiring at two levels. Senior Talent Partners own the room with engineering leaders up to VP level. Principal Talent Partners go further, shaping hiring strategy with executives and leading the most critical engineering hires.

**About Preacta**

At Preacta, we're setting a new benchmark in Recruiting & Talent.

We're a global Talent Solutions organisation built on exceptional people, innovative systems, and thoughtfully designed experiences. We partner with some of the world's most exciting technology companies, including Atlassian and Miro, embedding talented recruitment professionals directly into our clients' businesses to help them scale, innovate and grow.

What started as an Australian organisation has grown into a global operation spanning Australia, the Philippines, India, South Africa, the UK, Europe and the USA.

We're passionate about building better ways of working, challenging traditional recruitment models, and creating an environment where great talent can do their best work.

**What you'll do**

**Senior and Principal Talent Partners**

* **Own the req, front to back.**
  Every requisition in your portfolio is yours. Run full-cycle recruitment across Software Engineering, AI, Security and Infrastructure roles, from intake to offer and close.
* **Be business facing.**
  Partner independently with Engineering Managers, Directors and VPs as the front-facing owner of their hiring – no one sits between you and the business.
* **Lead the intake.**
  Clarify requirements and expectations with hiring leaders, challenge them where needed, and guide them through a structured process.
* **Lead complex searches.**
  Deliver senior-level and niche engineering hires through multi-channel sourcing, market mapping and referrals, working with our Talent Intelligence and Sourcing Engineering teams.
* **Assess with rigour.**
  Run structured screening and qualification conversations, then present shortlists and support hiring leaders through structured evaluation.
* **Hold the line on the talent bar.**
  Think strategically about every hire, and push back with evidence when there's pressure to compromise on quality.
* **Act, don't wait.**
  Bring a bias for action - self-sufficient, resourceful and quick to unblock your own roles.
* **Lead with data.**
  Keep ATS records accurate, know your funnel, give clear progress updates and flag risks early.
* **Make the team better.**
  Spot process breakdowns and fix them, and support peers on delivery and stakeholder management.

**Principal Talent Partners – in addition to the above**

* **Own the most critical hires.**
  Lead Lead, Staff and leadership-level hiring across engineering.
* **Partner at executive level.**
  Build trusted relationships with senior executives and engineering leadership, and present hiring insights and reviews.
* **Plan ahead of demand.**
  Align hiring with the client's workforce plans, contribute to planning and requisition release, and build talent pools for evergreen and high-volume roles.
* **Own talent strategy.**
  Set the approach for complex or specialist portfolios, including market strategy for the India talent landscape.
* **Grow the team.**
  Coach and mentor Talent Partners and Sourcing Engineers.
* **Raise the operating standard.**
  Drive process improvement and operational uplift across the engagement.

**What we're looking for**

**Senior and Principal Talent Partners**

* **Essential:**
  front-facing experience owning requisitions end to end and partnering independently with Engineering Managers, Directors and VP-level leaders.
* Consistent delivery at volume - for Senior Talent Partners, typically 10 or more technical hires a quarter across multiple roles at once.
* A track record of senior-level and niche technical hires in Software Engineering, AI, Security or Infrastructure.
* A working understanding of engineering roles and tech stacks, enough to assess candidates and challenge hiring managers.
* Evidence of delivery, you know your numbers: hires, roles, time to hire and conversion.
* Experience in fast-moving environments, such as scale-ups, Series B–D companies, unicorns or high-volume technology hiring.
* A history of protecting quality under pressure, with examples of when you held the line and why.
* Examples of improving a hiring process, not just running one.

**Principal Talent Partners - in addition to the above**

* **Essential:**
  a track record of Lead, Staff and leadership-level engineering hires.
* Delivery measured on complexity as well as volume: typically 6-8 Lead, Staff or leadership-level hires a quarter, or an equivalent mix of senior and critical hires, in place of the Senior volume benchmark.
* Experience advising senior executives on hiring strategy and workforce planning.
* Experience building or scaling a hiring function, ideally from zero to one.
* A history of coaching or mentoring other recruiters.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, with the calm and judgement of a leader.

**Why join us**

* **A rare build opportunity.**
  Help a globally recognised technology company scale in India and shape how it hires.
* **Work with the best.**
  Partner with world-class engineering leaders on business-critical hiring.
* **A fast, fair process.**
  A short, structured process – screen, two interviews and a final – with decisions within days.
* **Flexibility.**
  Remote-first, with occasional office visits.
* **Room to grow.**
  A 6-month fixed-term contract with a view to extend, and permanent options based on performance and business needs.

**The details**

* **Location:**
  India - remote-first, with occasional office visits
* **Levels:**
  Senior Talent Partner and Principal Talent Partner
* **Employment:**
  6-month fixed-term contract, with a view to extend and permanent options
* **Specialisations:**
  Software Engineering, AI, Security, Infrastructure and broader Technology

**Ready to build?**

Apply with your CV and a short note on your last 12 months: how many hires you made, for which roles and levels, and one time you held the line on quality. Tell us whether you're applying at Senior or Principal level.

Preacta is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and assess every candidate on evidence of capability.

title: HR Business Partner - India
description:
**Job Title**
HR Business Partner - India
  
  
**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
  
  
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
  
  
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
  
  
**Your team**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 listed fintech helping people trade the world’s financial markets since 1974. We run platforms used by more than a million clients across 18 countries. IG Securities is our institutional business, combining Trading, Prime and Technology with a clear ambition to grow. Bangalore is our largest technology hub and one of the most important engineering centres in the group.
  
  
**Your role in the Team’s Success**
You will be the HR Business Partner for Group Technology in IG Securities, partnering leaders across Core Technology, Cyber Security, Infrastructure and Operations and Data and AI. You will own the relationship with the Tech leadership team, run the people agenda for this population and play a central role in building the workforce IG Securities needs for the future. IG Securities is mid-transformation, reducing headcount, shifting to AI-enabled engineering, decommissioning legacy systems, and building deep specialist capability in low-latency and platform engineering. The person who fills this role needs to understand that context, shape the people response to it, and challenge leaders on cost, structure and talent from a position of credibility.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Partner the Technology leadership team**

* Own the relationship with the Group Technology leadership team and be their trusted partner on anything that touches people. Be in the room for the decisions that matter.
* Develop a genuine understanding of how each technology domain works, what Core Trading, Trading Platform, Platform Services, AI DevEx, Prime Technology and Product each do, how they are performing, and what their leaders are most focused on.
* Bring insight your leaders have not asked for. Flag the talent risk before it becomes a resignation. Identify the structural issue before it becomes a problem. Connect the people agenda to what the business is actually trying to deliver.
* Hold a position under pressure without damaging the relationship. Be the person who asks the question no one else will.
* Navigate competing priorities across multiple senior stakeholders and keep everyone moving in the same direction.

**Challenge on cost, headcount and commercial decisions**

* Be the commercial conscience in people decisions, challenge headcount growth, flag cost risk in hiring and contractor plans, and push back when structure does not reflect the strategy.
* Support the contractor reduction and Project Catalyst agenda, ensuring headcount and cost decisions are made with the right information and appropriate rigour.
* Build and defend a business case. Connect people decisions to cost, risk and delivery in language the business uses.
* Use attrition, headcount, engagement and cost data to make an argument, not just to report the position.

**Own the workforce of the future agenda**

* Partner the Tech leadership team on the skills and capability agenda, what Technology skills IG Securities needs in 12-18 months, where the gaps are, and how we close them through retraining, hiring or exiting roles no longer aligned to the strategy.
* Lead the skills inventory process for the Bangalore technology population, working with tech leads to map current capability against future need, identify single-person dependencies, and build a retention plan for the most critical individuals.
* Support the shift to AI-enabled engineering, low-latency expertise and platform reliability as core capabilities, help leaders understand what that means for the shape of their teams.
* Develop clear progression frameworks that make technical and individual contributor careers as visible and valued as people management careers.

**Own initiatives end to end**

* Lead people initiatives for the Technology population, do not wait to be asked and do not hand off what you can own yourself.
* Shape and deliver a people plan that addresses the real challenges: retention of critical engineers, capability building, culture of accountability, and performance differentiation.
* Feed what you see on the ground back into the Centre of Excellence so that central programmes are designed for how the business actually works.

**Lead employee relations in your area**

* Take the most sensitive and complex ER cases, including senior-level and cross-border matters, under Indian employment law.
* Coach managers through cases so they grow in confidence and need you less next time.
* See the pattern behind the cases and fix the cause, not just the case.
* Work with Group ER on anything that carries serious legal or reputational risk.

**Drive a high performance culture**

* Set the bar for what good performance management looks like in the Tech population and push leaders to differentiate, recognise and act.
* Own the engagement agenda for the Bangalore technology population and hold leaders accountable for their own scores rather than carrying it for them.
* Ensure high performers are known, retained and stretched, and that poor performance is addressed with appropriate speed and care.

**Lead organisation design and change**

* Lead restructures in the Technology population from start to finish, compliantly and with care for the people involved.
* Advise leaders on structure, spans, layers and role design before decisions are made, not after.
* Support the operating model changes in IG Securities Technology — helping the business land change in a way that people come with us on.

**What does success look like?**

* The Tech leadership team describes you as a trusted adviser and seeks you out for the hard decisions.
* The skills inventory is complete and is actively being used to shape hiring, retraining and exit decisions.
* Headcount and contractor cost decisions are being made with better rigour and your challenge is welcomed.
* Critical engineers are identified, retained and on clear development paths.
* ER cases are resolved fairly and high-risk matters never catch us by surprise.
* The people plan for Bangalore Technology is owned, delivered and making a visible difference.
* Leaders in the Technology population are more confident, more commercially minded, and managing their people better because of your coaching.

**What You’ll Need For This Role**
We think you will need most of this, and we would rather hear from you if you have some of it and the appetite for the rest.
  
  

* Significant HRBP experience, ideally within technology, financial services or a fast-paced global business and confidence partnering senior technology leaders.
* A genuine commercial curiosity, you want to understand what Technology teams do, how they deliver, and what the business strategy means for the people in them.
* The credibility and courage to challenge senior leaders on cost, headcount, structure and talent, backed by evidence and with the relationship to make it land.
* Experience leading restructures, redundancy processes and organizational change under Indian employment law, with care for the people involved.
* Confidence with ER cases at a senior and complex level, you know when to act, when to escalate, and how to protect the business.
* Strong commercial thinking, you can build a business case, defend a number, and connect people decisions to business outcomes.
* Experience working on skills, capability or workforce planning, ideally in a technology context.
* Comfort with people data. You do not need to be an analyst, but you should enjoy finding the insight in the numbers and using it to influence decisions.
* Clear communication, sound judgement, discretion, and the ability to operate across multiple senior stakeholders simultaneously.
* You work in line with our performance principles: Lead and Inspire, Think Big, Champion the Client, Deliver at Pace and Raise the Bar.

**The Perks**
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognize your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
  
  
**Join us for this exciting journey.**
**Apply now!**

1

title: Associate-Central P&A -Allocations
description:
**Job Description**
Join the Central Planning and Analysis team as part of the Central Allocations team, supporting expense management and allocation processes. You will collaborate with finance partners, business managers, and functional teams to understand financial drivers and analyze trends. This role supports financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and decision support for senior stakeholders across Consumer and Community Banking and Firmwide Finance. You will help deliver actionable insights and improve processes across reporting, planning, and allocations. This is an individual contributor role suited for a highly analytical, motivated finance professional.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Financial Analysis in the Central Planning and Analysis organization, you will support the Central Allocations team across expense management, allocation processes, planning, forecasting, reporting, and decision support. You will partner closely with finance and business stakeholders to understand cost drivers, allocation logic, and financial impacts. You will analyze trends and variances, support allocation methodologies, and provide insights to help senior stakeholders make informed decisions. You will contribute to executive-ready reporting and presentations that clearly communicate key financial messages.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Support the monthly close, forecast, budget, and planning cycles for Central Allocations.
* Prepare, review, and analyze financial reporting, including trends, allocation movements, recoveries, variance analysis, and business commentary.
* Partner with finance and business stakeholders to understand cost drivers, allocation logic, financial impacts, and reporting requirements.
* Perform monthly, quarterly, and yearly variance analysis, identifying key drivers and providing meaningful insights to support management decisions.
* Assist business and finance partners with ad hoc analysis, issue resolution, deep dives, and strategic finance requests.
* Review methodologies, rules, volumes, and financial assumptions to ensure they remain aligned with business needs and Firmwide policies.
* Develop presentations and reporting packs for senior management, clearly explaining trends, risks, opportunities, and key financial messages.
* Use artificial intelligence and related tools to drive process improvements and automation across reporting, planning, and allocations.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* MBA, CFA, CPA, or post graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or related discipline.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), finance support, corporate finance, expense management, financial reporting, or management reporting.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, expense management, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and business performance drivers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and convert analysis into actionable insights.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts, trends, and variances clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.
* Proactive mindset with demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for growth and impact.
* Strong stakeholder management and partnering skills; able to work effectively across teams, functions, and geographies.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight timelines.
* Ability to challenge existing processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, including complex formulas, financial models, data analysis, and executive-ready presentation.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Prior experience in banking, financial services, consulting, or global finance functions.
* Working knowledge of tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Python, SQL, Essbase, SAP, or other reporting and automation platforms.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

title: Sr Operations Manager, AI&R Office
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
**About Technology@Lilly**
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
**Sr Operations Manager, AI&R Office**
At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. You must meet the minimum qualifications outlined in the job description and have/obtain work authorization in the country the position is located in order to be considered. When applying internally for a position, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied to the position. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor prior to applying.
  
  
**Path/Level**
P3
  
  
**Role Summary**
  
  
Run the operational backbone of the AI&R function, spanning across headcount, financials, vendor, reporting, process documentation and internal communications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Workforce and organisation data. Maintain headcount tracking against approved plan across employees and contractors; keep org charts, role mappings, and position status current; coordinate onboarding and offboarding logistics with HR and hiring managers.
* Contractor operations. Own the full contractor lifecycle, demand intake, onboarding and system access, extensions, rate and utilisation tracking, offboarding, and compliance with Lilly contingent-workforce policy.
* Procurement operations. Drive procure-to-pay end to end, including sourcing requests, vendor onboarding and third-party risk review, PO creation, goods receipting, invoice tracking and issue resolution, SOW and renewal timelines.
* Operational dashboards. Build and maintain the function’s reporting layer covering headcount, spend, vendor and license position, and delivery metrics; keep data current and definitions consistent so numbers hold up under scrutiny.
* Leadership reporting. Consolidate status from multiple workstreams into leadership-ready reporting, business reviews, governance decks, executive updates, writing the synthesis rather than forwarding raw submissions.
* Process documentation. Author and maintain SOPs, RACI matrices, and process maps for how the function operates; drive adoption, review cycles, and continuous improvement of those processes.
* Knowledge management. Own the information architecture, SharePoint and Teams site structure, document repositories, naming and version conventions, access governance so material stays findable and current.
* Internal communications and engagement. Produce newsletters, town halls, and leadership updates reaching the whole team; run the leadership operating rhythm (agendas, decision logs, action tracking) and deliver offsites and engagement events.
* Leader support. Provide targeted support to the Senior Director for priority scheduling and engagement logistics. This is a secondary component of the role

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years in business operations, functional operations, or PMO roles
* Hands-on procure-to-pay and vendor management experience in an enterprise platform (SAP, Ariba), including software and subscription procurement.
* Proven experience managing contingent workforce operations at scale, onboarding, tracking, and compliance across multiple suppliers.
* Ability to build and maintain operational dashboards independently and to define metrics that survive leadership challenge.
* Strong written English; able to produce leadership-ready narrative and whole-team communications without editing support.
* Proven discretion with confidential people, financial, and strategy information; sound judgement under ambiguity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or postgraduate qualification in business, operations, or management.
* Experience supporting AI, data science, or R&D technology functions — including familiarity with cloud compute, GPU capacity, and data or model licensing commercials.
* Prior experience in pharmaceutical or life sciences, ideally within a global capability centre in India.

**Additional Information**
  
  

* Up to 10% travel, including international

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
**Manager – F&B**

**Z Hotels | Zolo**

Run the outlet like a business. Protect margins. Elevate the dining experience.

**Why this role exists**

At Z Hotels, F&B is not a support function.

It is:
**A revenue engine + a guest experience layer.**

Guests may come for the stay.

But dining experience significantly shapes:

* Guest satisfaction
* Reviews
* Repeat usage
* Brand perception

As hotel occupancy scales:

* Dining demand increases
* Peak-hour pressure rises
* Table turnover becomes critical
* Cost leakages compound quickly
* Guest expectations around food and service become non-negotiable

Without discipline, F&B operations quickly become:
**Low-margin + inconsistent + complaint-heavy.**

The biggest operational failures usually happen when:

* Revenue performance is not tracked daily
* Food costs and wastage remain uncontrolled
* Service quality becomes inconsistent
* Upselling and banquet opportunities are missed
* Hygiene and compliance standards weaken
* Teams operate without accountability and productivity visibility

Without strong outlet leadership:

* Revenue leakages increase
* Margins weaken despite occupancy growth
* Guest complaints rise
* Team discipline breaks down
* Brand experience becomes inconsistent

This role exists to ensure:

* F&B operates like a structured business unit
* Revenue is tracked and grown predictably
* Costs are controlled tightly
* Service quality remains consistent
* Hygiene and compliance remain non-negotiable

If this role is strong:

* Outlet revenue grows predictably
* Margins improve sustainably
* Guest experience strengthens significantly
* Teams operate with accountability and discipline
* Events and banquets execute smoothly

If this role is weak:

* Revenue leakages increase
* Food cost overruns hurt profitability
* Guest complaints rise
* Service quality becomes inconsistent
* Operations become reactive and chaotic

This role directly controls:
**Revenue + margin + guest experience + outlet performance**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Drive predictable F&B revenue growth
* Protect outlet margins through cost discipline
* Maintain strong service and hospitality standards
* Build a high-performing and disciplined team
* Ensure hygiene and compliance governance consistently

**This is not a floor management role.**

**This is outlet business leadership.**

**About Zolo and Z Hotels**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

Z Hotels operates on:

* Consistency
* Operational discipline
* Predictable guest experience

F&B directly contributes to:

* Revenue diversification
* Guest satisfaction
* Repeat usage and loyalty

The hospitality model works only when:

* Outlet performance is tracked daily
* Service quality remains consistent
* Cost and experience stay balanced
* Teams execute with accountability

At scale:
**F&B discipline determines sustainable profitability.**

This role directly impacts:
**Hotel profitability + guest experience + operational reliability**

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own Revenue & Outlet Performance**

* Track daily:
* Sales
* Covers
* Revenue
* Average Bill Value (ABV)
* Design upselling and promotional strategies
* Improve banquet and event revenue opportunities
* Monitor outlet performance trends consistently
* Conduct weekly reviews and corrective action discussions

**2. Enforce Cost Control & Margin Discipline**

* Track food cost % daily and weekly
* Control wastage, portion sizes, and inventory leakages
* Monitor procurement and vendor pricing closely
* Ensure inventory accuracy and stock rotation discipline
* Conduct cost audits and identify operational leakages proactively
* Balance profitability without compromising guest experience

**3. Lead Guest Experience & Service Standards**

* Conduct regular service quality audits
* Monitor guest feedback and dining experience ratings
* Personally handle major guest escalations and complaints
* Train teams on:
* Service quality
* Etiquette
* Guest interaction standards
* Ensure SOP adherence during peak operations consistently

**4. Drive Team Leadership & Productivity**

* Conduct structured daily team briefings
* Plan staffing and shifts based on occupancy and demand forecasts
* Track productivity and accountability across teams
* Coach and correct underperformance proactively
* Build future supervisors and second-line leaders
* Maintain morale, discipline, and operational energy

**5. Govern Hygiene, Safety & Compliance**

* Conduct regular hygiene and kitchen audits
* Ensure food safety and storage discipline consistently
* Maintain cleanliness standards across kitchen and dining areas
* Enforce grooming and hygiene SOPs strictly
* Maintain audit and compliance readiness at all times

**6. Execute Events & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Plan and execute banquet and event operations smoothly
* Coordinate with:
* Kitchen teams
* Front office
* Operations teams
* Ensure inventory and staffing readiness for events
* Prevent execution breakdowns during high-pressure situations
* Deliver seamless event guest experience consistently

**What success looks like after 12 months**

* Stable and predictable F&B revenue growth
* Increase in Average Bill Value (ABV)
* Food cost maintained within benchmarks consistently
* Minimal service-related guest complaints
* Strong hygiene and audit compliance scores
* Smooth and reliable banquet/event execution
* Predictable contribution to hotel profitability

The outlet begins to feel:
**Structured + Predictable + Scalable**
—not reactive.

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You think commercially, not just operationally
* You track numbers and performance rigorously
* You enforce discipline without damaging morale
* You stay calm during peak operational pressure
* You balance cost and guest experience intelligently
* You naturally take ownership of outcomes

**Experience we value**

* 5–7 years in:
* F&B operations
* Restaurant management
* Hotel dining operations
* Experience managing:
* Outlet revenue
* Food cost control
* Team productivity
* Guest escalations
* Banquet and event execution exposure preferred

Hospitality background preferred.

**Commercial awareness is non-negotiable.**

**The impact you will have**

* Direct impact on hotel profitability
* Improve guest dining experience and reviews
* Control food cost and operational leakages
* Build disciplined and scalable F&B operations
* Strengthen Z Hotels’ hospitality brand perception

**Why join now**

Z Hotels is scaling rapidly across markets.

As occupancy increases:
**F&B discipline will determine whether revenue growth remains sustainable.**

This role offers:

* Ownership of a business unit within the hotel
* Strong exposure to revenue and operational leadership
* Direct impact on profitability and guest experience
* Growth into Cluster and Operations leadership roles.
