title: Reservations Manager
description:
**Reservations Manager**

**Business Unit | Z Hotels | Zolo**

*Own reservations across hotels. Convert demand into bookings. Build a central function that drives occupancy.*

Why this role exists

Z Hotels needs a central reservations function that can manage booking demand across multiple properties, convert enquiries into confirmed stays, maintain reservation accuracy, and coordinate room availability across locations and booking channels.

The Central Reservations Manager will own this function end to end—ensuring every property is represented accurately, every booking opportunity receives timely attention, and the central team contributes directly to occupancy and revenue outcomes.

Your mandate is clear

Build and run a high-performing central reservations team that converts enquiries into bookings across Z Hotels properties. Own response times, follow-ups, booking conversion, reservation accuracy, channel coordination, and performance reporting while ensuring each property's operations team receives timely and accurate booking information.

About Zolo and Z Hotels

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

What you will be responsible for

* **Central Reservation Operations:**
  Own the reservation pipeline across multiple Z Hotels properties, managing incoming enquiries, availability requests, bookings, confirmations, cancellations, modifications, extensions, and special requests.
* **Enquiry Conversion:**
  Drive timely responses and structured follow-ups to convert enquiries into confirmed bookings. Identify where potential bookings are being lost and implement corrective actions.
* **Multi-Property Inventory Coordination:**
  Work with individual hotel teams to maintain accurate information on room availability, rates, room types, restrictions, and property-specific booking conditions.
* **Channel and Booking Management:**
  Oversee reservations from direct enquiries, online travel agencies, corporate accounts, and other active channels. Ensure booking information is accurately captured and discrepancies are resolved quickly.
* **Team Leadership and Productivity:**
  Manage the central reservations team, allocate workloads, set performance expectations, coach team members, and ensure consistent service and conversion standards across shifts or channels.
* **Reservation Quality and Accuracy:**
  Establish checks to minimise incorrect dates, guest details, room categories, rates, duplicate bookings, missed updates, and other errors that can affect guest experience or hotel operations.
* **Guest Communication and Escalations:**
  Maintain clear standards for enquiry handling, booking confirmations, payment or guarantee requirements, cancellations, modifications, and resolution of reservation-related complaints.
* **Coordination with Property Teams:**
  Establish reliable handover processes so hotel teams receive accurate arrival lists, booking updates, guest preferences, group requirements, and special requests in time to prepare for arrivals.
* **Performance Monitoring:**
  Track and review enquiry volumes, response times, conversion rates, follow-up completion, cancellations, booking errors, channel contribution, and team productivity. Translate performance gaps into specific actions.
* **Process and System Improvement:**
  Build standard operating procedures, escalation matrices, reporting dashboards, and workflows that allow the central function to support more properties without compromising booking quality or response speed.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Work with Sales, Revenue, Marketing, Finance, and hotel operations to resolve booking bottlenecks, improve conversion, maintain rate and inventory consistency, and support occupancy objectives.

What success looks like after 6–12 months

* A central reservations function operates consistently across all assigned Z Hotels properties, with clear ownership and standard workflows.
* Enquiries receive timely responses and disciplined follow-ups, improving conversion into confirmed bookings.
* Reservation conversion, response times, and team productivity are visible through reliable performance reporting.
* Availability and rates are communicated accurately across properties and relevant booking channels.
* Booking errors, avoidable reservation disputes, and missed follow-ups reduce.
* Property teams receive timely, accurate information about upcoming arrivals, changes, and special requirements.
* The team identifies booking losses and channel-level issues and takes measurable corrective action.
* Reservation processes scale as more properties are added, without a corresponding deterioration in service or accuracy.

Who this role is for

You are a hospitality reservations professional who can manage a central team and think across a portfolio of properties. You combine commercial urgency with operational discipline: you want to convert demand, but you also understand that an inaccurate booking or a missed handover can damage the guest experience.

You are comfortable using data to manage performance, coaching people against measurable standards, resolving cross-property coordination issues, and building processes that work consistently without requiring constant intervention.

Experience we value

* Experience in central reservations, multi-property hotel reservations, hotel booking operations, or a comparable hospitality environment.
* Strong understanding of hotel inventory, room types, rate plans, booking channels, cancellations, modifications, and reservation workflows.
* Experience managing reservation executives or a booking operations team against service, conversion, and accuracy metrics.
* Familiarity with hotel PMS, CRS, channel managers, OTA extranets, and reservation reporting tools.
* Ability to analyse booking funnels, identify lost-conversion opportunities, and improve team performance using data.
* Experience coordinating with hotel operations, revenue teams, sales teams, and other stakeholders across multiple properties.
* Strong communication, escalation management, process design, and execution skills.

Candidates from OTA or travel booking operations may be considered if they have meaningful hotel inventory and reservation exposure, along with demonstrable team leadership and accountability for booking outcomes.

The impact you will have

You will turn central reservations into a measurable business function for Z Hotels—improving booking conversion, supporting occupancy, reducing reservation leakage and errors, and enabling multiple properties to operate through one reliable reservation process.

Why join now

As Z Hotels expands across properties, the central reservations function can become a key driver of commercial performance and guest experience. This role offers the opportunity to build that function, develop a high-performing team, and establish the systems and standards needed to scale.

title: Manager, Supply Chain
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.

In this role, the Supply Chain Manager manages the supply chain team—driving procurement execution, material planning, and supplier performance to ensure on-time delivery, inventory optimization, and system efficiency, while developing people capabilities that support Armstrong’s operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Strategic & Analytical Thinking**

* Forecasting demand and planning capacity while balancing cost, speed, and risk
* Making data-driven decisions using KPIs (inventory turnover, fill rate, lead time, OTIF)
* Seeing the end-to-end flow — not just their own link in the chain
* Adjusting to market shifts, tariffs, or supply shocks
* Driving continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma mindset)Financial Acumen
* Understanding cost structures — procurement, warehousing, transportation, inventory carrying costs
* Making trade-off decisions that protect margins without hurting service levels

**Ensure On-Time Delivery (OTD) and Procurement Execution**

* Drive on-time delivery (OTD) as a top-level KPI, aiming for high performance across all suppliers and value streams.
* Oversee timely procurement by ensuring buyers act on purchase requisitions promptly and in correct quantities & Focus on LT on deliveries
* Conduct daily shortage and backlog reviews with planners and buyers to ensure a continuous flow of production orders.
* Lead a daily cadence meeting with the entire buyer-planner team to review order releases, past dues (quantity and dollar value), and commodity-specific challenges.
* Monitor and support adherence to consignment agreements for critical parts such as castings and impellers sourced through partners like the Regional Supply Chain team.

**Lead Material Planning and Inventory Optimization**

* Review Material Requirement Planning (MRP) signals regularly and coordinate material fulfillment by collaborating with suppliers and aggregating demand when feasible.
* Coordinate closely with global demand planners to align inventory and safety stock levels with forecasts.
* Optimize safety stock strategies, drive inventory turnover improvements, and enforce just-in-time (JIT) principles across Armstrong facilities and supplier sites.
* Lead efforts to improve forecasting precision and production order releases with internal planners, ensuring readiness aligned with capacity and customer expectations.
* Have CFT approach on new product launches and enhance material procurement plans accordingly.

**Monitor and Improve Supply Chain Performance**

* Develop and sustain delivery performance tracking systems using the PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) methodology to drive continuous improvement.
* Track and analyze key supply chain metrics such as lead times, order handling cycle times, and fill rates to enhance operational performance.
* Collaborate with customer service and sales teams to improve lead times and streamline the quote-to-fulfill cycle.
* Monitor global trends, disruptions, and risks to adapt supply chain strategies using tools like dual sourcing, supplier localization, and logistics optimization.

**Strengthen Supplier Management and Accountability**

* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships through regular performance reviews, scorecards, and compliance checks.
* Conduct supplier audits and implement continuous improvement initiatives based on audit findings and operational KPIs.
* Collaborate with sourcing and supplier teams to proactively assess capacity constraints and implement delivery assurance strategies.
* Structure and assign supplier ownership clearly among buyers and planners by value streams, reducing overlap and improving accountability.
* Enforce ISO-compliant procedures for purchasing and planning functions to maintain quality and process integrity.

**Lead and Develop Buyer-Planner Teams**

* Supervise a team of buyer/planners categorized by product families and value streams.
* Clarify ownership of supplier portfolios by aligning responsibilities to specific value streams, reducing overlap and improving accountability.
* Drive transformation initiatives to realign team structure for better performance tracking and supplier relationship management.
* Conduct coaching, training, and performance reviews to build capability in ERP tools and supply chain analytics.
* Provide mentorship and day-to-day guidance to buyer-planners to improve performance and ownership.

**Implement and Optimize Supply Chain Systems**

* Lead the implementation of Kinaxis for advanced planning capabilities, guiding cross-functional teams through integration and change management.
* Monitor and correct LN ERP workflows and master data issues to ensure planning and execution systems are synchronized.
* Automate routine supply chain tasks and enhance system capabilities to improve forecast accuracy, planning responsiveness, and operational agility.
* Ensure that all systems are aligned to support dynamic planning requirements and real-time visibility into supply performance.

**Integrate Supply Chain in New Products, Projects, and Regions**

* Collaborate with engineering, sales, and program teams to support new product introductions (NPIs), phase-outs, and engineering change orders.
* Lead supply chain integration for new regional markets and strategic projects, ensuring timely sourcing, logistics setup, and compliance alignment.
* Participate in SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) processes with commercial teams to align inventory and demand.
* Streamline and optimize the New Change Process (NCP) to improve supply chain responsiveness to product lifecycle changes.

**People Management**

* Coaching and motivating warehouse, procurement, and logistics staff
* Delegating effectively across multiple sites or shifts
* Conflict resolution between departments (e.g., sales wants more stock, finance wants less)
* Building long-term supplier partnerships, not just transactional deals
* Managing multiple stakeholders — internal teams, 3PLs, customers, regulators

**Problem-Solving Under Pressure**

* Handling disruptions (supplier delays, demand spikes, logistics failures) quickly and calmly
* Root-cause analysis rather than just firefighting
* Building contingency plans and backup supplier networks

**Communication & Negotiation**

* Negotiating pricing, terms, and SLAs with vendors and suppliers
* Translating operational issues into business language for senior leadership
* Aligning sales, procurement, warehousing, and finance teams who often have conflicting priorities

**What We’re Looking For**

To thrive in this role, you should bring:

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree Mechanical/Electrical/industrial engineering or Masters in business administration, supply chain management, operations management shall be an additional advantage.
* 10-15 years of demonstrated experience in supply chain, procurement and logistics functions in a configured manufacturing environment.
* Preferred to have the following:
* APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
* Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM)
* Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) – from ISM
* Prior experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, ideally LN or similar such as SAP, CMS etc.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, with advanced data organization and analytics capabilities in Excel and Power BI.
* Exposure to supply chain planning platform like Kinaxis.

**Technical Skills**

* Excellent understanding of materials planning and inventory management principles.
* Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and experience in implementing process improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of cost reduction and supply optimization initiatives.
* Knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies is considered an asset
* Knowledge of commodity costing & rich supplier Base locally/globally.
* Good understanding on Manufacturing processes.

**Soft Skills**

* Demonstrated success in leadership experience managing teams or cross-functional projects
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis.
* Capability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse stakeholders, suppliers and team members.

**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?**

* By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid-flow technology while upholding Armstrong's commitment to sustainability. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
AD-ASM Service Delivery Manager

**Job Description | Offshore Service Delivery Leadership**

Role Summary:

The Java/AWS AD & ASM Service Delivery Manager is the single point of accountability for end-to-end delivery of Application Development and Application Management Services across the Java application and AWS including cloud landscape and platforms understanding. The role combines hands-on technical and functional oversight with ITIL-led service governance, executive stakeholder management, commercial ownership, workforce leadership, and continuous improvement. The incumbent will ensure stable operations, predictable delivery, SLA achievement, high user satisfaction, and measurable business value across environments.

Experience and Profile

* 15 years of industry experience, including significant leadership responsibility in AMS, application support, enhancements, and development delivery.
* Proven experience managing medium-to-large support and development engagements with cross-functional teams of 50+ consultants.
* **Application development & AMS leadership**
* Strong delivery ownership across with core depth in Java engineering, AWS, cloud services and application support –
  **Full stack application development across agile implementation**
* Experience managing global delivery models, multi-vendor environments, template rollouts, and business-critical operations.
* Demonstrated commercial acumen, including P&L awareness, contract and scope governance, effort estimation, productivity management, and margin improvement.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage business leaders, IT leadership, process owners, and delivery teams.
* ITIL certification preferred
* Automation, GenAI, and agentic AI mindset with evidence of applying technology to improve service efficiency and quality.

Core Java/AWS

* Provide delivery oversight for Java-based applications, APIs, microservices, batch services, integration components, and cloud-native workloads hosted on AWS.
* Ensure strong engineering governance across Java, Spring Boot, REST and SOAP APIs, microservices, messaging, containerized workloads, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and secure coding.
* Oversee cloud services relevant to the managed landscape, such as EC2, ECS or EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, SNS, SQS, Route 53, load balancing, and infrastructure automation.
* Govern application availability, scalability, resiliency, performance, security, cost efficiency, backup, disaster recovery, patching, vulnerability remediation, and cloud operational readiness.
* Provide technical leadership for incident diagnosis, JVM and application performance analysis, log and trace analysis, API failures, database issues, deployment defects, cloud capacity events, and integration disruptions.
* Ensure reliable integration between Java/AWS applications
* middleware, CPI, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, events, files, or approved enterprise integration patterns.
* Validate solution designs, technical specifications, estimates, non-functional requirements, test strategy, release plans, rollback plans, and production-readiness criteria for Java/AWS
* Drive modernization, technical debt reduction, platform upgrades, cloud adoption, automation, and service improvements without compromising production stability.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End AMS Service Delivery

* Own service delivery across incidents, service requests, problems, enhancements, minor releases, and approved project work within the application development scope and landscape.
* Define and govern the operating model across L1, L2, L3, functional, technical, integration, testing, release, and project teams.
* Ensure SLA, KPI, OLA, quality, productivity, backlog, ageing, availability, resolution, and customer satisfaction targets are achieved.
* Run daily and weekly operational reviews, monthly service reviews, and quarterly governance forums with clear actions and accountability.
* Maintain service continuity, on-call coverage, major incident readiness, knowledge management, and transition-to-support controls.
* Balance business priorities, technical risk, capacity, and release commitments to deliver a stable and predictable service.

2. Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Governance

* Provide leadership during priority incidents, ensure timely stakeholder communication, and drive restoration through coordinated technical and functional response.
* Govern root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions for recurring Java integration issues; track actions to verified closure.
* Chair or support change and release governance, ensuring impact assessment, estimation, testing, approvals, segregation of duties, transport sequencing, rollback planning, and post-implementation validation.
* Improve first-time-right delivery and reduce incident recurrence, emergency changes, failed transports, and avoidable rework.
* Ensure compliance with client ITSM processes, change calendars, audit requirements, security policies, and documentation standards.

3. Client and Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary service delivery contact for client IT leadership, business process owners, CoE, and internal delivery stakeholders.
* Build trusted relationships, manage expectations, communicate service health transparently, and resolve escalations with urgency and discipline.
* Present executive dashboards covering service performance, major incidents, risks, capacity, release status, improvement initiatives, and business outcomes.
* Facilitate steering committees, service review boards, demand prioritization, and escalation forums.
* Identify opportunities for service expansion, modernization, automation, and value creation while maintaining contractual and delivery integrity.

4. Team, Capacity, and Resource Management

* Lead, mentor, and develop a cross-functional team support analysts, integration specialists, testers, and delivery leads.
* Define roles, skill matrices, succession coverage, performance objectives, certification plans, and targeted learning paths.
* Own resource forecasting, demand-capacity planning, onboarding, transition, utilization optimization, pyramid management, and critical-skill retention.
* Coordinate with talent acquisition, HR, practice teams, and subcontractors to fulfil approved demand and minimize delivery gaps.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, documentation discipline, continuous learning, and a service-oriented culture.

5. Commercial and Contract Governance

* Manage delivery within the agreed contract, scope, service catalogue, staffing model, and financial baseline.
* Monitor effort, utilization, productivity, leakage, subcontractor costs, change requests, and delivery risks affecting revenue or margin.
* Validate estimates and commercial impact for enhancements, new scope, transformation initiatives, and out-of-scope requests.
* Support financial forecasting, invoicing inputs, cost optimization, and P&L improvement actions.
* Prevent scope creep through disciplined demand intake, prioritization, approvals, and traceability.

6. Continuous Improvement, Automation, and AI

* Build and execute a continuous service improvement roadmap linked to measurable operational and business outcomes.
* Drive automation across ticket triage, monitoring, testing, code review, knowledge retrieval, recurring fixes, reporting, and release controls.
* Assess and govern GenAI and agentic AI use cases for AMS while protecting client data, security, compliance, and human accountability.
* Improve shift-left capability, self-service, knowledge reuse, defect prevention, and predictive risk identification.
* Benchmark service performance and translate improvement opportunities into approved initiatives with tracked benefits.

7. Risk, Compliance, and Quality

* Maintain a live risk, issue, dependency, and action register covering delivery, service, technology, people, security, compliance, and commercial exposure.
* Define early-warning indicators and escalation thresholds before risks result in business disruption or SLA impact.
* Ensure audit readiness, access and transport compliance, segregation of duties, evidence retention, and adherence to client quality processes.
* Conduct regular service health checks and implement recovery or improvement plans for areas below target.
* Ensure business continuity, disaster recovery support, knowledge resilience, and succession coverage for critical services.

Service Management Metrics

The role should be comfortable defining, interpreting, and improving metrics such as:

**Metric Area**

**Illustrative Measures**

**Service performance**

SLA attainment, response and resolution compliance, backlog ageing, reopen rate, first-contact resolution, major incidents, user satisfaction

**Engineering quality**

Defect leakage, rework, code review compliance, code-quality findings, technical debt, vulnerability remediation, deployment success, test effectiveness, release stability

**Delivery productivity**

Throughput, enhancement cycle time, estimate accuracy, utilization, automation benefits, shift-left adoption, knowledge reuse

**Business and commercial**

Demand fulfilment, service availability, business impact avoided, benefit realization, scope adherence, cost efficiency, revenue and margin indicators

Education and Certifications

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business, or a related discipline.
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification strongly preferred.

title: Fleet & Service Head
description:
**FLEET & SERVICE HEAD**

**About the Role:**
At our organization, every vehicle on the road is a driver’s livelihood. When a vehicle is down, the driver isn’t earning and we’re losing revenue. We’re looking for a Fleet Service & Operations Lead to own the service experience behind our fleet: fast ticket closure, high uptime, quick recovery and replacement, and tight control of service costs across cities.

You’ll lead the Service and Asset teams that handle daily service, breakdown, recovery, and vehicle return tickets. You’ll work closely with service centers, OEM partners, vehicle providers, and spares vendors to keep downtime low and turnaround times tight. You’ll also run the processes that keep the fleet accountable, including audited deployments, exchanges and returns through the Fyn Application, daily physical audits at our warehouses, and accurate platform data. Using telematics and audit data, you’ll move the team from reactive fixes to predictive and preventive maintenance.

**Job Description:**

*1. Fleet Growth*

● Work with Vehicle OEMs to identify, test, and qualify vehicles for the fleet as per business requirements and testing SOPs.

● Negotiate and close vehicle quotes with OEMs for required quantities and pricing.

● Work with Vehicle Providers (Financiers/Lessors) to close leasing agreements with negotiated EMI values, lease terms, and tenure.

● Coordinate tri-partite Service Level Agreements (SLAs) between Vehicle Providers and OEMs to ensure proper post-procurement servicing.

● Ensure strict Pre-Delivery Inspections (PDIs) are closed before registration, confirming zero issues and full feature presence.

● Coordinate with Vehicle Providers and OEMs for quick registration and hypothecation closure, including insurance and document collection.

● Coordinate with Fast Charging/Battery Swapping providers or CPOs to ensure charging infrastructure is ready for newly procured vehicles.

*2. Daily Operations*

● Manage the Service and Asset team to ensure daily closure of tickets — service, recovery, breakdowns, and attritions (vehicle returns).

● Coordinate cross-functionally to fulfill all business and operations requirements.

● Ensure minimum operational revenue loss (per target) from vehicle issues, through strong service/replacement SOPs.

● Ensure vehicle uptime targets are met across all cities via close coordination with service centers, vehicle providers, and OEM partners.

● Ensure audited deployment, exchange, and return of vehicles to drivers via the Fyn Mobile App.

● Ensure daily physical audits of all fleet vehicles at Fyn warehouse locations (in service, returned, or deployment-ready).

● Control service and vehicle movement costs, and maximize damage recovery from clients/drivers on vehicle return.

● Manage vendor relationships for servicing and spares, including weekly invoice auditing and payment cash flow.

● Ensure monthly Repair & Maintenance reports are tracked for accounting and MIS purposes.

● Ensure all vehicle addition/inactivation data and related cost data (charging, AMC, maintenance) are audited and captured monthly for accounting and MIS.

● Work with Vehicle Providers to ensure accurate lease billing, including downtime tracking and deductions.

● Execute time-sensitive activities within defined TAT — accident insurance claims, vehicle release during legal matters — to minimize downtime.

● Use vehicle telematics and audit data to plan predictive and preventive maintenance.

*3. Fleet Data & Technology*

● Ensure uptime of all vehicle telematics (IoT) devices for 24/7 tracking and traceability.

● Ensure uptime of immobilizer and battery-blocking systems for round-the-clock vehicle recovery capability.

● Ensure all vehicle data on the Fyn internal platform is current, with all documents uploaded.

● Ensure the platform captures complete financial and agreement data — Monthly EMI, lease start/end dates, ownership type, security deposit, etc.

● Ensure vehicle status on the platform always matches real-world status and location.

● Work with Tech and Product teams to continuously enhance and digitally implement data points, processes, and workflows on the Fyn platform and app, in line with business and operational needs.

● Monitor and control the fleet daily via OEM telematics dashboards, tracking battery health, asset performance, utilization, and safety.

● Manage and maintain Metabase via SQL queries for fleet analytics, ticketing systems, data tracking, fleet counts, and financier visibility for investors.

● Drive AI implementation to speed up analytics, insights, and complex problem-solving using fleet data.

● Work with OEM and technology partners to keep the fleet current with the latest telematics hardware, battery technology, performance controls, and charging network access.

**Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor’s Degree in Automobile or related field.

2. Excellent written and verbal communication.

3. Must have proven experience in scaling fleet, repair and maintenance(2W, 3W, 4W Vehicles).

4. EV Vehicle exposure and understanding.

Interested candidates can apply using our internal portal link: Link

title: Senior Business Operation Manager
description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
**As Senior Business Operations Manager,**
you will independently own impactful projects and initiatives, end-to-end. They will emerge from data, voice of our customers, from our people on the ground and in general from cross-business units across Payoneer.
  
  
You’ll be asked to lead these projects and initiatives, while in most cases the actual solution will be driven by other departments. You’ll be responsible for keeping ROI in mind and balancing quick wins with core initiatives that support our long-term growth strategy.
  
  
You’ll partner with business units across Payoneer to drive business operational excellence through building clear improvement. For this, you’d be analyzing the data, calculating the required resources for your initiatives, and be accountable for their cross-company execution. You’ll do all this whilst also keeping cost and risk implications in mind, and in an environment of competing demands for resources and frequent re-prioritizations.
  
  
The issues you will be dealing with will be central and with high potential to impact the business positively done, you will be the owner, driving multiple cross-functional teams and senior management to get things done, fast and with high quality.
  
  
Your actions and progress will be clearly measured by increase of our revenues or a reduction in our losses.
  
  
**What you’ll do**

title: Senior Manager -Publications Delivery Lead - Scientific Publications(GBS BBU)
description:
Job Title: Senior Manager - Publications Delivery Lead - Scientific Publications(GBS BBU)
  
  
Career Level: E
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build and lead a world-class publications capability that elevates scientific communication and accelerates impact for patients and clinicians? Do you thrive on creating structure, scaling teams, and delivering measurable outcomes in a fast-moving, global environment?
  
  
As the Publications Delivery Lead, you will establish and run a multi-tier Publications Delivery team encompassing content authors, visual designers, and iEnvision specialists. You will blend people leadership with operational excellence to deliver end-to-end publications that are on time, scientifically accurate, and aligned with global standards and policy. Your work will connect directly to how our evidence is delivered to the scientific community and informs better decisions. It will also involve crafting how we operate at scale across therapy areas and publication types.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Team Build-Out and Leadership: Establish and scale a high-performing publications delivery organization; define roles, levels, and career pathways that attract and retain top talent.
* Mentoring and Capability Development: Provide structured mentorship and feedback to publication writers, graphic artists, and iEnvision experts; improve scientific rigor, storytelling, and visual communication.
* Performance and Workforce Planning: Set clear goals, run regular check-ins, manage performance, and recognize excellence; forecast demand, plan capacity, and lead recruitment, onboarding, and succession to match portfolio needs.
* Delivery Excellence: Oversee end-to-end planning, drafting, review cycles, approvals, and finalization of publications to meet timelines and quality standards; drive first-time-right delivery and reduce cycle times.
* Ways of Working and SOPs: Design and implement SOPs, RACI matrices, workflows, and operating models across therapy areas and publication types to ensure consistency and scalability.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify bottlenecks and lead Lean/Kaizen initiatives; standardize guidelines across teams to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Metrics and Quality Management: Define and track SLAs, important metrics, and objectives and key results, including timely delivery, first-time-right quality, cycle-time, rework rates, and collaborator happiness; implement robust QA/QC processes, editorial standards, and audit readiness; ensure compliance with GPP or equivalent experience and internal policies.
* Risk and Issue Management: Proactively identify risks, maintain RAID logs, and drive timely mitigations and resolution of critical issues to protect delivery and quality.
* Collaborator Partnerships and Governance: Build positive relationships with BBU publication teams and external partners; run structured demand intake, triage, resourcing, and scheduling; lead stand-ups, iteration reviews, routine oversight meetings, and QBRs; publish dashboards and present performance to leadership.
* Serve as the trusted advisor for publication-related queries. Provide high-impact review and mentorship to Expert and Senior Publication Writers. Resolve conflicting author comments and changing collaborator needs through clear facilitation and alignment.
* Standards and Compliance: Align with GPP, ICMJE, CONSORT/PRISMA where applicable, and medical-legal-regulatory requirements; advocate appropriate use of EQUATOR Network guidelines.
* Tools, Technology, and Documentation: Champion publication management platforms, digital archives, citation tools, cooperative software, and workflow trackers; build and maintain templates, checklists, SOPs, and training materials; explore AI opportunities to improve efficiency; develop automated dashboards and run monthly business reviews that deliver actionable insights.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Education: Advanced degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, or related field.
* Experience: 08-12 years in the field of medical writing and publications, including 3+ years in people management and operations leadership.
* Proven track record: Setting up new teams/functions in GCCs or service agencies, implementing SOPs, critical metrics, and delivery governance.
* Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of GPP, ICMJE, CONSORT/PRISMA, ethical authorship, data standards, and journal/congress processes.
* Operational excellence: Demonstrated ability to run large-scale delivery with metrics, QA, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborator management: Experience collaborating with global cross-functional groups and outside agencies; strong communication and influence skills.
* Global experience: Working across time zones and cultures; experience in global capability centres or offshore/nearshore models.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* PhD/MD/PharmD/MSc.
* ISMPP CMPP Certification.
* Hands-on experience with publication management tools, content repositories, reference managers, collaboration suites, iEnvision, and solutions for overseeing workflow progress.
* Experience creating and maintaining templates, checklists, SOPs, and training materials for scalable operations.
* Familiarity with Lean, Kaizen, and standardization methods in publication operations.
* Awareness of AI potential in medical publications and identification of efficiency/savings opportunities.
* Experience building automated dashboards and leading monthly business reviews to inform decision-making.
* Background in scientific visualization or publication graphics programs.
* Exposure to agile governance forums such as sprint reviews, monthly governance calls, and QBRs.

**Purpose and Scope:**

* The role will be responsible for driving consistency of service delivery standards and solutioning of continuous service improvement opportunities to ensure the delivery is continuously improving and reflects best practice benchmarks

* The role will analyse Service Quality (3rd party provider SLAs), understand trends and completing root cause analysis to identify continuous improvement opportunities and develop options / proposals / business cases for changes in service delivery – to be reviewed and approved by senior stakeholders
* The role will own and oversee the implementation of all service transition and continuous improvement projects
* The role will act as an Account Mgmt. (point of contact) for broader HR colleagues across the CoE and Business Partner teams – ensuring they are properly supported by the People Services function
* The role will act as a custodian for employee experience aligned with business outcomes and overall HR vision, purpose and objectives

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Strategic Planning: Develop and maintain a strategic continuous improvement plan for HR focusing on reliability and high performance across operational, query, and transactional activities.
* Change Solutioning: Design and implement changes in scope and service to support the dynamic HR environment.
* Account Management: Serve as the primary contact for HR GPO, ensuring alignment with global models and principles, and supporting HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and Centers of Excellence (CoEs).
* Service Transition Oversight: Oversee transitions of scope/processes to third-party providers (NGA & Conduent), aligning HR activities with the agreed HR Operating Model.
* Third-Party Management: Support day-to-day account management of service delivery by third parties, acting as a point of contact as needed.
* Change Request Tracking: Manage and track business-as-usual change requests with third-party providers, collaborating with HR Operations stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Ensure senior stakeholders inside and outside People Services are aligned with the HR Service Delivery model and objectives.
* Performance Analysis: Review and analyze service reports from third-party providers, manage SLAs, and use data insights to drive improved performance.
* Model Stabilization: Drive the stabilization and adoption of the Global People Services Model (including myHR, Global Payroll, Global Time, and People Services Specialists) for respective countries/clusters.

  

**Required skills, experience & education:**

* Substantial experience in a leadership position encompassing HR, customer service and project management
* Sound knowledge and experience in Employee Experience across core HR functions (e.g. Compensation, Benefits, Performance Management, etc.) with substantial experience in HR process design, transaction support and employee administration within a multinational organisation – across geographical regions
* Sound knowledge and experience of HR metrics and their applicability
* Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
* Experience in the development and implementation of a range of continuous improvement projects, including both technology and process improvement in a cross-cultural, multinational setting
* Strong knowledge and experience Project Management Tools and Techniques
* An in-depth knowledge and understanding of the HR employee lifecycle
* Good understanding of employment law, its application and best practice.
* Proven excellent people manager with an ability to lead and motivate a team
* Experience of coaching employees and managers on employee lifecycle processes
* Experience of delivering to customer service targets within a complex environment
* Ability to multi-task and alter direction easily to accommodate changing priorities
* Sound judgement to manage conflicting priorities and manage client expectations.
* Experience of creating and managing a budget
* Chartered MCIPD or equivalent qualification, or equivalent HR experience.

title: Tech Lead Manager, Software Engineering
description:
### **ABOUT EARNIN**

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products.

As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly.

**POSITION SUMMARY**  
We're on a mission to reinvent the financial system and make it work for people. We are looking for an experienced professional to lead a full-stack engineering team comprising backend and mobile engineers. As a hands-on Tech Lead Manager for one of our core services teams, you will have the unique opportunity to contribute to the design and development of some of our early-stage, innovative products. You will work with your cross-functional partners and team to shape the direction of these products and help make them significant drivers for the company.

This position is a hybrid role based in our **Bengaluru office,** with 2 days a week in the office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View HQ. Our salary ranges depend on role, level, and location.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Partner closely with Product and other engineering teams to improve business metrics and build new features. Examples include improving user acquisition metrics, cross-selling and upselling products, and improving user experience.
* Drive the design and implementation of new product areas and features. Break complex problems down to their bare essentials, translate that complexity into elegant design, and create high-quality, maintainable code.
* Guide your team through ambiguity and ensure technical excellence through rapid experimentation cycles.
* Guide your team to strong execution—make pragmatic decisions, help them launch MVPs quickly, and iterate based on feedback.
* Lead your team through frequent pivots and evolving priorities in a fast-changing environment.
* Recruit other great engineers for your team and support recruiting efforts across teams.
* Mentor and coach the engineers on your team. Help them advance their careers by enabling them to do the best work of their lives.
* Manage cross-functional relationships with all teams to deliver high-quality products.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent industry experience
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading a small team as a manager.
* You're just as energized diving into architecture, writing clean, scalable code, and solving challenging technical problems as you are mentoring engineers, shaping team culture, and driving delivery. You know when to roll up your sleeves and when to empower others—and you're equally excited to do both.
* You can work comfortably with a cross-functional team of PMs, Analysts, and mobile and back-end-focused engineers.
* You have led a team that consistently delivered high-quality output on critical infrastructure projects.
* You are a creative, tenacious problem solver with a get-it-done attitude
* You tend to be the standard bearer who takes a great deal of pride in your work and can inspire others to rise to the occasion
* You can create and maintain a positive, healthy team environment in which everyone is supported, encouraged, and meaningfully challenged to do great work
* Preferred tech skills: C#, .NET/.NET Core, Kotlin, Python, SQL, Databricks, AWS, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, Kafka, CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native development.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar tools) as part of your software development workflow
* Experience in fintech is a plus.
* Experience leading the design, implementation, and deployment of high-scale cross-functional payments systems.

#LI-Hybrid

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E-Verify participant.

EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

title: Head of IT & Operations Support
description:
Head of IT & Operations Support, India

*Machinify | IT & Site Operations*

**Location:** India (on-site at the primary Machinify India office)

**Reports to:** Global IT/Corporate Operations leadership (US-based), with a growth path toward an India Site Lead role

**Direct reports:** IT support staff and facilities/administrative operations staff based in India

**Employment type:** Full-time

**About Machinify**
===================

Machinify is a healthcare payment integrity company formed through the 2024–2025 mergers of Legacy Machinify, Apixio Payment Integrity (CPS/ClaimLogiq, including Varis), Rawlings Company (Right Payer Solutions), and Performant Health. As we integrate infrastructure and operations across four previously separate companies, our India office needs strong local IT and operations leadership to support a growing employee base and to lay the groundwork for a future site leadership function.

**Role Summary**
================

The Head of IT & Operations Support will own day-to-day IT infrastructure and facilities/administrative operations for Machinify's India office. This role is the local point of accountability for employee IT support, office operations, vendor management, and facilities, while also helping integrate India infrastructure with Machinify's broader (mixed cloud and on-premise) technology environment. Over time, and as the India presence grows, this role is expected to expand into a broader Site Lead position with additional people and operational responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**IT Infrastructure & Support**
-------------------------------

* Manage day-to-day IT operations for the India office: helpdesk/employee support, hardware and software provisioning, network and endpoint management.
* Support integration of India IT systems with Machinify's global infrastructure, which spans mixed cloud and on-premise environments across four legacy entities.
* Maintain IT security practices consistent with Machinify's compliance obligations (HITRUST r2; SOC 2 Type I & II where applicable) and healthcare data handling requirements (HIPAA, HITECH).
* Manage relationships with local IT vendors, ISPs, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers.
* Maintain IT asset inventory, licensing, and access management for the India site, coordinating with global IT and security teams.

**Facilities & Administrative Operations**
------------------------------------------

* Own facilities management for the India office: workspace planning, vendor contracts, office supplies, health and safety compliance.
* Coordinate administrative operations supporting the India team (travel, procurement, expense support, local vendor payments) in partnership with finance.
* Serve as the primary local point of contact for employee operational needs and office-related escalations.
* Support local onboarding/offboarding logistics for new hires in partnership with HR.

**Cross-Entity & Compliance Alignment**
---------------------------------------

* Help harmonize IT and operational policies inherited from separate legacy-entity infrastructures into a single, consistent India site standard.
* Partner with global security and compliance teams to maintain audit readiness (HITRUST, SOC 2) for India-based systems and operations.
* Flag and help manage any operational considerations relevant to Machinify's government-contract business (e.g., data handling requirements tied to ATO obligations), even where India operations do not directly support those contracts.

**Growth Into Site Leadership**
-------------------------------

* Build the operational and IT foundation expected of a full Site Lead role as India headcount grows.
* Take on expanded responsibilities over time, potentially including local HR liaison duties, employee engagement, and broader site governance.
* Partner with global leadership on workforce planning and site strategy as the India office scales.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* 8+ years in IT infrastructure/support and/or facilities/operations management, including 3+ years in a leadership or supervisory capacity.
* Experience managing IT operations in a hybrid cloud/on-premise environment.
* Experience working in or supporting a multi-site or multi-entity organization, ideally through a merger or integration.
* Strong vendor management, budgeting, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Comfortable operating with significant autonomy while maintaining close communication with US-based leadership across time zones.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience in a healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industry with exposure to HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST, or SOC 2 requirements.
* Prior experience as, or direct preparation for, a site leadership or office-head role.
* Experience supporting IT/operations during a company merger or post-acquisition integration.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Reliable, well-supported IT infrastructure and facilities operations for the India office.
* India IT systems and operational policies fully aligned with Machinify's global standards and compliance requirements.
* A demonstrated readiness to step into an expanded Site Lead role as the India office grows.

title: Tax Support Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**

We are looking for an analytical, Customer -first , people-first Customer Support Manager (Tax) to lead and scale our frontline support operations. In this role, you will manage a frontline team of customer support associates and leads

You will be the operational backbone of frontline execution owning team performance, holding agents accountable to clear operational scorecards, and partnering cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to automate, deflect, and streamline support workflows. * Own end-to-end performance and consistency across the keyoperational scorecard.

* Ensure team compliance across QA adherence, LMS training completion, and schedule adherence.

#### **Continuous Improvement & Root-Cause Problem Solving**

* Conduct regular "Gemba walks" (go-and-see analysis) to observe frontline workflows, identify systemic bottlenecks, and design root-cause solutions for recurring customer pain points.

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

**About State Street Investment Management**
--------------------------------------------

State Street Investment Management (formerly State Street Global Advisors) is the asset management business of State Street Corporation and one of the world’s largest institutional asset managers, with approximately $6.3+ trillion in assets under management. Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Boston, the firm is the fourth-largest asset manager globally and a pioneer in exchange-traded funds, having launched the first US-listed ETF in 1993. The successful candidate will also help embed AI-enabled tools into day-to-day research and contribute to high-quality collaboration across Bangalore, Boston, EMEA and APAC.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own Tactical Asset Allocation research workstreams** , including idea formulation, data preparation, model development, back-testing, robustness analysis, documentation and implementation support for short- to medium-term multi-asset signals with focus on equity forecasting.

* undefined

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Advanced degree (PhD/MS/MBA) in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline.

* 7+ years of professional and/or academic experience; CFA designation a plus.

* Experience in quantitative research and modelling for multi-asset portfolios, with demonstrated exposure to developing tactical signals for equity forecasting, including sector and country rotation strategies.

* Strong quantitative modelling, analytical and programming skills (e.g., Python and/or R, SQL, Excel, VBA).

* Familiarity with financial software and data platforms (FactSet, Bloomberg, Reuters)

* Understanding of model governance, validation and monitoring expectations in a regulated institutional environment is preferred.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain quantitative work to technical, investment and client-facing audiences.

* Ability to work independently, manage multiple stakeholders and collaborate effectively across a globally distributed team.

title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Functional Analyst

title: Senior HR Advisor
description:
### **Job Description**

**Join Us!**

We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy’s deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!

  
  

The role will be responsible for employee relations, labor compliance, employee engagement, benefits administration, and HR projects. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to employees and managers, independently manage day-to-day HR matters, and drive key people initiatives while ensuring compliance with applicable policies and statutory requirements.

  

**What will you do?**

  

* **Employee Relations**
    
  + Manage employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary actions, workplace concerns, performance-related issues and employee separations.
  + Conduct fact-finding, investigations, documentation, and case management activities, escalating complex matters as appropriate.
  + Provide guidance to employees and managers on HR policies, procedures and workplace practices.
* **Labor Compliance & HR Governance**
    
  + Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, statutory requirements, and company policies.
  + Monitor developments in Indian labor legislation and assess their impact on HR practices and processes.
  + Support the review and implementation of the new Indian Labour Codes and related Wage Code requirements in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external advisors.
  + Support audits, compliance reviews, and documentation requirements as needed.
* **Employee Engagement & Culture**
    
  + Design and implement employee engagement initiatives based on employee feedback, surveys, focus groups, one-to-one discussions and business requirements.
  + Partner with managers to develop action plans that improve employee engagement and workplace culture.
  + Lead employee events, recognition programs, wellness initiatives and culture-building activities.
* **Compensation & Benefits**
    
  + Manage employee insurance programs, including vendor coordination, employee communication and process administration.
  + Develop and maintain SOPs related to insurance and employee benefits administration.
  + Provide guidance to employees on compensation, benefits and HR-related processes.
  + Liaise with vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery of insurance & benefits programs.
* **Performance, Learning & Organizational Effectiveness**
    
  + Support competency assessment and capability development initiatives across the organization.
  + Coordinate and monitor effectiveness of learning and development programs.
  Support organizational effectiveness and talent development initiatives as required.

  

**Experience and Education Required:**

* Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Human Resources or Business Administration
* 8-10 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in a multinational or matrix organization.
* Strong experience in employee relations, grievance handling, disciplinary processes, investigations, and employee case management.
* Sound knowledge of Indian labor laws, labor codes, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting labor code or wage code implementation projects will be preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in designing and executing employee engagement initiatives.
* Experience in employee benefits administration, insurance management and vendor management.
* Exposure to competency assessments, talent development, or organizational effectiveness initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and influencing skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and handle sensitive and confidential matters with discretion.  

  

**What we offer:**

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,

* 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year.
* Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression
* When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you’ll see things our way, too.
  

  

**About Linxon**

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

  
  

We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy’s deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon.

Linxon’s vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects.

  
  

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you.

Employee

Regular

We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.*

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title:**
Relationship Manager – Talent Operations & Experience

**Experience:**
6-8 years in talent acquisition, recruitment operations, HR business partnering, or a related function

**Reporting To:**
[Head of HR / Head of TA, to be confirmed]

**Role Summary**

This role owns the operational effectiveness and experience quality of the Talent Acquisition practice and extends that experience through a new joiner's first 90 days in the organization. You will work closely with the Head of HR, Delivery Heads, and cross-functional teams, and act as the connecting layer between recruiters, clients, hiring managers, candidates, and new employees.

You will also serve as the dedicated buddy to every new joiner (approximately 3-5 per month), helping them settle in, stay engaged, and become productive quickly.

The role focuses on recruitment operations, experience management, and process excellence. It does not involve direct recruitment delivery (sourcing and closing roles) or HR operations such as payroll, policy administration, or compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Process and Operational Discipline***

* Define, document, and enforce standard recruitment processes and best practices across the TA practice
* Monitor adherence, flag deviations, and drive corrective action with recruiters and delivery teams
* Maintain trackers, dashboards, and MIS covering pipeline health, turnaround times, and bottlenecks

***Leadership and Cross-Functional Partnership***

* Partner with the Head of HR and Delivery Heads to align hiring priorities, capacity, and timelines
* Provide regular reporting and insights to leadership on TA performance, new joiner experience, risks, and improvement areas
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Finance, Onboarding, IT, Admin) to ensure smooth offer, documentation, and joining processes
* Escalate delays or blockers to the right stakeholders, including directly to Delivery Heads where process is not followed, and track resolution

***Interview Coordination and Feedback***

* Oversee interview scheduling between candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers
* Drive timely feedback from clients and hiring managers, escalating delays as needed
* Track interview-to-feedback turnaround and report on trends

***Client and Stakeholder Management***

* Act as a point of contact for clients and hiring managers on process, status, and follow-ups
* Run regular check-ins and reviews to capture feedback and strengthen relationships
* Ensure stakeholder commitments (feedback, decisions, availability) are met

***Candidate Experience and Offer-to-Joining Engagement***

* Maintain consistent, proactive communication with candidates at every stage
* Own candidate engagement from offer to joining, including regular touchpoints, resolving concerns, and reducing dropout risk
* Gather candidate feedback and use it to improve the experience

***New Joiner Buddy and Onboarding Support***

* Act as the dedicated first point of contact and buddy for every new employee through their first 90 days
* Welcome new joiners on Day 1 and personally guide them through introductions to teams, leaders, tools, and ways of working
* Run structured check-ins (Day 1, Week 1, Day 30, 60, 90) and maintain a tracker of each joiner's progress and any open concerns
* Coordinate with managers, HR, and cross-functional teams to close onboarding gaps (access, equipment, documentation, role clarity)
* Capture feedback on the hiring and onboarding experience and feed it into process improvements
* Flag early attrition risks to the Head of HR and relevant Delivery Heads
* Receive backup support from HR during peak hiring periods

***Accountability and Continuous Improvement***

* Drive clear ownership and accountability across recruiters and stakeholders
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to efficiency and experience
* Run periodic reviews with TA and HR leadership and share best practices

**Key Outcomes (with suggested metrics)**

* Standardized operations: process adherence rate, fewer missed follow-ups
* Stronger engagement: client and candidate satisfaction (CSAT/NPS)
* Interview discipline: feedback turnaround (e.g., within 48 hours), fewer reschedules and no-shows
* Higher joining conversion: offer-to-join ratio, fewer offer dropouts
* Smoother onboarding: 100% of new joiners covered by the buddy program, with new joiner satisfaction score and Day 1 readiness (access, equipment, documentation)
* Early retention: reduced attrition within the first 90 days
* Operational efficiency: time-to-hire, pipeline velocity
* Leadership visibility: timely, accurate MIS and review reports.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work without direct authority
* Empathy, approachability, and the ability to build trust quickly with new employees
* Comfort presenting data and recommendations to leadership
* Detail-oriented, structured, with strong follow-through
* Working knowledge of ATS/recruitment tools, trackers, and reporting
* Understanding of the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle and onboarding practices
* Graduate or postgraduate degree; HR or business specialization preferred
