* Help the Group meet its commitment of being “Here for Good” by building a sustainable compliance framework that places regulatory and compliance best practice standards, and a culture of appropriate conduct at the forefront of the Group’s agenda.
* As an independent second line risk control function, execute the relevant aspects of the Compliance framework through robust independent risk control and the provision of specialist advice and constructive challenge in a manner proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of the business.
* Provide a single interface for the function’s stakeholders for the coverage area.
* Support the management of the regulatory relationships with each of the regulators, whose rules the Group is subject to.
* Maintain constructive and effective relationships with the relevant Business Heads, Chief Operating Officers ("COOs"), and other functional stakeholders, and assist Compliance, CFCR Advisory, Group Control Room and other relevant Compliance teams to interface with and support such stakeholders.
* Act as the Compliance Officer for the SEBI Merchant Banking registration as well as SEBI Research Analyst registration.
* Act as single point of contact with all SEBI regulations applicable to India CIB Businesses and develop required regulatory relationships with various SEBI departments to fulfil the role of designated Compliance Officer for SEBI regulated CIB businesses in India.

**Strategy**

* Support and implement the vision, strategy, direction and leadership for CFCR teams, consistent with Group CFCR vision and strategy for the CFCR function and in support of the Bank’s strategic direction and growth aspirations.
* Promote the culture and practice of compliance with compliance standards (including conducting business within regulatory requirements, and to high ethical standards) within the Bank and embed a Here for good culture and the Group Code of Conduct.

**Business**

* Build and maintain an effective and constructive relationship with all key business and functional stakeholders that is based on trust, capability and integrity, providing timely, responsive and quality regulatory CFCR advice and guidance to enable the business and functions to meet/ achieve their strategic tactical objectives.
* Act as a CFCR lead for the Global Banking, Syndicate and Portfolio Management and Global Research businesses (together “the Regional and Country Private-Side Businesses”) as they operate in India & SA.
* Act as the regional lead for provision of expert CFCR advice to the Regional and Country Private-side Businesses, in liaison with relevant country-based colleagues as deemed relevant and necessary.
* Provide regulatory advice, analysis (and challenge when appropriate) in relation to the full product life cycle including product design through to post sale reviews/ assessments, new business initiatives, bespoke projects, remedial activities (including nature, scale and rigour of past business reviews), transitional investigations.
* Provide local support to the global Control Room programme.
* Provide robust challenge to senior management and all relevant business stakeholders where activities are outside risk tolerance/ appetite, escalating as necessary, until appropriate oversight and ownership is achieved including actions and plans to address any remedial action needed to come back within risk tolerance/ appetite.
* Work closely with the business to provide timely regulatory compliance advice to ensure compliance with all relevant laws and regulations and support the transition to pro-active and pre-emptive compliance and conduct risk mitigation.

**Processes**

* Establish and maintain effective processes (including training, advice and support) to ensure that policies, procedures and standards to address all compliance risks are effectively implemented and adhered to across business.
* Provide support and challenge to the Bank’s senior management to ensure that they establish and monitor appropriate processes for compliance with compliance policies, procedures and standards (including meeting regulatory obligations and maintaining high standards of conduct).

**People & Talent**

* Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
* Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are competent, suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.

**Risk Management**

* Act as Risk Owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework for Global Banking processes where Compliance is the second line Risk Owner.
* Ensure effective management of compliance matters, and in collaboration with the rest of the CFCR team, effectively manage regulatory issues that have a significant impact on the Bank.
* Collaborate with the other Products Compliance teams and Group Private Side business CFCR Management Group to anticipate horizon risks that may have a significant impact on the Bank and develop effective strategies to mitigate such horizon risks including global standards for conduct of business.
* In the event of serious regulatory breaches, or where risk tolerances have been breached, ensure senior management in the Bank and relevant regulators are informed and that actions are taken quickly to remediate and/or activities are ceased. Ensure proactive and timely identification, assessment, advice and dissemination of evolving regulatory changes/practices and associated risks, and proactive engagement in regulatory reform.
* Provide reports to relevant Regional and Business risk and control committees and management group on key compliance risks and issues.
* Ensure global standards are understood and implemented in locally, with any identified exceptions, or need for more/less stringent standards escalated to Group Compliance for joint decision-making.

**Governance**

* Within the Group's overall Risk Management Framework, establish and maintain appropriate risk based CFCR frameworks for identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, mitigating and reporting CFCR (including regulatory and financial crime) risks across
* Ensure appropriate product governance measures are in place so that product approval documents reflect all relevant regulatory requirements.
* Assist in developing and recommend (for approval by the relevant risk committee), appropriate CFCR policies, standards and guidance notes.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Assist in leading the CCIB CFCR Compliance teams in the Country to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank's Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Operation of Financial Markets, Financial Crime Prevention; Creating the Right Environment.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Regulators
* Risk
* Internal Audit
* Global Banking Business team
* Legal Team
* Group Control Room Head
* Group GB, SPM, Markets CFCR Advisory teams
* Business and Geographic COOs
* Regional and Country Heads of Compliance

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in IBU Compliance Team.
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

**Skills And Experience**

* IFSCA Regulation
* FEMA regulations
* Parent regulator like PRA/FCA knowledge
* FPI regulation from SEBI /RBI
* ODI regulation from SEBI
* Sanction regulations
* SEZ rules

**Qualifications**

* Education: Postgraduate In Commerce and Law or CS / CA (CS / Law Preferable)
* Languages: English

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Lead, Market Conduct & Fraud Risk Management
description:
**Position Summary:**
The Market Conduct Professional will be responsible for ensuring that the company conducts its business in a fair, transparent, ethical and customer-centric manner in compliance with applicable IRDAI regulations, consumer protection requirements, and internal governance standards.

The role involves monitoring sales and distribution practices, intermediary oversight, and conduct risk management across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory Compliance & Market Conduct Oversight**

* Monitor compliance with applicable IRDAI regulations, master circulars, and guidelines relating to Fraud Risk Management and conduct matters as prescribed in Policyholder Protection and Corporate governance regulations
* Assess implementation of regulatory changes and advise internal stakeholders on conduct-related implications.
* Support preparation and submission of regulatory reports, certifications and responses to IRDAI observations, inspections and thematic reviews.
* Maintain market conduct compliance trackers, dashboards and escalation matrices.

**Conduct Risk Management**

* Identify, assess and monitor conduct risks arising from:
* Sales practices
* Distribution channels
* Claims handling
* Customer communications
* Third-party service providers
* Digital platforms and telemarketing activities
* Develop and implement conduct risk indicators (KRIs), monitoring frameworks and control mechanisms.
* Conduct periodic conduct risk assessments and recommend corrective actions.

**Sales & Distribution Governance**

* Review sales journeys, marketing material, and customer disclosures to ensure fairness and regulatory compliance.
* Monitor intermediary conduct including agents, brokers, web aggregators, POSP channels, TPAs and corporate agents.
* Identify and investigate potential instances of:
* Mis-selling
* Unfair trade practices
* Fraudulent sales activity
* Inadequate disclosures
* Customer detriment

**Educational Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in Law, Commerce, Finance, Management, Insurance or related discipline.

Professional qualifications such as LL.B., CA, CS, MBA, PGDM, CPCU, III certification or compliance/risk certifications shall be preferred.

**Experience**

* 10–12 years of relevant experience in:
* Insurance compliance
* Market conduct
* Risk management
* Internal audit
* Regulatory affairs
* Consumer protection
* Health insurance operations
* Prior experience in health insurance, general insurance, TPA or insurance consulting preferred.

Supply Chain / Finance / Regulatory & Compliance

**Reporting To**

Head – Supply Chain / Finance / Operations (as applicable)

**Location**

Thane

**Position Overview**

The Manager – EXIM is responsible for managing
**end‑to‑end export–import regulatory compliance for pharmaceutical products**
, with specific focus on
**DGFT, Foreign Trade Policy (FTP), Customs, ICEGATE, and export incentive schemes**
.

The role ensures
**timely availability, optimal utilization, and closure of export authorisations**
, accurate realization of incentives, strong audit defensibility, and seamless coordination with internal and external stakeholders in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regulatory Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure full compliance with
  **Indian Foreign Trade Policy (FTP)**
  ,
  **DGFT regulations**
  ,
  **Customs laws**
  , and
  **ICEGATE requirements**
  applicable to pharmaceutical exports.
* Track and interpret amendments, notifications, public notices, and circulars impacting pharma exports and advise management on implications.
* Act as the
  **internal regulatory expert**
  for all DGFT, FTP, and Customs‑related matters.
* Ensure adherence to compliance expectations for
  **regulated and semi‑regulated export markets**
  .

**2. License & Authorization Management**

* Manage the complete lifecycle of:
* **Advance Authorisations**
* **EPCG Licenses**
* Any other DGFT‑issued approvals relevant to pharma exports
* Monitor utilization, export obligation fulfillment, timelines, and extensions to minimize compliance risk.
* Lead
  **closure and redemption**
  of licenses, including resolution of pending obligations and deviations.
* Support new applications, amendments, and extensions of Advance Authorisation and EPCG licenses.

**3. Export Incentives & Financial Reconciliation**

* Manage and reconcile pharma export incentives including:
* **RoDTEP**
* **Duty Drawback**
* Ensure reconciliation between:
* Books of Accounts
* ICEGATE records
* Actual receipts
* Investigate mismatches and coordinate rectifications with Finance, Customs authorities, and consultants.
* Maximize benefit realization while maintaining regulatory integrity.

**4. Documentation, Certification & Submissions**

* Coordinate and obtain
  **Chartered Accountant certificates**
  , including:
* FOB certification
* Consumption statements
* Export house certification
* Redemption‑related certifications
* Ensure accurate and compliant data submission to DGFT and consultants.
* Maintain structured documentation and audit trails for all regulatory filings and applications.

**5. Stakeholder & Consultant Management**

* Liaise effectively with internal teams:
* Manufacturing Plants
* Quality & Regulatory
* Logistics & Supply Chain
* Finance & Accounts
* Coordinate with external stakeholders:
* DGFT consultants
* Customs Clearing Agents
* Chartered Accountants
* Export Promotion Councils
* Government authorities
* Ensure timely document collation, validation, submission, and follow‑up.

**6. Portal & System Administration**

* Manage filings and data integrity on:
* **DGFT Portal**
* **ICEGATE**
* Update and maintain organization, license, and authorization details as required.
* Ensure system data aligns with physical documentation and financial records.

**7. Audits, Notices & Risk Management**

* Handle and respond to:
* **Show cause notices**
* Summons and communications from DGFT and Customs
* Coordinate responses with consultants, legal advisors, and management.
* Address audit queries (internal, statutory, government) related to import–export and incentive schemes.
* Ensure strong audit defensibility in line with pharma compliance expectations.

**8. MIS, Reporting & Controls**

* Prepare and circulate periodic
  **Management Information System (MIS)**
  reports covering:
* License status and closures
* Pending export obligations
* Incentive claims and realizations
* Maintain robust tracking mechanisms with weekly or fortnightly reviews.
* Escalate compliance risks, delays, or regulatory issues to management promptly.
* Maintain structured record retention and document control.

**9. Continuous Improvement & Advisory**

* Identify opportunities to improve EXIM compliance processes in pharma operations.
* Advise management on favorable export schemes, incentives, and strategic trade benefits.
* Assist in defining and monitoring scopes of work for EXIM consultants and partners.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely closure of Advance Authorisations and EPCG licenses
* Zero regulatory non‑compliances or penalties
* Accurate and timely realization of export incentives
* Audit‑ready documentation and regulatory correspondence
* Effective risk escalation and issue resolution

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in
  **Commerce / Finance / Management / Pharmacy**
  (MBA preferred)
* **6–9 years**
  of experience in
  **EXIM / international trade compliance**
  , preferably in the
  **pharmaceutical or life sciences industry**
* Strong working knowledge of:
* DGFT procedures
* FTP provisions
* Customs and ICEGATE processes

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong regulatory and compliance orientation
* High attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills
* Analytical skills for incentives reconciliation and risk evaluation
* Ability to work independently in a regulated pharma environment

description:

**Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a Tax Specialist to join our UBS Asset Management Tax Team as an Associate Director.
  
  
the job holder is expected to:
  
  

* Collaborate with all business areas of AM across the US region to manage and resolve tax issues related to AM products, including the development of new products and providing specialized asset management tax advice on structuring and efficiency at the fund, investor, and portfolio levels.
* Oversee annual tax compliance processes for various fund types (trading funds, private credit funds, fund of funds, mutual funds), ensuring adherence to all relevant regulations.
* Manage and monitor FATCA/CRS, FBAR, 1099, and shareholder reporting for UBS AM Funds.
* Serve as the primary contact for investor inquiries regarding tax reporting deliverables, ensuring timely and accurate responses and thorough reviews of investor deliverables (e.g., K-1 forms, estimated tax letters).
* Ensure timely filing of all tax returns and compliance with Group Tax policies and supplements.
* Manage tax risk (financial and reputational) across the region, including, but not limited to:
* Regular reviews and reporting of tax risk issues to the US Head of AM Tax.
* Implementing procedures and controls to mitigate tax risk.
* Monitoring tax and operational risk related to third-party service providers (fund administrators, advisors).
* Provide prompt and comprehensive responses to investor inquiries.
* Support portfolio managers by addressing fund-related questions concerning jurisdictional requirements, diversification tests, and withholding tax matters.
* Support business initiatives through the TRPA process, including pre- and post-launch conditions and coordination with Group Tax specialists for country-specific and indirect/specialist tax sign-off.
* Manage the appointment and oversight of external advisors on tax matters, ensuring compliance with UBS internal contract management requirements.
* Review of tax wording in fund documentation and other AM relevant legal agreements.
* Build and maintain relationships with senior management and UBS Group stakeholders to establish and communicate tax priorities based on changing regulatory environments.

In a time of increasing regulatory and operational challenge, coupled with a growing business globally, we are looking for an experienced tax professional who enjoys working in a dynamic and constantly developing environment. title: Contract Manager
description:
We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future.
  
  
We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress.
  
  
Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background. At BASF, careers develop from opportunities .
  
  
**About The Role**

* As Project Contract Manager, be responsible for awarding and management of service and works contracts within CAPEX projects in India, including identification of cost-saving opportunities, timely award, post-award contract administration, change and claims management, and contract close-out together with project stakeholders.
* Oversee the project services procurement process and create Contract Status Reports ensuring transparency; serve as the project-specific Services Procurement focal point for progress, commercial risk and escalation management; and implement company policies, guidelines, approval requirements and documentation standards into project contracting.
* Support the project team with contractual and commercial advice to safeguard BASF positions, including scope changes, extension of time, acceleration and catch-up plans, contractor non-conformances, contractual remedies, final account and close-out.
* Develop and manage the contractor pool for CAPEX projects in accordance with business targets together with Engineering, EHS, category teams and other project stakeholders.
* Provide end-to-end contract and commercial management across the full greenfield project contracting portfolio – technology licence, EPC, construction, unit/package system and other CAPEX and OPEX service contracts – from project development through execution, commissioning and close-out.

**What Will You Do**
**Project Contract Management Responsibilities:**

* Ensure compliance in the procurement process in accordance with the BASF Supplier Code of Conduct, local laws, company compliance requirements and global procurement guidelines.
* Develop and implement the Contract Execution Plan and contracting strategy for assigned CAPEX projects in India, aligned with the project schedule, packaging strategy, market conditions, commercial risk profile and applicable IA/FA approval requirements.
* Lead the contracting strategy, tendering, negotiation, award and post-award administration for technology licence agreements, EPC contracts, construction contracts, unit/package system contracts, and other general CAPEX and OPEX service contracts for greenfield projects, ensuring appropriate allocation of scope, interfaces, performance obligations, guarantees, liabilities, risks and commercial terms.
* Generate service and works contract bidder lists in collaboration with stakeholders from the operating division, Project Management, Engineering and category teams.
* Support Cost Engineering to establish BOQs, base prices, unit-rate structures and commercial benchmarks; evaluate bids to identify cost optimization opportunities and potential claim exposure.
* Ensure timely award of contracts, including expediting MRQs and scope readiness, driving RFQ generation and tendering, expediting TBE, conducting CNBs, negotiation and CBE, and preparing award recommendations.
* Lead post-award management of assigned contracts during project execution, including obligations, contractual correspondence, securities, insurances, warranties, payment conditions, change orders, claims, non-conformances and status reporting.
* Generate and track the Contract Status Report and an integrated contract-performance dashboard for assigned projects, providing regular updates to the project team on award status, budget, obligations, milestones, KPIs, payments, securities, commercial risk, changes, claims, non-conformances, contractor performance, forecast exposure and required decisions.
* Review and approve purchase orders and change orders according to project signing matrices and delegated authority.
* Manage the contract lifecycle and digital visibility in SAP, Icertis, Mercanis, SAP Analytics Cloud, JIRA, P2P Toolbox or other designated systems, ensuring complete, timely and audit-ready records.


+ Own readiness for internal, external and quality audits for assigned contracts and ensure corrective and preventive actions are closed.
+ Maintain a project contract-management plan, obligation register and contract-governance RACI covering Procurement, Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Project Controls, Legal, Finance, EHS and Operations.
+ Lead disciplined EOT, delay and disruption assessment using contemporaneous programme evidence, critical-path analysis, cause-and-effect records and cost substantiation appropriate to the contract.
+ Maintain an India-specific contractual risk checklist covering governing law, notice requirements, variation mechanisms, liquidated damages, liability, indemnity, insurance, force majeure, termination and dispute resolution, with Legal validation where required.

**Contractor Management Responsibilities:**

* Follow up on strategic contractor management and maintain regular exchange with core contractors; provide feedback to regional Procurement Management, Engineering and operating divisions; and transfer best practices and lessons learned.
* Conduct contractor audits and qualifications with the Procurement Verbund Team, EHS and project stakeholders, ensuring qualification covers technical capability, financial health, EHS, Responsible Care, sustainability, human rights, BPDD and EcoVadis requirements, as applicable.
* Act as first line for potential contractual issues and contractor non-conformances and escalate material issues to the Team Leader, Project Manager, Legal or regional management, as required.
* Support the Category Manager in developing the CAPEX contracting and contractor strategy.
* Coordinate contractor performance reviews, recovery actions, final evaluation and lessons learned for assigned projects.
* Apply risk-based contractor segmentation and differentiated governance for strategic, critical and routine contract packages.
* Define measurable contract KPIs covering safety, quality, schedule, productivity, commercial responsiveness, sustainability and close-out, with corrective-action or service-credit mechanisms where appropriate.
* Identify contractor capacity, workforce, subcontractor, regulatory, EHS and continuity risks and develop practical mitigation or alternative sourcing actions.

**Procurement Planning & Strategy:**

* Align Procurement, Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Legal, Finance, Cost Engineering, Project Controls, EHS and Operations on scope readiness, commercial strategy, tender progress and execution priorities.
* Identify diverging stakeholder interests early and facilitate conflict resolution while safeguarding BASF’s contractual and commercial position.
* Complete contract close-out including final account, claims settlement, securities and warranty status, release documentation, records retention, contractor evaluation and lessons learned.
* Evaluate bids on total service cost, risk, compliance, quality, schedule and capability, not price alone, applying should-cost, clean-sheet, productivity and risk-adjusted analysis for major packages where reliable data is available; document the award rationale and residual risks.
* Lead end-to-end change and claims governance, including early warning, timely notices, entitlement assessment, substantiation, valuation, negotiation, settlement, recovery and formal closure; ensure no changed work proceeds without written authorization except under an approved emergency process.
* Track value realization against the approved business case and contract baseline, including savings, avoided cost, recoveries, value leakage and forecast exposure.
* Drive dispute avoidance through early-warning reviews, defined escalation protocols, documented settlement authority and timely involvement of Legal and project leadership.

**What We Look For**

* Strong negotiation skills for prices, payment terms, securities, terms and conditions, changes, extensions of time and claims.
* Deep knowledge of supplier and contractor landscapes and types of contractual engagement in engineering, construction, EPC and EPCM projects.
* Deep knowledge of contract terms and conditions, deviation handling, contract administration, change and claim management, non-conformance remedies and contract close-out, including related tools and legal exposure.
* Comprehensive understanding of BOQs, unit rates, cost structures and procurement processes, with the ability to establish a Contract Execution Plan, carry out bidder qualification and shortlisting, and report contract status, changes and claims.
* Strong project-management and influencing skills for virtual and cross-functional teams without direct reporting lines.
* Solid knowledge of SAP, purchase orders, Microsoft Office (particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word) and contract/claims-management tools such as Icertis; knowledge of Mercanis, SAP Analytics, Power BI and SAP S/4HANA is advantageous.
* Solid knowledge of contractor audits, qualifications and EHS standards expected by large multinational companies.


+ Excellent written and verbal English for stakeholder interaction and for drafting contractual notices, correspondence and management reports; an additional Indian or international language is an advantage.
+ Full mobility within India for project relocation and willingness to travel extensively to support projects in India and, when assigned, Asia Pacific.
+ Practical knowledge of FIDIC-based and bespoke EPC/construction contracts used in India, together with awareness of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 and the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996; Legal remains responsible for legal interpretation.
+ Working capability in EOT, variation, delay, disruption and cost-claim substantiation; PMP, MRICS, CCM, CPCM or equivalent certification is advantageous but not mandatory.

**Minimum Education And Qualification Required For The Position**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Law, Commerce, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
* More than 7 years of work experience in Indirect Procurement, Contract/Commercial Management and CAPEX projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing service or works contracts through tendering, award, execution, change/claims and close-out.

**Location**
Mumbai - Vikhroli Godrej One

title: ACPL Company Secretary
description:
**Responsibilities Of A Company Secretary**
The responsibilities of a company secretary include:
  
  
Assist senior management.
  
  
Making sure a board of directors has the right guidance and tools to execute its legal obligations to shareholders is an essential responsibility of a company secretary. The board of directors cannot function without the secretary, who also has a big impact on corporate governance. A competent corporate secretary makes sure the board is conducting processes that adhere to prevailing legal compliances. To effectively convey and interpret laws and legal judgements to chief executive officers (CEOs), board members and stakeholders, corporate secretaries are often skilled communicators. It is important to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
  
  
**Keep Company Records**
Maintaining records is a crucial duty for almost all company secretaries. They are in charge of the content of the minutes and make sure that they accurately reflect the decisions of the board. Maintaining significant business records and papers, including disclosure information and compliance
**with Company’s Act**
and compliance, is also the responsibility of the company secretary. They are also often in charge of managing stockholder relations and keeping records of communications with stockholders, stock issuances and transfers or proxy statements.
  
  
**Manage Board Activities**
The corporate secretary organises and coordinates board meetings to ensure their effectiveness successfully. Corporate secretaries oversee several aspects of the board of directors and committee meetings, from creating the agenda to setting up the logistics. Company secretaries may also oversee yearly shareholder meetings. They make sure that there is adequate time for these meetings and can prepare meeting calendars up to two years in advance.
  
  
**Provide Guidance To Board Members**
A corporate secretary's secondary tasks can include suggesting advice on matters like subsidiary management and governance and the board's roles and obligations. Corporate secretaries may also assist with board reviews, assure succession planning and give orientation, education and training to incoming directors. Conducting an annual strategic planning meeting and creating informational meeting packets for the directors at least one week before a meeting can be additional responsibilities necessary for a corporate secretary.
  
  
**Essential Skills For A Company Secretary**
The following skills are necessary to become a company secretary:
  
  
**Attention to detail**
Keen attention to detail is an essential ability for a corporate secretary to better assess the requirements of a company. In addition, their position calls for them to have a thorough awareness of every project on which the company is working. This makes it easier for them to identify issues, resolving which may help the company in optimising its processes. An excellent corporate secretary can often easily answer questions regarding the organisation's operations and finances with pertinent and helpful information.
  
  
**Organisational Skills**
Company secretaries frequently make schedules while taking the organisation's board of director's requirements into consideration. They also make it easier to organise the logistics of meetings. It is important that these meetings, whether they take place online, in person or elsewhere, proceed with requisite logistic, travel and lodging arrangements. In addition, company secretaries can also arrange meeting notes, facts and specifics so that they are available to interested parties upon request. This skill also helps them to govern and communicate relevant information to the intended personnel successfully.
  
  
**Consultative Abilities**
A company secretary's responsibilities are typically similar to those of senior corporate officers. The person in charge of informing the board of directors of a corporation about corporate governance issues is usually a senior corporate officer. This requires them to be well-versed in and proficient in executive management and stakeholders in a corporation. They use this data to convey it to the directors and maintain a robust governance structure.
  
  
**Typing and taking notes**
Company secretaries are administrative experts who frequently assist in recording significant meetings to use the information in the future. As a result, being efficient at typing and taking notes is also important to take notes during a crucial meeting on the most relevant facts and takeaways. Shorthand proficiency can be a great technique for a company secretary to follow the conversation and avoid losing crucial details.
  
  
**Legal knowledge**
A company secretary also ensures that an organisation is abiding by all applicable legal requirements. This makes it essential for them to be aware of and understand the legal and regulatory standards established by institutions like the corporate and accounting regulatory agencies in relevant regions. These include timely submission of yearly reports, changing the memorandum and articles of association and ensuring timely updates of shares, transfers, notices and business registries.

title: Manager – HR, India
description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

Established in Malaysia in 1991, MFE, a company of Doka, has evolved into a global leader of high-quality, efficient, and cost-effective aluminium formwork systems today. Acquired by Doka in 2024, MFE is driven by continuous product innovations and an unwavering commitment to quality and customer service.

With a presence in India through its Mumbai office, MFE is strengthening its position in one of the world’s most dynamic construction markets. From supporting local housing developments to enabling large-scale urban transformation projects, MFE is shaping the future of construction in India.

Expanding beyond its initial success in residential projects, MFE has established itself as a one-stop shop for monolithic solutions. Providing end-to-end support, from bespoke formwork design, which utilises in-house 3D software, to experienced on-site technical assistance, MFE's state-of-the-art, eco-friendly manufacturing facility in Malaysia covers annual formwork production capacity exceeding 1.5 million m².

With a strong focus on on-site training and support, MFE further enables clients to achieve rapid construction cycles, solidifying its vision to be a world-class formwork enterprise dedicated to quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous innovation.

As a customer-focused organisation, MFE understands that its greatest assets are its employees, which is why it is consistently looking for talented professionals who are keen to develop their careers in this dynamic industry. Having grown continuously, based on the strength of its products and its agility to anticipate market demand, MFE is looking for skilled candidates to join their rapidly growing team.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**WHAT IF you could shape the HR function of a growing business while creating meaningful employee experiences and enabling sustainable organizational growth?**

MFE India is seeking a proactive, self-driven and hands-on HR professional to take ownership of the day-to-day HR function and support the growth of its business in India.

Reporting directly to the Head of HR, this role will be responsible for managing the complete HR function at the operational level, establishing robust and scalable HR processes, and partnering with business leaders to address current and future people requirements.

As the business enters its next phase of growth and expansion, this role will play an important part in building a robust and scalable HR infrastructure, strengthening people practices, driving employee engagement and ensuring effective HR delivery to support the organization's evolving needs.

We are looking for someone who has experience supporting business growth, can independently establish and implement HR processes, takes ownership of deliverables, and can balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Drive end-to-end recruitment activities in collaboration with business leaders and hiring managers, ensuring timely fulfilment of manpower requirements.
* Develop and strengthen recruitment processes to support business expansion and evolving workforce requirements.
* Partner with stakeholders on workforce planning, manpower budgeting, hiring priorities and recruitment strategies.
* Explore and support campus recruitment initiatives, university partnerships and graduate hiring programmes to build a sustainable talent pipeline.
* Ensure effective onboarding and integration of new employees.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency, candidate experience and hiring processes.

**2. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Own and manage day-to-day HR operations and the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, confirmations, employee movements, transfers and offboarding.
* Establish, implement and continuously improve HR policies, processes, procedures and documentation to support business growth.
* Coordinate payroll activities, ensuring timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee data and resolution of payroll-related queries.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR documentation and personnel files.
* Ensure consistent and effective implementation of HR processes across the organization.

**3. Performance Management & Employee Relations**

* Drive the performance management cycle, including goal setting, performance reviews, feedback and performance improvement initiatives.
* Support managers in addressing performance-related matters and developing effective people management practices.
* Take ownership of employee relations matters, including grievance handling, disciplinary processes, conflict resolution and employee concerns.
* Provide guidance to managers on employee-related matters, ensuring consistency, fairness and adherence to company policies.
* Promote a culture of accountability, engagement and continuous improvement.

**4. Employee Engagement & Culture**

title: Director, Professional Services - India
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Director, Professional Services - India**
===========================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Mumbai Office**

**Practice Director – Professional Services ( SaaS ) | Mumbai**
  
  
**Role Overview**
  
  
The Practice Director is a senior, strategic, and highly execution-oriented techno-functional leader responsible for the growth, performance, and evolution of a Professional Services practice.
  
This role requires a leader who can operate confidently at both the strategic and operational levels—setting the direction for the practice while remaining close enough to the technology, product, customer, and delivery landscape to make sound decisions and unblock complex engagements.
  
The Practice Director will own practice strategy, portfolio performance, delivery excellence, customer outcomes, talent development, and the evolution of scalable service offerings. They will play a critical role in translating Workforce AI capabilities, customer needs, and business priorities into practical, differentiated, and scalable services.
  
A key expectation of this role is the ability to lead in an evolving AI landscape. The successful candidate must bring demonstrated experience in Workforce AI and practical AI capabilities, with a strong understanding of how AI can transform workforce processes, customer outcomes, and Professional Services delivery.
  
Working closely with Professional Services, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Alliances, and Support, the Practice Director will shape strategy, influence product and services direction, resolve critical customer and delivery challenges, and build a high-performing organization capable of executing at scale.
  
  
**In This Role You Will:**

Provide strategic guidance during complex pursuits, helping shape solution approaches, estimates, assumptions, risks, and customer outcomes.
  
Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and serve as an executive escalation point when required.
  
Lead critical customer and delivery escalations with urgency, sound judgment, and clear accountability through resolution.
  
Cross-Functional Leadership
  
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to provide market and customer insights, influence priorities, and address product or capability gaps affecting customer outcomes.
  
Work across Sales, Customer Success, Support, Alliances, and regional Services leadership to ensure strong alignment from opportunity through delivery and value realization.
  
Drive clear ownership and accountability across complex cross-functional dependencies.
  
**People & Organizational Leadership**
  
Build and lead a high-performing organization of Practice Managers, architects, consultants, and delivery leaders.
  
Set a high bar for leadership, accountability, technical depth, execution, and customer ownership.
  
Develop future leaders through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and targeted capability development.
  
Create an environment that combines strategic thinking, operational discipline, innovation, and strong execution.
  
**AI & Workforce Transformation**
  
Bring practical experience and thought leadership in Workforce AI and AI-enabled workforce transformation.
  
Shape how AI capabilities are positioned, implemented, adopted, and operationalized for customers.
  
Drive the responsible adoption of AI across Professional Services, including use cases that improve productivity, delivery quality, insights, risk visibility, and decision-making.
  
Establish practical AI-enabled ways of working while ensuring appropriate governance, human oversight, quality controls, security, and responsible use.
  
  
**You’ve Got What It Takes If You Have:**

  

10–15+ years of progressive experience in Professional Services, consulting, SaaS, enterprise technology, or digital transformation, including significant leadership responsibility.
  
Demonstrated experience in Workforce AI, AI-enabled workforce transformation, or enterprise AI solutions is required.
  
Strong understanding of how AI can be applied to workforce strategy, skills, talent, learning, mobility, productivity, and organizational transformation.
  
Strong techno-functional depth, with the ability to move comfortably between business strategy, product capabilities, solution architecture, integrations, implementation complexity, and delivery execution.
  
A proven ability to set strategy and personally drive execution—translating broad business priorities into clear plans, decisions, operating mechanisms, and measurable results.
  
Demonstrated success leading a Professional Services practice, portfolio, business unit, or large delivery organization.
  
Proven ownership of business and portfolio performance, including revenue, margin, utilization, productivity, delivery quality, customer satisfaction, and employee engagement.
  
Experience shaping and scaling service offerings, delivery methodologies, governance models, and repeatable implementation approaches.
  
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence customers and senior stakeholders and navigate complex, high-stakes situations.
  
Proven experience leading complex customer escalations and making timely decisions in ambiguous environments.
  
A strong track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams across geographically distributed and matrixed organizations.
  
Experience influencing and partnering effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and other senior cross-functional leaders.
  
Demonstrated experience applying AI to Professional Services delivery, with practical use cases across discovery, solution design, implementation, documentation, testing, knowledge management, reporting, and delivery insights.
  
Strong understanding of responsible AI practices, including human oversight, quality controls, data security, governance, and adoption.
  
  
**Leadership Attributes We Are Looking For**
  
The successful candidate will be:
  
Strategic, but highly execution-oriented
  
Technically credible and commercially minded
  
Comfortable moving between executive conversations and delivery-level detail
  
Decisive and able to bring clarity to ambiguity
  
A strong people leader who sets a high bar and holds teams accountable
  
Customer-focused, with strong ownership and a bias for action
  
Comfortable challenging the status quo and driving change
  
Passionate about Workforce AI and the practical application of AI to customer and business outcomes
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**
  
Experience in HR technology, talent management, learning, skills intelligence, workforce transformation, or enterprise HCM solutions.
  
Experience delivering or consulting on AI-powered workforce, talent, skills, learning, or employee experience solutions.
  
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
  
Relevant certifications in AI, cloud, enterprise architecture, project/program management, Agile, or Professional Services.
  
Experience with CRM, Professional Services Automation, resource management, project management, and portfolio management platforms.

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

* Offer advisory and ensure effective implementation of travel policies for domestic travel and internal transfers.
* Facilitate and obtain approvals in line with the Schedule of Authority for administrative actions (e.g., backdated promotions, disturbance allowance approvals).
* Advise employees and stakeholders on appropriate policy application based on individual scenarios (e.g., determining suitable leave types such as career break, loss of pay, or medical leave), in coordination with Line Managers and HR Business Partners.

* Ensure a seamless transition by coordinating a warm handover to the Global Mobility team for international assignment cases, enabling a smooth experience for assignees. Knowledge Management and simplification:
* Identify opportunities for continuous process improvement and document them as knowledge articles to drive standardization and efficiency.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Location -**
Pune, Maharashtra, India

**About EDMO:**

EDMO is an AI-powered SaaS company that provides enrollment-centric solutions to universities, colleges, and higher education institutions. By streamlining repetitive tasks—such as document verification, transcript evaluation, SOP/essay reviews, and applicant matching—EDMO enables its clients to process student applications faster and more accurately. Its intelligent workflows not only reduce administrative workload but also empower admission advisors to focus on personalized guidance and student engagement.

With features like AI-powered chatbots, Photo ID verification, GPA calculator, and transfer credit evaluation, EDMO ensures transparency and efficiency across the enrollment journey. Institutions using EDMO services report significant time savings, improved decision-making, and enhanced student satisfaction.

At its core, EDMO is built to reimagine & streamline admissions—making them smarter, quicker, and more human-centric.

**Website:**

https://goedmo.com/

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Senior HR Manager to build and lead the people function at EDMO. As we scale rapidly at the intersection of AI and higher education, this role is critical in shaping our culture, attracting top talent, and building the organisational capabilities needed to support our growth. The ideal candidate brings 7+ years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a senior role, and a proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

**Reporting to :**
CEO

**What You'll Do**

* Own and drive the end-to-end HR strategy encompassing talent acquisition, performance management, learning & development, compensation, and employee engagement.
* Partner closely with the CEO and senior leadership to align people strategy with business goals and organisational priorities.
* Build and scale HR processes, policies, and frameworks, ensuring compliance with Indian and US labour laws and employment regulations.
* Lead talent acquisition efforts to attract and retain high-calibre professionals across product, engineering, AI, and business functions.
* Design and implement performance management systems, career development frameworks, and succession planning processes.
* Champion a strong, inclusive, and high-performance culture that reflects EDMO's values.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives, pulse surveys, and retention strategies to maintain a motivated and committed workforce.
* Oversee onboarding, offboarding, and the overall employee lifecycle experience to ensure consistency and quality at every touchpoint.
* Manage HR operations including payroll coordination, HRIS systems, and HR analytics to enable data-driven people decisions.
* Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers and leaders on people matters, conflict resolution, and organisational development.

**What We're Looking For**

* 7+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years in a senior role.
* Prior experience in a startup, SaaS, or technology company is strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws, HR compliance, and statutory requirements.
* Proven ability to build HR functions and processes in a scaling organisation.
* Experience across the full HR spectrum — talent acquisition, L&D, compensation & benefits, performance management, and HR operations.
* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging HR analytics and HRIS platforms.
* High degree of discretion, integrity, and emotional intelligence.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience supporting a globally distributed or cross-border team (India + US).
* Exposure to AI, EdTech, or high-growth B2B SaaS environments.
* Familiarity with modern HR tools such as Keka, GreytHR, or equivalent.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a mission-driven company reshaping the future of higher education through AI.
* Play a pivotal role in building the people function and culture at a category-defining company.
* Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a variety of perks.
* A collaborative, fast-moving team that values people, impact, and continuous growth.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**Head of Human Resources**

**Industry:**
Manufacturing

**Experience:**
14–18 years

**Current Organisation Size:**
1,000–2,500 employees

**Reporting To:**
CEO / Managing Director

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Head of Human Resources to lead the overall HR function for a manufacturing organisation.

The role will be responsible for developing and executing the organisation's people strategy, strengthening talent and leadership capabilities, driving employee engagement, and building a high-performance workplace culture.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of the manufacturing business, with the ability to partner with senior leadership on organisational priorities while overseeing the complete HR lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**HR Strategy & Business Partnership**

* Develop and implement the overall HR strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Partner with the CEO and business leaders on organisational effectiveness, workforce planning and people priorities.
* Drive organisational design, change management and HR transformation initiatives.
* Lead the HR function and build a strong, business-oriented HR team.

**Talent Management & Leadership Development**

* Drive talent acquisition, succession planning and leadership development.
* Build frameworks for talent identification, career progression and internal mobility.
* Strengthen performance management and capability development across the organisation.
* Develop future-ready talent pipelines for critical business and leadership roles.

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Build a strong employee-centric and performance-driven culture.
* Drive employee engagement, retention and employee experience initiatives.
* Strengthen communication, recognition and employee welfare programmes.
* Promote diversity, equity and inclusion across the organisation.

**Compensation & HR Operations**

* Oversee compensation and benefits, HR policies, payroll governance and HR operations.
* Ensure effective HR processes and statutory compliance across the organisation.
* Drive HR analytics and data-led decision-making.
* Monitor key people metrics including attrition, engagement, workforce productivity and employee costs.

**Manufacturing HR & Workforce Management**

* Oversee plant HR and workforce management across manufacturing operations.
* Partner with plant leadership on workforce productivity, employee relations and manpower planning.
* Ensure effective industrial relations and labour law compliance.
* Build alignment between corporate HR strategy and plant-level HR execution.

**Candidate Profile**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* 14–18 years of overall HR experience, with significant experience in manufacturing.
* Currently working in a manufacturing organisation with 1,000–2,500 employees.
* Experience leading the overall HR function or managing a broad HR portfolio.
* Strong exposure to strategic HR, talent management, organisational development and employee engagement.
* Understanding of plant HR, industrial relations and labour compliance.
* Experience partnering with senior leadership and managing HR teams.
* Strong business acumen, leadership and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Industries**

Automotive, engineering, industrial manufacturing, FMCG, chemicals, metals, electricals and allied manufacturing sectors.

title: Senior Front Office Executive
description:
**Job Description: Front Office Executive**

**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Function:** Administration / Facilities  
**Position:** Front Office Executive  
**Experience:** 5 to 10 years  
**Minimum Relevant Experience:** At least 5 years of hands-on experience in independently managing front office/reception operations

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a professional, well-organized, and service-oriented **Front Office Executive** to manage front office operations at our Pune office.

The incumbent will be the first point of contact for employees, visitors, customers, vendors, and other external stakeholders and will play an important role in creating a professional and welcoming workplace experience.

The role will be responsible for reception management, visitor coordination, telephone handling, meeting room coordination, courier and mail management, office administration, and day-to-day facility support. The successful candidate should be capable of independently managing a busy corporate front office while maintaining high standards of professionalism, confidentiality, safety, and service.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Front Office & Visitor Management**

* Manage day-to-day front office and reception operations in a professional and efficient manner.
* Welcome and receive visitors, customers, vendors, interview candidates, and other guests.
* Maintain visitor records and ensure appropriate visitor registration and issuance of visitor badges/passes.
* Inform concerned employees promptly regarding visitor arrivals and coordinate visitor movement within the office.
* Ensure visitors are appropriately attended to while waiting and maintain a high standard of hospitality.
* Ensure that no unauthorized visitor enters restricted office areas without an appropriate employee/contact person.
* Provide visitors with relevant office, safety, and security information.
* Maintain the reception and waiting areas in a clean, professional, and presentable condition.
* Support visitors with information regarding local transportation, hotels, restaurants, taxi arrangements, and other requirements, where necessary.

**2. Telephone & Communication Management**

* Manage incoming calls received through the company's main telephone/reception number.
* Screen and route calls professionally to appropriate employees/functions.
* Respond to general enquiries and ensure accurate and timely communication.
* Manage the reception/facility mailbox and coordinate requests with the appropriate internal stakeholders.

**3. Meeting Room & Office Coordination**

* Coordinate the readiness of meeting rooms and common areas.
* Ensure meeting rooms are maintained in a professional condition and required supplies are available.
* Support meeting arrangements, including coordination for visitors, refreshments, room readiness, and other administrative requirements.
* Coordinate with internal teams and service partners to resolve meeting room or workplace-related issues.

**4. Mail, Courier & Delivery Management**

* Receive, record, sort, and internally distribute incoming letters, couriers, and small packages.
* Coordinate outgoing courier and postal requirements.
* Liaise with courier, transport, and delivery service providers as required.
* Receive and appropriately process office deliveries.

**5. Facility & Office Administration Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative and facilities support to ensure smooth office operations.
* Coordinate employee and facility-related requests received through the reception/facilities desk.
* Support the management and issuance of office keys, access-related items, remote controls, and other company assets assigned through reception.
* Assist in coordinating employee and visitor parking facilities, wherever applicable.
* Monitor requirements for office stationery, paper, drinking water, meeting-room supplies, and other general office consumables and coordinate replenishment.
* Coordinate with facility management, housekeeping, security, and other service providers for routine requirements.
* Support basic administrative activities and documentation as required by the Administration/Facilities team.

**6. Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure front office activities are carried out in accordance with company security, safety, and visitor management procedures.
* Work closely with Security, Facilities, EHS, IT, HR, and other functions as required.
* Ensure appropriate confidentiality when dealing with visitor information, employee information, telephone calls, documents, and other sensitive matters.
* Promptly escalate any safety, security, facility, or visitor-related concerns to the appropriate stakeholder.

**Experience & Qualification**

* **5 to 10 years of overall professional experience**, preferably in front office, reception, administration, hospitality, or corporate facilities.
* **Minimum 5 years of direct experience in independently handling front office/reception operations** in a professional corporate environment.
* Graduate degree in any discipline. A qualification in Administration, Hospitality, Hotel Management, or a related discipline will be an advantage.
* Previous experience working in a **multinational company, large corporate office, engineering/manufacturing organization, or premium business/hospitality environment** would be preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and customer-service orientation.
* Professional appearance, etiquette, and executive presence.
* Ability to interact confidently with senior management, employees, customers, international visitors, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Ability to independently prioritize multiple front office and administrative requirements.
* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, and other standard Microsoft 365 applications**.
* Good telephone etiquette and professional correspondence skills.
* Strong attention to detail and record-keeping ability.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise appropriate discretion.
* Calm and composed approach when managing difficult visitors, complaints, emergencies, or unexpected situations.
* Good coordination and vendor-management skills.

title: Head of Operations
description:
**About Fraganote**

Fraganote is an Indian fragrance house making everyday fragrances fun, interesting, premium, and aspirational. We create scents people love to wear and love to talk about, from our signature gourmands that smell like vanilla, coffee, caramel, and chocolate to fresh new launches. Since 2023, we've built a community of 300,000+ active customers with a 38% repeat purchase rate, across 30+ SKUs. We sell on our own website, Amazon, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and in modern trade and offline retail. We're Series A funded, based in Delhi, and growing fast.

**The Role**

You will own everything that happens between a finished product and a customer's doorstep. Warehouse, procurement, 3PL partners, D2C fulfilment, B2B and marketplace dispatches, offline and modern trade supply. You'll build the operating backbone that lets us scale without breaking.

**What You'll Own**

**Warehousing and fulfilment**

* Run warehouse operations end to end: inbound, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns
* Lead a mixed team of blue collar and white collar staff. Hiring, shift planning, training, productivity, and safety
* Set and hit SLAs for D2C orders, including gifting and customised orders
* Keep inventory accuracy above 99% through cycle counts, audits, and clean processes

**Channel dispatches**

* Manage dispatches to Amazon FBA, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, modern trade, and offline distributors
* Meet every channel's appointment, labelling, packaging, and compliance requirement. Zero rejected consignments is the goal
* Plan peak season logistics for OND, Rakhi, Valentine's, and campaign spikes

**Procurement and supply**

* Own procurement of raw materials, packaging, and finished goods with suppliers and contract manufacturers
* Negotiate costs, lead times, MOQs, and payment terms
* Build vendor scorecards on quality, timeliness, and cost

**Inventory planning**

* Work with Revenue, Growth, and Finance on demand forecasting and channel allocation
* Prevent stockouts on hero SKUs and flag dead or slow moving stock early
* Manage stock transfers across warehouse, FBA, and qcomm dark stores

**3PL and logistics partners**

* Manage courier and 3PL partners. Negotiate rates, track RTO, delivery TAT, and damage rates
* Own the order flow across Shopify, OMS, and shipping partners. Support ERP evaluation and rollout (Odoo or equivalent)

**Cross functional**

* Partner with NPD on launch readiness, Finance on landed cost and inventory valuation, Customer Service on delivery and returns issues

**KPIs**

* Order dispatch TAT and on-time delivery %
* Inventory accuracy and stockout days on top SKUs
* Fulfilment cost per order and logistics cost as % of revenue
* RTO %, damage %, channel PO fill rate
* Procurement savings and supplier on-time delivery

**What You Bring**

* 8 to 12 years in operations and supply chain, at least 4 in a D2C, beauty, personal care, or FMCG brand
* Hands-on experience running a warehouse with blue collar teams
* Deep familiarity with Amazon FBA, quick commerce inbound, and modern trade dispatch norms
* Comfort with OMS, WMS, and ERP tools (EasyEcom, Unicommerce, Odoo, SAP, or similar) and strong Excel skills
* A builder mindset. You fix processes, not just fires

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with fragrance, cosmetics, or regulated product categories (Legal Metrology, BIS labelling)
* Gifting and kitting operations experience

title: Partner Onboarding Lead – O&M
description:
**About Claro Energy**

Claro Energy is a leading clean energy company in India with 15+ years of experience in building decentralized renewable energy solutions. We have delivered 1,00,000+ solar projects across solar irrigation pumps, rooftop solar, and large-scale clean energy programs, working closely with farmers, households, institutions, and government initiatives across multiple Indian states. As we scale further, we are building an AI-first data and intelligence foundation to power automation, forecasting, and faster decision-making across operations, growth, inventory, and finance.

**About The Role**

Our installed base is growing faster than any in-house service team can cover. We are building a freelance O&M partner network: certified solar technicians who handle servicing, breakdowns, preventive maintenance, and warranty calls for rooftop solar and solar pump systems in their own districts.

You will own this network from start to finish. You will source partners, verify them, onboard them, activate them, and keep them. Think of it as the partner/supply lead role at a mobility or home-services platform, applied to solar field service. You will also work with the tech team on bringing AI into processes to smoothen up operations, from partner screening to job allocation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Partner Acquisition

• Build supply pipelines of freelance technicians district by district, using ITIs, local electrical contractors, ex-installer networks, dealer referrals, and digital channels

• Map coverage gaps against our installed base and service ticket density, then prioritize recruitment accordingly

• Run referral and drive-based hiring campaigns to hit district-level partner targets

Verification & Onboarding

• Own the onboarding funnel from lead to document collection, KYC, and background check, through skill assessment and agreement signing, and finally activation

• Run practical skill assessments for both rooftop (on-grid/hybrid) and solar pump (AC/DC, VFD controllers) systems

• Get partners onboarded onto the partner app/CRM, covering job acceptance, photo-proof uploads, and closure workflows

Training & Certification

• Design and run induction and certification modules on Claro product lines, safety standards, RMS diagnostics, and service SOPs

• Build a tiering system (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold) based on skill level, ratings, and SLA performance, and tie it to job priority and payouts

Activation, Quality & Retention

• Track first-job activation, ensure partners complete their first jobs within defined timelines, and fix drop-offs

• Monitor partner performance on TAT, first-time-fix rate, customer ratings, rework, and photo-proof compliance

• Run quality audits and field spot checks, and manage escalations, warnings, and offboarding

• Work with Finance on rate cards, incentive structures, and on-time payouts, since payouts are the top driver of partner retention

• Run partner engagement through WhatsApp communities, monthly calls, and recognition programs

Process & Data

• Maintain a clean partner database with skills, coverage pincodes, tier, tools owned, and availability

• Work with the tech team to automate screening, reminders, and job-routing using n8n/Make and AI agents

• Publish weekly dashboards covering funnel conversion, active partners, district coverage, SLA adherence, and churn

**What We're Looking For**

• 3–6 years in partner/supply onboarding, field operations, or service network management. Gig/marketplace platforms (mobility, home services, logistics) or solar/electrical service companies are ideal backgrounds

• Proven track record of building and scaling a distributed partner or vendor network across multiple geographies

• Enough technical comfort with solar systems to assess a technician's skill. You do not need to be an engineer

• Strong data discipline: you run the funnel on numbers, not gut feel

• Comfortable in Tier 2/3 towns and rural geographies; fluent in Hindi and English, and regional languages are a plus

• Comfort with CRMs, Google Sheets, and automation tools; exposure to n8n, Make, or AI tools is a strong plus

**Success Metrics — First 6 Months**

• Active, certified partners in target districts against plan

• Lead-to-activation conversion rate and time-to-activate

• Service TAT and first-time-fix rate across partner-handled tickets

The Clinical Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for all clinical aspects of the Avitum division business. The position acts as the bridge between clinical excellence and business growth, ensuring sustainable expansion while maintaining the highest standards of patient care and clinical governance.

+ Dialysis adequacy (Kt/V)
+ Vascular access outcomes
+ Hospitalization rates
+ Infection rates
+ Anemia management
+ Mortality and morbidity indicators

+ Clinical governance

+ Dialysis operations

title: Risk Manager / Senior Manager – Infrastructure (InvIT)
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Risk Manager / Senior Manager with strong hands-on exposure to Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) and Roads & Highways infrastructure. The incumbent will be responsible for identifying, assessing, monitoring and mitigating financial, operational, commercial and regulatory risks across the InvIT portfolio and underlying project SPVs.

**The role will work closely with**
Finance, Investment Management, Asset Management, Operations, Legal, lenders, rating agencies, the Trustee, NHAI and other external stakeholders to strengthen the overall risk management framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Risk Identification & Assessment**

* Identify and assess enterprise, project-level and asset-level risks across road and highway assets.
* Conduct risk assessments for new asset acquisitions, investments, refinancing and operational SPVs.
* Monitor key macro and sectoral risks including traffic, toll revenue, regulatory changes, EPC and O&M contracts.
* Develop risk mitigation plans and track their implementation and effectiveness.

**2. InvIT & Regulatory Risk**

* Monitor compliance with applicable SEBI InvIT Regulations, NHAI concession agreements, lender covenants and other regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with the Investment Manager, Trustee, Valuer and relevant stakeholders on InvIT risk reporting.
* Support risk and commercial due diligence for asset acquisitions, investments, refinancing and divestments.
* Monitor regulatory, contractual and concession-related developments that may impact the portfolio.

**3. Financial & Commercial Risk**

* Analyse traffic risk, toll revenue risk, revenue leakage, O&M cost overruns, interest-rate risk and refinancing risk.
* Perform cash-flow stress testing, scenario analysis and DSCR assessment for road/highway assets.
* Evaluate project and asset-level financial risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Review insurance coverage, claims, business continuity and contingency plans.
* Assess financial and commercial risks associated with BOT, HAM and Toll-based project structures.

**4. Risk Governance & Reporting**

* Develop, maintain and periodically review the Risk Management Framework, Risk Register and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs).
* Establish effective risk monitoring and escalation mechanisms across the InvIT portfolio.
* Prepare risk reports and presentations for the Board, Audit Committee, Investment Committee, lenders and senior management.
* Coordinate with internal audit, external auditors and other assurance functions on risk-related matters.
* Track risk observations, action plans and closure of identified gaps.

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Liaise with NHAI, lenders, rating agencies, EPC contractors, O&M contractors, Investment Managers, Trustees and other stakeholders on risk-related matters.
* Partner closely with Finance, Legal, Operations, Asset Management and Investment teams.
* Provide risk inputs for strategic, investment and portfolio-management decisions.
* Present risk insights, stress-test outcomes and mitigation plans to senior management and relevant committees.

**Must-Have Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: CA / MBA Finance / M.Com or equivalent qualification.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in Risk Management, Infrastructure, Project Finance, InvITs, Infrastructure Funds, PE Funds or large Road/Highway Developers.
* Mandatory hands-on experience with InvIT structures and Roads / Highways infrastructure assets.
* Strong understanding of project finance, financial risk assessment and infrastructure project structures.
* Relevant Risk Management certification is preferred.

**Key Skills & Technical Competencies**

• SEBI InvIT Regulations and regulatory compliance

• NHAI policies, concession agreements and highway operations

• BOT / HAM / Toll-based project structures

• Financial modelling and cash-flow risk analysis

• DSCR analysis, stress testing and scenario analysis

• Traffic and toll revenue risk assessment

• Project finance and lender covenant monitoring

• Risk Management Framework, Risk Register and KRI/KPI development

• Governance, Board / Audit Committee reporting and presentation

• Senior stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience with listed InvITs.
* Experience working with Investment Managers, Trustees, lenders and / or rating agencies.
* Exposure to asset acquisition / divestment due diligence.
* Experience in refinancing and financial restructuring of infrastructure assets.
* FRM / IRM or other relevant Risk Management certification will be an advantage.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate will be a finance / risk professional who combines strong risk management capability with practical understanding of infrastructure assets and InvIT structures. Candidates from
**InvITs, Infrastructure Investment Managers, Road / Highway Developers, Infrastructure Funds, Project Finance teams or Infrastructure-focused PE / Funds**
with hands-on experience in asset-level financial analysis and risk assessment will be highly relevant.

**Candidate Targeting – Priority Backgrounds**

* Listed / unlisted InvITs and Investment Managers
* Road & Highway Developers / concessionaires
* Infrastructure-focused PE / Infrastructure Funds
* Project Finance / Infrastructure Finance teams
* Risk Management teams within infrastructure businesses
* Candidates with combined exposure to InvIT + Roads/Highways + financial modelling / project finance
