title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Manager**
to manage the company's day-to-day finance and accounting operations. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting, timely compliance, effective cash-flow management, strong financial controls, and providing meaningful financial insights to support business decisions.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of accounting principles, taxation, statutory compliance, financial reporting, and preferably experience in managing finance operations in a growing organisation.

**1. Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger and reconciliations.
* Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing.
* Prepare and review Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow statements and other financial reports.
* Ensure accounting records are accurate, complete, and maintained in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
* Review and reconcile bank, vendor, customer and other balance sheet accounts.

**2. Financial Planning & Analysis**

* Prepare budgets, forecasts and periodic financial projections.
* Track actual performance against budgets and provide variance analysis.
* Prepare management reports and dashboards highlighting key financial trends and business performance.
* Provide financial insights to management to support business and operational decisions.
* Identify areas for cost optimisation and improved financial efficiency.

**3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

* Monitor daily/weekly cash flow and ensure adequate liquidity.
* Manage receivables and payables to optimise working capital.
* Track outstanding customer receivables and coordinate with relevant teams for timely collections.
* Review payment schedules and ensure timely vendor payments.
* Support management in cash-flow planning and forecasting.

**4. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely compliance with applicable GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with external consultants, auditors and tax advisors wherever required.
* Review statutory filings and ensure accuracy of supporting documentation.
* Stay updated on relevant changes in accounting, taxation and regulatory requirements.

**5. Audit & Internal Controls**

* Coordinate internal and statutory audits and ensure timely closure of audit requirements.
* Prepare schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents required for audits.
* Establish and maintain appropriate financial controls and approval processes.
* Identify financial and operational risks and recommend corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to company finance policies and procedures.

**6. Business Finance Support**

* Work closely with HR, Sales, Operations and other business teams on finance-related matters.
* Review commercial proposals, contracts and business transactions from a financial perspective.
* Support management in evaluating costs, profitability and financial implications of business decisions.
* Provide timely financial information and analysis to senior management.

**7. Team Management**

* Manage and mentor the finance and accounts team.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of finance activities.
* Review the team's work for accuracy and compliance.
* Build efficient processes and improve finance operations through automation and standardisation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related field.
* CA / CMA / MBA Finance qualification will be an added advantage.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
* Good understanding of GST, TDS, income tax and statutory compliance.
* Experience with accounting/ERP systems such as Tally, SAP, Oracle, Zoho, Keka or similar platforms.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow management and MIS reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with deadlines.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Program Lead
description:
**Strategy & Programme Lead | India**

**Location:**
India, with regular travel, including to the Himalayan region

**Level:**
Senior
Manager / Director, depending on experience

**Contract**
: Initially contractor set up and then, depending on experience and programme needs we can look at staff or fixed term arrangement

**About Systemiq**

Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with practical, on-the-ground work, partnering with businesses, governments, investors and civil society to deliver system change. Our international teams work across sectors and geographies, bringing together diverse expertise to address interconnected sustainability challenges.

**The opportunity**

Systemiq is seeking an experienced Strategy & Programme Lead to help deliver and grow our portfolio of work in India, initially taking a leading role in our Himalayan systems change programme.

Building on our report,
*Prosperous and Resilient Himalayas*
, this programme aims to translate an ambitious agenda for sustainable economic growth and resilience into practical initiatives, partnerships and financing solutions. Work may span water security, climate and disaster resilience, sustainable tourism, mountain products, enterprise development and policy.

Alongside leading this programme, you will contribute to other strategic advisory and systems change projects across India, working with colleagues across Systemiq's global platforms. You will also help identify and develop new opportunities, build relationships with potential clients and partners, and contribute to expanding our presence and impact in India.

We are looking for someone who combines strong management consulting capabilities, practical programme leadership and commercial judgement with a deep understanding of India's economic, policy and institutional landscape.

At Systemiq, our leaders remain closely involved in the substance and delivery of our work. This role offers significant autonomy and requires someone equally comfortable shaping strategy, leading complex engagements and turning new opportunities into funded work.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead strategic programmes and engagements. Take ownership of the Himalayan programme and contribute to other advisory projects across India, shaping priorities, analytical approaches, workplans and delivery.
* Drive business development and growth. Identify and develop new project opportunities across sectors, build relationships with potential clients and funders, lead proposals and help convert opportunities into funded engagements.
* Provide strategic and analytical leadership. Guide complex research, economic and financial analysis, business cases and feasibility assessments, translating findings into clear recommendations and practical solutions.
* Build senior stakeholder relationships. Develop trusted relationships with government, businesses, financial institutions, funders and other partners, navigating complex institutional and commercial environments.
* Translate strategy into implementation. Turn policy, sustainability and financing challenges into actionable programmes, partnerships and investment propositions that can deliver measurable impact.
* Lead and develop teams. Provide direction, oversight and mentorship to multidisciplinary project teams, ensuring high-quality delivery, sound project economics and effective collaboration.
* Collaborate across platforms and geographies. Work with Systemiq colleagues internationally, bringing together expertise across nature, energy, finance, materials and economic development to address interconnected challenges.

**The experience and capabilities we are looking for**

**Consulting and strategic leadership**

* Typically 7+ years of relevant experience in management consulting, strategy advisory or an equivalent consulting-led environment, with seniority reflecting experience.
* A strong generalist consulting toolkit, including structured problem-solving, quantitative and qualitative analysis, strategic synthesis and executive-level communication.
* Proven experience independently leading complex consulting engagements or strategic programmes, managing teams and delivering high-quality recommendations.
* Strong commercial judgement, with experience identifying opportunities, developing proposals, winning work or building client relationships.
* The ability to work across different sectors and subject areas, quickly developing an understanding of unfamiliar challenges and translating analysis into practical solutions.

**Relevant sector and regional experience**

* Significant professional experience in India, with a strong understanding of its economic, policy, institutional and business environment.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders across government, business, finance, development institutions or philanthropy.
* Relevant experience in sustainable development, climate resilience, natural resources, economic development, sustainable finance or related sectors.
* Experience in the Himalayan region, mountain economies, rural livelihoods, sustainable tourism or nature-based economic development would be an advantage.
* Sound economic and financial literacy, including experience developing business cases, investment propositions or financing strategies.

**Leadership and personal attributes**

* An entrepreneurial, commercially minded leader who combines strategic thinking with practical delivery.
* Confident operating independently, managing ambiguity and taking ownership of complex engagements.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the credibility to engage senior stakeholders.
* Adaptable and intellectually curious, with the ability to move between different projects, sectors and challenges.
* Able to think across policy, markets, finance and environmental systems, recognising how they interact and identifying opportunities for wider systems change.
* A collaborative leader committed to Systemiq's mission and to advancing sustainable, inclusive economic development.

**Languages and travel**

* Fluent English is essential. Hindi and/or another relevant Indian language would be an advantage.
* Willingness to travel regularly across India, including field visits in the Himalayan region, is essential.

**What we offer**

* Meaningful leadership: Take a leading role in a high-impact Himalayan initiative while contributing to Systemiq's wider portfolio in India.
* Entrepreneurial opportunity: Help shape new projects, partnerships and opportunities across an evolving regional portfolio.
* Diverse project experience: Work across strategy, policy, finance, sustainability and implementation, with opportunities to influence work beyond a single sector.
* Local focus, global collaboration: Build relationships in India while working with international colleagues and accessing Systemiq's global expertise.
* Autonomy and influence: Take ownership of major engagements and contribute directly to the growth and impact of our work.
* Flexible engagement arrangements: We are open to considering both fixed-term employment and consultancy arrangements, depending on experience and programme needs.

**Reward and Recognition**
The remuneration and benefits package will reflect the successful candidate's experience and expertise.

title: Managing Consultant, Geology
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a Level 3 Geologist, you will play a key role in delivering complex contaminated land, hydrogeology, and remediation projects across ERM's global client portfolio. You will provide technical leadership, manage project delivery, mentor junior staff, and work closely with regional teams and clients to ensure high-quality project outcomes. This role is critical in driving delivery excellence, maintaining technical quality, and supporting business growth initiatives.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Leading multidisciplinary investigation and remediation projects.
* Providing technical guidance and mentoring junior geologists and consultants.
* Managing project schedules, budgets, and client expectations.
* Supporting proposal development and business development activities.
* Driving technical quality, consistency, and innovation across project delivery.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Strong understanding of contaminated land assessment, hydrogeology, remediation, and environmental consulting practices.
* Working knowledge of international regulations, industry guidance documents, and best practice standards.
* Proven experience in managing project teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
* Strong technical report writing and data interpretation capabilities.

**Preferred:**

* Experience managing large and complex site investigation, hydrogeological assessment, and remediation projects.
* Experience with groundwater flow and contaminant transport

modelling.
  
  

* Experience supporting multinational clients across various industry sectors.
* Understanding of ESG, due diligence, and environmental liability assessments.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Manage and deliver contaminated land, hydrogeological, and remediation projects from planning through completion.
* Lead technical interpretation of geological, hydrogeological, and environmental datasets.
* Review technical reports, conceptual site models, and risk assessments and provide recommendations to support senior technical review and approval.
* Manage project budgets, resources, schedules, and quality assurance processes.
* Supervise field investigations, subcontractors, and project teams.
* Mentor and provide technical oversight to junior staff.
* Prepare and review fee proposals, scopes of work, and technical methodologies.
* Support client meetings, presentations, and project discussions.
* Ensure compliance with ERM quality, health, safety, and risk management requirements.
* Contribute to technical excellence initiatives and knowledge-sharing programs.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor's and/or Master's Degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science, or related discipline.
* 7-10 years of relevant consulting experience.
* Strong experience in contaminated land assessment and remediation.
* Demonstrated project management experience.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong client communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Advanced proficiency in data analysis, interpretation, and reporting.
* Experience with industry-standard modelling and GIS software is advantageous.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering (Singapore)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

title: Manager of Manufacturing
description:
**Company Description**
Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing company known for its wide range of formulations and strong focus on quality and compliance. The organization operates multiple state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and serves domestic and international markets. Akums emphasizes innovation, efficiency, and adherence to regulatory standards to deliver safe and effective medicines. Team members work in a structured, process-driven environment with opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement in manufacturing practices.
  
**Role Description**
The Manager of Manufacturing is a full-time, on-site role based in Ghaziabad. This role oversees end-to-end manufacturing operations, including production planning, resource allocation, and coordination with cross-functional teams to meet output and quality targets. The manager ensures adherence to GMP, safety, and regulatory standards, monitors process parameters, and leads initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce deviations. Day-to-day responsibilities include supervising production staff, reviewing batch records, resolving operational issues, implementing standard operating procedures, and supporting audits and inspections. The role also involves collaborating with quality, maintenance, and supply chain teams to ensure uninterrupted production and timely delivery.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong manufacturing operations and production management skills, with experience overseeing large-scale pharmaceutical or related production environments.
* Proficiency in production planning and operations management, including scheduling, capacity planning, and resource utilization.
* Experience in quality control within regulated industries, ensuring compliance with GMP and relevant regulatory guidelines.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams, manage performance, and promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements and audit processes in pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

Someone who can take ownership of the manufacturing unit, establish efficient systems, maintain regulatory compliance and ensure consistent product quality while improving productivity and controlling costs.

title: Service Delivery Leader – Data Quality
description:
Amex GBT is a place where colleagues find inspiration in travel as a force for good and – through their work – can make an impact on our industry. We’re here to help our colleagues achieve success and offer an inclusive and collaborative culture where your voice is valued.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage the Level 2 Data Quality Enablement Operations team, owning case intake, triage, and resolution for issues escalated from Program Care and submitted directly by Customer Analytics
* Coordinate and escalate complex cases to the appropriate Level 3 teams or external partners, including upstream product and data teams, mid/back office platforms, and the Travel Partner Network
* Set and manage day-to-day case-handling standards, workload, and coverage, ensuring consistent quality and turnaround across the team
* Build and manage relationships with Level 3 teams and external partners, holding them accountable for timely, quality resolution
* Own case volume, resolution time, and recurrence reporting, using this data to manage team performance
* Mentor and develop the L2 team, building capability in travel transaction data investigation and case management
* Drive root cause analysis on significant and recurring cases, and use those findings to inform Data Quality Enablement's proactive prevention and monitoring priorities
* Translate operational issue trends into recommendations that shape the wider team's data quality roadmap, not just case-level fixes
* Partner with data producers and upstream teams to push ownership of quality closer to the source, reinforcing the broader Data Governance, Contribute case insights and evidence to the team's data quality scorecards, governance reporting, and audit readiness activities

**What We're Looking For**

* Demonstrate ability in data quality, data operations, technical support, or case/issue management, including direct people leadership
* Demonstrated experience managing a team that investigates and resolves data-related issues at scale, including handling customer concerns involving other teams or partners
* Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to interpret transactional data to pinpoint the source of a data quality issue
* Working knowledge of data quality and data governance principles, including root cause analysis and the distinction between data producers, consumers, and owners
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical, operational, and business teams, including third-party partners
* Experience with case or ticket management tooling and operational reporting
* Demonstrated ability to move between hands-on team management and strategic, data-driven thinking
* Experience in the travel, TMC, or travel technology industry, and familiarity with tools like Ataccama or data governance concepts (e.g., Critical Data Elements), is a plus

**Location**
Gurgaon, India
  
  
**The #TeamGBT Experience**

* Flexible benefits are tailored to each country and start the day you do. These include health and welfare insurance plans, retirement programs, parental leave, adoption assistance, and wellbeing resources to support you and your immediate family.
* Travel perks: get a choice of deals each week from major travel providers on everything from flights to hotels to cruises and car rentals.
* Develop the skills you want when the time is right for you, with access to over 20,000 courses on our learning platform, leadership courses, and new job openings available to internal candidates first.
* We strive to champion Inclusion in every aspect of our business at Amex GBT. You can connect with colleagues through our global INclusion Groups, centered around common identities or initiatives, to discuss challenges, obstacles, achievements, and drive company awareness and action.
* And much more!

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to age, sex, gender (and characteristics related to sex and gender), pregnancy (and related medical conditions), race, color, citizenship, religion, disability, or any other class or characteristic protected by law.

Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the hiring process. title: Senior Manager - Replenishment Planning
description:

title: Design Delivery Lead - Production Design Operations
description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Design Delivery Lead to own and drive creative design and multimedia delivery across the organisation. You will lead a team of graphic designers, multimedia specialists, and creative professionals. Your team will deliver high-quality visual communication and digital content aligned with business and client objectives.

You will set the creative strategy, oversee design execution, and partner with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. The goal is to deliver impactful, consistent brand experiences across presentations, campaigns, digital channels, and client-facing materials. You will also build scalable workflows, quality standards, and AI-enabled ways of working that raise the team's efficiency and creative output.

**What will you do?**

**Team Leadership and People Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of graphic designers, multimedia specialists, and creative professionals.
* Set clear goals, track performance, and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Provide constructive feedback and creative guidance to build design capability and a culture of quality.
* Plan team capacity, resourcing, and shift coverage to support odd operating hours and global delivery.

**End-to-End Delivery Ownership**

* Own planning, prioritisation, execution, quality assurance, and on-time delivery of creative and multimedia projects.
* Manage multiple projects at once, balancing priorities, timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations.
* Track delivery against SLAs, turnaround times, and quality metrics, and escalate risks early.
* Report on delivery performance, productivity, and quality to senior leadership.

**Creative Strategy and Concept Development**

* Develop creative concepts and visual strategies for presentations, campaigns, digital assets, social media, internal communications, and client-facing materials.
* Translate business objectives and brand guidelines into clear, effective visual solutions.
* Keep the team informed on design trends, emerging formats, and multimedia best practices.

**Quality, Brand Compliance, and Governance**

* Review and approve creative outputs for quality, consistency, brand compliance, and adherence to client requirements.
* Establish creative standards, templates, style guides, and quality frameworks.
* Maintain version control, asset management, and review and approval workflows.

**Stakeholder and Client Management**

* Partner with business leaders, marketing and communications teams, and client stakeholders to gather and clarify requirements.
* Set expectations, manage feedback cycles, and resolve conflicting priorities or escalations.
* Act as the senior point of contact for design delivery.

**What will you need?**

* **Experience:**
  14–16 years of overall experience, including 9–12+ years in Production and Design Operations, creative services, graphic design, multimedia, or visual communications.
* **Leadership:**
  Proven experience leading and managing creative teams, with strong mentoring and performance management skills.
* **Delivery management:**
  Demonstrated experience managing large-scale, multi-project creative delivery with tight deadlines.
* **Design expertise:**
  Strong understanding of graphic design, visual communication, typography, layout, and branding.
* **Tools proficiency:**
  Hands-on knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro) and Microsoft PowerPoint.
* **Multimedia knowledge:**
  Working understanding of video, animation, motion graphics, and digital content production.
* **Quality and brand governance:**
  Strong eye for detail, with experience reviewing outputs and ensuring brand compliance.
* **Stakeholder management:**
  Excellent communication and negotiation skills with senior business leaders, marketing teams, and clients.
* **Process orientation:**
  Experience building workflows, templates, SOPs, and quality frameworks.

title: Oliver Wyman - Senior Lead Contingent Workforce Management - Gurugram or Mumbai
description:
**Oliver Wyman is looking to bring onboard a seasoned professional to lead the Contingent Workforce strategy for the IMEA (India, Middle-East, South Africa) region!**
**This role can be based out of our Gurugram or Mumbai office.**
**Job Overview:**
We are looking for an exceptional senior, hands-on leader to lead the IMEA Contingent Workforce function. This is a highly visible position in a fast-paced professional services environment.
  
  
The role is accountable for the strategy, governance and end-to-end management of the region’s contingent workforce model, covering external talent access, procurement and vendor management, commercial frameworks, lifecycle service, data, technology and reporting.
  
  
The role partners closely with business and people leadership, leads the operational CWR team, acts as the senior escalation point for material matters and continuously improves the function’s contribution to the firm.
  
  
This role is integral to establishing a consistent, commercially disciplined, and high-performing external workforce capability across IMEA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Function Strategy, Governance and Leadership**

* Responsible for the IMEA contingent workforce strategy, policies, operating model, standards and priorities
* Advise People and business leadership on the appropriate role and use of external workforce capacity
* Connect CWR population, deployment and utilization insights with broader staffing, recruiting and workforce discussions
* Responsible for the governance, control and exception framework, ensuring required standards and approvals are consistently applied
* Lead, coach and prioritize the CWR Operations Specialists and ensure resilient day-to-day service delivery
* Represent IMEA in relevant global CWR forums and align regional practices with global standards and local requirements

**External Talent, Vendor and Commercial Management**

* Develop the external sourcing approach, channels and reusable talent pools required to access consulting, specialist, expert and support capacity
* Responsible for the IMEA CWR vendor portfolio, senior vendor relationships and adherence to preferred-vendor arrangements
* Lead vendor frameworks, fees, service expectations and material commercial discussions in coordination with the relevant functions
* Establish appropriate market rate, fee and vendor-performance transparency to support business and leadership decisions
* Ensure vendors and commercial deviations are challenged and routed to the appropriate decision-maker

**CWR Service, Lifecycle and Performance**

* Be accountable for the quality and integrity of the end-to-end CWR service, from initial request through sourcing, contracting, onboarding, active engagement, extension and offboarding
* Ensure the function acts as a consistent internal and external point of contact for the business, CWRs, vendors and enabling teams
* Oversee complex, material or sensitive engagements and intervene where decisions, controls or cross-functional coordination require senior judgment
* Ensure approval, contractual, lifecycle and operational guardrails are consistently applied, coordinating with Legal, Finance, Procurement and other functions where their authority is required
* Responsible for the CWR performance record and future-engagement framework

**Data, Technology and Operational Excellence**

* Responsible for the business requirements for CWR data, workflows, technology and reporting
* Establish transparent management information on the CWR population, deployment, capacity equivalent, utilization, rates, vendor fees, expenses and total spend
* Monitor service performance, data quality, control adherence, process bottlenecks and recurring exceptions
* Coordinate the resolution of cross-functional issues and ensure failures between organizational boundaries do not remain unresolved
* Continuously improve the function’s capabilities, service quality, controls, technology and stakeholder experience

**Experience Required:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in business, management, human resources, operations, procurement, finance or a related field
* Significant experience leading or managing a complex cross-functional workforce, business service or operational agenda
* Demonstrated ability to combine strategic direction with hands-on operational leadership
* Experience leading people and coordinating delivery across teams in a matrixed organization
* Demonstrated procurement and vendor-management experience, including commercial frameworks, supplier performance, cost transparency, negotiation and portfolio management
* Proven ability to engage, influence and constructively challenge senior business and functional stakeholders
* Strong analytical capability and experience using data, reporting and technology to improve decisions and service performance
* Experience in professional services or another project-based, fast-paced and matrixed organization is strongly preferred
* Direct experience in contingent workforce management, external talent or contractor management would be advantageous

**Skills and Attributes:**

* Strategic and operational leadership, with the ability to translate business and People priorities into clear strategies, standards and actions
* Ability to move effectively between long-term direction, senior stakeholder dialogue and detailed operational problem solving
* Strong procurement, commercial and analytical judgment, including an understanding of vendor economics, rates, fees and workforce-spend drivers
* Ability to use workforce, utilization, service and spend information to develop actionable insights and recommendations
* Excellent stakeholder influence and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and escalate material issues with sound judgment
* Proven team and service leadership, including setting expectations, developing team members and creating consistent service standards
* Ability to create accountability while enabling collaboration across organizational boundaries.
* Strong control awareness and the ability to identify recurring weaknesses and drive sustainable corrective action
* Highly self-motivated, pragmatic and willing to roll up their sleeves in complex, sensitive or operationally demanding situations
* High integrity and discretion when working with confidential workforce, contractual and commercial information
* Regional experience in IMEA or another complex multinational environment would be advantageous

**Technical Skills:**

* Fluent in English (written and verbal)
* Strong proficiency in management reporting, analysis and executive communication
* Strong Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook skills
* Experience working with workforce, procurement, data/ reporting or workflow systems as well as embedding AI into processes is highly desirable

title: Head- Publisher/Affiliate/Delivery Team
description:
Job Opening: Manager / Senior Manager – Affiliate Delivery & Publisher Growth

\*\*Company:\*\* SKyline Digital Growth

\*\*Location:\*\* Gurugram / Greater Noida (Work From Office)

\*\*Experience:\*\* 3–5+ Years

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Industry:\*\* Affiliate Marketing | Performance Marketing | Digital Advertising

## Role Description

We are looking for an experienced and result-driven \*\*Manager / Senior Manager – Affiliate Delivery & Publisher Growth\*\* to lead campaign delivery, publisher partnerships, and revenue growth across international affiliate marketing programs.

The ideal candidate should have \*\*3–5+ years of hands-on experience working with an affiliate network, performance marketing agency, or affiliate marketing company\*\*, with strong expertise in international CPS (Cost Per Sale) and CPL/CPA (Lead Generation) campaigns.

This role requires strong operational knowledge of leading affiliate platforms, including \*\*Awin, Rakuten, Tradedoubler (TD), and Impact\*\*, along with an established network of international publishers, affiliate networks, and traffic partners.

The candidate will be responsible for maximizing campaign performance, driving quality conversions, scaling publisher relationships, and achieving revenue and profitability targets.

## Key Responsibilities

- \*\*Campaign Delivery & Performance:\*\* Own end-to-end execution, optimization, and scaling of international CPS, CPL, and CPA campaigns across multiple verticals.

- \*\*Publisher Acquisition & Management:\*\* Identify, recruit, onboard, and manage high-performing international publishers, affiliates, subnetworks, and traffic partners.

- \*\*Affiliate Platform Management:\*\* Independently manage and operate campaigns through Awin, Rakuten, Tradedoubler, Impact, and other affiliate platforms.

- \*\*Revenue & Profitability:\*\* Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue, delivery, and gross margin targets through effective campaign allocation and publisher optimization.

- \*\*International Network Partnerships:\*\* Leverage existing relationships with international affiliate networks, publishers, and agencies to unlock new campaign opportunities and scale existing programs.

- \*\*Campaign Optimization:\*\* Monitor clicks, conversions, EPC, CR, ROI, approvals, reversals, and other performance metrics to improve campaign efficiency.

- \*\*Publisher Compliance:\*\* Ensure traffic quality, source transparency, advertiser guideline adherence, and prevention of fraudulent or non-compliant activities.

- \*\*Cross-Functional Collaboration:\*\* Work closely with advertiser acquisition, business development, and finance teams to ensure smooth campaign activation, delivery, reconciliation, and payment processes.

- \*\*Team Leadership:\*\* For senior-level candidates, lead, mentor, and manage affiliate delivery executives while establishing performance benchmarks and operational processes.

## Required Skills & Qualifications

- \*\*3–5+ years of relevant experience\*\* in an affiliate network, affiliate marketing company, or performance marketing agency.

- Strong hands-on experience managing \*\*international CPS and CPL/CPA lead generation campaigns\*\*.

- \*\*Practical working knowledge of Awin, Rakuten, Tradedoubler, and Impact affiliate panels is essential.\*\*

- Established professional relationships with international affiliate networks, publishers, and traffic partners.

- Experience managing campaigns across the \*\*US, UK, Europe, and other international markets\*\*.

- Strong understanding of affiliate tracking, attribution, postbacks, conversion validation, and campaign reporting.

- Ability to troubleshoot campaign delivery challenges, optimize publisher performance, and scale profitable traffic.

- Strong analytical, commercial negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills.

- Proven track record of achieving campaign delivery, revenue, and profitability targets.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Existing publisher relationships in eCommerce, Travel, Retail, Finance, Insurance, and Lead Generation verticals.

- Experience working with affiliate platforms such as CJ, Partnerize, Admitad, and Everflow.

- Knowledge of diverse traffic sources, including content publishers, comparison websites, coupon and cashback platforms, native advertising, paid media, and email marketing.

- Previous experience managing an affiliate delivery or publisher management team.

## What We Offer

- Competitive salary based on experience and expertise.

- Attractive performance-linked incentives.

- Five-day working week.

- Opportunity to manage international campaigns and build global publisher partnerships.

- Leadership opportunities within a growing international performance marketing company.

- Collaborative, performance-driven work environment with long-term career growth.

## How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at \*\*hr@skylinedigitalgrowth.com\*\*.

\*\*Email Subject:\*\* Application – Manager / Senior Manager, Affiliate Delivery

\*\*Join SKyline Digital Growth and take ownership of building, managing, and scaling high-performing international affiliate partnerships.\*\*

title: Food & Beverage Director – Strategy & Performance
description:
**Organization- India Consultancy Private Limited**
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
The F&B Director – Strategy & Performance will establish the planning, reporting, analytical and performance-management discipline for regional F&B.
  
  
The role will provide accurate and timely insight into portfolio performance, support budget and forecast processes, maintain regional KPIs and tools, coordinate improvement plans and prepare executive-level materials for decision-making.
  
  
**Regional F&B Strategy and Annual Planning**

* Support the Director of F&B in preparing the annual F&B strategy and operating plan.
* Translate strategic priorities into measurable initiatives, targets and milestones.
* Coordinate inputs from Culinary, FOH/Bar, Events, Marketing and hotels.
* Prepare strategic analysis, business cases and recommendations.
* Track progress against annual priorities and identify emerging risks and opportunities.

**Budgeting, Forecasting and Financial Planning**

* Coordinate the regional F&B budget and forecast process.
* Establish planning timelines, templates, assumptions and submission requirements.
* Review hotel submissions for completeness, consistency and commercial logic.
* Analyse forecast changes, gaps and variances.
* Partner with Finance to reconcile F&B reporting with official financial results.

**KPI, Reporting and Performance Management**

* Define and maintain regional F&B KPIs and reporting standards.
* Produce weekly flashes, monthly performance packs and quarterly reviews.
* Lead benchmarking across hotels, outlets and markets.
* Provide clear explanations of performance drivers and variances.
* Ensure reports are accurate, timely, concise and decision-oriented.

**Portfolio Improvement and Performance Enablement**

* Coordinate structured improvement plans for underperforming hotels or outlets.
* Support hotels in diagnosing revenue, cost, productivity, control and profitability gaps.
* Establish baselines, targets and benefits for improvement initiatives.
* Monitor implementation progress and escalate delays.
* Evaluate whether interventions are producing measurable results.

**P&L, Business Cases and Commercial Analysis**

* Partner with Finance on F&B P&L delivery, business cases, capex and return-on-investment analysis.
* Analyse revenue, profitability, food cost, beverage cost, labour productivity and outlet performance.
* Highlight risks to revenue, profitability, cost and productivity.
* Provide recommendations to improve commercial outcomes.
* Support strategic projects, openings, conversions and repositioning initiatives with financial analysis.

**Systems, Tools and Digital Enablement**

* Partner with IT and systems teams on F&B reporting and operating tools.
* Improve data availability, accuracy, consistency and usability.
* Support dashboard, reporting and automation initiatives.
* Ensure hotel teams understand reporting requirements and tools.
* Promote practical use of data in operating decisions.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in F&B performance, hotel finance, commercial planning, business analytics or multi-unit operations.
* Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, P&L analysis, benchmarking and KPI design.
* Experience in portfolio performance management and improvement planning.
* Strong understanding of hotel F&B operations, outlet economics, cost controls and profitability drivers.
* Experience partnering with senior leaders, Finance, hotel teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, business-partnering and executive-communication skills.
* Hospitality-sector and multi-market experience preferred.

title: Implementation Team Lead
description:
**Team Lead, Implementation**

*Cvent Implementation Team | Full-Time| People-Leadership Role |AI-Augmented*

**About the Team**

The Cvent Implementation team configures and deploys Cvent software for new and existing clients. Our mission is to provide expert guidance and hands-on technical execution so every client successfully launches, adopts, and realizes value from their Cvent products.

The work blends project management, technical configuration, and client-facing consulting — and increasingly, the smart use of AI tools to move faster, reduce manual work, and deliver a sharper, more consultative client experience. As a Team Lead, you own the performance, growth, and delivery economics of a pod of Implementation Consultants operating in exactly this environment.

**Role Overview**

As Team Lead, Implementation, you lead a pod of Implementation Consultants and Senior Implementation Consultants — accountable for their delivery quality, client outcomes, professional growth, and the financial performance of your pod's portfolio. You operate as a player-coach: close enough to projects to unblock complex escalations and guarantee delivery standards, while owning the coaching, capability-building, and pod-level P&L that turn a group of strong ICs into a high-performing, predictable delivery team.

You are the first line of business accountability for delivery economics and the first line of client governance, running business reviews at the pod and skip-level, and mentoring your team on AI-first ways of working.

**Recruitment Scam Notice:**
Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email addresses. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.

For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Leadership & Coaching**

* Lead, coach, and develop a pod of Implementation Consultants and Senior Implementation Consultants, owning their performance, growth, and engagement end-to-end.
* Run structured weekly or bi-weekly 1:1s (more frequent for new hires) focused on project coaching, skill development, and career progression — not just status updates.
* Conduct at least one live coaching/feedback client call per direct report per month, using real client interactions as the basis for targeted development.
* Write and conduct mid-year and annual performance reviews; build and execute individual development and ramp plans; actively manage under-performance and grow bench strength.
* Own new-hire onboarding and ramp for the pod — ensure training is completed thoroughly and new hires reach productivity on plan.
* Balance and monitor individual workloads across the pod, reallocating capacity to protect delivery quality and prevent burnout.

**Delivery & Financial Ownership (P&L)**

* **Own the P&L for your pod's project portfolio**
  — accountable for utilization, burn rate, project profitability, cost-to-serve, and gross margin at the pod level, and take corrective action where performance drifts.
* Manage the health of all projects across the pod — timeliness of deliverables, quality of client deliverables, scope adherence, customer satisfaction, and portfolio risk.
* Track time and profitability across engagements and drive recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign to improve delivery economics.
* Enforce SOP and quality compliance across all client-facing deliverables — workflow diagrams, MRFs, AM templates, step-by-step guides, and configuration output — ensuring consistent, high-quality material leaves the pod.
* Own escalation management for all direct reports and projects: course-correct, put action plans in place, and mitigate delivery and relationship risk before it reaches leadership.

**Client Governance & Business Reviews**

* **Conduct Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs / QBRs)**
  with clients and skip-level stakeholders (Sr. Manager / Director of PSO), using business storytelling to connect delivery and financial metrics to clear recommendations and actions.
* Join new-customer Kick-Off and project Close-Out calls for direct reports, and maintain regular executive check-ins with key client stakeholders across the pod's portfolio.
* Translate pod performance into executive-ready narratives — trends across delivery quality, utilization, margin, cost-to-serve, customer sentiment, and delivery risk — for skip-level and senior leadership.
* Provide proactive, structured communication to senior leadership on team feedback, performance signals, customer risks, and recognitions.

**AI-Enabled Delivery Leadership**

*AI is now a core part of how implementation work gets done. As a Team Lead, you are expected not only to use AI fluently, but to raise the pod's AI capability:*

* **Model and coach AI-first ways of working**
  — help your pod use generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate requirements docs, process maps, configuration workbooks, test cases, training material, and client communications.
* **Own quality of AI-assisted output at the pod level**
  — set and enforce human-in-the-loop review standards so AI-generated configurations, documentation, and client communications are validated before they reach the client.
* Identify and champion lightweight automations and AI-agent workflows for repetitive delivery tasks — status updates, test-case generation, FAQs — and scale what works across the pod.
* Use AI-powered analytics on usage patterns, support tickets, and historical project data to proactively flag delivery risk and improve implementation quality across your portfolio.

**Technical Depth & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Stay hands-on enough to assist with complex issue resolution and configuration work, and to guarantee delivery standards on the pod's most challenging engagements.
* Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success where implementation expertise supports adoption, renewal readiness, and expansion — surfacing opportunities to those teams (retention and expansion targets remain owned at the Manager level).
* Interface with Product to convey client feature requests and delivery friction identified across the pod.
* Carry 1–2 team-wide internal initiatives (e.g., SOP/SME workstreams, scope team, training series, product readiness) that improve how the broader team operates.

**Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications**

* **10+ years of overall work experience**
  in implementation, professional services, project delivery, or client-facing roles — preferably in SaaS, corporate meetings/events, software, or high-tech.
* **Minimum 3–4 years of direct people-management experience**
  , leading client-facing delivery or implementation teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery economics — utilization, project profitability, and margin — with a track record of improving them through coaching and process change.
* Proven ability to run client-facing business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and translate operational and financial metrics into clear, executive-ready recommendations.
* Strong coaching and development track record — measurably improving IC performance, ramp speed, and retention.
* Strong project management discipline — scoping, planning, RAID/risk logs, milestone tracking, and status reporting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Ability to translate customer goals into objective, measurable success criteria (adoption, time-to-value, cycle time, ROI) and hold the pod accountable to them.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with confident client-facing presence and strong presentation skills.
* Ability to diagram intermediate-to-complex process flows and identify efficiency opportunities.
* Proficiency with core productivity tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio/Draw.io) and CRM/PSA tooling (e.g., Salesforce).
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent applicable experience.

**AI & Technology Fluency**

* Hands-on, practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate delivery work, and the ability to coach others in doing the same.
* Comfort operating and enforcing a human-in-the-loop model — reviewing, validating, and correcting AI-generated outputs before they reach clients.
* Working understanding of how AI agents and automated workflows apply to onboarding, configuration, and reporting (formal AI/ML background not required).

**Preferred, Not Required**

* Experience with AI-assisted meeting transcription/summarization tools (e.g., Copilot, Glean, Claude).
* Exposure to no-code/low-code automation (e.g., Zapier, Power Automate) or agentic workflow builders.
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) or Six Sigma (Green Belt+).

description:

CG Foods businesses in Serbia, Egypt, Kazakhstan and Bangladesh, including domestic and export sales, manufacturing and related business operations.

India, with frequent travel to Serbia, Egypt, Kazakhstan and Bangladesh

Lead the overall performance and growth of
**CG Foods**
across the four assigned countries, with end-to-end accountability for sales, profitability and business operations. Translate Group priorities into country plans, build effective routes to market and drive execution through country teams. Deliver sustainable revenue growth, stronger margins and cash generation while protecting product quality, customer service and business continuity.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Business strategy and profitable growth**

* Develop country strategies, annual business plans and growth priorities based on consumer demand, competitive position and business capability.
* Set revenue, volume, margin and profitability objectives with the CFO and country leadership.
* Identify new markets, export opportunities, categories, channels and partnerships; assess their commercial viability and convert approved opportunities into executable plans with clear ownership and milestones.

* Set pricing, trade terms, incentives and promotional plans within approved policies.
* Review primary and secondary sales, distributor stock and collections to ensure healthy sell-through.
* Conduct market visits and resolve customer, channel and execution gaps.

1. **Profitability and commercial discipline**

* Own country and consolidated business profit and loss, including revenue, gross margin, operating costs and EBITDA.
* Improve product and channel mix, pricing realization and promotional returns.
* Drive cost efficiency across manufacturing, procurement, logistics and overheads with functional leaders.
* Work with the CFO on budgets, forecasts, credit discipline and working capital; lead corrective action where growth, margins, cash generation or returns fall below plan.

1. **Manufacturing supply chain and business operations**

* Lead operating delivery through country, plant and functional teams.
* Align demand forecasts, production, procurement and distribution to improve availability, capacity utilization, delivery reliability and cost.
* Address raw-material and packaging supply, imports, inventory, wastage, downtime and operational bottlenecks.
* Ensure disciplined sales and operations planning, preventive maintenance, food safety, quality, employee safety and continuity of supply, with clear local accountability.

1. **Brands portfolio and business investment**

* Work with marketing and product teams on consumer insights, brand development, product quality, pack sizes, pricing and innovation suited to each market.
* Evaluate launch readiness and track sales, margins and repeat demand after launch.
* Sponsor capacity expansion, productivity improvements and other investment proposals with the CFO; secure approvals and ensure approved projects deliver agreed timelines, costs, commercial benefits and returns.

1. **Country leadership and stakeholder management**

* Lead and develop country heads and assigned sales, operations and functional leaders.
* Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, succession plans and capability-building priorities with HR.
* Build effective relationships with distributors, key customers, suppliers and business partners.
* Represent CG Foods in relevant leadership and stakeholder forums, resolve cross-country issues and share successful practices while respecting local market requirements.

1. **Performance reviews governance and risk**

* Run regular country and consolidated business reviews covering sales, profit, cash, operational performance and growth initiatives.
* Make structured country visits, including plants and markets, to validate execution.
* Track corrective actions to closure and escalate material issues with recommendations.
* Ensure country teams meet applicable operating, food safety, product, employment, environmental and commercial requirements with relevant specialists.

  **(Preferably Noodles)**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Business, Marketing or a related field preferred; strong commercial judgment, negotiation and multicultural team leadership.

title: Asst Dir-Data Specialist
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Proven experience with atleast 3-5 years in Mergers & Acquisitions research, financial data, corporate ownership, or a related business information domain, with strong knowledge of transaction structures and the deal lifecycle.
* Experience leading and developing research, operations, or data teams in a production environment, including coaching, performance management, and delivery against productivity and quality targets.
* Strong operational management capability across workflow planning, resource allocation, market coverage, backlog management, service levels, and data quality controls.
* Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across global teams and manage competing priorities.
* Experience identifying and implementing process improvements that enhance efficiency, data quality, scalability, and client outcomes.
* Experience with Generative AI, automation tools, AI-assisted research workflows, SQL, data analysis, or process improvement methodologies is preferred, along with an understanding of responsible AI, data governance, quality control, and risk management.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead M&A data operations, develop research teams, and advance AI-enabled workflows to improve quality, productivity, and scalability.
* Lead, mentor, and develop Data Specialists and Senior Data Specialists, ensuring delivery against quality, productivity, and service-level expectations.
* Manage daily production activities, including workload allocation, coverage planning, backlog management, resource allocation, and operational performance monitoring.
* Conduct quality reviews, deal validations, and spot checks, and provide coaching to ensure adherence to research methodologies and quality standards.
* Support onboarding, training, and capability development to drive consistent application of methodology, research standards, and best practices.
* Act as a subject matter expert for Mergers & Acquisitions research, deal determination, transaction analysis, corporate structures, and market coverage across assigned regions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen operational efficiency, data quality, scalability, and client outcomes.
* Identify, test, and implement Generative AI, automation, and advanced tooling opportunities that improve research workflows, quality, and productivity.
* Partner with product, technology, research, and operations stakeholders to design and refine AI-assisted processes, workflow enhancements, and quality controls.
* Manage stakeholder communications and respond to internal and external client inquiries accurately and with appropriate urgency.
* Monitor team performance, investigate root causes of performance gaps, and implement coaching or corrective action plans where required.
* Ensure compliance with research methodologies, quality control processes, data governance standards, responsible AI practices, and company policies.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on innovation, operational excellence, and the continued evolution of investment data products.

**About The Team**
Our Investment Data team delivers comprehensive, timely, and high-quality Mergers & Acquisitions data that supports Moody's products, analytics, and decision-making capabilities. The team combines market expertise, rigorous research standards, and advanced technology to identify, validate, and maintain critical transaction information across global markets.
  
  
By joining our team, you will help drive operational excellence, develop talent, and advance the use of artificial intelligence and automation in research workflows. You will collaborate with global research, product, technology, and data teams to improve data quality, increase efficiency, and support the continued evolution of Moody's investment data capabilities.

title: Regional Head of RSA Operations - APAC
description:
The Regional Head of Road Side Assistance (RSA) & Mobility Operations is within our Operations division, providing service delivery to our customers and own operational processes and delivery for our RSA and Mobility Line of Businesses (LoBs). The role, reporting to the Global Head of RSA & Mobility Operations, is a management role responsible for overseeing and managing the day-to-day the RSA & Mobility insurance and assistance operation division in the region and requires a strong focus on delivering operational results, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Primary objectives include establishing short- and long-term strategic plans for the RSA & Mobility operations in your region, in alignment with corporate directions, providing leadership to senior managers and country leads, delivering superior customer service regionally, driving change management efforts to create operational efficiencies and competitive advantage in the region. This role also includes liaison with the regional senior executives across all divisions, both internally and externally, such as Business partners/customers, Sales, Marketing & Operational Management (OM) functions as well as all major functional role withing Global Operations and within the company.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Execute Strategy: Whilst running the daily operations in the region, implement the new LoB structure in the RSA & Mobility LoB in the territory and ensure efficient delivery of RSA & Mobility insurance and assistance services while aligning with the overall LoB goals and objectives.
* Performance Metrics: Deliver on established key performance indicators to ensure meeting targets set for budget, service delivery, customer experience, and efficiency for the region. Generate and analyze reports on operational performance and efficiency, providing regular updates to senior management.
* Collaboration: Collaborate with the rest of the RSA & Mobility Operations leadership team and contribute positively to the overall success of operations.
* Process Management: Execute the optimal RSA & Mobility insurance and assistance process for the territory and across direct report contact centers and claim handling functions and drive consistency in the execution. Manage the day-to-day process and operation and ensure delivery of the 5-star customer rating.
* Operating Model: Transition the RSA & Mobility operations to a new operating model in the territory that includes increasing offshoring/nearshoring and regionalization resulting in a more streamline efficient organization. Implement group standards & policies related to operations setup, steering & processes, fosters collaboration across units, and streamlines platform processes of in-and outbound call center & claims activities.
* Innovation: Support the development of digital tools and digital roadmap by providing subject matter expertise, training, and change management within the operations team.
* Financial & Budget Management: Manage RSA & Mobility Insurance Operations operating budget in your scope.
* Quality Assurance: Implement quality control measures to ensure accuracy and quality of all processes, complaint handling, and fraud control.
* Networks of providers management and cases cost containment: Manage provider networks, chose & build adequate quality & quantity of providers in the region. Proactively manage external costs to feed business forecasting activities & actuarial functions adequately.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure that the RSA & Mobility operations comply with all relevant international and local regulations, working with legal and compliance teams to stay up to date on evolving laws.
* Team Leadership: Develop teams and leaders, providing coaching on growth and career planning to aid succession management and building of talent bench. Support analysis and improvement of the AES results and drive actions that will improve the employee experience.
* Claims & Contact Center Management: Set the strategy for the RSA & Mobility claims process to ensure efficient and fair claims handling for policyholders. Prioritize customer satisfaction and address customer inquiries, concerns, and feedback to enhance the overall customer experience.
* Customer Experience: Stay up to date with global RSA & Mobility trends, customer preferences, and regulatory changes to ensure the company's operations remain competitive, compliant, and customer focused. Set 5-star voice of the customer alignment across all locations and leadership teams are driving a consistent customer experience delivery.

What you will bring
  
  

* 10+ years of progressive experience in insurance or assistance operations, with a strong track record in roadside assistance, mobility services, or a closely related field
* Proven leadership experience managing large, multi-site operations across multiple countries, including contact centres and claims handling functions
* Demonstrated ability to lead senior managers and country-level leaders, with a hands-on approach to coaching, talent development, and succession planning
* Experience driving operational transformation, including offshoring/nearshoring initiatives, regionalisation, and operating model redesign
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with direct experience managing P&L or operational budgets and contributing to cost containment and forecasting
* Track record of delivering against KPIs in service delivery, customer experience, efficiency, and budget management
* Experience managing provider/supplier networks, including selection, quality assurance, and cost negotiation
* Solid understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks across multiple jurisdictions, with the ability to partner effectively with legal and compliance teams
* Proven ability to drive change management and digital transformation within operations, including adoption of new tools, platforms, and processes
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across divisions (Sales, Marketing, Operational Management) and engaging with external business partners and customers
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to generate, analyse, and act on operational performance reporting
* Customer-obsessed leadership style, with experience embedding Voice of the Customer programmes and driving 5-star service delivery
* Excellent English (written and spoken); additional languages relevant to the region are a plus
* University degree in Business, Operations Management, Insurance, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
* Willingness to travel within the region as required

What we offer
  
  
Our employees play an integral part in our success as a business. We appreciate that each of our employees are unique and have unique needs, ambitions and we enjoy being a part of their journey. We are there to empower and encourage you with your personal and professional development ensuring that you take control by offering a large variety of courses and targeted development programs. All that in a global environment where international mobility and career progression are encouraged. Caring for your health and wellbeing is key priority for us. This is why we build Work Well programs to providing you with peace of mind and give the flexibility in planning and arranging for a better work-life balance.

AI supports our recruiters by enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of candidate assessments and job recommendations, while all applications are reviewed by our recruitment team and final hiring decisions are made by humans.
  
  
Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer. We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the center of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions. Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our customers and for the world around us.
  
  
At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture. We therefore welcome applications regardless of race, ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
  
  
Join us.
**Let's care for tomorrow.**
