title: Manager-Operational Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Global Risk & Compliance Organization (GRC) is an independent risk management function, led by the Chief Risk Officer, with the objective of ensuring that American Express operates in a safe, sound, and fully compliant manner with all applicable regulatory expectations. GRC creates and maintains the overall risk management framework, performs independent risk management assessments, and monitors applicable risks.
  
  
The objective of the GRC Control Management (CM) and Transformation role will coordinate and support control testing activities, develop executive reporting and insights, partner across risk organizations, to strengthen the control environment. This role will drive process standardization and continuous improvement, leverage data and AI-enabled solutions to enhance efficiency and provide actionable reporting to support risk and control management decisions.
  
  
Global Risk & Compliance (GRC) is looking for an Manager for GRC Control Management and Transformation focused on ensuring control management is embedded in the day-to-day operations of our organization. It will involve extensive collaboration with multiple partners across numerous business units, functional areas, and geographies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Manager, GRC, Control Management and Transformation will:
  
  

* Coordinate and support control testing activities across multiple GRC stakeholders, including tracking testing execution, results, and remediation efforts.
* Develop executive reporting, dashboards, and presentations that clearly communicate control performance, risk trends, program status, and actionable recommendations.
* Perform data validation, quality assurance, and analysis of control management data to identify key trends, risks, insights, and opportunities for improvement.
* Review Regulatory Change Management (RCM) to ensure appropriate stakeholder is assigned, updates are made, and effective challenge of RCM closures.
* Support regular status updates and communicate progress, findings, and risks to key stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Support ad-hoc requests in the Global Risk & Compliance space related to privacy, data, regulatory matters, compliance, etc.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Audit, and business teams to streamline processes, improve governance, and identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and analytics to enhance control management activities.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ Years experience in Operational Risk, Governance, Risk, Compliance (GRC), Controls Management, Internal Audit, or a related discipline.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, Information Systems, or related field; advanced degrees (e.g., MBA, MSc).
* Experience working in financial services at a large, global bank.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience tracking deliverables, managing timelines, coordinating across multiple stakeholders, and driving initiatives to completion.
* Proficiency in data analytics, including data validation, trend analysis, reporting, and translating data into actionable business insights.
* Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex information into executive-level insights.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with control testing, risk and control reporting, data analysis, and stakeholder management.
* Working knowledge of operational risk and controls, including risk identification and assessment, control design and effectiveness, issue management, and control testing practices.
* Experience driving transformational change across the enterprise.
* Knowledge of AI, automation, process improvement methodologies, or continuous improvement initiatives.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

* + Controlling- CO-Cost element accounting CO-Cost Center Accounting and CO-Internal Orders.

  + Excellent business communication skills

title: Head – Administration
company: iForest - International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology
description:
Reference code: Admin/NCR-04-11/26

**Reporting to:** Chief Executive Officer

**Location:** Noida (on-site), with travel to other iFOREST offices as needed

**Experience:** 20+ years in administration, operations or facilities management

**About iFOREST**
-----------------

iFOREST is an independent, not-for-profit research and innovation organisation established in 2019. It identifies, promotes and scales up solutions for pressing environment–development challenges in India and other developing countries in Asia and Africa.

Our work is rooted in regional priorities. We accelerate environmental action at the sub-national level and use that regional knowledge to improve national policies and plans and strengthen international collaboration. We conduct independent, evidence-based research, develop new knowledge and innovative solutions, convene stakeholders to build consensus, and partner with think tanks, civil society, government agencies, philanthropies and industry to scale up solutions.

**The role**
------------

The Head – Administration will lead all administrative, operational and facility functions across iFOREST’s offices in India. The role keeps the organisation running smoothly so that research and programme teams can focus on their work. The position covers office and facility management, procurement and vendor management, travel and event logistics, asset management, the CEO’s office, and administrative policies and compliance.

Success for Head – Administration would mean well-run offices, transparent and cost-effective procurement that meets donor standards, and reliable support for staff, events and visitors.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Administrative leadership and policy**

* Lead the administration function across all iFOREST offices in India and supervise the administration team.
* Develop, review and implement administrative policies and SOPs, including procurement, travel, asset and office-use policies.
* Prepare and manage the annual administration budget and track spending against it.
* Report on administrative performance, costs and risks to the CEO and senior management.
* Contribute to institutional planning as part of the senior management team.

**Office and facility management**

* Ensure management of office infrastructure, maintenance, utilities, housekeeping and security services.
* Oversee office space planning and facility improvements, when needed.
* Manage leases, rental agreements and relations with building management.
* Ensure health, safety and fire-safety standards are met, including emergency preparedness.
* Ensure timely payment of utility and service bills.
* Promote environmentally responsible office practices in energy, water, waste and procurement, in line with iFOREST’s mission.

**Travel, events and visitors**

* Support logistics for workshops, conferences, roundtables and meetings, including venues, catering, accommodation and on-ground support.
* Support domestic and international travel for staff and the CEO, including bookings, visas, accommodation and travel insurance.
* Ensure compliance with the travel policy and support timely settlement of travel claims.
* Manage guests and visitors at the Noida office.
* Ensure the smooth functioning of the CEO’s office, including scheduling, travel and visitor coordination.

**Procurement and vendor management**

* Manage procurement of goods and services in line with organisational policy, budgets and donor requirements.
* Run competitive quotations and tenders, and maintain a transparent, well-documented audit trail.
* Negotiate, draft and manage contracts and annual maintenance agreements with vendors and service providers.
* Maintain an approved vendor list and review vendor performance regularly.
* Ensure quality, cost efficiency and value for money across procurement.

**Asset and inventory management**

* Ensure maintenance of the asset register for furniture, equipment and IT hardware, with tagging and allocation records.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of assets with the Finance team.
* Manage asset insurance, repairs, disposal and write-offs as per policy.
* Manage stock of office supplies and programme materials.

**Compliance, records and coordination**

* Ensure administrative and statutory compliances for offices, including registrations, licences and renewals.
* Maintain administrative MIS, records and documentation for audits.
* Support HR with onboarding logistics, workstations and exits, and support Finance with procurement documentation and audits.
* Coordinate with IT support on equipment, connectivity and access.
* Ensure the confidentiality and security of organisational documents and data.

**Qualifications and experience**
---------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. A master’s degree is an advantage.
* At least 20 years of experience in administration, operations or facilities management, including managing a team.
* Strong working knowledge of procurement processes, vendor and contract management, and office compliance.
* Experience managing travel and logistics for events and meetings.
* Proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with ERP or procurement software.

**Competencies**
----------------

* Experience in a think tank, research institution, non-profit or donor-funded organisation (desirable).
* Experience with procurement under donor guidelines and audit requirements, and experience managing administration across more than one office location (desirable).
* Strong organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage several priorities at once.
* Clear communication and a service-oriented approach with staff, leadership, vendors and visitors.
* Negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* High integrity, transparency and attention to detail in procurement and spending.
* Ability to lead and motivate a support team.
* Calm and practical under pressure, especially during events and travel disruptions.

**What we offer**
-----------------

iFOREST provides an inclusive and supportive work environment and is committed to professional development through education, training and capacity building.

We offer highly competitive salaries within the think tank space and recognise performance through annual appraisals. The final designation will depend on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience.

**Remuneration**

Competitive salary as per the candidate’s experience and proficiency. Final designation of successful candidate will be based on qualification and experience.

**Application deadline & instructions**

Apply online at iforest.global/careers. If you have difficulty applying online, send your CV and a cover letter to careers@iforest.global with “Head – Human Resources” in the subject line.

Immediate opening. Position open until filled.

Published

Nov 04, 2026

You may also apply by writing to careers@iforest.global with the position and
  
reference code in subject line.

#### **Why Choose iFOREST**

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
About Sinclairs

Sinclairs Hotels & Resorts is one of eastern India's most established hospitality names, operating nine properties across the country's hills, plains and coastline, from Himalayan resorts to a beachfront hotel in the Andamans. We are a listed, debt-free group with a strong cash position, now in an active expansion phase and transforming how we run: our commercial discipline, our people systems and our technology.

The Role

You will be the group's first Head of HR, building the people function for nine properties and a growing head office. Sinclairs is transforming how it runs, and people are the biggest part of that: hiring the leaders and specialists the next phase needs, putting in place a grade framework, performance and incentive systems that work across very different properties, and building a culture that attracts and keeps talent in locations from Darjeeling to Port Blair.

This is a builder's role. You will set policy and you will also run recruitment drives, sit in on property appraisals, handle the hard conversations and travel to the properties to understand the people who work there.

What You'll Own

* Talent acquisition for head office and property leadership; employer brand; hiring from the top hotel groups and beyond
* - Organisation design, grade framework, role definitions and the group incentive scheme
* - Performance management, appraisals and succession planning for general managers and department heads
* - Learning and development, including a group training school and a pipeline of talent from the communities around our properties
* - HR policy, compliance and statutory requirements across states (PF, ESI, labour laws, contracts)
* - Compensation benchmarking and structures; payroll oversight with finance
* - Employee relations, engagement and retention across the estate
* - HR systems and data: a single, reliable view of the group's people

What We're Looking For

* 8+ years in HR with at least 3 leading the function for a multi-location business; hotels or hospitality strongly preferred
* - Has built or substantially rebuilt an HR function, policies and systems
* - Hands-on recruiting record for senior and specialist roles
* - Strong working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance across states
* - Experience designing grade structures, incentive schemes and performance frameworks
* - Clear communicator with judgement, discretion and the ability to influence general managers and leadership
* - Based in Mumbai or Kolkata, willing to travel regularly to the properties

Where This Goes

Founding HR seat for a group in expansion; progression to Chief People Officer as the estate and the team scale.

**3. Talent Management, Mentorship & Leadership Development**

? Design structured Onboarding, technical training, and buddy/mentorship programs specifically tailored to support women entering precision electronics manufacturing.

? Create targeted leadership development and high-potential (HiPo) identification programs to accelerate career progression for women into supervisory and plant-leadership roles.

? Monitor diversity metrics, retention rates, and engagement scores to continuously improve the workplace experience for women employees.

**4. Specialized Engineering & Skills Training**

? Spearhead continuous training initiatives on advanced electronics manufacturing standards, ensuring equal and equitable upskilling opportunities

**5. Employee Engagement & Statutory Compliance**

? Establish & encourage employee resource groups that support work-life balance.

? Ensure 100% compliance with central and state labour regulations, including maternity and statutory requirements governing individuals working in industrial shifts.

  
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

Capability Over CV Length: Prior experience is NOT mandatory if you can prove your capability. Whether you are a sharp, hungry MBA graduate with a strong entrepreneurial mindset or an experienced local professional, we care about how you think, plan, and execute.

title: Customer Success Manager – Plum
description:
**About This Role**
Plum is Xoxoday’s rewards and incentives platform for global teams. Customers use it to send rewards, gift cards, prepaid cards and payouts across 150+ countries, through the dashboard, the Rewards API, SSO-based marketplace access or an embedded storefront.
  
  
We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to own the post-sale relationship for a portfolio of Plum accounts. You’ll help customers adopt the platform fully, renew with confidence and grow their programs over time. You’ll work directly with customer stakeholders, including program owners and developers, and partner closely with Support, Category and Sales to manage escalations well. The role requires working US business hours on specific days of the week.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**Retention**

* Own a portfolio of Plum accounts and take accountability for gross and net revenue retention.
* Run regular business reviews covering redemption rates, program ROI, category and brand management, utilisation and roadmap alignment.
* Track account health using usage, redemption, support and sentiment signals, and run recovery plans when churn risk appears.
* Lead renewals with Sales and the Program Owner, and handle commercial conversations where needed.
* Build executive-level relationships beyond the day-to-day admin contact.

**Adoption**

* Drive onboarding and time-to-value for new accounts, from program setup through to the first successful reward send.
* Guide customers across Plum’s delivery models: reward points, codes, links, Rewards API, marketplace SSO and the embedded storefront.
* Help customers move from manual or one-off sends to automated, workflow-driven programs through CRM, marketing and survey tool integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot and Qualtrics.
* Run enablement for customer admins and developers through training, playbooks and best-practice sharing.
* Work with Support and Product to resolve integration and fulfilment issues quickly.

**Growth**

* Identify expansion across new use cases, regions, teams and higher volumes, for example moving a customer from employee rewards into referral, channel or consumer programs.
* Build account plans with clear expansion targets, and work with Sales on upsell and cross-sell.
* Bring customer insights to Product, including feature requests, integration gaps and competitive signals.
* Turn successful programs into case studies, references and advocacy.

**AI-Enabled Ways of Working**

* Use AI tools day to day to prepare for customer calls, summarise accounts, draft QBR decks and follow-ups, analyse usage data and flag risk.
* Build and share repeatable AI-assisted workflows and prompts that improve team productivity.
* Help customers see how Plum’s capabilities, including its MCP support, fit into their own AI-driven workflows.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 4–8 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a similar customer-facing role, ideally in SaaS or platform businesses.
* Hands-on understanding of APIs, including REST, authentication, webhooks, request and response handling, error codes and sandbox testing.
* Ability to read API docs, work through integration issues with a customer’s developers and use tools such as Postman.
* A proven track record on retention, renewals and expansion, with clear ownership of NRR or GRR numbers.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, from business users to senior leaders to engineers.
* Practical, regular use of AI tools such as Claude in your own work, with real examples to share.
* Comfort working with dashboards, spreadsheets and usage data to tell a clear account story.
* Flexibility to work across time zones, including adjusting your schedule to US business hours on specific days.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience in rewards, incentives, loyalty, recognition, gifting or payouts.
* Experience in an API-first or developer-facing product business, such as payments, fintech, communications or other platform APIs.
* Familiarity with CRM and CS tools such as HubSpot and Zendesk, and with SSO or identity concepts.
* Experience working with global or multi-currency customers.

What Makes You a Strong Fit
  
  

* You’re curious, structured and proactive, and you get ahead of problems before customers raise them.
* You’re technically fluent enough to earn engineers’ trust and commercially sharp enough to hold your own in renewal conversations.
* You experiment with AI early and share what works with your team.
* You’re comfortable owning outcomes in a fast-moving, global environment.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Customer Success is where Plum’s value shows up for customers. Your work shapes how well programs perform, whether accounts renew and grow, and which insights reach Product. Retention and expansion across your portfolio, time-to-value for new customers, active usage and API adoption, CSAT/NPS, and the quality of your QBRs and account plans are how we’ll measure the impact of your work.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  

* Work on a rewards and incentives platform used by over 5,000 companies across 150+ countries.
* Partner directly with Support, Category, Sales and Product on customer outcomes.
* Build relationships with customer stakeholders from program owners to senior leaders and engineers.
* Use AI tools in your daily work and help shape shared workflows for the team.
* Work in a hybrid setup based in Bengaluru.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Goodfit is an AI-powered talent platform. Hiring teams use our AI interviews and assessments to screen and evaluate candidates at scale. HR teams use Goodfit beyond hiring too: AI-led employee check-in conversations, exit interviews, and a new Learning module. Recruiters set up role-specific AI interviews and assessments; candidates take them anytime; hiring managers get structured evaluations instead of raw resumes.

Our customers are mostly large Indian enterprises running high-volume hiring. They buy Goodfit on a credit-based model, so their success depends on how quickly they get live, how many interviews they run, and how much value they see per credit.

**The role**

You will own a portfolio of enterprise accounts from signed contract to renewal: getting them live, driving interview volume, and growing credit usage. You are the customer's main point of contact and their voice inside Goodfit.

**What you'll do**

1. Onboarding and adoption
2. Run kickoff and onboarding for new accounts: set up roles, interview templates and assessments with the recruiting team
3. Get each account to its first live interviews within the agreed timeline, then to steady weekly volume
4. Train recruiters and hiring managers; build simple playbooks they can reuse

**Account health and growth**

1. Track interview volume, completion rates and credit burn per account; spot drops early and act on them
2. Run monthly check-ins and quarterly business reviews with HR and TA leaders
3. Own account expansion: cross-sell employee check-ins, exit interviews and the Learning module to existing hiring customers, and grow usage into new business units, roles and geographies
4. Own renewals and credit top-ups for your portfolio, including usage summaries and invoice follow-ups

**Support and escalation**

1. Be first responder for account issues across Goodfit's own in-app chat, email and WhatsApp; resolve or route within SLA
2. Log bugs and feature requests in Linear with clear reproduction steps and business impact
3. Close the loop with customers when fixes ship

**Voice of the customer**

1. Bring structured feedback to product: what blocks adoption, what customers ask for, what competitors offer
2. Keep HubSpot accurate: contacts, notes, health status, renewal dates
3. Post a short daily update on account activity and open issues

**How we'll measure you**

1. Time to first live interview for new accounts
2. Interview volume and credit utilisation across your portfolio
3. Gross and net revenue retention (renewals, top-ups, expansion), including modules adopted per account
4. Support response and resolution time
5. Customer satisfaction (CSAT / NPS)

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves**

1. 2 to 4 years in customer success, account management or implementation at a B2B SaaS company
2. Experience managing enterprise or mid-market accounts in India, with HR, TA or business stakeholders
3. Clear, confident communication in English, written and spoken; comfortable leading calls with senior HR leaders
4. Comfort with data: reading usage dashboards, building a simple account health view in Sheets
5. Ownership mindset: you follow up without being chased and keep commitments to customers
6. Hands-on with a CRM (HubSpot preferred) and a customer support or live-chat tool

**Nice-to-haves**

1. Background in HR tech, recruitment or talent acquisition
2. Exposure to AI products, or curiosity about how LLM-based tools work
3. Experience running QBRs, renewals, or upsell and cross-sell conversations
4. Hindi or another Indian language for client conversations
5. Early-stage startup experience

**Why join**

1. Own real enterprise relationships from day one, not a ticket queue
2. Work directly with the founding team and shape how customer success runs at Goodfit
3. See how AI is changing hiring for some of India's largest employers
4. Room to grow into a senior CSM or CS lead role as the team scales

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Dil Foods, through its Dil Brands initiative, creates and operates virtual food brands designed to meet the daily meal needs of people across India. By partnering with small and medium-sized restaurants, Dil Foods helps them increase utilization of their existing assets, kitchen capacity, and staff through these virtual brands. This model enables partner restaurants to expand their reach, diversify offerings, and improve profitability without significant additional investment. As part of a fast-growing, technology-enabled food ecosystem, team members at Dil Foods contribute directly to the success of both customers and restaurant partners. The organization values innovation, collaboration, and a strong focus on delivering reliable, quality meal experiences.

We are seeking a proactive, customer-focused and process-driven Customer Success Manager to lead and manage customer support operations in a fast-paced food manufacturing environment.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring exceptional customer service, resolving complaints efficiently, strengthening relationships with restaurant partners and business customers, and coordinating with internal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

The role requires strong problem-solving abilities, operational understanding, data-driven decision-making and the ability to manage customer expectations in a time-sensitive food business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Customer Support Operations**

* Manage day-to-day customer support operations across calls, emails, WhatsApp and other communication channels.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer queries, complaints and escalations within defined turnaround times (TAT).
* Establish and monitor service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high customer satisfaction.
* Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for customer interactions and complaint resolution.
* Ensure professional, consistent and empathetic communication with customers and business partners.

**2. Complaint Management & Resolution**

* Handle escalated complaints relating to product quality, food taste, packaging, delivery delays, shortages and order discrepancies.
* Coordinate with Production, Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Logistics and Sales teams for prompt resolution.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) of recurring complaints and implement preventive measures.
* Maintain detailed complaint records, corrective actions and closure reports.
* Escalate food safety and product quality concerns immediately to the Quality Assurance team as per established protocols.

**3. Restaurant Partner & B2B Customer Relationship Management**

* Act as a key point of contact for restaurant partners, distributors, institutional customers and other B2B clients.
* Build strong relationships through proactive communication and timely issue resolution.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate with internal teams to ensure service continuity.
* Identify recurring service gaps that could impact customer retention or business growth.
* Support onboarding of new restaurant partners by ensuring smooth customer support processes.

**4. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with manufacturing and production teams to resolve product-related concerns.
* Coordinate with logistics teams regarding delivery timelines, shortages and order fulfilment.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance teams to investigate complaints and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Work with Sales, Business Development and Operations teams to improve customer satisfaction.
* Ensure timely communication of operational disruptions and resolution timelines to affected customers.

**5. Team Management & Development**

* Lead, train, motivate and supervise the customer support team.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor productivity and ensure adherence to service standards.
* Conduct regular training on customer handling, communication, escalation management and product knowledge.
* Establish individual and team performance targets.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.

**6. Customer Experience & Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve customer support processes and overall service efficiency.
* Introduce automation, CRM tools and structured ticketing systems wherever appropriate.
* Analyse customer feedback to recommend improvements in products, packaging, delivery and service.
* Develop customer retention initiatives through proactive engagement and effective grievance handling.
* Work towards reducing repeat complaints and improving first-contact resolution.

**7. MIS, Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly customer support performance reports.
* Monitor complaint volumes, resolution timelines, customer satisfaction and recurring issues.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, escalations, resolutions and pending cases.
* Present customer insights and service improvement recommendations to management.
* Track trends and highlight potential operational risks arising from customer feedback.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel Management, Food Technology or a related discipline.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Operations, Customer Relationship Management or a related field will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in customer support, customer service or customer experience management.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience managing a customer support team.
* Prior experience in Food Manufacturing, FMCG, QSR, Cloud Kitchens, Food Delivery or B2B Food Service is strongly preferred.
* Experience handling restaurant partners, distributors or institutional clients will be an advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi. Knowledge of regional languages will be an advantage.
* Strong customer complaint handling and conflict resolution skills.
* Understanding of food manufacturing operations, order fulfilment, quality standards and supply chain processes.
* Ability to manage high-pressure situations and time-sensitive escalations.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting and CRM platforms.
* Strong leadership, team management and interpersonal skills.
* Customer-centric mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who:

* Takes complete ownership of customer issues rather than merely forwarding complaints.
* Can effectively coordinate with multiple departments to deliver solutions.
* Understands the urgency of customer concerns in the food industry, where quality, freshness and delivery timelines are critical.
* Can balance customer expectations with operational realities.
* Uses customer feedback to identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Is comfortable working in a growing organisation with evolving systems and processes.
* Can build a customer support function that is responsive, accountable, data-driven and focused on customer retention.

title: Forward Deployed Implementation, Associate Director (BLR)
description:
Alchelyst is a client solutions and infrastructure partner for private markets asset managers. Purpose-built for the expanding demands and sophistication of global private markets, the firm offers a comprehensive managed service offering that can support GPs, private wealth funds and investors. Alchelyst has offices in the US, Ireland, UK, Luxembourg and India.
  
  
**Role**
AURUM, Alchelyst’s proprietary technology platform, is designed to automate fund administration processes at scale. Its core features work out of the box, and the platform is flexible enough to adapt to each client’s needs. The Forward Deployed Implementation team makes sure AURUM works for every client, from day one and every day after. The team’s work has two parts, and this role leads both:
  
  

* Implementation: Onboarding new clients onto AURUM. This means understanding their fund structures, reporting needs, and operating model, then working with operations and technology teams to configure the platform so clients go live smoothly.
* Adoption and tactical solutions: Extending AURUM to client-specific, complex and exception-driven cases. The team sits alongside operations teams to understand these cases and works with the technology team to deliver tailored solutions quickly, so that AURUM becomes part of how operations works every day.

We are seeking a senior techno-functional leader with 12-14 years of experience in fund administration, with a background as a fund accountant or business analyst on fund accounting systems and a track record of leading teams, client implementations and system change.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of private markets fund accounting with a strong grasp of technology and proven people leadership. They’ll lead new client implementations end to end, own the adoption and tactical solutions agenda for assigned operations teams, and build and develop the team that delivers both.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Client Implementation****

* Lead the onboarding of new clients onto AURUM end to end, from scoping and requirements through configuration, data migration, testing and go-live.
* Own implementation plans, timelines, resourcing and risks across concurrent client onboardings, raising issues early and keeping commitments on track.
* Act as the senior point of contact for new clients during onboarding, setting expectations, leading status updates with client stakeholders and building lasting relationships.
* Set the approach for data migration, validation and parallel runs, and make go-live recommendations with operations and client stakeholders.
* Capture lessons from each implementation and refine the onboarding approach, templates and playbooks.

****Operations Engagement & Adoption****

* Own AURUM adoption for assigned operations teams and clients, agreeing adoption goals and success measures with operations leadership.
* Partner with operations leads to embed AURUM in day-to-day processes, helping teams understand how the platform supports their work.
* Oversee reviews of fund accounting, investor services and reporting workflows to identify manual workarounds and where standard AURUM features do not fully meet the need.
* Track adoption across teams, clients and processes, and resolve or escalate barriers with clear, actionable recommendations.

****Use Case Analysis & Solution Design****

* Provide functional direction on client-specific and non-standard use cases, including bespoke fund structures, waterfall and allocation logic, non-standard investor reporting and exception handling.
* Make the final call on whether each use case is best addressed through configuration, a tactical build, a workflow change or a roadmap item for the core product.
* Set the standard for business requirements, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria, and review the team’s work so the technology team can build robust solutions.
* Agree solution approaches with technology leads, balancing speed of delivery with scalability, control and maintainability.

****Delivery & Prioritization****

* Own and prioritize the implementation and tactical solutions backlog for assigned operations areas and clients, based on business impact, risk, effort and client commitments.
* Run the delivery cadence with developers, product owners and QA across concurrent workstreams, managing dependencies and capacity.
* Lead user acceptance testing with operations, owning the test approach and sign-off while the team handles scenario design, data preparation and parallel runs.
* Be accountable for go-live readiness, including cutover, training, user guides and hypercare support.

****Product Feedback & Standardization****

* Identify recurring patterns across implementations and tactical requests, and make the case to the product team for generalizing them into core AURUM features.
* Bring structured, prioritized feedback to product leadership on usability, feature gaps and operational pain points.
* Own the library of reusable solutions, configurations and playbooks, and make sure the team uses it to speed up delivery.

****Leadership & Governance****

* Lead, mentor and develop a team of Associates and Senior Analysts, including hiring, goal-setting, work allocation and reviewing their output.
* Report on implementation progress, adoption metrics and benefits realized (hours saved, errors reduced) to senior leadership and, where relevant, to clients.
* Ensure solutions meet internal control, audit and data governance requirements, with appropriate documentation and change management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. CA, CPA, ACCA, CFA or an MBA in Finance would be an advantage.
* 12-14 years of experience in fund administration or private markets, as a fund accountant, business analyst, or in a techno-functional role on fund accounting systems, including at least 4 years leading teams or delivery.
* Strong understanding of private markets fund accounting, including capital calls, distributions, management fees, carried interest and waterfalls, NAV calculations, investor allocations, and financial and investor reporting.
* Experience leading client implementations or system migrations on fund accounting platforms such as Investran, Geneva, eFront, Allvue, LemonEdge, FIS, or similar.
* Experience gathering requirements from operations users and translating them into functional specifications and user stories for technology teams.
* Experience leading UAT and system go-lives in an operational environment.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation and troubleshooting.
* Experience managing and developing a team.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to work with senior operations leaders, clients and engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure or Fund of Funds administration, ideally across more than one asset class.
* Experience leading or working in Agile delivery teams, with tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Exposure to workflow automation, low-code platforms, or scripting (e.g., Python, Power Automate).
* Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience with data integrations, file-based imports and exports, or APIs between fund accounting and third-party systems.
* Prior experience leading change management, transformation or process re-engineering programs.
* Experience managing teams or stakeholders across locations (e.g., India, US and Europe).

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 1–3 Months: Build a strong understanding of AURUM, the client implementation process and existing operational workflows. Take ownership of the team, the implementation pipeline and the adoption backlog, and agree priorities and success measures with operations and technology leadership.
* Within 4–9 Months: Take in-flight client implementations through to smooth go-lives and deliver prioritized tactical solutions within agreed timelines, with requirements that minimize rework and few UAT defects. Show measurable growth in AURUM adoption and less reliance on manual workarounds outside AURUM.
* Within 9–12 Months: Report the impact of delivered solutions to senior leadership, including hours saved, errors reduced and improved turnaround times. Work with the product team to bring recurring tactical solutions into core AURUM features, and have a repeatable onboarding playbook in place.
* Ongoing: Keep improving operational efficiency, AURUM adoption and the implementation approach. Develop Associates and Senior Analysts so they work independently and can take on larger engagements.

* Track the sales pipeline, manage discount guardrails, and ensure swift, seamless deal closures.
* Support tentpole content monetization by identifying brand fitment, enabling sponsor thinking, and crafting strategic client specific pitches & packages.
* Work cross-functionally with Content, Ops, Ad Tech and others to deliver integrated client solutions and ensure alignment between platform offerings and market demand.
* Evangelize sales team on new ad products to ensure market adoption.
* To conduct regular business reviews with Sales pods to evaluate performance against targets, identify revenue opportunities, and address potential shortfalls proactively.
* Shape competitive strategy by evaluating positioning across digital, broadcast, OTT ecosystems.
* Drive operating model optimization across revenue functions, improving accountability, planning rigor, and cross functional collaboration.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Deep experience in structured strategy development, hypothesis driven problem solving, and executive stakeholder management.
* Strong financial acumen with expertise in business case development, forecasting, and investment evaluation.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and operational altitudes, balancing long term vision with near term execution rigor.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior cross functional teams
* Media ecosystem exposure is preferred, though not mandatory.

**Preferred Education & Experience**

* Postgraduate degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or Media Studies (MBA preferred).
* 2 to 4 years of experience across management consulting, corporate strategy, Ads sales or Strategy

title: CX manager
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**HPE Financial services**
is where we help organizations create the investment they need for digital transformation, in an innovative and sustainable way. We partner with customers across their entire IT asset portfolio from edge to cloud to end-user. Unique to each client’s aspirations and size, our financial and asset management solutions are anchored by best-in-class tech upcycling services. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Customer Experience (CX) Manager will lead the Customer Experience Team, a strategic India-based organization responsible for delivering Level 1 customer support and beyond, customer advocacy, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the customer lifecycle to become the world class contact center organization for customers.
  
  
This role will drive exceptional customer experiences by managing customer interactions through the Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) platform, leading proactive issue resolution, reducing customer effort, and partnering across functions to improve business processes. The position combines people leadership, operational management, strategic thinking, automation enablement, and transformation leadership to improve customer satisfaction while enhancing operational efficiency.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Customer Experience Leadership**

* Define and execute the Customer Experience strategy aligned with business and customer priorities.
* Foster a customer-first culture focused on responsiveness, accountability, and service excellence.
* Serve as the voice of the customer by translating customer insights into actionable improvements.
* Drive initiatives that improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, and ease of doing business.
* Ensure consistent customer experiences across all supported geographies and channels.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead day-to-day CX operations across customer-facing support activities.
* Ensure effective management of:
* Missing Invoice Support
* Statement of Account (SOA) Requests
* Customer Portal Support
* Unassigned Customer Account Management
* Undelivered Email Management
* Triage Queue Management
* Customer Data and Name Alignment Activities
* Customer Contact Maintenance Processes
* Establish governance models and operational controls to ensure service quality and compliance.
* Drive standardization and simplification of processes across regions

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Identify process gaps and customer pain points using operational and customer data.
* Lead automation initiatives that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Drive digital adoption and self-service enablement through customer portals and workflow solutions.
* Partner with technology teams to implement scalable solutions and process enhancements.
* Champion innovation and continuous improvement across the customer support ecosystem

**Stakeholder & Customer Advocacy**

* Build strong relationships with global stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Customer Service, IT, Sales, and Product teams.
* Influence cross-functional teams to resolve customer-impacting issues.
* Facilitate discussions to drive alignment on customer experience priorities.
* Advocate for customer needs while balancing business objectives and operational realities.

**Data, Insights & Performance Management**

* Establish and monitor operational and customer experience KPIs.
* Analyze trends, root causes, and recurring customer issues to identify improvement opportunities.
* Deliver executive-level dashboards, business reviews, and performance reports.
* Leverage data and customer feedback to drive informed decision-making.
* Ensure performance targets are achieved, and corrective action plans are implemented when required.

**People Leadership Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Customer Experience professionals.
* Set clear goals, expectations, and development plans.
* Create a culture of ownership, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Build future leadership capabilities through mentoring and succession planning.
* Drive employee engagement, inclusion, and talent development initiatives.
* Manage workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and capability-building programs.

**Education And Experience Required**

* Typically 8+ years to establish proven track record in Service Business Management Established management background of high level individual contributors (leading teams).
* Typically first level and advanced level university degree.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* High market knowledge. Need broad knowledge competitive market dynamics, business models, business strategies and processes.
* Demonstrate knowledge of corporate organization, culture and policies, cross functional roles and objectives.
* Skills in management of people and business relationships, knowledge in organizational design and planning, problem solving, managing individual and team productivity and dynamics, and excellent communication, and negotiation skills.
* Familiarity with financial reporting tools and ability to correctly design reports and interpret their output.
* Demonstrated ability to provide thought leadership and drive change across functions; highly developed program management and change management.
* Management by influence with international, multi-cultural, virtual teams.
* Influence cross-functionally and on senior management level.

title: Tax Support Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an analytical, Customer -first , people-first Customer Support Manager (Tax) to lead and scale our frontline support operations. In this role, you will manage a frontline team of customer support associates and leads
  
  
You will be the operational backbone of frontline execution owning team performance, holding agents accountable to clear operational scorecards, and partnering cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to automate, deflect, and streamline support workflows. If you excel at diagnosing operational friction, coaching managers, and driving measurable metric improvements for high-value enterprise accounts, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
****People Leadership & Coaching****

* Manage, mentor, and develop a team of frontline Agents and Leads, cultivating leadership capabilities and holding them accountable to team SLAs.
* Foster an inclusive, high-performance, and continuous-learning team culture.
* Lead weekly 1:1s and operational check-ins grounded in objective scorecard metrics and actionable development plans.

****Scorecard Ownership & Operational Performance****

* Own end-to-end performance and consistency across the keyoperational scorecard.
* Drive targeted initiatives to bring Time to First Response (TFR) for both Case and Chat within strict SLA targets.
* Improve support delivery and resolution times for our highest-value clients, ensuring high attainment on case-aging thresholds.
* Increase self-service and AI ticket deflection without compromising customer satisfaction.
* Ensure team compliance across QA adherence, LMS training completion, and schedule adherence.

****Continuous Improvement & Root-Cause Problem Solving****

* Conduct regular "Gemba walks" (go-and-see analysis) to observe frontline workflows, identify systemic bottlenecks, and design root-cause solutions for recurring customer pain points.
* Partner with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to advocate for improved Product , internal tooling, ticketing automations, and AI workflow enhancements.
* Standardize standard operating procedures (SOPs), knowledge-base articles, and escalation playbooks to ensure scalable support execution.

**What You Will Need**

* 3–5+ years of progressive customer support/CX experience, with at least 2+ years managing supervisors, team leads, or large frontline teams in a fast-paced environment (SaaS / Tech experience preferred).
* Metric-Driven Leadership: Proven track record of owning operational scorecards, managing to SLAs, and using data to guide weekly 1:1s and team coaching.
* Enterprise / High-Touch Awareness: Experience handling or overseeing escalations and SLAs for high-value enterprise accounts ($500k+ ARR or equivalent tiering).
* Process & Tooling Proficiency: Experience with modern support tools (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Intercom, Jira) and workforce management (WFM) tools.
* Root-Cause Problem Solver: Demonstrated ability to dive deep into frontline workflows, diagnose friction points, and partner with technical teams to implement permanent fixes
* Strong Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and stakeholder management skills.

**Additional Information**
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com
  
  
Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Customer Success Manager - 19921
description:
**Who are we?**
Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.
  
  
At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.
  
  
This intelligence powers our entire product suite.
  
  

* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.
* Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments.

These are ur embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.
  
  
Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.
  
  

* Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.
* Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category.

Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.
  
  
Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee.
  
  
At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.
  
  
The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.
  
  
Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.
  
  
Investors: A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.
  
  
Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:
  
  

* Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year
* Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively.
* We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99.8%
* Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software - 100 or More Employees.
* Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category.
* RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year”

These recognitions are matched by business performance:
  
  

* Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fifth Consecutive Year
* Listed on the Financial Times & Statista's High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2025 list.
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal

**Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!**
**Are you ready for the next phase of your growth?**
At Whatfix, the Customer Success team is on a mission to maximize the value our customers derive from our product and services. We are looking for a stellar Customer Success Manager who is passionate about solving real business problems for our customers and delivering best-in-class customer service. You will be part of a close-knit motivated team of rock stars consisting of success managers, solutions engineers and project managers..
  
  
**What do you get to do?**

* Get involved in the entire customer lifecycle from on-boarding through the duration of their subscription period. Being responsible for every aspect of the customer journey post sales handoff.
* Be the product champion and consultant to drive desired customer outcomes and enable the customers to realize the potential of Whatfix
* Understand customer’s business, their application for which they have purchased a Whatfix subscription and their key digital adoption goals
* Identify product usage gaps and provide actionable solutions to the customers
* Build value-based relationships with customers and create Whatfix champions
* Conduct Strategic Business Reviews (EBRs and QBRs) to understand customer lifecycle milestones, communicate the value of our product, showcase ROI
* Ensure customer retention by negotiating and closing renewals
* Identify opportunities of upselling and cross-selling along with the Account Managers
* Establish deployment goals and desired success outcomes and then develop a plan to carry them out successfully
* Have a strong business sense to keep looking out for new use cases and solutions using Whatfix to create a win-win situation with customers
* Communicate and brain-storm with the product team on customer feedback and help refine product roadmap
* Work with the marketing team to execute customer surveys, case studies, etc
* Optimize existing processes within the company and actively enhance all Customer Success initiatives
* Drive customer advocacy through reviews, testimonials, customer meetups; and create a center of excellence within the customer's organization

**What you need to have/ bring to the table:**

* Has relevant 5 to 10 years of work experience in a high-touch Customer Success / Strategic Consulting role in a B2B SaaS or Tech Product based company
* Has worked directly with small/medium/large enterprise customers
* Being an organization that believes in a flat hierarchy, we have only 1 people manager per region for the CS team and everyone else, including those with 15+ yrs of Customer Facing experience add value to Whatfix and its customers in the capacity of an individual contributor
* Should be open to aligning with the North America timezone (5.30pm to 2.30am IST) & EMEA Timezone (1pm - 10pm).
* Prior experience of handling quota based account portfolio, handling customer negotiations and renewals
* Showcases exemplary written and verbal communication skills to work along with global customers.
* Passionate about solving problems by understanding customer needs. Should have a growth and learning mindset to solve additional challenges.
* Interested and aware about different applications enterprises use for their workforce and business processes.
* Has an exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships
* Demonstrates a deep understanding of customers concerns and thoughts regarding the use of products
* Managed customers across different segments in the past and knows how to manage them differently
* Exhibits a true passion for customers and for Customer Success

****Perks and Benefits (India)****

* Best-in-class medical insurance coverage
* Free lunch & dinner buffet
* Doorstep cab drop facility
* Education sponsorship
* Internal job transfer & global mobility programs
* Scope to represent Whatfix at global events
* We also provide uncapped incentives, bonus plans and opportunities to employees (especially those in GTM teams) to travel to meet our global customers

****Note:****

* We strive to live and breathe our Cultural Principles and encourage employees to demonstrate some of these core values - Customer First; Empathy; Transparency; Fail Fast and scale Fast; No Hierarchies for Communication; Deep Dive and innovate; Trust, Do it as you own it;
* We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of and not in spite of the differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
* At Whatfix, we deeply value collaboration, innovation, and human connection. We believe that being together in the office five days a week fosters open communication, strengthens our sense of community, and accelerates innovation—ultimately helping us achieve our goals more effectively. At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility in balancing personal and professional priorities. To support this, we offer the option to work from home up to two days per month.
* In any situation that requires additional flexibility, we’re open to considering exceptions on a case-by-case basis to ensure you’re supported in managing both work and life seamlessly.

title: Client Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Role**
: Client Relationship Manager
  
  
**Location**
: Bangalore
  
  
**Work schedule**
: 6:30 PM IST to 3:30 AM IST
  
  
**Working model**
: Hybrid
  
  
**Intro**
: We are looking for a dynamic and client-focused Client Relationship Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for protecting existing revenue by proactively identifying client risks, developing retention strategies, and strengthening long-term client relationships. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in account management or client success, a proven track record of retaining and expanding enterprise accounts, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. CSC offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment where you will partner across Sales, Service, Product, and Support teams to improve client outcomes and drive long-term retention.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Retention & Revenue Protection
* Own and deliver against assigned client retention and revenue preservation targets.
* Proactively identify and address attrition risks through client engagement, service trend analysis, M&A activity, organizational changes, and competitive threats.
* Develop and execute account-specific retention plans to protect recurring revenue.
* Lead recovery efforts for at-risk accounts and manage escalations as needed.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve issues impacting client satisfaction and loyalty.
* Client Expansion & Opportunity Identification
* Identify client needs and expansion opportunities that increase account stickiness and long-term retention.
* Generate qualified opportunities and collaborate with Sales on account growth initiatives.
* Support account expansion strategies, renewals, and retention-focused business cases.
* Account Intelligence & Retention Planning
* Monitor indicators that may impact retention, including:
* Merger & Acquisition activity
* Leadership and organizational changes
* Client responsiveness issues related to data requests
* Client engagement levels
* Industry and competitive developments
* Develop proactive communication and retention strategies based on account insights.
* Use CRM and account analytics to prioritize retention efforts and allocate resources.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with Sales, Service, Product, and Support teams to deliver a seamless client experience.
* Coordinate internal resources to address risks, improve client outcomes, and strengthen account health.
* Serve as the primary advocate for client retention across the organization.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Client Retention Rate
* Revenue Preserved from At-Risk Accounts
* Net Promoter Score (NPS)
* Commercial Growth Contribution

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-7 years in Account Management, Client Success, Retention, or Relationship Management.
* Demonstrated success retaining and expanding enterprise client relationships.
* Experience managing proactive client outreach and risk mitigation programs.
* Strong consultative communication and executive relationship management skills.
* Proven ability to identify early attrition signals and execute retention strategies.
* Experience using CRM tools and account health metrics to manage client portfolios.

**About Us**
CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®
  
  
Visit our careers site to learn more about CSC and our commitment to our clients, communities, and each other.
  
  
CSC is committed to creating a feeling of belonging through a diverse and growth-oriented environment where everyone is valued.
  
  
CSC colleagues have global career opportunities and excellent benefits, including annual success-sharing bonuses or commission plans based on individual performance. To learn more, visit cscglobal.com/service/careers .
  
  
We offer a range of support to colleagues with disabilities, ensuring people have the necessary resources to thrive in their roles. We encourage candidates to work closely with our talent acquisition partners to convey their specific needs. Our commitment to accessibility reflects our broader dedication to diversity and belonging,
  
  
CSC only accepts resumes from employment agencies that are part of our approved supplier program. Resumes submitted from other agencies either to talent acquisition, our hiring leaders, employees, or through any other mechanism other than our supplier process, will not be eligible to claim related fees and the submitted resumes will be considered property of CSC.
  
  
We encourage candidates to apply directly to our website and not through third-party sources.
  
  
*Disclaimer: The information above describes the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not intended to describe all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications.*
**About The Team**
At CSC®, we’re always looking ahead, finding ways to innovate, challenge the status quo, and anticipate the needs of our clients. We exceed expectations by adapting client ambitions and goals as our own. This Fierce Client Spirit has helped us adapt and create solutions that have enabled businesses to run smoother and smarter for more than 125 years. It’s also the reason we’re the trusted partner of many of the world’s most successful organizations.
  
  
CSC is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented people whose values align with ours. We empower our colleagues to bring the right solutions to market to meet client demand. That’s why we are the leading provider of business administration and compliance solutions.
  
  

* CSC is a great place to work with smart and dedicated people.
* We have won several employer recognition awards, including Top Workplace USA, Great Places to Work India, and Built In’s Best Places to Work.
* We offer fulfilling work and career opportunities. Most positions are filled with internal moves and employee referrals.

description:

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience managing cross-functional technical teams, stakeholders, and external deployment partners.
* Experience programming in one or more of the following: Java, Python, Go, C++, or similar programming languages.
* Experience with cloud computing, IT systems integration, and deploying enterprise Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions (specifically Google Workspace).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Professional certification in Google Workspace Administration or Google Cloud.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical tradeoffs to both executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage the end-to-end delivery and technical strategy for Google Workspace deployments, ensuring architectural alignment and smooth data migrations from legacy systems.
* Act as the central interface, coordinating complex technical requirements between customers, internal cross-functional teams, and external system integrators.
* Define project scope, establish baselines, and manage schedules while identifying and mitigating risks to successfully deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Conduct regular service reviews, monitor service level agreements (SLAs), and track quality metrics to ensure optimal service delivery and customer satisfaction.
* Guide customers through technical change management and user adoption strategies to help them maximize the value of their Google Workspace investment.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.
