title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Cloud/ Kubernetes Platform
description:
India - Bangalore

Product Development and Operations/Full time/Onsite

Guidewire provides outstanding software for the second-largest financial services industry in the world: insurance. We deliver the core applications that Property and Casualty (P/C) insurers use to build their products, sell policies, settle claims, and bill their customers. Through Guidewire Cloud, our SaaS platform, we enable customers to rapidly innovate, scale securely, and drive measurable value.
  
  
Our Cloud Platform provides the foundational capabilities, infrastructure, and engineering services that enable teams to build, deploy, and operate modern cloud-based products at scale. We focus on secure, resilient, and scalable platform capabilities that improve developer productivity, enable self-service engineering, and accelerate innovation across Guidewire Cloud.
  
  
As a Senior Manager, Software Engineering – Cloud Platform, you will lead and develop high-performing Cloud Platform Engineering teams, combining strong technical leadership with effective people management. You will remain closely engaged in technical design, engineering execution, and problem-solving while providing direction, coaching, and career development for your engineers. Working closely with Staff and Principal Engineers, Product Management, and other engineering leaders, you will shape platform architecture and technical strategy, guide complex engineering decisions, and drive the evolution of reliable, scalable, and secure cloud platform capabilities. Your leadership will be critical to improving platform reliability, developer experience, and engineering effectiveness across Guidewire Cloud.

**Job Description**

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Lead and develop Cloud Platform Engineering teams:** Provide technical direction, coaching, and career development while building a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.
* **Build and develop engineering talent:** Establish clear expectations, provide regular feedback, manage performance, and develop engineers' technical and leadership capabilities. Foster an inclusive environment that encourages independent thinking, collaboration, and accountability for engineering outcomes.
* **Provide hands-on technical leadership:** Work closely with engineers on complex technical problems, architectural decisions, design reviews, and implementation trade-offs. Help resolve technical roadblocks, challenge proposed solutions, and guide teams toward scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable designs. Remain technically engaged without becoming a bottleneck for implementation.
* **Own engineering execution and outcomes:** Drive end-to-end delivery from planning and prioritization through implementation, rollout, and continuous improvement. Stay close to technical execution, identify engineering risks early, help resolve critical blockers, and ensure delivery decisions support quality and long-term platform health.
* **Champion engineering excellence:** Drive adoption of API-first design, TDD, BDD, automated testing, GitOps, observability, secure coding, and continuous delivery. Champion the collaborative engineering practices we use,, such as pair programming and spec-driven development, where requirements and design are written and reviewed before implementation begins, as the default way the team builds software, and help engineers who are new to them get comfortable. Provide practical technical guidance and promote engineering standards that improve code quality, maintainability, and delivery effectiveness.ance and promote engineering standards that improve code quality, maintainability, and delivery effectiveness.
* **Shape platform strategy and architecture:** Partner with Product Management, Security, Architects, and engineering leaders to evolve the Cloud Platform roadmap. Evaluate architectural options, prioritize technical investments, address technical debt, and balance near-term delivery with scalability, reliability, security, and long-term platform evolution.
* **Drive reliability and operational excellence:** Take accountability for platform reliability, availability, performance, security, and cost efficiency. Use operational metrics and SLOs to identify systemic issues, guide root-cause analysis, resolve recurring problems, and drive sustainable improvements.
* **Drive AI-enabled engineering and automation:** Champion the responsible use of AI and automation across software development, testing, delivery, and platform operations. Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, reduce manual toil, accelerate delivery, and improve quality, using measurable outcomes to assess impact.
* **Stay close to engineering:** Maintain the technical depth to engage in code and design reviews, understand implementation details, evaluate technical trade-offs, and provide actionable guidance when teams encounter complex engineering challenges.
* **Drive continuous platform improvement:** Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, modernize platform capabilities, reduce recurring engineering friction, improve developer experience, and balance immediate delivery needs with sustainable long-term improvements.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* + Demonstrated ability to apply AI and automation to software engineering and platform operations, with a focus on practical adoption, measurable productivity improvements, and improved engineering outcomes.
  + 15+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong background in building, designing, and evolving SaaS products, cloud platforms, or platform engineering capabilities in a product-focused organization.
  + Significant experience leading software engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development. Demonstrated prior experience managing a team of approximately 15 or more engineers, with the ability to balance people leadership with active technical engagement and accountability for engineering outcomes.
  + Proven experience leading a Cloud Platform Engineering team or equivalent platform-focused engineering team, with accountability for technical direction, architecture, engineering execution, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
  + Strong hands-on software engineering background in Java, Go, or Python, with the ability to review code, evaluate implementation approaches, assess architectural designs, and guide engineers through complex technical challenges. Demonstrated technical depth that extends beyond earlier-career coding experience.
  + Deep understanding of cloud-native and distributed systems architectures, preferably on AWS, including multi-tenant design, scalability, high availability, resilience, security, and operational excellence.
  + Strong experience with cloud-native technologies and platform tooling, including Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tools, and modern CI/CD and Git-based deployment pipelines. **The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN**

  

**This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.**

**Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST**

We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Senior Metrics Analyst to lead the development, management, and optimization of IT Service Management (ITSM) reporting, analytics, and performance measurement capabilities. This role will be responsible for transforming operational data into actionable insights that drive service excellence, continual improvement, and informed decision-making across IT.

The successful candidate will partner with IT leadership, service owners, and operational teams to establish meaningful performance metrics, develop executive-level dashboards, and provide strategic recommendations that improve service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

**Job Duties:**

* Build an Operational Controle Center (OCC) model for supporting SAP, MfgPro, QAD, Mainframe platforms and applications.
* Provide program leadership, transitions tracking, budgeting and support vendor management.
* Provide leadership for automation using complex operational data and derive business actions.
* Analyse service performance data to identify trends, recurring issues, service improvement opportunities, and operational risks that can be addressed with AI/Automation
* Partner with IT leadership, service owners, and operational teams to establish meaningful performance metrics and reporting standards.
* Champion data-driven decision-making across IT operations through automation and root-cause resolution through AI.
* Present findings, trends, risks, and improvement recommendations to senior management, stakeholders
* Identify opportunities for reporting automation and process optimization to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.

**Top Candidates Will Have:**

* Deep understanding of operation control centre best practices and control frameworks.
* Deep functional knowledge on Manufacturing and Supply Chain processes.
* Experience supporting global IT operations and service delivery organizations.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align technical metrics to business outcomes.
* Proven track record of driving measurable improvements in service performance, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency through analytics and reporting.

**Additional Duties**  
Support building AI/Automation capabilities for the SAP and Mainframe landscape

**Education / Experience**:

* Engineering degree or Equivalents
* Total 15+ Years of IT experience. 5+ years of experience in people management, IT Operations Analytics, Service Reporting, Business Intelligence, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse large data sets and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Additional Info**:

* 25% Travel
* This role requires 5 days onsite.
* Relocation is unavailable.

**Skill Descriptors**  
**Business Acumen:** Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.  
**Level Basic Understanding:**
  

* Works to understand the business priorities of internal and external clients.
* Describes profitability drivers and considerations.
* Describes desired or actual business results in measurable scales or terms.
* Explains how the organization makes money.

  
**Information Technology Trends:** Knowledge of marketplace experience, developments and trends related to the organization's use of Information Technology (IT); ability to apply knowledge of IT appropriately to benefit the organization.  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Compares organization's technology practices to other organizations.
* Discusses organizational position in relation to technology-related trends.
* Cites examples of successful organization initiatives and underlying technologies.
* Presents alternative views of key technologies and their implications.
* Highlights organizational implications associated with major IT trends.
* Advises key lines of business on major advances in technology and implications.

  
**Analytical Thinking:** Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Seeks discrepancies and inconsistencies in available information; explains variances.
* Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation.
* Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research.
* Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action.
* Approaches a complex problem by breaking it down into its component parts.
* Chooses among a diverse set of analytical tools according to the nature of the situation.

  
**Talent Management:** Knowledge of the critical competencies required to achieve intended results; ability to generate consistent approaches for hiring, selection, retaining and leveraging talent across the organization.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**
  

* Recommends improvements to talent management initiatives based on analysis of data on their effectiveness.
* Maintains strong relationships with formal and informal mentors.
* Implements systems and methods for supporting talent management programs.
* Negotiates for key developmental experiences and transitional experiences.
* Introduces contacts from personal and professional networks to hiring managers.

  
**Leadership:** Knowledge of leadership practices and processes; ability to use strategies and skills to enlist others in setting, embracing and achieving objectives while having a long-term perspective of the future state of things and how to get there.  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Translates vision into specific functional or departmental initiatives.
* Uses a normative decision model (with leadership styles and situational variables) to select style.
* Promotes efficacy through monitoring, coaching & motivating subordinates, intervention, etc.
* Uses emotional contagion to affect the mood of group members, tone of group and group processes.
* Initiates structure: role clarification, setting standards, holding subordinates accountable, etc.
* Employs various group decision-making methods depending on the situation.

  
**Vendor/Supplier Management:** Knowledge of external provider management processes and ability to effectively manage the business relationship with external providers (e.g. vendors, service providers, contractors, consultants and suppliers).  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Manages actual and perceived conflict of interest issues.
* Monitors and communicates vendor effectiveness, reliability and performance.
* Influences existing and new vendor relationships and the approved vendor list.
* Interprets documents detailing service provisions and financial arrangements.
* Explains case studies of effective and ineffective partnering relationships and lessons learned.
* Advises others on the issues and considerations for working with new vendors, suppliers or partners.

  
**IT Service Management (ITSM):** Knowledge of Information Technology (IT) service; ability to manage IT services and oversee service operations.  
**Level Expert:**
  

* Oversees the establishment and use of best practices in IT service management.
* Leads in the development of information technology and personal technical skills.
* Promotes the use of standard procedures in each function of IT services.
* Creates criteria to measure professional services; ensures the quality of IT services.
* Forecasts technological industry trends and potential risks in IT service management.
* Provides insight into system optimization and development of process-focused IT services

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Chief Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Hello eager tech expert!**

The Senior Service Delivery Manager acts as the key account manager and trusted strategic partner for GBS internal functions. The role connects business stakeholders with software delivery and domain teams to ensure that services and solutions are aligned with business priorities, delivered reliably, and continuously improved.

This leader enables delivery teams with the right strategy, direction, governance, and organisational support. They serve as a sounding board for senior stakeholders and delivery leaders, challenge constructively when required, and take ownership of complex escalations through to resolution.

**You’ll break new ground by**

Key Responsibilities:

**Key Account Management and Business Partnership**

* Own the senior relationship with assigned GBS internal functions and act as their primary contact for service delivery matters.
* Develop a deep understanding of stakeholder priorities, operating models, challenges, and strategic roadmaps.
* Build trusted relationships with senior business, technology, software delivery, and domain leaders.
* Translate business priorities into a clear, jointly owned service and delivery agenda.
* Manage stakeholder expectations through transparent communication, informed challenge, and dependable follow-through.

**Delivery Strategy and Enablement**

* Shape the service delivery strategy in alignment with business outcomes, enterprise priorities, and technology roadmaps.
* Enable delivery teams with clear priorities, decision frameworks, governance, and access to the right capabilities.
* Act as a sounding board and strategic adviser to delivery leaders, helping them evaluate options, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Remove organisational barriers and facilitate timely decisions across business, delivery, and domain teams.
* Promote outcome-based planning, operational excellence, standardisation, automation, and continuous improvement.

**Service Governance and Performance**

* Establish and lead governance forums covering delivery performance, service quality, financials, risks, dependencies, and improvement actions.
* Maintain end-to-end oversight of the service portfolio and ensure that commitments, service levels, and agreed outcomes are achieved.
* Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to identify trends, address root causes, and drive measurable improvements.
* Ensure clear ownership, decision rights, reporting, and accountability across all parties.
* Support demand, capacity, financial, resource, and supplier planning where relevant.

**Escalation, Risk, and Issue Management**

* Own major service and delivery escalations, ensuring rapid mobilisation, clear communication, and disciplined resolution.
* Bring together the appropriate business, software delivery, domain, and leadership stakeholders to resolve complex issues.
* Balance urgency with sustainable corrective action, including root-cause analysis and prevention of recurrence.
* Anticipate delivery, operational, commercial, security, and stakeholder risks and ensure timely mitigation.
* Provide concise executive updates, including impact, options, decisions required, recovery actions, and status.

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead through influence across a complex, matrixed, and international organisation.
* Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, constructive challenge, and customer focus.
* Coach service and delivery leaders and contribute to capability development and succession planning.
* Represent the voice of the internal customer while maintaining an enterprise-wide perspective.

**You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including**:

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 20+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial leadership responsibility in service delivery, technology delivery, key account management, business partnering, or a comparable role.
* Proven success managing strategic relationships with senior executives and internal customers in a large, complex organisation.
* Strong experience working with software delivery, product, platform, and domain teams across the service lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to shape delivery strategy, lead governance, improve service performance, and manage critical escalations.
* Experience operating in global, multicultural, and matrixed environments, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Sound commercial and financial acumen, including experience with budgets, forecasts, value realisation, and supplier or contract management.
* Bachelor’s degree in technology, engineering, business, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
* Relevant service management, programme, agile, product, or project management certification is desirable.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Executive stakeholder management and trusted advisory capability
* Strategic thinking with strong operational discipline
* Customer and outcome orientation
* Service delivery and governance leadership
* Software delivery and digital technology awareness
* Complex problem-solving and sound judgement
* Negotiation, influencing, and conflict resolution
* Decisive escalation and crisis management
* Clear executive communication and storytelling
* Collaboration, coaching, and leadership through influence

**Decision-Making & Ownership**

* High stakeholder confidence, satisfaction, and strength of strategic relationships
* Achievement of agreed service levels, delivery commitments, and business outcomes
* Effective alignment between GBS internal functions, software delivery teams, and domain teams
* Improved service quality, predictability, efficiency, and value realisation
* Timely resolution of critical escalations and sustained reduction in recurring issues
* Transparent governance, proactive risk management, and high-quality executive communication
* Stronger delivery capability, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration

**Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!**

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

This role is based in Bangalore. But you’ll also get to visit other locations in India and globe, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries and the shape of things to come. We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us craft tomorrow.

With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

The Solution Engineer role sits within the GTM organisation in India, making you a trusted technical advisor to the local sales team, our partners, and our customers. In this role, you will support the EMEA region, working closely with EMEA Account Executives, partners, and customers. You will work on exciting projects with some of the most forward-thinking organisations, helping guide the start of their Generative AI journeys. This role has a strong technical skill set and is not a classic SE profile. At Glean, our Solution Engineers work with our customers to help them connect Glean to their most important decision-making platforms. These platforms include Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, and everything in between! **You will:**

* Perform interactive demonstrations of the Glean platform to prospective customers.
* Educate the technical teams of our prospective customers on the architecture of the Glean platform, specifically articulating the "how" of how our solution works in the context of the customer landscape.
* Scope and execute sponsored pilot and Proof of Value (PoV) exercises to ensure the technical requirements and business objectives that the Glean solution provides are validated.

  + Maven or Gradle
  + Basic CI/CD: a pipeline that builds, tests, and publishes a Java service

* Knowledge on process methodologies – Agile/frameworks like CMMI

* Technical delivery skills

* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 500 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. title: Sr. Manager, Digital Product Management
description:
**Work Schedule**

**Environmental Conditions**

**Job Description**

When you're part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll do meaningful work that enables our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As the world leader in serving science, our digital ecosystem powers billions of dollars in customer interactions and supports scientists, researchers, healthcare professionals and industrial customers around the globe. Our Digital Customer Experience organization is responsible for defining and delivering the future of digital commerce across our digital experiences.

As a Senior Digital Product Manager, APAC, you will serve as the regional product leader connecting Asia Pacific market performance, customer needs and commercial priorities to Thermo Fisher Scientific's global digital product strategy. You will develop a fact-based point of view on where Digital can improve customer outcomes and commercial performance across the region, with particular attention to the different market structures, customer behaviors, dealer models and platform maturity that shape digital adoption in APAC.

This role is intentionally positioned in-region. You will work closely with regional Commercial, Marketing, and eBusiness leaders while partnering with global Product Management, UX, Analytics and platform teams. Your responsibility is not simply to represent regional requests. You will co-create product direction with the markets, distinguish local requirements from scalable patterns and ensure regional insights influence enterprise product decisions.

Success requires strong product judgment, commercial acumen and the ability to operate across a complex portfolio of global and localized digital experiences. You will be expected to understand revenue and funnel performance across the region, develop hypotheses about performance drivers, identify opportunities for experimentation and bring a clear recommendation back to the broader product organization. You will also identify successful regional capabilities and operating models that may warrant broader global scale.

**How You Will Make an Impact**
===============================

**Regional Product Vision and Strategy**
----------------------------------------

* Define and evolve the digital product vision for APAC, grounded in customer evidence, regional commercial priorities, competitive context and measurable business outcomes.
* Translate differences across markets into a contextualized regional strategy that clarifies what should be globally standardized, regionally adapted or locally differentiated.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year regional product roadmap that connects APAC priorities to global platform and experience roadmaps.
* Distinguish business requests from underlying customer and commercial problems, then recommend the most effective product intervention.
* Identify opportunities that span markets, sites or organizational boundaries and drive alignment on reusable capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
* Bring a clear APAC point of view into global product planning, investment discussions and roadmap trade-offs.

**Revenue, Funnel and Market Performance Leadership**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Develop command of digital revenue, engaged traffic, funnel performance, adoption and conversion across APAC markets and the digital platforms available to local teams.
* Partner with Finance, Commercial and regional stakeholders to understand performance versus plan and prior year, identify meaningful trends and explain the drivers behind regional variation.
* Build hypotheses that distinguish macroeconomic or market softness from addressable digital performance gaps.
* Bring regional insights back into the corporate product organization so market learning informs enterprise priorities, investment decisions and roadmap sequencing.

**Customer, Market and Dealer Insight**
---------------------------------------

* Establish a disciplined customer and market insight cadence using direct customer engagement, Sales and service feedback, behavioral analytics, CAS or satisfaction signals and competitive benchmarking.
* Develop a strong understanding of dealer and distributor personas across APAC, including which needs are common across markets and which are country-specific.
* Partner with UX and Research to validate customer problems before committing to solutions and ensure regional experiences reflect real customer behavior.
* Monitor local competitors, digital commerce practices and emerging market behaviors to identify opportunities for differentiation.

**Global-to-Local and Local-to-Global Product Leadership**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Accelerate adoption of global digital capabilities across APAC by translating enterprise products into relevant regional use cases, enablement plans and measurable adoption outcomes.
* Identify successful regional capabilities, market practices or customer solutions that have the potential to scale beyond a single country.
* Build the business and customer case for when localized innovation should be standardized or incorporated into global platforms.
* Anticipate dependencies across markets and product portfolios and proactively align roadmaps to reduce fragmentation.

**Cross-Functional Product Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Serve as a strategic product partner to APAC Marketing, eBusiness and regional leadership teams.
* Make and communicate prioritization recommendations when customer, regional, commercial and technical needs compete for investment.
* Clearly articulate expected customer and business outcomes, trade-offs, risks and strategic rationale to both senior executives and delivery teams.
* Create operating mechanisms that keep regional teams informed while avoiding a model centered on status reporting or request intake.
* Influence without direct authority and create momentum across globally distributed teams.

**Product Discovery and Delivery**
----------------------------------

* Lead discovery for regional customer and commercial problems before committing teams to specific solutions.
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product outcomes, requirements and MVP strategies that enable UX and Engineering teams to execute effectively.
* Determine the smallest meaningful intervention needed to validate a hypothesis and define criteria for scaling, iterating or stopping.
* Balance immediate market needs with the development of reusable global or regional platform capabilities.
* Maintain accountability for customer and business outcomes throughout the product lifecycle rather than measuring success primarily through feature delivery.

**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 7+ years of experience in Digital Product Management, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience or closely related roles.
* Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and owning roadmaps for customer-facing digital products.
* Experience leading product decisions in complex, cross-functional and geographically distributed environments.
* Experience using revenue, funnel, behavioral analytics, customer insights and experimentation to make prioritization and investment decisions.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer and business problems into product strategy, measurable outcomes and executable roadmaps.
* Strong ability to communicate strategy, recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, commercial leaders and technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with dealer or distributor portals, localized commerce models, market expansion or regional digital transformation.
* Experience delivering digital commerce capabilities for B2B customers, distributors, dealers, procurement organizations or enterprise purchasing workflows.
* Experience managing digital revenue or funnel performance and translating business performance into product interventions.
* Experience with global digital platforms that must support regional and market-specific requirements.
* Experience collaborating across cultures and time zones and influencing teams without direct authority.
* MBA or advanced business education.

**Key Capabilities for Success**
================================

* Regional strategic product leadership: Builds a clear product point of view from customer, commercial and market evidence rather than serving primarily as a conduit for requests.
* Commercial acumen: Understands revenue, funnel and market performance and can identify where Digital has meaningful levers to change outcomes.
* Customer and market grounding: Uses direct customer evidence, analytics, Sales insight, competitive context and emerging market or technology signals to challenge assumptions and guide priorities.
* Systems thinking: Understands how local market decisions interact with global platforms, shared capabilities and the broader customer journey.
* Global-local judgment: Recognizes when a market need should be localized, when a global capability should be adopted and when regional innovation has potential for enterprise scale.
* Influence and alignment: Builds trust across regional and global teams while remaining comfortable making recommendations and difficult trade-offs.
* Clear communication: Synthesizes complex performance and customer signals into a concise point of view for executive, commercial and technical audiences.
* Ownership: Takes accountability for customer and business outcomes from discovery through delivery, adoption and optimization.

Through the Saner Platform, SecPod enables organizations to strengthen security posture across endpoints, networks, servers, and cloud environments.

At SecPod, the culture is flat, innovation-driven, and execution-focused, where curiosity is encouraged, ownership is valued, and ideas matter more than hierarchy.

3 to 5 years

**Role Summary**

Join our Product Support Team at SecPod and be a vital connection between our products and customers. Your expertise will shine in understanding

diverse customer environments and solving complex issues. From helping prevent cyberattacks to assisting with log analysis and vulnerability checks, you'll be instrumental in reducing cyber risks and closing the gap in Cyber Exposure. * + Collaborate closely with various teams at SecPod, such as Development, Security Intelligence, Operations, and Sales, fostering strong relationships.

  + Thoroughly analyze and respond to customer technical inquiries to ensure prompt and effective resolution.

  + Replicate customer software issues in a controlled lab environment to facilitate troubleshooting and resolution.
  + Facilitate the flow of customer feedback to relevant departments, including Product Management and Research & Development, to drive product improvement.
  Create and publish KB Articles for re-use by customers and support Team.

  
  

**What You’ll Need**

  

* 3 - 5 years of experience in customer support, technical support, system administration, or related customer-facing roles, particularly for large enterprise clients.
* Comprehensive understanding of cross-platform operating systems including Linux, Mac OS, and Windows.
* Proficiency in any ticketing systems such as JIRA, Zendesk, or Salesforce.
* Genuine passion for learning, resolving customer issues and ensuring success in a fast-paced, highly technical environment.
* Excellent relationship management, customer service, and communication skills across various channels.
* Familiarity with Java-based applications and application-level troubleshooting techniques.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, using Postman for testing, debugging HTTP responses, and handling authentication errors.

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across operating systems, network infrastructure, cloud environments, identity and access management services, enterprise applications, and endpoint management solutions.

title: Senior Business Operation Manager
description:
**About Payoneer**

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

**Who you are -**

* At least 5 years' experience in business development/ business operation/ sales operation/ program management.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

The HR Service Center Administrator will support end-to-end onboarding, joining formalities, Workday administration, employee file management, HR data management, and payroll administration. * Maintain onboarding, joining, documentation, and employee-data trackers.

* Maintain an appropriate audit trail for transactions, approvals, and supporting documents.

* Ensure activities are completed within agreed service levels and process timelines.

* Escalate documentation gaps, data discrepancies, system issues, and process delays to the appropriate stakeholder.

* Support internal reviews, external audits, and compliance assessments.

* Participate in user acceptance testing and implementation of HR process or system enhancements.

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, Data Cloud, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in cloud computing, technical business engineering, or software engineering with cloud-native architectures.
* 2 years of experience managing a software engineering, FDE, or a related technical customer-facing team in a cloud computing environment.
* Experience reviewing designs and code in Python, PySpark and SQL.
* Experience designing platforms built on Data Cloud services (e.g. BigQuery, Managed Spark/Lightning Engine, Apache Iceberg (e.g., Borderless Lakehouse), Spanner, AlloyDB, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Kafka).
* Experience building agentic AI systems on enterprise data (e.g., agents, retrieval, vector search, evaluation).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience leading forward deployed engineering, field engineering or professional services organizations at a data platform or AI-first company or a hyperscaler’s data and machine learning services team.
* Experience engaging credibly with multi-level executives and with engineers.
* Experience across a broad range of data cloud specializations, including data engineering, data science/machine learning, application development, operations, and investigative databases/data management.
* Experience building end-to-end data pipelines, engineering features, and training/deploying machine learning models.
* Experience with RAG architectures, chunking/indexing strategies, vector databases, hybrid search, and the use of data governance for grounding agents in enterprise context.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google Cloud’s Data Cloud team builds the data platform behind Google’s agentic AI offerings: BigQuery, Managed Spark, borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB and Knowledge Catalog, integrated with Gemini Enterprise.  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, you will lead a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team for Google Cloud’s Data Cloud. You will bridge the gap between frontier data solutions and production-grade reality for customers. You will take customer data and machine learning workloads from prototype to production on BigQuery, managed Spark, borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB and Knowledge Catalog. You will be a technical leader first: credible with Chief Technology Officers (CTOs) and data platform leaders, able to review your team’s designs and code, and a strong judge of engineering talent.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the technical lead, establishing code standards, architectural best practices, and benchmarks to elevate engineering excellence across the team.
* Partner with business and tech leadership to define requirements for high-value opportunities, deploying specialized experts to key accounts.
* Lead technical hiring for Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), evaluating data engineering expertise, systems engineering, and coding skills to build an exceptional engineering team.
* Identify skill gaps in emerging tech (e.g., Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool-calling, and foundation models, building agents), ensuring the team maintains subject matter expertise in an evolving data stack.
* Collaborate with product and engineering to resolve blockers and translate field insights into roadmaps while building internal tools to drive organizational efficiency.

title: Associate Value Engineering - Orbit India
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**The Team:**

As an Associate Value Engineer, you are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. As a so-called Value Engineer (VE), you partner with sales and customers to create compelling and innovative technical solutions to critical business problems leveraging cutting edge (AI) capabilities within our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A great VE understands the customer, the technology, and the sales cycle making it what may be the most interesting, challenging, and fulfilling role in Enterprise Software.

You will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to a community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.

**The Role:**

  

Talented individuals launch their careers in the enterprise software world by joining the Orbit Graduate Program as an Associate Value Engineer.

The **12-month program** is a unique experience to fast start your career in the SaaS Industry that highlights hands-on learning, mentorship, and a team culture where we rely on each other to learn, grow and achieve. The program is designed to develop essential VE skills & competencies and establish strong lasting relationships allowing you to grow your career at Celonis.

Your journey will start with onboarding & enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation & demo skills, discovery & objection handling as well as value selling.

**The work you'll do:**

  

* Work as part of the Global VE CoE to support the Benelux Value Engineering team on customer engagements
* Collaborate with customers to uncover their core business challenges and determine how Celonis Process Intelligence can help them achieve their business objectives and AI Strategy
* Execute proof projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence, frame a quantitative business value and deliver presentations to senior executives to drive investment decisions
* Prototype and develop AI solutions tailored to customer needs, including both traditional machine learning, LLM-based solutions and orchestration technology
* Drive change management and value realisation and ensure a positive return on investment
* Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen to act as a trusted advisor
* Collaborate and share customer insights & feedback with internal Product and Engineering teams to influence and co-develop (AI) product innovations
* Create re-usable collateral, best practices & tools within the Global VE Center of Excellence and feed them back to the regional Value Engineering team
* Travel to the Benelux region to meet clients in person to ensure the success of customer engagements

**The qualifications you need:**

We are looking for people who enjoy solving problems, think outside the box, and are not afraid to make and learn from mistakes. In particular, we seek "builders" who thrive in fast-paced environments and can rapidly develop solutions and pilots using our platform and AI technologies.

You have a bachelors and/or masters degree in (Industrial) Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science / Business Analytics, AI/ML, Mathematics or other related fields, as well as valuable work/internship experience. You're curious, self-motivated, enjoy continuous learning, and you want to work in a lively environment characterized by high growth.

**You are successful as a Value Engineer if you:**

  

* Have a passion for technology, data and AI and the impact it can have on the world.
* Have a hunger to learn new technologies and bring at least basic knowledge or hands-on experience in SQL and/or Python.
* Any exposure to process mining principles and completion of Celonis "Rising Star" modules would be a welcome indicator of your eagerness to develop in this field.
* Are able to think analytically and creatively, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems.
* Are focused on creating and adding value for customers.
* Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to multi-task, prioritize and execute.
* Are able to build relationships with senior management and influence decision-makers.
* Are confident to present to C-level executives and larger audiences.
* Are willing to travel to India region to meet clients in person.
* Are an effective communicator and fluent in English.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

title: Enginner II, Infrastructure (Platform Engineer)
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next - together!

**Platform Engineer P3 (3-6 years experience)**

At Anaplan, we are looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Environment Tooling team. The team is responsible for building, owning, and operating the platform infrastructure and non-production environments that enable engineers to develop, test, and deliver services to production with speed, safety, and reliability. As a mid-senior individual contributor, you will be part of a collaborative team of five engineers reporting to the team engineering manager.

You will play a key role in delivering our environments strategy, shifting Anaplan away from shared development environments toward reproducible, automated local and ephemeral environments.

As well as this, you will take ownership of the health of our remaining shared non-production environments, maintain our Argo CD deployment architecture, oversee secrets management using Vault, and establish resilient, code-driven governance for feature flagging that delivers lasting value.

  

**Your Impact...**

* **Empower engineering teams:** Collaborate in a cross-functional team to build and operate tools, frameworks, and platforms that improve developer experience, platform scalability, and security for hundreds of engineers
* **Shape the future of environments:** Contribute to the design, implementation, and roll-out of our next-generation environments strategy, helping transition engineering teams to automated, code-defined local and remote ephemeral environments
* **Champion environment health:** Take collective ownership of our non-production environments, ensuring platform service health and acting as a trusted first port of call for engineering support and troubleshooting
* **Scale deployment & configuration infrastructure:** Contribute to the maintenance and architectural evolution of our Argo CD deployment pipelines, secrets management infrastructure, and feature flagging capabilities
* **Evolve existing platform tooling:** Help maintain, refactor, and modernize our existing Go-based tools, APIs, and Kubernetes Operators to eliminate configuration toil and support new platform capabilities by elevating standards
* **Delivering measurable outcomes:** Act as a proactive self-starter who takes end-to-end ownership of your work through agile practices, planning, and road mapping, while participating in the team on-call rota

  

**Your Skills...**

* **Kubernetes:** Experience with Kubernetes in a production or pre-production environment
* **CD & GitOps:** Strong practical understanding of continuous delivery pipelines, GitOps workflows, and continuous deployment tooling (specifically **Argo CD**)
* **Platform-as-a-Product:** A passion for treating platform infrastructure as a product, focusing on improving Developer Experience, reducing cognitive load for engineers, and gathering feedback to build highly usable tools
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools, ideally Terraform
* **Secrets management:** Experience working with HashiCorp Vault or similar secrets management technologies
* **Resilience & quality mindset:** A focus on building fault-tolerant systems, backed by automated testing, golden templates, and clear developer documentation
* **Strong communication:** A collaborative mindset with the ability to provide clear guidance, support, best practices and articulate trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences

  

**Bonus Points for…**

* **Software engineering:** Hands-on development experience in Go (or a similar language)
* **Kubernetes operators:** Experience writing, testing, or maintaining Kubernetes Operators and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs)
* **Feature flagging:** Experience administering feature flagging platforms (such as LaunchDarkly)
* **Local development:** Experience designing local container-based development workflows
* **Observability:** Knowledge of observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Loki

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Privacy & AI** **Notice**

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Key Account Manager Q-Commerce – Ambient & Frozen -SM
description:
**Job Description**
Job Description – Key Account Manager (Q-Commerce – Ambient & Frozen)
  
  
Company: Sarya Holdings Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  
  
Department: Sales – Quick Commerce
  
  
Position: Key Account Manager (KAM) – Q-Commerce
  
  
Experience: 4–8 Years
  
  
**About The Company**
Sarya Holdings is an FMCG distribution group operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and India. In India, the company focuses on building and scaling Korean food brands, including Good Seoul, Samyang, OKF, and other partner brands.
  
  
The company operates across Quick Commerce, Modern Trade, and General Trade, with a strong presence on platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart Minutes, and Amazon Fresh.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Key Account Manager – Q-Commerce to manage and drive the overall business for both Ambient and Frozen product categories.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing national/platform-level sales, developing strong relationships with Quick Commerce platforms, driving business growth, improving product availability, managing listings, promotions, pricing, inventory, and ensuring operational excellence.
  
  
The role will involve managing both regular ambient products and temperature-sensitive frozen products, ensuring proper cold chain management, inventory control, and business expansion across platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Key Account & Business Management

Manage and grow business across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart Minutes, and Amazon Fresh.
  
  
Act as the primary point of contact for Quick Commerce platform central teams.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with platform category managers and key stakeholders.
  
  
Drive sales targets, revenue growth, account profitability, and business expansion.
  
  
Lead commercial negotiations, visibility packages, pricing discussions, and Joint Business Planning (JBP).
  
  

* Sales & Category Management – Ambient and Frozen

Drive sales growth across both Ambient and Frozen product categories.
  
  
Develop category-wise sales strategies and expansion plans.
  
  
Monitor primary and secondary sales performance across platforms.
  
  
Ensure product assortment, pricing, and availability across relevant platforms.
  
  
Identify opportunities for new product launches and category expansion.
  
  

* Availability & Inventory Management

Monitor daily product availability and stock levels across platforms.
  
  
Identify and resolve Out-of-Stock (OOS) issues.
  
  
Coordinate with supply chain and warehouse teams to ensure timely stock replenishment.
  
  
Maintain healthy inventory levels and minimize stock-outs and product expiry.
  
  
Prepare rolling forecasts and monitor forecast accuracy.
  
  

* Frozen Category & Cold Chain Management

Ensure proper cold chain compliance throughout transportation and storage.
  
  
Coordinate reefer dispatches, temperature monitoring, and cold chain documentation.
  
  
Manage freezer capacity at distribution centres (DCs) and dark stores.
  
  
Coordinate freezer allocation and infrastructure requirements with platform teams.
  
  
Handle temperature-related rejections and resolve operational issues.
  
  
Monitor FEFO (First Expiry, First Out), shelf life, ageing inventory, and expiry risks.
  
  

* Promotions, Listings & New Product Launches

Plan and execute promotional campaigns across Quick Commerce platforms.
  
  
Manage product listings, catalogue accuracy, pricing, and visibility.
  
  
Coordinate new product launches (NPD) and ensure timely platform onboarding.
  
  
Monitor promotional performance and analyse ROI.
  
  
Ensure promotional activities are aligned with stock availability and inventory requirements.
  
  

* Reporting & Analytics

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales and business performance reports.
  
  
Monitor platform-wise sales, availability, inventory, and category performance.
  
  
Track key business KPIs and identify improvement opportunities.
  
  
Conduct regular business reviews with management and platform partners.
  
  
Maintain dashboards and provide actionable business insights.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
4–8 years of experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, or food distribution sales.
  
  
Minimum 2+ years of direct experience managing Quick Commerce or E-commerce key accounts.
  
  
Hands-on experience with platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Amazon, or Flipkart.
  
  
Experience managing both Ambient and Frozen/Food categories will be highly preferred.
  
  
Strong understanding of sales growth, account management, commercial negotiations, and category management.
  
  
Knowledge of inventory management, forecasting, product availability, and supply chain operations.
  
  
Understanding of cold chain logistics, temperature-controlled storage, and frozen product handling.
  
  
Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel and familiarity with Power BI, GobbleCube, or platform dashboards.
  
  
Ability to manage platform relationships and independently drive business targets.
  
  
Graduate degree required; MBA or Supply Chain qualification preferred.
  
  
**Preferred Industry Background**
Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:
  
  
FMCG and Food & Beverage
  
  
Frozen Foods and Frozen Snacks
  
  
Dairy and Ice Cream
  
  
Ready-to-Eat and Packaged Foods
  
  
Food Distribution and Supply Chain
  
  
Quick Commerce and E-commerce
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Overall sales growth and revenue achievement.
  
  
Product availability across Quick Commerce platforms.
  
  
Fill rate and inventory management.
  
  
Dark store coverage and distribution expansion.
  
  
Promotion execution and sales performance.
  
  
Forecast accuracy and stock planning.
  
  
Listing accuracy and new product launches.
  
  
Cold chain compliance and frozen product availability.
  
  
Reduction in stock-outs, rejections, and expiry-related losses.
  
  
Platform relationship management and business development.

title: account manager IV
description:
**Job Summary**
Field sales executive focused on customers to achieve revenue and margin goals in assigned accounts. Identifies customer needs and applies company’s value proposition to drive sales growth and improved profitability. Develops strategic relationships and aligns customer and business goals, creating and managing a business and execution plan for shared success among the customer, vendor partners and the company.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Serves as the primary point of contact for the customer interface to the company's resources that drives and supports high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty, as measured in surveys and share of wallet.
* Develops strong, strategic relationships with customer(s) to identify and leverage the customers’ business goals, growth strategies and profit drivers to deliver the appropriate business value proposition sales solution strategy.
* Provides leadership and guidance in critical customer planning and engagement.
* Performs critical customer analysis to identify and leverage the partner’s marketing programs to achieve growth in their customer’s solutions capability.
* Engages customer(s) in joint planning that integrates the company's services, programs and supplier partnerships securing customer commitment for the development of a comprehensive investment in strategies that advance the company’s market position, entanglement and financial goals
* Conducts regular business reviews with assigned accounts to track progress toward revenue and growth goals and owns execution of business plan.
* Maintains and monitors pipeline and metrics for assigned customers, performs analysis and identifies improvement opportunities.
* Supports supplier's strategies by aligning solutions with customer to maximize profitable growth, and customer expansion.
* Prioritize customers and opportunities with greatest potential for success.
* Closely manages profitability by minimizing profit leaks and maximizing gross profit.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Job Level Specifications**

* Deep understanding of business, financials, products/services, the market or the needs/challenges of assigned accounts. Requires depth and/or breadth of sales expertise within a specialized product, service or account type. Requires a deep understanding of the full range of offerings that the organization and its competitors sell and that assigned customers buy. Recognized as a technical expert (by colleagues and customers) in one or several product/service areas.
* Complexity is extremely high (territory/account, products/services, sales or account management process); serves as team lead. Plans own territory or account approach and has input into colleagues' approaches; manages own and often others' resources. Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgement and identify innovative sales solutions.
* Leads sales teams on negotiations to identify, pursue or manage accounts/ opportunities with extremely large size/strategic importance/risk of loss. Develops colleagues' understanding; acts as a role model for colleagues with less experience. Has extremely high authority/opportunity to set and negotiate product/service terms. Plans own territory or account approach and has input into colleagues' approaches; manages own and often others' resources.
* Serves as consultant to management and/or internal/external spokesperson for the organization on major initiatives related to policies, plans and long-range objectives. Impacts the relationship the organization has with its leading clients
* Impacts the relationship the organization has with its leading clients. Leads sales that have a significant impact on the function/region/division. Actions may impact the organization and its reputation. Effects of erroneous decisions may be long-lasting, influence the future course of the organization and/or require the expenditure of extensive additional resources.

* Minimum experience required is typically 8+ years with bachelor's or equivalent. This is typically the most senior sales position in the company and is reserved for the most experienced sales professionals.

* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

title: Sr Product Mgr I
description:
**Sr Product Mgr I**

  

**Are you keen to develop your Product Management career?**

  

**Would you enjoy working on our cutting-edge products?**

  

**About the Team**

Mercury is RX’s global registration and eCommerce platform, supporting the journeys that bring visitors and exhibitors to our events. It covers registration, purchasing, badging, and onsite access, connecting customer experiences with the data and business systems behind them. Our Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Success, and regional business teams work together to deliver reliable services, better customer experiences, and measurable business value.

  

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with strong communication, influencing, and product judgment skills who can build effective relationships across a complex, international business. You’ll help shape our registration and eCommerce capabilities by turning customer insights and business needs into prioritized opportunities and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Initially, you’ll have a significant role in go-to-market activity and business-unit engagement, working with regional teams to understand needs, assess readiness, remove adoption barriers, and support successful rollouts. As our operating model evolves, Product Success will take on more ongoing rollout coordination and day-to-day business engagement. You’ll help enable that transition, creating more capacity for product discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, and continuous improvement while remaining closely connected to customers and stakeholders and retaining responsibility for product decisions within your remit. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how products work in practice and using that insight to decide what should change and why.

  

**Responsibilities (What you’ll do)**

  

**Discover opportunities and shape product direction**

* Build a deep understanding of visitor, exhibitor, and event-team needs through research, stakeholder conversations, product data, and live-event observation.
* Look beyond feature requests to uncover underlying problems, test assumptions, and distinguish local needs from opportunities with broader value.
* Assess opportunities across registration, eCommerce, and related journeys, including improvements that support revenue growth, customer experience, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations and proportionate business cases that clearly explain benefits, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Own and maintain a prioritized opportunity backlog for your area and contribute to the broader product strategy and roadmap.
  

  

**Turn priorities into measurable improvements**

* Partner with Design, Engineering, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to translate validated opportunities into clear outcomes, scope, and requirements.
* Balance customer value and business priorities with technical feasibility, operational readiness, and the needs of a shared global platform.
* Work with adjacent product and business-system teams to manage dependencies across end-to-end journeys.
* Partner with Product Analytics to define success measures, establish baselines, and evaluate releases and experiments.
* Use launch results, customer feedback, and product performance to refine priorities and continuously improve the product.
  

  

**Partner with business units on rollout and adoption**

* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across registration, marketing, commercial, and event teams.
* Initially lead agreed product-engagement forums to clarify priorities, communicate roadmap decisions, and maintain visibility of adoption barriers and dependencies.
* Assess how well existing capabilities meet event requirements and determine whether process changes, configuration, or product development is the right response.
* Work with Product Success and delivery teams on launch readiness, pilots, and adoption plans, helping teams understand available capabilities and required business changes.
* Provide product input on significant issues through established support and escalation processes, ensuring recurring problems drive product improvements rather than repeated workarounds.
* Communicate decisions, constraints, and next steps clearly without committing ahead of discovery or delivery agreement.
  

  

**Help build a scalable Product–Product Success partnership**

* Establish clear responsibilities, decision-making boundaries, and feedback loops across Product, Product Success, and business units.
* Support the phased transfer of agreed go-to-market and stakeholder-coordination activities through shared documentation, knowledge transfer, and joint working.
* Maintain continuity for business units as responsibilities evolve, pacing handovers to agreed readiness and capacity.
* Equip Product Success colleagues with clear product context, value propositions, and guidance, while using their adoption insights to inform discovery.
* Retain ownership of product priorities and outcomes within your remit as more day-to-day engagement and coordination moves to Product Success.
  

**Requirements (What you’ll bring)**

* Experience managing digital products or a clearly defined product area, from problem discovery and opportunity prioritization through delivery and evaluation.
* Evidence of improvements that delivered customer or business outcomes, rather than simply completed features or project milestones.
* Strong discovery and analytical skills, including the ability to combine qualitative and quantitative evidence and recognize data limitations.
* Sound prioritization and commercial judgment, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, explain trade-offs, and constructively say “not yet.”
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams in an agile product-development environment.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, including influencing across functions and balancing regional needs with global product goals.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences, plus a practical understanding of rollout, adoption, and business change.
* The ability to learn complex workflows and integrations, navigate ambiguity, and stay focused on the highest-value problems.
  

**Useful, but not essential**

* Experience with registration, ticketing, eCommerce, payments, or other transaction-based digital products.
* Experience with global platforms serving multiple markets, business units, or customer groups.
* Familiarity with products connected to finance, CRM, identity, marketing, or reporting systems.
* Experience working with Product Success, Customer Success, or implementation teams on launches, adoption, and structured handovers.
* Experience with experimentation, conversion optimization, product analytics, or digital revenue growth.
* Experience in events or other time-critical environments where reliability and operational readiness are essential.
  

**What success looks like**

* Clear, evidence-based product priorities balancing customer needs, business value, and platform scalability.
* Product improvements with defined outcomes and measurable impact.
* Business units that understand product direction, adoption requirements, and the rationale behind decisions.
* Successful rollout and adoption of agreed capabilities, with risks and dependencies identified early.
* A sustainable partnership with Product Success, with responsibilities transferred progressively and without gaps in business engagement.
* More capacity for proactive discovery and continuous improvement, supported by strong customer and business insight.
  

**Why join us?**

You’ll work on a business-critical global platform with a direct connection to real customer experiences. The role combines hands-on business engagement with end-to-end product management, giving you the opportunity to shape both the product and how its value reaches customers.

  

**Work in a Way That Works for You**

We support a healthy work-life balance and flexible ways of working. Wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals can help you meet both immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.

  

**Working for You**

Your wellbeing is central to a long and successful career. Benefits include:

* Comprehensive health insurance for you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced health insurance options at company-negotiated rates.
* Group life insurance.
* Group accident insurance covering accidental death and permanent disability.
* Flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program for personal and work-related support.
* Medical screening.
* Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long-service awards.
* New baby gift.
* Subsidized meals in Chennai.
* Paid time off, including Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
  

**About the Business**

RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, using industry expertise, data, and technology to help individuals, communities, and organizations build their businesses. Operating in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events each year and is committed to an inclusive workplace. RX is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. For more information, visit http://www.rxglobal.com

We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1-855-833-5120.
