title: Client Relationship Manager (EdTech)
description:
**About Bytego AI & CampusHub AI**
At Bytego AI, we build intelligent solutions that solve real-world institutional challenges. Our flagship EdTech product, CampusHub AI, is transforming how schools manage operations, academics, and student engagement through seamless automation and AI-driven insights.
  
We are looking for a dynamic Client Relationship Manager to be the face of CampusHub AI—bridging the gap between visionary school leaders and our product team to drive both adoption and long-term success.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Client Relationship Manager, you will play a dual role in driving growth and ensuring customer success. You will spearhead outreach to prospective K-12 schools and educational institutions to expand CampusHub AI’s footprint, while nurturing strong, lasting relationships with our existing partner schools. Additionally, you will work closely with our Product Specialists to ensure every new school experiences a smooth, stress-free onboarding journey.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
1. School Outreach & Business Development
  
\* Identify, prospect, and initiate outreach to new schools, educational trusts, and decision-makers (Principals, Directors, Trustees, and IT Heads).
  
\* Pitch CampusHub AI’s value proposition clearly and schedule product demonstrations.
  
\* Manage the outreach pipeline from initial contact to deal closure in collaboration with the sales and product teams.
  
2. Client Relationship Management & Retention
  
\* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for existing partner schools using CampusHub AI.
  
\* Conduct regular check-ins and quarterly review meetings with school management to assess satisfaction, gather feedback, and ensure high platform adoption.
  
\* Proactively resolve client escalations, address queries, and identify opportunities for account expansion or renewals.
  
3. Onboarding & Product Coordination
  
\* Partner directly with Product Specialists during the transition from signed contract to active implementation.
  
\* Assist in coordinating data collection, stakeholder alignment, and training schedules with school staff to ensure timely onboarding.
  
\* Translate unique school requirements to the Product Specialist and engineering teams to ensure the platform is configured accurately for each institution.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
\* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in Client Servicing, Account Management, B2B Sales, or Business Development—preferably within the EdTech, SaaS, or education sector.
  
\* Industry Network: Familiarity with how school ecosystems operate; an existing network of K-12 school leaders is a strong plus.
  
\* Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills with the confidence to engage top-level school administrators.
  
\* Collaborative Mindset: Ability to coordinate smoothly with internal technical/product specialists and non-technical school staff alike.
  
\* Tech-Savvy: Comfort with CRM tools, product workflows, and explaining AI/SaaS concepts in simple, relatable terms.
  
  
**Why Join Bytego AI?**
\* High-Impact Product: Work on a cutting-edge AI product that directly modernizes education management.
  
\* Growth Trajectory: High ownership role with direct visibility into company growth and client strategy.
  
\* Collaborative Culture: Work alongside an agile, supportive team of AI builders, product specialists, and educators.
  
  
📩
**How to Apply:**
Apply directly via LinkedIn or send your resume to rakesh.kokkirala@bytego.ai with the subject line "Application – CRM (CampusHub AI)".

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title:**
Relationship Manager – Talent Operations & Experience

**Experience:**
6-8 years in talent acquisition, recruitment operations, HR business partnering, or a related function

**Reporting To:**
[Head of HR / Head of TA, to be confirmed]

**Role Summary**

This role owns the operational effectiveness and experience quality of the Talent Acquisition practice and extends that experience through a new joiner's first 90 days in the organization. You will work closely with the Head of HR, Delivery Heads, and cross-functional teams, and act as the connecting layer between recruiters, clients, hiring managers, candidates, and new employees.

You will also serve as the dedicated buddy to every new joiner (approximately 3-5 per month), helping them settle in, stay engaged, and become productive quickly.

The role focuses on recruitment operations, experience management, and process excellence. It does not involve direct recruitment delivery (sourcing and closing roles) or HR operations such as payroll, policy administration, or compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Process and Operational Discipline***

* Define, document, and enforce standard recruitment processes and best practices across the TA practice
* Monitor adherence, flag deviations, and drive corrective action with recruiters and delivery teams
* Maintain trackers, dashboards, and MIS covering pipeline health, turnaround times, and bottlenecks

***Leadership and Cross-Functional Partnership***

* Partner with the Head of HR and Delivery Heads to align hiring priorities, capacity, and timelines
* Provide regular reporting and insights to leadership on TA performance, new joiner experience, risks, and improvement areas
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Finance, Onboarding, IT, Admin) to ensure smooth offer, documentation, and joining processes
* Escalate delays or blockers to the right stakeholders, including directly to Delivery Heads where process is not followed, and track resolution

***Interview Coordination and Feedback***

* Oversee interview scheduling between candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers
* Drive timely feedback from clients and hiring managers, escalating delays as needed
* Track interview-to-feedback turnaround and report on trends

***Client and Stakeholder Management***

* Act as a point of contact for clients and hiring managers on process, status, and follow-ups
* Run regular check-ins and reviews to capture feedback and strengthen relationships
* Ensure stakeholder commitments (feedback, decisions, availability) are met

***Candidate Experience and Offer-to-Joining Engagement***

* Maintain consistent, proactive communication with candidates at every stage
* Own candidate engagement from offer to joining, including regular touchpoints, resolving concerns, and reducing dropout risk
* Gather candidate feedback and use it to improve the experience

***New Joiner Buddy and Onboarding Support***

* Act as the dedicated first point of contact and buddy for every new employee through their first 90 days
* Welcome new joiners on Day 1 and personally guide them through introductions to teams, leaders, tools, and ways of working
* Run structured check-ins (Day 1, Week 1, Day 30, 60, 90) and maintain a tracker of each joiner's progress and any open concerns
* Coordinate with managers, HR, and cross-functional teams to close onboarding gaps (access, equipment, documentation, role clarity)
* Capture feedback on the hiring and onboarding experience and feed it into process improvements
* Flag early attrition risks to the Head of HR and relevant Delivery Heads
* Receive backup support from HR during peak hiring periods

***Accountability and Continuous Improvement***

* Drive clear ownership and accountability across recruiters and stakeholders
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to efficiency and experience
* Run periodic reviews with TA and HR leadership and share best practices

**Key Outcomes (with suggested metrics)**

* Standardized operations: process adherence rate, fewer missed follow-ups
* Stronger engagement: client and candidate satisfaction (CSAT/NPS)
* Interview discipline: feedback turnaround (e.g., within 48 hours), fewer reschedules and no-shows
* Higher joining conversion: offer-to-join ratio, fewer offer dropouts
* Smoother onboarding: 100% of new joiners covered by the buddy program, with new joiner satisfaction score and Day 1 readiness (access, equipment, documentation)
* Early retention: reduced attrition within the first 90 days
* Operational efficiency: time-to-hire, pipeline velocity
* Leadership visibility: timely, accurate MIS and review reports.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work without direct authority
* Empathy, approachability, and the ability to build trust quickly with new employees
* Comfort presenting data and recommendations to leadership
* Detail-oriented, structured, with strong follow-through
* Working knowledge of ATS/recruitment tools, trackers, and reporting
* Understanding of the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle and onboarding practices
* Graduate or postgraduate degree; HR or business specialization preferred

**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- SailPoint IIQ Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

title: Oracle Cloud SCM Order Management Lead
description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
  
Peloton is seeking an Oracle Cloud SCM Workstream Lead with deep expertise in Order Management to support large-scale Oracle Cloud implementations. This role is responsible for leading the Order Management workstream, driving solution design, and ensuring successful delivery aligned with client business objectives. As an Order Management Lead, you will partner with supply chain, fulfillment, and finance stakeholders to design and implement solutions that optimize order capture, orchestration, fulfillment, and customer experience.
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
Workstream Leadership & Delivery
  
- Lead the Order Management workstream across the full project lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
  
- Own solution design, configuration, and delivery for Oracle Order Management Cloud
  
- Manage workstream scope, risks, issues, and dependencies
  
Process Assessment & Solution Design
  
- Assess current-state order-to-cash (O2C) processes and identify improvement opportunities
  
- Design future-state Order Management solutions aligned with Oracle Cloud best practices
  
- Define and refine business processes across areas such as:- Order capture and entry
  
- Order orchestration and fulfillment
  
- Pricing and discounting
  
- Shipping, fulfillment, and returns (RMA)
  
  
Requirements Gathering & Configuration
  
- Lead workshops to gather and document business requirements
  
- Translate requirements into functional designs and Oracle Cloud configurations
  
- Configure Order Management Cloud capabilities, including:- Order orchestration and fulfillment flows
  
- Pricing strategies and rules
  
- Shipping and fulfillment integration points
  
  
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
- Partner with Inventory, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Finance teams to ensure end-to-end O2C process alignment
  
- Ensure seamless integration with:- Inventory and fulfillment execution
  
- Accounts Receivable and billing
  
- Pricing and revenue recognition processes
  
  
Client Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement
  
- Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders on Order Management transformation and best practices
  
- Communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences
  
- Provide recommendations to improve spend control, compliance, and operational efficiency
  
Testing, Deployment & Support
  
- Lead testing activities (SIT/UAT), including scenario design and validation
  
- Support deployment, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization
  
Practice Development
  
- Contribute to continuous improvement of Peloton methodologies, accelerators, and intellectual property
  
- Mentor junior team members and support capability development
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience:
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  
  
- 7+ years of experience in Oracle SCM Cloud implementations
  
  
- Strong functional expertise in Oracle Order Management Cloud
  
  
- Experience with key Order Management capabilities, including:
  
- Order orchestration and fulfillment
  
  
- Pricing and discounting
  
  
- Shipping and logistics coordination
  
  
- Returns and reverse logistics (RMA)
  
  
  
- Experience leading at least one full lifecycle Oracle Cloud implementation
  
  
- Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes and best practices
  
  
- Understanding of financial integration points, including billing and Accounts Receivable
  
  
- Ability to translate business requirements into system configurations and solutions
  
  
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  
  
- Ability to work independently in a remote, client-facing environment
  
  
- Alignment with Peloton values: Amplify Ideas, Can-Do Attitude, Teamwork, Integrity, Own Your Voice, and Next-Level Service
  
  
- Willingness to travel as required
  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
- Oracle Cloud Order Management certification
  
  
- Experience across additional SCM modules (e.g., Inventory, Procurement, Manufacturing, Pricing)
  
  
- Experience with complex fulfillment scenarios (e.g., drop ship, back-to-back orders, global order promising)
  
  
- Experience supporting multi-pillar Oracle Cloud implementations (ERP + SCM)
  
  
- Experience mentoring junior team members
  
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including:
  
  
- Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus
  
  
- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
  
- Annual Health Wallet
  
  
- Group Medical Insurance
  
  
- Group Term Accident & Life Insurance
  
  
- Paid holidays and PTO
  
  
  
Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

* Own escalations on Technical Services engagements: make sure each is acknowledged fast, agree an action plan with the Customer Success owner within one business day, drive the fix with the delivery team, write the daily update until it closes, and lead the root-cause review.
* Hold scope with care: review every scope sign-off before it goes out, run change control, and route new requests into a new, approved scope.
* Keep the engagement tracker as the single source of truth: milestones, hours against estimate, QA status, service levels and a risk log. Flag an engagement the day it turns amber.
* Work side by side with the Support delivery teams to match work to capacity and keep hand-offs to US and EMEA colleagues clean across time zones.
* Work inside the Customer Success relationship: the CSM or Onboarding Manager owns the customer, the agenda and every invitation. On your engagements and your escalations, you are the one Technical Services voice, on the account thread and on the calls they set.
* Report performance: monthly business unit scorecards, service levels and trends, and inputs to executive and board updates.
* Improve the engagement model: templates, playbooks, SalesForce views, tracker automation and retrospectives. Propose rule changes through change control.
* Support each business unit's launch of Technical Services: engagement setup, tracker lines and the weekly interlock.
* Partner with Support and Engineering when a product defect surfaces in an engagement, through the Jira escalation lane.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Candidate Traits**

* Calm and decisive in an escalation. You own the problem until it is closed and keep everyone informed without being asked.
* Confident on a US customer call from India: clear, direct English, equally credible with a marketing leader who doubts the numbers and analytics engineer who owns the integration.
* Holds scope firmly and kindly. Accommodate scope changes as necessary.
* Process discipline without bureaucracy. The tracker is always current, and every status report fits on one page.
* Influence without authority: you move work through delivery leads, CSMs and customer teams in three regions.
* Sense of urgency.
* Data-driven. You run the portfolio on the scorecard and spot the trend before it becomes an escalation.
* Service mindset: additional hands and eyes on Customer Success's side, never a second track for the customer.

**Background**

* 7 to 12 years of experience, including at least 4 years in customer-facing program, implementation or engagement management at a B2B SaaS product company.
* A record of running 15 or more concurrent engagements for US or EMEA customers against scope, timelines, hours and acceptance criteria, with oversight of a larger portfolio.
* Escalation management with US enterprise customers, alongside Customer Success and account teams, including executive-level communication.
* Technical fluency in marketing and analytics technology: Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, Google Search Console, single sign-on, APIs and data validation. SEO, Martech or AI search platform experience is a strong plus.
* Tools: Zendesk or Freshdesk, Salesforce, Jira, and Excel, Google Sheets or BI for reporting.
* Excellent spoken and written English: leading a call with a customer's leadership, and writing scope documents, status reports and executive summaries.
* Bachelors Degres or an equivalent degree; an MBA or PMP is a plus.

BrightEdge is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of every background.

title: IT.JuniorInformation SystemSecurity Officer
description:
**About Citco:**

Armed with superior services, smart people, and strong technology, we tackle our customers’ complicated challenges by developing sophisticated solutions driven directly by their demands. The result? Innovation that generates tangible value and makes a real difference for our clients and their companies.

Junior Information Systems Security Officer (Junior ISSO)

**Reports to:** Manager or Senior ISSO

**Role type:** Permanent, Full‑time

**Overview**  
Junior Information Systems Security Officers (Junior ISSO) will support access governance for production applications under Citco’s User Access Management (UAM) and Role‑Based Group (RBAG) process. The Junior ISSO will assist with access reviews, onboarding/offboarding of applications to Citco’s Intake/Outtake/RBAG process, monitoring production application access, and remediation activities while operating in a second‑line, check‑and‑challenge capacity.

**Key responsibilities**

* Support access governance processes: review access requests and approvals for production applications governed by Citco’s User Access Management and RBAG process.
* Assist with client access certification campaigns and review of AD security groups.
* Monitor application access records and escalate anomalies.
* Develop and run basic scripts or queries to detect access issues.
* Validate provisioning actions against approved access and liaise with provisioning teams to resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate documentation for access controls and remediation activities.
* Support audit and compliance requests.
* Participate in onboarding new applications to Citco’s User Access Management and RBAG process.
* Attend meetings with business and technical stakeholders; capture actions and owners.

**Required skills & experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, or equivalent experience preferred.
* Minimum 2 years’ experience in IT, IAM, access governance, or related operational roles (e.g., provisioning, service desk, systems support).
* Basic understanding of RBAC (Role‑Based Access Control) / RBAG (Role‑Based Access Group), the least‑privilege principle, and segregation of duties (SoD).
* Strong attention to detail, good documentation skills, and process orientation.
* Presentation skills — able to communicate clearly to technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Basic scripting or query skills (SQL, Python, or PowerShell, ACL) are desirable.
* Familiarity with IAM tools or access‑certification platforms is a plus.
* Team player — collaborative, flexible, and able to work effectively with cross‑functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in a second‑line assurance role.
* Good stakeholder and communication skills; ability to follow directions and escalate appropriately.

**Certifications (Additional desirable skills)**

* CIA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, or other relevant security certifications.

**Working hours / conditions**

* Role requires shifting work hours to cover cross‑region support; flexibility for occasional early/late shifts or participation in an on‑call rota may be required.

May require participation in cross‑region meetings and occasional after‑hours support.

  

**Our Benefits**

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

title: Senior Security Engineer Manager
description:
**Overview**

The Cloud & AI organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. Microsoft is one of the largest enterprise service companies in the world.

Security represents one of the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. The Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is accountable for managing and prioritizing cybersecurity risks for Microsoft. This team oversees the company’s overall cyber defense, including the security of Microsoft products and business operations, and collaborates with Engineering teams to advance Secure Future Initiative (SFI) objectives.

Security is a core priority for Microsoft, and Identity and Access Management protections are essential to protecting Microsoft at global scale.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing team of Software Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) building and operating secure, scalable, cloud-native services and platforms that strengthen endpoint security and protect Microsoft’s enterprise environment. This role combines technical and people leadership to drive platform engineering, endpoint protection, service reliability, security automation, and AI-enabled engineering practices while improving security posture, operational resilience, and engineering productivity.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of Software Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers building secure, scalable services and platforms for endpoint protection, device management, security operations, and enterprise security.
* Define the engineering vision, technical strategy, and architecture for endpoint security platforms spanning policy enforcement, application governance, vulnerability management, device health, security telemetry, and automated threat response.
* Drive the development of scalable, automated security capabilities that translate security policies into enforceable controls, govern application trust and privileged access, and continuously improve endpoint security posture.
* Lead vulnerability and patch management engineering, enabling risk-based prioritization, automated remediation, and measurable reduction of security exposure across enterprise environments.
* Drive automated threat containment and response capabilities that enable timely remediation, limit security incident impact, and improve organizational resilience.
* Establish and evolve site reliability engineering practices, including service-level objectives (SLOs), availability, capacity planning, resilience engineering, production readiness, and systematic reduction of operational toil for mission-critical services.
* Partner across engineering, product, identity, security, infrastructure, and operations teams to translate security requirements into integrated platform capabilities and drive execution across organizational boundaries.
* Drive execution across multiple engineering investments by managing technical priorities, dependencies, resources, and delivery commitments while balancing long-term platform strategy with near-term business objectives.
* Build an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture by attracting, developing, and mentoring exceptional talent while empowering engineers to innovate, collaborate, take ownership, and grow.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years of technical engineering experience designing and building large-scale software systems, with coding experience in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, or C#. OR equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of people management experience leading engineering teams comprising Software Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), or both.
* Experience in endpoint security, vulnerability management, or related security engineering domains, including developing or operating capabilities that improve security posture, identify risks, or enable remediation.
* Experience implementing reliability engineering practices to improve service availability, resilience, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical, security, and operational requirements into scalable engineering solutions with measurable outcomes.
* Demonstrated success driving cross-organizational engineering initiatives, managing competing priorities, and aligning technical execution with business objectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years of technical engineering experience.
* + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 10+ years of technical engineering experience.
  + OR equivalent experience.
* 6+ years of people management experience, including leading multiple engineering teams.
* Experience building enterprise-scale endpoint security, identity, device management, application governance, vulnerability management, or security automation solutions.
* Experience building and operating enterprise-scale endpoint security and vulnerability management solutions, including risk-based prioritization, patching, remediation automation, and security posture improvement.
* Experience building enterprise-scale identity, device management, application governance, security automation, or related security platforms.
* Experience establishing advanced reliability and operational excellence practices, including service-level objectives (SLOs), observability, telemetry, incident management, and automated recovery.
* Experience integrating AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, or data-driven engineering practices into the software development lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to influence long-term engineering strategy and build partnerships across engineering, product, security, identity, and infrastructure organizations.

Proven track record of developing engineering talent, building inclusive teams, and improving engineering effectiveness across multiple teams.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Business - External Integrations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you energized by building technology that makes life easier for business customers? Do you want to work at the center of enterprise commerce, connecting Amazon Business with the procurement, ERP, and finance systems that organizations run on? Would you thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, start-up-like environment? If you answered yes to any of these, the Amazon Business System Integrations team is the place for you.  
  
We are building the systems integrations capabilities that let business customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. This includes APIs, protocols, and partner connections that make procurement faster, more automated, and more reliable at global scale. Our teams design, launch, and operate these integrations with a wide range of partners, and each launch has to work securely and seamlessly across many different systems, regions, and customer needs.  
  
The Amazon Business System Integrations team shares a passion for innovation, a love of solving complex challenges, and a desire to make a meaningful difference for customers. We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy solving hard problems at scale, and do well in a start-up-like environment.  
  
We need a versatile, curious, and motivated Technical Program Manager to drive complex, cross-functional programs from concept to launch. You will partner with software engineers, product managers, scientists, and external partners to define scope, align stakeholders, manage dependencies and risks, and deliver high-quality integrations on schedule. You will build the mechanisms that keep programs on track, such as clear roadmaps, metrics, and operational reviews, and you will communicate status and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders.
  
  
If you are passionate about pioneering new technology, bringing structure to ambiguous problems, and delivering results for customers, we want to talk to you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You will own delivery of integration programs that connect Amazon Business with customer and partner procurement and ERP systems. That means defining scope, goals, and success metrics, building the roadmap, and keeping engineering, product, and partner teams aligned from kickoff through launch.  
  
You will work closely with software engineers, product managers, and external partners to turn business needs into clear technical requirements. You'll understand the architecture well enough to question designs, flag risks, and help teams decide between approaches on APIs, security, and scalability.  
  
You will manage dependencies, schedules, and risks across several teams. This includes running weekly status meetings and monthly business reviews, tracking open issues, and escalating blockers early with a clear recommendation.  
  
You will define and track metrics such as partner onboarding time, adoption, error rates, and reliability, and use them to prioritize fixes. You'll also make sure each launch is operationally ready, with runbooks, monitoring, and support handoffs in place.  
  
At the L6 level, you are expected to lead complex programs with little oversight, write clear program documents and updates for senior leaders, mentor other program managers, and improve team processes over time.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Business System Integrations team connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner systems. We are driving API based shopping, protocols and agentic interactions.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

Volody is a global provider of AI-powered Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) software that helps enterprises and legal professionals digitize and automate their contract processes. Its configurable, cloud-based platform centralizes contracts from multiple repositories, turning static legacy documents into strategic business assets. The solution enables teams to track renewal dates, obligations, and key terms, while proactively identifying risky clauses and streamlining workflows and digital signatures. * Prior experience in implementation or consulting roles within legal tech, CLM, or enterprise software in a similar on-site environment.

title: Manager – International Business & Market Expansion (Speciality Chemicals)
description:
**About CLYZO**

CLYZO is a fast-growing Pharma B2B platform backed by
**14+ years of industry expertise**
, helping pharmaceutical companies with reliable sourcing, manufacturing support, and supply chain solutions.

We are building a high-performance, entrepreneurial organization where ownership, innovation, and execution drive growth.

**As a Manager – International Business & Market Expansion, you will play a pivotal role in building CLYZO’s international business for its Specialty Chemicals portfolio.**

**This role goes beyond export sales—you will be responsible for identifying international opportunities, developing markets, launching products, building distributor and customer networks, and driving revenue growth across global markets.**

You will work closely with the Director and cross-functional teams to develop and execute CLYZO’s international expansion strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**International Business Development**

* Develop international sales strategies for Specialty Chemicals.
* Identify target markets, customers, distributors, and partners.
* Generate and convert export enquiries into business.
* Build and manage a strong international customer pipeline.
* Drive market expansion and new business opportunities.

**International Product Launch & Market Expansion**

* Plan and execute international product launches.
* Identify market opportunities, competition, pricing, and regulatory requirements.
* Develop market-entry strategies for new countries.
* Drive product expansion and market penetration across international markets.

**Export Sales & Commercial Operations**

* Manage the end-to-end export sales cycle from enquiry to payment.
* Handle quotations, pricing, negotiations, and customer relationships.
* Coordinate with Production, Quality, Logistics, Regulatory, and Finance for order execution.
* Ensure timely export documentation, shipments, and receivables.

**Market Intelligence & Strategy**

* Research international markets, competitors, pricing, and regulations.
* Identify high-potential markets and product opportunities.
* Develop market-wise business and expansion strategies.
* Track market trends, sales performance, and growth opportunities.

**Distributor & Partner Management**

* Identify and develop international distributors, agents, and channel partners.
* Build and maintain long-term strategic partnerships.
* Set and monitor distributor targets and performance.
* Drive partner growth and corrective actions where required.

**Business Targets & Leadership**

* Own international sales, revenue, and business targets.
* Drive export processes and cross-functional execution.
* Represent CLYZO at international exhibitions and customer meetings.
* Prepare business forecasts, reports, and market updates.
* Work closely with the Director on global expansion initiatives.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or Business.
* 3–8 years’ experience in International Business, Export Sales, Pharma B2B, or Specialty Chemicals.
* Mandatory understanding of APIs, excipients, pharma raw materials, or specialty chemicals.
* Experience in international sales, distributor development, and market expansion preferred.
* Strong negotiation, communication, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Proficient in CRM, ERP, and MS Excel.
* Strong ownership and execution mindset suited to a fast-paced environment.
* Team management experience is an advantage.
* Preferred Age: 32–40 years

**We are looking for someone who is commercially driven, entrepreneurial, and execution-oriented—someone who can identify an international opportunity and take it from market research → product selection → market launch → customer acquisition → order conversion → repeat business.**

This is a
**high-impact leadership role**
where you will work closely with the Director and have the opportunity to shape CLYZO's international business strategy and global presence.

**If you enjoy building markets from scratch, developing international relationships, launching products globally, and taking complete ownership of business growth, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Ready to Build CLYZO's Global Business?**

Share your updated resume at
**hr@clyzo.com**

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**Overview**
Cactus Life Sciences partners with the global biopharma industry to drive innovation and elevate patient outcomes through agile, science-driven medical communications. We transform complex data into actionable insights, bridging the critical gaps between research, decision-making, and real-world healthcare impact. As a growing scientific communications agency, we are seeking a Senior Account Manager who will be responsible for managing accounts and standard projects independently, ensuring they are completed on budget, on schedule, and to the required specifications.
  
  
We are a remote-first organization, and we embrace an "accelerate from anywhere culture". You may be required to travel based on business requirements or for company/team events.
  
  
**Please Note:**
You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events (Use this option 1 when the position does not require travel to home office/client site). However, given the business requirements of this role, you are expected to frequently travel to our Mumbai office/location office (Use this option 2 for positions which require travel to office/client site). For this critical role, we are looking for the candidate to be based in Mumbai. You may choose to work from home in Mumbai; however, you will be required to travel to our Andheri East office once a week for business requirements, meetings, or company/team events, or on short notice as needed, (Use this option 3 when looking for a candidate based in Mumbai)
  
  
Insert an overview of the role, for eg who this role will be working with, function etc.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Client relationship accountability
  
  

* Understand client objectives, adapt to their working style, and ensure all deliverables align with client expectations
* Proactively identify challenges and delivery risks, implementing solutions and corrective measures to strengthen partnerships and optimise outcomes
* Lead and support strategic, complex projects across therapeutic areas using compelling storytelling and impactful visual conceptualization
* Encourage client feedback to drive improvement, and present new initiatives to stakeholders when appropriate

Workflows
  
  

* Ensure a seamless client experience and drive timely project closure to boost productivity
* Review deliverables to ensure alignment with client objectives and monitor timelines to ensure on-schedule delivery
* Lead project kick-off and client calls, share scopes and MoMs promptly, and conduct debriefs to capture and implement learnings
* Maintain regular communication and take relevant actions with third parties that influence deliverables, such as congress secretariats

Project status and governance
  
  

* Lead project status meetings with accurate reporting to ensure alignment with client objectives
* Support governance reporting with the Account Director through monthly and quarterly reviews

Organic Growth
  
  

* Identify growth opportunities and support the Account Director with business forecasting

**Qualifications And Prerequisites**

* Education: Degree minimum (life science degree advantageous) or demonstrable experience in medical communications or pharmaceutical industry
* Experience: 2+ years’ experience as an Account Manager within healthcare communications agencies, predominantly in the medical affairs
* Business skills: Strong client relationship-building and business communication skills with experience in managing small accounts and executing global programs while ensuring client satisfaction and trust
* Business Acumen: Demonstrates strong understanding of medical communications, has knowledge of client environments and market dynamics, and makes strategic decisions that drive value for both the company and its clients
* Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills by building rapport across diverse personalities, presenting facts objectively, owning mistakes, and solving problems with excellence
* Technology skills: Microsoft Office suite (e.g., Microsoft Project), Adobe
* AI Adaptability: Shows an eagerness to learn and apply AI tools and technologies

Application Process
  
  
**Application Process**
Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. The selection process for this role includes an initial recruiter screening, two interviews with the hiring manager and peers, and HR interview rounds.
  
  
**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
  
  
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
  
  
We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
  
  
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**About CACTUS**
At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

At M&G our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. As an international savings and investments business with roots stretching back more than 170 years, we offer a range of financial products and services through Asset Management, Life and Wealth. All three operating segments work together to deliver attractive financial outcomes for our clients, and superior shareholder returns.
  
  
Through our behaviours of telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

This role is responsible for end-to-end oversight of NAV production, fund accounting, and financial reporting across M&G’s public markets fund range, covering a diverse range of structures and jurisdictions.
  
  
The role plays a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of fund reporting, safeguarding investor outcomes, and strengthening M&G’s risk and control environment within an operating model involving TPAs.
  
  
The position also contributes to the ongoing evolution of the fund accounting oversight framework, driving standardization, efficiency, and enhanced governance. It also builds relationships with TPAs and internal teams to uphold M&G’s risk and control framework across fund accounting, reporting and expense oversight
  
  
**Key Responsibilities/ Accountabilities:**

* Deliver robust NAV and financial reporting oversight across assigned funds, ensuring adherence to SLA timelines, accuracy thresholds, and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with onshore and offshore partners, including India based colleagues.
* Carry out BAU oversight across technical areas within financial reporting, fund accounting and NAV oversight.
* Act as a subject matter expert for fund accounting oversight, including Fund, Financial Reporting and Costs & Charges.
* Perform error and risk validation, analyse control failures, support remediation activity and contribute to Risk & Compliance investigations.
* Drive continuous improvement across processes, controls and oversight.
* Manage complex internal and external stakeholder queries.
* Build and maintain relationships with TPAs and internal partners.

**Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Educational Qualification**

* Strong technical expertise in fund accounting, NAV oversight, and financial reporting, with knowledge of regulations across key jurisdictions (UK, Ireland, Luxembourg).
* Solid understanding of public markets structures and asset classes (e.g.,UCITS, SICAVs, money market etc.).
* Experience working within an outsourced operating model, with the ability to effectively oversee and challenge third-party administrators (TPAs) and financial outputs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to assess NAV errors, control issues, and drive timely resolution.
* Proven ability to operate with independence, sound judgement, and accountability in a governance-driven environment.
* Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence TPAs, auditors, and internal teams.
* Focus on risk, controls, and continuous improvement, with the ability to identify gaps and strengthen oversight frameworks.
* Relevant accounting or finance qualification, with the ability to apply technical knowledge to support decision-making.

**Experience:**

* 8-10 years of experience in financial services. Min 5 years of experience in Fund accounting oversight or fund financial reporting oversight with at least 2–3 years in a supervisory or managerial role.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance. Professional certifications (e.g., CFA, CA, MBA Finance) are a plus.
* Relevant IOC or Investment Management qualification / Certification would be desirable.

**M&G Behaviours relevant to all roles:**

Respectfully speaking up to create better ways forward – both direct and empathetic

title: Risk & Quantitative Strats, Private Financing Solutions (PFS), Associate/Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
HPS Investment Partners is a credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offer the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients
  
  
**Position Description**
PFS is seeking an Associate/Vice President level individual to join our Risk & Quant Strat (RQS) team in Mumbai. The VP/Associate will support the day-to-day business-as-usual (BAU) operations of the Quant Credit pod within the Private Financing Solutions (PFS) Risk function. The role will help ensure that recurring credit analytics, portfolio monitoring and reporting processes are completed accurately and on schedule. A core focus will be data quality assurance through structured reconciliations, exception investigation, documentation and coordination with business, risk, data and technology stakeholders. The VP/Associate will also support business requests, process improvements and project delivery across private credit risk workflows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:
  
  
**BAU Operations & Process Execution**

* Execute and coordinate recurring Quant Credit pod processes, including data preparation, validation, portfolio monitoring and reporting activities.
* Maintain process calendars, checklists, trackers and operating documentation to ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
* Monitor daily and periodic workflows, identify exceptions or breaks, and coordinate timely follow-up with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Serve as a dependable point of contact for routine process questions, status updates and operational support.

**Data Quality Assurance & Reconciliations**

* Perform recurring reconciliations across source systems, databases, analytical outputs and reporting files to assess accuracy, completeness and consistency.
* Investigate data mismatches, missing records, stale inputs and other exceptions; document findings and support root-cause analysis and remediation.
* Maintain clear evidence of data checks, exceptions, resolutions and approvals to support control, governance and auditability requirements.
* Track data-quality issues and trends, escalate material exceptions, and follow through with business and technology teams until resolution.
* Support testing and validation of data changes, process enhancements and model or reporting updates before production use.

**Credit Analytics & Business Support**

* Support recurring credit-risk analytics and portfolio monitoring, including rating migration, downgrade-risk and related surveillance metrics.
* Prepare analyses, management information, presentation materials and status updates for business and risk stakeholders.
* Respond to ad hoc data and analytical requests by gathering requirements, validating outputs and communicating results clearly.
* Develop a practical understanding of private credit portfolios, underlying data, analytical methodologies and downstream reporting requirements

**Projects, Process Improvement & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Support projects from requirements gathering and planning through testing, implementation and post-launch monitoring.
* Coordinate actions, milestones, risks, dependencies and decisions using project-management tools such as Asana or JIRA.
* Work with business, risk, data and technology teams to translate operational needs into clear requirements and practical solutions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize or automate recurring workflows using Excel, SQL and, where applicable, Python.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, to streamline recurring workflows, reduce manual effort, identify and alleviate operational bottlenecks, and improve overall process efficiency.
* Prepare concise process documentation, user guides, meeting materials and presentations to support stakeholder alignment and adoption

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field;
* 3-6 years experience at Associate level and 7+ years experience for a VP in project management, process management, operations, data quality, risk analytics or a related business-support function.
* Working knowledge of statistics and credit-risk concepts, including rating migration and downgrade risk.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with practical experience using Python and SQL.
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency with project-management tools such as Asana or JIRA.
* Excellent coordination, written and verbal communication, and presentation skills.
* Strong organizational ability, attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and deliver with limited handholding.
* Hands-on experience with Python or another programming language preferred.
* Experience performing data reconciliations, investigating exceptions or supporting data-control frameworks preferred.
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, to improve process efficiency, automate repetitive tasks, and resolve operational bottlenecks preferred.
* Exposure to private credit, investment operations, risk management, credit analytics or financial-services data preferred.
* Experience supporting workflow automation, user acceptance testing, reporting enhancements or technology-enabled change preferred.
* CFA Charter holder preferred

**Location**
:
  
  

* Mumbai, India
* undefinedHybrid Work Schedule:4/1 split (Friday WFH)

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

description:
**About Credit Saison**
Established in 2019, Credit Saison India (CS India) is one of the country’s fastest growing Non-Bank Financial Company (NBFC) lenders, with verticals in wholesale, direct lending and tech-enabled partnerships with Non-Bank Financial Companies (NBFCs) and fintech's. Its tech-enabled model coupled with underwriting capability facilitates lending at scale, meeting India’s huge gap for credit, especially with underserved and under penetrated segments of the population.
  
  
Credit Saison India is committed to growing as a lender and evolving its offerings in India for the long-term for MSMEs, households, individuals and more. Credit Saison India is registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)and has an AAA rating from CRISIL (a subsidiary of S&P Global) and CARE Ratings.
  
  
Currently, Credit Saison India has a branch network of 80+physical offices,2.06 million active loans, an AUM of over US$2B and an employee base of about approx ~2000 employees.
  
  
Credit Saison India is part of Saison International, a global financial company with a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, creating resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact. Across its business arms of lending and corporate venture capital, Saison International is committed to being a transformative partner in creating opportunities and enabling the dreams of people.
  
  
Saison International is the international headquarters (IHQ)of Credit Saison Company Limited, founded in 1951 and one of Japan’s largest lending conglomerates with over 70 years of history and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The Company has evolved from a credit-card issuer to a diversified financial services provider across payments, leasing, finance, real estate and entertainment. Based in Singapore, Saison International’s global operations span over Singapore, India, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Mexico, Brazil, with active investments in debt, equity, corporate venture capital, and technology.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Revenue Assurance Manager will be responsible for end-to-end assurance of revenue streams, aiming to identify, analyze, and plug revenue leakages. This role involves rigorous reconciliation, system configuration validation, and reporting to senior management, ensuring income recognition is accurate and compliant with RBI regulations and Ind-AS standards.
  
  

* Identify and investigate anomalies, discrepancies, and leakage points across all product lines (Loan Against Property, MSME, Personal Loans, etc.).
* Analyze revenue data to plug leakages resulting from system bugs, incorrect interest configurations, fee waivers, or operational lapses.
* Perform root cause analysis of detected revenue gaps and work with Business/Tech teams to fix them.
* Oversee critical reconciliations between the Loan Management System (LMS) and the General Ledger (GL).
* Validate interest calculations, penal interest, processing fees, and other charges against customer contracts and company policy.
* Prepare detailed monthly revenue assurance dashboards, highlighting leakage metrics, recovery status, and risk areas for senior management.
* Monthly preparation & Review of partner book and reporting, Co-work with other team for reconciliation of transactions for partner payout at partner level.
* Prepare Financial Statements, Business Activity Reports and Financial Forecasts.
* Validate data integrity for regulatory reporting (e.g., RBI returns such as NBS-1, NBS-7).
* Analyze portfolio yield, net interest margins (NIM), and fee income trends.
* Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new products, system changes, or interest rate updates to ensure accurate revenue capture.
* Laisioning with auditors, external agencies, consultants and close end to end audits and activities.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Education: CA / MBA (Finance) preferred.
* Experience: 3–5 years of experience in Revenue Assurance, preferably in NBFC, Fintech, or Banking.
* Technical Skills: Advanced MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot tables, Macros) and strong experience with SQL for data extraction and analysis.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of Loan Lifecycles, Income Recognition, and RBI Guidelines for NBFCs.
* Attributes: Analytical mindset, high attention to detail, and ability to handle large data volumes.

title: Credit Controller
description:
The candidate will be responsible for improving collection efficiency, reducing overdue receivables, managing credit exposure and ensuring effective coordination with Sales, Operations and Finance teams to optimise working capital.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Accounts Receivable & Collection Management

* Monitor PAN India receivables, including domestic and overseas customers.
* Review outstanding balances, ageing reports and overdue accounts regularly.
* Drive timely collections and maintain Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) within established targets.
* Coordinate with Regional Heads, Sales teams and branch accountants for recovery of overdue payments.
* Conduct weekly collection review meetings and escalate critical overdue accounts to management.
* Ensure timely reconciliation of customer receipts against outstanding invoices.
* Identify long-outstanding balances and recommend corrective or recovery actions.

2. Customer Credit Risk Assessment

* Evaluate new and existing customers' creditworthiness through financial analysis, credit reports, payment history and trade references.
* Assess proposed credit limits, credit periods and overall customer exposure.
* Provide recommendations for approval, modification or rejection of credit requests in accordance with company policy.
* Review customer credit exposure periodically and identify potential defaults or high-risk accounts.
* Monitor adherence to approved credit terms and recommend credit holds or restrictions wherever required.
* Ensure timely processing of credit approval requests.

3. Cash Flow & Collection Forecasting

* Prepare weekly and monthly customer collection forecasts.
* Track actual collections against forecasts and analyse variances.
* Coordinate with Regional Heads to obtain realistic and achievable collection commitments.
* Identify collection shortfalls and highlight their impact on cash flow and working capital.
* Support Finance management in cash flow planning and liquidity management.

4. Customer Dispute Resolution

* Coordinate with Sales, Operations and customers to resolve billing, documentation and payment disputes.
* Ensure timely resolution of domestic and overseas customer discrepancies affecting collections.
* Identify recurring disputes and recommend process improvements.
* Maintain professional customer relationships while ensuring adherence to agreed payment terms.

5. MIS Reporting & Management Review

* Prepare and circulate weekly and monthly receivables ageing reports, including region-wise and customer-wise analysis.
* Provide management with overdue trends, collection performance, DSO analysis and credit exposure reports.
* Highlight high-risk customers, collection delays and deviations from approved credit policies.
* Prepare accurate MIS reports to support management decisions.
* Coordinate with IT/ERP teams for data accuracy, reporting improvements and customised reporting requirements.
* Support internal and external audits relating to receivables and credit control.

6. Statutory Compliance & Accounting Support

* Perform periodic reconciliation of Form 26AS with customer TDS ledgers.
* Prepare foreign currency revaluation workings and provisions for doubtful debts for month-end/year-end closure.
* Coordinate with the Compliance team on GST-related customer queries, reconciliations and documentation.
* Ensure accuracy of customer ledgers, receipts and related accounting records.

7. Process Improvement & Automation

* Identify opportunities to automate collection tracking, customer reminders and receivables reporting.
* Improve accuracy and turnaround time of credit control and reporting processes.
* Strengthen internal controls relating to customer credit approvals, receivables monitoring and collections.
* Ensure compliance with credit control SOPs and recommend improvements.

**About the Role:**

The Manager – Accounts will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end finance operations including Accounts Payable, General Ledger, month-end close, statutory and group audits, treasury operations, and providing finance support for corporate restructuring initiatives across Zeta Group entities.

The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, leadership capability, and the ability to operate in a fast-growing, multi-entity environment.

An ambitious individual who can deal with ambiguity and is interested in working for a growth-phase company would be an ideal fit for the role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Financial Accounting & Month-End Close**

* Own and manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

**Accounts Payable & Payments**

* Oversee Accounts Payable operations, including vendor accounting, invoice processing, and aging management.

**General Ledger & Controls**

**Treasury & Banking**

* Oversee treasury operations, including cash flow monitoring, fund utilization, and banking relationships.
* Manage bank accounts, signatories, and payment authorization controls.
* Support cash forecasting and liquidity planning in coordination with leadership.

**Restructuring & Special Projects**

* Provide accounting and finance support for group restructuring, de-mergers, mergers, and internal reorganizations.
* Assist in implementation of accounting treatments, disclosures, and audit coordination related to restructuring.
* Support system migrations, process transitions, and finance transformation initiatives.

**Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the finance operations team.
* Review team deliverables and ensure adherence to timelines and quality standards.
* Partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Tax, FP&A, and Business teams.

* Expertise in month-end close, AP, GL, audits, and treasury
* Experience in multi-entity / group structures
* Strong analytical, review, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

**Experience & Qualification:**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) mandatory
* 4-6 years of post-qualification experience in finance and accounting
* Experience in Big-4, technology or fintech
* ERP experience (Oracle preferred)

title: Senior Executive - Accounts
description:
**The role in a gist:**

In this role, you will handle loan-portfolio accounting under Ind AS 109, preparing EIR and transaction cost amortization schedules for the loan book. You will interpret commercial terms in vendor and partner agreements to ensure correct accounting treatment. Day-to-day work involves managing large loan-level datasets in Excel and Tally or an ERP, along with reconciliations and close coordination with business, operations and partner teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Loan origination cost amortization**

* Review expense ledgers at transaction and vendor level to identify costs directly attributable to loan origination, such as marketing, sourcing, call centre, channel partner and marketplace costs, in line with Ind AS 109.
* Reclassify identified costs to the appropriate cost heads and record the related reclassification entries.
* Map costs to disbursements by channel, vendor and campaign using disbursement and lead data, separately for on-book and off-book loans (variabilization).
* Prepare and maintain amortization schedules under the EIR method, including the treatment of prepayments, foreclosures and write-offs.
* Record monthly amortization entries, and reconcile ledger balances with amortization workings at vendor level.
* Interpret performance-linked vendor and partner agreements (e.g. commission on disbursements, expenses paid on the partner's behalf and adjusted against invoices), and compute amounts payable or recoverable.
* Prepare marketing and processing cost MIS, including projections of expected costs and their EIR impact.
* Maintain a master record of agreements, invoices and approvals, and coordinate with marketing, business and operations teams.
* Prepare schedules and support internal, statutory and tax audits for amortization.
* Contribute to the automation of amortization and reconciliation workings.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com/M.Com or CA Inter / semi-qualified CA, with 4–6 years of experience in accounting at an NBFC, bank or fintech.
* Working knowledge of Ind AS 109, particularly EIR and transaction cost amortization.
* Experience in preparing amortization schedules for a loan portfolio.
* Ability to interpret commercial terms in vendor and partner agreements.
* Advanced Excel proficiency (pivot tables, lookups; Power Query an advantage) for handling large transaction-level and loan-level datasets; working knowledge of Tally or an ERP.
* Strong reconciliation skills and the ability to work with business, operations and partner teams.
* Exposure to NBFC lending or audit of financial services entities preferred.
