title: Intelligence & Insights – Manager / Senior Analyst
description:
TRYST, IIT Bombay, is looking for talented professionals to join its
**Intelligence & Insights team**
at two levels –
**Manager (5–7 years)**
and
**Senior Analyst (2–3 years)**
.

This is an exciting opportunity for professionals from management consulting, industry research, strategy, technology intelligence and analytics backgrounds who are passionate about understanding emerging industries, technological developments and the future of innovation.

The selected professionals will work at the intersection of
**frontier research, industry strategy, technology, investment and national priorities**
, helping shape TRYST's perspective on India's evolving industrial and technological landscape.

**Key Focus Areas**

The Intelligence & Insights team will work across the following domains:

* Healthcare & Life Sciences
* Semiconductors & Electronics
* Energy & Clean Technology
* Climate & Sustainability
* AI & Digital Technologies

AI and digital technologies will also be explored as cross-industry enablers across TRYST's priority sectors.

**Role 1: Manager – Intelligence & Insights**

**Experience: 5–8 Years**

The Manager will lead industry, technology and innovation intelligence across TRYST's priority domains, developing strategic perspectives and identifying opportunities that connect industry challenges with IIT Bombay's research strengths.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead industry, technology and innovation intelligence, covering market structures, industry segments, value chains, emerging technologies and frontier research.
* Develop five-year and ten-year industry outlooks, scenarios and strategic assessments.
* Evaluate India's competitive positioning, strategic dependencies and capability gaps against leading global economies, companies and research institutions.
* Identify high-value technology challenges across industries and connect them with IIT Bombay's research capabilities.
* Evaluate the innovation and investment landscape, including public research funding, deep-tech venture capital, corporate R&D and commercialisation barriers.
* Prepare industry outlook reports, white papers, strategic presentations and executive briefings for senior stakeholders.
* Engage with CXOs, R&D leaders, founders, investors, policymakers and faculty to validate and strengthen industry perspectives.
* Lead, mentor and develop the team of analysts while establishing research frameworks, methodologies and quality standards.

**Role 2: Senior Analyst – Intelligence & Insights**

**Experience: 2–3 Years**

The Senior Analyst will lead research and intelligence on AI & Digital Technologies while supporting the broader industry intelligence agenda across TRYST's priority sectors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct in-depth research on industries, technologies and markets, developing structured views of industry segments, sub-segments and value chains.
* Develop market models and analytical assessments to evaluate market size, growth opportunities and strategic dependencies.
* Track emerging technologies, frontier research, startups and investment activities to identify opportunities for research translation and commercialization.
* Contribute to five-year and ten-year industry outlooks, comparative assessments and global best-practice studies.
* Analyse India's position across relevant technology and industry segments, identifying areas where India leads, lags or depends on global capabilities.
* Synthesise research findings into high-quality reports, presentations, briefs and publications.
* Support engagements and interactions with industry leaders, investors, policymakers and faculty.
* Build expertise in AI and digital technologies while contributing to intelligence across healthcare, semiconductors, energy and climate-related domains.

**Preferred Candidate Profile – Applicable to Both Roles**

We are particularly interested in candidates with:

* Experience in management consulting, strategy consulting, industry research, market intelligence, research and analytics, corporate strategy, or R&D and product-related roles.
* Exposure to direct client and stakeholder interactions, including industry leaders and senior decision-makers.
* Strong experience in primary research, industry analysis, market intelligence and gathering insights through stakeholder engagements.
* Industry exposure in one or more of the following areas:
* Semiconductors & Electronics
* Energy & Clean Technology
* Healthcare & Life Sciences
* Climate & Sustainability
* Understanding of technology trends, innovation ecosystems, product development, technology commercialisation and emerging deep-tech opportunities.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving and research capabilities.
* Excellent communication, report writing, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

Educational Qualifications

**Manager:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science.
* MBA or an advanced degree from a leading institution is preferred.

**Senior Analyst:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science or Pharmacy.
* Master's degree or MBA will be an advantage.

**Why Join TRYST – IIT Bombay?**

* Shape where one of India's leading research institutions directs its research translation efforts.
* Work at the intersection of frontier science, industry strategy, capital and national priorities.
* Gain direct exposure to industry leaders, investors, policymakers and world-class faculty.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives that connect cutting-edge research with industry needs and real-world opportunities.

title: Pricing Analyst
description:
We're looking for a detail-oriented
**Price Analyst**
who understands jewellery costing, market pricing, and competitive analysis. Someone who can analyse numbers, research market trends, and ensure our jewellery is priced accurately and competitively.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Jewellery Costing & Pricing**

* Calculate product costs based on gold, silver, diamonds, gemstones, making charges, labour, and other expenses.
* Maintain accurate product costing and selling prices.
* Recommend competitive pricing based on costs and market conditions.

**2. Precious Metal Rate Monitoring**

* Track daily gold, silver, and other precious metal rates.
* Analyse price fluctuations and their impact on jewellery costs.
* Recommend timely product price revisions.

**3. Market Research & Price Comparison**

* Research similar jewellery designs across brands, online marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, and retail websites.
* Compare prices based on design, metal, diamond quality, specifications, and product characteristics.
* Identify prevailing market prices and evaluate our pricing against comparable products.
* Maintain competitor benchmarking reports and identify pricing opportunities.

Requirements

* 2–5 years of experience in jewellery costing, pricing, or market analysis.
* Strong knowledge of gold, diamonds, gemstones, and jewellery manufacturing costs.
* Advanced Excel and analytical skills.
* Experience in competitor research and product price benchmarking.
* Strong attention to detail and commercial understanding.

**We're looking for someone who doesn't just calculate prices but understands what jewellery should actually sell for in the market.**

description:

**Director, Professional Services - India**

**Practice Director – Professional Services ( SaaS ) | Mumbai**

A key expectation of this role is the ability to lead in an evolving AI landscape. Working closely with Professional Services, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Alliances, and Support, the Practice Director will shape strategy, influence product and services direction, resolve critical customer and delivery challenges, and build a high-performing organization capable of executing at scale.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

Establish practical AI-enabled ways of working while ensuring appropriate governance, human oversight, quality controls, security, and responsible use.

Demonstrated experience in Workforce AI, AI-enabled workforce transformation, or enterprise AI solutions is required.
  
Strong understanding of how AI can be applied to workforce strategy, skills, talent, learning, mobility, productivity, and organizational transformation.
  
Strong techno-functional depth, with the ability to move comfortably between business strategy, product capabilities, solution architecture, integrations, implementation complexity, and delivery execution.
  
A proven ability to set strategy and personally drive execution—translating broad business priorities into clear plans, decisions, operating mechanisms, and measurable results.
  
Demonstrated success leading a Professional Services practice, portfolio, business unit, or large delivery organization.
  
Proven ownership of business and portfolio performance, including revenue, margin, utilization, productivity, delivery quality, customer satisfaction, and employee engagement.
  
Experience shaping and scaling service offerings, delivery methodologies, governance models, and repeatable implementation approaches.
  
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence customers and senior stakeholders and navigate complex, high-stakes situations.
  
Proven experience leading complex customer escalations and making timely decisions in ambiguous environments.
  
A strong track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams across geographically distributed and matrixed organizations.
  
Experience influencing and partnering effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and other senior cross-functional leaders.

Comfortable moving between executive conversations and delivery-level detail
  
Decisive and able to bring clarity to ambiguity
  
A strong people leader who sets a high bar and holds teams accountable

title: Collection Manager - Digital
description:
**Job Title**: Collections Manager /AM– Digital

**Location**: Ghansoli Navi Mumbai

CTC: As per Std

**Role Overview**

As the Collections Manager – Digital, you will drive recovery outcomes across assigned unsecured retail portfolios — credit cards, personal loans, BNPL, and other consumer lending products. You will design and execute omnichannel, digital-first borrower engagement strategies (SMS, WhatsApp, Voice AI, email), optimize campaign performance, and manage operational KPIs to maximize recovery rates, roll-back, and margins — all while ensuring strict compliance with RBI and Indian regulatory norms.

This role requires a professional with deep experience in Indian collections and contact-centre operations, able to translate data-driven insights into scalable, bucket-wise strategies. You will report to the Head of Collections and collaborate closely with Operations, Portfolio Management, Data Science, Compliance, and Product teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Collections Strategy & Execution**

* Develop and implement borrower engagement frameworks across SMS, Email, WhatsApp, Voice Bots, and AI/ML-based segmentation, tailored to portfolio and delinquency bucket.
* Own campaign execution across digital channels, aligning with portfolio strategy, lender/client expectations, and regulatory limits.
* Design bucket-wise strategies (early-stage/X-bucket, 1–30, 30–60, 60–90, and late-stage/NPA) across credit cards, personal loans, BNPL, and other unsecured products.
* Drive digital-first collections with measurable improvement in recovery %, resolution rate, roll-back/roll-forward, bounce reduction, and contactability.
* Collaborate with tech/product teams to enhance dialer systems, workflow automation, and multi-channel orchestration.

**Portfolio & Performance Management**

* Own portfolio-level KPIs — resolution rate, PTP and PTP-kept rate, RPC/connect rate, flow rates, cost-to-collect, and recovery against targets.
* Monitor digital campaign metrics for productivity and cost-efficiency across lenders/clients.
* Run A/B testing and optimization to improve connect rates, PTP rates, and recovery margins.
* Build and review dashboards for portfolio and campaign health; recommend and review content/message templates for compliant, effective engagement.

**Compliance & Regulatory (India)**

* Ensure all collections activity complies with RBI Fair Practices Code and Recovery Agent guidelines (8:00 AM–7:00 PM calling window, no harassment/coercion, borrower dignity), RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, RBI Master Directions on Outsourcing, DPDP Act 2023, TRAI/TCCCPR for SMS & voice, IT Act 2000, Consumer Protection Act 2019, and SARFAESI awareness where relevant.
* Provide legal/regulatory feasibility assessments for proposed collection strategies and templates; escalate compliance risk proactively.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with Business Analysts and Data Science teams to define problem statements and optimize campaign performance.
* Share best practices and success patterns with client/lender leadership.
* Collaborate with R&D and Product stakeholders to influence the roadmap for collections performance and automation.
* Coach and guide team members and vendor/agency partners toward compliant, high-performing execution.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in collections, preferably in financial services (banks/NBFCs/fintechs) or contact-centre operations, with strong exposure to credit cards, personal loans, BNPL, and other unsecured retail portfolios.
* Solid understanding of bucket-wise collections strategy, campaign management, customer engagement, and data-driven optimization.
* Strong knowledge of Indian collections regulations: RBI Fair Practices Code, Recovery Agent guidelines, Digital Lending Guidelines, DPDP Act 2023, TRAI/TCCCPR, IT Act, and Consumer Protection Act.
* Hands-on experience with digital communication tools — SMS, WhatsApp, email platforms, and voice automation/bots.
* Ability to interpret performance metrics and run A/B testing frameworks.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills across tech, product, analytics, and compliance.
* Analytical mindset with a passion for using data to drive business results.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Exposure to AI/bot-assisted and omnichannel collections platforms; experience across multiple lenders/clients in a BPO/agency or in-house setup; familiarity with dialer platforms and speech/interaction analytics.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - Channel Management
description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

The role of Manager - Channel Management at Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd involves a multifaceted set of responsibilities to ensure robust channel development and effective market coverage within the Farm Machinery Business, particularly focusing on pioneering products such as Rice Transplanters, Potato Planters, and Harvesters.

**Channel Development & Management**
  
You will design and implement comprehensive channel policies, overseeing the onboarding and offboarding processes to maintain an efficient and dynamic network. Key responsibilities include appointing and nurturing a network of dealers, sub-dealers, and institutional partners. Strategic delineation of territory-wise channel structures, alongside coverage and outlet productivity norms, will be critical to maximizing market penetration and sales effectiveness.

**Sales Support & Market Expansion**
  
Identifying high-potential mechanization clusters within key agricultural belts, such as rice, potato, and grain regions, will be essential for targeted growth initiatives. Collaborating closely with Zonal Managers, you will spearhead seasonal channel sales planning aligning with agricultural cycles to optimise timing and resource allocation. Facilitating channel partners' access to finance and trade assistance at regional levels will be a vital support function.

**Dealer Enablement & Capability Building**
  
Ensuring all dealership touchpoints—from showrooms to workshops—adhere to the Corporate Identity Programme (CIP) branding standards is expected. Management of dealer funding inflows including bank guarantees, own funds, and trade advances, alongside proactive monitoring of working capital and exposures, will ensure financial health across the channel. Training initiatives will deliver crucial knowledge in product features, agronomical benefits, return on investment (ROI), and competitive advantages, empowering dealer teams to conduct effective demonstrations and value-based selling.

**Business Planning & Reporting**
  
You will drive the preparation of annual operating plans for dealers encompassing sales, geographic coverage, and profitability targets. Continuous tracking and analysis of channel sales performance, market intelligence, competitor activities, and pricing trends are essential for informed decision-making and proactive strategy refinement. Compliance with credit policies and channel hygiene standards will be stringently enforced to maintain operational integrity.

**Compliance & Governance**
  
Adhering to established company policies around channel partner agreements, onboarding and offboarding procedures, and Letters of Intent (LOI) management will remain a top priority to ensure governance standards are met.

This role demands a dynamic, strategic leader who can blend market insight with operational excellence to drive channel success and market expansion for Mahindra's agricultural machinery business.

**Experience**
--------------

The ideal candidate will possess a Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Agriculture, Engineering, or Management, reflecting a strong foundational knowledge aligned with the Farm Machinery business sector.

Candidates should have between 5 to 8 years of progressive experience managing channel networks within agricultural machinery domains, ideally in segments involving Rice Transplanters, Harvesters, or Tractors. Experience in these specialized product lines will enable a deeper understanding of market dynamics, dealer ecosystems, and customer needs.

A thorough understanding of rice agronomy practices, mechanization economics, and familiarity with government subsidy frameworks and regulatory environments will be critical. The candidate is expected to leverage this expertise to enhance channel efficiency and promote mechanization adoption among farming communities.

Proven capability in leading dealer engagement initiatives, negotiating complex contracts, and delivering training programs will be essential. Experience with business planning, sales forecasting, and monitoring key performance indicators within a channel management context will be highly advantageous.

**Industry Preferred**
----------------------

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the agricultural machinery industry, particularly those who have worked with products related to rice cultivation such as transplanters and harvesters, as well as those familiar with tractor markets.

Prior engagement in agribusiness sectors—encompassing agricultural equipment manufacturing, distribution networks, and mechanization services—will provide a strong foundation for navigating this role's challenges.

Experience within companies that operate in rural agricultural markets, and those with a track record of promoting mechanization and innovation in farming communities, will be beneficial. Familiarity with industries interfacing closely with government subsidy programs and rural financing schemes is also desirable.

**Qualifications**
------------------

A Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Agriculture, Engineering, or Management is required to ensure the candidate is well-versed in the technical aspects and business dynamics relevant to the agricultural machinery industry.

The qualifications should reflect a commitment to understanding both the agronomic factors underpinning product efficacy and the strategic aspects related to channel and business development.

Professional certifications or additional training related to agribusiness, sales management, or channel strategy will be considered advantageous, supporting ongoing learning and professional growth within this role.

**General Requirements**
------------------------

The role requires exceptional skills in channel development and relationship management, demonstrating the ability to cultivate and sustain productive partnerships with dealers and channel stakeholders.

Strong negotiation and influencing skills are essential for aligning channel partner objectives with company goals, securing favourable terms, and resolving conflicts effectively.

Excellence in seasonal planning and execution is required given the agronomic cycles that dictate sales windows and mechanization needs. The ability to synchronise channel activities with sowing and harvesting periods will drive business success.

A willingness and ability to travel extensively throughout rural markets is indispensable, supplying on-ground support, fostering dealer relationships, and understanding local market dynamics firsthand.

The candidate must be adaptable, proactive, and possess strong organisational capabilities to manage complex channel networks in diverse environments.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
------------------------------------------------------

At Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, we champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as core pillars that foster innovation and excellence within our workforce. We are dedicated to creating and nurturing a workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique talents.

We uphold an Equal Opportunity Employment policy that ensures all applicants receive consideration without discrimination based on any protected characteristic, including but not limited to age, caste, race, religion, colour, ethnicity, gender identity, nationality, physical or mental ability, sexual orientation, education, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We actively promote the inclusion of diverse voices and perspectives to strengthen our teams and decision-making processes. Our recruitment practices are designed to provide an accessible and respectful experience, encouraging candidates from all backgrounds to apply and succeed.

By embracing difference and fostering an equitable environment, we aim to build a future that truly reflects and serves the pluralistic communities where we operate. Together, we leverage diversity to drive sustainable growth and innovation at every level of our organisation.

title: Customer Service Manager
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

**Your future role**
--------------------

Take on a new challenge and apply your **customer service, railway systems, and techno-commercial expertise** in our Parts & Overhaul Services business.

You’ll lead the end-to-end customer relationship for **Metro Parts, Repairs, Overhaul and Warranty Services**, from opportunity identification through order execution, delivery, and payment.

Working closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Operations, you’ll drive **customer satisfaction, delivery performance, business growth, and continuous improvement**.

**We’ll look to you for:**
--------------------------

* Managing customer inquiries, orders, returns, complaints, and critical issues
* Coordinating **Metro Parts, Repairs, Overhaul and Warranty Services**
* Driving techno-commercial plans for **Propulsion, Bogies and Drives**
* Monitoring delivery KPIs and leading **RCA, action plans, and performance reviews**
* Identifying customer needs and opportunities and partnering with Sales/Business Development
* Supporting the conversion of ad-hoc Parts & Repairs business into **long-term agreements and overhaul opportunities**
* Coordinating bids, material planning, stock, and logistics costs
* Supporting reliability improvement and obsolescence solutions with Engineering
* Driving effective use of **SAP/GSI** and Customer Service tools
* Developing Customer Service competencies within the team
* Ensuring compliance with **Quality, ISO and EHS** requirements

**All about you**
-----------------

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* **12–14 years of relevant experience**
* Graduate in **Engineering or an Industrial discipline**
* Experience in Customer Service, Parts & Overhaul, Repairs, Maintenance, or After-Sales Services
* Knowledge of **train parts and sub-assemblies**
* Knowledge of **Propulsion and Bogie Drives systems**
* Strong customer relationship and delivery performance management skills
* Basic knowledge of **SAP/GSI**
* Understanding of supply chain, inventory, material planning, and MRP
* Good English and Microsoft Office skills
* Strong problem-solving, leadership, and team management capabilities

Railway experience, customer-facing field exposure, Quality/Audit knowledge, and data analytics experience would be advantageous.

**Your key network and stakeholders**
-------------------------------------

You’ll work closely with:

* Parts & Overhaul and Customer Service teams
* Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and Operations
* Sales, Business Development, Tender/Bid teams, and Customer Directors
* ISR, Maintenance, RAMS, and Contract Management
* Customer site and maintenance teams
* External suppliers

**How your success will be measured**
-------------------------------------

* Parts & Overhaul performance
* **On-time delivery and dispatch**
* Contractual milestone achievement
* Customer satisfaction
* **QCD** performance
* REX implementation and audit results
* EHS and process compliance
* Workload and competency development

**Things you’ll enjoy**
-----------------------

Join a dynamic Services environment where you’ll combine **customer management, railway technical knowledge, commercial awareness, and operational delivery**.

You’ll collaborate across functions, contribute to Metro Parts & Overhaul activities, develop long-term customer solutions, and help continuously improve service performance.

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2/P3). Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive actions. Coordinate with AWS Support, telecom providers, third-party vendors, and internal technical teams. Establish proactive monitoring and alerting mechanisms. Track incident trends and continuous service improvements.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
Pico fuels the global capital markets community by providing exceptional market data services and customized managed infrastructure solutions. As financial industry experts at the center of markets and technology, we help our clients efficiently scale their business and quickly access markets. From infrastructure to connectivity, we support our clients through the full trading lifecycle. We are a global company headquartered in New York, with offices in Chicago, London, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo.
  
  
**Purpose Of The Role**
Pico is looking to expand our Global Service Delivery organization to support our growth in clients and market share. The department sits alongside Sales and Sales Engineering and is focused on successful management and delivery of client projects working collaborative internally and externally. The role of the Service Delivery Manager is accountable for leading delivery across a global book of work (BOW), delivering complex client projects successfully and with the highest level of service, and converting delivery to revenue swiftly. This role is expected to contribute to the Service Delivery strategy, including how delivery supports the company growth strategy through forward‑thinking leadership, scalable operating models, and continuous improvement. Project and programme leadership is a core responsibility, working closely with external and internal stakeholders to assess and document requirements, construct project plans, coordinate delivery, and communicate status across multiple initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities and duties**
*(include but not limited to)*
  
  

* Own and evolve the Service Delivery strategy, ensuring delivery execution supports the company growth strategy, scalable operations, and improved client outcomes
* Lead delivery transformation initiatives, including automation and tooling (e.g., portals and automated workflows) to improve efficiency, transparency, and scale
* Drive process maturity improvements by defining and embedding standards, governance, and repeatable workflows to increase delivery predictability
* Own key delivery and financial outcomes across the global BOW, including forecast accuracy, delivery predictability, and time to revenue, partnering with Sales, Product, and Finance to support revenue realization and margin protection
* Provide senior people leadership and own delivery culture and standards, including setting delivery discipline, defining escalation norms, and establishing an accountability model across internal and external stakeholders
* Lead and act as subject matter expert on assigned projects
* Build strong and independent relationships with assigned client(s) to onboard key details and data on the client environment, dependencies, plans and goals to embed KYC as part of the account team
* Liaise with clients and technical teams across the business to define project deliverables and deliver complex solutions for global clients. This includes requirements-gathering sessions with clients and/or Pico internal teams and documenting assumptions, decisions, risks, and actions.
* Lead internal team(s) to prioritize approved project work based on analysis of strategic importance, tasks outstanding, obstacles or barriers, budgets, resources and deadlines.
* Create and maintain regular proactive communications (verbal and/or written) to ensure effective delivery, project risk mitigation and traceability with client’s key stakeholders and resources (including but not limited to):

+ Create, maintain and share project plans
+ Drive calls and written communications with clients and act as key touchpoint for ongoing activity
+ Lead project planning calls and written commination with Engineering teams (Network, Systems, Data Center and Implementation)

* Navigate the organization effectively to deliver each component of complex projects while holding internal resources accountable for their deliverables and managing clients for their inputs
* Make necessary decisions to prioritize elements of projects based on critical paths, tasks outstanding, key dependencies, and/or obstacles or barriers to successful delivery and recognition of revenues
* Evaluate all key project deliverables, as well as final product, to ensure traceability of requirements and customer acceptance
* Effectively translate requirements into plans, presentations, or specification documents for review with clients and management and for use by Sales
* Complete the “permit to operate” process to hand over large client initiatives to Service Operations
* Collaborate with client on overall book of work to drive visibility and prioritization to support client in achieving business goals.
* Occasional weekend work needed to support internal and external migration work

**Education, Skills And Background (incl. Education And Experience Requirements)**

* Highly driven, results oriented, “no detail too small” individual with a commitment to excellence and self-learning
* Ideally 10+ years’ relevant experience including PMP, Prince2 or PSM certification
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to work autonomously and as a team player
* Ability to manage multiple streams of work, with potential for changes in priorities, while maintaining high quality standards
* Financial market awareness including areas such as market participants, trading, market data and regulatory themes
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience partnering with Sales, Product, and Finance to drive revenue realization and margin protection
* Expertise in establishing delivery operating models, standards, and metrics to support predictable, scalable execution
* Advanced stakeholder management and escalation leadership across complex, multi‑party environments
* Highly developed decision‑making skills, balancing client outcomes, delivery risk, commercial objectives, and operational capacity
* Experience driving transformation initiatives, including process maturity improvement, tooling adoption, and operational efficiency
* Technology-minded with foundational understanding of Hosting/Network/Systems/Cloud/ Software/IT Operations and their interoperation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to engage with senior management and sensitive clients
* Strong proficiency in MS PowerPoint, Excel, Word and MS Project

**AMRS hours Shift**
  
  

+ 5 days per week - Tuesday - Saturday
+ Weekday hours (Mon-Fri) - 19:30pm - 04:00am
+ Weekend hours - 19:30pm - 04:00am

**Working Arrangements**
This is a Hybrid position with weekly time in the office with the flexibility of working from home. Though travel may be required from time to time, it is not expected to be regular or frequent. The role holder will be expected to work whatever hours are necessary for the performance of this role (recognizing that it involves multiple jurisdictions/geographies including but not limited to EMEA, USA and APAC).

You must possess a unique blend of business and technical savvy; a big-picture vision, create a vision of the product from an end user perspective, and the drive to make that vision a reality. You must enjoy spending time in the market to understand their problems, and find innovative solutions for the broader market. You must be able to communicate with all areas of the company. You will work with a technology counterpart to define product release requirements. You will work closely with various stakeholders to make business decisions and create product strategies that ensure the long-term sustainability of the products or tools. You will also serve as the internal and external evangelist for your product offering, occasionally working with the sales channel and key customers.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Identifying, evaluating, and planning new software products using lean/agile principles.
* Creating use-cases and related requirements materials for use by our development/technology teams
* Defining minimum viable product features (MVP) and/or pivoting existing products.
* Propose product strategy changes because of competitive changes in the marketplace.
* Working cross-functionally, define and drive alignment and implementation of the software roadmap including products, services, and solutions.
* Closely collaborate with cross-functional teams across business, technical and implementation teams to define product requirements to build and own the product roadmap.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog together with product management.
* Report to Global leadership on product status, management of budget etc.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of customers’ challenges and needs to clearly define product requirements
* Manage the product life cycle
* Assist in the build / buy strategy including recommendations for current solutions
* Communicate and drive organizational alignment on software deployment with key stakeholders including end users
* Works with the technology and client services teams to build and enhance products from existing ideas, and help develop new concepts based on industry research and the needs of end user

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Experience with HR / Payroll technology solutions and a good understanding of global HRIS / HR / Payroll technology landscape
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done
* Ability to effectively work as a leader in a cross functional team environment including business and product development, supply chain and procurement processes and execution dependencies
* Strong track record of influencing successful product/solution vision/roadmap and executing to a plan
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and expertise in communicating with teams across geographies
* Excellent knowledge of Design Thinking and User Experience methodologies.
* Strategic thinker who is comfortable in a fast-paced, always-on, ambiguous start-up environment

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in engineering (Computer Science/ Technology
* 12 - 15 years of experience in IT/software industry with at least 6 years in capacity of product manager.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Knowledge and experience in dealing with cross platform mobile applications.
* Demonstrated success in delivering high quality technology products/services in a very high growth environment where priorities shift rapidly.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Customer Support Quality Analyst
description:

**Location:** Pune, India

#### **About the Role:**

We're looking for a detail-oriented and analytical **Customer Support Quality Analyst** to join our team in Pune, India.  
  
You'll review and score customer interactions across phone, email, and live chat, ensuring they meet our quality standards and deliver a positive customer experience. You'll identify trends, highlight areas for improvement, maintain accurate quality records, and work closely with the Support Team and UK Head Office.  
  
Full training on our quality framework and internal processes will be provided. Previous QA experience is beneficial but not essential.

* Confidence using computer systems, spreadsheets, and digital tools.

**It would be great if you also had:**

Experience working with international teams.

**This is a 100% on-site position in Pune, India.** Applicants must currently be based in Pune. Relocation assistance is not available.

title: Partner Onboarding Lead – O&M
description:
**About Claro Energy**

Claro Energy is a leading clean energy company in India with 15+ years of experience in building decentralized renewable energy solutions. We have delivered 1,00,000+ solar projects across solar irrigation pumps, rooftop solar, and large-scale clean energy programs, working closely with farmers, households, institutions, and government initiatives across multiple Indian states. As we scale further, we are building an AI-first data and intelligence foundation to power automation, forecasting, and faster decision-making across operations, growth, inventory, and finance.

**About The Role**

Our installed base is growing faster than any in-house service team can cover. We are building a freelance O&M partner network: certified solar technicians who handle servicing, breakdowns, preventive maintenance, and warranty calls for rooftop solar and solar pump systems in their own districts.

You will own this network from start to finish. You will source partners, verify them, onboard them, activate them, and keep them. Think of it as the partner/supply lead role at a mobility or home-services platform, applied to solar field service. You will also work with the tech team on bringing AI into processes to smoothen up operations, from partner screening to job allocation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Partner Acquisition

• Build supply pipelines of freelance technicians district by district, using ITIs, local electrical contractors, ex-installer networks, dealer referrals, and digital channels

• Map coverage gaps against our installed base and service ticket density, then prioritize recruitment accordingly

• Run referral and drive-based hiring campaigns to hit district-level partner targets

Verification & Onboarding

• Own the onboarding funnel from lead to document collection, KYC, and background check, through skill assessment and agreement signing, and finally activation

• Run practical skill assessments for both rooftop (on-grid/hybrid) and solar pump (AC/DC, VFD controllers) systems

• Get partners onboarded onto the partner app/CRM, covering job acceptance, photo-proof uploads, and closure workflows

Training & Certification

• Design and run induction and certification modules on Claro product lines, safety standards, RMS diagnostics, and service SOPs

• Build a tiering system (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold) based on skill level, ratings, and SLA performance, and tie it to job priority and payouts

Activation, Quality & Retention

• Track first-job activation, ensure partners complete their first jobs within defined timelines, and fix drop-offs

• Monitor partner performance on TAT, first-time-fix rate, customer ratings, rework, and photo-proof compliance

• Run quality audits and field spot checks, and manage escalations, warnings, and offboarding

• Work with Finance on rate cards, incentive structures, and on-time payouts, since payouts are the top driver of partner retention

• Run partner engagement through WhatsApp communities, monthly calls, and recognition programs

Process & Data

• Maintain a clean partner database with skills, coverage pincodes, tier, tools owned, and availability

• Work with the tech team to automate screening, reminders, and job-routing using n8n/Make and AI agents

• Publish weekly dashboards covering funnel conversion, active partners, district coverage, SLA adherence, and churn

**What We're Looking For**

• 3–6 years in partner/supply onboarding, field operations, or service network management. Gig/marketplace platforms (mobility, home services, logistics) or solar/electrical service companies are ideal backgrounds

• Proven track record of building and scaling a distributed partner or vendor network across multiple geographies

• Enough technical comfort with solar systems to assess a technician's skill. You do not need to be an engineer

• Strong data discipline: you run the funnel on numbers, not gut feel

• Comfortable in Tier 2/3 towns and rural geographies; fluent in Hindi and English, and regional languages are a plus

• Comfort with CRMs, Google Sheets, and automation tools; exposure to n8n, Make, or AI tools is a strong plus

**Success Metrics — First 6 Months**

• Active, certified partners in target districts against plan

• Lead-to-activation conversion rate and time-to-activate

• Service TAT and first-time-fix rate across partner-handled tickets

• 90-day partner retention rate

**Why Join**

• Build a field service network from zero, with direct impact on customer uptime across 1,00,000+ installations

• Run a marketplace-style operations model in solar, a space where very few companies have built one

• Work closely with leadership and the tech team on automating a ground-level operation

**How to Apply**

Click Apply — you'll be redirected to our careers portal. Once there, click Apply Now again and fill out the short form with your LinkedIn ID, resume, and contact details. Alternatively, send your updated resume directly to hr@claroenergy.in with the subject line: Application –
Partner Onboarding Lead – O&M

Our team brings together specialists from leading in-house marketing organizations, agencies and technology platforms who combine deep practical expertise with a passion for measurable results. We don't just help clients determine
*what*
to do—we work alongside them to define
*how*

**Senior Manager, MarTech**
to join FRWD in APAC.
  
  
You'll bring broad marketing expertise together with deep MarTech experience, helping clients integrate technology, customer data and digital capabilities into larger marketing, commercial and growth transformations.
  
  
As a senior practitioner and workstream leader, you'll shape MarTech strategies, operating models and implementation roadmaps while partnering closely with Bain consulting teams, FRWD practitioners and senior client stakeholders across marketing, sales, technology, analytics and digital functions.
  
  
You'll also play an important role in growing Bain's MarTech capability across the APAC region through thought leadership, coaching and business development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead MarTech strategy and client delivery**

* Lead MarTech diagnostics, assessments and client workstreams across marketing technology, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, personalization, customer journey orchestration, analytics, attribution, privacy and AI-enabled marketing capabilities.
* Develop data-driven recommendations, investment cases, implementation of roadmaps and capability-building plans that connect technology decisions with measurable business outcomes.
* Assess existing MarTech ecosystems, vendor landscapes, organizational models and operating processes to identify opportunities for simplification, optimization and growth.
* Design customer data and activation strategies across leading platforms including Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, AppsFlyer and related technologies.
* Develop measurement frameworks, experimentation strategies and attribution approaches that improve customer acquisition, retention, lifecycle engagement and marketing ROI.
* Collaborate closely with client implementation teams, agencies, platform partners and Bain technical specialists, translating complex technical concepts into actionable business recommendations.

**Build trusted client relationships**

* Develop strong relationships with senior client stakeholders across marketing, growth, digital, technology, sales and executive leadership.
* Facilitate executive workshops and stakeholder interviews to align priorities and define practical transformation roadmaps.
* Deliver clear, compelling presentations that connect MarTech investments to commercial performance, customer experience and operating model improvements.
* Ensure all analyses, recommendations and client deliverables meet Bain's high standards for quality, accuracy and impact.

**Lead teams and grow the FRWD capability**

* Lead and coach integrated Bain and FRWD teams throughout client engagements.
* Share MarTech expertise across the broader Bain ecosystem through tools, methodologies, training and case examples.
* Support capability building, recruiting, intellectual property development and business development across the APAC FRWD practice.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering (Singapore)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**Overview**
**Our Culture and Impact**
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Cvent Implementation team configures and deploys Cvent software for new and existing clients. Our mission is to provide expert guidance and hands-on technical execution, so every client successfully launches, adopts, and realizes value from their Cvent products.
  
  
The role blends project management, technical configuration, and client-facing consulting — and increasingly, the smart use of AI tools to move faster, reduce manual work, and give clients a sharper, more consultative experience. This is no longer just a configuration role: it's a role where the best performers use AI as a force multiplier across research, documentation, testing, and client communication.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Implementation / Implementation Lead, you will own mid-to-complex client implementations end-to-end — from discovery and process mapping through configuration, testing, training, and go-live. You'll act as a trusted advisor to clients, a hands-on product expert, and a mentor to junior team members, while leveraging AI tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality at every stage of the project lifecycle.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
**Client Consultation & Strategic Delivery**

* Provide high-level consultation to clients on applying Cvent technology to meet their meetings and events program goals.
* Analyze current-state processes and map future-state workflows to Cvent solutions, identifying opportunities for automation along the way.
* Serve as a product specialist — deeply knowledgeable across Cvent products, able to demonstrate, consult, configure, test, train, and deploy solutions.
* Cultivate strong advisory relationships with key client stakeholders who influence adoption and long-term account health.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Apply structured project management discipline — scoping, planning, RAID logs, milestone tracking, and change control — to manage simple-to-complex implementations, keeping timelines on track and proactively escalating barriers to success.
* Translate customer goals into objective, measurable success criteria (e.g., adoption rate, time-to-value, process cycle time, cost savings, ROI) rather than relying on subjective or anecdotal measures of progress.
* Define and track KPIs and success metrics with clients at project kick-off, and report progress against them throughout the engagement so success is data-driven, not just directional.
* Oversee and/or configure client accounts, including testing, refining, and directing the contributions of other team members.
* Track time and profitability of implementation projects, providing recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign.
* Coordinate and conduct virtual user training sessions for client teams.

**Technical Configuration & Product Expertise**

* Configure, test, and refine Cvent product instances to match documented client requirements.
* Diagram intermediate-to-complex process flows and identify opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Interface with the Product Development team to define and convey client feature requests.

**AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation**
**Role**
*This is where the role has evolved most. AI is now a core part of how implementation work gets done, not an optional add-on:*

* Use generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to draft, summarize, and refine requirements documents, process maps, and configuration workbooks — cutting documentation time and improving consistency across projects.
* Apply AI-assisted meeting summarization and transcription tools during discovery calls and configuration workshops to speed up note-taking, action-item tracking, and follow-up communications.
* Identify and build lightweight automations or AI-agent workflows for repetitive project tasks — status updates, test-case generation, training material drafts, and client FAQs — freeing up time for higher-value consulting.
* Maintain quality and accuracy as a human-in-the-loop reviewer: validating AI-generated configurations, documentation, and communications before they reach the client.
* Model and mentor AI tool adoption to junior team members and peers, helping the broader team adopt AI-first ways of working.
* Use AI-powered analytics on data such as usage patterns, support tickets, or historical project data to proactively flag risk and improve implementation quality.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with Sales and Account Management to support sales activities where implementation expertise is a differentiator.
* Ensure client objectives and requirements are clearly conveyed and tracked throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Serve as a mentor to new team members, including on best practices for using AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Present internally as a subject-matter expert on implementation topics, lead conversations in team meetings, and participate in team committees, at times in a leadership capacity.

**Here's What You Need**

* 10 to 14+ years of external work experience in a project or customer management role — preferably in the corporate meetings, software, or broader high-tech industry — or a minimum of 5 years of Cvent experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent applicable experience.
* Experience implementing technology or automation, ideally within an organization responsible for managing meetings or events.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a positive, confident, and outgoing presence; strong presentation skills.
* Highly articulate and detail-oriented, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for clients of varying technical fluency.
* Strong project management skills — able to build and manage project plans, timelines, RAID/risk logs, and status reporting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer goals into objective, quantifiable outcomes and hold projects accountable to measurable results rather than subjective impressions of progress.
* Ability to comprehend and diagram intermediate process flows, identifying opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Proficiency in core productivity tools: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio/Draw.io.
* Demonstrable aptitude for learning and applying new technologies, and for applying general and industry-specific business knowledge in a fast-paced, analytical, team-oriented environment.
* Strong time-management and organizational discipline; ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently.
* A solutions-first mindset — comfortable proposing fixes rather than simply surfacing problems to management.

**Adaptability & Resilience Under Pressure**

* Ability to pivot quickly on customer situations — reworking scope, timelines, or approach mid-project when client needs, priorities, or constraints shift unexpectedly.
* Comfort operating through significant change management within a project (new stakeholders, revised requirements, shifting priorities) with flexibility rather than resistance to the change.
* Proven ability to multitask and stay effective under pressure — juggling competing deadlines, client escalations, and internal priorities without losing quality or composure.
* Willingness and ability to manage through non-ideal or ambiguous situations — messy data, incomplete requirements, tight timelines — rather than waiting for perfect conditions to make progress.

**AI & Technology Fluency (New)**

* Hands-on, practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate day-to-day work — documentation, research, communications, or analysis.
* Comfort working in a human-in-the-loop capacity: reviewing, validating, and correcting AI-generated outputs before they go to clients.
* Curiosity and adaptability toward emerging AI-powered workflow and automation tools, with a willingness to experiment and share learnings with the team.
* Basic understanding of how AI agents and automated workflows can be applied to client onboarding, configuration, or reporting tasks (formal AI/ML background not required).

**Preferred, Not Required**

* Experience with AI-assisted meeting transcription/summarization tools (e.g., Azure, Copilot, Glean, Claude).
* Prior exposure to no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Power Automate) or agentic workflow builders.
* Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP) good to have, not required.
* Six Sigma (Green Belt or higher) or equivalent process-improvement certification.

title: Implementation Team Lead
description:
**Team Lead, Implementation**

*Cvent Implementation Team | Full-Time| People-Leadership Role |AI-Augmented*

**About the Team**

The Cvent Implementation team configures and deploys Cvent software for new and existing clients. Our mission is to provide expert guidance and hands-on technical execution so every client successfully launches, adopts, and realizes value from their Cvent products.

The work blends project management, technical configuration, and client-facing consulting — and increasingly, the smart use of AI tools to move faster, reduce manual work, and deliver a sharper, more consultative client experience. As a Team Lead, you own the performance, growth, and delivery economics of a pod of Implementation Consultants operating in exactly this environment.

**Role Overview**

As Team Lead, Implementation, you lead a pod of Implementation Consultants and Senior Implementation Consultants — accountable for their delivery quality, client outcomes, professional growth, and the financial performance of your pod's portfolio. You operate as a player-coach: close enough to projects to unblock complex escalations and guarantee delivery standards, while owning the coaching, capability-building, and pod-level P&L that turn a group of strong ICs into a high-performing, predictable delivery team.

You are the first line of business accountability for delivery economics and the first line of client governance, running business reviews at the pod and skip-level, and mentoring your team on AI-first ways of working.

**Recruitment Scam Notice:**
Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email addresses. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.

For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Leadership & Coaching**

* Lead, coach, and develop a pod of Implementation Consultants and Senior Implementation Consultants, owning their performance, growth, and engagement end-to-end.
* Run structured weekly or bi-weekly 1:1s (more frequent for new hires) focused on project coaching, skill development, and career progression — not just status updates.
* Conduct at least one live coaching/feedback client call per direct report per month, using real client interactions as the basis for targeted development.
* Write and conduct mid-year and annual performance reviews; build and execute individual development and ramp plans; actively manage under-performance and grow bench strength.
* Own new-hire onboarding and ramp for the pod — ensure training is completed thoroughly and new hires reach productivity on plan.
* Balance and monitor individual workloads across the pod, reallocating capacity to protect delivery quality and prevent burnout.

**Delivery & Financial Ownership (P&L)**

* **Own the P&L for your pod's project portfolio**
  — accountable for utilization, burn rate, project profitability, cost-to-serve, and gross margin at the pod level, and take corrective action where performance drifts.
* Manage the health of all projects across the pod — timeliness of deliverables, quality of client deliverables, scope adherence, customer satisfaction, and portfolio risk.
* Track time and profitability across engagements and drive recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign to improve delivery economics.
* Enforce SOP and quality compliance across all client-facing deliverables — workflow diagrams, MRFs, AM templates, step-by-step guides, and configuration output — ensuring consistent, high-quality material leaves the pod.
* Own escalation management for all direct reports and projects: course-correct, put action plans in place, and mitigate delivery and relationship risk before it reaches leadership.

**Client Governance & Business Reviews**

* **Conduct Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs / QBRs)**
  with clients and skip-level stakeholders (Sr. Manager / Director of PSO), using business storytelling to connect delivery and financial metrics to clear recommendations and actions.
* Join new-customer Kick-Off and project Close-Out calls for direct reports, and maintain regular executive check-ins with key client stakeholders across the pod's portfolio.
* Translate pod performance into executive-ready narratives — trends across delivery quality, utilization, margin, cost-to-serve, customer sentiment, and delivery risk — for skip-level and senior leadership.
* Provide proactive, structured communication to senior leadership on team feedback, performance signals, customer risks, and recognitions.

**AI-Enabled Delivery Leadership**

*AI is now a core part of how implementation work gets done. As a Team Lead, you are expected not only to use AI fluently, but to raise the pod's AI capability:*

* **Model and coach AI-first ways of working**
  — help your pod use generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate requirements docs, process maps, configuration workbooks, test cases, training material, and client communications.
* **Own quality of AI-assisted output at the pod level**
  — set and enforce human-in-the-loop review standards so AI-generated configurations, documentation, and client communications are validated before they reach the client.
* Identify and champion lightweight automations and AI-agent workflows for repetitive delivery tasks — status updates, test-case generation, FAQs — and scale what works across the pod.
* Use AI-powered analytics on usage patterns, support tickets, and historical project data to proactively flag delivery risk and improve implementation quality across your portfolio.

**Technical Depth & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Stay hands-on enough to assist with complex issue resolution and configuration work, and to guarantee delivery standards on the pod's most challenging engagements.
* Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success where implementation expertise supports adoption, renewal readiness, and expansion — surfacing opportunities to those teams (retention and expansion targets remain owned at the Manager level).
* Interface with Product to convey client feature requests and delivery friction identified across the pod.
* Carry 1–2 team-wide internal initiatives (e.g., SOP/SME workstreams, scope team, training series, product readiness) that improve how the broader team operates.

**Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications**

* **10+ years of overall work experience**
  in implementation, professional services, project delivery, or client-facing roles — preferably in SaaS, corporate meetings/events, software, or high-tech.
* **Minimum 3–4 years of direct people-management experience**
  , leading client-facing delivery or implementation teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery economics — utilization, project profitability, and margin — with a track record of improving them through coaching and process change.
* Proven ability to run client-facing business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and translate operational and financial metrics into clear, executive-ready recommendations.
* Strong coaching and development track record — measurably improving IC performance, ramp speed, and retention.
* Strong project management discipline — scoping, planning, RAID/risk logs, milestone tracking, and status reporting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Ability to translate customer goals into objective, measurable success criteria (adoption, time-to-value, cycle time, ROI) and hold the pod accountable to them.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with confident client-facing presence and strong presentation skills.
* Ability to diagram intermediate-to-complex process flows and identify efficiency opportunities.
* Proficiency with core productivity tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio/Draw.io) and CRM/PSA tooling (e.g., Salesforce).
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent applicable experience.

**AI & Technology Fluency**

* Hands-on, practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate delivery work, and the ability to coach others in doing the same.
* Comfort operating and enforcing a human-in-the-loop model — reviewing, validating, and correcting AI-generated outputs before they reach clients.
* Working understanding of how AI agents and automated workflows apply to onboarding, configuration, and reporting (formal AI/ML background not required).

**Preferred, Not Required**

* Experience with AI-assisted meeting transcription/summarization tools (e.g., Copilot, Glean, Claude).
* Exposure to no-code/low-code automation (e.g., Zapier, Power Automate) or agentic workflow builders.
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) or Six Sigma (Green Belt+).

title: Associate Account Manager

title: Senior Principal Advanced Services Engineer(Senior Oracle WebLogic / SOA Administrator)
description:
**About the Company / Team**

Join Oracle’s Customer Success organization in a services and support role focused on enterprise Oracle database environments. Work with customers and global engineering and support teams across time zones to maintain availability, reliability, customer satisfaction and engineering quality.

**Job Title: Senior Oracle WebLogic / SOA Administrator**  
**Experience: 10+ years**  
**Role Overview**  
We are looking for an experienced Oracle WebLogic / SOA Administrator to manage enterprise middleware environments. The role involves installation, configuration, production support, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and ensuring the availability, security, and reliability of business-critical applications.
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, administer, and maintain Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle SOA Suite across development, testing, and production environments.
* Manage WebLogic domains, clusters, Administration Servers, Managed Servers, and Node Manager.
* Administer SOA components, including BPEL, Mediator, adapters, workflows, and Oracle Service Bus (OSB).
* Configure and troubleshoot JDBC data sources, connection pools, JMS servers, queues, topics, and persistent stores.
* Deploy applications and SOA composites; manage configuration changes, release activities, and rollback procedures.
* Monitor middleware health, investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis, and resolve production issues within agreed SLAs.
* Analyze JVM behavior, garbage collection, thread dumps, and heap dumps to resolve performance and stability issues.
* Plan and execute middleware patching, upgrades, migrations, and security remediation.
* Configure SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores, authentication providers, and role-based access.
* Implement and maintain high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Automate administration and monitoring tasks using WLST, Python, and shell scripting.
* Collaborate with application, database, infrastructure, network, and security teams.
* Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in on-call support and planned maintenance activities; mentor junior administrators.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in middleware administration, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle SOA Suite.
* Strong experience supporting clustered, highly available production environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Service Bus, SOA composite deployment, fault recovery, instance monitoring, and repository maintenance.
* Experience with SOA dehydration stores, MDS repositories, and coordination with DBAs on database-related issues.
* Strong understanding of Linux/Unix administration, networking fundamentals, DNS, load balancing, and HTTP/HTTPS.
* Proven troubleshooting skills across application, middleware, JVM, database connectivity, and infrastructure layers.
* Experience with Oracle Enterprise Manager / Fusion Middleware Control and monitoring tools.
* Proficiency in WLST and shell scripting; working knowledge of Python.
* Experience with incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
* Strong communication, documentation, stakeholder coordination, and technical ownership skills.

  

This role is for IC4/IC4.5/IC5
