title: 4772-Manager - GTM Enablement
description:
**Go to Market at Innovaccer**

Our GTM team is passionate about healthcare and wants to leave a positive impact in the ecosystem. We are the tip of the spear that leads the organization externally. We care deeply about our customers and want to resolve their challenges with our solutions. If this excites you, let's chat about how you can help us tell our special story.

**About the Role**

The Manager, GTM Enablement owns the day-to-day execution of Innovaccer’s GTM readiness programs, from new-hire onboarding and certifications to live enablement sessions, learning platforms, and readiness reporting. The role reports to the Head of GTM Enablement and works closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and GTM Operations.

Innovaccer’s sellers and customer-facing teams sell a multi-product platform in a market that changes every quarter, and Growth Enablement makes sure they are ready for it. This is a hands-on role. The Manager runs programs directly, administers the systems behind them, and helps shape how readiness is measured and improved.

* **Operational Scalability:** Builds repeatable playbooks, modular training, and a consistent governance model that work across business lines and buyer segments. This lets the GTM engine take on new products and headcount without rebuilding enablement each time.
* **Higher Program Adoption and Accountability:** Tracks and follows up on enablement and certification completion in the LMS and through frontline managers. Programs actually reach the field, and leadership can see readiness by team and role.
* **Improved Onboarding Experience and Retention**: Coordinates cohort logistics, schedules, materials, and buddy programs so new hires feel supported from day one.
* **Clean Data and Insights:** Keeps enablement dashboards accurate across every product line and GTM role. It does this by tagging content consistently by product, buyer type, and sales stage, keeping user records in the LMS and content platform clean, and compiling baseline performance metrics. Leadership can then trust the readiness data it uses to make decisions.
* **Consistent Quality Control:** Reviews training modules and content in the sales repository before they reach customer-facing teams. Each piece is checked to reflect Innovaccer’s approved brand voice and messaging, cleared proof points, and customer referenceability rules, so sellers never take outdated or unvalidated claims into health system and payer conversations.

**A Day in the Life**

* **New Hire Onboarding & Ramp:** Help design and run onboarding for new GTM hires across Sales and Marketing. This includes kickoff sessions, platform orientation, structured learning paths, and 30-60-90 day milestones that get new hires to full productivity faster.
* **Certification & Competency Assessment:** Support the certification lifecycle and own its execution. Working from scenarios and scoring rubrics defined by GTM Enablement leadership and sales leaders, the Manager builds and configures certifications in the learning platform, including AI role-play certifications (for example, an executive pitch delivered to an AI buyer persona) and live, juried certifications. The role schedules and runs attempts, coordinates coach feedback, maintains scorecards, and tracks completion and proficiency, flagging learners who need a recertification or additional support.
* **Enablement Program Design & Facilitation:** Run the weekly virtual enablement sessions that keep the field current on product launches, releases, pricing, and messaging. You will take each session from intake and leader approval through presenter prep, dry runs, live facilitation, and the recap, recording, and collateral that follow.
* **Learning Platform Administration:** Administer our learning platforms (Mindtickle and Docebo/Innovaccer Academy). Onboard learners, structure content and learning paths, maintain our Sales Enablement Hub, and build simulations. You will also manage vendor relationships and platform access.
* **Learning Analytics & Readiness Reporting:** Track attendance, completion, certification results, and proficiency. Work with GTM Operations to build readiness metrics and dashboards for leadership and sales managers, and use the data to spot skill gaps and show whether enablement is changing field performance.
* **Compliance & Required Training:** Deliver and track customer-mandated and company-required training for customer-facing employees, including assessments and completion reporting.

**What You Need**

* 5 to 8 years in sales enablement, GTM enablement, learning operations, or training program management, ideally supporting a B2B enterprise sales team
* Hands-on experience administering an LMS or sales readiness platform (Mindtickle, Docebo, Highspot, Seismic, or similar)
* Experience designing and running certifications, role-plays, or skills assessments with sales leaders
* Strong facilitation and project management skills. You are comfortable running a live session with senior presenters and managing many programs at once
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and a comfort with data. You can build a tracker, pull a report, and explain what it means
* Clear written communication. You can turn a product update into a recap or learning path a seller will actually use
* Familiarity with healthcare, health IT, or enterprise SaaS selling is a plus

 **Benefits**

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

**Here’s What We Offer**

  

* Generous Leave Benefits: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical Leave Policy: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.

Creche Facility for children\*: Say goodbye to worries and hello to a convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well-being first. \*India offices  

**Where and how we work**

Our Noida office is situated in a posh techspace, equipped with various amenities to support our work environment. Here, we follow a five-day work schedule, allowing us to efficiently carry out our tasks and collaborate effectively within our team.

title: mutual fund relationship manager
company: Seeman Fiintouch LLP & Asset Kraft Investments Private Limited
description:
Job Description – Mutual Fund Relationship Manager

**Department:**
Sales & Relationship Management

**Designation:**
Mutual Fund Relationship Manager

**Reporting To:**
Branch Manager / Sales Head

**Experience:**
2–5 Years (Preferred)

**Industry:**
Mutual Fund / Financial Services / Wealth Management

1. Job Purpose

To develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective investors, promote mutual fund investment products, generate business through new client acquisition, and ensure excellent customer service while achieving assigned business targets.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Client Acquisition & Business Development**

* Identify and acquire new investors for mutual fund products.
* Generate business through references, networking, cold calling, and market visits.
* Promote SIP, lump-sum investments, STP, SWP, and other mutual fund solutions.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly business targets, including SIP and AUM growth.
* Develop and maintain a strong investor database.

**B. Client Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Regularly connect with investors to understand their financial goals and investment requirements.
* Provide appropriate mutual fund product information based on clients' risk profiles and investment objectives.
* Conduct regular portfolio reviews and provide service support.
* Handle client queries, complaints, and investment-related concerns.

**C. Product Knowledge & Advisory Support**

* Maintain sound knowledge of mutual fund schemes, market trends, and investment products.
* Explain scheme features, risk factors, fund performance, and investment processes to clients.
* Assist investors with informed investment decisions in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with the research and investment teams for product-related updates.

**D. Documentation & Operations**

* Ensure timely completion of KYC, account opening, SIP registration, and transaction documentation.
* Coordinate with the operations team for purchase, redemption, switch, and other investment-related transactions.
* Maintain accurate client records and update CRM regularly.
* Ensure compliance with SEBI, AMFI, and internal company policies.

**E. Reporting & Performance Management**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
* Track individual business performance against assigned targets.
* Monitor SIP book, AUM growth, client acquisition, and client retention.
* Participate in sales meetings, product training, and business review sessions.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly business generation and AUM mobilisation.
* Number of new investor acquisitions.
* Monthly SIP registrations and SIP book growth.
* Client retention and relationship management.
* Lead conversion ratio.
* Number of client meetings and follow-ups.
* Revenue generation and target achievement.
* CRM updates and operational accuracy.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong sales, negotiation, and convincing abilities.
* Good knowledge of mutual fund products and financial markets.
* Customer relationship and client-handling skills.
* Business development and networking capabilities.
* Target-oriented approach and problem-solving ability.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, CRM, and basic computer applications.

5. Educational Qualifications

* Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA in Finance/Marketing will be an added advantage.
* NISM certification relevant to mutual fund distribution, as applicable to the role.

6. Experience Requirements

* 2–5 years of experience in mutual fund sales, wealth management, financial services, or investment advisory.
* Experience in handling HNI, retail, and corporate clients will be an advantage.
* Prior experience in SIP and AUM mobilisation is preferred.

title: Area Manager - Micra Specialist (Leadless Pacemaker)
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
Micra Specialist- Working around focus product in East with key customer in alignment with sales for Micra therapy adoption and skill building.
  
  
The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) business delivers therapies that help manage heart rhythm disorders through implantable pacing and cardiac monitoring technologies. This role supports the expansion of leadless pacing therapy, partnering with physicians, hospitals, and healthcare systems to increase adoption and improve patient access to advanced cardiac care.
  
  
This position covers East India and Chhattisgarh and requires management of a large, multi-state territory. The role is field-based with extensive customer engagement across hospitals, cardiac centers, and healthcare institutions. Travel is expected up to 60% of the time.
  
  
**Job Description Field**
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales growth, market development, and therapy adoption across the assigned territory. The role works closely with Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, hospital stakeholders, distributors, and key opinion leaders to expand access to Cardiac Rhythm Management therapies while achieving business objectives.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Drive sales performance and achieve annual operating plan targets across the assigned territory.
* Build and strengthen relationships with Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, hospital administrators, and other healthcare stakeholders.
* Develop and execute territory plans to increase adoption of leadless pacing and Cardiac Rhythm Management therapies.
* Identify new business opportunities, assess customer needs, and deliver appropriate product and therapy solutions.
* Manage key accounts, key opinion leaders, and distributor partnerships to support sustainable business growth.
* Analyze market trends, competitive activity, customer dynamics, and account potential to prioritize opportunities.
* Lead physician education, therapy awareness, and market development initiatives to expand therapy penetration.
* Maintain accurate sales reporting, customer records, and completion of required compliance and product training.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience\*
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience\*
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience\*

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Cardiac Rhythm Management devices, Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI), Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR), or Impella therapies.
* Experience managing corporate and government healthcare accounts.
* IBHRE Certified Cardiac Device Specialist (CCDS) certification.
* Understanding of electrophysiology procedures, pacing therapies, and catheterization laboratory environments.
* Experience leading therapy adoption and market development initiatives within cardiology.

**Physical Job Requirements**

title: Risk Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a
**Risk Analyst with 4–6 years of experience**
to join our family office’s investment team. The role will be responsible for monitoring and analysing risk across the family’s consolidated investment portfolio covering multiple entities, asset classes and geographies.

The portfolio includes equities, fixed income, mutual funds, PMS/AIFs, alternative investments, private markets, commodities and overseas investments.

The Risk Analyst will develop and maintain portfolio risk analytics, monitor risk limits and concentrations, conduct VaR, sensitivity and stress-testing analysis, assess liquidity and drawdowns, and evaluate the impact of new investments on the overall portfolio. The candidate will also work closely with the investment, operations and technology teams to implement the risk management framework through the technology platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Portfolio Risk Monitoring**

* Monitor risk at
  **instrument, asset-class and consolidated portfolio levels**
  .
* Track compliance with the approved
  **Investment Policy Statement (IPS)**
  and Pools of Capital framework.
* Monitor concentrations across securities, sectors, issuers, asset classes and investment managers.
* Identify emerging risks and highlight significant changes to senior management.
* Maintain
  **Green / Amber / Red**
  risk indicators and escalation triggers.

**2. VaR, Sensitivity and Stress Testing**

* Develop and maintain
  **Parametric VaR at 95% and 99% confidence levels**
  .
* Calculate VaR at instrument, asset-class and portfolio levels.
* Analyse risk contribution and diversification across investments.
* Conduct sensitivity analysis for:
* Equities
* Fixed Income
* Commodities including Gold, Silver, Metals and Agri
* Develop historical and hypothetical stress scenarios and assess their impact on the portfolio.
* Identify the key instruments and asset classes contributing to losses under stress scenarios.

**3. Exposure and Look-through Analysis**

* Analyse direct and indirect portfolio exposures across mutual funds, ETFs, PMS and other pooled vehicles.
* Calculate the family’s
  **effective exposure to individual securities and sectors**
  after considering underlying fund holdings.
* Monitor:
* Top security exposures
* Top sector exposures
* Corporate-group concentration
* Manager / AMC concentration
* Track the percentage of the portfolio for which underlying look-through information is available.

**4. Liquidity, Funding and Leverage Risk**

* Monitor portfolio liquidity and classify investments based on expected liquidation periods.
* Track unfunded commitments, expected capital calls and upcoming funding requirements.
* Monitor borrowings, collateral, LTV, financing costs and maturity profiles.
* Assess whether portfolio obligations can be met without requiring forced sale of long-term investments.

**5. Performance and Drawdown Risk**

Calculate and monitor at instrument, asset-class and portfolio levels:

* Returns
* Volatility
* Sharpe Ratio
* Sortino Ratio
* Maximum Drawdown
* Current Drawdown
* Recovery Period

Compare performance against relevant benchmarks and identify investments where returns are not adequately compensating for the risk taken.

**6. Cost and Investment-Level Risk**

* Develop an
  **all-in cost framework**
  covering TER / management fees, performance fees, platform/advisory charges, custody costs, financing costs, hedging costs and other applicable charges.
* Calculate all-in cost at the investment level and weighted cost at the portfolio level.
* Develop and monitor a
  **Mandatory Review / Stop-loss framework**
  .
* Identify investments requiring review due to:
* Significant drawdown
* Persistent underperformance
* Rating downgrade
* Covenant or governance issues
* Material deterioration in the investment thesis

The framework should trigger a formal review and not automatically result in a sale.

**7. Pre-Investment Portfolio Risk Assessment**

* Assess the portfolio impact of proposed investments before capital is committed.
* Compare the portfolio
  **before and after the proposed investment**
  across:
* IPS and Pool headroom
* VaR
* Sharpe / Sortino
* Stress loss
* Liquidity
* Security / sector concentration
* Risk contribution
* Portfolio cost
* Highlight whether the proposed investment is expected to
  **improve, remain neutral to, or worsen the overall portfolio risk profile**
  .

**8. Risk Reporting and Technology Implementation**

* Prepare monthly and quarterly risk reports for senior management and the Investment Committee.
* Develop concise dashboards covering VaR, stress risk, liquidity, concentration, drawdowns, costs and open risk actions.
* Work with the technology/vendor team to automate the risk management framework.
* Support migration of validated Excel risk models into the technology platform.
* Validate data received from portfolio systems such as
  **MProfit**
  .
* Reconcile Excel calculations with production-system outputs.
* Maintain documentation of risk methodologies, assumptions and calculation processes.

**9. Have knowledge of credit risk**

**Collaboration and Communication**

* Work closely with asset-class owners across Equity, Fixed Income and Alternatives.
* Coordinate with Operations to ensure completeness and accuracy of portfolio data.
* Work with Technology / external vendors for implementation of the risk platform.
* Present key risks, exceptions and analytical findings clearly to senior management and the Investment Committee.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
  **Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a related field**
  .
* **4–6 years of relevant experience**
  in portfolio risk, investment risk, asset management, wealth management, family office, treasury or a related role.
* **FRM, CFA or progress toward either qualification is preferred.**
* Strong understanding of:
* VaR
* Volatility
* Correlation and covariance
* Sensitivity analysis
* Stress testing
* Drawdown analysis
* Sharpe and Sortino ratios
* Portfolio diversification
* Good understanding of multiple asset classes, including equities, fixed income, mutual funds, alternatives and commodities.
* Advanced proficiency in
  **Microsoft Excel**
  .
* Working knowledge of
  **Python, SQL, Power BI or similar tools**
  would be an advantage.
* Familiarity with Bloomberg or other market-data platforms would be preferred.
* Strong quantitative, analytical and communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex risk analysis into clear and practical insights for senior management.

This role offers an opportunity to play an important part in building and institutionalising the
**risk management framework of a family office**
, covering both portfolio analytics and technology implementation.

title: Manager - Regulatory and Commercial
description:
**About the Role**

This role is responsible for supporting the team by executing essential regulatory tasks, initiating compliance procedures, and maintaining effective communication both internally and externally. This role is pivotal role for ensuring smooth operation within the regulatory framework of the power.

**Responsibilities**

**Policy Advocacy and Regulatory Compliance**

* Assist in monitoring policy developments and regulatory changes that may impact the organization's operations.
* Support efforts to ensure that the organization's practices align with current regulations and legislative requirements.
* Help gather information and contribute to internal discussions on how sector regulations and government interventions may affect the organization.
* Aid in the preparation of compliance documentation and reports, ensuring that all business activities adhere to regulatory standards.
* Stay up-to-date with changes in legislation and regulatory requirements, and assist in communicating these changes to relevant departments within the organization.

**Due Diligence and Research**

* Conduct due diligence for mergers and acquisitions (M&A) from a regulatory perspective, preparing notes and presentations for the Business Development (BD) team.
* Perform regulatory research by reviewing updates from regulatory websites such as the Ministry of Power (MOP) to identify new draft notifications, regulations, or policies.
* Support compliance efforts by contributing to the development and maintenance of internal controls and procedures.

**Litigation Coordination and Petition Drafting**

* Coordinate with advocates, briefing them on regulatory litigation matters, and ensure timely submission of petitions.
* Brief legal firms on specific cases and assist with in-house drafting of petitions by compiling information and ensuring logical presentation.
* If law firms are drafting petitions, provide a first draft or a comprehensive information bucket for their use.
* Manage administrative tasks related to litigation, such as obtaining certified copies of legal documents.

**Internal MIS and Reporting**

* Prepare internal MIS reports listing cases pending before the court, categorizing them by criticality, forum, and plant, and disseminate to promoters.
* Compile monthly reports detailing judgments passed, new guidelines from state or central regulators, and other relevant updates.
* Conduct weekly review meetings to discuss regulatory cases and develop strategies based on direction from the Head/ Chief of Energy Regulatory and Commercial group (ERCG).
* Monitor the progression of regulatory cases, keeping detailed records of filings, hearings, and judgments.
* Assist in the preparation and organization of legal documents required for regulatory submissions and correspondence.

**Billing and Revenue Management**

* Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.
* Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
* Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers
* Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.
* Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.
* Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.
* Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.

**Payment Tracking and Dispute Resolution**

* Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.
* In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.
* Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.
* Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.
* Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.

**Portal Management**

* Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.
* Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.
* Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.
* Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.
* Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.

**Financial Reporting and Reconciliation**

* Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.
* Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.
* Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.

**Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification**

* B.E./ B.Tech/ Masters ( Power Management, related field), Additional Certifications in regulatory affairs or compliance preferred

**Work Experience (Range of years)**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in regulatory compliance, preferably in power and transmission or related field.

**Preferred Industry**

* Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to power and transmission industry, with an understanding of regulatory challenges and compliance mechanisms.

title: AVP Branch Asset Specialist
description:

f you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
**Wealth and Personal Banking**
is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking, to become one of the world’s largest global wealth managers with USD1.4 trillion in assets. Across Asia, where wealth pools are growing faster than in any other region, HSBC’s wealth revenues grew 12% in 2019 (year-on-year) to USD5.7 billion. Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking that best suit our customers’ needs.
  
  
**Role Purpose**

* The bank primarily depends on the asset products (Mortgage) to build its assets business. Identifying new Product Opportunities.
* The assets business is extremely technical and with each region of India operating under different local regulations.
* The Asset specialist is a subject matter expert with hardcore domain experience in Mortgage, is needed for the fulfillment of asset product applications sourced from Global Private Banking customer, open market / DSA channel for customers who are Ultra High Net Worth Individual (UHNI) and Existing Premier Customers or New Premier Criteria Alike and ensure seamless processing of these applications within the system.
* It involves interaction with various stakeholders both within HSBC and outside of HSBC (Risk Team, Builders, Societies, Legal Team etc.)
* Identifying, structuring, negotiating and underwriting complex / high value new credit opportunities for UHNW / Global Priority Clients/Family Offices

**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**
Impact on the Business / Function
  
  

* Responsible for new business acquisition and identifying sales opportunities through Existing Premier and Non-Premier clients of the Branch and Premier Alike clients through open market to achieve sales target
* Should have a strong Customer management and experience skills to help both Internal and External Clients.
* Sound knowledge about real estate market and title documents of the property, Mortgage product and policy.
* Effective co-ordination with internal & external stakeholders eg, Collateral Management, Credit Risk and Underwriting, Digital Business Solutions, Global Service Centres, Legal, Compliance, Fraud, etc.
* Identify cross-sell opportunities for other product lines and sell / refer these to the Relationship Managers (RM)
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities.
* Demonstrate an understanding of Politically Exposed Person (PEP) acceptance, prohibition, Customer Due Diligence (CDD) & Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) guidelines in order to ensure that the INM WPB is fully compliant with the PEP Line of Business Procedures (LoBP).
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile, else raise it to line manager for further clarification.
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner.
* Back-end support to Branch RMs in the End-To-End process of sourcing to disbursal of any asset product applications. Regular monitoring of status of logged in applications.

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Internal – Credit Risk and Underwriting, Digital Business Solution, Global Service Centre, Collateral Management Unit, Legal, Compliance, Fraud, & Branch staff
* External – Customers, Lead Generators (if applicable)

**Leadership**
**& Teamwork**

* Developmental & coaching intervention for the branch RMs
* Effective co-ordination with all stakeholders
* Identify cross-sell opportunities for other product lines and sell / refer these to the RMs and Universal Bankers in the Branch.

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Discrepancy rates in applications
* Fraud control
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM WPB is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM WPB example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM WPB customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps need to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile, else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Major Challenges**

* The Asset Specialist will play a crucial & challenging role in increasing business & Staff Activation of the branches.
* With branch staff having limited expertise in handling complex Asset product applications, the incumbent will also play the role of a coach & mentor for the RMs.
* The role holder will need to display effective working capabilities in handling these challenges in a dynamic environment.

**Role Context**

* The assets business accounts for major share of INM’s retail lending portfolio. It has been identified as an area of focus and is expected to be a key contributor to profitability going forward.
* The branch sourced assets products are expected to contribute 50-70% of monthly disbursals.
* A strong and effective specialist role will need to be in place to ensure that this source of business is not at risk.
* By participating in all aspects of the sales process, the incumbent of this position will be a key contributor to the achievement of these targets.

**Management of Risk**

* Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.

**Observation of Internal Controls**

* Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.

**Role Dimensions**

* Primary responsibility for them is to help Relationship Manager achieve KPI targets in mortgage and achieve their own mortgage targets by ensuring seamless asset product disbursals
* The incumbent would effectively carry the direct accountability for achieving assets disbursals of the Branch reporting directly into the Branch Manager or the Mortgage Sales Manager.

**Qualifications - External**

* Graduate with 3 + years of experience

**Knowledge / Experience**

* Demonstrate behaviours consistent with HSBC Values
* Proven adherence to controls and compliance with no significant breaches
* Market/Competition Product Knowledge
* In depth understanding of the bank’s assets sourcing and disbursal process

**Skills**

* Organising skills & Problem solving skills

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:
Synchronoss Technologies, a global leader in personal Cloud solutions, empowers service providers to establish secure and meaningful connections with their subscribers. Synchronoss is seeking an experienced Desktop Engineer I.

The Desktop Support Engineer I installs, configures, supports, monitors, tests, and troubleshoots end-user hardware, software, and peripherals. The role supports Windows and Apple devices, approved business applications, network connectivity, collaboration tools, and related workplace technology. Working under established procedures and escalation paths, the specialist resolves incidents and service requests, documents work accurately, supports device lifecycle activities, and helps maintain a secure and reliable end-user computing environment.

How you will help:

**Essential Functions**

* Provides World Class Customer Service to internal and external customers.

* Creates, updates, and resolves incidents and service requests in the approved IT service management system, maintaining accurate notes, categorization, status, and resolution details.
* Supports the creation, maintenance, and implementation of procedures for identifying, receiving, documenting, assigning, escalating, and resolving technical issues.
* Ensures project documents are complete, current and stored appropriately.
* Assigns, documents, and maintains computer logins, certificates, passwords, and access profiles for software applications, network access, and telecommunications systems.
* Configures, deploys, and supports workstations, laptops, mobile devices, docks, and approved peripherals in accordance with organizational standards, security requirements, and device lifecycle procedures.
* Diagnoses and resolves hardware, operating system, application, connectivity, printing, peripheral, and endpoint performance issues. Coordinates repair or replacement when an issue cannot be resolved remotely or at the workstation.
* Provides responsive support for executives and other designated users across laptops, mobile devices, collaboration tools, conference rooms, and related workplace technology, following established escalation and communication procedures.
* Coordinates with Human Resources, hiring managers, and other stakeholders to prepare, issue, recover, and document devices and access for employee onboarding, transfers, and offboarding.
* Applies approved endpoint security controls, including device encryption, security software, certificates, configuration policies, and asset identification, in accordance with organizational standards.
* Assists with identifying potential security issues, follows approved containment and escalation procedures, and promptly reports suspected incidents to the appropriate security team.
* Coordinates third-party maintenance for hardware and software.
* Responds to needs and questions of users concerning their access of network resources.
* Writes process and procedural documentation including requirements.
* Makes self-available to other staff members as a source of information.
* Maintains accurate inventory and lifecycle records for computers, mobile devices, peripherals, accessories, assigned users, locations, warranties, and disposition status.

Who we have in mind:

**Work Experience Requirements**

* Typically requires one to two years of related technical support experience. Hands-on experience supporting end-user devices, software, peripherals, and basic connectivity issues is preferred.
* Works under general supervision, follows established procedures, and escalates unfamiliar or higher-risk issues while developing independent troubleshooting judgment.
* Relies on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job.
* Familiar with a variety of the field's concepts, practices, and procedures.
* Requires a high level of technical skill in field of expertise
* Experience supporting current Microsoft Windows and Apple macOS operating systems, including common productivity, collaboration, security, and device-management workflows.
* Knowledge of endpoint hardware, docks, displays, printers, peripherals, and common diagnostic and replacement procedures.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 or comparable productivity and collaboration platforms, including email, calendaring, document tools, messaging, and virtual meetings.
* Basic knowledge of wired and wireless networking, VPN connectivity, authentication, name resolution, and common endpoint connectivity troubleshooting.
* Basic knowledge of cloud-based email and calendaring systems, account configuration, mobile synchronization, and common client troubleshooting.

It would be great if you had:

* Typically requires two or more years of college-level coursework or completion of an information technology trade school program. Relevant certifications or at least two years of equivalent technical support experience may be considered in place of formal education.

**Analytical/Interpersonal Skills**

* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Uses established procedures and sound judgment to prioritize work, troubleshoot routine issues, protect company assets and information, and determine when escalation is required.
* Sets priorities based on workload.

**Physical/Environmental Demands**

* Must be able to safely lift, carry, and move equipment weighing up to 75 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* This position may require weekend & evening hours.

**Job Description**

**Technical Support Engineer**

*Enterprise Storage Platforms*

**Shift**
– 24/7

**Work Location**
– Bangalore, Brookfield office. Cab will be provided to the candidates within 25KM range only.

**Work Model: Bangalore**
WFO

**Experience**
: 4-7 years

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join our enterprise storage support team in a high-touch, mission-critical environment. This role is a great fit for someone with solid hands-on experience in enterprise storage and infrastructure troubleshooting who genuinely enjoys solving complex customer problems.

You will work on real-world issues across storage platforms and associated infrastructure, supporting customers through phone, email, chat, and remote sessions. You'll be expected to own cases end to end, communicate clearly under pressure, and bring structured thinking to every troubleshooting scenario.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide technical support to enterprise customers on complex storage and infrastructure issues across a global 24x7 model.
* Own cases end to end, from initial triage through troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and resolution.
* Diagnose problems spanning storage protocols, host connectivity, controller behaviour, performance symptoms, platform interoperability, and more.
* Troubleshoot any HW and SW issues that comes up during ongoing platform use.
* Manage customer communication with professionalism and urgency, especially during business-impacting situations.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams including escalation teams, engineering, and customer stakeholders to drive timely outcomes.
* Maintain high-quality case notes, action plans, and technical documentation throughout the support lifecycle.
* Adhere to SLA targets, escalation protocols, and quality standards consistently.

**Required Experience**

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in technical support, infrastructure support, and enterprise storage support.
* Solid track record in customer-facing troubleshooting roles within enterprise IT environments.
* Demonstrated hands-on understanding of enterprise storage concepts and troubleshooting methodology.

**Technical Skills**

* **Storage:**
  Strong working knowledge of SAN and NAS environments (protocols - FC, iSCSI, NFS, and CIFS/SMB), including RAID, high availability, controller architecture, disk behaviour, and failover concepts.
* **OS:**
  Good working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration fundamentals.
* **Virtualization:**
  Familiarity with VMware or similar virtualization platforms and their integration with storage.
* **Networking:**
  Good grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* **Diagnostics:**
  Ability to analyze logs, alerts, symptoms, and customer-reported behaviour to isolate the root cause or likely fault domain.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience supporting enterprise storage platforms such as NetApp ONTAP, FAS / AFF controllers, StorageGRID, E-Series, or equivalent (Dell EMC, HPE, Pure, IBM, Hitachi).
* Prior experience in managed service or enterprise support environments handling platform or infrastructure incidents.
* Familiarity with critical case management, and ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or equivalent).

**How You Work**

* You communicate clearly, written and verbal and can hold your own during high-pressure customer conversations.
* You set expectations well and follow through, even when resolution timelines are uncertain.
* You stay composed during escalations and apply structured thinking rather than guesswork.
* You take ownership seriously and don't pass problems without context.
* You work well with distributed, cross-functional teams across time zones.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education:**

* Proficiency in networking concepts (LAN/WAN, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and Google Workspace / Microsoft 365.

**Work Details & Compensation**

* **Work Days:**
  Monday to Saturday (Saturdays Half a day)
* **Work Timing:**
  10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary based on industry standards and experience (fuel/travel allowance for official errands provided).

**Job Description**

Capability Based Planning - Practitioner

Level – 26/27

The Capability based planning - Practitioner is an individual contributor associated with the Enterprise Architecture Team within the Align Pillar . Working within methods, priorities and governance established by the Capability-Based Planning and Execution Lead, the role gathers evidence, analyzes capability maturity and develops architecture views that connect business capabilities with processes, information, applications, data, integrations, platforms and enabling technologies.

This role is accountable for the quality, traceability and currency of assigned capability-analysis and architecture artifacts. It does not own the enterprise capability-planning framework, assessment methodology, multi-year planning cycle, investment prioritization, executive alignment, governance decisions or cross-domain execution; those accountabilities remain with the Capability-Based Planning and Execution Lead.

**Job Responsibilities**

• Apply approved capability maps, value-stream structures, maturity criteria and heatmap conventions to assigned capability areas.

• Gather, validate and document evidence across people, process, technology and data dimensions using assessment criteria defined by the Capability-Based Planning and Execution Lead.

• Map assigned capabilities to supporting processes, applications, data, integrations, infrastructure and technology services, and maintain traceable relationships in the architecture repository.

• Translate approved assessment findings into architecture options, transition views, dependencies and measurable outcome statements for lead and domain-architect review.

• Develop current-state, target-state and transition architecture views for assigned capability areas using approved standards and templates.

• Analyze maturity evidence to identify capability gaps, root causes, interdependencies and improvement opportunities, and provide findings to inform lead-owned roadmap and investment prioritization.

• Supply validated architecture inputs and dependency information to portfolio and domain teams for incorporation into roadmaps and plans owned by those teams.

• Conduct discovery sessions and working meetings to capture evidence, assumptions, decisions and unresolved questions; escalate matters requiring governance or executive alignment.

• Maintain assigned capability and architecture artifacts in the approved enterprise architecture repository, including relationships, metadata, status and supporting evidence.

• Produce factual maturity and architecture reporting for assigned capabilities, highlighting evidence gaps, dependencies, risks and items requiring lead review.

• Represent Enterprise Architecture in tool, vendor and RFP assessments associated with capability-maturity evolution, evaluating capability fit, architecture alignment, interoperability, data, security, scalability, resilience, lifecycle sustainability and technical risk; document findings and recommendations for the accountable sourcing, domain and governance decision makers.

• Analyze the application, data, integration, security, platform and infrastructure implications of approved capability outcomes with the relevant domain architects.

• Assist in the authoring of enterprise blueprints, reference architectures, and golden paths that standardize the software development lifecycle (SDLC) across all business units.

• Document SDLC and DevOps dependencies when an assigned capability change affects engineering delivery, then coordinate with the accountable platform or engineering owner.

• Champion and promote the modernization of legacy governance processes, converting manual, gate-based approvals into automated, telemetry-driven continuous assurance.

**Basic Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, business, engineering or related discipline.

• 3+ years of relevant experience in business architecture, enterprise architecture, business analysis, product strategy, capability planning or technology road mapping.

• Practical experience applying established capability models, maturity criteria, heatmaps, value streams and architecture methods to assigned analysis.

• Ability to gather, validate, structure and document evidence across people, process, technology and data dimensions using defined criteria.

• Ability to connect business outcomes to application, data, integration, platform, security and infrastructure implications.

• Experience developing architecture options and current-state, target-state and transition views from approved assessment findings.

• Experience maintaining traceability among capabilities, processes, applications, data, integrations, infrastructure and technology services.

• Ability to prepare objective value, risk, readiness, technical-debt, cost and capacity analysis that informs decisions made by accountable leaders.

• Strong discovery facilitation, analytical thinking, visual storytelling and stakeholder communication skills, including clear escalation of unresolved matters.

• Experience maintaining architecture and roadmap artifacts with clear metadata, evidence, assumptions, dependencies and status.

• Experience with architecture or planning tools such as LeanIX, Ardoq, Alfabet, Visio, Jira, Azure DevOps, PowerPoint or Power BI.

• Ability to produce concise, evidence-based architecture recommendations and reporting for lead, domain-architect and portfolio review.

• Working knowledge of modern technology delivery, including SDLC and DevOps concepts, sufficient to assess roadmap dependencies and collaborate with engineering specialists.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Master’s degree or MBA in a relevant discipline.

• TOGAF, Business Architecture Guild, product management, Agile or related training.

• Experience in life sciences or another regulated industry.

• Familiarity with portfolio planning, investment prioritization and benefits measurement.

• Experience using LeanIX or another enterprise architecture repository and Power BI or an equivalent analytics platform.

• Experience creating reusable capability models, assessment templates, heatmaps, roadmap views, scorecards and architecture artifacts.

• Ability to identify shared-platform opportunities and application rationalization considerations through capability analysis.

• Practical AI literacy, including identifying appropriate AI-assisted opportunities, limitations, risks and required human oversight.

• Experience using approved AI capabilities responsibly while protecting confidential, personal, regulated and proprietary information.

• Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs, validate important conclusions against authoritative evidence and follow enterprise Responsible AI, security, privacy, legal and compliance requirements.

title: Head of IT & Operations Support
description:
Head of IT & Operations Support, India

*Machinify | IT & Site Operations*

**Location:** India (on-site at the primary Machinify India office)

**Reports to:** Global IT/Corporate Operations leadership (US-based), with a growth path toward an India Site Lead role

**Direct reports:** IT support staff and facilities/administrative operations staff based in India

**Employment type:** Full-time

**About Machinify**
===================

Machinify is a healthcare payment integrity company formed through the 2024–2025 mergers of Legacy Machinify, Apixio Payment Integrity (CPS/ClaimLogiq, including Varis), Rawlings Company (Right Payer Solutions), and Performant Health. As we integrate infrastructure and operations across four previously separate companies, our India office needs strong local IT and operations leadership to support a growing employee base and to lay the groundwork for a future site leadership function.

**Role Summary**
================

The Head of IT & Operations Support will own day-to-day IT infrastructure and facilities/administrative operations for Machinify's India office. This role is the local point of accountability for employee IT support, office operations, vendor management, and facilities, while also helping integrate India infrastructure with Machinify's broader (mixed cloud and on-premise) technology environment. Over time, and as the India presence grows, this role is expected to expand into a broader Site Lead position with additional people and operational responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**IT Infrastructure & Support**
-------------------------------

* Manage day-to-day IT operations for the India office: helpdesk/employee support, hardware and software provisioning, network and endpoint management.
* Support integration of India IT systems with Machinify's global infrastructure, which spans mixed cloud and on-premise environments across four legacy entities.
* Maintain IT security practices consistent with Machinify's compliance obligations (HITRUST r2; SOC 2 Type I & II where applicable) and healthcare data handling requirements (HIPAA, HITECH).
* Manage relationships with local IT vendors, ISPs, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers.
* Maintain IT asset inventory, licensing, and access management for the India site, coordinating with global IT and security teams.

**Facilities & Administrative Operations**
------------------------------------------

* Own facilities management for the India office: workspace planning, vendor contracts, office supplies, health and safety compliance.
* Coordinate administrative operations supporting the India team (travel, procurement, expense support, local vendor payments) in partnership with finance.
* Serve as the primary local point of contact for employee operational needs and office-related escalations.
* Support local onboarding/offboarding logistics for new hires in partnership with HR.

**Cross-Entity & Compliance Alignment**
---------------------------------------

* Help harmonize IT and operational policies inherited from separate legacy-entity infrastructures into a single, consistent India site standard.
* Partner with global security and compliance teams to maintain audit readiness (HITRUST, SOC 2) for India-based systems and operations.
* Flag and help manage any operational considerations relevant to Machinify's government-contract business (e.g., data handling requirements tied to ATO obligations), even where India operations do not directly support those contracts.

**Growth Into Site Leadership**
-------------------------------

* Build the operational and IT foundation expected of a full Site Lead role as India headcount grows.
* Take on expanded responsibilities over time, potentially including local HR liaison duties, employee engagement, and broader site governance.
* Partner with global leadership on workforce planning and site strategy as the India office scales.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* 8+ years in IT infrastructure/support and/or facilities/operations management, including 3+ years in a leadership or supervisory capacity.
* Experience managing IT operations in a hybrid cloud/on-premise environment.
* Experience working in or supporting a multi-site or multi-entity organization, ideally through a merger or integration.
* Strong vendor management, budgeting, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Comfortable operating with significant autonomy while maintaining close communication with US-based leadership across time zones.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience in a healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industry with exposure to HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST, or SOC 2 requirements.
* Prior experience as, or direct preparation for, a site leadership or office-head role.
* Experience supporting IT/operations during a company merger or post-acquisition integration.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Reliable, well-supported IT infrastructure and facilities operations for the India office.
* India IT systems and operational policies fully aligned with Machinify's global standards and compliance requirements.
* A demonstrated readiness to step into an expanded Site Lead role as the India office grows.

title: Automobile Technical Help Desk Executive
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Technical Help Desk Executive – ICE (Electrical & Mechanical)**

1. Position Overview

**Job Title**

Technical Help Desk Executive – ICE (Electrical & Mechanical)

**Department**

Technical Help Desk

**Target Qualification**

Diploma /B.Tech Pass-outs (Mechanical, Automobile,MVM, Electrician, Auto Electrician, Diesel Mech, 2W/3W Mech)

**Reporting To**

Manager / Manager Diagnostic center

**Work Location**

Centralized Technical Call Center / Diagnostic center

2. Role Purpose & Work Context

The Technical Help Desk Executive – ICE (Electrical & Mechanical) plays a vital role in delivering real-time, remote technical support to dealership Technicians and Technical coordinators across the nation. Operating in an advanced AI-enabled help desk environment, the executive receives inbound calls that are auto-classified by an AI Voice Bot into Electrical or Mechanical streams. The AI pre-logs structured tickets containing Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), vehicle details, and symptom summaries, pushing them via Screen Pop directly to the executive's monitor. The executive is responsible for guiding workshop technicians through systematic troubleshooting, coordinating with field teams, and achieving rapid ticket closure within target lead time SLAs.

3. Key Responsibilities3.1 Inbound Call Handling & AI Screen Pop Integration

· Attend pre-routed incoming technical calls from dealership technicians across regional zones.

· Review pre-populated CRM ticket summaries (auto-generated by Speech-to-Text AI) on screen before engaging with the technician.

· Validate caller identity, dealership location, vehicle model, and confirmed diagnostic symptoms.

3.2 Technical Diagnostics Support – ICE Electrical

· **Ignition & Charging Systems:** Guide mechanics through step-by-step testing of ignition coils, spark plug circuits, magneto/stator coil output, and rectifier/regulator (RR) units.

· **Wiring Harness & Continuity:** Assist in diagnosing short circuits, open circuits, earth grounding issues, and harness voltage drops using digital multimeters.

· **ECU & Sensor Diagnostics:** Analyze Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), interpret ECU flashing/re-mapping failures, and troubleshoot sensor signals (O2, Throttle Position Sensor, Engine Temp Sensor).

· **Battery & Digital Display:** Address parasitic battery drain issues, charging circuit faults, and digital instrument cluster communication errors.

3.3 Technical Diagnostics Support – ICE Mechanical

· **Engine Core & Head Assembly:** Provide remote troubleshooting for engine knocking/noises, valve clearance/tappet settings, compression loss, and piston/cylinder wear.

· **Transmission & Clutch:** Guide technicians on clutch slipping, hard gear shifting, gearbox noise, and clutch assembly tolerances.

· **Fuel Injection (FI) & Intake:** Troubleshoot electronic fuel pump pressure, fuel injector clogging, throttle body cleaning/calibration, and air-fuel ratio faults.

· **Brakes & Suspension:** Assist in hydraulic brake air-bleeding, ABS mechanical binding, front fork oil leakage, and rear shock absorber performance.

3.4 Field Team Coordination & Escalation Management

· Maintain continuous telephone/ticket coordination with Manager Technical support for chronic or critical field issues.

· Escalate to Product monitoring when remote phone diagnosis reaches a boundary limit.

· Escalate unresolved, high-complexity, or repeated technical failures to Level-3

· Log detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and component replacement codes into the CRM to enrich the Knowledge Base.

4. Candidate Profile & Eligibility Criteria

**Criteria Parameter**

**Eligibility Requirements**

**Educational Qualification**

ITI (Industrial Training Institute) National Trade Certificate (NTC) / SCVT in relevant trades.

**Approved ITI Trades**

* Mechanic Motor Vehicle (MMV)
* Electrician / Wireman
* Mechanic Auto Electrical & Electronics
* Diesel Mechanic
* Mechanic Two & Three Wheeler

**Experience Profile**

Work Experience / Apprenticeship at authorized 2W OEM Dealerships, Multi-brand Workshops, or Auto Service Centers is highly desirable.

**Age Criteria**

20 to 30 years at the time of joining.

**Language Skills**

* Proficient Spoken Hindi (Mandatory)
* Basic Working English (Ability to read circuit diagrams and manuals)
* Regional Languages (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali) are strong advantages.

5. Technical & Behavioral Competencies5.1 Technical Skills

· Hands-on familiarity with 2W engine overhauling, fuel injection systems, and drivetrain assemblies.

· Ability to read and interpret 2W electrical circuit wiring diagrams and schematic layouts.

· Skill in using workshop diagnostic tools (Multimeter, OBD-II scanner, compression gauge, fuel pressure gauge).

· Basic computer literacy (operating CRM software, viewing digital manuals, typing call notes).

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: IT Onsite Support Specialist
description:
**Create a better future!**

Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future? We believe we can develop technology and gain the knowledge to make that difference. We have launched our ambition, Mission Zero – enabling our customers to move towards zero emissions in mining We need your leadership skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. **The IT Onsite Support Specialist**
provides advanced onsite technical support for employees and IT

infrastructure across one or more assigned locations. This role serves as the primary onsite resource for all physical IT support activities and acts as the local extension of global IT teams, including Workplace Services, Network Services, and Platform Services. Unlike a traditional Help Desk or Level 1 support role, this position focuses on hands-on technical support, incident resolution, service request fulfillment, asset management, and onsite execution of IT initiatives requiring physical presence. The technician is responsible for maintaining a high level of

customer satisfaction while ensuring adherence to global IT standards, processes, and service levels. The technician operates as an integral part of a globally distributed IT team and may be managed remotely by a regional or global IT Manager. This is a 100% onsite position.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**End User Support**

• Resolve incidents and service requests assigned through ServiceNow, maintaining SLA

compliance at all times.

• Provide Level 2 technical support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, printers,

and meeting room technologies.

• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues requiring onsite physical

intervention.

• Coordinate with remote support teams and third-party vendors to resolve complex technical

issues.

• Ensure timely resolution of assigned tickets and maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation

in ServiceNow.

**Workplace Technology Support**

• Support Windows and mobile device (iOS/Android) environments in compliance with

enterprise standards.

• Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and replace end-user hardware including laptops, desktops,

and peripherals.

• Support conference rooms, audiovisual systems, printers, docking stations, and collaboration

technologies (e.g., Microsoft Teams Rooms).

• Perform hardware lifecycle management activities, including device refreshes, upgrades, and

decommissioning.

**Hands & Feet Support for Global IT Teams**

• Act as the onsite physical representative for Network, Platform, Security, and Workplace teams.

• Execute physical tasks as directed by remote engineering teams, including:

◦ Server installations, replacements, and hardware diagnostics.

◦ Maintain and rotate backup media in tape libraries

◦ Network equipment installation, cable tracing, and connectivity verification.

◦ Rack and stack activities and cable management in data closets and server rooms.

◦ Equipment reboots and smart hands support for remote engineers.

◦ Physical patching, labeling, and port verification.

**Asset & Inventory Management**

• Maintain accurate IT asset records within ServiceNow (CMDB / Asset Management module).

• Receive, inspect, register, and deploy new IT equipment; update inventory records upon

delivery.

• Conduct periodic physical inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies with CMDB data.

• Manage stock levels of consumables and provide timely feedback on inventory requirements.

• Coordinate equipment disposal and asset recovery in accordance with company policies and

data security standards.

**Employee Onboarding & Offboarding**

• Prepare, configure, and deploy equipment for new hires; ensure day-one readiness in

coordination with HR and People Operations.

• Recover devices, peripherals, and access cards from departing employees; wipe and reimage

equipment per policy.

• Update asset records and maintain full compliance with asset management and data handling

processes.

• Support employee moves, additions, and changes (MAC requests) requiring physical IT

involvement.

**Site Operations Support**

• Support local and global IT projects and initiatives that require onsite execution.

• Conduct IT site surveys and infrastructure assessments; document findings for remote

engineering teams.

• Pack, label, and coordinate shipment and receipt of IT equipment between locations following

logistics and security procedures.

• Assist with office expansions, relocations, and technology deployments.

• Support disaster recovery and business continuity activities when required.

**Documentation & Process Improvement**

• Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles in

ServiceNow or the designated knowledge platform.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements or permanent fixes to remote

teams.

• Participate in process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives within the global

IT team.

• Provide regular operational feedback to global IT teams regarding site-specific trends,

challenges, and opportunities.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

• Associate degree, technical diploma, or equivalent practical experience in Information

Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Experience**

• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, or a related technical

role.

• Demonstrated experience providing onsite technical support in a corporate or enterprise

environment.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise hardware, software, and end-user device management.

• Experience working with an ITSM ticketing system; ServiceNow strongly preferred.

• Experience with IT asset management processes and physical inventory management.

**Technical Skills**

• Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 suite.

• Desktop, laptop, and mobile device hardware troubleshooting (iOS and Android).

• Printers, multifunction devices, docking stations, and peripherals.

• Meeting room and collaboration technologies (Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, AV systems).

• Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VLANs, basic switching and cabling

standards.

• IT asset management processes and ServiceNow Asset/CMDB modules.

• Incident, request, and change management processes (ITIL framework awareness).

**Language Skills**

• Fluent in English — written and verbal — required for communication with global IT

teams and ticket documentation.

• Native or business-level proficiency in the local language of the assigned site.

**Soft Skills**

• Strong customer service orientation — treats every interaction as an opportunity to deliver

an excellent experience.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to explain technical concepts clearly

to non-technical users.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision as part of a geographically distributed

team.

• Strong organizational and time management skills; able to handle multiple open tickets and

competing priorities.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities with a methodical, detail-oriented

approach.

• Collaborative mindset; comfortable working across cultures and time zones.

• Professional demeanor with a positive, solution-focused attitude.

**Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**

• CompTIA A+ — hardware and end user support foundation.

• ITIL Foundation — IT service management processes and best practices.

• Microsoft 365 / Windows Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate.

KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

  
  

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions.

  
  

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact.

  
  

*Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.*

***Job Title : Associate, IT Customer Support Analyst***

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused **Associate**, **IT Customer Support Analyst,** to join our team. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for customers who need assistance with technical issues. You will provide remote and on-site support, troubleshoot hardware and software problems, and guide users through resolving issues with technology products and services. The ideal candidate will have strong communication skills, a solid understanding of IT systems, and a passion for helping customers.

Trinzic is being established as an independent public company through the planned separation of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, which is expected to be completed on January 4, 2027.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Customer Support:** Respond to customer inquiries, concerns, and technical issues via phone, email, or live chat. Provide prompt, friendly, and efficient assistance.
* **Technical Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, software, and network problems, and provide clear instructions for resolving these issues. Escalate more complex issues to senior technical staff if necessary.
* **Ticket Management:** Log, track, and prioritize customer issues using a ticketing system. Ensure tickets are resolved within agreed service level agreements (SLAs).
* **Product and Service Support:** Assist customers with setting up, configuring, and using software, hardware, or IT-related services. Provide guidance on system installation, updates, and upgrades.
* **Knowledge Base Management:** Contribute to and maintain internal documentation and customer-facing knowledge bases (FAQs, troubleshooting guides, etc.).
* **Customer Education:** Educate customers on how to use IT products and services effectively. Provide training or resources as needed to improve their technical understanding and user experience.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred.
* **Experience:**
  + Previous experience in a customer support role, particularly in IT or technology-related support, is preferred.
  + Familiarity with helpdesk or ticketing systems (e.g. ServiceNow,) is a plus.
* **Technical Skills:**
  + Solid understanding of common operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and productivity software (Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, AWS).
  + Knowledge of hardware troubleshooting, network connectivity issues, and software installation.
  + Familiarity with remote desktop tools and IT support tools is a plus.

**Soft Skills:**

o Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.

o Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

o Patience, empathy, and a customer-first mindset.

o Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to work in an office.

* Ability to work flexible hours as required, including after-hours support if necessary.

**Key Considerations:**

* **Skills Focus:** Emphasize both technical and soft skills needed for customer interaction and problem-solving.
* **Customer Interaction:** Clearly highlight that the role involves direct customer support, which is a key aspect of IT customer service.
* **Job Expectations:** Be clear about the responsibilities regarding ticket management, technical troubleshooting, and communication.
* **Qualifications:** Outline technical competencies and experience required, including familiarity with helpdesk systems and common troubleshooting tools.

description:

We are looking for a skilled IT Network & Systems Administrator to manage, maintain, and troubleshoot the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, hardware, software, and security systems. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth IT operations, network connectivity, system performance, and data security.
