title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Join Us as a Technical Support Engineer!**

Are you passionate about helping others and solving technical challenges? At ORBCOMM, we’re looking for a **Technical Support Engineer** to join our global support team. In this role, you’ll be the first line of support for our customers, delivering timely, effective, and professional assistance across a suite of innovative IoT products. If you're tech-savvy, customer-focused, and thrive in a fast-paced, international environment, we want to hear from you!

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

At ORBCOMM, we connect the world through intelligent IoT solutions. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-energy support team that plays a vital role in ensuring our customers succeed. From logistics and transportation to maritime and supply chain, you'll support critical operations around the globe—helping real-world users solve real-world problems.

Enjoy the challenge of a 24/7 global environment, where no two days are the same. We offer learning opportunities, career growth, and the chance to work with leading-edge technologies.

This role is based out of our Hyderabad office and working full-time on-site. With an on-site working schedule, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate in person and build strong connections with our team.

**What You’ll Do:**

As a Level 1 Support Specialist, you’ll provide exceptional service to ORBCOMM customers by troubleshooting and resolving technical issues via phone, email, and our Salesforce CRM system. Your responsibilities will include:

* Serve as the first point of contact for customers, providing technical support for ORBCOMM’s product suite via phone, email, and Salesforce.
* Log and track customer issues, ensuring timely updates and resolution.
* Collaborate with In-region teams to escalate and analyze more complex issues as needed.
* Coordinate with internal teams such as Engineering (Software/Hardware), QA, Sales, Order Management, and Billing to ensure accurate and effective problem-solving.
* Maintain detailed documentation for all customer interactions and resolutions.

**Who You Are:**

You're a confident communicator with a strong service mindset and solid technical aptitude. You’re energized by problem-solving and working across global time zones.

If you have:

* 2+ years of experience handling international, inbound customer-facing calls (Required)
* Demonstrated experience in customer-facing roles requiring clear, professional communication.
* A genuine interest in learning and how things work with a proactive attitude for expediting resolutions for improving customer experience.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. (Required)

* Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Good troubleshooting skills and logical thinking.
* Comfortable handling international phone calls and willing to work in a 24/7 environment, primarily during night shifts.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* A passion for learning new technologies and product lines.
* A team-first attitude and strong work ethic.
* A bachelor’s degree (preferred, but not mandatory).
* Reliable transportation and willingness to commute independently. (Required)
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Then we want to meet you!

  

**The Benefits of Working Here**  
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.

**How We Hire**

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.

**About Us**

At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com!

**Ready to Join Us?**

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

title: End User Support Analyst, Specialist (Service Desk lead)
description:
**About Vanguard**
  
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

  

**Vanguard India**

Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

**Role Summary**

We’re looking for someone who solves complex issues, shares knowledge, and elevates the team. The ideal Technical Support professional with at least two years of experience who thrives on resolving complex and escalated issues while delivering an exceptional client experience. This role combines advanced troubleshooting, strong client relationship management, knowledge creation, and peer coaching to strengthen the entire support team. Successful candidates identify recurring trends, create knowledge that enables faster resolution, coach developing analysts, and turn frontline insights into opportunities to improve processes and the overall client experience. Ideally, we are looking for candidates with Windows, MacOS, Virtual Desktop and Remote connectivity experience. Preferred candidates will have experience with ServiceNow and Genesys Contact Center Solutions.

**Responsibilities**

1. Provides intermediate level technical support to address end user issues such as implementation, configurations, control, maintenance, troubleshooting, security, and usage monitoring.

2. Resolves moderately complex technical troubleshooting issues to ensure end user productivity.

3. Provides consultation with clients and key stakeholders on potential technical issues or problems that may affect end user productivity.

4. Creates and maintains knowledge-based articles, procedures, and training for support areas and crew.

5. Maintains an accurate data inventory regarding end-user issues within the tracking system and according to policies and standards.

6. Resolves issues elevated from crew with less experience. Determines severity of unresolved issues and escalates issues accordingly.

7. Learns and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures.

8. Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in technical support or end-user IT services, with at least 1 year in a direct support role.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent training and experience.
* Windows and MacOS support experience.
* Virtual desktop environment experience.
* VPN, connectivity, and endpoint troubleshooting.
* ServiceNow experience (preferred).
* Genesys experience (preferred).

**Location**

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

**Our mission**

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

  

**Our commitment to you**

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

**Financial wellness**
  
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

**Physical wellness**
  
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

**Personal wellness**
  
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

**How we work**

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: IT Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced IT Manager to oversee and enhance our organization's IT infrastructure, with a particular emphasis on enterprise networking and Citrix VDI management. Team handling, vendor coordination, and incident management experience are essential, along with good troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. This position is based in Borivali, Mumbai, and requires a commitment to working Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

title: Customer Support Associate
description:
**Job Title: Customer Support Associate**

**Experience Required: 3+. Years**

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused
**Customer Support Associate**
with strong experience in providing technical and functional support to enterprise customers in a SaaS environment. The ideal candidate will have excellent troubleshooting abilities, strong analytical thinking, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.

In this role, you will serve as a key point of contact for customers, helping them navigate the platform, resolve technical issues, understand product functionalities, and maximize the value of the solution. You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to ensure timely issue resolution and continuous improvement of the customer support experience.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling complex customer queries, managing support tickets independently, and working with global customers and distributed teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Customer Support & Issue Resolution**

* Provide timely and effective customer support through multiple channels, including live chat, email, and ticketing platforms.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer queries, technical issues, and product-related concerns.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve technical and functional issues related to SaaS applications and platform workflows.
* Manage customer support tickets throughout their lifecycle, ensuring appropriate prioritization, follow-ups, resolution, and closure within defined SLAs.
* Handle complex issues independently and coordinate with Engineering, Product, and Subject Matter Experts for advanced troubleshooting and resolution.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication with customers regarding issue status, resolution timelines, and next steps.

**2. Product Knowledge & Customer Enablement**

* Develop a strong understanding of the SaaS platform, its features, functionalities, and workflows.
* Guide customers on product usage, configuration, navigation, and best practices.
* Help customers understand product capabilities and direct them to relevant knowledge-base articles, documentation, and self-service resources.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and proactively recommend training or product education initiatives.
* Support customer onboarding and product adoption activities, wherever required.

**3. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to understand customer expectations, address concerns, and improve overall customer satisfaction.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to communicate product defects, recurring issues, enhancement requests, and customer feedback.
* Ensure effective escalation and coordination of critical or high-priority customer issues.
* Act as a bridge between customers and internal technical teams to ensure smooth communication and timely resolution.

**4. Process Improvement & Support Operations**

* Identify recurring support issues and recommend improvements to support workflows, processes, and documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and escalations.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of FAQs, knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Monitor support metrics such as ticket resolution time, first response time, SLA adherence, customer satisfaction (CSAT), and ticket backlog.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance support efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.

**5. Team Development & Knowledge Sharing**

* Contribute to the training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing initiatives within the Customer Support team.
* Assist in onboarding and developing new support team members.
* Share technical knowledge, troubleshooting approaches, and best practices with team members.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and leadership in managing customer issues and improving team performance.

Required Skills

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Support, Technical Support, or Customer Success roles.
* Strong experience supporting enterprise (B2B) customers in a SaaS or technology-driven environment.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting technical issues related to web-based applications, software platforms, and enterprise workflows.
* Hands-on experience writing and executing SQL queries to retrieve, analyze, validate, and troubleshoot data within databases.
* Experience working with ticketing and customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with IT, Healthcare IT, or enterprise software environments is highly preferred.
* Experience working with international customers and remote or offshore support teams is an added advantage.
* Demonstrated career progression, increased responsibilities, or contributions toward team and process improvements.

**Company Overview:**

Aventior is a leading provider of innovative technology solutions for businesses across a wide range of industries. At Aventior, we leverage cutting-edge technologies like AI, ML Ops, DevOps, and many more to help our clients solve complex business problems and drive growth.

We also provide a full range of data development and management services, including Cloud Data Architecture, Universal Data Models, Data Transformation & and ETL, Data Lakes, User Management, Analytics and visualization, and automated data capture (for scanned documents and unstructured/semi-structured data sources). Our team of experienced professionals combines deep industry knowledge with expertise in the latest technologies to deliver customized solutions that meet the unique needs of each of our clients. Whether you are looking to streamline your operations, enhance your customer experience, or improve your decision-making process, Aventior has the skills and resources to help you achieve your goals.

We bring a well-rounded, cross-industry, and multi-client perspective to our client engagements. Our strategy is grounded in design, implementation, innovation, migration, and support. We have a global delivery model, a multi-country presence, and a team well-equipped with professionals and experts in the field.

title: Support Engineer (Night Shift: 8 PM - 5 AM)
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is a global leader in cloud-based enterprise solutions, empowering businesses to adapt faster and thrive in an increasingly dynamic, digital world. With a strong focus on innovation and AI-driven insights, QAD is shaping the future of enterprise transformation across industries. We foster a flexible, inclusive culture where bold ideas and future-focused talent to drive real impact. Join us to help build the intelligent, connected enterprise of tomorrow.
  
  
This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune, with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.
  
  
**Job Description**
The ERP Support Engineer plays a key role in delivering technical support for QAD and Progress products. This role focuses on providing effective solutions for customer-reported issues, managing technical inquiries, and ensuring seamless system operation through troubleshooting and resolution efforts.
  
  
As a Support Engineer, you will engage with customers and partners via communication platforms such as CRM, telephone, email, and internet-based tools. Your responsibilities include diagnosing technical problems, resolving issues related to installations, upgrades, and configurations, and performing basic Progress DBA tasks under guidance.
  
  
This position also involves documenting solutions and contributing to the organization's knowledge base to support continuous learning and team growth. You will work closely with senior team members, leveraging their expertise to improve your skills while ensuring timely and high-quality support delivery.
  
  
Given that our support organization operates 24/7, this position demands a flexible approach to scheduling. You will be expected to participate in shift rotations, along with weekend shifts and potential on-call coverage as required. These elements are vital to providing continuous support to our global customer base. Your willingness to adapt to these scheduling requirements is crucial for the role.
  
  
In a structured team environment, you will be encouraged to engage in continuous learning and regular practice of existing product knowledge. This is necessary to stay prepared for any new challenges that might arise. As a Sr. Functional Analyst, you have a unique opportunity to grow professionally while significantly contributing to the success of our clients and the organization.
  
  
**Technical Support And Troubleshooting**

* Provide frontline technical support for QAD and Progress products, assisting with installations, configurations, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Diagnose and resolve basic technical issues, escalating complex cases to senior team members when required.
* Perform Progress DBA tasks under guidance, such as database monitoring, backups, and basic optimization.

**Incident Handling**

* Manage incoming support requests through ticketing systems and communication channels, ensuring accurate categorization and prioritization.
* Resolve issues within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), escalating unresolved incidents appropriately.
* Proactively identify patterns in incidents to suggest preventive measures and reduce repeat occurrences.

**Documentation And Knowledge Sharing**

* Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and best practices for handled cases.
* Contribute to the organization’s knowledge base by documenting verified solutions and reusable resources.
* Develop simple guides or FAQs to empower customers and internal teams with quick access to relevant information.

**Customer Engagement And Communication**

* Communicate regularly with customers to provide updates on issue resolution progress and next steps.
* Explain technical concepts clearly and concisely to ensure understanding by both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Foster trust and transparency with customers by demonstrating a proactive approach to addressing their concerns.

**Collaboration And Teamwork**

* Work closely with peers, team leads, and cross-functional teams, such as R&D and Product Management, to address escalated issues.
* Participate in team discussions to share knowledge, discuss challenges, and contribute to process improvements.
* Leverage expertise from senior team members and collaborate to ensure effective resolution of complex cases.

**Shift Coverage And Flexibility**

* Participate in shift rotations, weekend shifts, and on-call schedules to provide uninterrupted global support.
* Adapt to varying scheduling requirements to ensure timely assistance for customers across different time zones.

**Any Other Duties As Assigned**

* Fulfill additional responsibilities as needed to support organizational goals and priorities, ensuring alignment with the overall mission of delivering high-quality support.

**Qualifications**
Education:
  
  
A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  
  
**Experience**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in supporting enterprise products, focusing on troubleshooting and resolving customer-reported issues.
* Experience in Linux / Linux Troubleshooting is mandatory.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proven ability to manage high-priority cases in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment.
* Hands-on experience in ERP support is highly preferred, including:
* Installing, upgrading, and configuring ERP products like QAD, SAP, Oracle ERP, or Dynamics 365.
* Basic troubleshooting and resolving system-level issues related to performance and configuration.
* Progress DBA knowledge (e.g., backups, monitoring) is advantageous but not mandatory.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Familiarity with debugging and troubleshooting in Unix/Linux and Windows environments.
* Basic knowledge of scripting (e.g., Shell) and SQL for issue diagnosis and resolution.
* Understanding of database management principles and system configurations.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.

Additional information
  
  

* We offer an amazing culture and comprehensive suite of health and wellness benefits so that employees can focus on helping customers reach our vision for them: the Effective Enterprise.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* The collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* Our employees tell us they love working for a global organization focused on collaboration, teamwork and customer outcomes.
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set.

**Additional Information**
**About QAD:**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

description:

**hybrid**
.

title: Commercial Underwriter
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Manager – Credit Risk to lead credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements. The role will combine hands-on credit expertise, client management, solution development and team leadership. The ideal candidate should have strong financial analysis and commercial credit underwriting expertise, sound credit judgment, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to translate client requirements into practical processes and solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

 Lead delivery of credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements, ensuring quality, timelines and client requirements are met.

 Perform and review financial and credit analysis, including financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flows, liquidity, leverage, profitability, working capital, AR/AP aging and other key credit indicators.

 Monitor credit portfolios and risk trends, identifying emerging risks, changes in financial performance and other indicators requiring attention, and communicate relevant insights to clients.

 Conduct quantitative and qualitative credit assessment, including business model, industry, customer concentration, debt obligations, contracts and supporting documentation, to identify key risks and form a credit view.

 Own client communication and requirement gathering, translating business needs into underwriting frameworks, processes, SOPs and practical risk/technology solutions.

 Manage and develop internal team, including work allocation, quality review, coaching and capability building.

 Drive process improvement, standardization, automation and risk-monitoring initiatives, and proactively communicate key risks, trends and recommendations to clients.

**What we are looking for**

 5 years of experience in commercial credit risk, financial analysis or risk consulting, preferably within banking, lending, fintech or financial services; experience with US, Canada or LATAM markets preferred.

 Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, credit appraisal, ratio analysis, cash-flow and working- capital assessment, with sound credit judgment.

 Strong credit judgment and attention to detail, including ability to identify financial, operational and qualitative risks from multiple information sources.

 Excellent client-facing, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand ambiguous requirements and develop practical solutions.

 Experience managing/reviewing junior team members and taking ownership of project delivery.

 Experience with process design, SOP development, automation or analytics initiatives.

Should have strong understanding of Advanced MS Excel and financial analysis/modeling skills.

 Exposure to credit underwriting, financial spreading, banking/transaction data or risk analytics platforms is an advantage.

**Educational Qualifications**

 CA / CA Inter / Semi-qualified CA preferred.

 Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.

 Equivalent qualifications with relevant credit risk/underwriting experience may also be considered.

Write to us with your resume at hello@whizzhr.com

Warm regards,

Whizz HR

title: Principal Accountant
description:
**Principal Accountant**

Pune, India | On-site | 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. IST as required

**Take ownership of complex accounting—and make the process better.**

If you enjoy working through complex accounting questions, taking ownership through close and audit, and finding smarter ways to work, this role brings those challenges together. At BrightNight, you will manage multi-entity consolidation and reporting, apply technical accounting judgment, and help improve the processes behind accurate, timely financial information.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants both technical depth and the opportunity to improve how work gets done. You will partner with Operational Accounting, Tax, FP&A, and auditors, connecting detailed accounting work with the wider needs of the business.

**Why BrightNight**

BrightNight is a next-generation power and digital infrastructure company serving utilities, data centers, and commercial and industrial customers. We deliver clean, dispatchable, and resilient power solutions. Our AI-native PowerAlpha® platform has enabled the development of a 30 GW portfolio comprising 61 projects concentrated in fast-growing energy markets and data-center hubs across the U.S. Strategic investors include Goldman Sachs and Global Infrastructure Partners (BlackRock).

**Why this role stands out**

• Meaningful ownership. Manage consolidation and reporting across multiple entities, with direct responsibility for the quality of financial statements, reporting packages, and supporting schedules.

• Real technical scope. Work through intercompany transactions, foreign-currency impacts, consolidation adjustments, accounting guidance, and financial-statement disclosures—not just routine processing.

• Room to improve the work. Bring ideas for automation and AI-enabled tools that improve accounting efficiency and accuracy while maintaining strong controls.

• A business with a tangible mission. Apply your accounting expertise to a company building reliable clean-power solutions for utilities, data centers, and other high-demand customers.

**What you will do**

**Consolidation and financial reporting**

• Manage monthly, quarterly, and annual multi-entity consolidation and reporting processes.

• Review consolidated financial statements, reporting packages, and supporting schedules for accuracy and completeness.

• Analyze intercompany transactions, eliminations, foreign-currency impacts, and consolidation adjustments.

**Technical accounting, controls, and audit**

• Apply U.S. GAAP and/or IFRS guidance to accounting matters, complex transactions, and financial-statement disclosures.

• Identify accounting issues, develop practical solutions, and document your conclusions clearly.

• Support SOX and financial-reporting controls, identify gaps, and help implement remediation plans.

• Coordinate with internal and external auditors, providing clear analysis and well-supported documentation.

**Partnership and process improvement**

• Work closely with Tax, Operational Accounting, FP&A, and other stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver timely reporting.

• Improve accounting workflows through better processes, automation, and practical use of AI-enabled tools.

**What you bring**

• A Chartered Accountant qualification with 5–7 years of relevant accounting experience, or a CPA qualification with 4–6 years of relevant experience.

• Strong U.S. GAAP and/or IFRS knowledge, with the ability to explain and apply guidance to real accounting situations.

• Hands-on experience in multi-entity consolidation, intercompany accounting, financial close, and reporting.

• Experience supporting internal and external audits, financial-reporting controls, and SOX requirements.

• Clear, concise communication: you can explain your work, distinguish what you owned from what you supported, and be candid when an issue requires further research.

• A proactive, collaborative approach, attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves to get the work done.

**What will help you stand out**

Experience preparing financial statements, handling Indian GAAP/Ind AS-to-U.S. GAAP conversions, or improving a process through automation or AI will be valuable. Energy-sector experience is not essential; strong accounting experience in another complex, multi-entity business can translate well.

**Location and working hours**

This position is based on-site in Pune, India. Working hours are 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. IST as required.

**Bring your accounting depth, your judgment, and your ideas for doing the work better. Apply to join BrightNight’s Pune accounting team.**

title: Senior Network Administrator (VPN, Zero Trust & Network
description:
**Job Description: Senior Network Administrator (VPN, Zero Trust & Network Security)**

**Experience**

**8-12 Years**

**Location : Pune ,** Hybrid

**Role Summary**

Seeking an experienced **Senior Network Administrator** to manage, secure, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure with a strong focus on **VPN technologies, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), network security, and enterprise connectivity** . The ideal candidate will possess expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, SD-WAN, VPN solutions, NAC, and modern Zero Trust architectures while ensuring high availability, security compliance, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Network Infrastructure Management**

* Design, implement, and administer enterprise LAN, WAN, Wireless, and Data Center networks.
* Manage routers, switches, load balancers, wireless controllers, and Internet connectivity.
* Perform network capacity planning, performance tuning, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Ensure network availability aligned with defined SLAs.

**VPN & Remote Access Management**

* Configure and support IPSec, SSL VPN, Site-to-Site VPN, and Client VPN solutions.
* Manage remote access platforms from vendors such as Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or Zscaler.
* Troubleshoot VPN connectivity, authentication, performance, and access-related issues.
* Implement secure remote workforce solutions.

**Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)**

* Design and administer ZTNA solutions to enable secure application access.
* Implement identity-based access controls and least-privilege principles.
* Integrate ZTNA platforms with IAM, MFA, Conditional Access, and Endpoint Security solutions.
* Support technologies such as:
  + Zscaler ZPA
  + Palo Alto Prisma Access
  + Netskope
  + Cisco Secure Access
  + Cloudflare Zero Trust

**Network Security**

* Administer next-generation firewalls (NGFW) and security platforms.
* Create and maintain security policies, ACLs, NAT, IPS/IDS rules.
* Monitor network security events and collaborate with SOC teams.
* Conduct vulnerability remediation and security hardening activities.
* Support DDoS protection, segmentation, and micro-segmentation initiatives.

**Operations & Incident Management**

* Handle L2/L3 complex network incidents and problem management activities.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.
* Participate in major incident management and change management processes.
* Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, and knowledge repositories.

**Cloud & Hybrid Networking**

* Manage networking across Azure, AWS, and hybrid environments.
* Configure VNETs, VNets Peering, Transit Gateways, Virtual WAN, and VPN Gateways.
* Support secure cloud access using ZTNA and SASE principles.

**Monitoring & Automation**

* Utilize monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, LogicMonitor, ThousandEyes, or Observability platforms.
* Automate routine networking tasks using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or APIs.
* Generate network health reports and executive dashboards.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Networking**

* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP
* VLANs, STP, HSRP, VRRP
* MPLS, SD-WAN, WAN Optimization
* Network Load Balancing

**Security**

* Zero Trust Architecture
* SASE Framework
* VPN Technologies (IPSec, SSL VPN)
* IDS/IPS
* NAC (Cisco ISE, Aruba ClearPass)
* Network Segmentation & Microsegmentation

**Firewall & Security Platforms**

* Palo Alto
* Cisco Firepower / ASA
* Fortinet FortiGate
* Check Point
* Zscaler
* Netskope

**Cloud Networking**

* AWS Networking
* Azure Networking
* Hybrid Connectivity
* Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)

**Monitoring Tools**

* SolarWinds
* PRTG
* LogicMonitor
* ThousandEyes
* Splunk
* Grafana

**Desired Certifications**

* CCNP Enterprise / CCIE
* PCNSE (Palo Alto)
* NSE 4/5/7 (Fortinet)
* Zscaler Certified Administrator
* Cisco Secure Access Certification
* Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
* AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
* CISSP (Preferred)

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and executive communication skills.
* Experience in client-facing managed services environments.

* Mentoring junior engineers and driving operational improvements.

**About TMF Group**

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing globally. We focus on providing specialized and business-critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds in different geographical locations.

TMF India is a Great Place to Work, ISO & ISAE certified organization.

**Discover the Role**

The Senior Engineer - Global Service Desk is responsible for delivering exceptional end-user support while providing day-to-day operational support to the Global Service Desk team. The role acts as the primary escalation point within the shift, ensuring service excellence, operational efficiency, SLA compliance, and a high standard of customer experience across global support operations.

The position combines hands-on technical support responsibilities with team support, coaching, queue management, incident oversight, stakeholder communication, and continuous service improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Desk Operations Leadership**

* Provide day-to-day support and guidance to Global Service Desk engineers across assigned shifts.
* Act as the first point of escalation for operational issues, customer concerns, and service delivery challenges.
* Monitor team performance, workload distribution, and queue health throughout the shift.
* Ensure adherence to operational procedures, support standards, and ITSM processes.
* Drive shift handovers and ensure seamless continuity across global support teams.
* Support management in achieving operational KPIs and service targets.

**Incident & Request Management**

* Manage complex incidents and service requests requiring advanced troubleshooting.
* Ensure incidents are correctly logged, categorized, prioritized, and assigned.
* Drive timely incident resolution while maintaining SLA and OLA commitments.
* Review escalated tickets before assignment to L2/L3 teams to ensure quality and completeness.
* Ensure all customer communications are accurate, timely, and professional.

**Major Incident Support**

* Identify potential Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents and initiate appropriate escalation procedures.
* Coordinate with Major Incident Managers and technical teams during critical service disruptions.
* Assist with business impact assessments and service restoration activities.
* Support communication activities during major incidents and high-priority outages.

**Team Coaching & Development**

* Provide mentoring, coaching, and knowledge sharing to Service Desk engineers.
* Conduct quality reviews of tickets and customer interactions.
* Support onboarding and training of new team members.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend development plans.

description:
**Job Title: Senior Windows Server Engineer**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Windows Server Engineer with strong expertise in Windows Server administration, configuration, deployment, automation, and infrastructure management. The ideal candidate should have extensive knowledge of Windows Server technologies, from Windows Server 2008 onwards, along with hands-on experience in Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM), Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, PXE, DHCP, and PowerShell automation. The candidate should also possess experience working with VMware, container technologies, hybrid infrastructure environments, server hardening, performance tuning, and enterprise infrastructure integration.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Windows Server Administration & Engineering

- Manage, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Windows Server environments.

- Demonstrate deep technical knowledge of Windows Server versions, including the evolution from Windows Server 2008.

- Optimize server performance, availability, and reliability.

2. Configuration Management & Deployment

- Administer and manage SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager.

- Manage operating system deployment using PXE boot and related deployment technologies.

- Configure and troubleshoot DHCP and network boot processes.

- Implement automated server provisioning and configuration management.

3. Automation & Infrastructure as Code

- Develop and maintain automation scripts using PowerShell.

- Utilize Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation.

- Work with Packer for automated server image creation and management.

- Leverage Redfish for server hardware management and automation.

4. Active Directory & Core Infrastructure Services

- Administer and maintain Active Directory environments.

- Manage DNS, Group Policy, authentication, and directory services.

- Troubleshoot infrastructure-related connectivity and domain issues.

- Ensure secure and reliable integration of enterprise services.

5. Virtualization, Containers & Hybrid Infrastructure

- Support and manage VMware-based infrastructure environments.

- Work with container technologies and hybrid infrastructure patterns.

- Support integration between physical, virtualized, and hybrid environments.

- Ensure infrastructure compatibility, scalability, and operational efficiency.

6. Security, Performance & Monitoring

- Perform Windows Server OS tuning, security hardening, and configuration optimization.

- Implement infrastructure observability and monitoring practices.

- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and system vulnerabilities.

- Maintain enterprise security and operational standards.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

- Minimum 7+ years of experience in Windows Server administration and infrastructure engineering.

- Strong knowledge of Windows Server architecture and administration, including experience with Windows Server 2008 and subsequent versions.

- Hands-on experience with SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager.

- Strong understanding of PXE, DHCP, and server deployment processes.

- Experience with Redfish, Packer, Ansible, and PowerShell.

- Strong expertise in Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy.

- Experience with VMware, container technologies, and hybrid infrastructure environments.

- Knowledge of OS performance tuning, security hardening, monitoring, and observability.

- Experience integrating Windows Server infrastructure with enterprise systems.

title: Modern Workplace Engineer, Tech & Ops, Associate
description:
**About This Role**
Your team
  
  
Modern Workplace Engineering delivers and operates enterprise workplace technologies that enable secure and reliable access across managed devices. The team engineers and supports enterprise mobile services, with a strong focus on Apple iOS and iPadOS and hands-on ownership across Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) and Microsoft Intune. The team partners across security, identity, network, application and service-management functions to improve platform reliability, automation and the overall mobile experience.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As an Associate in Modern Workplace Engineering, you will be an individual contributor responsible for delivering mobile-platform engineering and operational improvements from design through production support. You will help evolve enterprise mobile services by strengthening device-management capabilities, improving automation, resolving complex technical issues and supporting secure integration with identity, networking and adjacent platforms. iOS and iPadOS engineering will be the primary technical focus, with macOS and Jamf experience contributing to broader Apple-platform capabilities. The role combines engineering delivery with steady-state service ownership and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Engineer and operate enterprise mobile management services across Ivanti EPMM and Microsoft Intune, including enrollment, configuration, compliance, application management, testing, controlled releases, platform standards and technical documentation.
* Own the mobile-platform service lifecycle, delivering engineering backlog items and Level 3 troubleshooting while supporting controlled environments, incident and problem management, knowledge transfer and reliable day-to-day operations.
* Develop secure, supportable automation and reporting using PowerShell and other appropriate scripting, application programming interface (API) and source-control capabilities to reduce manual effort, improve data quality and increase visibility of platform health and performance.
* Lead iOS and iPadOS engineering and contribute to broader Apple-platform capabilities, including device enrollment, managed applications, certificates, macOS and Jamf collaboration, automation and lifecycle standards.
* Partner across security, identity, network, application and service-management teams to deliver secure and resilient mobile services, manage dependencies and communicate technical risks, decisions and status to stakeholders.

Your experience
  
  

* Demonstrated experience in enterprise endpoint, mobility or modern workplace engineering, including hands-on enterprise mobile management and strong iOS and iPadOS engineering capabilities.
* Experience engineering enterprise device enrollment, configuration, compliance, managed applications, reporting and device lifecycle processes.
* Practical experience with scripting, automation, APIs and controlled source-management practices, including PowerShell and relevant experience with Python, shell scripting, Git or Azure DevOps.
* Strong Apple enterprise-management experience, with iOS and iPadOS as the primary focus and additional macOS or Jamf experience beneficial.
* Understanding of enterprise identity, certificate, network and secure-access technologies and their integration with endpoint-management services, including Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).
* Strong troubleshooting, engineering ownership, documentation and communication capabilities in complex enterprise environments, with experience supporting service improvements or significant platform changes beneficial.
* Experience with enterprise automation, service-management, security or operational-reporting platforms is beneficial, as is experience in regulated environments and relevant endpoint-management certifications.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**Overview**
**Our Culture and Impact**
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Cvent Implementation team configures and deploys Cvent software for new and existing clients. Our mission is to provide expert guidance and hands-on technical execution, so every client successfully launches, adopts, and realizes value from their Cvent products.
  
  
The role blends project management, technical configuration, and client-facing consulting — and increasingly, the smart use of AI tools to move faster, reduce manual work, and give clients a sharper, more consultative experience. This is no longer just a configuration role: it's a role where the best performers use AI as a force multiplier across research, documentation, testing, and client communication.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Implementation / Implementation Lead, you will own mid-to-complex client implementations end-to-end — from discovery and process mapping through configuration, testing, training, and go-live. You'll act as a trusted advisor to clients, a hands-on product expert, and a mentor to junior team members, while leveraging AI tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality at every stage of the project lifecycle.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
**Client Consultation & Strategic Delivery**

* Provide high-level consultation to clients on applying Cvent technology to meet their meetings and events program goals.
* Analyze current-state processes and map future-state workflows to Cvent solutions, identifying opportunities for automation along the way.
* Serve as a product specialist — deeply knowledgeable across Cvent products, able to demonstrate, consult, configure, test, train, and deploy solutions.
* Cultivate strong advisory relationships with key client stakeholders who influence adoption and long-term account health.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Apply structured project management discipline — scoping, planning, RAID logs, milestone tracking, and change control — to manage simple-to-complex implementations, keeping timelines on track and proactively escalating barriers to success.
* Translate customer goals into objective, measurable success criteria (e.g., adoption rate, time-to-value, process cycle time, cost savings, ROI) rather than relying on subjective or anecdotal measures of progress.
* Define and track KPIs and success metrics with clients at project kick-off, and report progress against them throughout the engagement so success is data-driven, not just directional.
* Oversee and/or configure client accounts, including testing, refining, and directing the contributions of other team members.
* Track time and profitability of implementation projects, providing recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign.
* Coordinate and conduct virtual user training sessions for client teams.

**Technical Configuration & Product Expertise**

* Configure, test, and refine Cvent product instances to match documented client requirements.
* Diagram intermediate-to-complex process flows and identify opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Interface with the Product Development team to define and convey client feature requests.

**AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation**
**Role**
*This is where the role has evolved most. AI is now a core part of how implementation work gets done, not an optional add-on:*

* Use generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to draft, summarize, and refine requirements documents, process maps, and configuration workbooks — cutting documentation time and improving consistency across projects.
* Apply AI-assisted meeting summarization and transcription tools during discovery calls and configuration workshops to speed up note-taking, action-item tracking, and follow-up communications.
* Identify and build lightweight automations or AI-agent workflows for repetitive project tasks — status updates, test-case generation, training material drafts, and client FAQs — freeing up time for higher-value consulting.
* Maintain quality and accuracy as a human-in-the-loop reviewer: validating AI-generated configurations, documentation, and communications before they reach the client.
* Model and mentor AI tool adoption to junior team members and peers, helping the broader team adopt AI-first ways of working.
* Use AI-powered analytics on data such as usage patterns, support tickets, or historical project data to proactively flag risk and improve implementation quality.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with Sales and Account Management to support sales activities where implementation expertise is a differentiator.
* Ensure client objectives and requirements are clearly conveyed and tracked throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Serve as a mentor to new team members, including on best practices for using AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Present internally as a subject-matter expert on implementation topics, lead conversations in team meetings, and participate in team committees, at times in a leadership capacity.

**Here's What You Need**

* 10 to 14+ years of external work experience in a project or customer management role — preferably in the corporate meetings, software, or broader high-tech industry — or a minimum of 5 years of Cvent experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent applicable experience.
* Experience implementing technology or automation, ideally within an organization responsible for managing meetings or events.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a positive, confident, and outgoing presence; strong presentation skills.
* Highly articulate and detail-oriented, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for clients of varying technical fluency.
* Strong project management skills — able to build and manage project plans, timelines, RAID/risk logs, and status reporting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer goals into objective, quantifiable outcomes and hold projects accountable to measurable results rather than subjective impressions of progress.
* Ability to comprehend and diagram intermediate process flows, identifying opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Proficiency in core productivity tools: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio/Draw.io.
* Demonstrable aptitude for learning and applying new technologies, and for applying general and industry-specific business knowledge in a fast-paced, analytical, team-oriented environment.
* Strong time-management and organizational discipline; ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently.
* A solutions-first mindset — comfortable proposing fixes rather than simply surfacing problems to management.

**Adaptability & Resilience Under Pressure**

* Ability to pivot quickly on customer situations — reworking scope, timelines, or approach mid-project when client needs, priorities, or constraints shift unexpectedly.

title: Systems Administration Analyst-App Packaging
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Administration Analyst-App Packaging to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
We are seeking a skilled Application Packager to join NTT DATA's India EPM delivery team. This mid-senior role involves independently managing complex packaging projects — handling difficult repackages, compatibility remediation, scripted deployments, and advanced Intune/SCCM integration — for large global enterprise clients. The packager will serve as a key technical contributor on the India packaging team, handling L2/L3 packaging requests, driving quality standards, and contributing to platform and tooling improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Advanced Application Packaging
  
  

* Handle complex application repackaging scenarios including multi-component installers, 32/64-bit dual packages, per-user vs per-machine conflicts, and custom action remediation.
* Develop and maintain MSI packages from source using WiX Toolset or InstallShield IDE for applications without vendor installers.
* Apply Package Support Framework (PSF) fixups for MSIX compatibility including working directory, file redirection, and registry virtualisation fixes.
* Package and sequence App-V virtual applications including connection group configuration and dynamic composition.
* Design and implement Intune Win32 deployment strategies including staged rollouts, dependency chains, and supersedence workflows.
* Develop custom PowerShell pre-install, post-install, and detection scripts for complex packaging requirements.

Compatibility & Remediation
  
  

* Analyse and resolve application compatibility issues including DPI awareness, UAC elevation, write virtualisation, and Windows 10/11 API compatibility.
* Apply and test compatibility shims using Microsoft Application Compatibility Toolkit (ACT) or PSF.
* Identify and remediate packaging issues causing deployment failures — custom actions, hardcoded paths, registry ACLs, and service configurations.
* Collaborate with application owners and vendors to obtain silent install parameters and resolve licensing or activation issues.
* Assess applications for MSIX packaging suitability and document conversion feasibility with recommended approach.

Deployment Integration & Automation
  
  

* Build SCCM application models with complex detection methods, global conditions, requirement rules, and multi-deployment-type configurations.
* Develop PowerShell automation scripts for batch packaging operations, package validation, and SCCM/Intune inventory reporting.
* Integrate packaging workflows with software delivery pipelines — scripted uploads to Intune via Graph API, SCCM package import automation.
* Support Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline integration for automated package build and test workflows.
* Develop and maintain packaging test scripts for regression automation on golden image environments.

Quality & Governance
  
  

* Define and enforce packaging standards, quality checklists, and peer review processes for the India packaging team.
* Conduct technical review of packages produced by junior packagers and provide structured feedback.
* Maintain and improve the packaging knowledge base, SOPs, and runbooks.
* Contribute to SLA governance by tracking packaging queue metrics, turnaround times, and defect rates.
* Participate in client delivery reviews and contribute packaging status updates and quality metrics.

**Required Skills**

* Advanced MSI packaging — WiX Toolset, InstallShield, AdminStudio (expert-level repackaging and custom authoring)
* MSIX packaging — Package Support Framework, MSIX Packaging Tool, advanced compatibility fix development
* App-V sequencing — virtual application packaging, connection groups, dynamic configuration
* Intune Win32 and SCCM deployment — advanced deployment type configuration, Graph API integration
* PowerShell advanced scripting — detection scripts, pre/post-install automation, batch packaging operations
* Application compatibility — ACT, shims, PSF fixups, UAC/DPI/virtualisation remediation
* Windows internals — deep understanding of registry, file system, services, COM, WMI for packaging analysis
* Log analysis and troubleshooting — MSI verbose logs, AppEnforce.log, CMTrace, Event Viewer, Procmon

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AdminStudio's Automated Application Converter for bulk MSI-to-MSIX migration
* Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline experience for packaging automation
* Flexera Software Vulnerability Manager or third-party patch management integration
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent senior enterprise packaging experience will be considered.

Job Description

**Title: Mainframe Transmission Services**

**Total years of experience: 4 years to 8 years**

**Location: Coimbatore**

**Job Description – Key Responsibilities**

* Support and maintain mission-critical file transmission services and platforms.
* Perform L2/L3 support, troubleshooting complex issues escalated by the team.
* Manage Mainframe File Transfer technologies including FTP, Connect:Direct/NDM and Axway MFT/CFT.
* Monitor and manage Control-M job scheduling, file transfers and batch operations.
* Understand and troubleshoot JCL and Mainframe-related transmission issues.
* Handle critical incidents, SWAT escalations and on-call support while minimizing business impact.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), problem management and ticket trend analysis.
* Implement changes, vulnerability remediation, patching and service requests.
* Support scheduled Disaster Recovery (DR), audit and compliance activities.
* Drive automation, Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) and shift-left initiatives to reduce manual effort and operational costs.
* Conduct health checks, monitoring, ticket-quality reviews and documentation maintenance.
* Train, coach and cross-train team members to strengthen L2/L3 technical capabilities.
* Maintain knowledge documents and lessons learned for operational readiness and training.
* Validate change tasks, escalation procedures and operational processes before implementation.
* Respond to customer/stakeholder queries through email and calls and provide timely technical updates.
    
    
  **Experience & Skills Preferred**
* 5–7 years of experience in Mainframe Transmission Services / Managed File Transfer (MFT).
* Strong file transmission troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
* Monitor and validate successful file transfers between customers, partners and third parties.
* Investigate, resolve and escalate failed or delayed file transmissions.
* Monitor file transfer systems, alerts and transfer schedules to ensure service availability.
* Manage incidents/tickets, maintain accurate updates and follow through to resolution.
* Configure and maintain transfer alerts and warning schedules.
* Coordinate with L2/L3 support teams for complex transmission issues and escalations.
* Monitor the shared mailbox and respond to operational requests requiring action.
* Communicate outages and service impacts to customers, business teams and management.
* Participate in transmission-related operational and technical meetings.
* Provide shift/on-call support, including customer calls and timely management updates.

* Support internal and external audits related to access management.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization.

* Experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Entitlement Management.

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent business communication skills

* Understanding of Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, MFA, and federation technologies (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).
* Experience supporting audits and regulatory frameworks such as SOX, ISO 27001, GDPR, or similar standards.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.

title: System Administrator
description:
**L2 System Administrator**  
  
**Windows server administration**

* Install, configure, patch and maintain Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 (physical and virtual).
* Manage server roles: file and print, IIS, DHCP, DNS, WSUS, Remote Desktop Services.
* Monitor performance, capacity and event logs; fix root causes, not just symptoms.
* Run monthly patching cycles through WSUS, SCCM/MECM or Intune, with rollback plans.

**Active Directory and identity**

* Administer AD DS: users, groups, OUs, trusts, sites and replication health.
* Create and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect sync, MFA and conditional access.
* Handle privileged account reviews and access requests per policy.

**Network administration**

* Configure and troubleshoot switches, routers, VLANs, trunking and inter-VLAN routing.
* Maintain firewalls (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA/FTD): rules, NAT, site-to-site and client VPNs.
* Manage wireless controllers and access points.
* Diagnose LAN/WAN issues with Wireshark, ping/tracert, SNMP and NetFlow data.

**Virtualization, backup and cloud**

* Administer VMware vSphere/ESXi or Hyper-V hosts, clusters and VM lifecycle.
* Operate backup and recovery (Veeam, Commvault or similar); run restore tests quarterly.
* Support Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online and basic Azure resources.

**Security and compliance**

* Apply server and network hardening baselines; remediate vulnerability scan findings.
* Manage endpoint protection / EDR consoles and respond to alerts with the security team.
* Keep audit evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2 or internal controls.

**Support, change and documentation**

* Own L2 incidents and service requests within SLA; escalate to L3 with full diagnostics.
* Raise and execute change requests following ITIL change management.
* Maintain network diagrams, runbooks, asset inventory and knowledge-base articles.
* Coach L1 engineers and take part in the on-call rotation.

title: Quality Systems admin
description:
About the job

**Powersonic – Join Us in Powering the Future!**

Our mission at Powersonic is to help power the products of the future and make everyone fall in love with great hardware, great engineering, and great design. This mission is super exciting, but there’s still a lot to do — and that’s exactly where you come in!

**Role Description**\

This is a full-time, on-site role as a **Quality Admin Support** in **Coimbatore**.

You will be responsible for providing essential administrative and documentation support to the Quality team, ensuring the effective maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS), supporting internal and external audits, maintaining quality records, coordinating training activities, and assisting with continuous improvement initiatives.

**You will:Documentation Management**

* Manage and maintain QMS documents, including revision control, distribution, and record retention.
* Ensure quality documents are updated accurately and within the required timelines.
* Review and maintain technical documents, quality manuals, work instructions, and customer specifications.
* Support the Quality team in preparing visual aids, quality check points, quality alerts, and other quality-related documents.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for quality issues, rejects, corrective actions, and related records.
* Maintain organized physical and digital filing systems for quality documentation.
* Maintain quality records and relevant data in ERP systems, including Visual ERP.

**Audit Preparation & Support**

* Coordinate and support internal and external audits, including **ISO 9001, UL, and CSA** audits.
* Prepare and organize required documentation and records for audits and inspections.
* Support follow-up activities related to audit findings and corrective actions.
* Maintain audit schedules, records, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure timely closure of audit-related actions.

**Data Collection & Reporting**

* Collect and maintain quality-related data accurately.
* Assist in preparing quality reports, charts, and management review reports.
* Track and maintain quality KPIs and performance indicators.
* Support data analysis and reporting for quality improvement activities.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of quality information to management.

**Training Coordination**

* Support the coordination of quality-related training programs.
* Maintain employee training records and ensure required documentation is complete.
* Prepare and distribute training materials.
* Coordinate training schedules and maintain attendance records.
* Support compliance with quality-related training requirements.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Participate in quality improvement and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective action activities.
* Assist in implementing process improvements and monitoring their effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to improve quality documentation, processes, and administrative workflows.

**Coordinate with:**

* Global Quality Assurance Administrator to support quality system requirements and activities.
* Quality team members to maintain documentation, records, and quality processes.
* Production, Engineering, Purchasing, and Operations teams regarding quality requirements and documentation.
