title: Assistant Manager - Villa Operations
description:
Provide day-to-day leadership and direction by maximising financial returns, driving development of people, creating and maintaining a unique guest experience, executing on brand standards, and building awareness of apartments and brand in the local community.

At ELIVAAS, we want people who are friendly, welcoming and full of life; people who are always finding ways to make every guest’s experience a memorable one.

**Duties and responsibilities**

**Financial returns:**

· Analyse financials to drive revenues, future profitability, and maximum return on investment. Focus on Upselling initiatives to drive revenue and maximise market share.

· Develops and monitors the performance of financial and operational plans which support the overall objectives of the villas and operating division; develops the annual budget and business plan, and makes recommendations for capital improvements to enhance the assets of the villa and ensure brand loyalty.

· Oversees the development and execution of operations plans and yield management efforts to maximize revenue generation.

**People:**

· Develop programmes that drive improvements in team member engagement and are aligned with the service philosophy.

· Manage day-to-day staffing requirements, plan and assign work, and establish performance and development goals for team members and provide mentoring, coaching and regular feedback to enhance performance.

· Establishes and maintains a proactive function to ensure employee motivation, training and development and compliance with policies and procedures and local labor regulations.

· Fosters the development of a positive work environment for all employees. Mentors all levels of employees through formal and informal meetings, discussions and performance feedback

· Works effectively with staff to address cultural and/or work environment issues so as to affect positive employee and guest experiences

· Champions the brand at all times and provides brand perspective site tours to perspective guests, developers, owners and Elivaas personnel.

**Guest experience:**

· Demonstrate brand citizenship by maintaining compliance with all required brand and service standards, and licence agreement mandates.

· Drive improvement in guest satisfaction goals. Collaborate with colleagues and villa team members to establish and implement services and programmes that meet or exceed guest expectations.

· Make time to interact with guests, solicit feedback and build relationships.

· Oversees the delivery of superior services to all guests ensuring the utmost quality and care is delivered including prompt response to requests and the effective resolution of all complaints to the satisfaction of guests

· Ensures that product quality and service standards are met in all areas of the villas as pertains to physical appearance, maintenance and cleanliness. Establishes and maintains preventative maintenance programs to protect the physical assets of the villa.

· Ensures the handling of community/media related inquiries in the most effective manner, while referring sensitive matters to corporate media office.

**Responsible business:**

· Ensure a safe and secure environment for guests, team members and apartments assets in compliance with company’s and owner’s policies and procedures and regulatory requirements.

· Ensure the security and proper storage of food and beverage products, inventory and equipment, and replenish supplies in a timely and efficient manner while minimising waste.

· Perform other duties as assigned. May also serve as manager on duty.

**Accountability:**

This position will involve managing operations of apartments with variety of technical aspects, complex owner relationships, extensive competitive pressures, difficult labour relations and/or union pressures.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

Bachelor’s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Hotel Administration, Business Administration, plus eight to ten years of prior hotel/Villa management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience required may vary based on size and complexity of operation. Must speak fluent English. Other languages preferred.

The statements in this job description are intended to represent the key duties and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be ALL responsibilities or qualifications of the job.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Global Billing Operations - Assistant Manager
description:
**Why this role is important to us**

  

Global Billing Operations (“Global Billing”) is responsible for all of State Street’s client billing processes across the globe. The remit spans across Asset Servicing, Alpha, Global Markets, Global Advisors and the Digital division, covering over 50+ billing processes and 40+ legacy platforms. Global Billing is undergoing a multi-year transformation spanning people and operating model, processes and controls, data automation and technology.

State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Global Delivery, which is responsible for Billing Transformation, Client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in India, Poland and China.

  

**Job Purpose**

  

State Street has committed to significantly automating and streamlining the technology and data associated to its varied billing processes. As part of this commitment, there is a dedicated Billing Data team responsible for developing and implementing the appropriate strategy to migrate from legacy, manual processes to a highly automated environment with more robust controls.

  

This role will be supporting Global Billing Data Sourcing Lead, as the team implements billing transformation strategy across data sourcing, will be partnering with teams to monitor, track, report progress, targets and outcome linked to target state operating. This role will be responsible for ensuring data is available within agreed SLA for timely client billing, support new sources identification across all regions, automation, user acceptance testing of new data source, system build out validation and conversion to provide insights, status, opportunities and ensuring that various components of underlying processes are run as expected –in line with the strategy and prioritization defined by the Head of Billing Operations to achieve the goals of migration to the single, Oracle based platform (ORMB).

  

**What you will be responsible for**

* Work with Data Sourcing Lead to ensure data can be automated within Data Hub and sent to downstream applications including ORMB within a controlled environment
* Support, partner with invoicing and setup teams for to help identify opportunities for reduction, conversion for manual data sources to automation in Data Hub ( at product, system level)
* Partner with GBIC, Fee Schedule Governance, Data Governance – for new services to clients, on billing methodology, data, SLA, data source provider agreement to ensure the team has the necessary documentation to drive onboarding new clients
* Align with Global Billing Data Sourcing Lead on prioritization (conversion, DCO and billability) with Product (DMH, CSA, ORMB), and optimize existing data sources
* Promote risk excellence culture and looking at opportunities for continuous improvement
  

**What we Value**

* Attention to detail, ownership and accountability
* Ability to navigate and partner with various stakeholders
* Ability to communicate and above par presentation skills
* Positive attitude, organized, self-starter, with a history of contributing to a successful, diverse team
* Demonstrated experience of multi-tasking and effective time management with attention to detail in a fast paced environment
* Ability to influence across siloes and work with broader teams and a collaborative attitude

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master degree in IT/Finance or equivalent industry recognized qualification
* Must have a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in Financial/Global Services Organization /Investment banking related IT Industry
  

**About State Street**

**What we do** . State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

**Work, Live and Grow** . We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

  

**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility** . We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you. State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

  
  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Executive Secretary / Executive Assistant to Head of Operations
description:
**Role: Executive Secretary to Head of Operations**

We are looking for a sharp, reliable, and well-organized Executive Secretary to work directly with our Head of Operations.

This is not a regular back-office typing job. You will be the central point of contact for all the teams - handling daily schedules, managing important files, and building simple tracking systems from day one. You will also sit in management meetings, share practical ideas for business growth, and take key decisions on the ground when Head of Operations is on leave or visiting other locations.

If you want to understand how retail operations and business expansion work at a senior level, this role gives you hands-on experience and real career growth.

Key Responsibilities

**Executive Support & Daily Planning**

* **Manage Emails:** Check the Head of Operations' inbox, reply to standard queries, coordinate with the finance team for urgent vendor payments, and highlight urgent matters on a daily basis.
* **Schedule Management:** Plan daily calendars, fixing store visits, vendor meetings, and internal team reviews without time clashes.
* **Store Monitoring:** Check head-office CCTV feeds regularly to see daily store operations and staff discipline.
* **Meeting Preparation:** Prepare agendas, short briefing notes, and background details before major meetings and site visits.

**Systems & Record Keeping**

* **SOPs & Workflows:** Create simple, step-by-step SOPs, approval steps, and daily checklists for store staff as guided by the Head of Operations.
* **File Management:** Maintain a clean Google Drive folder system for store licenses, rental agreements, vendor contracts, and audit reports.
* **Daily Trackers:** Update daily Excel / Google Sheets for sales numbers, store stock levels, and project deadlines corresponding to the data provided by the Head of Operations.

**Team Follow-Up & Operations Support**

* **Task Delegation:** Convert instructions from Head of Operations into clear daily tasks for store managers and supervisors.
* **Follow-Ups:** Follow up with teams to make sure work is completed on time.
* **Solve Ground Issues:** Handle minor day-to-day operational issues, write quick incident reports, and escalate major problems to the Head of Operations.

**Strategy & Meetings**

* **Join Discussions:** Attend leadership meetings and share suggestions on new store openings, reducing costs, and improving customer service (training will be provided on the job).
* **Market Ideas:** Keep an eye on market trends and bring sensible, practical ideas to help improve store performance.
* **Minutes of Meeting (MOM):** Write clear meeting notes noting who is responsible for each task and the exact due date.

**Who We Are Looking For?**

* **Experience:** 2 to 5 years working as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Senior Admin supporting top managers.
* **Organized Mindset:** Ability to take unorganized work and convert it into simple checklists, sheets, and trackers.
* **Practical Thinking:** Basic business sense, good observation skills, and confidence to speak up in meetings.
* **Independent Worker:** Can take quick, sensible decisions on daily matters without needing constant supervision.
* **Clear Communication:** Good written and spoken English, polite communication, and complete trust with confidential company data.
* **Tech Skills:** Fast and comfortable using Google Workspace (Google Sheets, Docs, Calendar, and Gmail).

**What We Offer**

* **Direct Career Growth:** Fast path to move into an Operations Manager or Chief of Staff role.
* **Real Responsibility:** Freedom to work independently with direct trust from leadership.
* **Visible Results:** See your systems and suggestions used across all our stores every day.
* **Salary & Benefits:** Good industry salary, performance incentives, Providence Fund, 2 days off/week and sick leave/paid leave.

Pay: From ₹250,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Head of Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Operations Leadership:**

Lead, manage, and mentor Gold Processing Managers across multiple states.

Oversee the gold transaction process — collection, verification, processing, certification, and sales.

Ensure uniformity and adherence to SOPs across all operational units.

**2. Transaction Process Oversight:**

Monitor secure gold movement from branches to state hubs and Head Office.

Ensure accuracy in gold weight, billing, stone removal, melting, and purity certification.

Supervise market transactions for selling gold to bidders, ensuring optimal returns.

**3. Data & Reporting:**

Collect and consolidate transaction data from different states.

Perform analysis and comparison of volumes, discrepancies, processing times, and sales performance.

Generate MIS and analytical reports for management to track efficiency, trends, and risks.

**4. Compliance & Risk Management:**

Ensure all operations comply with statutory, audit, and company policies.

Drive security protocols in handling and movement of gold.

Identify risks in transaction handling and implement corrective measures.

**5. Strategic Contribution:**

Provide insights to management on operational efficiency, market trends, and process improvements.

Support the company’s expansion strategy by standardizing operations for scale.

Collaborate with Finance, HR, and Business Development teams for cross-functional alignment.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

Proven leadership and multi-state operations management.

Deep understanding of gold buying, processing, and sales transactions.

Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.

Integrity, confidentiality, and accountability in handling high-value transactions.

Excellent people management and communication skills.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

Graduate / Postgraduate in Business, Commerce, or Operations Management.

12–15 years of experience in operations, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role in the gold/precious metals/financial services/retail industry.

Experience managing multi-location/state-level operations.

Strong track record in data analysis, reporting, and process standardization.

Work Location: In person

title: IS Operations Manager
description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

IS Service Owner - Run Services

\_\_

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be accountable to deliver and orchestrate the delivery of Information Systems (IS) service line operations activities. Each day, you will coordinate with and supervise internal and/or external third-party supplier resources for the effective delivery and operational performance of the services in scope. You will also showcase your skills by ensuring continuous improvement and compliance.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Managing the operational execution of key enterprise applications, ensuring 99.9% uptime and service stability.
* Providing technical skill in diagnosing, identifying and fixing, and resolving infrastructure and application issues to ensure service continuity.
* Monitoring and optimizing system performance, carefully identifying inefficiencies and implementing solutions to improve operational effectiveness.
* Ensuring compliance with ITIL processes, security standards, and applicable corporate policies.
* Collaborating with external vendors to define Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitor service quality, and manage technical escalations.
* Implementing automation and continuous improvements in operational processes to enhance the efficiency and resilience of RUN Services.
* Supporting application onboarding and ensuring effective transitions into RUN Services.
* Monitoring and analyzing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), providing insights and recommendations to improve service quality and operational performance.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* You have 3–5 years of practical experience in IT operations, including managing enterprise applications and infrastructure.
* You possess solid technical knowledge of cloud environments (Azure/AWS), Linux/Windows operating systems, networking, and databases.
* You have demonstrated experience in identifying and fixing, diagnosing, and resolving complex IT incidents and system performance issues.
* You have a well-developed understanding of ITIL frameworks and IT Service Management processes, including Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
* You have practical experience with automation tools and practices, such as scripting, CI/CD, and monitoring solutions, to improve operational efficiency.
* You demonstrate effective organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to changing requirements, and maintain service quality.
* As an advantage, you hold ITIL, Azure, or infrastructure-related certifications.

**Your benefits:**

* Enjoy flexible working hours to support your work-life balance.
* Benefit from the possibility of working from home, including a financial contribution to support your home office setup.
* Receive an annual financial bonus and benefit from an annual salary review.
* Explore opportunities for career growth and professional development within an international organization.
* Take advantage of a MultiSport card to support your health and well-being.
* Benefit from private medical care (including offers for family members) and life insurance.
* Access learning and development opportunities, including internal and external professional training and language courses.
* Choose from various benefits in kind, ranging from healthy lifestyle offerings and knowledge sharing to team-building activities.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Warehouse Operations Supervisor

title: Global Billing Operations - Team Lead
description:
**Why this role is important to us**

  

Global Billing Operations (“Global Billing”) is responsible for all of State Street’s client billing processes across the globe. The remit spans across Asset Servicing, Alpha, Global Markets, Global Advisors and the Digital division, covering over 50+ billing processes and 40+ legacy platforms. Global Billing is undergoing a multi-year transformation spanning people and operating model, processes and controls, data automation and technology.

State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Global Delivery, which is responsible for Billing Transformation, Client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in India, Poland and China.

  

**Job Purpose**

  

State Street has committed to significantly automating and streamlining the technology and data associated to its varied billing processes. As part of this commitment, there is a dedicated Billing Data team responsible for developing and implementing the appropriate strategy to migrate from legacy, manual processes to a highly automated environment with more robust controls.

  

This role will be supporting Global Billing Data Sourcing Lead, as the team implements billing transformation strategy across data sourcing, will be partnering with teams to monitor, track, report progress, targets and outcome linked to target state operating. This role will be responsible for ensuring data is available within agreed SLA for timely client billing, support new sources identification across all regions, automation, user acceptance testing of new data source, system build out validation and conversion to provide insights, status, opportunities and ensuring that various components of underlying processes are run as expected –in line with the strategy and prioritization defined by the Head of Billing Operations to achieve the goals of migration to the single, Oracle based platform (ORMB).

  

**What you will be responsible for**

* Work with Data Sourcing Lead to ensure data can be automated within Data Hub and sent to downstream applications including ORMB within a controlled environment
* Support, partner with invoicing and setup teams for to help identify opportunities for reduction, conversion for manual data sources to automation in Data Hub ( at product, system level)
* Partner with GBIC, Fee Schedule Governance, Data Governance – for new services to clients, on billing methodology, data, SLA, data source provider agreement to ensure the team has the necessary documentation to drive onboarding new clients
* Align with Global Billing Data Sourcing Lead on prioritization (conversion, DCO and billability) with Product (DMH, CSA, ORMB), and optimize existing data sources
* Promote risk excellence culture and looking at opportunities for continuous improvement
  

**What we Value**

* Attention to detail, ownership and accountability
* Ability to navigate and partner with various stakeholders
* Ability to communicate and above par presentation skills
* Positive attitude, organized, self-starter, with a history of contributing to a successful, diverse team
* Demonstrated experience of multi-tasking and effective time management with attention to detail in a fast paced environment
* Ability to influence across siloes and work with broader teams and a collaborative attitude

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master degree in IT/Finance or equivalent industry recognized qualification
* Must have a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in Financial/Global Services Organization /Investment banking related IT Industry
  

**About State Street**

**What we do** . State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

**Work, Live and Grow** . We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

  

**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility** . We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you. State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

  
  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. title: Lead, Reporting & Data Stewardship, Content Operations
description:
**Role Purpose**

The Lead Reporting role is responsible for driving high-quality, reliability, and decision-oriented reporting across Content Operations. The role will lead the design, production, governance, and continuous improvement of operational and management reporting, ensuring that KPIs and insights are accurate, consistent, timely, and actionable. The candidate should be able to Looks beyond numbers to understand drivers, risks, and implications.

  
  

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capability with reporting governance, data quality, automation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. The role will also act as a subject-matter expert for reporting standards and support the transition from manual reporting toward scalable, automated, and self-service reporting solutions.

  
  

**Job Summary**
===============

  
  

We are looking for an experienced reporting professional to take on a Lead Reporting role within Content Operations.

This role provides an opportunity to lead the evolution of reporting from traditional operational outputs toward more automated, governed, and insight-driven management information.

The ideal candidate will bring strong reporting and analytical expertise, a passion for data quality and continuous improvement, and the ability to work effectively across Operations, Data, Product, and Technology stakeholders. The individual will be expected to take ownership, challenge existing processes constructively, develop others, and ensure reporting delivers meaningful business insights rather than simply producing metrics.

This role is particularly suited to someone ready to move from producing reports to owning the reporting framework, governance, insights, and improvement agenda. The candidate should be able to Looks beyond numbers to understand drivers, risks, and implications.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Analytics and Automations**
-----------------------------

* Transformation and readiness of the team towards Product lead to deliverables for content operations.

* Define operating rhythm and improvements to the current processes especially focusing on the client engagement activities.

* Lead the delivery of recurring operational, management, and leadership reporting.

* Develop meaningful KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, trend analysis, and performance insights.

* Translate complex operational data into concise, decision-oriented management information.

* Identify trends, exceptions, risks, bottlenecks, and areas requiring management attention.

* Ensure reporting explains what happened, why it happened, and what action is required.

* Identify opportunities to reduce manual reporting through automation and process simplification.

* Support development and enhancement of management dashboards using Power BI, Excel, Power Query, and other approved reporting technologies.

* Improve reporting processes to increase scalability, transparency, and efficiency.

* Partner with technology and data teams to enhance data availability and reporting capabilities.

* Encourage migration from spreadsheet-heavy reporting toward governed and reusable reporting solutions where appropriate.

* Takes end-to-end responsibility and proactively resolves issues.

* Maintains high standards for data accuracy and reporting integrity.

* Looks beyond numbers to understand drivers, risks, and implications.

  
  

**Reporting Governance & Data Quality**
---------------------------------------

* Establish and maintain clear definitions, calculation methodologies, ownership, and governance for reporting metrics.

* Implement validation and reconciliation controls to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.

* Investigate data discrepancies and coordinate root-cause analysis and remediation.

* Maintain KPI definitions, reporting logic, source documentation, SOPs, and control procedures.

* Promote strong data stewardship practices and clear accountability for reporting data.

**Stakeholder Management**
--------------------------

* Partners with Operations, Product, Data, Technology, Governance, and leadership stakeholders understand reporting requirements.

* Convert business requirements into measurable KPIs and practical reporting solutions.

* Communicate reporting changes, data-quality concerns, dependencies, and delivery risks clearly.

* Challenge requirements constructively where reporting does not provide sufficient business value or decision-making insight.

* Present reporting outcomes and key insights confidently to senior stakeholders.

**Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------

* Review existing reports and identify opportunities for consolidation, standardization, automation, and simplification.

* Reduce duplication and manual intervention across reporting processes.

* Develop reusable reporting frameworks and templates.

* Drive root-cause resolution rather than relying on recurring manual adjustments.

* Support implementation of controls that improve reporting accuracy and operational resilience.

**Leadership & Team Development**
---------------------------------

* Provide functional leadership and subject-matter expertise to reporting analysts and specialists.

* Review reporting outputs and provide constructive feedback to improve analytical quality.

* Support knowledge sharing, cross-training, documentation, and succession readiness.

* Delegate responsibilities effectively while maintaining clear accountability.

* Coach team members in analytical thinking, stakeholder communication, data quality, and reporting best practices.

**Key Competencies**
====================

**Technical / Functional**
--------------------------

* Advanced analytical and reporting capability.

* Strong understanding of KPI design and performance measurement.

* Advanced Excel capability, including analysis, validation, reconciliation, and reporting.

* Experience with Power BI, data visualization, or comparable business intelligence solutions.

* Understanding of data governance, data quality, lineage, controls, and stewardship principles.

* Ability to work with large and complex datasets.

* Experience with reporting automation and process improvement.

* Knowledge of SQL, Power Query, or similar data-transformation capabilities is advantageous.

**Leadership**
--------------

* Ability to lead through influence and take ownership from requirement through delivery.

* Strong prioritization and decision-making capability.

* Ability to manage competing reporting requirements and deadlines.

* Effective coaching and knowledge-sharing skills.

* Demonstrated accountability for quality and outcomes.

**Experience & Qualifications**
===============================

* 8+ years’ experience in relevant space.

* Good knowledge of content operations is an added advantage.

* Strong professional experience in reporting, management information, data analytics, business intelligence, data quality, or related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience owning complex or business-critical reporting deliverables.

* Experience developing operational KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and management reporting.

* Proven ability to analyze data and convert findings into actionable business insights.

* Experience working with multiple stakeholders across business and technical functions.

* Experience improving or automating manual reporting processes.

* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.

**Career Stage:**

Manager

title: Senior Business Operation Manager
description:
**About Payoneer**

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

**As Senior Business Operations Manager,** you will independently own impactful projects and initiatives, end-to-end. They will emerge from data, voice of our customers, from our people on the ground and in general from cross-business units across Payoneer.

You'll be asked to lead these projects and initiatives, while in most cases the actual solution will be driven by other departments. You'll be responsible for keeping ROI in mind and balancing quick wins with core initiatives that support our long-term growth strategy.

You'll partner with business units across Payoneer to drive business operational excellence through building clear improvement.For this, you'd be analyzing the data, calculating the required resources for your initiatives, and be accountable for their cross-company execution. You'll do all this whilst also keeping cost and risk implications in mind, and in an environment of competing demands for resources and frequent re-prioritizations.

The issues you will be dealing with will be central and with high potential to impact the business positively done, you will be the owner, driving multiple cross-functional teams and senior management to get things done, fast and with high quality.

Your actions and progress will be clearly measured by increase of our revenues or a reduction in our losses.

**What you'll do** **-**

* Strong problem-solving skills, able to prioritize among many conflicting needs, advocate a course of action with strong sense of ownership and ability to deliver.
* Strong communication skills – written and verbal to be able to push your ideas and agendas forward in a clear and simple manner working effectively
* Experience in working with senior management.
* Strategic thinker who can constantly connect the dots between the different parts of the business
* Strong analytics skill, able to extract business insights from data. Including hands on analytics
* Flexible and responsive to dynamic situations, while pursuing the execution consistently, with the ability to perform under pressure.
* A humble, caring professional who puts customers and colleagues first and passionate about both their experience.
* A team player who understands that collaboration is the key to success, whilst being self-motivated and a self-starter with a "Can do" attitude.
* Energetic, motivated self-starter who possess strong interpersonal skills and is able to collaborate with various teams across the business and driving execution.

**Who you are -**

* At least 5 years' experience in business development/ business operation/ sales operation/ program management.
* Deep understanding of the "Payoneer" flows, policies and decision makers.
* Data oriented, possesses a high level of attention to detail with strong analytical and business reasoning skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proven experience of working with senior management, including C-level.
* Demonstrated experience working with and presenting to senior executives.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
* Leading global projects, from discovery to execution
* Working in a dynamic environment, establishing relationships with global teams
* Collecting and translating feedback from both customers and different business teams, across various touch points, identifying processes and areas that need improvements and recommending solutions to improve the business infrastructure, processes, reports, etc.
* End to end tracking of the business and operational metrics and delivering insights to the business and management on an ongoing basis
* Establishing and maintaining cross-functional communication and working procedures with internal key stack holders.

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**

**Act as our customer's partner on the inside**
  
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*

**Do it. Own it.**
  
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*

**Continuously improve**
  
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*

**Build each other up**  
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

title: Sr. Facility Manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
ey Responsibilities
  
Multi-City Facilities Operations Management
  
Lead and oversee facilities management operations across multiple sites within the assigned cluster.
  
Ensure consistent delivery of hard services, soft services, and workplace experience standards across all locations.
  
Drive operational excellence through standardization, process compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
Conduct regular site reviews and operational audits to ensure service quality and compliance.
  
KPI & Performance Management
  
Monitor and review operational KPIs and SLAs across all sites.
  
Analyze performance metrics, identify operational gaps, and implement corrective actions.
  
Prepare and present operational dashboards, monthly reviews, and management reports.
  
Drive service delivery improvements through data-driven decision-making.
  
Budget & Financial Management
  
Manage cluster-level operational budgets and ensure financial targets are achieved.
  
Monitor expenses, optimize operational costs, and improve cost efficiencies.
  
Review billing, invoicing, forecasting, and financial reporting activities.
  
Support annual budgeting and financial planning processes.
  
Vendor Management
  
Manage vendor performance across engineering, soft services, security, landscaping, pest control, and specialized services.
  
Ensure vendors comply with contractual obligations, SLAs, safety standards, and statutory requirements.
  
Conduct periodic vendor performance reviews and support contract renewals and negotiations.
  
Drive service quality improvements through effective vendor governance.
  
Client Relationship Management
  
Serve as the primary point of contact for key client stakeholders across the cluster.
  
Build and maintain strong client relationships through proactive engagement and service responsiveness.
  
Conduct regular governance meetings, business reviews, and escalation management discussions.
  
Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and support account growth opportunities.
  
Team Leadership & People Management
  
Lead and mentor site managers and operational teams across the cluster.
  
Ensure proper staffing, training, succession planning, and performance management.
  
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer service excellence.
  
Compliance & Risk Management
  
Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, safety requirements, and organizational policies.
  
Drive EHS initiatives and risk mitigation programs across all managed sites.
  
Support audits, inspections, and incident management processes.
  
Qualifications
  
Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
  
Certifications in Facilities Management or Project Management are preferred.
  
Experience
  
12–18 years of experience in facilities management or property operations.
  
Proven experience managing multi-site and multi-city operations.
  
Strong exposure to corporate real estate, commercial facilities, industrial, or mixed-use portfolios.
  
Experience in client-facing leadership roles preferred.
  
Technical & Functional Skills
  
Strong understanding of integrated facilities management operations.
  
Expertise in KPI management, operational reporting, and governance reviews.
  
Financial acumen with experience in budgeting and cost management.
  
Vendor management and contract administration experience.
  
Strong operational planning and problem-solving capabilities.
  
Behavioral Competencies
  
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
  
Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  
Strategic thinking with operational execution focus.
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities across geographically dispersed teams.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

Run the operational backbone of the AI&R function, spanning across headcount, financials, vendor, reporting, process documentation and internal communications.

title: Senior Manager - Branch Operations (Senior Manager - BSAT)
description:
### **What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a Senior Manager - BSAT to take ownership of branch operations governance, risk and audit readiness, application access controls, process communication, control reporting and improvement initiatives. The role requires a hands-on leader who can manage a broad portfolio, coordinate multiple stakeholders, guide team members and convert regulatory or business requirements into timely, tracked execution across branches.

### **What does the job entail?**

Governance, Risk, Audit and Compliance

* Review and maintain Branch Operations documents, including Business Continuity Planning (BCP), Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), risk, audit and related governance documents.

* Plan and execute quarter-end audit checks, validations and evidence readiness, with closure tracking for observations and exceptions.

* Coordinate quarterly NAV certification and maintain supporting documentation, sign-offs and audit trails.

* Own BPM documentation and periodic reviews to ensure processes, controls, roles and approvals remain current.

Application Access and Master Data Governance

* Lead periodic access recertification for Branch Operations applications, including LMS, TEBT, LifeAsia Mumbai/Bangalore, OEL and other relevant systems.

* Govern new-user application access activities, ensuring correct approvals, maker-checker controls, timely provisioning and closure of exceptions.

* Maintain Branch Master accuracy and coordinate additions, modifications and closure-related changes with relevant stakeholders.

Control Reports, Command Centre and Operational Monitoring

* Govern the Command Centre portfolio of existing reports and audits, including approximately 25 control reports, with clear ownership, exception thresholds and escalation routines.

* Monitor report outliers and drive timely resolution with regional, zonal and central stakeholders.

* Review requirements for new control reports and periodically remove, consolidate or redesign reports that no longer add value.

* Oversee loans, surrender aversion and other operational control reports, ensuring data quality, actionable insights and closure tracking.

Customer Retention, Process Improvement and Strategic Initiatives

* Drive surrender aversion initiatives through smart cuts, review calls, performance tracking and implementation of new requirements.

ontent.

* Maintain the branch visit calendar and track planned visits, observations and closure actions.

* Coordinate central receipting changes, inclusion of new channels, MICR code requirements and related implementation activities.

Stakeholder and Team Management

* Work closely with Risk, Audit, Compliance, Claims, Finance, Technology, Policy Servicing, Data, regional operations and central processing teams.

* Lead and guide assigned team members through clear work allocation, review cadence, quality checks and capability development.

* Provide concise updates, decision notes, dashboards and escalation summaries to Branch Operations leadership.

### **Work Experience**

8+ years in BFSI operations, preferably in life insurance, with experience in branch operations, governance, risk controls, audit coordination, process management and stakeholder engagement.

### **Essential Qualification**

Graduate in any discipline. MBA/PGDM or a relevant professional qualification is preferred.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Strong understanding of branch operations, operational risk, internal controls, audit readiness and regulatory compliance.

* Ability to manage a diverse portfolio with multiple recurring deadlines and cross-functional dependencies.

* Strong analytical capability, including exception analysis, root-cause identification and control-report rationalisation.

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; working knowledge of Power BI or similar visualisation tools is desirable.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create clear process notes, circulars, review decks and leadership updates.

* Effective stakeholder management, influencing and follow-through across central and field teams.

* People leadership, work allocation, coaching and performance monitoring.

* Comfort with digital tools, workflow automation and AI-enabled productivity solutions.

title: Duty Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Duty Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the hotel’s daily operations, ensuring that all departments work together seamlessly to deliver outstanding guest service. Your leadership and problem-solving skills will be key in providing a positive guest experience and ensuring smooth hotel operations. As a
**Duty Manager**

**Responsibilities**
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
  
  

* Manage daily hotel operations: Oversee the overall functioning of the property, including front desk, staffing, room inventory, guest service, and policy compliance
* Delight our guests: Bring an upbeat and friendly attitude to all guest interactions, respond promptly to inquiries, and resolve any issues in a friendly, efficient manner
* Assist across departments: Step in to support operational roles as needed, including bell service or front desk coverage during breaks or high-volume periods
* Monitor the property: Conduct walkthroughs to assess safety, security, and service quality, addressing issues promptly
* Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
* Track and improve performance: Monitor guest satisfaction metrics (e.g., SALT, Revinate), identify trends, and implement improvements as needed
* Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**

* Proven background in front office or hotel operations, ideally in a supervisory or managerial role.
* Strong team management skills with the ability to motivate staff and drive service excellence.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; able to handle complaints and challenges professionally.
* Proficient in hotel PMS and familiar with standard operational procedures.
* Calm under pressure and responsive to changing priorities or schedules.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
* Flexible to work nights, weekends, and holidays.

**About Us**
**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
  
  
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Assistant Vice President - Transaction Reporting
description:
**Job Title:**
Assistant Vice President – Regulatory Transaction Reporting & Data Services
  
  
**Department:**
Asset Management – Investment Operations / Reporting
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Asset Management Reporting and Data Services are responsible for the end-to-end integrity of the data lifecycle. This includes transforming validated investment, accounting, pricing, and reference data into accurate, timely, and compliant reports for clients, regulators, and internal stakeholders. The function ensures that regulatory transaction reporting (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC) is executed with precision while maintaining the robust data foundations required for institutional-grade reporting.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The Assistant Vice President (AVP) serves as a strategic leader and dual-function controller within the Regulatory Transaction Reporting (RTR) and Data Services ecosystem. The role is responsible for the governance, oversight, and continuous improvement of both the regulatory reporting framework and the underlying data management architecture.
  
  
The AVP is accountable for ensuring the "Golden Source" of data is maintained, managing the full data lineage from ingestion to regulatory submission, and driving the strategic roadmap for data quality and reporting automation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Direct Responsibilities**

* Strategic Oversight: Lead the end-to-end delivery strategy for regulatory transaction reporting and the data services lifecycle, ensuring all global SLAs and multi-jurisdictional requirements are met.
* Data Governance & Integrity: Act as the primary authority for data quality; establish and enforce standards for data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and consistency across all reporting streams.
* Regulatory Control Authority: Direct the oversight of both direct production (SFTR, MiFID II) and outsourced/delegated reporting (EMIR, ASIC), ensuring rigorous control over 3rd party Service Providers and Clearing Brokers.
* Critical Escalation & Incident Management: Serve as the senior point of contact for resolving complex regulatory discrepancies, systemic data breaks, and high-priority reporting failures.
* Quality Assurance Framework: Define and implement enhanced control standards for transaction pairing, matching, UTI management, and master data reconciliation.

**Contributing Responsibilities**

* Leadership & Talent Development: Provide strategic direction to Production Analysts and Data Processors; drive a culture of technical excellence, data literacy, and continuous professional development.
* Transformation & Data Engineering Oversight: Lead large-scale automation and digitalization projects; oversee the implementation of automated data validation rules and streamlined data ingestion workflows.
* Data Lineage & Traceability: Partner with IT and Data Engineering to ensure full end-to-end data lineage, enabling seamless audit trails from regulatory submission back to the original source system.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with senior leaders in Performance, Accounting, and Product teams to optimize upstream data flows and resolve systemic "root cause" issues.
* Audit & Regulatory Liaison: Lead the response to internal/external audits and regulatory inquiries, ensuring all data controls, governance documentation, and oversight evidence are robust.
* Change Management: Drive the implementation of new regulatory requirements (e.g., EMIR Refit) and system enhancements across the global reporting and data landscape.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Competencies**

* Advanced Regulatory Reporting Mastery: Deep expertise in the mechanics of EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, and ASIC, including submission lifecycles and exception handling.
* Data Management & Governance Expertise: Advanced understanding of Master Data Management (MDM), data sourcing, enrichment, and the management of investment data domains (Holdings, Pricing, Reference Data, Corporate Actions).
* Data Quality & Analytics: Ability to design data quality dashboards and use statistical methods to monitor data health and identify emerging trends/risks.
* Systems & Data Architecture: High-level understanding of the end-to-end data pipeline, including the connectivity between source systems, data warehouses, and regulatory interfaces (ARMs/APAs/TRs).
* Risk & Control Design: Advanced ability to design and implement complex control frameworks to mitigate operational, regulatory, and reputational risks.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategic Leadership: Ability to lead diverse teams through complex regulatory shifts and inspire a culture of data-driven accountability.
* Influencing & Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and effectively challenge 3rd party service providers and brokers.
* Decisiveness under Pressure: Ability to make high-stakes, time-sensitive decisions regarding regulatory deadlines and data integrity.
* Problem-Solving & Innovation: A proactive approach to identifying systemic gaps in data/reporting logic and implementing long-term technological solutions.
* High Accountability: Absolute ownership of the function’s regulatory standing, data accuracy, and global delivery quality.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Education: Post Graduate degree in Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline (MBA/CFA preferred).
* Experience: Extensive experience (5+ years) in Regulatory Transaction Reporting or Financial Data Management within an Asset Management or Sell-side environment.
* Data Mastery: Proven track record in managing complex data flows, performing high-level reconciliations, and validating data lineage and traceability.
* Leadership Track Record: Experience in managing operational teams and overseeing outsourced service providers/vendors.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Expert-level understanding of the evolving global regulatory landscape (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Process Excellence: Demonstrated experience in leading process improvement, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.

**Skills Referential**
**Technical Skills:**

* Advanced Regulatory Frameworks (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Data Governance, Data Lineage, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Strategic Risk Management & Control Design.
* Expert proficiency in Data Analysis tools (Advanced Excel, SQL/Python knowledge preferred) and Reporting Platforms (e.g., Aladdin, DTCC, Tri-Optima).

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strategic Thinking & Vision.
* Executive Communication (Reporting KPIs and trends to senior management).
* Change Leadership & Transformation.
* Advanced Conflict Resolution & Negotiation.
* Risk-based Decision Making.

**Education Level:**
Post Graduate degree in Finance
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai

title: Country Manager
description:
Role Summary

The Country Manager – India will be the senior-most business leader for Client of Pinnacle Group in the country, holding full P&L accountability for the India business and its expansion. The role requires a leader with deep local market knowledge, strong relationships across government, GCC and enterprise clients, and a proven track record of growing IT services and technology business across India. The Country Manager will represent the company to government bodies, regulators, key clients, technology partners, and industry forums, while driving revenue growth, operational excellence, and talent development across all business lines.

Key Responsibilities

Business Leadership & P&L Ownership

* Own the full profit and loss (P&L) for Client of Pinnacle Group’s India operations across IT Services, IT Consulting, KPO, IT Training, and Software Products.
* Develop and execute the annual business plan and multi-year growth strategy for India, aligned with overall group objectives.
* Drive revenue growth, margin improvement, and operational efficiency across all business lines.

Sales & Business Development

* Lead new business development with government ministries, semi-government entities, GCCs, and large private-sector enterprises in India.
* Build and maintain C-level and senior executive and government relationships to identify, pursue, and win large IT services and consulting engagements.
* Oversee the sales pipeline, key account strategy, and major bid/proposal processes; personally lead negotiations on large or strategic deals.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling KPO, IT training, and software products into the existing client base.

Client & Stakeholder Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the company’s largest and most strategic India accounts.
* Represent Client of Pinnacle Group with regulators, industry associations, technology partners (e.g., global OEMs and software vendors), and at public/industry forums.
* Ensure compliance with India country statutory requirements, local labour laws, and other regulatory obligations.

Operations & Delivery Oversight

* Oversee delivery quality and client satisfaction across all engagements, working closely with delivery and consulting leads.
* Ensure robust governance, risk management, and commercial discipline across projects and contracts.

People Leadership

* Lead, mentor, and develop the India leadership team across sales and business development, and work in tandem with the company executive suite across delivery, operations, finance, and HR.
* Build a strong local talent pipeline, with particular attention to developing talent in line with country goals.
* Foster a high-performance, client-centric culture aligned with the company’s values.

Candidate Profile

Required Background

* Indian resident, with the vast majority of life and career based in India, and strong existing networks across government, GCCs and private-sector clients in the country.
* A significant portion of career spent with an IT Services / IT Consulting organization — ideally a global Tier-1 player with an established India presence, such as IBM, Accenture, Capgemini, or a top tier IOP service provider organization.
* Prior experience in a Sales, Business Development, or Client-Facing Leadership role is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of winning and managing large enterprise, GCCs or government IT contracts in India.
* Experience managing or contributing to a P&L of meaningful scale (multi-million-dollar revenue base) is highly desirable.

Skills & Attributes

* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, with comfort operating at CXO and senior executive levels.
* Working knowledge of the broader IT services landscape: infrastructure, consulting, KPO/BPO, training, and software products.
* Fluency in English and at least one other Indian langauge (written and spoken).
* Strong leadership and people-management capability across multi-disciplinary teams.
* High personal integrity, and credibility with executives, government and regulatory stakeholders.

Education & Experience

* A bachelor’s degree is typically expected; an MBA or equivalent is a plus but not mandatory. Age, gender, and specific educational background are not limiting factors — demonstrated experience and results matter most.
* Typically 12–20+ years of overall experience, with at least 5–10 years in a senior sales, business development, or general management capacity within IT services in India.

What We Offer

* Full P&L leadership of a sizeable, well-established India business (~US$60M annualized revenue) within a diversified global IT services group.
* A high-visibility mandate with direct access to group leadership and the autonomy to shape the country strategy.

Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and the opportunity to build and scale a high-performing local leadership team.

Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.

Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.

title: Costing Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Costing Manager is a growing organization focused on delivering accurate, data-driven costing and financial insights to support effective business decisions. The company values precision, transparency, and collaboration, working closely with internal teams to optimize resource utilization and profitability. Based in Tiruppur, Costing Manager serves clients in dynamic, cost-sensitive markets where efficiency and reliability are critical. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, improve processes, and develop professionally in a supportive environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Costing Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Tiruppur, responsible for overseeing product and project costing activities. Day-to-day tasks include collecting and analyzing cost data, preparing cost sheets, monitoring material, labor, and overhead expenses, and ensuring accurate cost allocation across departments. The role requires close coordination with production, procurement, finance, and sales teams to validate costing assumptions, support pricing decisions, and improve margin performance. The Costing Manager will also review existing costing methodologies, recommend process improvements, and prepare regular reports for management on cost trends and profitability.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret financial and operational data for costing purposes.
* Experience in cost accounting, budgeting, variance analysis, and product or manufacturing costing.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets and ERP or accounting software, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate cost insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders
* Relevant experience in manufacturing or production environments, preferably in Tiruppur or similar markets.
* Strong organizational skills, problem-solving abilities, and a proactive approach to process improvement.

title: Senior Manager – Global Logistics & Last Mile Operations
description:
**About Handelnine Global:**

Handelnine Global is a profitable, self-funded e-commerce house of brands with customers in 60+ countries. We operate 10+ online brands across the USA, UK, Europe, Australia, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia — powered by our own proprietary technology platform and a fulfilment network spanning the US, UK, and India.

We're not a marketplace or a 3PL. We own the entire chain — from product sourcing to storefront technology to last-mile delivery. For an operations leader, this means you're not optimising one link; you're shaping the whole system.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Senior Manager – Global Logistics & Last Mile Operations to own delivery performance, carrier relationships, and shipping cost efficiency across all our markets.

This is the person who obsesses over why a package to Germany took 9 days instead of 5, why our UK carrier's first-attempt delivery rate dropped 3 points this month, and whether rerouting Middle East volume through a different carrier saves costs per shipment at scale.

You'll manage our relationships with global carriers like DHL, FedEx, Royal Mail, USPS, and regional last-mile partners across 30+ countries. You'll own the data - delivery times, cost per shipment, exception rates, return logistics - and use it to make decisions that directly impact customer experience and margins.

The immediate priorities are clear: reduce last-mile costs without sacrificing speed, improve carrier performance through data-driven SLA management, and support expansion into new markets by identifying and onboarding the right delivery partners.

You'll report to the Head of Global Operations, work closely with our tech and finance teams, and have ownership of a function that touches every order we ship. If you're currently a strong number two in a global logistics or express delivery environment and ready to run the show, this is that opportunity.

**What You'll Do**

**Carrier & Last-Mile Management**

* Own all carrier relationships across markets - negotiating rates, managing SLAs, conducting quarterly business reviews, and holding partners accountable on performance
* Evaluate and onboard new last-mile partners as we expand into new geographies
* Manage the carrier mix by region to optimise the cost-speed-reliability tradeoff
* Reduce delivery timelines, breaches, failed deliveries, and minimise return-to-origin volumes

**Cost & Efficiency**

* Direct accountability for global shipping cost per order - you own the number
* Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities across carrier contracts, routing, packaging, and zone optimisation
* Build and maintain rate card benchmarks across carriers and corridors
* Work with finance to forecast shipping costs and flag variances early

**Data & Analytics**

* Use our internal dashboards to track daily delivery performance across all markets
* Build reporting frameworks for carrier scorecards, delivery SLAs, exception rates, and cost trends
* Spot patterns before they become problems — a spike in customs delays, a carrier underperforming in a specific region, a cost creep on a particular lane
* Present weekly operational reviews to the CEO with clear data, root causes, and action plans

**Warehouse & Fulfilment Coordination**

* Coordinate with our fulfilment centres in the US, UK, and India to ensure smooth handoff from warehouse to last-mile
* Support new warehouse setup and operationalisation as we expand the network
* Work with the tech team to improve order routing logic and carrier allocation rules

**Team & Cross-Functional**

* Build and mentor a lean, high-performing operations team
* Work with customer service to reduce delivery-related tickets and improve post-purchase experience

**What We're Looking For**

* 6-12 years in last-mile logistics, express delivery, or e-commerce fulfilment operations — ideally with international exposure
* Background at a global express carrier (DHL, FedEx, UPS, Aramex), a cross-border e-commerce company, or a D2C brand with serious shipping volume
* Deep understanding of last-mile economics — you think in cost per shipment, delivery attempt rates, zone surcharges, dimensional weight, and customs clearance times
* Analytically strong — you're comfortable in spreadsheets, dashboards, and data. You question numbers, not just report them
* Experience managing carrier relationships and negotiating contracts
* Clear, structured communicator — you can present to the leadership team at 10am and troubleshoot a carrier escalation at 2pm
* Based in Mumbai, willing to work full-time from our Bandra W office

**Stands out**

* Experience with multi-country, multi-carrier logistics across US, UK, Europe, and Middle East
* Exposure to customs, duties, and cross-border compliance
* Comfort with AI tools and automation for operational improvement
