title: Manager - Customer Experience
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and data-driven Customer Experience Manager to lead and strengthen the customer experience function for our D2C business. The role will own day-to-day CX operations, performance reporting, service-level adherence, critical escalations, outsourced support partner performance, online reputation management, process improvements and the development of a structured Customer Insights / Voice of Customer (VoC) programme.

1. Customer Experience Operations & Performance Management

* Own day-to-day customer experience operations across D2C channels, including email, calls, WhatsApp and social media.
* Track, analyse and report CSAT, NPS, First Response Time (FRT), resolution TAT, ticket backlog, contact rate, repeat contacts and escalation rate.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly CX dashboards and management reports.
* Identify performance gaps, recurring customer pain points and operational bottlenecks, and drive corrective actions.
* Improve customer satisfaction, resolution quality and the overall post-purchase experience.

2. Escalation & Grievance Management

* Independently handle L3 customer escalations across calls and emails, ensuring timely, professional and policy-aligned resolutions.
* Manage sensitive complaints, high-value customer issues and critical brand-related escalations.
* Coordinate investigations with D2C, warehouse, logistics, finance, product, quality and other internal teams.
* Maintain an escalation tracker and ensure closure within defined timelines.
* Coordinate responses to formal consumer grievances and relevant consumer forums in consultation with management.

3. Outsourced Customer Support Management – Dialdesk

* Act as the primary point of contact for the outsourced customer support partner.
* Monitor agent productivity, attendance, availability, quality and SLA adherence.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with the outsourcing partner.
* Define and monitor agent-level KPIs, quality parameters, productivity benchmarks and escalation processes.
* Ensure adequate staffing, training, holiday coverage and resource planning based on business volumes.
* Drive corrective actions for performance gaps and conduct regular call and ticket audits.

4. SLA Management & Process Improvement

* Establish, monitor and continuously improve SLAs across all customer support channels.
* Ensure timely first responses, resolutions and closure of customer queries.
* Review existing workflows, SOPs and escalation matrices to identify inefficiencies.
* Implement process improvements, automation, workflow-based ticket categorisation and routing.
* Work with technology and operations teams to improve support tools, reporting and resolution efficiency.
* Reduce avoidable customer contacts through proactive communication and better customer-facing processes.

5. Online Reputation Management (ORM)

* Own ORM across social media platforms, review portals and other digital customer touchpoints.
* Monitor customer comments, complaints, reviews and direct messages, ensuring timely and brand-aligned responses.
* Develop response guidelines, escalation workflows and ORM performance metrics.
* Identify recurring complaints and negative sentiment trends and coordinate corrective actions.
* Leverage AI-assisted responses and automation while ensuring appropriate human intervention for sensitive issues.

6. Customer Insights & Voice of Customer (VoC) Programme

* Build and drive a structured Customer Insights programme for the D2C business.
* Establish a common taxonomy for customer feedback, complaints, product issues and purchase experience.
* Analyse customer interactions, reviews, surveys and feedback to identify recurring trends and behavioural patterns.
* Conduct customer surveys, feedback exercises and structured customer interviews.
* Identify insights relating to product expectations, fragrance preferences, product performance, website experience, checkout, delivery and post-purchase experience.
* Translate customer feedback into actionable recommendations for marketing, product, merchandising, website and operations teams.
* Present periodic Voice of Customer reports and track implementation and business impact of recommendations.

7. Team Management & Development

* Lead, mentor and manage the internal customer experience team.
* Define individual responsibilities, targets and performance metrics.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions and quality calibration.
* Ensure consistent product, process and policy knowledge across the team.
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership and customer-centric problem-solving.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* CSAT and NPS improvement
* First Response Time (FRT) and Resolution TAT
* SLA adherence across all channels
* Ticket backlog and ageing
* L3 escalation volume and closure TAT
* Repeat contact and complaint rates
* Outsourced agent productivity and quality scores
* ORM response time and complaint resolution
* Customer feedback categorisation and insight reporting
* Number of actionable customer insights implemented
* Reduction in recurring customer complaints and avoidable contacts



Skills & Competencies

* Strong understanding of D2C / e-commerce customer experience operations.
* Excellent analytical and reporting skills; proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets required. Power BI knowledge is an advantage.
* Experience managing outsourced contact centres and vendor relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to independently manage difficult customer conversations and escalations.
* Experience with CRM, ticketing, contact centre and ORM platforms.
* Strong process orientation, problem-solving and stakeholder management.
* Ability to convert customer feedback and data into actionable business improvements.
* Working knowledge of AI-based customer support automation and workflow management is preferred.



Recommended Work Experience

Overall experience: 5–8 years, with at least 3 years in D2C / e-commerce customer experience or customer support operations. Candidates should ideally have at least 2 years of experience managing a team or outsourced support partner, along with hands-on ownership of CX reporting, SLA performance and escalations.

title: Commercial Planning Manager
description:
**Position**
- Manager – Planning & Commercial

**Location**
- BKC, Mumbai

**Experience-**
7–10 years in retail planning and commercial operations, including team supervision.

**Industry**
- Retail/FMCD

**Education**
-Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Finance, Business Administration or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

**Job Purpose**

Drive planning and commercial management for Samsung’s D2C COCO retail business through annual planning, performance analysis, inventory availability, expense management and financial controls. Partner with the GM & Business Head – D2C COCO on P&L planning and tracking, supporting revenue and profitability objectives through coordination with Operations, Finance, Marketing, category teams and Head Office.

**Purpose of Role and Key Deliverables**

Manage business planning and commercial processes, ensuring timely reporting, stock readiness, cost discipline and compliance. Key responsibilities include:

**Business Planning and Reporting**

**1. AOP and Business Performance**

• Prepare the AOP covering category-wise sales, margins, OPEX and inventory; phase targets into monthly, weekly and daily plans.

• Drive P&L planning and tracking in partnership with the GM & Business Head – D2C COCO; analyse variances, update forecasts and follow through on corrective actions.

• Assess the revenue, margin and inventory impact of pricing, promotion and product-mix recommendations.

**2. MIS, Business Tools and Management Reviews**

• Prepare and present AOP and weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual business reviews, highlighting performance, risks and actions.

• Maintain the Stock Tracker, Affordability Tracker, Weekly Sales Review dashboard and CRM MIS; ensure refresh, validation and Monday delivery of weekly reporting.

• Reconcile data before reporting; train Operations on the tools and build standard templates suitable for future COCO stores.

**Inventory Management**

**3. Forecasting, Replenishment and Launch Readiness**

• Forecast category- and SKU-level demand and submit monthly requisitions. Plan replenishment in sequence: store stock, STO from warehouse, Estore virtual stock, then fresh demand; ensure timely receipts.

• Maintain appropriate weeks of stock cover, especially during launches and promotions; address stock-outs, ageing and excess inventory.

•Coordinate with product managers, supply teams and Operations on launch stock, demo availability and timely display readiness.

**4. Stock Control and Warehouse Coordination**

• Oversee stock records, transfers, returns, physical verification and system reconciliations; coordinate stock flow and documentation with warehouse and logistics teams.

• Investigate discrepancies and initiate stock adjustments, recovery proposals and insurance claims through approved processes

**Financial and Commercial Management**

**5. Offers and Head Office Coordination**

• Coordinate approved offers with category teams; proactively communicate bank offers, cashback, EMI/finance schemes, discounts, eligibility and validity through the Affordability Tracker before implementation.

• Monitor execution and commercial impact; resolve discrepancies and track claims, settlements and Head Office dependencies.

**6. Financial Controls, Reconciliations and Compliance**

• Ensure billing, cash, card and digital collections reconcile with system records and settlements; investigate day-end variances and track outstanding items to closure.

• Process NEFT refund RFAs and other commercial requests; review gift card reconciliations and replenishment, approving only within delegated authority.

• Maintain audit-ready records and close audit findings; coordinate cash, POS, inventory and loss-prevention controls with Operations, cashier and security teams.

**7. OPEX, Cost Management and Mall Coordination**

• Manage all operating expense budgets; prepare proposals and business justifications and obtain required management approvals.

• Track committed and actual costs against budget, explain variances and implement cost-control measures, monitoring savings and service standards.

• Oversee invoice checks, expense documentation and payment follow-ups; coordinate with Jio World Plaza on lease obligations, CAM, marketing fund charges and related reconciliations.

**Administration and Team Management**

**8. Team and Administrative Oversight**

• Manage assigned planning, MIS, inventory and administration personnel; set priorities, review delivery, coach staff and maintain process documentation and backup coverage.

• Oversee administrative services, vendors and facility requirements with Operations; follow through on service obligations, renewals and identified safety or maintenance gaps

**Skills:**
Advanced formula-led Excel modelling and dashboards without macros (lookups, pivots, dynamic ranges and data validation); SAMS/SAP, POS, large sales-data extracts and PowerPoint.

**Attributes:**
Analytical judgement, accuracy, ownership, integrity, clear presentation skills and mature stakeholder management.

title: Production & Post-Production Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a Production & Post-Production Manager who can take a locked script from

the Creative Director and be the CD’s right hand in throughout the production and post

production process- from planning and budgeting, to crew and vendor negotiations, to

being on set, to final delivery of the edited video. This role sits at the intersection of

production management, vendor negotiation, and creative coordination. You'll be the person

who makes sure the creative vision survives contact with real-world budgets, timelines, and

logistics - without ever using budget as an excuse for a lesser video.

**What You'll Do**

Pre-Production & Planning

● Take locked scripts from the CD and translate the creative requirements/direction into

a concrete production plan.

● Break down each script into crew, equipment, location, cast, and budget

requirements.

● Lock crew members and negotiate their pay/terms.

● Scout, shortlist, and negotiate shoot locations.

● If shooting in-office, identify and arrange all production requirements (space,

equipment, permissions, setup, etc.).

● Handle relevant casting coordination for shoots as needed.

● Make budget sheets

Budgeting & Vendor Management

● Own and control the production budget for each shoot/project.

● Find creative, practical hacks to keep video quality high even under budget

constraints - the budget should never visibly compromise the output.

● Negotiate with vendors (crew, locations, equipment, editors, etc.) to get the best

quality within the budget sanctioned by the company.

● Coordinate with the finance team to lock vendor registrations/onboarding.

● Coordinate release of advances and ensure all vendors are paid on time.

On Shoot

● Be present on shoot days to coordinate all production elements — crew, schedule,

logistics, vendor issues - in real time.

● Troubleshoot on-ground issues quickly, keeping the shoot on schedule and on

budget.

Post-Production

● Coordinate the post-production process once shoot is wrapped.

● Take creative feedback from the CD/creative team and ensure edits are executed

exactly as per that feedback.

● Track edit timelines and ensure final deliverables are completed and delivered on

schedule.

**What We're Looking For**

● Prior experience in production planning/coordination for video/ad shoots (agency,

production house, or in-house brand team background all welcome).

● Existing industry contacts across crew, vendors, locations, and production houses.

● Strong negotiation skills - proven ability to get quality output at feasible costs.

● Solid budgeting and cost-control skills, with a knack for creative problem-solving

when budgets are tight.

● Comfort coordinating with finance teams on vendor registration, advances, and

payments.

● Experience with post-production coordination - working with editors, tracking

feedback loops, and managing delivery timelines.

● A go-getter attitude - someone who solves problems on the spot rather than

escalating everything.

● Strong organizational skills to juggle multiple shoots/projects and their respective

timelines simultaneously.

● Willingness to be hands-on and present on shoot days as required.

Good to Have

● Experience working on performance marketing/ad creative shoots (vs. only brand

films).

● Basic understanding of the creative process so you can bridge conversations

between the CD and vendors/editors effectively.

● Prior casting coordination experience.

title: Head of Supply Chain (PSS08145)
description:

An integrated pharmaceutical organization with comprehensive capabilities in API development and manufacturing, finished dosage product development, regulatory affairs, and international markets. The company operates state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with multiple global GMP certifications and is focused on expanding its global presence and leadership strength in the pharmaceutical sector.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The
**Supply Chain Head**
role exists to lead and integrate supply chain and purchase functions, excluding commercial order fulfilment. This strategic leadership position will build and operate an integrated supply chain system across the group, encompassing demand/supply planning, procurement, vendor and CMO development, inventory, warehousing, and dispatch. The role reports directly to the Managing Director with a dotted line to the Director.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Establish and drive S&OP and demand/supply planning processes aligned with commercial forecasts and manufacturing capacity.
* Translate demand into procurement, production, inventory, and dispatch plans with clear accountability.
* Lead Purchase and strategic sourcing, including new vendor identification, development, and vendor performance governance.
* Develop new CMO partners ensuring supply continuity, quality, cost efficiency, and capacity requirements are met.
* Set inventory norms to improve material and product availability while controlling working capital and obsolescence.
* Oversee warehouse and dispatch governance, including export and logistics coordination where applicable.
* Build ERP-enabled planning systems, dashboards, OTIF measurement, supplier scorecards, and drive continuous improvement.
* Develop the SCM/Purchase organization and strengthen cross-functional operating discipline.
* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Managing Director, Director, Sales, Operations, Quality, R&D/PMC, Finance, and site teams.
* Manage relationships with external suppliers, CMOs, logistics partners, warehouses, and service providers.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Education: Graduate or Postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Pharmacy, or equivalent; pharmaceutical background strongly preferred.
* Experience: 20 years in pharmaceutical supply chain management and procurement with leadership across planning, purchase, inventory, warehousing, and vendor/CMO development.
* Leadership: Proven ability to lead large, cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders including executive reporting to Managing Director and Director.
* Technical Expertise: Strong expertise in S&OP, ERP systems, OTIF metrics, inventory management, and cross-functional execution.
* Soft Skills: Strategic thinker with strong execution capability, integrity, transparency, and commitment to quality and data-driven decision-making.

Why Consider this Opportunity?
  
  

* Lead the design and execution of an integrated supply chain operating system critical to organizational growth.
* Drive significant impact on supply reliability, working capital efficiency, and procurement savings.
* Operate at the intersection of manufacturing, commercial, and vendor management with broad cross-functional influence.
* Shape and develop a high-performing SCM and Purchase organization with strong ERP and data visibility capabilities.
* Contribute to a fast-growing pharmaceutical company with global certifications and expanding international footprint.

**Mumbai, India (Hybrid - 2 office days per week)**

About the Role

As ADVANZ PHARMA continues to strengthen its position as the partner of choice for specialty, hospital, and rare disease medicines, we are seeking an
**Associate Director, Technical Services**
to join our
**Scientific Affairs**
function.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for supporting ADVANZ PHARMA's established product portfolio through technical expertise in product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations, and supply continuity. Working across oral solid dosage forms, liquids, and injectables, you will lead a team of experienced technical professionals while partnering closely with commercial teams, global regulators, and Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs).

The role combines strategic technical leadership with people management, offering broad exposure across global markets, manufacturing networks, lifecycle projects, product optimisation activities, and due diligence initiatives. You will play a key role in ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, and uninterrupted supply across ADVANZ PHARMA's international portfolio.

What You'll Be Responsible For

* Lead and develop a team of Technical Services specialists supporting ADVANZ PHARMA's established portfolio.
* Provide technical leadership across product lifecycle management activities, ensuring products remain robust, compliant, and commercially successful.
* Resolve complex manufacturing, packaging, quality, and supply-related technical issues through collaboration with CMOs and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Support lifecycle projects, including product improvements, manufacturing changes, and technical risk mitigation initiatives.
* Partner with commercial, quality, regulatory, supply chain, and external manufacturing teams to deliver business objectives.
* Provide technical input into product and company due diligence activities where required.
* Lead technical investigations, risk assessments, troubleshooting activities, and implementation of corrective actions.
* Review and approve complex technical documentation, scientific reports, technical justifications, and regulatory submission content.
* Manage technical project priorities, resources, budgets, and timelines to ensure successful delivery.
* Establish performance metrics and continuous improvement initiatives across the Technical Services function.
* Support the development, coaching, and progression of team members.
* Travel periodically (approx once per month) to manufacturing sites and CMOs across Europe and India as required.
* Thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and take accountability for results.
* Embrace challenge and change, applying a growth mindset approach.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an ambitious, resilient, and commercially aware technical leader who is passionate about delivering high-quality medicines to patients and driving business success.

You will bring strong pharmaceutical industry experience across product development, technical services, manufacturing science, or lifecycle management, together with proven people leadership capability.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy or another relevant scientific discipline.
* Master's degree in Pharmacy or another technically relevant subject.
* Project management training or certification (e.g. Prince2)
  **(advantageous)**
* Experience using project management tools such as Microsoft Project or Smartsheet advantageous.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

* Extensive working experience in a technical role within the pharmaceutical or medical device industry.
* Strong experience in Technical Services, Product Development, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Tech Transfer, Production, or Lifecycle Management.
* Demonstrated people management experience, ideally leading experienced technical teams.
* Experience supporting products for regulated markets.
* Strong understanding of GMP requirements, manufacturing operations, process validation, and quality systems.
* Experience managing technical issues that impact product quality, compliance, or supply continuity.
* Expertise across multiple pharmaceutical dosage forms, including oral solids, liquids, and injectables.
* Experience conducting technical investigations, root cause analysis, risk assessments, and troubleshooting activities.
* Strong technical writing and documentation review capabilities, including exposure to regulatory submissions and CMC documentation.
* Ability to manage complex stakeholder groups across quality, regulatory, supply chain, commercial, and external manufacturing functions.
* Strong commercial awareness and ability to balance technical decision-making with business priorities.
* Positive, solutions-focused mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement.

Why Join ADVANZ PHARMA?

At ADVANZ PHARMA, our purpose is clear: improving patients' lives by increasing access to medicines that matter. We are a fast-growing international pharmaceutical company where employees have the opportunity to make a tangible impact, take ownership, and contribute to meaningful work every day.

A Place Where You Can Grow

We foster a culture built on trust, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous development. This role offers exposure to global markets, regulatory authorities, manufacturing partners, and a diverse product portfolio spanning multiple dosage forms and therapeutic areas.

Entrepreneurial by Nature

Our teams are empowered to make decisions, challenge convention, and create solutions that drive results. We value people who bring energy, accountability, and a desire to make things happen.

A Meaningful Mission

Every role at ADVANZ PHARMA contributes to improving access to important therapies for patients across the globe. The work you do will have a direct impact on healthcare professionals, healthcare systems, and ultimately the patients they serve.

Flexibility and Support for Your Wellbeing

Our agile and flexible working arrangements, paired with a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, are designed to support your health, career aspirations, and work-life balance.

Rewards & Benefits

We are delighted to offer a comprehensive package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and professional growth of our employees.

Global Benefits

* Global Recognition Programme
* Long Service Award
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Birthday Leave
* Wellbeing Day
* Volunteering Leave
* Compassionate Leave
* Agile Working
* Work From Anywhere (subject to local legislation)

Our People Recommend Us

We're proud that 82% of employees in our engagement survey said they would recommend ADVANZ PHARMA as a great place to work.

If you're looking for an opportunity to combine technical leadership, global exposure, and meaningful patient impact,
**apply today.**

title: Global MOH Digital Lead & Asia/ANZ Regional Lead
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
**The Role**
The Global MOH Digital Lead & Asia/ANZ Regional Lead is responsible for translating TMICC's global Medical & Occupational Health strategy into sustainable regional execution across Asia and ANZ while leading the deployment and adoption of key MOH digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
The role acts as the primary Corporate Center focal point for MOH governance, digital health transformation, vendor management, compliance oversight, and operational implementation across Asia and ANZ. The role ensures that global standards, operating models, and digital solutions are implemented consistently while supporting workforce health, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and business performance.
  
  
**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Regional MOH Leadership – Asia & ANZ
* Serve as the Corporate Center MOH lead for Asia and ANZ.
* Translate global MOH strategy into regional implementation plans.
* Drive country-level gap assessments, action plans, and follow-up activities.
* Ensure alignment between local HR, SHE, Procurement, Legal, Operations and MOH providers.
* Support development and implementation of country MOH roadmaps.
* Escalate significant compliance, operational, medical, and governance risks where appropriate.
* Support crisis preparedness, response readiness, and workforce resilience activities.
* Drive implementation of TMICC's global vendor-governance framework.
* Support contract reviews, renewals, provider selection, and service harmonization.
* Monitor provider performance against defined KPIs and service-level expectations.
* Partner with Procurement and Legal on MOH contract governance.
* Support implementation of standardized regional service models and minimum requirements.
* Ensure consistent quality, compliance, and employee experience across MOH service providers.
* Digital Health Transformation Leadership
* Partner with IT, Data & Analytics, HR and SHE teams on systems integration.
* Support health-data governance, privacy, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements.
* Support development of digital workflows, reporting dashboards, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled ways of working.
* Ensure consistent use of approved MOH systems and reporting standards across the region.
* Lead regional deployment of Enterprise Health and other approved MOH digital solutions.
* Coordinate local adoption, training, testing, and implementation readiness activities.
* Governance, Compliance & Risk Management
* Support implementation of global MOH policies, standards, and minimum requirements.
* Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory and privacy requirements.
* Identify governance gaps and drive remediation activities.
* Support management of fitness-for-work, occupational disease, health surveillance, and medical governance processes.
* Contribute to audit readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support enterprise health-risk governance and reporting processes.
* Reporting & Health Intelligence
* Support implementation of MOH metrics and reporting frameworks.
* Monitor regional performance indicators and identify emerging risks and trends.
* Ensure data quality and reporting discipline across countries.
* Contribute to development of enterprise health analytics, dashboards, and health-risk indicators.
* Translate data into actionable recommendations for business leaders.

**We're Looking For Someone Who**

* Medical, Occupational Health, Health Sciences, Nursing, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or related degree.
* Significant experience in Medical & Occupational Health, Health & Wellbeing, Healthcare Operations, SHE, or a related field.
* Experience managing multiple countries and stakeholders across complex organizations.
* Experience leading transformation, implementation, or change programs.
* Experience working with external providers and vendor-governance frameworks.
* Strong understanding of health-data governance, compliance, and confidentiality requirements.
* Experience with Enterprise Health, Cority, Workday, Enablon, or similar systems.
* Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, supply chain, or multinational environments.
* Experience in digital transformation and health analytics initiatives.

**What You'll Get**
Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes
  
  

* Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards
* Flexible ways of working
* Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
* Time off to rest and recharge
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Global exposure and cross-functional career experiences
* Career growth through internal mobility and talent programmes
* A diverse, inclusive and values-led workplace culture
* Recognition & rewards - Celebration of individual and team success
* Modern, collaborative workspaces designed for connection and innovation
* Regular moments that bring our people together through networking, learning and community events

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: License Owner, Mumbai
description:
**Are you passionate about football (soccer) and interested in building something of your own?**
**Stranger Soccer is expanding globally and is looking for a License Owner to launch and grow Stranger Soccer in Mumbai.**
**This is not your traditional management job—**
**it is designed for entrepreneurial individuals who want to build, operate, and grow their own local football operation while creating a meaningful impact in their community.**
**Interested in learning more?**
Visit
**www.strangersoccer.com**
and explore the
**Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City**
section to learn more about the opportunity. If it feels like the right fit, complete the interest form to start the conversation. We also encourage you to download the Stranger Soccer app and experience the platform firsthand.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Launch and grow Stranger Soccer in Mumbai
* Build and manage a local team, including staff and Official Hosts
* Secure suitable football venues
* Drive marketing and customer acquisition to grow the player community
* Oversee game operations and deliver an outstanding player experience
* Work closely with our Singapore HQ, supported by operations and technology teams

**You should have**

* A passion for football and involvement in the local football community
* Experience in management, operations, or customer service
* An entrepreneurial mindset and desire to build a business
* The ability to take ownership and grow the Stranger Soccer brand locally
* Strong drive, resilience, and a results-oriented attitude

**About Stranger Soccer**
Football is the world's most popular sport, and Stranger Soccer exists to make playing football simple, accessible, and convenient.
  
  
Through the Stranger Soccer app, players can discover games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play—making football as easy as going to the gym.
  
  
Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer is expanding across cities worldwide, delivering thousands of games and building a growing international community. We are looking for passionate individuals who want to bring Stranger Soccer to their own city.
  
  
**Our Mission**
To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.
  
  
**Our Vision**
A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.
  
  
**Ready to make an impact?**
If you share our vision and want to bring Stranger Soccer to more communities around the world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: CME Head
description:
Looking for Head CME (Machining) / Manufacturing Engineering
  
  
**Industry:**
Automobile / Automotive Manufacturing / Auto Components
  
  
**Position:**
Head CME (Machining)
  
  
**Experience:**
18+ Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Industrial / Automobile Engineering
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai / Nagpur / Punjab
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced engineering leader to head the Central Manufacturing Engineering (CME) Machining function for a leading automobile organisation.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong background in project engineering, capital project management and execution within machining-intensive manufacturing environments, preferably with an automotive OEM or Tier-1 auto-component manufacturer.
  
  
The incumbent will be responsible for driving end-to-end manufacturing engineering projects, including conceptualisation, feasibility, planning, equipment procurement, installation, commissioning and production stabilisation, while ensuring cost, quality, productivity and project delivery objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities Candidate Profile / Desired Experience Educational Qualification
  
  

* CME Machining Function Leadership
* Lead the Central Manufacturing Engineering function for machining operations.
* Develop manufacturing engineering strategies aligned with business and plant requirements.
* Drive standardisation of machining processes, technologies and engineering practices across manufacturing facilities.
* Provide technical direction and governance for machining-related projects and initiatives.
* Capital Projects & Project Execution
* Lead end-to-end capital projects involving new machining lines, machine installations, capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
* Manage project planning, budgeting, scheduling, resource allocation and execution.
* Drive projects from concept development and feasibility assessment through procurement, installation, commissioning and production stabilisation.
* Coordinate with machine suppliers, technology partners, consultants and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure adherence to project budgets, timelines, technical specifications and implementation milestones.
* Machining Technology & Process Engineering
* Drive development and implementation of machining processes for automotive and farm equipment components.
* Provide technical expertise in CNC machining, turning, milling, grinding, boring and related manufacturing processes.
* Evaluate and implement advanced machining technologies, automation, robotics and material-handling solutions.
* Drive cycle-time reduction, line balancing, tooling optimisation and productivity improvement.
* Ensure robust process design, machine capability and manufacturing feasibility.
* New Product Introduction & Capacity Development
* Collaborate with Product Development, R&D, Quality and Manufacturing teams for new product and process introduction.
* Ensure manufacturing readiness for new products, machining lines and capacity expansion programmes.
* Drive process validation, capability studies, production trials and successful handover to plant operations.
* Ensure alignment of manufacturing processes with product specifications, quality requirements and production volumes.
* Cost Optimisation & Operational Excellence
* Drive CAPEX optimisation and effective utilisation of project investments.
* Identify opportunities for automation, productivity improvement and manufacturing cost reduction.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor project cost, implementation timelines, machine utilisation, cycle time and productivity metrics.
* Quality, Safety & Engineering Standards
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards, process specifications and quality requirements.
* Drive equipment safety, statutory compliance and engineering best practices.
* Ensure machine validation, process capability and equipment reliability before production handover.
* Collaborate with Quality and Maintenance teams to ensure stable manufacturing operations.
* Team & Stakeholder Management
* Lead, mentor and develop the CME Machining team.
* Collaborate with Plant Operations, Production, Quality, Maintenance, R&D, Procurement and Supply Chain.
* Manage relationships with equipment suppliers, technology partners and external agencies.
* Drive technical excellence, accountability and timely project execution.
* Minimum 18 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering, Capital Projects, Project Engineering or related functions within the automotive / auto-component industry.
* Experience with an Automotive OEM or Tier-1 auto-component manufacturer preferred.
* Strong experience in planning, execution and commissioning of machining lines and manufacturing facilities.
* Proven track record of handling large-scale CAPEX projects, machine installations, capacity expansions and technology upgrades.
* Strong technical understanding of machining processes, CNC machines, tooling, automation and manufacturing systems.
* Experience managing equipment suppliers, project budgets, timelines and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams and execute multiple projects simultaneously.
* Exposure to tractor, engine, transmission, axle or other machining-intensive manufacturing operations will be an added advantage.
* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Industrial / Automobile Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline Mandatory.

**Preferred Candidate Background:**
Automotive OEMs, Tier-1 auto-component manufacturers, tractor manufacturing, engine and transmission manufacturing, and other machining-intensive engineering organisations.

title: Logistics & Customs Manager
description:
**Logistics & Customs Manager – Full-time – Mumbai – Onsite**
**About The Company**
Pharmanovia is a dynamic, fast-growing international pharmaceutical company with a portfolio of over 20 brands across more than 160 markets. Our mission is to improve patient health globally by revitalising niche, trusted medicines. Since our founding in 2013, we have grown consistently year on year, supported by a diverse global team of over 300 employees across 29 nationalities. We operate across Europe, the Middle East, Asia and beyond, focusing on our core therapeutic areas: Cardiovascular, Oncology, Endocrinology and Neurology. We are an agile, innovative speciality pharma organisation partnering with leading pharmaceutical companies to maximise the lifecycle value of established medicines.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Logistics & Customs Manager to join our Global Supply Chain team based in India, supporting Pharmanovia’s rapidly expanding international operations. This is a truly global position, responsible for managing the end-to-end logistics and customs operations across Pharmanovia’s international trade lanes between India and key markets throughout Europe, LATAM, APAC and the Middle East & Africa (MEA). You will oversee both exports of finished pharmaceutical products from India and imports of materials and goods into India, ensuring compliant, efficient and cost-effective movement of products throughout our global supply chain. Leading an international logistics team with colleagues based in both India and Europe, you will work closely with Regional Supply Chain teams, Quality, Finance, Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs), freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehouse providers and external logistics partners across multiple regions. This role is ideal for an experienced international logistics professional with a strong background in pharmaceutical supply chains, customs compliance and global trade, who enjoys working in a fast-paced, collaborative and highly regulated environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end international logistics strategy for all shipments between India and Pharmanovia’s markets across Europe, LATAM, APAC and MEA, ensuring safe, compliant and timely product movement.
* Own all customs and international trade compliance activities, ensuring imports and exports comply with Indian customs legislation as well as international customs regulations across multiple global markets.
* Manage international freight operations, including air, sea and road transportation, ensuring optimum service levels, cost efficiency and on-time delivery performance.
* Lead and develop an international logistics team, including direct reports based in Europe, providing leadership, coaching, performance management and continuous development.
* Develop strategic relationships with freight forwarders, customs brokers, 3PL providers and warehouse partners, ensuring high performance, contractual compliance and continuous service improvement.
* Ensure uninterrupted pharmaceutical supply by proactively managing logistics risks, customs delays and transportation challenges across global trade lanes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across logistics operations, identifying opportunities to optimise transportation costs, improve lead times and enhance customer service.
* Monitor and manage logistics KPIs, preparing regular performance reports and using operational data to improve supply chain performance.
* Ensure full compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and Pharmanovia Quality Management System requirements throughout the international distribution network.
* Lead customs clearance activities, working closely with customs brokers and authorities to minimise delays and ensure compliant import and export operations.
* Manage bonded warehouse and Free Trade Zone operations, ensuring regulatory compliance and operational efficiency where applicable.
* Ensure compliance with global anti-counterfeiting legislation, including the EU Falsified Medicines Directive (FMD), product serialisation and product traceability requirements.
* Own logistics SOPs, policies and operational procedures, ensuring documentation remains current, compliant and aligned with global standards.
* Lead investigations into logistics deviations, customs issues and distribution incidents, conducting root cause analysis and implementing effective CAPAs.
* Monitor changes in international trade legislation, customs regulations and pharmaceutical distribution requirements, proactively implementing business process improvements.
* Partner closely with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing and Commercial teams to ensure seamless supply chain execution across all regions.
* Support Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs) by coordinating international shipment planning, customs requirements and inventory movements.
* Manage logistics budgets, transportation spend and supplier performance to maximise operational efficiency while maintaining service excellence.
* Lead regular business reviews with logistics providers, monitoring contractual performance against agreed service levels and KPIs.
* Provide expert advice to internal stakeholders on customs regulations, import/export requirements and international trade compliance.
* Support business continuity planning, ensuring robust contingency plans are in place to minimise disruption across global supply chains.
* Represent Pharmanovia during audits, inspections and regulatory assessments relating to logistics, GDP and customs compliance.
* Travel internationally as required to support regional teams, logistics partners and business operations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, International Trade, Business or a related discipline.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Microsoft Office skills.
* Experience using ERP systems such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC or equivalent Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).

**Required Skills**

* Minimum 8 years’ experience within international logistics, supply chain or global trade.
* Strong experience managing international import and export operations.
* Experience working within pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience managing complex global trade lanes across multiple international markets.
* Proven experience leading international logistics teams, including remote management of overseas employees.
* Strong experience managing freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehouse providers and third-party logistics partners.
* Experience negotiating logistics contracts and supplier service agreements.
* Experience managing customs compliance within India and international markets.
* Experience implementing logistics process improvements and operational efficiencies.
* Experience managing international transportation budgets and logistics KPIs.
* Experience supporting Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs) and global manufacturing operations.

**Preferred Skills**

* Professional qualification in Customs Compliance, International Trade, Supply Chain or Logistics.
* APICS, CILT, CSCMP or equivalent professional certification.
* Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement certification.
* Experience leading international

**Pay Range And Compensation Package**
We offer a competitive salary plus a bonus and rewards package, including holidays, employee recognition awards, social events, a pension scheme, and hybrid working.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Pharmanovia is an equal-opportunity employer. Pharmanovia does not unlawfully discriminate against employees or applicants for employment based on an individual’s race, colour, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, marital status or any other status protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all terms, conditions, and privileges of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, compensation, promotion, discipline, and termination. Pharmanovia will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

title: Delivery Lead Manager - Voice
description:
**Skill required:**
Omnichannel - Customer Service
  
  
**Designation:**
Delivery Lead Manager
  
  
**Qualifications:**
Any Graduation
  
  
**Years of Experience:**
13 to 18 years
  
  
**About Accenture**
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  
  
**What would you do?**
This role is for a Customer Operations or Delivery Lead Manager accountable for the strategic and operational management of an assigned customer operations portfolio supporting business functions across regions. The role operates within a complex omni-channel environment that may include Voice, Email, Chat, Chatbot and Social Media support for external customers, internal customers, consumers and business partners. The role owns operational performance, people leadership, client and stakeholder relationships, financial discipline, risk governance, workforce readiness, change management and continuous transformation. It ensures services are stable, controlled, timely, accurate and aligned with customer expectations, contractual commitments, quality standards and Accenture delivery requirements. The Customer Operations Manager represents the delivery organisation in senior governance forums, maintains connectivity with supported businesses and enabling functions, and uses operational, customer and financial insights to improve customer experience, strengthen controls and create sustainable business value.
  
  
**What are we looking for?**

* Extensive experience leading large-scale Customer Operations or contact-center delivery in a complex BPMS, shared-services or global delivery environment.
* Strong command of end-to-end service management, including SLA, KPI, QA, workforce, productivity, customer experience, operational risk and financial levers.
* Proven ability to lead leaders, shape operating culture and build resilient, high-performing delivery organisations.
* Executive-level client engagement, stakeholder management, influencing, negotiation and governance capability.
* Fluent spoken and written English for senior client interaction, leadership communication, governance, escalation management, and reporting.
* Strong numeracy and analytical ability to translate operational and financial data into decisions, priorities and measurable improvement plans.
* Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement, automation, digital transformation, operational simplification and innovation.
* Commercial awareness across cost-to-serve, utilisation, productivity, contractual scope, revenue protection and margin improvement. Roles and Responsibilities:
* Own end-to-end service delivery for the assigned portfolio, including SLA, KPI, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, operational risk, financial and commercial outcomes.
* Provide senior leadership across service lines and delivery teams through Associate Managers, Senior Team Leaders and Team Leaders, setting direction, standards and governance expectations.
* Ensure safe, stable, controlled, resilient and scalable operations, with activities completed accurately, on time and in line with customer expectations and approved procedures.
* Govern omni-channel operations across Voice, Email, Chat, Chatbot, Social Media and other approved channels, ensuring consistent service and low-effort customer experiences.
* Act as the senior operational contact for the client and supported businesses, leading service reviews, governance forums, executive escalations and decision follow-through.
* Translate client business priorities, strategic objectives and contractual commitments into delivery strategies, operating plans, resource actions and measurable outcomes.
* Own workforce strategy, capacity planning, queue and demand governance, utilisation and organisational readiness in partnership with Workforce Management and support functions.
* Lead performance governance cycles, including trend analysis, operational deep dives, root-cause reviews, recovery planning and sustained corrective-action management.
* Own complex customer escalations, claims, service disruptions and client-critical issues, ensuring effective diagnosis, timely resolution, transparent communication and preventive action.
* Maintain strong knowledge of supported businesses, customer processes, internal procedures, systems, operational dependencies and relevant market or supply dynamics.

title: Senior Manager - Administration & Workplace Operations
description:
****Position Summary****
The Senior Manager – Administration & Workplace Operations will lead office administration, workplace services, technical facilities, leases and real estate support, and will also facilitate workplace EHS and ESG across India, with the concerned functional leader. Based in Mumbai, the role leads the India administration team and outsourced service partners to deliver workplaces that are safe, compliant, reliable, cost-effective and valued by employees.
  
  
The position partners closely with business leaders, Human Resources, Finance, Procurement, IT, Legal, Environment, Health & Safety, Security and the Global Real Estate team. As the function matures, the role may take on wider regional (APAC) workplace responsibilities.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Administration & Workplace Leadership**

* Lead, develop and set clear goals for the India administration team responsible for day-to-day office operations at all leased and co-working sites.
* Establish standard service levels, operating procedures and a single set of performance metrics across all India locations.
* Run a single admin helpdesk with defined response and closure times, and use employee feedback to improve services.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve operational efficiency and employee experience.

**Workplace Services: Security, Housekeeping & Front Office**

* Facilitate and collaborate with EHS and ESG lead to implement relevant initiatives across India offices.
* Manage security, housekeeping, pantry or cafeteria, pest control, front office, mailroom and courier services through outsourced partners.
* Select, contract and govern service agencies through clear SLAs, monthly scorecards and periodic performance reviews.
* Ensure security agencies hold valid PSARA licences and that guards, housekeeping staff and drivers are background verified.
* Oversee access control, CCTV, visitor management, emergency response and the safety of employees working late or night shifts.

**Travel, Accommodation & Visitor Management**

* Manage hotel bookings for group stays and events, using preferred hotels and negotiated corporate rates in each city.
* Plan end-to-end arrangements for global and senior visitors, including hotels, airport transfers, local transport, office access and duty-of-care measures.
* Maintain approved travel and transport vendors with vetted drivers and clear safety standards.

**Technical Facilities, Engineering & Maintenance**

* Oversee operation and maintenance of office building services, including electrical systems, HVAC, plumbing, fire and life-safety systems, lifts, UPS, DG sets, access control and other critical utilities.
* Maintain asset registers and govern preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance, annual maintenance contracts, equipment uptime and lifecycle replacement plans.
* Lead office fit-outs, refurbishments, relocations, expansions, reinstatement and minor civil works from scoping and budgeting through execution, commissioning, handover and close-out.
* Review layouts, drawings, bills of quantities, specifications and contractor proposals with internal experts, consultants, landlords and the Global Real Estate team.
* Ensure only competent and authorised vendors perform technical work, and monitor their quality, safety, timelines, costs, snag closure and warranties.

**Leases, Co-working & Global Real Estate Partnership**

* Maintain lease abstracts and a critical-dates calendar (lock-in, notice, escalation, renewal and expiry) for all leased and co-working sites.
* Lead lease renewals, renegotiations, exits and reinstatement with the Global Real Estate team, landlords, brokers and Legal.
* Manage co-working contracts and track seat utilisation so that seats match actual demand.
* Act as the primary India liaison to the Global Real Estate organisation on site selection, due diligence, occupancy reviews, projects and total occupancy cost.
* Ensure landlords and property managers deliver agreed services, repairs, approvals and lease obligations, and drive adoption of global workplace standards and design guidelines.

**Statutory Compliance, Building Governance & Risk**

* Ensure administration, facilities, fit-out, maintenance and vendor activities comply with central, state and municipal requirements, company policies, lease conditions and building rules.
* Maintain a location-wise compliance calendar and evidence repository for registrations, licences, permits, certificates, inspections, renewals and statutory tests.
* Coordinate compliance for occupancy, fire and life safety, electrical systems, lifts, DG sets, environmental requirements, waste disposal, accessibility and workplace safety, with relevant internal specialists.
* Ensure contractors meet labour, wage, social security, insurance and licensing requirements, with monthly verification of PF, ESI and wage payments before invoices are released.
* Support statutory inspections, audits, risk assessments, emergency drills and incident investigations, and close compliance gaps on time.
* Track changes in laws and codes (including the Labour Codes) with Legal, HR and EHS, and translate them into site-level controls.
* Escalate material safety, legal, regulatory, landlord or business continuity risks promptly, with documented mitigation and closure plans.

**Environment, Health & Safety and ESG**

* Implement the workplace EHS programme across offices, including fire wardens, first aiders, drills, inspections and incident and near-miss reporting.
* Collect and report site-level ESG data, including electricity, DG diesel, water and waste, in line with global reporting requirements.
* Drive energy efficiency, utility conservation, waste segregation and responsible e-waste disposal through authorised recyclers.

**Financial Management, Procurement & Expense Governance**

* Prepare and manage operating and capital budgets for administration and workplace functions, and support annual planning and forecasting.
* Enforce purchase order discipline for all admin purchases and services; raise indents, process expense claims and secure approvals within the delegation of authority.
* Run tenders and commercial evaluations with Procurement, and manage vendor contracts and service agreements.
* Identify and deliver cost optimisation, including vendor consolidation and right-sizing of co-working seats, without compromising compliance or service.

**Business Partnership & Growth**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to India leadership on workplace, operational and office-related matters.
* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, IT and business leaders to support organisational objectives, including growth, new sites and workplace changes.
* Build scalable operating models for workplace services, including evaluation of integrated facility management, and support business continuity planning.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Statutory compliance: 100% of applicable licences, certificates and inspections valid at every site.
* Contractor compliance: 100% of service vendors verified for PF, ESI and wages before invoice release.
* Cost: admin cost per seat within budget, with agreed annual savings delivered.
* Service: helpdesk requests closed within agreed SLA; employee satisfaction with admin services at or above target.
* Facilities: preventive maintenance completed on schedule; critical equipment uptime at or above target.
* Real estate: zero missed lease notice dates; co-working utilisation at or above target.
* Safety and ESG: Collaborate with EHS and ESG Head and facilitate safety drills ensuring completion as planned, zero serious incidents, and timely ESG data submission.

****Essential****
**Educational Qualifications & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical or Mechanical), Architecture, Facilities Management or a related discipline; or any bachelor’s degree with substantial hands-on experience in facilities, fit-outs, building services and statutory compliance.

****Preferred****

* Postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Operations, Real Estate, Facilities Management or Project Management.
* Certifications such as IFMA (FMP/CFM), PMP/PRINCE2, NEBOSH/IOSH, fire and life-safety training, energy management or green-building (IGBC/LEED).

****Essential****
**Experience & Skills**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in corporate administration, facilities management or workplace operations, including at least 5 years leading multi-site teams.
* Experience managing multi-site office operations across Indian cities in a multinational or similarly complex organisation.
* Strong vendor management: tendering, SLAs, contract negotiation and performance governance for security, housekeeping and technical services.
* Sound working knowledge of Indian statutory requirements for office premises, contractor and labour compliance, fire and life safety, and licences.
* Experience preparing and managing budgets and delivering cost optimisation.

****Preferred****

* Hands-on experience with office fit-outs, refurbishments or relocations, and landlord interfaces.
* Working knowledge of MEP, HVAC, fire and life-safety and critical utility systems, sufficient to review risks and challenge proposals.
* Lease negotiation and co-working portfolio management experience.
* Good understanding of workplace EHS programmes and ESG data reporting.
* Experience working with a global real estate or facilities team in a matrix organisation.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong service orientation, with employee experience as a measure of success.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and work effectively with HR, Finance, Procurement, IT, Legal, EHS, Security and Real Estate.
* Calm, decisive incident and crisis management.
* Integrity and high standards in vendor dealings and compliance.
* Data-driven approach to reporting, decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution.

title: Assistant Horticulture-Manager
description:
**Job Location**
As per project/site requirement.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To plan, develop, maintain, and improve landscape areas, gardens, lawns, nurseries, plantations, and green infrastructure within project sites, residential townships, campuses, or industrial facilities. The role involves ensuring healthy plant growth, aesthetic landscaping, efficient irrigation systems, and adherence to environmental sustainability standards.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**
**Landscape & Garden Maintenance**

* Plan, supervise, and maintain landscapes, gardens, lawns, avenue plantations, and green belts.
* Ensure proper upkeep of ornamental plants, shrubs, trees, seasonal flowers, and turf areas.
* Monitor plant health and implement corrective measures to maintain aesthetic standards.
* Prepare and execute annual and seasonal landscaping plans.

**Plantation & Horticulture Operations**

* Manage plantation activities including planting, pruning, transplanting, fertilization, and soil conditioning.
* Develop and maintain nurseries for ornamental and landscaping plants.
* Ensure optimum survival and growth rates of planted trees and shrubs.
* Recommend suitable plant species based on climate, soil conditions, and project requirements.

**Irrigation Management**

* Supervise irrigation systems including drip, sprinkler, and automated irrigation networks.
* Monitor water consumption and ensure efficient water management practices.
* Coordinate maintenance and repair of irrigation infrastructure.

**Pest & Disease Control**

* Identify plant diseases, pest infestations, and nutrient deficiencies.
* Implement preventive and corrective pest management measures.
* Ensure safe usage and storage of fertilizers, pesticides, and horticultural chemicals.
* Maintain records of treatment schedules and compliance requirements.

**Landscape Development Projects**

* Coordinate execution of new landscaping projects and garden development activities.
* Review landscape drawings, planting schedules, and material specifications.
* Monitor contractors and vendors engaged in landscaping and horticulture works.
* Ensure quality, cost control, and timely completion of horticulture-related projects.

**Environmental & Sustainability Initiatives**

* Support environmental sustainability programs including tree plantation drives and biodiversity initiatives.
* Promote composting, organic manure usage, and waste recycling practices.
* Maintain compliance with environmental regulations and company sustainability objectives.

**Vendor & Contractor Management**

* Manage horticulture contractors, gardeners, and maintenance staff.
* Evaluate vendor performance and ensure adherence to contractual obligations.
* Verify work completion and certify contractor bills.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain records of plant inventory, fertilizer consumption, pest control activities, and maintenance schedules.
* Prepare periodic reports on landscape condition, plantation status, and improvement plans.
* Track budget utilization and operational expenses.

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of horticulture practices and landscape management.
* Knowledge of irrigation systems and water conservation techniques.
* Familiarity with plant nutrition, soil science, and pest management.
* Understanding of landscape drawings and planting plans.
* Vendor and contractor management skills.
* Budgeting and cost control capabilities.
* Good communication and team management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office for reporting and documentation.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in maintaining large-scale landscapes, gardens, townships, campuses, industrial facilities, airports, hotels, hospitals, educational institutions, or infrastructure projects.
* Hands-on experience in nursery management, plantation activities, and landscape development projects.
* Experience in managing teams of gardeners and horticulture contractors.
* Exposure to environmental sustainability and green belt development initiatives.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Landscape and garden maintenance quality.
* Plant survival and growth rate.
* Irrigation system efficiency and water conservation.
* Reduction in pest and disease incidents.
* Compliance with maintenance schedules.
* Budget adherence and cost optimization.
* Contractor performance management.

Customer/stakeholder satisfaction with landscape aesthetics

title: DCEO , Data Centre Engineering Operations, Data Centre Engineering Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
AWS Infrastructure Operations is hiring a Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer to maintain and operate the critical infrastructure that keeps AWS's global cloud running 24/7.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
1/ Manage day-to-day engineering operations of data center critical infrastructure
  
  
2/ Plan and execute corrective and preventative maintenance
  
  
3/ Respond to facility incidents as a first responder
  
  
4/ Supervise specialist vendors and contractors
  
  
5/ Drive operational excellence across safety, security, availability, and cost
  
  
6/ Develop into a subject matter expert for your facility
  
  
**What You'll Need**
1/ Experience in critical facilities management
  
  
2/ Strong technical understanding of data center systems
  
  
3/ Results-driven mindset with a focus on continuous improvement
  
  
Why It Matters: You're not just maintaining a building — you're ensuring the reliability of infrastructure that millions of AWS customers depend on every day.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.
  
  

* Act as the site primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders involving communication and relationship management.
* Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
* Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA’s as required.
* Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analysis, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
* Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
* Work with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
* Establish documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
* Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
* Assist in recruiting efforts.
* Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues

A day in the life
  
  
**In Day Today Scale, You Will Be Involved In**

* Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility MEP management.
* Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
* Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
* Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
* Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience in vendor management
* Diploma in electrical/Mechanical engineering with Min 8 years experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of data center engineering experience
* Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filtering, battery monitoring systems, branch circuit monitoring systems or SCADA systems
* Knowledge of mission critical systems (data centers, hospitals, power plants, military facilities, etc.)
* Experience in operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
