title: Manufacturing Digital Initiatives
description:
**Job Title**
**Senior Manager - Manufacturing Digital Initiatives**
**Business Unit**
SUN Global Operations
  
  
**Job Grade**
G9A
  
  
**Location :**
Mumbai/Baroda
  
  
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “Create your own sunshine”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
**Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?**
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
We are seeking a seasoned professional to lead certain digital transformation initiatives across our pharmaceutical manufacturing plant. The incumbent will be responsible for identifying, designing, implementing, and scaling digital solutions that improve operational efficiency, compliance, traceability, and user productivity across manufacturing and plant support functions.
  
  
This role will play a key part in driving ownership and continuous improvement of core manufacturing digital systems at Sun Pharma — SAP (PP, MM /WM ,PM modules) along with digitizing paper-based and manual workflows such as eLogbook, Permit to Work, electronic checklists, line clearance, cleaning and equipment usage records, shift handovers, and related GMP workflows. The role requires close collaboration with Manufacturing, QA, Engineering, EHS, IT, CSV/Validation, and external technology partners to ensure solutions are compliant, practical, scalable, and well adopted by end users.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Digital Initiative Identification and Prioritization**

* Identify opportunities to digitize manual, paper-based, and spreadsheet-driven plant workflows.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize initiatives based on business value, compliance impact, feasibility, and scalability.
* Develop and maintain a roadmap for plant digital initiatives.

**Business Process Mapping and Solution Design**

* Understand current-state processes across manufacturing and plant support functions.
* Map process flows, pain points, control points, approval requirements, and compliance dependencies.
* Translate business requirements into digital workflow requirements, use cases, and functional specifications.
* Ensure workflow simplification and standardization prior to digitization wherever necessary.

**Project Delivery and Implementation**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of plant digital solutions from concept through rollout.
* Coordinate with IT, automation, validation, quality, operations, and vendors for design, build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Manage project scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, governance, and stakeholder communication.
* Support pilot deployment, phased rollout, and post-implementation stabilization.

**Compliance and Validation Support**

* Ensure all digital initiatives align with GMP, data integrity, and electronic records requirements.
* Work with QA and validation teams to support URS, risk assessments, test scripts, UAT, SOP updates, training records, change controls, and validation documentation.
* Ensure solutions are audit-ready and support sustainable compliance with applicable regulations and internal standards.

**Change Management and User Adoption**

* Drive user adoption through structured training, communication, and change management.
* Engage with end users on the shopfloor to ensure solutions are practical and fit for purpose.
* Monitor usage, adoption barriers, and user feedback, and drive corrective actions where required.
* Build a digital-first culture within plant operations through effective engagement and problem-solving.

Performance Monitoring and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Define and track KPIs for implemented digital solutions.
* Measure impact in terms of compliance, productivity, turnaround times, reduction in paperwork, reduction in manual errors, and user adoption.
* Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities post deployment.

**Scope of Work**

* Typical initiatives may include SAP related improvements along with eLogbook implementation, digital Permit to Work workflows, electronic checklists and approvals, digital line clearance records, shift handover digitization, equipment usage and cleaning workflow digitization, maintenance and utility workflow digitization, exception capture and escalation workflows, and other plant digital use cases supporting manufacturing effectiveness and compliance.

**Travel Estimate**
30-40% of time
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Educational Qualification**
Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Engineering, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  
  

* Strongly Preferred (But Not Mandatory)

**Postgraduate Qualification Such As**

* M.Tech / MS (Pharma, Chemical, Industrial, Manufacturing)
* MBA / PGDM (Operations, Supply Chain, or Systems)

**Experience**
**Must-Have:**

* Knowledge on SAP Production related modules - SAP PP/MM/ WM
* Relevant experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, manufacturing IT, digital transformation, plant systems, automation, or operations excellence.
* Experience in digitizing manufacturing or plant support workflows preferred.
* Experience working in cross-functional roles involving plant operations, quality, IT, and vendors
* Strong process mapping, business analysis, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good project management and implementation skills.
* Strong communication, training, and change management capability.
* Familiar with GXP regulations for Pharmaceutical Drug formulation plants.
* Ability to create best practices for batch execution and documentation.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with EBR/MES rollouts.
* Knowledge of OT/automation systems.
* Lean Six Sigma certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale process harmonization
* Experience with low-code/no-code applications, or plant digital tools.

Tenure : 10+ years of experience
  
  
**Your Success Matters to Us**
At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!

title: AVP - Accounts

* Drive continuous improvement and standardization across the function

* Experience managing audits and strengthening control frameworks

title: Technical Superintendent  (Tanker)
description:
As a
**Technical Superintendent**
at
**BSM,**
you will be responsible for providing end-to-end technical and operational oversight of assigned tanker vessels, ensuring safe, compliant, and cost-efficient ship management. * High level of organisation, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability

**Why You Should Join Us!**
We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:

* Annual performance bonus
* Exposure to international clients, vessels and a diverse workforce

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Landor is looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our Global Design Studio studio. Could this be you?

**We are Landor, part of WPP**

**World-leading brand experts,**

**underpinned by the most expansive strategic & creative capabilities in our category.**

**We make brands more valuable and less vulnerable.**

**We build brands differently. We work with our clients to define and solve their business problems through the lens of brand. We strategically join the dots between our design, experience, governance and measurement capabilities, and always connect our brand work to business outcomes.**

**Landor companies also include amp (sonic branding), bdg (workplace & architectural experts), Deep Local (creative technologists) and ManvsMachine (3D motion design).**

**About WPP:**

**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.**

**Role Overview:**

The Senior Project Manager is an offshore operational anchor based in Mumbai, driving delivery governance, project planning, and operational excellence for client-facing Client Services teams across the US.

Operating as a high-functioning project management lead across global brands and time zones, this individual moves beyond basic administration to own the initial development (Round 1 / R1) of Scopes of Work (SOWs), staff plans, project approaches, and delivery timelines. Partnering closely with US Senior Client Service Leaders, regional/global resourcing directors, and cross-functional creative teams, the Senior Project Manager acts as operational “ground control”, driving resource management, financial governance and delivery rhythm for both live client engagements and organic growth pitches.

**What you’ll do:**

**1. Project Scoping, Planning & Delivery Leadership**

• Lead Draft Ownership (R1): Author and build high-quality initial drafts (Round 1) of comprehensive Scopes of Work (SOWs), detailed staffing plans, project methodologies/approaches, and phase-by-phase delivery timelines, partnering with US Senior Client Service Leads to bring them to final approval.

• Delivery Governance: Establish and enforce critical path schedules, workback plans, and milestone checkpoints across complex, multi-track brand initiatives; proactively anticipate bottlenecks and mitigate scope creep.

• Process Templatization & AI Integration: Build, standardize, and scale project management templates, leveraging generative AI tools and modern workflows to accelerate scoping, reporting, and operational efficiency.

• Project Status & Communications: Maintain rigorous, real-time client status documentation and dashboards; drive clear operational alignment so cross-functional squads know current status, upcoming milestones, and clear next steps.

**2. Resource Management**

• Resourcing Partnership: Act as the operational “ground control” for squad allocations, working in direct partnership with Regional and Global Resourcing Directors and US Client Leads.

• Staff Plan Translation: Translate approved scopes and project timelines into precise resourcing allocations; monitor bandwidth and utilization proactively, identifying shortages or overages well in advance.

• Dynamic Capacity Management: Lead regular resource alignment reviews, managing cross-squad resource sharing and shifts as project needs evolve.

**3. New Business & Organic Growth (Farming) Support**

• Pitch Operations: Provide behind-the-scenes operational and project management infrastructure for new business opportunities and competitive pitch sprints (timelines, internal deliverable tracking, squad coordination).

• Organic Account Growth (Farming): Partner with client leads to structure project setups, initial proposals, and operational frameworks for organic extensions and follow-on phases across existing global client accounts.

**4. Commercial & Financial Governance**

• Financial Management: Drive commercial rigor across accounts by tracking ongoing project budgets, monitoring fee burn against milestones, and proactively forecasting revenue and billing milestones.

• Invoicing & Reconciliations: Partner directly with the US Finance team and Client Leads to execute monthly billing requests, review draft invoices, manage PO tracking, and follow up on timesheet compliance and WIP reconciliation.

**5. Quality Assurance & Knowledge Management**

• Brand & Quality Control: Ensure all external-and internal-facing materials, pitch proposals, decks, and status reports meet the highest standards of quality, precision, and the Landor brand.

• Asset & Knowledge Governance: Oversee the structured archiving of master deliverables, pitch collateral, credentials, case histories, and commercial benchmarks across internal asset libraries and shared drives.

**What you’ll need:**

• Relevant Experience of structured project management or project operations experience within a brand consultancy, creative agency, or professional services firm.

• Scoping & Planning Expertise: Demonstrated capability to author comprehensive Scopes of Work (SOWs), staff plans, project approaches, and commercial budgets from scratch (owning Round 1 deliverables).

• Resource Management: Hands-on experience managing agency resource allocation, staffing models, and capacity forecasting in partnership with regional/global resourcing leads.

• Pitch & Account Growth Acumen: Experience supporting new business pitches and organic account expansion (“farming”) behind the scenes.

• Global Brand Delivery: Proven success collaborating across distributed, cross-functional teams, global brands, and cross-cultural time zones.

• Tech & AI Fluency: High comfort with modern project management systems, workflow automation, and rapidly integrating generative AI tools to drive templatization and speed to output.

• Commercial Savvy: Strong understanding of project finance, billable utilization, rate cards, fee structures, and commercial risk mitigation.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to hold teams accountable, drive alignment, and communicate clearly under tight deadlines and ambiguous situations.

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week.**

**We build brands. We build futures. Landor, a WPP company, is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics, committed to a culture of respect where everyone belongs and can progress in their careers.**

title: Senior Manager - Administration & Workplace Operations
description:
**It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!**

Job Description:

**Position Summary**

  
  

The Senior Manager – Administration & Workplace Operations will lead office administration, workplace services, technical facilities, leases and real estate support, and will also facilitate workplace EHS and ESG across India, with the concerned functional leader. Based in Mumbai, the role leads the India administration team and outsourced service partners to deliver workplaces that are safe, compliant, reliable, cost-effective and valued by employees.

  

The position partners closely with business leaders, Human Resources, Finance, Procurement, IT, Legal, Environment, Health & Safety, Security and the Global Real Estate team. As the function matures, the role may take on wider regional (APAC) workplace responsibilities.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Administration & Workplace Leadership**

  

* Lead, develop and set clear goals for the India administration team responsible for day-to-day office operations at all leased and co-working sites.
* Establish standard service levels, operating procedures and a single set of performance metrics across all India locations.
* Run a single admin helpdesk with defined response and closure times, and use employee feedback to improve services.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve operational efficiency and employee experience.  

  

**Workplace Services: Security, Housekeeping & Front Office**

  

* Facilitate and collaborate with EHS and ESG lead to implement relevant initiatives across India offices.
* Manage security, housekeeping, pantry or cafeteria, pest control, front office, mailroom and courier services through outsourced partners.
* Select, contract and govern service agencies through clear SLAs, monthly scorecards and periodic performance reviews.
* Ensure security agencies hold valid PSARA licences and that guards, housekeeping staff and drivers are background verified.
Oversee access control, CCTV, visitor management, emergency response and the safety of employees working late or night shifts.  

  

**Travel, Accommodation & Visitor Management**

  

* Manage hotel bookings for group stays and events, using preferred hotels and negotiated corporate rates in each city.
* Plan end-to-end arrangements for global and senior visitors, including hotels, airport transfers, local transport, office access and duty-of-care measures.
Maintain approved travel and transport vendors with vetted drivers and clear safety standards.  

  

**Technical Facilities, Engineering & Maintenance**

  

* Oversee operation and maintenance of office building services, including electrical systems, HVAC, plumbing, fire and life-safety systems, lifts, UPS, DG sets, access control and other critical utilities.
* Maintain asset registers and govern preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance, annual maintenance contracts, equipment uptime and lifecycle replacement plans.
* Lead office fit-outs, refurbishments, relocations, expansions, reinstatement and minor civil works from scoping and budgeting through execution, commissioning, handover and close-out.
* Review layouts, drawings, bills of quantities, specifications and contractor proposals with internal experts, consultants, landlords and the Global Real Estate team.
Ensure only competent and authorised vendors perform technical work, and monitor their quality, safety, timelines, costs, snag closure and warranties.  

  

**Leases, Co-working & Global Real Estate Partnership**

  

* Maintain lease abstracts and a critical-dates calendar (lock-in, notice, escalation, renewal and expiry) for all leased and co-working sites.
* Lead lease renewals, renegotiations, exits and reinstatement with the Global Real Estate team, landlords, brokers and Legal.
* Manage co-working contracts and track seat utilisation so that seats match actual demand.
* Act as the primary India liaison to the Global Real Estate organisation on site selection, due diligence, occupancy reviews, projects and total occupancy cost.
Ensure landlords and property managers deliver agreed services, repairs, approvals and lease obligations, and drive adoption of global workplace standards and design guidelines.  

  

**Statutory Compliance, Building Governance & Risk**

  

* Ensure administration, facilities, fit-out, maintenance and vendor activities comply with central, state and municipal requirements, company policies, lease conditions and building rules.
* Maintain a location-wise compliance calendar and evidence repository for registrations, licences, permits, certificates, inspections, renewals and statutory tests.
* Coordinate compliance for occupancy, fire and life safety, electrical systems, lifts, DG sets, environmental requirements, waste disposal, accessibility and workplace safety, with relevant internal specialists.
* Ensure contractors meet labour, wage, social security, insurance and licensing requirements, with monthly verification of PF, ESI and wage payments before invoices are released.
* Support statutory inspections, audits, risk assessments, emergency drills and incident investigations, and close compliance gaps on time.
* Track changes in laws and codes (including the Labour Codes) with Legal, HR and EHS, and translate them into site-level controls.
Escalate material safety, legal, regulatory, landlord or business continuity risks promptly, with documented mitigation and closure plans.  

  

**Environment, Health & Safety and ESG**

  

* Implement the workplace EHS programme across offices, including fire wardens, first aiders, drills, inspections and incident and near-miss reporting.
* Collect and report site-level ESG data, including electricity, DG diesel, water and waste, in line with global reporting requirements.
Drive energy efficiency, utility conservation, waste segregation and responsible e-waste disposal through authorised recyclers.  

  

**Financial Management, Procurement & Expense Governance**

  

* Prepare and manage operating and capital budgets for administration and workplace functions, and support annual planning and forecasting.
* Enforce purchase order discipline for all admin purchases and services; raise indents, process expense claims and secure approvals within the delegation of authority.
* Run tenders and commercial evaluations with Procurement, and manage vendor contracts and service agreements.
Identify and deliver cost optimisation, including vendor consolidation and right-sizing of co-working seats, without compromising compliance or service.  

  

**Business Partnership & Growth**

  

* Serve as a trusted advisor to India leadership on workplace, operational and office-related matters.
* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, IT and business leaders to support organisational objectives, including growth, new sites and workplace changes.
Build scalable operating models for workplace services, including evaluation of integrated facility management, and support business continuity planning.  

  

**Key Performance Indicators**

  

* **Statutory compliance:** 100% of applicable licences, certificates and inspections valid at every site.
* **Contractor compliance:** 100% of service vendors verified for PF, ESI and wages before invoice release.
* **Cost:** admin cost per seat within budget, with agreed annual savings delivered.
* **Service:** helpdesk requests closed within agreed SLA; employee satisfaction with admin services at or above target.
* **Facilities:** preventive maintenance completed on schedule; critical equipment uptime at or above target.
* **Real estate:** zero missed lease notice dates; co-working utilisation at or above target.
* **Safety and ESG:** Collaborate with EHS and ESG Head and facilitate safety drills ensuring completion as planned, zero serious incidents, and timely ESG data submission.

  

**Educational Qualifications & Certifications**

  

**Essential**

  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical or Mechanical), Architecture, Facilities Management or a related discipline; or any bachelor’s degree with substantial hands-on experience in facilities, fit-outs, building services and statutory compliance.  

  

**Preferred**

  

* Postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Operations, Real Estate, Facilities Management or Project Management.
Certifications such as IFMA (FMP/CFM), PMP/PRINCE2, NEBOSH/IOSH, fire and life-safety training, energy management or green-building (IGBC/LEED).  

  

**Experience & Skills**

  

**Essential**

  

* 12+ years of progressive experience in corporate administration, facilities management or workplace operations, including at least 5 years leading multi-site teams.
* Experience managing multi-site office operations across Indian cities in a multinational or similarly complex organisation.
* Strong vendor management: tendering, SLAs, contract negotiation and performance governance for security, housekeeping and technical services.
* Sound working knowledge of Indian statutory requirements for office premises, contractor and labour compliance, fire and life safety, and licences.
Experience preparing and managing budgets and delivering cost optimisation.  

  

**Preferred**

  

* Hands-on experience with office fit-outs, refurbishments or relocations, and landlord interfaces.
* Working knowledge of MEP, HVAC, fire and life-safety and critical utility systems, sufficient to review risks and challenge proposals.
* Lease negotiation and co-working portfolio management experience.
* Good understanding of workplace EHS programmes and ESG data reporting.
Experience working with a global real estate or facilities team in a matrix organisation.  

  

**Behavioural Competencies**

  

* Strong service orientation, with employee experience as a measure of success.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and work effectively with HR, Finance, Procurement, IT, Legal, EHS, Security and Real Estate.
* Calm, decisive incident and crisis management.
* Integrity and high standards in vendor dealings and compliance.
* Data-driven approach to reporting, decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution.

description:
Job Title: Infrastructure Delivery Lead – IT Infrastructure Operations

**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 12+ Years  
**Relevant Leadership Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Role Level:** Delivery Lead  
**Domain:** IT Infrastructure Operations / Managed Services  
**Work Environment:** 24x7 Infrastructure Operations

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced **Infrastructure Delivery Lead** to manage end-to-end delivery of 24x7 L1.5 and L2 infrastructure operations across multiple technology towers.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in IT infrastructure service delivery, managed services (MSP), SLA management, major incident management, client governance, commercial operations, and team leadership.

This role will be responsible for managing infrastructure services across Hosting, Connectivity (Network and Telephony), Database Administration (DBA), Data Platforms, and the Infrastructure Command Center.

The candidate will act as the primary point of contact for client infrastructure leadership, ensuring operational excellence, service availability, contractual compliance, and continuous service improvement.

Key Responsibilities1. Infrastructure Service Delivery Management

* Own end-to-end delivery of L1.5 and L2 infrastructure operations across multiple towers.
* Lead Hosting, Networking, Telephony, DBA, Data Platform, and Infrastructure Command Center teams.
* Manage 24x7 infrastructure support operations and ensure service continuity.
* Act as the primary point of contact for client infrastructure leadership.
* Conduct daily operational meetings, weekly service reviews, and governance discussions.
* Drive service improvement initiatives and operational efficiency.

2. SLA Management and Governance

* Monitor and manage response and resolution SLAs across infrastructure services.
* Prepare weekly and monthly SLA, KPI, and operational performance reports.
* Conduct monthly and quarterly client governance reviews.
* Maintain RAID logs, service dashboards, and operational documentation.
* Ensure ServiceNow ticket quality, CMDB accuracy, and proper incident closure.
* Review infrastructure capacity, utilisation, and performance reports.

3. Incident and Escalation Management

* Lead and participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) for P1/P2 incidents.
* Manage critical client escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis (RCA), problem management, and corrective actions.
* Work with infrastructure teams, security operations, OEM vendors, telecom providers, and client L3 teams.
* Drive repeat-incident reduction and proactive monitoring improvements.

4. Infrastructure Operations and Availability

* Oversee infrastructure changes, patching, maintenance, and release activities.
* Track Windows, Linux, VMware, and database patch compliance.
* Ensure backup monitoring, restoration testing, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Coordinate server, database, and network provisioning and decommissioning.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, capacity, and performance.

5. Commercial and Contract Management

* Manage monthly invoicing inputs and reconciliation for infrastructure services.
* Ensure delivery aligns with Statement of Work (SOW) and contractual commitments.
* Handle scope changes, contractual reviews, service credits, and penalties.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and clients on commercial and delivery matters.

6. Team Leadership and Resource Management

* Lead and manage onshore and offshore infrastructure teams of 20+ engineers.
* Plan staffing, shift rosters, and 24x7 support coverage.
* Manage hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, and resource allocation.
* Develop skill matrices, cross-training plans, and team development initiatives.
* Ensure adequate coverage for critical infrastructure operations.

7. Compliance and Continuous Improvement

* Ensure compliance with infrastructure security standards and operational policies.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge management documentation.
* Identify opportunities for infrastructure automation and operational improvements.
* Support infrastructure service transitions and new service onboarding.

Mandatory Skills and Experience

* **12+ years** of experience in IT Infrastructure Operations.
* **5+ years** of experience as an Infrastructure Delivery Lead or Service Delivery Manager in a managed services environment.
* Proven experience managing 24x7 multi-tower infrastructure operations for global enterprise clients.
* Experience leading onshore and offshore teams of 20+ engineers.
* Strong expertise in SLA management, service delivery governance, and client stakeholder management.
* Hands-on operational knowledge of AWS, Azure, Windows Server, Linux/Unix, networking, and databases.
* Experience with Major Incident Management (MIM), P1/P2 escalations, RCA, and problem management.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes, including incident, problem, change, and request management.
* Experience with ServiceNow ITSM, CMDB, reporting, and dashboards.
* Knowledge of infrastructure monitoring tools such as Datadog and PagerDuty.
* Experience managing MSP contracts, invoicing, SOW deliverables, and contractual reviews.
* Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Technical Skills

**Cloud Platforms**

* AWS (EC2, S3, ELB, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, IAM)
* Microsoft Azure

**Infrastructure and Networking**

* Windows Server
* Linux / Unix
* VMware
* Cisco Routers, Switches, and WLAN Controllers
* Firewalls and Load Balancers
* Cisco Call Manager / PBX

**Databases and Data Platforms**

* Oracle Database
* Microsoft SQL Server
* Cloud Databases
* Snowflake, Airflow, Talend
* Tableau and Power BI

**Monitoring and ITSM Tools**

* ServiceNow
* Datadog
* PagerDuty

Good to Have

* Experience transitioning infrastructure services from an incumbent provider.
* Knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Automation and scripting experience with PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Tableau, and Power BI.
* Exposure to infrastructure automation, cloud migration, and service transformation.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL 4 Foundation
* AWS Solutions Architect – Associate
* Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
* CCNA / CCNP
* Oracle OCP

Required Candidate Profile

We are looking for a delivery-focused infrastructure leader who can independently manage large-scale, multi-tower infrastructure operations while maintaining strong client relationships, operational stability, and service quality.

Candidates should have proven experience in managed services delivery, global stakeholder management, infrastructure governance, and leading cross-functional technical teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV through the following channels:

**Email:** hire@kasmoprav.com

**Apply Online:** https://jswitcher.com

**Subject Line:** Application for Infrastructure Delivery Lead

Please mention your total experience, relevant delivery leadership experience, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period when applying.

**Relevant candidate referrals are also welcome.**

title: Senior Manager - Operations Management (GSP - Vendor Risk Management)
description:
Marsh is seeking a Vendor Risk Management expert for the following position based in the Pune, India office.
  
  
**Designation : Senior Manager - Operations Management (GS - Vendor Ops Third Party Vendor Risk Management )**
**Location Pune, India**
**We will count on you to:**
Work with Senior Business/OPS leaders Quality and Governance experts
  
  
An energizing culture to work in and exposure to tools and best practices.
  
  
Working with an energetic curious team of multi-disciplinary professionals
  
  
Opportunity to contribute to Operational outcomes and make an impact.
  
  

* Strategic Leadership: Develop and refine the third-party risk management strategy aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Risk Assessment & Due Diligence: Manage comprehensive risk assessments for high-risk vendors, including financial stability, cybersecurity, operational resilience, privacy/AI, compliance, and reputational risks.
* Policy & Framework Development: Establish, implement, and continuously improve policies, procedures, and standards for third-party risk management.
* Vendor Lifecycle Management: Oversee the entire vendor lifecycle, from onboarding and due diligence to ongoing monitoring and offboarding.
* Risk Monitoring & Reporting: Design and oversee the implementation of key risk indicators (KRIs), dashboards, and reporting mechanisms for senior management and risk committees.
* Regulatory & Industry Compliance: Ensure all third-party activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, SOC, etc.).
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with legal, procurement, compliance, IT, and other risk management functions to evaluate vendor risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Third-Party Risk Program Oversight: Lead the third-party risk management team, providing mentorship, guidance, and performance management.
* Issue & Incident Management: Oversee the investigation and resolution of third-party risk incidents, including breach or compliance issues.
* Audit & Review: Coordinate internal and external audits related to third-party risk, ensuring timely remediation of identified issues.
* Training & Awareness: Promote a risk-aware culture through training programs, workshops, and communication initiatives.
* External Relationships: Manage relationships with external vendors, risk assessment providers, and industry forums.

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8-10 years of experience. Masters preferred
* > 5 years of experience in third-party/vendor risk management, compliance, or related fields
* Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks, industry standards, and best practices related to third-party risk.
* Proven experience managing complex vendor portfolios, including high-risk or strategic vendors.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, data privacy, operational resilience, and contractual risk mitigation.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and implement risk management frameworks and policies.
* Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Professional certifications such as Certified Third Party Risk Professional (CTPRP), Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or equivalent are highly desirable.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Experience in highly regulated industries such as financial services, Insurance, or technology.
* Familiarity with third-party risk management tools and platforms.
* Understanding of Procurement functions such as Sourcing, Contracting, Vendor Operations and Buyer functions.
* Ability to influence organizational culture and promote risk awareness.
* Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex risk issues to executive leadership.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Assistant Production Manager
description:
BHS Corrugated India Pvt. Ltd., based in Pune, was established in 2011 as a subsidiary of BHS Corrugated, Germany. Since its inception, the company has grown multifold and has steadily expanded its presence across multiple business verticals, including Sales, Service, NEW Corrugating Rolls (CR), factory and the Global Capability Centre (GCC). As part of the world-leading BHS Corrugated group, BHS India combines a professional corporate culture with decades of global expertise to support the evolving needs of the corrugated cardboard industry.

The organization is actively shaping the digital future of the corrugated cardboard sector by connecting manufacturers, customers, and service providers through an integrated industrial ecosystem. Through highly efficient and simplified processes, advanced technology, and strong customer orientation, BHS Corrugated India contributes to making the corrugated cardboard industry one of the most innovative and productive industry segments worldwide.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager - Production - to lead the manufacturing operations of Corrugating Rolls, ensuring achievement of Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Productivity (SQDCP) targets. The role involves managing end-to-end production processes including machining, welding, grinding, coating, finishing, and quality control while driving operational excellence, process improvements, and team development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage daily production operations to achieve Safety, Quality, Delivery, Productivity, Cost, EBITDA, and profitability objectives.
* Oversee the complete manufacturing process including stripping, turning, CNC machining, welding, grinding, sandblasting, tungsten carbide coating, polishing, and final inspection.
* Ensure production planning, resource optimization, machine utilization, and on-time delivery commitments.
* Lead production teams through effective training, coaching, performance management, and cross-skilling initiatives.
* Drive TPM, Autonomous Maintenance, Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement programs.
* Monitor critical process parameters, especially in grinding and coating operations, ensuring consistent product quality and process capability.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective actions, and problem-solving activities to eliminate recurring issues.
* Ensure compliance with ISO standards, quality systems, EHS policies, and statutory requirements.
* Oversee equipment maintenance, calibration, and machine uptime in collaboration with maintenance teams.
* Utilize ERP systems, digital production data, and KPI dashboards to support data-driven decision-making.
* Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Planning, Procurement, Suppliers, and Global Teams to ensure smooth operations and implementation of best practices.
* Analyze manufacturing KPIs and drive initiatives for productivity improvement, cost reduction, and operational excellence.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering.
* 9-10 years of experience in production/manufacturing management, preferably in precision machining, grinding, coating, or heavy engineering industries.
* Strong expertise in CNC machining, welding, grinding, tungsten carbide coatings, and production process optimization.
* Experience in ISO-compliant manufacturing environments, TPM, Lean Manufacturing, and ERP systems.
* Exposure to global manufacturing practices will be an added advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Knowledge of production planning, quality management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in CAD/CAM and manufacturing systems preferred.

**We Offer You**

* An opportunity to work with a growing global organization in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
* A modern workplace with an employee-centric culture focused on innovation and continuous learning.
* Career growth opportunities, professional development, and ownership from day one.
* Flexibility, openness, teamwork, and the opportunity to make a real business impact

title: TechOps1-DE-CloudOpsAMS-SAP AMS SDM-Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP Team Manager - TechOps - Application Management - Consultant**
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an SAP Team Manager to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* 8-10 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP functional areas preferably with Global client
* Deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes and methodology and how it interacts with the application lifecycle management principles
* Ability to manage cross functional and technical team, give them directions and drive functional and technical discussions with various stake holders
* Proven track record of successfully driving solutions in a complex, multi-platform environment
* Extensive in client management working with various regions in a global setting
* Depth of experience in setting up, growing, transforming, and delivering application management teams
* Strong leadership and team building skills with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization
* Strong client management, analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to think strategically and make data driven decisions
* Responsible for providing support within the SAP domain expert module for incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
* Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
* Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
* Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onshore model.
* Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* Experience with both S/4HANA and ECC
* Strong knowledge of SAP integration points with other SAP cross modules like FICO, MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.
* SAP Certification in any functional domain
* Experience in good Team management skills, People skills, communication, soft skills etc
* Expertise in working with Onshore teams with good co-ordination and collaboration

**What you will do:**

* Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
* Lead and mentor the cross functional team fostering culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement
* Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP solutions and designs.
* Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
* Mentor and train junior SAP functional and technical Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of hundreds of professionals.
* Opportunities to work with EY SAP application maintenance, practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

**What working at EY offers:**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manger/Sr Manager Project (Pune,Mumbai,Bangalore)
description:
The Project Manager will support the planning, coordination, execution, and handover of school, campus, infrastructure, fit-out, refurbishment, and related projects across India, ensuring alignment with approved scope, budgets, timelines, quality standards, safety requirements, compliance obligations, and operational needs.

**Roles and responsibilities**

**Leadership:**

* Coordinate project teams, site teams, consultants, contractors, and vendors to support effective delivery of assigned projects across India.
* Work with senior leadership to translate business priorities, budgets, timelines, approval requirements, and organizational objectives into clear project execution plans, milestones, deliverables, accountability structures, and governance practices.
* Promote consistent project management practices, reporting discipline, documentation standards, timely information sharing, and cross-functional coordination to minimize disruption during execution.

**Financial management:**

* Support preparation, review, and monitoring of project budgets, cost estimates, BOQs, cash flow projections, funding requirements, and budget variance reports in coordination with Finance and senior management.
* Review contractor/vendor quotations, comparative statements, work orders, invoices, running bills, variation claims, final bills, change requests, additional works, and scope variations before recommending approval.
* Ensure all cost changes are justified, documented, approved, assessed for budget impact, and coordinated with Finance, Procurement, and internal stakeholders for timely payment processing while protecting commercial interests.

**Functional responsibilities**

**Operations:**

* Support site evaluation, feasibility review, due diligence, and early-stage inputs for new schools, expansions, fit-outs, refurbishments, and infrastructure upgrades in India.
* Review site conditions, access, utilities, statutory constraints, operational needs, construction risks, design drawings, specifications, material selections, authority submissions, and execution methodologies.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, vendors, campus teams, and internal stakeholders to define requirements and ensure execution aligns with approved scope, drawings, specifications, timelines, budgets, quality standards, safety requirements, compliance obligations, and school operational needs.
* Track statutory approvals, permits, fire and life safety requirements, building compliance, environmental requirements, and local authority coordination for each project.

**Project planning:**

* Develop project execution plans covering scope, deliverables, timelines, resources, procurement requirements, approvals, dependencies, risks, reporting cadence, schedules, milestone trackers, resource plans, approval trackers, risk registers, issue logs, and action trackers.
* Identify design, approval, procurement, funding, site, vendor, safety, and operational risks early, develop mitigation plans with clear ownership and timelines, and align planning with academic calendars, school operations, admissions timelines, and business commitments.

**Integration management:**

* Identify and coordinate key stakeholders, including leadership, campus operations, academics, finance, procurement, legal, consultants, contractors, vendors, and statutory authorities.

* Facilitate project review meetings, document key decisions, track action items, and escalate critical issues through the appropriate reporting line.

**Schedule management:**

* Prepare and monitor realistic project schedules aligned with academic calendars, admissions targets, statutory approvals, procurement lead times, and school operational requirements.
* Track progress against approved timelines, identify delays, dependencies, and bottlenecks, coordinate timely completion of design, approvals, procurement, execution, testing, commissioning, and handover, and escalate critical delays with recovery plans.

**Procurement management:**

* Support vendor identification, prequalification, tendering, technical evaluation, commercial comparison, negotiation, recommendation, and review of contractor/vendor capability, market presence, delivery timelines, after-sales support, compliance, safety practices, and past performance.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and user departments for timely work orders, purchase orders, contracts, approvals, material/equipment/service deliveries, and procurement lead-time monitoring.
* Ensure procurement decisions balance cost, quality, compliance, durability, maintainability, and operational suitability for Indian campus conditions.

**Risk management:**

* Identify, monitor, and mitigate risks related to approvals, statutory compliance, cost, schedule, procurement, site conditions, safety, quality, contractor performance, and operational readiness.
* Maintain risk registers, issue logs, change trackers, escalation records, follow-up actions, and lessons learned, and apply preventive controls to avoid repeated issues in design, procurement, execution, documentation, and handover.
* Regularly review site safety, compliance, quality, and risk controls during project execution.

**Execution and handover:**

* Monitor site execution through site visits, coordination meetings, progress reports, quality checks, safety observations, and contractor/vendor performance reviews.
* Ensure works are completed as per approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, timelines, and contractual commitments.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, inspections, snagging, rectification, statutory readiness, operational preparedness, and engagement with Operations, Facilities, IT, Procurement, Finance, School Leadership, and other relevant teams for smooth transition to operations.
* Complete structured handover of as-built drawings, warranties, manuals, specifications, test certificates, compliance documents, asset information, vendor contacts, snag lists, maintenance requirements, and project closure reports covering cost, timelines, approvals, variations, pending actions, lessons learned, and future improvement recommendations.

**Key performance indicators**

* Schedules are regularly prepared, monitored, updated, tracked against approved timelines, and supported by recovery plans where delays occur.
* Costs are monitored against approved budgets, with timely reporting of variances, commitments, savings, overruns, corrective actions, bills, variations, and approvals.
* Statutory approvals, permits, authority submissions, fire and life safety requirements, and compliance documentation are tracked and completed within required timelines.
* Execution meets approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and operational expectations of the school or campus.
* Vendor, contractor, consultant, procurement, risk, issue, approval, action, and stakeholder trackers are maintained accurately and submitted on time for management review.
* Risks related to cost, schedule, approvals, safety, quality, procurement, vendors, and operations are identified early and mitigated through clear action plans.
* Testing, commissioning, snag closure, operational readiness, handover documentation, and project closure reports are completed before closure.

**Job requirements**

**Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Project Management, Construction Management, or Contract Management is an added advantage.

**Experience:**

* good years of experience in project management, infrastructure development, construction management, or campus development, preferably within India.
* Hands-on experience supporting or delivering school, institutional, commercial, fit-out, refurbishment, or campus infrastructure projects from planning through execution and handover.
* Working knowledge of Indian construction practices, statutory approvals, municipal authority requirements, building codes, fire and life safety norms, environmental requirements, and regulatory processes.
* Experience coordinating with architects, consultants, contractors, vendors, government authorities, school leadership, operations teams, and internal management stakeholders.
* Ability to support project budgets, cost estimates, BOQs, tendering, vendor comparisons, contracts, change requests, billing reviews, cost control, procurement, and local material/contractor coordination.
* Practical experience in planning, scheduling, site execution monitoring, quality coordination, risk tracking, safety compliance, issue resolution, and adherence to approved scope, specifications, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Ability to prepare project reports, dashboards, progress updates, risk registers, approval trackers, action trackers, and handover documentation for management review.
* Good communication, coordination, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently under guidance and collaborate effectively across teams.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
Pico fuels the global capital markets community by providing exceptional market data services and customized managed infrastructure solutions. As financial industry experts at the center of markets and technology, we help our clients efficiently scale their business and quickly access markets. From infrastructure to connectivity, we support our clients through the full trading lifecycle. Pico is looking to expand our Global Service Delivery organization to support our growth in clients and market share. The department sits alongside Sales and Sales Engineering and is focused on successful management and delivery of client projects working collaborative internally and externally. The role of the Service Delivery Manager is accountable for leading delivery across a global book of work (BOW), delivering complex client projects successfully and with the highest level of service, and converting delivery to revenue swiftly. This role is expected to contribute to the Service Delivery strategy, including how delivery supports the company growth strategy through forward‑thinking leadership, scalable operating models, and continuous improvement. Project and programme leadership is a core responsibility, working closely with external and internal stakeholders to assess and document requirements, construct project plans, coordinate delivery, and communicate status across multiple initiatives.

* Own and evolve the Service Delivery strategy, ensuring delivery execution supports the company growth strategy, scalable operations, and improved client outcomes
* Lead delivery transformation initiatives, including automation and tooling (e.g., portals and automated workflows) to improve efficiency, transparency, and scale
* Drive process maturity improvements by defining and embedding standards, governance, and repeatable workflows to increase delivery predictability
* Own key delivery and financial outcomes across the global BOW, including forecast accuracy, delivery predictability, and time to revenue, partnering with Sales, Product, and Finance to support revenue realization and margin protection

+ Create, maintain and share project plans

description:
**Job Title:**

Lead, Internal Audit - IT Operations & Cybersecurity

**Job Description:**

**Job Summary**

The Lead, IT Operations & Cybersecurity Audit is a strategic leader within the Internal Audit function responsible for advancing the organization's technology risk assurance capabilities. This role provides subject matter expertise and leadership across IT operations, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, infrastructure, identity and access management, SAP technology risks, and digital transformation initiatives.

As a senior member of the Internal Audit team, this individual will lead complex technology-focused audits, influence enterprise risk management strategies, and partner with senior leaders across Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Finance, and Operations. The role will help establish and mature a scalable technology assurance program capable of addressing Entegris' evolving digital risk landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Risk Assurance Leadership**

  

* Lead the development and execution of the Internal Audit technology assurance strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and emerging risk areas.
* Serve as the primary Internal Audit subject matter expert for technology operations, cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud environments, identity and access management, and technology governance.
* Provide strategic recommendations to Internal Audit leadership regarding technology risk trends, emerging threats, and assurance priorities.
* Support the continuous enhancement of audit methodologies to address evolving technology and cybersecurity risks.

**IT and Cybersecurity Audits**

  

* Lead complex audits and advisory engagements covering IT general controls (ITGCs), cybersecurity, cloud platforms, infrastructure environments, network security, privileged access management, and technology operations.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and control frameworks supporting enterprise technology functions.
* Assess cybersecurity programs, incident response capabilities, vulnerability management processes, and third-party technology risks.
* Perform technology-focused investigations and special reviews as needed.

**SAP and Digital Transformation Risk Management**

  

* Lead risk assessments and assurance activities related to SAP S/4HANA, enterprise applications, automation initiatives, and digital transformation programs.
* Evaluate technology risks associated with system implementations, migrations, upgrades, and cloud adoption initiatives.
* Assess automated controls and technology-enabled business processes for operational effectiveness and risk mitigation.
* Provide assurance over business-critical technology platforms and supporting control environments.

**SOX and Compliance Support**

  

* Partner with management and external auditors to support SOX compliance activities related to IT general controls and automated controls.
* Evaluate control design and operating effectiveness across key technology processes supporting financial reporting.
* Contribute technology expertise to enterprise compliance and regulatory initiatives.
* Assist in identifying opportunities to improve control efficiency while maintaining regulatory compliance.

**Continuous Assurance and Analytics**

  

* Lead development of technology risk dashboards, monitoring tools, and continuous assurance capabilities.
* Partner with Internal Audit analytics resources to identify opportunities for automation and continuous monitoring.

* Leverage data-driven insights to improve audit coverage, enhance risk detection, and increase assurance effectiveness.
* Promote innovative approaches to technology risk management and audit execution.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration**

  

* Build strong partnerships with leaders across Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and other business functions.
* Coordinate technology assurance activities with external auditors and third-party assessors.
* Influence stakeholders to strengthen risk management practices and address control gaps.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on technology and cybersecurity risk matters.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Internal Audit, IT Audit, Cybersecurity, Technology Risk Management, Information Security, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technology audit engagements across multiple risk domains.
* Strong knowledge of IT general controls, cybersecurity frameworks, cloud technologies, infrastructure operations, identity and access management, and technology governance.
* Experience assessing enterprise applications, ERP systems, and automated controls.
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments and related technology controls.
* Experience assessing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT, CIS Controls, and other recognized cybersecurity and governance frameworks.
* Experience supporting public company SOX compliance programs.
* Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, CIA, CPA, or equivalent.
* Experience operating in a global, geographically dispersed organization.

**Leadership Expectations**

  

* Serves as a recognized expert in technology risk, cybersecurity, and technology assurance.
* Leads enterprise-wide initiatives and influences strategy beyond immediate functional responsibilities.
* Exercises significant independent judgment in addressing highly complex business and technology challenges.
* Builds credibility with senior leaders and acts as a trusted advisor on technology risk matters.
* Drives innovation, capability development, and continuous improvement across the Internal Audit function.
* Mentors and develops less experienced team members while elevating overall technical expertise within the organization.

**Success Measures**

**This role will be successful by:**

  

* Strengthening Internal Audit's technology and cybersecurity assurance capabilities.

* Improving technology risk visibility through continuous assurance and monitoring capabilities.

Pune offers access to a highly skilled talent market with deep expertise in technology risk, cybersecurity, SAP, cloud technologies, and technology consulting. The location enables efficient global support across Asia, Europe, and North America while helping establish a scalable center of excellence for technology assurance and cybersecurity risk oversight.

title: Business Operations Manager
description:
**About ShyftLabs**
-------------------

ShyftLabs builds AI that fits the way businesses actually work. Since 2020, we've helped enterprises turn the data and knowledge they already have into practical AI and Data solutions that drive real results.

Today, our 250+ data and AI experts serve 50+ global clients across retail, banking, healthcare, and more, delivering over $2B in business impact. With offices in Toronto, New York, Dubai, Noida, and Hyderabad, we're growing fast and looking for people who want to grow with us.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for a hands-on **Business Operations Manager** to make sure our India operations run smoothly. This is an in-office role, based in Noida, that owns the day-to-day running of our India business: office operations, compliance, vendors, and internal systems.

You will be the main link between the India office and our global teams, making sure the business in India runs well, stays compliant, and that our people are equipped with everything they need to do their best work. The role is based in our Noida office 5 days a week, with travel to our Hyderabad location once a month.

  

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for global teams and leadership on all matters relating to India business / office operations.

* Take overall ownership of business office operations, ensuring all business functions run smoothly and in line with company goals.
* Ensure office facilities and essential services (internet, power backup, security, housekeeping, etc.) are reliable and well maintained, with issues resolved promptly.
* Oversee vendor relationships and service contracts, holding vendors accountable to agreed service levels and costs.
* Define, document, and enforce operational processes, and ensure teams follow them consistently.
* Own the operations budget for the India offices, approving spend and monitoring costs against plan and budget.
* Manage urgent, sensitive, or unclear matters with discretion and sound judgement, ensuring clear communication, timely follow-up, and appropriate escalation.

* Partner with leadership to align priorities, drive accountability on action items, and implement operational initiatives that support the company's growth.
* Support stakeholders onboarding and operational coordination where the India team is involved, ensuring a consistent and professional experience.
* Deliver regular reporting and updates to leadership on the performance, risks, and priorities of India operations.
* Strengthen processes and documentation to reduce single-point dependencies and ensure operations remain consistent, scalable, and resilient.
* Provide leadership with clear and consistent visibility into global operations, including ongoing activities, operational challenges, risks, and escalations, ensuring timely communication and resolution of issues across regions.
* Take full ownership of assigned operational initiatives, challenges, and processes, driving them from identification through execution and resolution.
* Proactive Problem-Solving: Anticipate operational challenges, identify potential risks and bottlenecks, and proactively implement solutions before they impact business performance.

### **What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, management, commerce, or a related field; an MBA or Master's in Management is preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in business operations, office administration, or a related role, ideally within a professional services, IT, or consulting organization.
* 2+ years of experience in a managerial role, overseeing teams, vendors, or operational functions.
* Proven experience establishing or scaling business operations in a high-growth environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian statutory compliance and office administration, including labour law, PF/ESI, GST, and related processes.
* Proficiency with standard business tools, including Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, Slack, and spreadsheets.
* Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining composure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience collaborating with global teams across time zones.
* Sound judgement, discretion, and diplomacy in handling confidential and sensitive matters.
* Ability to work from our Noida office 5 days a week and travel to our Hyderabad office once a month.

We are proud to offer a competitive salary alongside a strong healthcare insurance and benefits package. The role is in-office, 5 days a week. We pride ourselves on the growth of our employees and offer extensive learning and development resources.

**Inclusion at ShyftLabs**
--------------------------

We're building something big, and we want you on the journey with us. ShyftLabs is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. If you're ready to help a growing team run at its best, apply today and let's grow together.

description:
**The Role**

The Lead Operations & Payroll Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for global People Operations and payroll services. The role is accountable for governance, service performance, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement across retained People teams, managed service providers, payroll vendors and other external partners.

The role translates People Function strategy into a controlled and measurable operating model. It ensures that employee lifecycle and payroll services are delivered accurately, on time and in accordance with global policy, local legislation, contractual commitments and internal controls. The role leads through data, clear accountabilities and disciplined governance, while maintaining a strong focus on employee and stakeholder experience.

The role also leads major transformation, vendor consolidation, automation and operating-model initiatives, including business-case development, transition planning, benefits tracking and leadership reporting. It acts as a senior escalation point for complex operational, payroll, statutory, supplier and service-delivery matters and provides advice to the PB10 Director and other senior stakeholders.

The People Function delivers HR and payroll services across multiple regions, countries, legal entities and service channels. Delivery is shared between internal People teams, retained service desks, managed service providers, payroll partners, Finance, Procurement, Technology and country stakeholders. This creates a complex control environment requiring clear ownership, standard processes, reliable data and active supplier governance.

The Lead Operations & Payroll Manager operates across both business-as-usual service delivery and transformation. The role oversees global operations such as AskHR governance, retained-desk activity, managed-service performance, payroll controls, vendor and invoice governance, management reporting and operational improvement. It works closely with regional Lead Operations & Payroll Managers, Payroll and People Data Managers, People Solutions colleagues and cross-functional partners.

The role reports to the Director - Head of HR Operations and Payroll (PB10). It may directly or matrix-manage managers, specialists and project resources and will be expected to represent the function in leadership forums, service reviews, audits, supplier meetings and transformation governance.

**Main responsibilities**

The role translates People Operations and Payroll strategy into effective global operating models, governance frameworks, delivery priorities and clear accountabilities. It provides senior oversight of AskHR, retained HR service desks, outsourced operations and end-to-end payroll delivery, ensuring service quality, SLA performance, statutory compliance, payroll accuracy, financial controls, risk management and timely resolution of operational issues. It also leads supplier, commercial and financial governance, including contract management, vendor performance, purchase orders, invoice validation, budgets, cost optimisation and supplier payments.

The role drives global transformation, vendor consolidation, service transitions, automation, digitalisation and continuous improvement initiatives. This includes developing business cases, cost-benefit models, implementation plans, risk assessments, KPIs, milestones and benefits realisation. It owns operational performance reporting, dashboards, executive insights, audit and assurance activities, using data and root-cause analysis to identify risks, capacity pressures, control weaknesses and improvement opportunities. It also ensures robust documentation, business continuity, data protection and regulatory compliance across regions.

Working closely with regional and country leadership, Finance, Procurement, Technology, Legal, Risk and external service providers, the role provides strategic advice to the PB10 Director, leads governance and transformation forums, manages complex escalations and aligns stakeholders on operational priorities. It also leads, coaches and develops managers and specialists, strengthens succession planning and operational resilience, builds expertise in payroll, analytics, supplier management and controls, and promotes a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, customer focus and continuous improvement.

**Role specific skills**

* Business acumen (exemplary): connects service, risk, cost and employee experience outcomes to organizational strategy.
* Data literacy (exemplary): uses operational, financial and service data to shape priorities, challenge performance and support investment decisions.
* People advocacy (developing/exemplary): balances customer needs, fairness, compliance, ethics and organisational risk.
* Executional excellence (exemplary): converts direction into measurable plans, sustained governance and accountable delivery.
* Problem solving (exemplary): resolves complex, cross-functional issues with incomplete information and competing stakeholder interests.
* Interpersonal and influencing skills (exemplary): builds alignment across senior stakeholders, suppliers and distributed teams.
* Commercial and supplier management (developing/exemplary): manages performance, obligations, cost, risk and value across outsourced services.
* Change and transformation leadership (developing/exemplary): leads operating-model, process, technology and behavioural change.

**Role specific knowledge and experience**

**Minimum/essential**

* Substantial leadership experience in complex People Operations, payroll, shared services or outsourced service-delivery environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-country or global payroll and HR operations governance across internal teams and external providers.
* Strong knowledge of payroll operations, controls, reconciliations, statutory compliance, risk management and audit requirements.
* Experience managing service providers and payroll vendors through SLAs, KPIs, governance forums, corrective actions and commercial discussions.
* Experience designing or improving target operating models, processes, controls, SOPs, RACI structures and escalation frameworks.
* Proven delivery of transformation, transition, automation or vendor-consolidation initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Experience in preparing business cases, financial models, cost-benefit analysis, executive presentations and leadership recommendations.
* Advanced analytical capability, including strong Excel and presentation skills and the ability to turn data into clear executive insight.
* Experience leading managers, specialists or matrix teams across different locations and priorities.
* Excellent stakeholder management, judgement, written communication and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.

**Desirable**

* Experience of global payroll transformation, managed payroll services, payroll technology integration or HR service outsourcing.
* Knowledge of HRIS, case-management, reporting and workflow platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, SAP, C4C/AskHR or equivalent.
* Experience of contracts, supplier invoice, purchase-order and financial-control governance within a global organisation.

**Language Requirements**

**Professional Qualification and Certification**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.
* Governance, risk and controls
* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.
* Continuous improvement and digital
* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.
