* Build the teams from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**Essential**
**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll

title: Admin Manager
description:

About the role

I'm Vinay Pasricha, founder of GoodSpace AI. I'm looking for an Admin Manager to run our Noida office end to end. You'll keep the office clean, working and well supplied, manage every vendor we use, and own the office budget. I want someone who treats the company's money like their own: you negotiate hard, track every rupee, and tell me each month where it went.

Must-haves

* Can work 9 to 6, Monday to Saturday, from the office.

How we hire

After a conversation, we check references with your past employers, then you do a paid trial week in the office.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
WEVOW is a leading Indian ethnic wear brand specializing in handcrafted sarees, blouses, and jewelry that showcase the richness of Indian culture. The brand blends traditional craftsmanship with contemporary design to create distinctive, high-quality pieces for a modern audience. WEVOW focuses on preserving artisanal techniques while offering products that are relevant to current fashion trends. Team members work in a creative, detail-oriented environment closely connected to skilled artisans and designers. More information about WEVOW and its collections can be found at www.wevow.in.
  
**Role Description**
The Production Manager will oversee end-to-end production operations for ethnic wear and accessories, ensuring quality, timely delivery, and efficient use of resources. Day-to-day responsibilities include planning and scheduling production, coordinating with artisans and suppliers, monitoring inventory of fabrics and materials, and supervising the workflow from sampling to final dispatch. The role involves implementing quality control processes, resolving production issues, optimizing costs, and maintaining clear communication with design, merchandising, and logistics teams. The Production Manager will also be responsible for documenting processes, tracking production metrics, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong production planning and coordination skills, including scheduling, resource allocation, and workflow management in apparel or textiles.
* Experience with quality control and assurance, including inspection standards, defect tracking, and continuous improvement in manufacturing processes.
* Proficiency in vendor and artisan management, including sourcing, negotiating timelines and costs, and maintaining collaborative relationships.
* Inventory and materials management skills, including tracking stock levels, overseeing procurement, and minimizing wastage.
* Knowledge of garment construction, fabrics, and traditional Indian ethnic wear production techniques is highly beneficial.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and deadline-focused execution.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead and motivate production teams in a diverse environment.
* Comfort with basic digital tools (spreadsheets, production tracking software, or ERP systems) for reporting and planning.
* Relevant experience in apparel manufacturing, textile production, or fashion industry; prior work with handcrafted or artisanal products is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Production Management, Textile Engineering, Fashion Technology, or a related field preferred.

title: Regional Business Head
description:
About HNS Gold

HNS Gold Pvt. Ltd. is a growing company specializing in buying old gold and silver jewellery at competitive market-linked rates with instant payment. Our services also include Gold Loan Settlement, Monthly Gold Investment Plans (MGIP), and Free Gold Valuation.

As part of our business expansion in West Bengal, we are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Regional Head**
to lead our Kolkata region, strengthen branch performance, develop high-performing teams, and drive sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Regional Business Development & Growth**

* Take overall responsibility for business performance, revenue generation, and profitability across the Kolkata region.
* Drive Gold Buying, Silver Buying, Gold Loan Settlement, and MGIP business.
* Ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly business targets across all assigned branches.
* Identify new business opportunities, strengthen local market presence, and develop strategies for customer acquisition.
* Monitor branch-wise business performance and implement corrective action wherever required.

**4. Branch Expansion & Market Development**

* Identify high-potential locations for new branch expansion across Kolkata and surrounding markets.
* Support market research, competitor analysis, and branch feasibility assessments.
* Coordinate new branch launches, recruitment, business planning, and initial performance development.

* Monitor daily MIS, sales pipeline, branch productivity, and target achievement.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, gold valuation procedures, KYC requirements, and operational controls.
* Work closely with Operations, HR, Marketing, and Lead Management departments.
* Monitor branch operating expenses, business efficiency, and profitability.
* Ensure timely reporting, proper escalation, and closure of business-related issues.

Candidate Requirements

**Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or postgraduate qualification in Management is an advantage.
* **Minimum 5–10 years of relevant experience, including significant experience in the Gold Loan industry.**
* **Proven experience managing multiple branches, regions, or large sales teams.**
* **Prior experience as Regional Manager, Area Manager, Cluster Manager, Zonal Manager, or in a comparable multi-branch leadership role.**
* **Demonstrated success in achieving sales targets, developing business volumes, and managing branch profitability.**
* **Strong knowledge of the Kolkata and West Bengal markets.**
* **Willingness to travel extensively across assigned branches.**

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
* Excellent sales planning, business development, and customer acquisition skills.
* Ability to improve underperforming branches and drive measurable results.
* Strong analytical, MIS reporting, and performance monitoring skills.
* Knowledge of gold valuation, gold-backed financial products, and branch operations.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Regional Head will be evaluated on:

* Regional Gold and Silver Buying business volume.
* Revenue generation and branch profitability.
* Daily, weekly, and monthly target achievement.
* Branch-wise productivity and sales growth.
* Customer walk-ins and lead conversion performance.
* New customer acquisition and existing customer retention.
* Gold Loan Settlement and MGIP business development.
* Team performance, retention, and leadership effectiveness.
* Successful branch expansion and new branch performance.
* Operational compliance and cost management.

What We Offer

* Senior leadership opportunity in a growing gold and silver buying business.
* Responsibility for managing and expanding the Kolkata region.
* Opportunity to build and lead high-performing teams.
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience and role requirements.
* Performance-based incentives as per company policy.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant Gold Loan industry experience and proven multi-branch leadership capabilities are invited to apply through LinkedIn.

* **Join HNS Gold and lead our next phase of regional business growth.**

title: Purchase Manager
description:
About Sinclairs

Sinclairs Hotels & Resorts is one of eastern India's most established hospitality names, operating nine properties across the country's hills, plains and coastline, from Himalayan resorts to a beachfront hotel in the Andamans. We are a listed, debt-free group with a strong cash position, now in an active expansion phase and transforming how we run: our commercial discipline, our people systems and our technology.

The Role

You will own group procurement for Sinclairs: food and beverage, operating supplies, housekeeping and guest amenities, engineering and maintenance materials, and support for capital purchases and new-property fit-outs. The mandate is to move the group from property-by-property buying to a disciplined central function: consolidated spend, contracted rates, standard specifications, clean approvals and a full audit trail, without losing the local responsiveness a hotel needs.

This is a hands-on, commercially sharp role. You negotiate, build the vendor base, set the policy, chase the savings, and travel to properties to solve supply problems in person. Integrity is the non-negotiable.

What You'll Own

* Spend analysis by category, property and vendor; consolidation, standardisation and annual savings targets
* - A qualified vendor base for every major category, including reliable supply lines into remote locations (Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Gangtok, Chalsa, Port Blair)
* - Rate contracts, terms and SLAs; vendor performance management; regular price benchmarking
* - Group purchase policy: approval matrix, quotation and tender thresholds, PO discipline, three-way matching
* - Controls that make leakage difficult; GST, TDS and vendor reconciliation with finance
* - Par levels, ordering cycles and stock-take support with property stores and chefs
* - Capex and project procurement: equipment, FF&E, renovation materials and new-property openings
* - Item and vendor masters, rate contracts and monthly procurement reporting in the group's systems

What We're Looking For

* 5-8 years in procurement, at least 3 in hotels, resorts, restaurant chains or multi-unit hospitality/F&B
* - Deep knowledge of hotel purchasing categories, F&B and perishables above all
* - Proven negotiation record with measurable savings and rate contracts you have put in place
* - Experience writing or running purchase policies and PO-based controls
* - Strong Excel and data skills; working knowledge of GST, TDS and FSSAI requirements
* - Unimpeachable integrity, with references that will say so
* - Willing to travel regularly to the properties, including remote hill and island locations

Where This Goes

First central procurement seat; designed to become Head of Procurement & Supply Chain as the estate grows.

title: GRC - SAP - GRC - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY - GDS Consulting**
–
**GRC Technology – SAP GRC AC – Manager**
As part of our EY-GDS GRC Technology team, you will drive complex GRC Technology (SAP Security & GRC) engagements and help solve broader risks through solution implementation. You will be responsible for ideating, developing & launching new services in line with the SAP roadmap for enterprise solutions. You will be the SMR to recommend, design, develop, document, test and debug new and existing implementations and/or applications for internal use, for difficult business problems. In addition, participate in solution designing and consult with business clients/onsite team to understand and meet business needs, and achieving business and technology initiatives.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Manager with expertise in
**SAP GRC AC (Access Controls)**
to join the leadership group of our
**EY-GDS GRC Technology Team**
. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Actively aid the team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation, design and deployment
* Share responsibility, provide support, foresee challenges, maintain clear communication channels with the senior management as well as possess a strong grasp on engagement nitty-gritties
* Should possess the technical prowess to drive the projects and the capability to lead a team
* Build connect with client stakeholders, understand their business challenges/pain areas a work with leadership to propose innovative solutions
* Lead process walkthrough discussions to document end-to-end business processes and functional requirements
* Demonstrate a detailed knowledge of market trends, competitor activities, EY products and service lines
* Generate innovative ideas and challenge the status quo
* Build and nurture positive working relationships with clients with the intention to achieve exceptional client service
* Identify opportunities to improve engagement profitability
* Help manage the financial aspects of engagements by organizing staffing, tracking financials, proactive Project management and tracking of issues
* Support leadership to drive business development initiatives and account mining activities.
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Support business development activities through both leading pursuits and developing strong relationships with existing clients
* Contribute in development of intellectual capital in your industry of expertise
* Be a part of case teams to provide solutions to unstructured problems

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication, presentation and team building skills and experience in producing high quality reports, papers, and presentations
* Develop people through effective coaching and mentoring
* Experience in executing and managing research and analysis of companies and markets trends, preferably from a commercial due diligence standpoint
* Contribute to people-related initiatives including recruiting, retaining, appraisal and training
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop skills of team members and self

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA/MBA/M.Sc./B.Tech with a minimum 8+ years of consulting / auditing experience
* Manage complex S4HANA transformation projects and drive delivery of SAP GRC and Security solutions
* Drive client discussions to design robust SAP GRC solutions for complex SAP landscapes
* Rich experience in strategizing GRC architecture, implementing key controls and driving innovations within the projects
* Good exposure to designing processes for managing key controls within the organisation
* Experience in at least 4-6 implementation, upgrade or migration projects for SAP GRC and has led at least 1 end to end S4HANA implementation or migration project
* Ability to independently lead/drive pursuits and sales discussions
* Should be able to independently drive strategic initiatives within the firm
* Preferable and added advantage, comfortable with SAP Security architecture and implementations, ability to design robust SAP Security solutions for complex SAP landscapes
* Good to have experience managing ITGC framework and logical access review/assessments, defining the best practices/KPIs for configuration and settings of change management and logical access controls, assessing current ITGC controls and deliver remediation roadmaps
* Good exposure to regulatory requirements like SOx, GDPR, GxP etc. and its impact on SAP GRC solutions
* Exposure to GRC products other than SAP will be an added advantage (For e.g. Oracle GRC,Archer, ServiceNow GRC, IBM Open pages etc.)
* Clear understanding of project lifecycle managements for e.g. SDLC, Agile and its deliverables
* Project management skills
* Good knowledge of MS Office tools
* Good to have certifications - CISA, PMP, SAFe Agilist, SAP GRC AC, SAP Security professional or SAP authorization and auditing
* Innovative mindset to drive automation agenda within the team
* Exposure to RPA transformation program approach and understanding of RPA tools like Blue Prism, UI Path
* Working knowledge of analytical tools and software to support data analysis and visualization engagements

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line: SAP - Position Title: Manager- SAP FICO**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Manager in the IT Consulting Services team to work on various SAP Implementation projects for our customers across the globe.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Need to work as a Manager in different phases of various ongoing SAP Implementation Projects and contribute effectively.
* Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the manager/lead.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* SAP Finance – FI- New General Ledger & Profit Center Accounting, FI-Accounts Payable, FI-Bank accounting and FI-Asset Accounting.
* Exposure on SAP Simple Finance – GL Accounting, Asset Accounting and CO – Overhead Cost Controlling & Profitability Analysis.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Knowledge of SAP – BPC (Consolidation), Special purpose ledger, SOX, US GAAP, Various of Exits, Background on the Technical and Functional upgrade, Report painter, Report writer etc.
* Experience on FIORI APPS, BO-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools.
* Prior client facing consulting experience.
* SAP Finance/Controlling Certification is a plus.

**What We Look For**

* CA/ICWA (ICMA)/MBA Finance in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience with 10+ years.
* Experience of having worked in an onsite- offshore delivery model.
* Project Management experience should be of leading at least a team of 10-15 members.
* Experience should be in End-to-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.
* SAP Finance – FI- New General Ledger & Profit Center Accounting, FI-Accounts Payable, FI-Bank accounting and FI-Asset Accounting.
* Exposure on SAP Simple Finance – GL Accounting, Asset Accounting and CO – Overhead Cost Controlling & Profitability Analysis.
* SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
* SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions & Reporting.
* Controlling- CO-Cost element accounting CO-Cost Center Accounting and CO-Internal Orders.
* Knowledge on CO-PA & Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling).
* FI integration with MM, SD, HR & PS.
* Excellent business communication skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Risk Consulting-Digital Risk-Manager-Cloud
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job description -**
**Manager – Cloud (Risk Consulting – Digital Risk)**
**Requisition ID - TBC**
EY focuses on high-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. At EY GDS, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY GDS become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The objective of our Risk Consulting services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions enable clients to build confidence and trust with customers, regulators, and the broader market.
  
  
Within Cloud Risk and Security, this role focuses on leading engagements that assess, test, and validate cloud security and risk controls across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments. The role involves working closely with IT, cloud engineering, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that cloud environments are secure, resilient, and aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Operate as a fieldwork leader, assisting clients in identifying, assessing, and monitoring cloud-related security and technology risks.
* Lead and execute cloud security and risk assessments, including control design and operating effectiveness testing across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Collaborate with engagement teams to plan engagements, develop work programs, timelines, risk assessments, and testing procedures.
* Serve as a fieldwork leader by directing daily testing activities, tracking engagement progress, and managing staff performance.
* Perform cloud architecture and configuration reviews covering landing zones, identity models, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, and backup and disaster recovery.
* Assess cloud governance and security controls aligned to shared responsibility models and industry frameworks.
* Prepare high-quality deliverables, reports, and recommendations aligned with US work product quality standards.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong fundamentals across cloud risk and cloud security, with hands-on experience across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong audit mindset with the ability to design, execute, and evidence control testing across cloud environments.
* Proven experience leading cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and maturity assessments.
* Practical experience assessing controls related to identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring/SIEM, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Experience with containerized and cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes, serverless, and workload security.
* Proven ability to lead multi-location teams, manage delivery risks, and deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (non-negotiable).
* Ability to manage time effectively and work in US time zones, as per project needs.
* Exposure to cyber-related risk or security activities is an added advantage.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Demonstrates adaptability and agility, with a strong commitment to continuous learning across cloud platforms and emerging technologies.
* Exhibits end-to-end engagement leadership, delivering cloud security audits and risk assessments across complex environments.
* Brings an innovation-oriented mindset, leveraging automation and analytics to enhance control testing efficiency and continuous monitoring.
* Actively contributes to practice-building initiatives, including development of accelerators, tools, and reusable assets.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Communicates effectively and manages stakeholder expectations across technical and business audiences.

**To qualify for the role, you must have.**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7–12 years of total experience, including 3–5 years in cloud security or cloud risk roles.
* Cloud security certifications such as CCSP or CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience in cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and control testing.
* Experience designing and assessing controls across identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and compliance standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and privacy expectations.
* Client-facing experience working with engineering, security, and risk stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Exposure to container security, Kubernetes, Zero Trust concepts, SASE/SSE, CASB, or cloud-native security tooling is preferred.
* Experience supporting regulated industries or large-scale cloud transformations or migrations is an added advantage.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
About Sinclairs

Sinclairs Hotels & Resorts is one of eastern India's most established hospitality names, operating nine properties across the country's hills, plains and coastline, from Himalayan resorts to a beachfront hotel in the Andamans. We are a listed, debt-free group with a strong cash position, now in an active expansion phase and transforming how we run: our commercial discipline, our people systems and our technology.

The Role

You will join the leadership team driving that transformation, working across strategy, operations, commercial and technology. This is a generalist seat for a sharp, structured early-career operator: one week you are building a forecast model or a procurement comparison, the next you are running an initiative tracker, analysing guest data, or travelling to a property to understand why a process is not working and fixing it.

You will do real analysis and real execution, with direct exposure to senior leadership and to the general managers who run our hotels.

What You'll Do

* Build analysis and models that drive decisions: forecasts, budgets, business cases, pricing, procurement and vendor comparisons
* - Track and drive cross-functional initiatives: plans, owners, milestones, status reporting and follow-through
* - Turn property and guest data into dashboards and insights leadership can act on
* - Prepare leadership and board materials: clear, concise documents and presentations
* - Work with property teams to roll out new processes, policies and systems, and measure whether they land
* - Research markets, competitors and new opportunities, including support on new-property projects
* - Use modern tools, including AI, to move faster and automate the routine

What We're Looking For

* 1-4 years in consulting, business operations, strategy, finance, analytics or a high-growth startup
* - Strong analytical skills; comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets models and working with data
* - Clear, structured written communication and presentation skills
* - Organised, detail-oriented and reliable on follow-through
* - High ownership and curiosity; comfortable with ambiguity and moving between analysis and execution
* - Hospitality, consumer or multi-location business exposure is a plus
* - Willing to travel to our properties

Where This Goes

A fast-track seat with broad exposure across a growing hotel group; progression into larger ownership of initiatives, functions or properties as the group expands.

title: Costing Executive
description:
**Company Description**
ANKRAJ DEVELOPER PVT LTD is a growing organization in the real estate and construction sector, focused on delivering high-quality projects and reliable services. The company emphasizes professional project management, cost efficiency, and timely delivery. It offers opportunities for individuals who want to develop their careers in project costing, budgeting, and financial planning within the built environment. The Costing Executive will work full time on-site at the company’s office in Kolkata. * Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Finance, Commerce, Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
* Prior experience in project costing, estimation, or related roles in construction or real estate is preferred.
* Commitment to ethical practices, data confidentiality, and continuous improvement in costing processes.

At PwC, this opportunity sits within our Tax Services group and the Global Mobility Services network, where the work centers on advising businesses through complex tax topics and helping them manage tax planning, compliance, and strategy. In this role at PwC, you will develop commercial awareness, respond to different perspectives, take ownership of assigned work, and contribute to a team that values learning, accountability, and steady growth.

* Knowledge of governance, compensation and related-party disclosures

title: Purchase Manager
description:
About Sinclairs

Sinclairs Hotels & Resorts is one of eastern India's most established hospitality names, operating nine properties across the country's hills, plains and coastline, from Himalayan resorts to a beachfront hotel in the Andamans. We are a listed, debt-free group with a strong cash position, now in an active expansion phase and transforming how we run: our commercial discipline, our people systems and our technology.

The Role

You will own group procurement for Sinclairs: food and beverage, operating supplies, housekeeping and guest amenities, engineering and maintenance materials, and support for capital purchases and new-property fit-outs. The mandate is to move the group from property-by-property buying to a disciplined central function: consolidated spend, contracted rates, standard specifications, clean approvals and a full audit trail, without losing the local responsiveness a hotel needs.

This is a hands-on, commercially sharp role. You negotiate, build the vendor base, set the policy, chase the savings, and travel to properties to solve supply problems in person. Integrity is the non-negotiable.

What You'll Own

* Spend analysis by category, property and vendor; consolidation, standardisation and annual savings targets
* - A qualified vendor base for every major category, including reliable supply lines into remote locations (Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Gangtok, Chalsa, Port Blair)
* - Rate contracts, terms and SLAs; vendor performance management; regular price benchmarking
* - Group purchase policy: approval matrix, quotation and tender thresholds, PO discipline, three-way matching
* - Controls that make leakage difficult; GST, TDS and vendor reconciliation with finance
* - Par levels, ordering cycles and stock-take support with property stores and chefs
* - Capex and project procurement: equipment, FF&E, renovation materials and new-property openings
* - Item and vendor masters, rate contracts and monthly procurement reporting in the group's systems

What We're Looking For

* 5-8 years in procurement, at least 3 in hotels, resorts, restaurant chains or multi-unit hospitality/F&B
* - Deep knowledge of hotel purchasing categories, F&B and perishables above all
* - Proven negotiation record with measurable savings and rate contracts you have put in place
* - Experience writing or running purchase policies and PO-based controls
* - Strong Excel and data skills; working knowledge of GST, TDS and FSSAI requirements
* - Unimpeachable integrity, with references that will say so
* - Willing to travel regularly to the properties, including remote hill and island locations

Where This Goes

First central procurement seat; designed to become Head of Procurement & Supply Chain as the estate grows.

* Support intercompany accounting, group reporting and audits; coordinate routine information requests with external accountants, tax advisers and auditors.

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline.

* Practical exposure to Spanish VAT, corporate income tax, withholding taxes and applicable Modelo declarations.
* Familiarity with Spanish statutory books, annual accounts and tax/invoicing compliance requirements.
* Experience with an accounting/ERP system and good Excel skills.
* Fluent Spanish and good English communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, organisation, confidentiality and ability to work with colleagues and advisers across countries.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SII, electronic invoicing requirements and related Spanish compliance developments.
* Exposure to intercompany reconciliations, cross-border transactions and group reporting.
* Experience supporting statutory or tax audits and responding to requests from the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT).

* A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.

title: Factory Operations Manager – Food Processing
description:
**Company:** Basulimata Agro Foods LLP  
**Location:** West Bengal, India  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, On-site  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹45,000 per month (Negotiable based on experience and expertise)

**Job Overview**

Basulimata Agro Foods LLP is looking for an experienced and technically proficient Factory Operations Manager to independently manage and oversee its complete food processing and manufacturing operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the entire factory lifecycle, including raw material processing, cleaning, sorting, grading, quality control, packaging, inventory management and finished goods preparation for domestic and international markets.

The ideal candidate must possess strong knowledge of food technology, industrial food processing machinery, automated production systems and factory management. The person will be responsible for supervising existing factory workers, ensuring production efficiency, maintaining product quality and implementing effective operational procedures.

The candidate will report directly to company management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Factory & Production Management**

* Independently manage and oversee all day-to-day factory operations.
* Plan, organise and monitor daily, weekly and monthly production activities.
* Ensure production targets are achieved within specified timelines.
* Manage the complete production cycle, from raw material intake to finished product packaging.
* Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for factory operations.
* Monitor production efficiency, resource utilisation and operational costs.

**2. Workforce & Labour Management**

* Supervise, manage and coordinate existing factory workers, machine operators and production staff.
* Allocate daily responsibilities and production duties.
* Monitor worker attendance, discipline, productivity and performance.
* Organise work shifts and ensure adequate manpower allocation.
* Provide operational training and ensure workers follow safety and hygiene procedures.
* Maintain an efficient and productive working environment.

**3. Food Processing Machinery & Automation**

* Possess practical knowledge of industrial food processing and manufacturing machinery.
* Understand the operation, configuration and maintenance of automated processing and packaging systems.
* Supervise machinery used for cleaning, sorting, grading, processing, weighing and packaging.
* Identify suitable machinery and technologies for different agricultural food products.
* Evaluate machinery capacity, performance and production efficiency.
* Implement preventive maintenance schedules and coordinate machinery servicing.
* Identify opportunities for automation and production-line improvements.

**4. Food Processing & Product Management**

* Oversee processing operations for agricultural and food products, including rice, puffed rice (muri), dried red chilli, soya chunks and other agro-food products.
* Ensure appropriate cleaning, sorting, grading, processing and packaging procedures.
* Monitor product quality, consistency, moisture levels and contamination risks.
* Optimise processing methods to improve product yield and reduce wastage.
* Ensure products meet the required specifications of international buyers.

**5. Quality Control & Food Safety**

* Establish and implement quality control procedures throughout the production process.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations and food safety requirements.
* Implement and monitor GMP, HACCP and hygiene standards.
* Conduct and supervise raw material, in-process and finished product inspections.
* Maintain batch-wise quality records and production traceability.
* Ensure proper sanitation, pest control and safe storage practices.
* Coordinate product testing and inspections whenever required.

**6. Inventory & Warehouse Management**

* Monitor raw material, packaging material and finished goods inventory.
* Maintain accurate stock and consumption records.
* Monitor production yield, wastage, rejected materials and stock losses.
* Ensure appropriate storage conditions and stock rotation.
* Coordinate material requirements with procurement and company management.
* Ensure proper inventory reconciliation.

**7. Packaging, Storage & Export Readiness**

* Supervise bulk packaging and customised/private-label packaging operations.
* Ensure correct packaging specifications, weights, labelling and batch identification.
* Maintain product quality during storage and handling.
* Ensure finished products meet buyer specifications and applicable export requirements.
* Coordinate with the export and logistics teams for timely order fulfilment.

**8. Reporting & Operational Improvement**

* Prepare regular production, inventory and factory performance reports.
* Monitor production output, machine downtime, wastage and operational costs.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective measures.
* Recommend improvements in machinery, processes and production methods.
* Report factory performance, operational issues and resource requirements directly to company management.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Tech / B.Sc / M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or an equivalent relevant discipline.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in food processing, agro-processing, FMCG or food manufacturing.
* Previous experience managing factory production operations and supervising factory workers is essential.
* Strong practical knowledge of industrial food processing machinery and automated production systems.
* Good understanding of food safety, quality control, HACCP, GMP and FSSAI regulations.
* Experience in production planning, inventory management and operational cost control.
* Ability to independently manage factory operations and take operational decisions.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in rice mills, grain processing, spice processing, agricultural food processing or packaged food manufacturing.
* Knowledge of optical sorting, grading, cleaning, weighing and automated packaging machinery.
* Experience with export-oriented food processing and international quality standards.
* Knowledge of ISO 22000 and other relevant food safety management systems.

* Monitor traffic, conversion rate, AOV and repeat customer metrics.

* Monitor order processing, dispatch, delivery, cancellations and returns.

* Monitor competitor pricing regularly.

**The opportunity**
The objective of our Risk Consulting services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions enable clients to build confidence and trust with customers, regulators, and the broader market.
  
  
Within Cloud Risk and Security, this role focuses on leading engagements that assess, test, and validate cloud security and risk controls across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments. The role involves working closely with IT, cloud engineering, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that cloud environments are secure, resilient, and aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Operate as a fieldwork leader, assisting clients in identifying, assessing, and monitoring cloud-related security and technology risks.

* Serve as a fieldwork leader by directing daily testing activities, tracking engagement progress, and managing staff performance.
* Perform cloud architecture and configuration reviews covering landing zones, identity models, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, and backup and disaster recovery.
* Assess cloud governance and security controls aligned to shared responsibility models and industry frameworks.
* Prepare high-quality deliverables, reports, and recommendations aligned with US work product quality standards.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong fundamentals across cloud risk and cloud security, with hands-on experience across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong audit mindset with the ability to design, execute, and evidence control testing across cloud environments.
* Proven experience leading cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and maturity assessments.
* Practical experience assessing controls related to identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring/SIEM, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Experience with containerized and cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes, serverless, and workload security.
* Proven ability to lead multi-location teams, manage delivery risks, and deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (non-negotiable).
* Ability to manage time effectively and work in US time zones, as per project needs.
* Exposure to cyber-related risk or security activities is an added advantage.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Demonstrates adaptability and agility, with a strong commitment to continuous learning across cloud platforms and emerging technologies.
* Exhibits end-to-end engagement leadership, delivering cloud security audits and risk assessments across complex environments.
* Brings an innovation-oriented mindset, leveraging automation and analytics to enhance control testing efficiency and continuous monitoring.
* Actively contributes to practice-building initiatives, including development of accelerators, tools, and reusable assets.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Communicates effectively and manages stakeholder expectations across technical and business audiences.

**To qualify for the role, you must have.**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7–12 years of total experience, including 3–5 years in cloud security or cloud risk roles.
* Cloud security certifications such as CCSP or CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience in cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and control testing.
* Experience designing and assessing controls across identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and compliance standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and privacy expectations.
* Client-facing experience working with engineering, security, and risk stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Exposure to container security, Kubernetes, Zero Trust concepts, SASE/SSE, CASB, or cloud-native security tooling is preferred.
* Experience supporting regulated industries or large-scale cloud transformations or migrations is an added advantage.

title: Manager Purchase
description:

Responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of the company's purchasing activities. This role involves strategic sourcing, vendor management, cost negotiation, and ensuring timely and efficient procurement of goods and services while adhering to company policies and regulatory standards.

PF, Insurance, Bonus, Gratuity and other benefits

* Ability to design and implement effective Test Strategy and Testing approaches for transformers and package substations.
* Experience in Test Management, including planning, scheduling, and overseeing end-to-end test cycles.
* Hands-on expertise in Test Execution and preparation of Test Cases for routine, type, and special tests.
* Strong knowledge of electrical engineering principles related to power transformers, switchgear, and substations.
* Experience with QAQC frameworks, standards, and regulatory compliance in the electrical manufacturing sector (e.g., IEC, IS standards).
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical teams, mentor staff, and manage performance in a production environment.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with attention to detail and safety.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline; significant relevant industry experience in transformer and substation testing is expected.
* Familiarity with testing equipment, diagnostic tools, and quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001) is an advantage.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams, suppliers, and customers.

title: Director - Regional Clinical (Avitum Division) - Asia Pacific
description:
Are you passionate to be in the role as
**Director - Clinical**
**?**
Do you have experience in
**clinical excellence and business growth**
? If so, this opportunity could be for you! Join us at B. Braun, a leader in the medical devices industry, where your skills and experience will be recognized and celebrated. Take the next step in your career with us and help shape the future of healthcare!
  
  
As a
**Director - Clinical**
at B. Braun you will play a vital role in….
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Clinical Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for all clinical aspects of the Avitum division business. The role ensures excellence in patient care, clinical quality, safety, regulatory compliance, and clinical outcomes across the Avitum division portfolio.
  
  
The position acts as the bridge between clinical excellence and business growth, ensuring sustainable expansion while maintaining the highest standards of patient care and clinical governance.
  
  
**Your key responsibilities:**
**1. Clinical Governance and Quality Management**

* Lead and oversee clinical governance frameworks across all renal care facilities.
* Establish, implement, and continuously improve clinical policies, protocols, and standards of care.
* Ensure compliance with local healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and company clinical policies.
* Monitor quality indicators and drive quality improvement initiatives.
* Develop corrective and preventive action plans to address quality gaps.
* Clinical outcomes management - define and monitor key clinical outcome metrics including but not limited to:

+ Dialysis adequacy (Kt/V)
+ Vascular access outcomes
+ Hospitalization rates
+ Infection rates
+ Anemia management
+ Mortality and morbidity indicators
+ Patient satisfaction and experience measures

* Benchmark clinical outcomes against national and international best practices.
* Drive programs to improve patient outcomes and overall quality of care.

**2. Regional Clinical Program and Sales Excellence**

* Lead clinical engagement and support sales activities
* Partner with commercial teams during customer presentations, tenders, and contract negotiations.
* Develop clinical value-based selling strategies highlighting patient outcomes, safety, and economic benefits.
* Engage with clinicians, hospitals, healthcare providers, and healthcare authorities to strengthen referral networks.
* Act as a clinical ambassador for the organization at conferences, professional forums, and industry events.
* Provide clinical education and training to customers and internal commercial teams.
* Develop and oversee clinical competency programs for nursing and allied healthcare personnel.
* Lead clinical education initiatives across the organization.
* Mentor and coach clinical managers and multidisciplinary teams.
* Provide clinical input into operational, financial, and expansion decisions.
* Identify opportunities for service innovation, operational improvement, and business growth.

**3. Medical and Professional Engagement**

* Establish strong collaborative relationships with nephrologists, intensivists and other relevant key opinion leaders.
* Serve as the clinical liaison with healthcare authorities, regulatory bodies, and professional societies.
* Facilitate physician engagement and support medical advisory activities.
* Monitor emerging trends, technologies, and evidence-based practices.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**Clinical Quality & Outcomes**

* Achievement of target clinical outcome benchmarks
* Improvement in dialysis adequacy metrics
* Regulatory and accreditation compliance

**Business Development**

* New HD center development and activation
* Growth in patient census
* Referral network expansion
* Support of acute dialysis business growth

**Operational Excellence**

* Clinical audit performance
* Staff competency compliance

**What you will bring to the team:**

* Medical Doctor (MD/MBBS), specialization in Nephrology an added advantage
* Minimum 10 years of experience in corporate role, regional experience an added advantage.
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership or management role.
* Demonstrated experience in:

+ Clinical governance
+ Quality management
+ Dialysis operations
+ Customer-facing clinical support

* Experience in acute dialysis and critical care settings is highly desirable.

**What sets B. Braun apart?**
Founded in Germany in 1839, B. Braun is a leading medical technology company with over 66,000 employees in 64 countries. Specializing in infusion therapy, orthopaedics, neurosurgery, anaesthesia, and more, B. Braun develops high-quality products and services that improve global health. In Asia Pacific, B. Braun employs over 16,000 people across 10 production sites and 16 business offices.
  
  
Established in 1972, B. Braun Medical Industries in Penang is the regional headquarters for APAC. With more than 7,000 employees, the plant located in Penang is among the largest manufacturers of medical, surgical and pharmaceutical products not only in Malaysia but also in the APAC region. It also houses the Centre of Excellence for Intravenous Access.
  
  
**What can we offer you?**

* Hybrid working arrangement
* Employee Incentive Scheme
* Training and development programs
* Onsite fitness area including running track, futsal and classes.
* Medical Insurance and dental and optical allowance.
* Travel Allowance
* Retirement Fund

**What’s next?**
Once you click on the link to Apply, you will be directed to update your personal information and submit your CV. Our Talent Acquisition team will carefully review your application, and if you pass the CV screening you will be invited for the first interview. We ask you to conduct two interviews, one in person and one remotely. If you stand out and meet our requirements, we will present you with an offer and guide you through our seamless onboarding process. Join us and be part of something extraordinary!
  
  
We appreciate different perspectives, thoughts, experiences and backgrounds. By strengthening an appreciative, inclusive, respectful and equal working environment, we create a culture in which all our employees feel free to be who they are.

title: TechOps-DE-ITSM Process Specialist-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: ITSM Process Specialist -Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Process Governance: Ensure Compliance with incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management processes.
* SLA Management: Monitor SLA performance, identify imminent breaches and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Ticket Hygiene: Ensure accurate categorization, prioritization, documentation, updates and timely ticket closure.
* Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with Service managers, delivery teams and customer leadership on process gaps and improvement plans.
* Customer Collaboration: Engage proactively with customer stakeholders to review process effectiveness, gather feedback and jointly identify improvement opportunities.
* Process Transformation: Challenge existing practices, eliminate inefficiencies and redesign workflows to improve operational effectiveness and SLA performance.
* Joint Governance: Conduct periodic process reviews with the customer, agree on improvement actions and track implementation through measurable outcomes.
* Best Practice Adoption: Recommend and implement industry best practices, standardisation and automation opportunities in alignment with customer requirements.
* Reporting & Analysis: Publish daily operational reports, weekly KPI dashboards and Monthly business review (MBR) metrics.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify automation opportunities, reduce recurring incidents, improve MTTR and eliminate repetitive tickets.
* Audit & Compliance: Ensure process adherence, maintain evidence and address audit findings
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong knowledge of ITIL processes, including incident, Problem, Change, request and Knowledge Management
* Expertise in ITSM tools, with proficiency in developing dashboards and reports to track SLAs, KPIs, ticket trends and operational performance
* Experience in process standardisation, SOP development and ITSM governance across application teams
* Proficiency in SLA monitoring, breach prevention & performance improvement
* Expertise in operational reporting, KPI dashboards and monthly business reviews
* Ability to collaborate with customers to identify process gaps and implement improvements
* Strong analytical skills to identify recurring incidents, root causes and automation opportunities
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and end-to-end ownership of continuous improvement initiatives

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8-10 years of experience in ITSM process governance, service management and process improvement
* ITIL4 Foundation Certification; Advance ITIL certifications are an advantage
* Proficiency in Excel, Power BI or equivalent reporting and analytics tools.
* Hands-on experience with ITSM tools, including ServiceNow for process management and workflow configuration
* Proven ability to standardize ITSM processes, develop SOPs and drive process compliance across teams.
* Experience in SLA management, operational reporting, KPI dashboards and performance analysis
* Strong customer engagement skills to identify process gaps and implement continuous improvement initiatives
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
**Technologies and Tools**

* ITSM Platforms: ServiceNow , Jira Service Management
* Knowledge management :Confluence, Sharepoint
* Reporting & Dashboards: ServiceNow, Performance Analytics, Power BI & Advanced Microsoft excel

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: GRC - SAP - GRC - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY - GDS Consulting**
–
**GRC Technology – SAP GRC AC – Manager**
As part of our EY-GDS GRC Technology team, you will drive complex GRC Technology (SAP Security & GRC) engagements and help solve broader risks through solution implementation. You will be responsible for ideating, developing & launching new services in line with the SAP roadmap for enterprise solutions. You will be the SMR to recommend, design, develop, document, test and debug new and existing implementations and/or applications for internal use, for difficult business problems. In addition, participate in solution designing and consult with business clients/onsite team to understand and meet business needs, and achieving business and technology initiatives.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Manager with expertise in
**SAP GRC AC (Access Controls)**
to join the leadership group of our
**EY-GDS GRC Technology Team**
. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Actively aid the team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation, design and deployment
* Share responsibility, provide support, foresee challenges, maintain clear communication channels with the senior management as well as possess a strong grasp on engagement nitty-gritties
* Should possess the technical prowess to drive the projects and the capability to lead a team
* Build connect with client stakeholders, understand their business challenges/pain areas a work with leadership to propose innovative solutions
* Lead process walkthrough discussions to document end-to-end business processes and functional requirements
* Demonstrate a detailed knowledge of market trends, competitor activities, EY products and service lines
* Generate innovative ideas and challenge the status quo
* Build and nurture positive working relationships with clients with the intention to achieve exceptional client service
* Identify opportunities to improve engagement profitability
* Help manage the financial aspects of engagements by organizing staffing, tracking financials, proactive Project management and tracking of issues
* Support leadership to drive business development initiatives and account mining activities.
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Support business development activities through both leading pursuits and developing strong relationships with existing clients
* Contribute in development of intellectual capital in your industry of expertise
* Be a part of case teams to provide solutions to unstructured problems

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication, presentation and team building skills and experience in producing high quality reports, papers, and presentations
* Develop people through effective coaching and mentoring
* Experience in executing and managing research and analysis of companies and markets trends, preferably from a commercial due diligence standpoint
* Contribute to people-related initiatives including recruiting, retaining, appraisal and training
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop skills of team members and self

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA/MBA/M.Sc./B.Tech with a minimum 8+ years of consulting / auditing experience
* Manage complex S4HANA transformation projects and drive delivery of SAP GRC and Security solutions
* Drive client discussions to design robust SAP GRC solutions for complex SAP landscapes
* Rich experience in strategizing GRC architecture, implementing key controls and driving innovations within the projects
* Good exposure to designing processes for managing key controls within the organisation
* Experience in at least 4-6 implementation, upgrade or migration projects for SAP GRC and has led at least 1 end to end S4HANA implementation or migration project
* Ability to independently lead/drive pursuits and sales discussions
* Should be able to independently drive strategic initiatives within the firm
* Preferable and added advantage, comfortable with SAP Security architecture and implementations, ability to design robust SAP Security solutions for complex SAP landscapes
* Good to have experience managing ITGC framework and logical access review/assessments, defining the best practices/KPIs for configuration and settings of change management and logical access controls, assessing current ITGC controls and deliver remediation roadmaps
* Good exposure to regulatory requirements like SOx, GDPR, GxP etc. and its impact on SAP GRC solutions
* Exposure to GRC products other than SAP will be an added advantage (For e.g. Oracle GRC,Archer, ServiceNow GRC, IBM Open pages etc.)
* Clear understanding of project lifecycle managements for e.g. SDLC, Agile and its deliverables
* Project management skills
* Good knowledge of MS Office tools
* Good to have certifications - CISA, PMP, SAFe Agilist, SAP GRC AC, SAP Security professional or SAP authorization and auditing
* Innovative mindset to drive automation agenda within the team
* Exposure to RPA transformation program approach and understanding of RPA tools like Blue Prism, UI Path
* Working knowledge of analytical tools and software to support data analysis and visualization engagements

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
