title: Universal Banker
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our
  
  
customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening
  
  
up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
  
  
**Role Purpose**

* To plan, direct and control the branch customer interface functions in the front office and teller areas in order to achieve a high level of customer satisfaction together with operational efficiency.
* To develop and implement service and cross sell discipline and assist in developing service and cross sell culture in the service team.

Customers / Stakeholders
  
  

* Ensure a consistently high level of service and product delivery.
* Anticipating customer needs and working with sales team to respond appropriately.
* Coach the team to achieve business goals and effectively meet customer needs
* Share all examples of best practise to drive overall customer experience.

Leadership & Teamwork
  
  

* Manage, develop and coach all customer facing sales and service staff, creating an environment to exceed individual and branch goals.
* Ensure visibility on the bank floor and facilitate excellent customer service.
* Display high standards around HSBC values and behaviour.

Role
  
  

* Service proposition is a key differentiator in any retail business, and the jobholder needs to ensure a positive customer experience on a consistent basis. The jobholder needs to manage the branch independently (when required) and should be sensitive to managing teams and conflicts therein. The CSM needs to manage the platform service stream, and ensure increase in customer service quality
* Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.
* Demonstrates leadership on regulatory and compliance matters. Maintains awareness of risk and minimizes the likelihood of it occurring through its identification, assessment, mitigation and control.
* Coverage & Management of all aspects of branch
* Cross Sell of bank products
* Lobby Management

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
**Additional Notes**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:

title: Business Operations & FP&A Analyst
description:
**Business Operations & FP&A Analyst (India)**

Job Description

**Team**

Finance / FP&A

**Location**

India (hybrid), with overlap with EST Hours

**Reports to**

Sr. Director Strategic Finance

**About the Role**
==================

We're looking for a sharp, adaptable analyst to be a force multiplier for the finance team. You'll take recurring monthly work and make it repeatable, documented, and faster each cycle. You'll also help turn data into clear narratives for leadership. This is not a "run the report and send it" role. We want someone who asks why we do something this way and proposes a better more efficient and repeatable solution.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**1. Build sustainable processes and SOPs (core focus)**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Document how monthly and weekly deliverables are produced, step by step, so anyone could run them.
* Turn manual, tribal-knowledge workflows into standardized, repeatable processes with clear inputs, owners, checks, and timelines.
* Identify bottlenecks, error-prone steps, and automation opportunities, then recommend and implement improvements.
* Maintain a living SOP library and keep it current as processes change.

**2. Monthly FP&A reporting support**
-------------------------------------

* Support the monthly P&E financial dashboard update and the review materials that go with it.
* Assist with spend allocation work, such as mapping AI and token spend to managers and departments, with gross vs. capitalized views.
* Run reasonableness checks, flag variances, and reconcile to prior periods before anything goes out.

**3. Market intelligence**
--------------------------

* Compile the weekly earnings and market intelligence report from public company earnings materials and transcripts.
* Summarize key themes, pull relevant takeaways, and organize them into a clean, leadership-ready format.
* Track competitors and industry developments, and flag what matters to our business.

**4. Deck and presentation creation**
-------------------------------------

* Build and polish on-brand PowerPoint decks from raw data and rough outlines.
* Turn analysis into clear visuals, tables, and storylines that fit brand standards.
* Prepare recurring leadership and board-style materials on schedule.

**5. Challenge and improve**
----------------------------

* Pressure-test assumptions, definitions, and methods. Respectfully push back when something doesn't make sense.
* Bring a point of view, not just output.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Must-haves**
--------------

* 3 to 5 years in FP&A, finance operations, business operations, strategy, or analytics (flexible for the right candidate).
* Affinity towards AI and integrating into daily workflows
* Advanced Excel: lookups, pivots, multi-tab models, and structured formatting. Comfortable with large, messy datasets.
* Strong written communication. You can write an SOP a stranger could follow.
* Strong PowerPoint skills and an eye for clean, consistent design.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work.
* Comfortable with ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined ask and structure it yourself.

**Nice-to-haves**
-----------------

* Experience with HRIS or payroll data (Paycom, Workday) and ERP or accounting systems (Sage).
* Familiarity with software capitalization concepts.
* Experience with AI tools (Claude or similar) to speed up analysis, documentation, and drafting.
* Basic SQL, Python, or automation experience.
* Background in healthcare, payments, or SaaS.

**Who Thrives Here**
====================

* Nimble: You're comfortable switching between a headcount reconciliation, a deck, and a research summary in the same week.
* Adaptable: Priorities shift and you adjust without losing quality.
* A free thinker: You question the process, offer alternatives, and aren't afraid to disagree.
* Ownership-minded: You see a task through, flag risks early, and improve what you touch.
* Collaborative: You work well across time zones and with finance, HR, and product and engineering partners.

**How Success Is Measured**
===========================

* Monthly deliverables are accurate, on time, and need minimal rework.
* Every recurring process has an up-to-date SOP, and turnaround times keep dropping.
* Decks and reports are leadership-ready with light review.
* You regularly surface process improvements and ideas you've initiated yourself.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The FRTB Market Risk Business Analyst role sits at the center of how Citi manages risk across its trading book, turning complex market risk frameworks into clear, actionable policy. In this role, you will develop and oversee risk policies that keep portfolios healthy, compliant, and aligned with global and regional requirements. Your analysis and policy governance will directly inform credit and market risk decisions that protect Citi, its clients, and its reputation.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage market risk policy under the FRTB framework for assigned product portfolios to maintain overall portfolio health.
* Develop and interpret risk frameworks and policies that guide credit and market risk decisions across the business.
* Partner with regional risk teams to secure policy approvals and confirm alignment with global and regional policy requirements.

* Track policy implementation progress and report status updates to key stakeholders.
* Identify obstacles to policy execution and resolve them to keep programs on schedule.

* Assess risk in business decisions and escalate control issues with transparency to protect Citi, its clients, and its assets.

* Has worked as a risk policy officer or in a similar risk management role.
* Understands market trends, risk management practices, and portfolio strategy.
* Has experience developing risk policies and assessing and mitigating financial risk.
* Analyzes and interprets data to support portfolio monitoring and sound risk decisions.
* Navigates regulatory requirements and compliance considerations across financial services and communicates findings clearly to stakeholders.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

Join a global risk organization where your policy expertise directly shapes how Citi manages market risk across its trading book.

* Work in a hybrid arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.
* Shape governance and policy decisions that influence risk outcomes across global and regional portfolios.

title: Risk Manager / Senior Manager – Infrastructure (InvIT)
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Risk Manager / Senior Manager with strong hands-on exposure to Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) and Roads & Highways infrastructure. The incumbent will be responsible for identifying, assessing, monitoring and mitigating financial, operational, commercial and regulatory risks across the InvIT portfolio and underlying project SPVs.

**The role will work closely with**
Finance, Investment Management, Asset Management, Operations, Legal, lenders, rating agencies, the Trustee, NHAI and other external stakeholders to strengthen the overall risk management framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Risk Identification & Assessment**

* Identify and assess enterprise, project-level and asset-level risks across road and highway assets.
* Conduct risk assessments for new asset acquisitions, investments, refinancing and operational SPVs.
* Monitor key macro and sectoral risks including traffic, toll revenue, regulatory changes, EPC and O&M contracts.
* Develop risk mitigation plans and track their implementation and effectiveness.

**2. InvIT & Regulatory Risk**

* Monitor compliance with applicable SEBI InvIT Regulations, NHAI concession agreements, lender covenants and other regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with the Investment Manager, Trustee, Valuer and relevant stakeholders on InvIT risk reporting.
* Support risk and commercial due diligence for asset acquisitions, investments, refinancing and divestments.
* Monitor regulatory, contractual and concession-related developments that may impact the portfolio.

**3. Financial & Commercial Risk**

* Analyse traffic risk, toll revenue risk, revenue leakage, O&M cost overruns, interest-rate risk and refinancing risk.
* Perform cash-flow stress testing, scenario analysis and DSCR assessment for road/highway assets.
* Evaluate project and asset-level financial risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Review insurance coverage, claims, business continuity and contingency plans.
* Assess financial and commercial risks associated with BOT, HAM and Toll-based project structures.

**4. Risk Governance & Reporting**

* Develop, maintain and periodically review the Risk Management Framework, Risk Register and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs).
* Establish effective risk monitoring and escalation mechanisms across the InvIT portfolio.
* Prepare risk reports and presentations for the Board, Audit Committee, Investment Committee, lenders and senior management.
* Coordinate with internal audit, external auditors and other assurance functions on risk-related matters.
* Track risk observations, action plans and closure of identified gaps.

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Liaise with NHAI, lenders, rating agencies, EPC contractors, O&M contractors, Investment Managers, Trustees and other stakeholders on risk-related matters.
* Partner closely with Finance, Legal, Operations, Asset Management and Investment teams.
* Provide risk inputs for strategic, investment and portfolio-management decisions.
* Present risk insights, stress-test outcomes and mitigation plans to senior management and relevant committees.

**Must-Have Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: CA / MBA Finance / M.Com or equivalent qualification.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in Risk Management, Infrastructure, Project Finance, InvITs, Infrastructure Funds, PE Funds or large Road/Highway Developers.
* Mandatory hands-on experience with InvIT structures and Roads / Highways infrastructure assets.
* Strong understanding of project finance, financial risk assessment and infrastructure project structures.
* Relevant Risk Management certification is preferred.

**Key Skills & Technical Competencies**

• SEBI InvIT Regulations and regulatory compliance

• NHAI policies, concession agreements and highway operations

• BOT / HAM / Toll-based project structures

• Financial modelling and cash-flow risk analysis

• DSCR analysis, stress testing and scenario analysis

• Traffic and toll revenue risk assessment

• Project finance and lender covenant monitoring

• Risk Management Framework, Risk Register and KRI/KPI development

• Governance, Board / Audit Committee reporting and presentation

• Senior stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience with listed InvITs.
* Experience working with Investment Managers, Trustees, lenders and / or rating agencies.
* Exposure to asset acquisition / divestment due diligence.
* Experience in refinancing and financial restructuring of infrastructure assets.
* FRM / IRM or other relevant Risk Management certification will be an advantage.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate will be a finance / risk professional who combines strong risk management capability with practical understanding of infrastructure assets and InvIT structures. Candidates from
**InvITs, Infrastructure Investment Managers, Road / Highway Developers, Infrastructure Funds, Project Finance teams or Infrastructure-focused PE / Funds**
with hands-on experience in asset-level financial analysis and risk assessment will be highly relevant.

**Candidate Targeting – Priority Backgrounds**

* Listed / unlisted InvITs and Investment Managers
* Road & Highway Developers / concessionaires
* Infrastructure-focused PE / Infrastructure Funds
* Project Finance / Infrastructure Finance teams
* Risk Management teams within infrastructure businesses
* Candidates with combined exposure to InvIT + Roads/Highways + financial modelling / project finance

About You: Competencies and Experience

* Independent, analytical mind with an excellent track record of applying sound financial judgment to complex issues.
* An ability to work under pressure and tight deadlines.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including fluency in English
* High attention to detail and strong organizational ability to be highly organised.
* Flexibility, professionalism, enthusiasm for working as part of a team, and ability to interact with diverse people.

About You: Personal Attributes

* You have an independent, analytical mind with a track record of applying sound strategic judgment to complex issues
* You are able to interact with high-level external stakeholders independently
* You have strong quantitative, data management, data analysis, critical thinking, and team management skills
* You have exceptional attention to detail, organization, time management, and prioritization skills, and an ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
* You are an advanced user of the MS Office suite, in particular Excel, and can learn and adapt to new systems
* You have outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including fluency in English
* You are willing to travel internationally/domestically

CPI is recruiting for one full-time position of Senior Associate - Contract & Operations (40 hours) to be based in our New Delhi office.

description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
.
  
  
Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
  
  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

**How You Will Contribute**
As Senior Associate, you will be working closely with Directors, Senior Directors and Managing Directors in a flat team structure. You will likely lead key Commercial Due Diligence / Operational Due Diligence (CDD/ODD) work streams and benefit from constant exposure to the senior members of the team and client, and gain ‘on-the-job’ learning and development, leveraging on their substantial experience. You come with a proven track record in due diligence experience, consulting case experience, market research, IP development. This role involves hands-on analysis and development client ready output to drive strategic decision-making for our corporate and private equity clients. The ideal candidate will combine functional & technical expertise with strong individual contributor skills to deliver impactful solutions across various TDI domains
  
  
Considering the pace of targeted growth, we are keen to find people who are entrepreneurial, driven by a passion to drive significant growth (people who can think in multiples of growth rather than percentages), are comfortable with ambiguity, will roll up the sleeves and be hands on to get things done and can be independent requiring limited cover.
  
  
The role will be initially based in Gurgaon. However, the person should be open to travel as and when needed and should be open to relocate to any location our Capability Center scales and decide to relocate.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead CDD/ODD delivery for Telecom & Digital Infrastructure (TDI) engagements
  
  

* Collaborate with clients and onshore case teams to gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into due diligence specifications and process improvements, especially within telecom and digital infrastructure contexts. You will focus onOwn and drive workstreams within
* Commercial Due Diligence (market sizing, competitive positioning, customer/churn analysis, growth thesis testing) and Operational Due Diligence (cost structure, network/ infrastructure efficiency, OSS/BSS maturity, organizational capability, synergy identification) for telecom and digital infrastructure targets

* Support post-diligence value creation planning where engagements extend into implementation
* Supporting sales and proposal efforts by developing domain-specific expertise, thought leadership, and market perspective
* Own medium to complex work-streams with support from supervisors
* Work with different analytical tools with focus on building expertise in Power BI, Alteryx/ Python, Excel and PowerPoint

Own stakeholder relationships
  
  

* Own stakeholder relationships
* Interpret, understand and break-down client data/ requirements and project goals across various scenarios and adapt to them
* Communicate information/ insights, and the impact of the analyses to the clients and internal team
* Manage important work streams and own key business processes to solve client problems
* Participate & Lead meetings with senior clients, A&M Managing Directors, and third parties about your workstreams. Lead pitch preparation with senior staff and support business development and marketing efforts

Prioritization and Growing A&M
  
  

* Identifying project needs and milestones to manage & accomplish assigned work by agreed deadlines
* Collaborate with team members to create and deliver client outputs
* Contribute to office management roles (such as trainings, marketing, recruitments etc.) Qualifica

**Qualifications**

* MBA graduate with 3-8 years of experience within a leading functional & strategy Consulting/ operational Consulting house is preferable
* Hands-on experience delivering CDD/ODD engagements preferably on US-based deals or for US clients
* Strong understanding of the Telecom & Digital Infrastructure industry across sub-sectors (such as Wireless, Wireline, Towers, Fiber, Data Centers, Managed Services, etc.), value chain, growth drivers, and how investors evaluate assets in the space
* Familiarity with the US telecom/digital infra competitive and regulatory landscape, including key players, consolidation trends, and the deal structures typical to the sector (carve-outs, infrastructure funds, platform build-ups, etc.)
* Track record of leading or co-leading diligence workstreams end-to-end: hypothesis design, data room navigation, management interviews, and synthesis into client-ready findings
* Technical Skills
* PowerPoint skills - preparation of defect-free, high-quality client presentations
* Excel modelling skills - structure data within Excel in a way to draw conclusions and support timely decision making with our clients
* Experience working in tools such as Alteryx or Python for data analysis, and Power BI or Tableau for data visualization is a strong plus
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, business acumen, writing, research and presentation-building skills; attention to detail and striving to produce defect free deliverables
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
* Guide/ mentor Analysts and Associates during projects and business development work
* A strong team player and demonstrated ability to motivate team members
* Ability to prioritize - especially in highly pressured situations
* High integrity that is characterized by the ability to deliver messages even when they are difficult to hear
* Ability to quickly understand and piece together very vast or very limited amounts of data and to draw certain conclusions/actions from it

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Finance Executive
description:
**WE ARE HIRING**

**FINANCE EXECUTIVE**

**CureAble | Delhi NCR | Full-Time**

CureAble is looking for a Finance Executive who can take ownership of day-to-day finance operations while also helping management understand what the numbers are telling us.

We are not looking for someone who only does accounting entries.

We are looking for someone who can:
**Maintain the numbers → Analyse the numbers → Find the gaps → Give business insights.**

🎯
**ROLE: FINANCE EXECUTIVE**

Department: Finance & Accounts Experience: 1–3 Years Employment Type: Full-Time Location: Delhi NCR Reporting To: Head of Admin / Management

🧩
**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

1. Zoho Books Management

You will be responsible for maintaining and managing the company's day-to-day financial records on Zoho Books. Your responsibilities will include:

● Maintaining accurate accounting records

● Creating and managing invoices

● Recording customer payments and receipts

● Recording expenses and vendor payments

● Maintaining customer and vendor ledgers

● Managing Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable

● Bank reconciliation

● Payment reconciliation

● Identifying and correcting accounting discrepancies

● Keeping Zoho Books updated and accurate

● Generating financial reports from Zoho Books Strong hands-on knowledge of Zoho Books is mandatory.

📊
**2**
.
**Financial Reporting & MIS**

You should be able to independently prepare and understand basic financial reports, including:

● Profit & Loss Statement

● Balance Sheet

● Cash Flow Statement

● Revenue Report

● Expense Report

● Accounts Receivable Report

● Accounts Payable Report

● Outstanding Receivables Report

● Ageing Report

● Budget vs Actual Report

● Monthly Finance MIS You should not just prepare reports — you should be able to explain them.

💡
**3. Financial Analysis & Business Insights**

This is a critical part of the role. You will be expected to analyse financial data and provide management with meaningful insights. For example:

● Why did revenue increase or decrease?

● Why did profit change?

● Why are receivables increasing?

● Where is cash getting blocked?

● Which expenses have increased?

● Which expenses can be controlled?

● Are collections keeping pace with revenue?

● Are there any unusual transactions or financial discrepancies?

● What financial risks should management be aware of?

You should be able to move beyond: “This is the number.” and explain: “This is why the number changed, this is what it means for the business, and this is what we should do next.”

💰
**4. Receivables & Payables Management**

You will be responsible for keeping a clear view of:

● Customer outstanding payments

● Vendor outstanding payments

● Invoice ageing

● Overdue payments

● Expected collections

● Upcoming payments

● Customer/vendor reconciliation

● Payment follow-ups and coordination You will ensure that management has a clear understanding of how much money is receivable, how much is payable and where cash is getting blocked.

🧾
**5. Invoice & Expense Management**

● Create and verify invoices

● Record invoices accurately

● Track invoice status

● Record expenses

● Verify supporting documents

● Categorise expenses correctly

● Track recurring and one-time expenses

● Identify unusual or incorrect expenses

● Maintain proper financial documentation

🏦
**6. Bank & Account Reconciliation**

You will independently handle:

● Bank reconciliation

● Customer ledger reconciliation

● Vendor ledger reconciliation

● Payment reconciliation

● Identifying unmatched transactions

● Identifying duplicate entries

● Resolving financial mismatches Accuracy and attention to detail are extremely important.

📅
**7. Monthly Closing**

You will support and eventually independently manage the monthly finance closing process. This includes: ● Ensuring all invoices are recorded

● Ensuring all expenses are recorded

● Recording all payments

● Completing bank reconciliation

● Reviewing receivables and payables

● Checking outstanding balances

● Reviewing P&L

● Reviewing Balance Sheet

● Preparing cash position

● Identifying major variances

● Preparing monthly finance summary

📈
**8. Management Finance Reporting**

Every month, you will provide a clear financial summary covering: Revenue | Collections | Expenses | Receivables | Payables | Profitability | Cash Flow | Key Variances | Key Insights

You should be able to highlight: What happened? Why did it happen? What is the financial impact? What action should we take?

🛠
**REQUIRED SKILLS MUST HAVE**

● Strong hands-on knowledge of Zoho Books

● Basic accounting knowledge

● Understanding of P&L

● Understanding of Balance Sheet

● Understanding of Cash Flow

● Accounts Receivable

● Accounts Payable

● Bank reconciliation

● Ledger reconciliation

● Invoice management

● Expense management

● Financial reporting

● Financial analysis

● Excel / Google Sheets

GOOD TO HAVE

● GST knowledge

● TDS knowledge

● MIS reporting

● Budgeting & forecasting

● Payroll accounting

● Experience with Zoho ecosystem

● Experience in a service-based organisation

🧠
**WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

We are looking for someone who is:

1. Detail-Oriented

You notice discrepancies instead of overlooking them.

2. Analytical

You understand what the numbers mean, not just how to enter them.

3. Business-Minded

You understand how finance impacts business decisions.

4. Proactive

You identify problems before management has to ask about them.

5. Accountable

You take ownership of financial accuracy and closure.

6. Confidential & Trustworthy

You will handle sensitive financial and business information.

7. Good at Communication

You can explain financial information in simple business language.

📊 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Your performance will be measured on:

● 98–100% accounting accuracy

● 100% timely bank reconciliation

● Accurate and timely invoicing

● Weekly receivables/outstanding tracking

● Timely monthly closing

● Timely financial reporting

● Accurate financial MIS

● Identification of discrepancies

● Reduction in unresolved financial mismatches

● 3–5 actionable financial insights every month

● Timely escalation of financial risks

🚫
**THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...**

● You only want to do data entry

● You don't understand P&L

● You cannot read a Balance Sheet

● You have never done bank reconciliation

● You have only theoretical knowledge of Zoho Books

● You need constant supervision

● You don't analyse financial data

● You cannot explain why numbers change

● You don't take ownership of discrepancies

⭐
**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Within your first few months, you should be able to independently manage: Zoho Books → Invoicing → Payments → Expenses → Reconciliation → Receivables → Payables → Financial Reports → Analysis → Management Insights

The ultimate expectation is simple:

**Don't just maintain the company's books. Understand the company's financial health and help management make better decisions through numbers.**

📩
**HOW TO APPLY**

If you believe you can take
**ownership of finance operations and turn financial data into meaningful business insights,**
we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and relevant experience in Zoho Books, accounting, financial reporting and analysis. CureAble Building a stronger, more structured and data-driven child development ecosystem.

**Interested Candidates can apply at: care@cureable.in**

Derivative SMEs are primarily responsible for the timely and accurate execution and reporting of derivative processing that impacts net asset valuations (NAVs) for our clients’ accounts (funds).
  
  
****Why This Role Is Important To Us:****
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Services (SSGS). SSGS gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGS’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

As a derivative SME, you are primarily responsible for the timely and accurate execution and reporting derivative activities that impact to net asset valuations (NAVs) for our clients’ accounts (funds). The derivative SME identifies, analyzes and substantiates impacts of derivatives to the NAV. Critical functions performed include the processing of and verification of all derivative activities and reflecting the same in system to be captured by downstream teams, assisting in addressing derivative queries and participating in various programs with derivatives requirement. This could extend to assist in data analysis, test performing and various new products onboarding, etc.

* Research and resolve exceptions, reconciliations, incorrect transactions, and issues.
* Receive and resolve inquiries in a timely and accurate manner and communicate effectively with clients when necessary.
* Escalate unresolved issues to management as required.
* Maintain appropriate records of daily and monthly activities.
* Support the production of financial, performance, and/or quality reports for clients, shareholders, directors, and management as needed.
* Maintain knowledge of current alternative procedures and processes.
* Document any updates or changes to formal procedures, databases, etc.
* Prepare and verify information for various projects or special requests as directed.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite

title: Accounts Executive - Part-Time (Remote)
description:
**Company Description**

VentraGate is a cloud-focused solutions and services firm specializing in designing, building, and maintaining digital transformation and cloud-based technologies that customers value and enjoy using. The company operates as a transformation consultancy, supporting organizations of all sizes in becoming faster, more agile, and more competitive in their markets. VentraGate partners closely with clients to modernize their operations and technology landscapes through innovative cloud strategies. Team members collaborate in a dynamic environment focused on continuous improvement, customer success, and long-term digital growth.

**Location:**

Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 

**Work Mode:**

Part-Time - Primarily Remote 

**Working Hours:**

6 Hours per Week 

**Office Visits:**

Occasional visits to the Coimbatore office as required

 

**Role Description**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Part-Time Accounts Executive**
to manage our day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting activities using Zoho Books.
 

The role primarily involves maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring timely recording of invoices and expenses, coordinating with the office admin for collection of bills and supporting documents, and working closely with the auditor to ensure timely GST, TDS, and other statutory payments and compliance requirements.
 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Zoho Books, a good understanding of accounting practices, and the ability to independently manage accounting activities with minimal supervision.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Bookkeeping & Accounting**

 

* Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting activities using Zoho Books.
* Record sales invoices, purchase bills, expenses, receipts, payments, and other financial transactions accurately.
* Maintain updated and organized financial records in Zoho Books.
* Perform regular bank, vendor, and ledger reconciliations.
* Review accounting entries to ensure accuracy and completeness.

**2. Invoice & Expense Management**

 

* Coordinate with the Office Admin to collect all vendor invoices, bills, expense statements, and supporting documents.
* Ensure all invoices and expenses are recorded in Zoho Books on a timely basis.
* Track pending invoices, payments, and outstanding receivables and payables.
* Maintain proper documentation of financial transactions.

**3. GST, TDS & Statutory Compliance**

 

* Work closely with the auditor to ensure timely GST and TDS payments and statutory compliance.
* Coordinate and provide the required accounting records, invoices, and supporting documents to the auditor.
* Track statutory payment and filing deadlines and follow up to ensure timely completion.
* Assist with GST and TDS reconciliations and related documentation.
* Ensure accounting records are updated and readily available for audit and compliance purposes.

**4. Reporting & Other Accounting Activities**

* Prepare periodic financial summaries and reports as required by management.
* Monitor accounts payable, and outstanding balances.
* Identify discrepancies in accounting records and take necessary corrective action.

title: GRC Lead
description:
**About The Role**
You will be our first compliance hire and will build one integrated compliance program covering SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, GDPR, HIPAA and ISO 42001. You will write the policies, map the controls, collect the evidence, and sit across the table from the auditors yourself. You will also help sales close enterprise deals by answering security questionnaires.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Run a gap assessment across all six frameworks and build one unified control set with cross-mapping, so each control is tested once and reused.
* Be the admin of frameworks and custom controls, control-to-test mapping, the policy module (approval, versioning, acceptance campaigns), training tracking, the risk register, vendor risk management, the data inventory and DPIAs, and the auditor workspace.
* Write and maintain the ISMS: scope, Statement of Applicability, information security policies, procedures and the risk methodology.
* Run the risk register and risk treatment plans; present risk status to the leadership every quarter.
* Lead external audits end to end: pick auditors and certification bodies, plan the SOC 2 observation window, run ISO Stage 1 and Stage 2, and close findings.
* Run internal audits and management reviews required by ISO 27001, 27701 and 42001.
* Build the privacy program: RoPA, DPIAs, DSAR process, cross-border transfers (SCCs), DPAs with customers and vendors, breach notification.
* Run HIPAA readiness if PHI is in scope: risk analysis, BAAs, safeguards mapping.
* Stand up the ISO 42001 AI management system: AI policy, AI system inventory, AI risk and impact assessments, and controls over model and data lifecycle.
* Run third-party risk management: vendor tiering, security reviews, subprocessor list.
* Answer customer security questionnaires with Vanta Questionnaire Automation and run the Vanta Trust Center; maintain the answer library and knowledge base.
* Run policy training, tabletop exercises, and BCP/DR test documentation.

Must have
  
  

* 6+ years in GRC, IT audit or security compliance, 2+ of them in-house at a SaaS or cloud company.
* Led at least one SOC 2 Type II audit and one ISO 27001 certification from start to finish.
* Working knowledge of GDPR and ISO 27701; practical exposure to HIPAA.
* Enough technical depth in AWS, GCP or Azure, IAM, logging and CI/CD to judge whether evidence is real.
* Strong policy writing and the ability to explain controls to engineers in plain terms.
* Comfortable working alone and pushing work across teams without authority.

Good to have
  
  

* Certifications: ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CISA, CISM, CIPP/E or CIPM, ISO 42001 Lead Implementer, CRISC.
* Exposure to ISO 42001, the EU AI Act or the NIST AI RMF.
* Background in a Big Four or audit firm plus in-house experience.
* Experience with Indian DPDP Act requirements.

description:
**Know The Company**
PeepalCo is a canopy for brands serving India with tailored wealth-tech products, Making Money Equal for All. Founded by Ashish Singhal, Govind Soni, and Vimal Sagar Tiwari, PeepalCo's products include CoinSwitch and Lemonn. The Group is backed by blue-chip investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Tiger Global, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Ribbit Capital, Paradigm, and Coinbase Ventures.
  
  
PeepalCo is the brand name for our Group entity and will house all our wealth-tech brands. The largest of our brands, CoinSwitch, Lemonn will be housed under PeepalCo.
  
  
For more information, visit: https://peepal.co | For media queries, contact: press@peepal.co
  
  
**About The Role**
You will be responsible for the end-to-end compliance lifecycle, from product development and marketing approvals to real-time surveillance and regulatory reporting. This is a hands-on role requiring a mix of regulatory expertise, analytical rigour, and a "product-first" mindset.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Advertisement & Marketing Approval**

* Review and provide compliance sign-off on all marketing collateral, social media content, and app notifications.
* Liaise with Stock Exchanges (NSE/BSE/MCX) for prior approval of advertisements and ensuring adherence to the latest SEBI Code of Advertisement.

**Regulatory Intelligence (Circular Management)**

* Daily tracking of SEBI and Exchange circulars.
* Interpret and disseminate impact analysis to relevant departments (Product, Tech, Ops).
* Drive the implementation of new guidelines within the specified timelines.

**Surveillance & AML**

* Monitor and resolve real-time surveillance alerts to detect and report suspicious trading patterns or market abuse.
* Oversee the AML/KYC framework, including risk categorization, PMLA reporting (STR/CTR), and periodic audits of the onboarding flow.

**Audits & Inspections**

* Manage and coordinate Internal Audits, System Audits, and Concurrent Audits.
* Act as the primary point of contact for SEBI/Exchange Inspections, ensuring data accuracy and timely submission of responses.

**Reporting & Filings**

* Ensure 100% adherence to the Compliance Calendar (Daily, Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual filings).
* Monitor the investor grievance redressal system (SCORES/internal) and drive prompt resolution.

**Product Compliance**

* Perform Pre-Prod Audits on new features (e.g., F&O, MTF, SIP) to ensure they meet the "Compliant-by-Design" standard.
* Provide sign-off on control testing reports before any feature goes live.

**What You Should Have**

* Experience: 5-8 years of core experience in Stock Broking Compliance (Fintech/Digital Broking experience is a massive plus).
* Domain Expertise: Subject Matter Expert in SEBI (Stock Broker) Regulations, 2026, PMLA guidelines, and Exchange Bylaws.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze complex trading data and "see" procedural risks before they become issues.
* Communication: Ability to communicate technical regulatory requirements to non-compliance teams (Tech/Design) clearly and precisely.
* Execution: Proven ability to plan and execute compliance projects/audits single-handedly.

**Qualifications**

* Mandatory: MBA, Professional degree in Finance, Commerce, or a related field ( CA, CS ) etc
* Plus: NISM Certificates

**Life at PeepalCo**
We take great pride in what we do and are committed to our mission. And we have a lot of fun while at it!
  
  
**Here’s How We Do Things At PeepalCo**

* Customer-first: That’s the North Star. Everything we do is to make our users’ investment experience better and simplified.
* Ownership: We don’t sport lab coats, but we experiment—a lot. And we take ownership. We even have a catchphrase for this: Think big, fail fast, and build better.
* Data-driven: The source of truth. Simple as that.
* Fun: PS5, anyone? Or do you prefer Foosball? Or perhaps Carrom? And yes, our HR team has a whole list of activities: Disco nights, offsites, gift boxes, and more!

Speaking of lists, the perks and benefits are so extensive, this space isn’t enough. Here are a few:
  
  

* Parenthood: Up to 8 months of Maternity leave and 1 month of Paternity leave
* Gender Reassignment Surgery: Be the best version of you! We’ll support you and reimburse your medical bill.

*Disclaimer: We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.*

title: Associate Director Institutional NFR Transaction Banking
description:
**About Us**
**Institutional**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
At
**Associate Directo**
**r**
level, the role is responsible for the identification, assessment, management, monitoring and reporting of material non-financial risks across the end-to-end product, platform and client lifecycle. The incumbent will help strengthen the control environment for Transaction Banking products and digital capabilities, support product design and change execution, contribute to client implementation and delivery risk management, regulatory readiness and incident learnings, and escalate material matters as appropriate.
  
  
This role is responsible for helping manage non-financial risk across Transaction Banking products, including Payments and Cash Management, Trade and Digital Payments. The role acts as a trusted risk partner to product, sales, implementation, operations, technology and digital delivery stakeholders, providing practical risk advice and execution support to enable safe, sustainable and customer-focused growth.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type: Permanent
  
  
Role Location: Bengaluru
  
  
Work Hours: 7AM to 4PM**
**What will your day look like?**
As an
**Associate Director Institutional NFR GCC Transaction Banking**
, you will:
  
  

* Act as a trusted non-financial risk partner to Transaction Banking product and digital businesses, providing practical guidance on product strategy, client solutions, commercialisation, platform delivery and change initiatives
* Provide analysis, advice and constructive challenge on product and digital risk profiles, control effectiveness, customer outcomes and risk in change across Payments and Cash Management, Trade, Digital Payments, client channels, connectivity solutions and related Transaction Banking capabilities
* Support the identification, assessment, monitoring and reporting of material non-financial risks across the end-to-end Transaction Banking product and platform lifecycle, including operational, compliance, technology, cyber, data, fraud, third-party, conduct, financial crime and resilience risks
* Contribute to uplift in product, platform and channel controls, risk indicators, governance, documentation and management information to strengthen transparency, ownership and control effectiveness
* Support quality and timely completion of risk assessments, control assurance, issues management, incident response and remediation activities relevant to Transaction Banking products, platforms and digital capabilities
* Provide risk input and execution support for new product development, product enhancements, platform changes, digital payment capabilities, client implementations, trade and cash management solutions and strategic initiatives impacting Transaction Banking
* Support strong product and digital governance through quality forum papers, issue transparency, escalation and decision support for relevant stakeholders
* Partner with Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Implementation, Compliance, Legal, Financial Crime, 2LOD Risk and Internal Audit stakeholders to support aligned and effective non-financial risk outcomes
* Help embed strong first-line risk ownership and awareness across Transaction Banking product and digital teams by promoting practical, customer-focused and commercially aware risk management

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* 15+ years of expertise in Transaction Banking, with strong knowledge of products and client solutions
* Strong experience in transaction banking, with sound understanding of Payments and Cash Management, Trade and/or Digital Payments products, platforms, client journeys, servicing models and the end-to-end product lifecycle
* Strong knowledge of non-financial risk management within a large and complex financial services environment, including governance, risk assessment, controls, issues and incident management, risk reporting and risk in change
* Demonstrated knowledge of key risk exposures relevant to Transaction Banking products and digital channels, including operational resilience, technology and cyber dependencies, data, fraud, third-party risk, financial crime, conduct risk, regulatory compliance and customer outcome risks.
* Demonstrated ability to provide credible advice and constructive challenge to product, digital, operations and technology stakeholders on product risk, platform controls, control design and risk in change, escalating material matters where appropriate
* Experience supporting new product approvals, product changes, digital platform enhancements, client implementation risk assessments and governance processes in a controlled banking environment
* Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across business and control teams, simplify complex risk matters, and provide clear recommendations that support effective and sustainable risk outcomes
* Knowledge of domestic and cross-border payment rails, cash management structures, trade finance products, digital payment capabilities, client connectivity solutions, APIs and emerging payment industry standards
* Knowledge of digital risk and control frameworks, payment security, fraud prevention, operational resilience, and regulatory requirements, with experience supporting audit, compliance, and non-financial risk management activities within banking and Transaction Banking environments
* Experience using risk data and governance reporting to identify emerging risks, support decision-making, and drive timely actions
* Exposure to global Transaction Banking environments and familiarity with risk systems, governance frameworks, and control improvement initiative

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
  
  
To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number
**121384**
.

title: Analyst Global Trade Compliance
description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
  
  
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
  
  
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
  
  
As
**Analyst, Global Trade Compliance**
here at
**Illumina**
, you will support the delivery and continuous improvement of our global trade compliance program.
  
  
Working as part of the Global Trade Compliance organisation, you will provide analytical, operational and project support across a broad range of international trade activities.
  
  
The role will have exposure to key areas of trade compliance including
**tariff classification, country of origin, customs valuation, export controls and sanctions, licensing, import/export operations, customs compliance and trade data analytics**
. You will also support global governance, reporting, audit readiness and process improvement initiatives as priorities evolve.
  
  
You will collaborate with Global Trade Compliance colleagues across regions and partner with cross-functional teams including
**Supply Chain, Logistics, Legal, Tax, Finance, Procurement and other business functions**
to support compliant and efficient global trade operations.
  
  
As part of Illumina’s global trade compliance organisation, you will contribute to building scalable, data-driven and digitally enabled compliance capabilities while supporting Illumina’s mission to
**unlock the power of the genome to improve human health**
.
  
  
**Why You**
You are an analytical and curious professional with an interest in international trade and global business operations. You are comfortable working with
**data, systems and detailed regulatory information**
, while being able to translate findings into clear actions and insights.
  
  
You enjoy working across different topics and are comfortable operating in a global environment where priorities may evolve. You bring a structured, proactive approach, strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn and develop across multiple areas of global trade compliance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Fluent English is essential.**

* Provide analytical and operational support across global trade compliance programs and priorities
* Support activities relating to tariff classification, country of origin, customs valuation, export controls, sanctions and licensing requirements
* Conduct trade compliance and regulatory research and document findings, recommendations and supporting rationale
* Analyze customs, trade and compliance data to identify trends, exceptions, inconsistencies and potential areas of risk or improvement
* Support the development and maintenance of trade compliance reports, dashboards, KPIs and management information
* Support global governance and control activities, including compliance reviews, control testing, documentation and follow-up of identified actions
* Assist with audit and regulatory readiness, including evidence collection, data analysis and maintenance of supporting records
* Support the maintenance and improvement of trade compliance processes, procedures, guidance and documentation
* Participate in process improvement, automation, digitalization and system initiatives, including data validation and user acceptance testing where required
* Collaborate with regional Trade Compliance teams and cross-functional stakeholders to support global initiatives and resolve trade-related questions
* Support training, knowledge management and other trade compliance awareness activities
* Provide support across other Global Trade Compliance projects and priorities as business and regulatory needs evolve

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in International Trade, Supply Chain, Business, Law, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field
* Approximately 2–5 years of relevant professional experience in trade compliance, customs, import/export, supply chain, logistics, regulatory compliance, data analytics or a related area
* Understanding of international trade and customs concepts; experience in one or more areas such as tariff classification, customs valuation, country of origin, export controls, sanctions or licensing is preferred
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex datasets and identify patterns, exceptions and root causes
* Strong Excel skills; experience with data visualisation and analytics tools is an advantage
* Experience with ERP, customs or global trade management systems; SAP and SAP GTS experience is preferred
* Interest in technology, automation and the use of data to improve compliance processes
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple activities and priorities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions, cultures and time zones
* Experience within a multinational or matrix organization is an advantage
* Professional trade compliance or customs certifications are a plus

We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. title: International IP & Contracts Paralegal
description:
**Location: Hosur or Noida, India**

Global Water Solutions (GWS), one of the world’s leading manufacturers of pressure vessels, water enhancement and smart tap products, is looking for an organised, detail-oriented and proactive **International IP & Contracts Paralegal** to support our growing international business.

As GWS continues to expand globally, we are looking for an experienced professional to take ownership of the day-to-day administration and coordination of our international trademark portfolio, alongside contract and NDA management.

Working closely with GWS management, internal departments and external legal advisers across multiple jurisdictions, you will ensure our intellectual property is properly protected, legal documentation is accurately maintained and important deadlines, renewals and contractual obligations are effectively managed.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with IP and legal administration experience who enjoys working independently and coordinating international legal matters within a dynamic global business.

**Key responsibilities**

**Intellectual Property & Trademark Management**

* Maintain and manage GWS's global trademark register, covering ownership, registrations, classes, territories, status, deadlines, renewals, legal advisers and associated costs.
* Coordinate trademark filings through BOIP and the WIPO Madrid System, working with regional law firms on direct national applications where required.
* Manage trademark renewals, assignments, recordals and evidence-of-use requirements.
* Prepare and coordinate powers of attorney, declarations of authority, approval letters, filing instructions, supporting evidence and translations.
* Monitor office actions and provisional refusals, coordinating responses with internal stakeholders and external legal advisers, ensuring legal and commercial decisions are escalated appropriately and deadlines are met.
* Coordinate preliminary trademark searches and trademark watch notices with external counsel and relevant business teams.
* Maintain accurate filing records and provide a monthly management dashboard covering portfolio status, upcoming deadlines, risks and legal expenditure.

  

**Contracts & Legal Administration**

* Conduct initial reviews of contracts and NDAs using approved templates and guidelines, identifying deviations and referring substantive legal issues to qualified legal counsel.
* Manage the complete NDA process for suppliers and customers, including preparation from approved templates, internal approvals, signatures, document storage and expiry or renewal tracking.
* Maintain organised contract records and confidentiality documentation.
* Coordinate legal documentation and approvals with GWS management and internal departments, including Marketing, Finance and HR.
* Liaise with GWS legal colleagues and external lawyers across Taiwan, China, the United States, Luxembourg/Benelux and other international jurisdictions.

  

**Requirements & experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Law or a related discipline. A paralegal or intellectual property qualification would be an advantage.
* Approximately 3–7 years of relevant experience in trademark administration, intellectual property portfolio management, legal operations, contract administration or within an IP law firm.
* Practical knowledge of BOIP, WIPO/Madrid System filings, trademark classifications, renewals, office actions and provisional refusals is strongly preferred.
* Experience coordinating with international law firms, trademark agents and external legal advisers.
* Strong English drafting and communication skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Highly organised, discreet and capable of independently managing multiple deadlines across different jurisdictions.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and document management systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and external advisers across different countries and time zones.

  

**Why join GWS?**

At GWS, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of an important international function within a growing global business. Working closely with senior management and legal professionals across multiple countries, you will play a key role in protecting GWS's intellectual property and supporting its international commercial activities.

We offer a dynamic and friendly working environment where initiative, accountability and collaboration are valued. This is an opportunity to develop your international IP and legal operations expertise while making a meaningful contribution to the business.

* Please visit the Global Water Solutions company website, go to the careers section, and apply for the position through our BambooHR platform. https://globalwater.bamboohr.com/careers/

  

Last, but not least, if you’re curious to learn more about Global Water Solutions, feel free to visit our company website and LinkedIn page linked below.

title: QRM- Confidentiality & Privacy - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**CMAT**
CMAT, a key Strategic Enabler in our new model, is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Deloitte’s overall success. Whether focused on project financials, quality and risk management, methods and tools, sales excellence, talent, leadership support, or other activities these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people are able to effectively serve clients every day.
  
  
**Level:**
Senior Consultant
  
  
**Work you'll do**
Key job responsibilities include:
  
  

* Provide review and summary assessments based on key contractual documents (e.g., Master Services Agreement (MSA), Statement of Work, Amendment, Engagement Letter, Change Order, etc.)
* Review proposals and provide recommendations for terms that provide additional protections for data access, storage, and transfer
* Deployment of Confidential Information Management Plans (CIMPs) across accounts and engagements to all industries, Operating Portfolios, Products, and Acquisitions
* Prepare MSA summary, CIMP recommendations, and CI/CIMP training documentation
* Support the development and update of General Guidance, Market Offering Playbooks, and Account/Engagement CIMPs, as required
* Identify key contractual terms and requirements, including obligations and deliverables, related to CI terms
* Conduct Insider Risk investigations, evaluate risk indicators, analyze evidence, and drive timely resolution of cases in accordance with organizational policies and procedures
* Perform Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) reviews and assess associated risks
* Conduct privacy verification activities to evaluate requests, validate compliance requirements, and ensure adherence to data protection and privacy policies
* Facilitate live CIMP training sessions for practitioners and stakeholders, providing guidance on processes, controls, and compliance requirements
* Develop and maintain training materials, e-learning content, job aids, and awareness resources to support learning and adoption of risk and compliance programs
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance processes, deliver training initiatives, and promote a culture of risk awareness and regulatory compliance
* Deliver CI Program and provide customized CI training to account or engagement teams as required
* Follow up with accounts/engagement data managers on tracking CIMP development and fulfillment progress
* Attend calls with C&P Risk Managers identifying projects to be included in the CI Program
* Assist with C&P website updates, manage team mailbox responses, and develop reports and dashboards to showcase effective monitoring

**The team**
The mission of Quality and Risk Management (QRM) is to manage the risk in our growing and increasingly complex business to improve financial performance and protect the firm’s assets and reputation. The mission of the Consulting Services Office of Confidentiality & Privacy (C&P) within QRM is charged to protect the informational assets of Deloitte and our clients.
  
  
The Consulting Services Office of Confidentiality and Privacy (C&P) is responsible for managing confidential information risk by working directly with delivery leadership and personnel to ensure data security throughout the delivery data lifecycle. The C&P team is responsible for helping to expand the Confidential Information (CI) risk management capabilities across all Deloitte industries in Consulting Services. The Senior Consultant will support the deployment of the CI Program to Industry Accounts and Engagements, working with Consulting Services Risk Managers (RM) to identify CI contractual risks and perform CI risk assessments, including recommendations on risk mitigation strategies and protocols through the deployment of the Confidential Information Management Plan (CIMP). The C&P team is responsible for the mitigation of incidents and the investigation of Insider Risk Program (IRP) cases where professionals have been identified for exfiltrating Deloitte and client sensitive confidential information.
  
  
Location: Hyderabad/ Bengaluru/ Pune/ Chennai
  
  
Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree
* Experience: 10+ years of general contract interpretation and project management experience
* Deep understanding of risks associated with the delivery of professional consulting services and an ability to identify specific approaches to ameliorating such risks
* Basic understanding of cloud and AI applications, tools, methodologies, and software development process
* General understanding of contracts and ability to provide interpretation of contract terms
* Strong analytical, reading, and presentation skills
* Proven track record influencing diverse stakeholders and driving common outcomes with a strong understanding of commercial contracting processes, including terms and conditions
* Excellent leadership skills, including ability to prioritize critical needs, act decisively, and handle a high volume of complex tasks within a given timeframe
* Strong relationship and project management skills
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills
* Proficiency in the use of MS Office - Word, Excel (Formula/Pivot), PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint
* Ability to build reports and dashboards for leadership review
* Willingness to learn new technical skills such as Smartsheet, Deloitte approved AI tools, and others as identified by project leaders
* Precision and attention to detail with a relentless focus on persistent and timely follow-up
* Accessibility / availability to respond to an unpredictable environment
* Highly collaborative work ethic; committed to team success
* Ability to multi-task across various initiatives and activities and at times work independently
* Work with, manage, and accommodate colleagues in other time zones; flexibility to be on call for urgent matters
* Quick learner, eager to learn new skills and technologies and apply them quickly to produce results

Preferred:
  
  

* Masters’ Degree or data privacy certifications
* Understanding of the different types of sensitive data (PII, PHI, etc.), the associated risk profile of handling each type of data, and the appropriate risk mitigation strategies to be deployed
* Ability to evaluate risks associated with large professional service engagements
* Able to showcase expertise in using any productivity tools (includes AI)

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
